jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
Neuroscience & Rare Diseases represent a major focus area where we are committed to realizing our long-term vision of changing lives of patients with severe brain disorders. Our preclinical research and early clinical development activities center around large and rare indications. With unparalleled strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science into medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system.
To achieve our goals, we are seeking a Medical Director, focusing on multiple sclerosis.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will lead and/or support early-stage clinical projects from entry into a human through proof of mechanism and proof of concept, to transform molecules into new medicines in an area with huge unmet medical needs.
You will leverage your expertise to translate innovative molecules into potentially transformative therapies for patients with severe brain disorders. By marrying science and strategy, you will design rigorous and efficient clinical experiments that will support robust decision-making, to get promising therapies to patients as soon as possible.

Your main responsibilities are:

• Lead and/or support cross-functional teams to design and execute clinical development plans from Phase 1 through Phase 2 (proof-of-concept)

• Coach Clinical Scientists in a line- or functional-manager status

• Closely interface with project team leaders as well as safety, clinical pharmacology, clinical operations, biostatistics, regulatory, research and biomarker groups and other members of project teams

• Lead and/or support internal stakeholder management and governance interactions around project plans and therapeutic area strategy

• Lead and/or support external engagements with advisory boards, site investigators, health authorities, and other key stakeholders

• Provide clinical input to programs in discovery research

• Lead scientific communications and disseminate the results of clinical trials in the form of conference presentations and journal publications

Who you are

• You have an MD or MD/PhD with a speciality in neuroimmunology, multiple sclerosis, or a similar field. Board certification and fellowship training or research experience in relevant areas is preferred.

• You bring at least 5 years of experience in longitudinal clinical research, preferably in drug development or clinical trials.

• You hold a strong track record of scientific excellence in the field, evidenced by substantial achievement in designing and implementing clinical trials and/or a high level of scholarship in industry or academia.

• You have experience in clinical drug development within the industry, ideally in the early stages of clinical development.

• As a leader,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'Azienda Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Neuroscienze & Malattie Rare rappresentano una importante area di attenzione in cui ci impegniamo a realizzare la nostra visione a lungo termine del cambiamento di vite di pazienti con gravi disturbi cerebrali. La nostra ricerca preclinica e le prime attività di sviluppo clinico si concentrano intorno a grandi e rare indicazioni. Con punti di forza senza pari in diverse discipline, Roche è posizionato in modo unico per condurre a trasformare la scienza in farmaci per i pazienti con disturbi del sistema nervoso. Per raggiungere i nostri obiettivi, stiamo cercando un direttore medico, concentrandosi sulla sclerosi multipla. L'Opportunità In questo ruolo, guiderai e/o supporterai i progetti clinici del primo stadio dall'ingresso in un umano attraverso la prova di meccanismo e la prova del concetto, per trasformare le molecole in nuovi farmaci in un'area con enormi esigenze mediche non metriche. Leverai la tua esperienza per tradurre molecole innovative in terapie potenzialmente trasformative per i pazienti con disturbi cerebrali gravi. Sposando scienza e strategia, si progettano rigorosi ed efficienti esperimenti clinici che supporteranno il processo decisionale robusto, per ottenere terapie promettenti ai pazienti il più presto possibile. Mansioni - Piombo e/o supporto di team interfunzionali per progettare ed eseguire piani di sviluppo clinici dalla Fase 1 alla Fase 2 (protezione del concetto) - Allenatore di scienziati clinici in uno stato linea- o funzionale-manager - Interfaccia ravvicinata con i leader del team di progetto e sicurezza, farmacologia clinica, operazioni cliniche, biostatistica, gruppi normativi, di ricerca e di biomarcatori e altri membri dei team di progetto - Guidare e/o sostenere la gestione interna degli stakeholder e le interazioni di governance intorno ai piani di progetto e alla strategia di area terapeutica - Guidare e/o sostenere gli impegni esterni con consiglieri, ricercatori del sito, autorità sanitarie e altri stakeholder chiave - Fornire input clinici ai programmi di ricerca alla scoperta - Guidare le comunicazioni scientifiche e diffondere i risultati delle sperimentazioni cliniche sotto forma di presentazioni di conferenze e pubblicazioni di riviste
• Requisiti - Hai un MD o MD/PhD con una specializzazione in neuroimmunologia, sclerosi multipla, o un campo simile. È preferibile la certificazione e la formazione di borsa di studio o l'esperienza di ricerca in settori rilevanti. - Porti almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella ricerca clinica longitudinale, preferibilmente nello sviluppo della droga o negli studi clinici. - Lei ha un forte record di eccellenza scientifica nel campo, evidenziato da un sostanziale successo nella progettazione e nell'attuazione di studi clinici e/o un alto livello di borsa di studio nell'industria o nell'accademia. - Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di farmaci clinici all'interno del settore, idealmente nelle prime fasi di sviluppo clinico. - Come leader, Cosa? Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. L'Azienda Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. In Roches Pharmaforschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisation (pRED ) machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Neurowissenschaften & Seltene Krankheiten stellen einen Schwerpunktbereich dar, in dem wir uns verpflichten, unsere langfristige Vision des Wandels von Leben von Patienten mit schweren Hirnstörungen zu verwirklichen. Unsere präklinische Forschung und frühe klinische Entwicklungsaktivitäten rund um große und seltene Indikationen. Mit unvergleichlichen Stärken in verschiedenen Disziplinen ist Roche einzigartig positioniert, um Wissenschaft in Medikamente für Patienten mit Erkrankungen des Nervensystems zu verwandeln. Um unsere Ziele zu erreichen, suchen wir einen Medical Director, der sich auf Multiple Sklerose konzentriert. L'Opportunità In dieser Rolle führen und/oder unterstützen Sie die frühesten klinischen Projekte von der Einreise in einen Menschen durch den Nachweis von Mechanismus und Nachweis von Konzept, um Moleküle in neue Medikamente in einem Bereich mit riesigen unmet medizinische Bedürfnisse zu verwandeln. Sie nutzen Ihr Know-how, um innovative Moleküle in potenziell transformative Therapien für Patienten mit schweren Hirnstörungen zu übersetzen. Durch die Heirat von Wissenschaft und Strategie entwerfen Sie strenge und effiziente klinische Experimente, die eine robuste Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen, um so schnell wie möglich vielversprechende Therapien für Patienten zu erhalten. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Objetivo del Puesto:

Apoyar el desarrollo de las actividades planeadas en pro de fortalecer el sistema integrado de gestión desde el ámbito ambiental por medio de la aplicación de la normativa vigente, así como el desarrollo de medidas acordes a las necesidades actuales y futuras de la organización, además del seguimiento de políticas y
disposiciones ya existentes.

Lo anterior, busca velar por generar el menor número de impactos ambientales posibles, asociados a la prestación de bienes y servicios contemplados en el enfoque empresarial y propiciando un ambiente laboral y natural saludable para todas y todos los colaboradores de la empresa.

Responsabilidades Principales:

• Adelantar iniciativas de gestión ambiental,

• Apoyar el plan de mitigación de huella de carbono y compensación de la misma.

• Apoyar la estimación de indicadores de gestión ambiental, resultados y planes de acción, así como la formulación de nuevos KPI acordes con la gestión.

• Realizar control de generación de residuos en todas las sedes.

• Apoyar las iniciativas de economía circular.

• Apoyar el plan de antifalsificación desde la gestión de residuos.

• Apoyo en el manejo de proveedores externos para la gestión de residuos.

• Apoyo en los reportes a las entidades ambientales competentes.

• Formular proyectos que aporten a la gestión ambiental de la organización.

Responsabilidades:

• Contribuir a la comunicación efectiva entre la organización y los colaboradores, facilitando la divulgación de información en temas relacionados con seguridad, salud en el trabajo, medio ambiente y bienestar.

• Gestionar las emisiones de la organización con el fin de conducirla a la carbono neutralidad acorde a los objetivos establecidos por el Sistema de Gestión.

• Evaluar los diferentes sitios de trabajo a nivel nacional para garantizar que equipos, materiales y procesos no presenten riesgos para los empleados y para el medio ambiente.

• Garantizar la necesidad de entrenamientos de los colaboradores y contratistas de acuerdo a las necesidades identificadas.

• Planificar y garantizar los entrenamientos para colaboradores, proveedores y contratistas en materia Safety, Health and environmental (SHE) que se requieran y que sean de su competencia.

• Trabajar con la ARL en el cumplimiento de los planes aprobados para el cumplimiento de los objetivos trazados.

• Suministrar información a empleados y público en general sobre aspectos de salud pública, higiene y seguridad en el trabajo, medio ambiente y salud mental.

• Participar en los comités que la organización determine o en los que a su juicio considere para aportar a la mejora de los procesos y para dar cumplimiento a los requisitos legales.

• Promover el uso correcto de los Elementos de Protección Personal (EPP) y de equipos de seguridad por parte del personal de la organización.

Formación:

• Estudiante de ingeniería ambiental .

• Estudiante de ingeniería sanitaria o afines.

• Inglés intermedio.

Habilidades, experiencia y competencias:

• Gestión ambiental

• Soluciones Ambientales en la industrial

• Desarrollo ambiental

• Control ambiental y de riesgos

• Economía circular

• Gestión de residuos

• Gestión de emisiones

• Huella de carbono

• Uso Eficiente de Agua y Energía

• Gestión documental

• Generación de informes

• Soluciones basadas en la naturaleza

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring ever

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Receive, sort, verify, handle exceptions, bar code, scan, and pre-archive Accounts Payable (AP) documents for further processing.

• Validate and process Purchase Order (PO) and contract-based invoices, non-PO invoices, prepayments, and down payments.

• Review supplier open items (due invoices, credit notes, debit balances, etc.) before executing payments.

• Handle internal and external queries and resolve them within the agreed timeline.

• Investigate and reverse non-successful payments.

• Perform supplier statement of account reconciliation and follow up on open items for closure.

• Perform month-end closing activities, including purchasing accrual according to the closing timetable/ schedule.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, or yearly reporting, such as monthly KPI reports and other operational reports based on affiliate requirements.

• Reconcile AP balance sheet accounts and clear aged items (e.g., GR/IR, GIT, suspense account).

• Participate in compliance audits, prepare statutory audit reports & respond to audit queries as necessary.

• Troubleshoot AP issues (workflow, OCR, BOT, process) and work with respective teams (IT, Automation& GBPS) for resolution

• Participate & support implementation of projects/ initiatives from global, business partners & RSS.

• Engage in system integration and testing.

• Initiate and drive process improvement projects.

• Provide technical mentorship to team members and conduct internal process training for new joiners.

• Process suppliers and intercompany invoices accurately and within the predefined KPIs

• Ensure timely payment of suppliers and Intercompany invoices in accordance with agreed payment terms & Intercompany payment schedule

• Respond promptly to internal and external queries, adhering to predefined KPIs.

• Perform timely and accurate AP month-end closing activities, including purchasing accruals, and provide related reports.

• Create and maintain up-to-date work documentation and processes in compliance with ICFR, group policies, guidelines, and local statutory/legal requirements within agreed timelines

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Основні обов'язки:

• Інсталяція та валідація: Проведення монтажу, налаштування, валідації та введення в експлуатацію нових лабораторних систем Roche .

• Технічне обслуговування: Виконання планового та профілактичного обслуговування обладнання згідно з міжнародними стандартами та регламентами компанії.

• Діагностика та ремонт: Оперативна діагностика несправностей (як на місці у клієнта, так і за допомогою засобів віддаленої підтримки) та проведення ремонтних робіт будь-якої складності.

• Технічна підтримка: Надання професійних консультацій та навчання персоналу лабораторій (лікарів-лаборантів, біологів, інженерів клієнта) щодо правил експлуатації та догляду за обладнанням.

• Модернізація: Встановлення оновлень програмного забезпечення та апаратних модифікацій (апгрейдів) систем.

• Звітність та документація: Своєчасне та точне ведення всієї сервісної документації, заповнення актів виконаних робіт та звітів у корпоративній CRM-системі (відповідно до стандартів ISO та внутрішніх політик).

• Управління запчастинами: Ефективне управління власним складом запасних частин.

Вимоги до кандидата:

• Освіта: Вища технічна освіта (біомедична інженерія, електроніка, радіотехніка, метрологія, ІТ або суміжні спеціальності).

• Досвід роботи: Від 2-х років на посаді сервісного інженера з медичним або складним лабораторним обладнанням.

• Технічні знання: Глибоке розуміння принципів роботи електроніки, механіки, оптики та гідравліки.

• ІТ-навички: Впевнений користувач ПК. Розуміння принципів роботи комп'ютерних мереж (TCP/IP, LIS/HIS інтеграція) .

• Мови:
Українська – вільно.
Англійська – не нижче рівня Intermediate (B1). Обов'язкова вимога для читання технічної документації, проходження навчань у виробника та листування з глобальною підтримкою.

• Мобільність: Наявність водійського посвідчення категорії «В» та досвід водіння.

• Готовність до відряджень: Робота має роз'їзний характер, готовність до регулярних відряджень по Україні.

• Особисті якості: Висока клієнтоорієнтованість, відмінні комунікативні навички, відповідальність, аналітичний склад розуму, вміння працювати в режимі багатозадачності та самостійно приймати рішення.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Діагностика та ремонт: Оперативна діагностика несправностей (як на місці у клієнта, так і за допомогою засобів віддаленої підтримки) та проведення ремонтних робіт будь-якої складності.

• Технічна підтримка: Надання професійних консультацій та навчання персоналу лабораторій (лікарів-лаборантів, біологів, інженерів клієнта) щодо правил експлуатації та догляду за обладнанням.

• Модернізація: Встановлення оновлень програмного забезпечення та апаратних модифікацій (апгрейдів) систем.

• Звітність та документація: Своєчасне та точне ведення всієї сервісної документації, заповнення актів виконаних робіт та звітів у корпоративній CRM-системі (відповідно до стандартів ISO та внутрішніх політик).

• Управління запчастинами: Ефективне управління власним складом запасних частин.

Вимоги до кандидата:

• Освіта: Вища технічна освіта (біомедична інженерія, електроніка, радіотехніка, метрологія, ІТ або суміжні спеціальності).

• Досвід роботи: Від 2-х років на посаді сервісного інженера з медичним або складним лабораторним обладнанням.

• Технічні знання: Глибоке розуміння принципів роботи електроніки, механіки, оптики та гідравліки.

• ІТ-навички: Впевнений користувач ПК. Розуміння принципів роботи комп'ютерних мереж (TCP/IP, LIS/HIS інтеграція) .

• Мови:
Українська – вільно.
Англійська – не нижче рівня Intermediate (B1). Обов'язкова вимога для читання технічної документації, проходження навчань у виробника та листування з глобальною підтримкою.

• Мобільність: Наявність водійського посвідчення категорії «В» та досвід водіння.

• Готовність до відряджень: Робота має роз'їзний характер, готовність до регулярних відряджень по Україні.

• Особисті якості: Висока клієнтоорієнтованість, відмінні комунікативні навички, відповідальність, аналітичний склад розуму, вміння працювати в режимі багатозадачності та самостійно приймати рішення.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Sei pronto a contribuire con la tua esperienza nella protezione dalle esplosioni e nella sicurezza degli impianti a un impianto di produzione chimica all'avanguardia? Ti piacerebbe modellare attivamente la conformità e la sicurezza dei nostri sistemi attraverso responsabilità personale, competenza tecnica e soluzioni pragmatiche? Allora entra a far parte del nostro agile team a Penzberg!

Il tuo contributo – Insieme diamo forma al futuro

In questo ruolo chiave garantirai che la sicurezza degli impianti, in particolare la protezione contro le esplosioni, sia garantita in ogni momento nella nostra produzione chimica. Ti assumerai la responsabilità indipendente dei compiti centrali:

- Competenza tecnica e documentazione: esegui test tecnici (come persona qualificata per eseguire test secondo BetrSichV o con esperienza comparabile) e crea i documenti associati sulla protezione contro le esplosioni.
- Risoluzione dei problemi e implementazione: trovi e valuti soluzioni tecniche e organizzative, ne supporti la fattibilità e, come partner attivo, garantisci l'implementazione orientata agli obiettivi nelle operazioni di produzione.
- Conformità e digitalizzazione: colleghi, mantieni e utilizzi i dati per la conformità operativa per garantire la massima sicurezza e promuovere la digitalizzazione dei documenti.
- Collaborazione e gestione del cambiamento: nell'ambiente a matrice, sei attivamente coinvolto con le unità tecniche, di sicurezza e di produzione per esigenze operative e pratichi la gestione del cambiamento.
- Leadership professionale e ulteriore sviluppo: attraverso la tua leadership professionale, consenti una collaborazione efficiente con le nostre interfacce. Ti tieni costantemente aggiornato sulle ultime tecnologie (formazione, fiere, ecc.).

Ciò che ci definisce: il tuo team e il tuo ambiente futuri

Nell'ambito di Diagnostics Operations Penzberg, l'area DOZ è essenziale per la produzione tempestiva di materiali di input chimici e biochimici.

- Il team: siamo un reparto agile di 45 persone che fornisce prodotti importanti a quasi tutte le unità della divisione Diagnostica.
- Il vostro gruppo: siamo il partner centrale per la conformità operativa, la sicurezza chimica, la protezione degli impianti e delle esplosioni, nonché la protezione dell'ambiente nella produzione chimica. Miglioramento continuo, apprendimento condiviso e diversità sono ciò che ci distingue.

Il tuo profilo: ci convincerai con queste competenze

Sei una personalità impegnata con una forte attenzione alla sicurezza tecnica e all'implementazione pragmatica:

- Formazione/studio: formazione tecnica completata con successo (ad es. ingegnere elettronico, ingegnere meccatronico, meccanico industriale, ecc.) con molti anni di esperienza pratica con sistemi di produzione o laurea con successo (ad es. ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ecc.) con ulteriore applicazione pratica nella conformità operativa e conoscenza approfondita della protezione tecnica dalle esplosioni.
- Specializzazione: solida e comprovata specializzazione professionale nella protezione operativa contro le esplosioni (ad es. prove, qualifica di "persona qualificata per testare", competenza secondo ATEX RL 2014/34/UE).
- Pratica: esperienza pratica in varie produzioni industriali (centri tecnici, laboratori, operazioni di produzione) e idealmente da comitati/associazioni professionali pertinenti.
- Modo di lavorare: sei responsabile, impegnato, strutturato e caratterizzato da un modo di lavorare indipendente e coscienzioso. Ti motivi attraverso l'implementazione tecnica di soluzioni sicure.
- Informatica e comunicazione: buona conoscenza dell'inglese e ottimo tedesco.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descriptif

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste

Êtes-vous prêt à apporter votre expertise en matière de protection contre les explosions et de sécurité des installations à une installation de production chimique de pointe ? Souhaitez-vous façonner activement la conformité et la sécurité de nos systèmes grâce à la responsabilité personnelle, à l’expertise technique et aux solutions pragmatiques ? Alors rejoignez notre équipe agile à Penzberg !

Votre contribution – Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir

Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que la sécurité des installations - notamment la protection contre les explosions - soit garantie à tout moment dans notre production chimique. Vous assumerez la responsabilité indépendante des tâches centrales :

- Expertise technique & documentation : Vous effectuez des tests techniques (en tant que personne qualifiée pour effectuer des tests selon BetrSichV ou avec une expérience comparable) et créez les documents associés sur la protection contre les explosions.
- Résolution de problèmes et mise en œuvre : vous trouvez et évaluez des solutions techniques et organisationnelles, soutenez leur faisabilité et, en tant que partenaire actif, assurez une mise en œuvre ciblée dans les opérations de production.
- Conformité & Numérisation : Vous reliez, maintenez et utilisez les données pour la conformité opérationnelle afin d'assurer une sécurité maximale et piloter la numérisation des documents.
- Collaboration & Gestion du Changement : Dans l'environnement matriciel, vous êtes activement impliqué auprès des unités de sécurité, de production et techniques pour les besoins opérationnels et pratiquez la gestion du changement.
- Leadership professionnel et développement ultérieur : Grâce à votre leadership professionnel, vous permettez une collaboration efficace avec nos interfaces. Vous vous tenez continuellement au courant des dernières technologies (formations, salons, etc.).

Ce qui nous définit – votre future équipe et votre futur environnement

Dans le cadre de Diagnostics Operations Penzberg, la zone DOZ est essentielle pour la production en temps opportun de matières premières chimiques et biochimiques.

- L'équipe : Nous sommes un département agile de 45 personnes qui approvisionne presque toutes les unités de la division Diagnostic en produits importants.
- Votre groupe : Nous sommes le partenaire central pour la conformité opérationnelle, la sécurité chimique, la protection des installations et contre les explosions ainsi que la protection de l'environnement dans la production chimique. L’amélioration continue, l’apprentissage partagé et la diversité sont ce qui nous distingue.

Votre profil – vous nous convaincrez avec ces compétences

Vous êtes une personnalité engagée avec un fort focus sur la sécurité technique et une mise en œuvre pragmatique :

- Formation/études : Formation technique réussie (par exemple ingénieur électronicien, ingénieur mécatronique, mécanicien industriel, etc.) avec de nombreuses années d'expérience pratique dans les systèmes de production ou un diplôme réussi (par exemple ingénieur électrique, ingénieur mécanique, etc.) avec une application pratique supplémentaire dans la conformité opérationnelle et une connaissance approfondie de la protection technique contre les explosions.
- Spécialisation : Spécialisation professionnelle solide et éprouvée en matière de protection opérationnelle contre les explosions (par exemple essais, qualification de « personne qualifiée pour tester », expertise selon ATEX RL 2014/34/UE).
- Pratique : Expérience pratique dans diverses productions industrielles (centres techniques, laboratoires, opérations de production) et idéalement auprès de comités/associations professionnelles concernés.
- Mode de travail : Vous êtes responsable, engagé, structuré et vous vous caractérisez par une manière de travailler indépendante et consciencieuse. Vous vous motivez par la mise en œuvre technique de solutions sécuritaires.
- Informatique & Communication : Bonne connaissance de l'anglais et très bon allemand.

As a Quality Solutions Lead within our PDQ, you will work within a team of experts and collaborate with peers within the function and across the organization to identify, design and execute fit-for-purpose quality solutions, driving the delivery and sustainability of a robust and regulatory compliance Quality Management System (QMS) ，drive quality culture and implement in China. La posizione Come leader di soluzioni di qualità all'interno del nostro PDQ, lavorerai all'interno di un team di esperti e collaborerai con coetanei all'interno della funzione e in tutta l'organizzazione per identificare, progettare ed eseguire soluzioni di qualità fit-for-purpose, guidando la consegna e la sostenibilità di una conformità robusta e regolamentare Quality Management System (QMS) , guidando la cultura della qualità e l'implementazione in Cina. Ti garantirai il completamento tempestivo delle soluzioni di qualità consegnabili e partner con business/stakeholder, supervisionando e fornendo competenze tecniche nella fornitura di soluzioni di alta qualità per fornire conformi normativi e processi di alta qualità. Contribuirai anche a iniziative funzionali, interfunzionali, aziendali o esterne che modellano il nostro ambiente tecnico, aziendale e sanitario. Avrete bisogno di forti capacità strategiche, di collaborazione e di comunicazione, nonché di una mentalità imprenditoriale, per evolvere il nostro modo di progettare e consegnare il QMS e per consentire farmaci di consegna accelerati e l'accesso per i nostri pazienti. Come leader di soluzioni di qualità, sarete responsabili di implementare e fornire soluzioni di qualità per dimostrare la fiducia nel nostro QMS al fine di accelerare la revisione e l'approvazione normativa per i farmaci e soluzioni sanitarie integrate. Potrai collaborare con team interfunzionali e partner esterni e lavorare con notevole indipendenza. Contribuisce al miglioramento continuo dei processi interni e del supporto del sistema. In qualità di Senior Quality Solutions Lead, sarete responsabili di fornire soluzioni di qualità attraverso la progettazione di soluzioni di qualità innovative/nuove/efficienti per dimostrare la fiducia nel nostro QMS al fine di accelerare la revisione normativa e l'approvazione per i farmaci e le soluzioni sanitarie integrate. Vi cercheremo di contribuire a complesse squadre di capitoli trasversali o incrociati assumendo un ruolo di primo piano e navigando situazioni all'interno del paesaggio QMS. Responsabilità e responsabilità primarie:
• SOLUZIONI DI QUALITÀ: fornire soluzioni di qualità che consentano a Roche di soddisfare le normative/standard /HA aspettative, in modo efficiente ed efficace. Le attività possono includere, ma non sono limitate a: ○ Regulatory Intelligence - analizza proattivamente il paesaggio normativo e valuta l'impatto di emergenze e modifiche alle normative esistenti ai processi Roche. ○ Sviluppo di processi e procedure - partner con processi di business to design, sfruttando al massimo l'automazione e il flusso di lavoro di sistema, lo sviluppo di metriche/segnali di performance/misure di supervisione basate sulle prove. ○ Distribuzione di processi - partner con l'azienda per implementare processi, compresa la fornitura di soluzioni di formazione/performance per dimostrare la qualifica e la competenza del business per eseguire i processi. ○ Miglioramento continuo - guida le attività di miglioramento del processo, sfruttando Quality Analytics & Insights e il forte processo decisionale per e con Global Process Owners; partner con il business per identificare, analizzare e migliorare i processi esistenti e creare soluzioni per ottimizzare le prestazioni, soddisfare i migliori standard di pratica o migliorare la qualità e l'esperienza degli utenti per i clienti e gli utenti finali.
• ESCELLENZA QMS: Dimostrare l'integrità del processo alle autorità sanitarie ○ Sviluppare strategie di processo e gestire in modo proattivo le linee temporali per garantire una corretta supervisione e consegna di soluzioni di qualità, tra cui l'implementazione e l'adozione di nuove tecnologie e soluzioni che favoriscano l'efficienza e il risparmio di costi. ○ Migliorare continuamente il proc interno
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Quality Solutions Lead within our PDQ, you will work within a team of experts and collaborate with peers within the function and across the organization to identify, design and execute fit-for-purpose quality solutions, driving the delivery and sustainability of a robust and regulatory compliance Quality Management System (QMS) ，drive quality culture and implement in China. You will ensure the timely completion of quality solution deliverables and partner with business/stakeholder, overseeing and providing technical expertise in the delivery of high quality solutions to deliver regulatory compliant and high quality processes. You will also contribute to functional, cross-functional, enterprise-wide or external initiatives that shape our technical landscape, business and healthcare environments. You will need strong strategic, collaboration and communication skills, as well as an entrepreneurial mindset, to evolve the way we design and deliver the QMS and to enable accelerated delivery medicines and access for our patients.

As a Quality Solutions Lead , you will be accountable to implement and deliver quality solutions to demonstrate confidence in our QMS in order to accelerate regulatory review and approval for medicines and integrated healthcare solutions. You will partner with cross-functional teams and external partners and work with considerable independence. Contributes to the continual improvement of internal processes and system support.

As a Senior Quality Solutions Lead , you will be accountable to deliver quality solutions through designing innovative/new/efficient quality solutions to demonstrate confidence in our QMS in order to accelerate regulatory review and approval for medicines and integrated healthcare solutions. We will look to you to contribute to complex cross-functional or cross chapter squads taking a leading role and navigating situations within the QMS landscape.

Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities :

• QUALITY SOLUTIONS : Deliver quality solutions which enable Roche to meet regulations/standards /HA expectations, in an efficient and effective way. Activities may include, but are not limited to:

○ Regulatory Intelligence - proactively analyzes regulatory landscape and assesses impact of emerging and changes to existing regulations to Roche processes.
○ Process design & procedures development - partners with business to design processes, maximally leveraging automation and system workflow, development of performance metrics/signals/evidence-based oversight measures.
○ Process deployment - partners with the business to implement processes, including delivery of training/performance solutions to demonstrate qualification and competency of business to execute processes.
○ Continuous Improvement - drives process improvement activities, leveraging Quality Analytics & Insights and strong decision making for and with Global Process Owners; partner with the business to proactively identify, analyze and improve existing processes and create solutions to optimize performance, meet best practice standards or improve quality and the user experience for customers and end-users.

• QMS EXCELLENCE: Demonstrate process integrity to health authorities

○ Develop process strategies and proactively manage timelines to ensure successful oversight and delivery of quality solutions, including the implementation and adoption of new technologies and solutions that drive efficiency and cost savings.
○ Continuously improve internal proc

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Sie sorgen für die zeitnahe Fertigstellung von Qualitätslösungen und Partner mit Business/Stakeholdern, die Überwachung und Bereitstellung technischer Expertise bei der Lieferung hochwertiger Lösungen zur Bereitstellung regulatorischer und qualitativ hochwertiger Prozesse. Sie werden auch zu funktionellen, funktionsübergreifenden, unternehmensweiten oder externen Initiativen beitragen, die unsere technischen Landschafts-, Geschäfts- und Gesundheitsumgebungen prägen. Sie benötigen starke strategische, kooperative und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie ein unternehmerisches Denkvermögen, um die Art und Weise zu entwickeln, wie wir das QMS entwerfen und liefern und beschleunigte Liefermedikamente und Zugang zu unseren Patienten zu ermöglichen. Als Quality Solutions Lead können Sie qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen implementieren und liefern, um das Vertrauen in unser QMS zu demonstrieren, um die regulatorische Überprüfung und Zulassung für Arzneimittel und integrierte Gesundheitslösungen zu beschleunigen. Sie werden mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten und mit großer Unabhängigkeit arbeiten. trägt zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der internen Prozesse und der Systemunterstützung bei. Als Senior Quality Solutions Lead können Sie qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen liefern, indem Sie innovative/neue/effiziente Qualitätslösungen entwickeln, um das Vertrauen in unser QMS zu demonstrieren, um die regulatorische Überprüfung und Zulassung für Arzneimittel und integrierte Gesundheitslösungen zu beschleunigen. Wir werden Sie dazu auffordern, zu komplexen kreuz- oder querverzahnten Kapitelquads beizutragen, die eine führende Rolle und navigierende Situationen in der QMS-Landschaft einnehmen. Primäre Verantwortungen und Rechenschaftspflichten:
• QUALITY SOLUTIONS : Liefern Sie qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen, die es Roche ermöglichen, die Vorschriften/Standards /HA-Erwartungen effizient und effektiv zu erfüllen. Aktivitäten können beinhalten, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf: ○ Regulatory Intelligence - analysiert die regulatorische Landschaft und bewertet die Auswirkungen der aufstrebenden und Änderungen bestehender Regelungen auf Roche-Prozesse proaktiv. ○ Prozessgestaltung & Verfahrensentwicklung - Geschäftspartner mit Business-to-design-Prozessen, maximaler Automatisierungs- und System-Workflow, Entwicklung von Performance Metriken/Signalen/evidence-basierten Aufsichtsmaßnahmen. ○ Prozess-Bereitstellung - Partner mit dem Unternehmen, um Prozesse zu implementieren, einschließlich der Bereitstellung von Trainings-/Performance-Lösungen, um Qualifikation und Kompetenz des Unternehmens zur Durchführung von Prozessen zu demonstrieren. ○ Kontinuierliche Verbesserung - treibt Prozessverbesserungsaktivitäten an, nutzt Quality Analytics & Insights und starke Entscheidungsfindung für und mit Global Process Owners; Partner mit dem Unternehmen, bestehende Prozesse proaktiv zu identifizieren, zu analysieren und zu verbessern und Lösungen zu schaffen, um die Leistung zu optimieren, Best Practice Standards zu erfüllen oder die Qualität und das Nutzererlebnis für Kunden und Endbenutzer zu verbessern.
• QMS EXCELLENCE: Demonstrate Prozessintegrität an Gesundheitsbehörden ○ Entwickeln Sie Prozessstrategien und verwalten Sie proaktiv Zeitlinien, um eine erfolgreiche Aufsicht und Lieferung von Qualitätslösungen zu gewährleisten, einschließlich der Umsetzung und Einführung neuer Technologien und Lösungen, die Effizienz und Kostenersparnis steigern. ○ Kontinuierlich verbessern interne Proc

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. La position En tant que responsable des solutions de qualité au sein de notre PDQ, vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe d'experts et collaborerez avec des pairs au sein de la fonction et dans l'ensemble de l'organisation pour identifier, concevoir et exécuter des solutions de qualité adaptées à l'usage, en conduisant à la livraison et à la durabilité d'un système de gestion de la qualité (SGQ) robuste et réglementaire, dynamiser la culture de qualité et mettre en œuvre en Chine. Vous veillerez à ce que les produits livrables de la solution de qualité soient achevés en temps opportun et qu'ils soient en partenariat avec les entreprises et les intervenants, en surveillant et en fournissant une expertise technique dans la prestation de solutions de haute qualité pour offrir des processus conformes à la réglementation et de haute qualité. Vous contribuerez également à des initiatives fonctionnelles, interfonctionnelles, à l'échelle de l'entreprise ou externes qui façonnent notre paysage technique, nos milieux d'affaires et de santé. Vous aurez besoin de solides compétences stratégiques, de collaboration et de communication, ainsi que d'un état d'esprit d'entreprise, afin d'évoluer dans la façon dont nous concevons et livrons le SGQ et de permettre une livraison accélérée des médicaments et un accès pour nos patients. En tant que responsable des solutions de qualité, vous devrez mettre en œuvre et fournir des solutions de qualité pour démontrer votre confiance dans notre SGQ afin d'accélérer l'examen réglementaire et l'approbation des médicaments et des solutions de santé intégrées. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des partenaires externes avec une indépendance considérable. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus internes et du soutien des systèmes. En tant que responsable principal des solutions de qualité , vous serez responsable de fournir des solutions de qualité en concevant des solutions de qualité innovantes/nouvelles/efficaces pour démontrer votre confiance dans notre SGQ afin d'accélérer l'examen réglementaire et l'approbation des médicaments et des solutions de santé intégrées. Nous comptons sur vous pour contribuer à des équipes interfonctionnelles ou transversales complexes qui jouent un rôle de premier plan et qui naviguent dans le paysage de QMS. Responsabilités et responsabilités principales :
• SOLUTIONS DE QUALITÉ : Offrir des solutions de qualité qui permettent à Roche de répondre aux attentes réglementaires/normes/HA, de manière efficace et efficiente. Les activités peuvent comprendre, sans s'y limiter, les éléments suivants : - Renseignements réglementaires - Analyse proactive du paysage réglementaire et évaluation de l'impact des changements et des changements aux règlements existants sur les processus Roche. - Oui. Conception de processus et élaboration de procédures - partenaires avec les entreprises pour concevoir des processus, tirer le meilleur parti possible de l'automatisation et du flux de travail du système, élaboration de mesures de rendement, de signaux et de mesures de surveillance fondées sur des preuves. - Oui. Déploiement de processus - Partenaires avec l'entreprise pour mettre en oeuvre des processus, y compris la prestation de solutions de formation et de rendement pour démontrer la qualification et la compétence de l'entreprise pour exécuter des processus. L'amélioration continue - stimule les activités d'amélioration des processus, en tirant parti de l'analyse de la qualité & Insights et d'une prise de décision solide pour et avec Global Process Owners; partenaire avec l'entreprise pour identifier, analyser et améliorer proactivement les processus existants et créer des solutions pour optimiser les performances, répondre aux normes de bonnes pratiques ou améliorer la qualité et l'expérience utilisateur pour les clients et les utilisateurs finaux.
• EXCELLENCE DU SGQ : démontrer l'intégrité des processus aux autorités sanitaires - Élaborer des stratégies de processus et gérer de façon proactive les délais afin d'assurer la supervision et la prestation réussies de solutions de qualité, y compris la mise en oeuvre et l'adoption de nouvelles technologies et de solutions qui favorisent l'efficacité et les économies. Amélioration continue du processus interne

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee reimbursement activities as well as associated healthcare compliance reviews in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e assessment results) activities in concur

• during claim processing

• Performs other relevant support activities as and when required (e.g. support in validating/ performing data analysis/testing which contributes to the reporting to affiliates/ Compliance Projects )

• Escalates issues to superior/RSS Line Manager (where required)

• Engages in networking with colleagues from other business functions when required to

• Supports the team in performing operational activities and involved in identifying/ implementing improvement opportunities within the current operational process

Academic requirement

• Undergraduate students from reputable universities in relevant fields of study (Prefer business, law or finance related major).

• Available for a minimum period of 6 months.

Key Competencies required

• Good command of spoken and written English and Mandarin

• Proactive at work and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Strong analytical skills and great attention to details

• Able to challenge the status quo with skepticism and is passionate about process validation/ improvement

• Possess strong communication skills and a good record of extra-curricular activities.

• Good interpersonal skills, able to work in a team effectively, deliver on commitment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 您是谁：
• 作为医院战略合作部门区域负责人，您将带领团队 与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。

您的主要职责：
• 1、与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系。作为医院非临床各职能科室的首要对接窗口，充分依托罗氏的创新资源禀赋，为医院提供一体化支持方案，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。
• 1.1 了解和挖掘所负责区域关键医院业务和学术发展需求，并提供相应的学术支持
• 1.2 设计和实施区域品牌项目，培养区域的讲者，打造公司在区域的影响力
• 1.3 部门合作推动所负责区域关键医院与公司的战略合作关系

2、负责所属区域关键医院的准入工作
• 2.1根据部门与业务共识的医院准入目标，确保在开发成功率和有效执行
• 2.2 推动需开发医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学部解决方案
• 2.3 负责所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医保办合作

• 3、负责所属区域关键医院业务计划（Account planning）制定
• 3.1完成和完善区域关键医院的 项目及预算计划
• 3.2 监督SAM执行所负责关键医院的计划执行
• 3.3 协同业务和跨部门一起完善和落实相关项目的落地和高效执行

4、负责团队和人员管理
• 4.1按时准确完成日常工作和相关报告，严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策
• 4.2负责区域T&E费用预算审核及实际费用审核，对预算负责
• 4.3 根据团队业绩考核目标，定期辅导和跟进计划执行，以确保业务目标达成

5、 参与或带领部门或跨部门的相关项目

我们期待这样的你加入：
• 1，具备医院准入，市场准入或医药销售二线管理工作经验。
• 2， 具备项目管理能力，辅导及提升团队项目管理知识及流程；辅导团队设计项目；能对风险及突发事件处理及预防。
• 3， 具备团队合作能力，能建立跨部门沟通合作机制；具有全局观和全面思考能力，从公司策略角度引导开展区域及跨区域活动会议，促成跨区域内部合作，形成品牌项目。

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist - TALENT POOL

titleByLocale.it: Media a pagamento Specialista - TALENT POOL

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for supporting and partnering with our Business Partners in executing on the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The role is expert in all aspects of paid campaign management across different channels and platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Planning, executing, and optimizing global digital marketing campaigns across key channels such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Display, in close collaboration with digital marketing managers and social media leads worldwide. This includes a focus on media buying, strategically purchasing ad space to reach our target audiences effectively and efficiently through our media agency.

• Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, managing key KPIs and budgets, and continuously driving improvements

• Conducting A/B testing and audience optimization to refine targeting, ad copy, landing pages, and bidding strategies, ensuring data-driven enhancements and higher conversion rates

• Staying up to date with industry trends and best practices, leveraging research and insights to keep campaign strategies at the forefront, while discovering and learning the pharma advertising space

• Contributing to process optimization and knowledge sharing, establishing process governance, collaborating cross-functionally to align campaign goals, share learnings, and strengthen team capabilities

Who you are:

• You have a degree in Business or Marketing (BSc/MSc) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience in paid media campaign management, running campaigns across platforms focusing mainly on LinkedIn Ads, and have a good understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Display Advertising

• You are analytical and data-driven, with strong technical skills, and have experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics. You know how to develop effective strategies, analyze performance, and continuously optimize campaigns for better results

• You are an excellent communicator with a C1-level English proficiency, confident in managing global stakeholders, collaborating with agencies and digital managers, and engaging with senior leaders to drive campaign success.

• You have a consultancy mindset, proactively providing insights and recommendations, developing actionable plans, and contributing to process improvements and best practices within the team

• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, are detail-oriented and well-organized, and bring a passion for digital technologies along with strong project management skills to keep initiatives on track

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

• Planning, executing, and optimizing global digital marketing campaigns across key channels such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Display, in close collaboration with digital marketing managers and social media leads worldwide. • Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.

• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives. Support on assigned projects or programs.

• Key Accountabilities: Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy. Convert Purchase Requisitions/Shopping Carts to Purchase Orders. Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.Manage and resolve internal and external queries. Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.

• ​Execute and produce accurate and timely reports. Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable. Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.

• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Who you are :

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N2 level)

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Coach per la costruzione di capacità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Role Purpose

• Build and enhance commercialization capabilities, ensuring alignment with Taiwan Pharma Ambition and boosting ecosystem mastery for customer-facing roles.

• Address skill gaps through coaching, insights, and learning programs, driving improved performance and patient value delivery.

• Support affiliate-wide excellence by connecting global best practices and fostering capability-driven strategies across all commercial functions.

Role scope:

• Lead commercialization capability learning programs, ensuring direct alignment with Pharma International’s overall business strategy and connecting with Taiwan Pharma Ambition.

• Translate global standards into local actionable roadmaps that ensure every PJP and partner has a clear path from foundational skills to advanced ecosystem mastery.

• Act as a strategic partner with PJS cluster leads and PJP team leads to identify key skill gaps and provide data-driven insights to improve individual and ecosystem-wide performance.

• Provide field coaching and timely feedback on customer engagement to remove roadblocks and unlock value for patients.

• Responsible for design and implement necessary trainings and connect internal / external resources

• Collaborate with Agile Coach to foster Working by Outcome realization at the affiliate level and facilitate key rituals like Impact Retrospectives to translate learnings and insights into business strategies.

• Partner with the Taiwan leadership team and chapter leaders to focus on capability building, ensuring end-to-end excellence across all commercialization functions.

• Serve as the Primary Subject Matter Expert and central point of contact for functional commercialization capability needs for Taiwan Pharma.

• Connect across APAC, Pharma International, and the extended global network to support ACE realization and share best practices across borders.

Requirements:
Qualifications:
Education:

• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• At least 8+ years work experience in commercial functions in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence

• Solid experience in commercialization roles, such as Marketing, Sales, Medical, or Digital, with the ability to act as a credible coach for senior stakeholders

• Experienced in in-house training design, capability building, L&D, or Organizational Development within a complex, matrixed environment is a plus

Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and program/system design skills

• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage, inspire and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Innovative mindset with a continuous improvement approach to learning and development practices.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire teams without formal authority.

• Fast-learner, good digital fluency with the ability to leverage AI tools, data analytics, and modern learning platforms to enhance learning experience.

• Fluent in the local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desired

jobs.title: Expert Android Design System Engineer (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en conception de système Android (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Roche utilizes a unified Design System to streamline the user interfaces of its digital products and deliver a consistent, harmonized user experience for our customers. The One Design System encompasses all web and mobile applications developed at Roche Diagnostics.

Our Engineering Team is looking for an Android Expert able to lead the development of Android Mobile components ensuring the correct design and implementation of cutting-edge user interfaces for Android mobile applications. You are able to translate UX and clients requirements into technical solutions and vice versa, and you will lead the development of such components.

You will be located either in of Vienna, or in Sant Cugat (near Barcelona).

Your upcoming mission:

Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:

• Architect, develop, maintain the Design System components & interaction patterns for mobile, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

• Write and review clean, testable, scalable code aligned with best practices and design patterns.

• Maintain code quality through automated testing, code review, and continuous integration pipelines.

• Provide Technical assessment of development of the design components in mobile, ensuring the approach is of quality, it is customer centric, future thinking and easy to use.

• Participate actively in the creation of the architecture for Mobile Applications, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Collaborate with Design & Development teams to align on goals, scope and business outcomes.

• Ensure Documentation on Mobile Components and support the mobile development community in adoption, implementation, testing and maintenance.

• Work with Roche clients (project leaders, architects, designers, front-end developers) to establish collaboration, understanding their needs and solve their doubts.

• Champion the adoption of the Design System together with the client and the Usability Engineers across Roche.

Creative / Strategic activities:

• Brainstorm improvements and propose innovative solutions to improve community engagement.

• Evaluate new technologies, patterns, and frameworks for potential adoption.

• Contribute to design review, prototypes, and mobile user experience standards.

AI powered design system:

• Create documentation for AI agents to ensure the users of the design system can vibe code with the library

• Create test applications using vibe coding to ensure the compatibility of the library with AI

• Document all the components in Fiigma code connect

Essential skills for your mission:

• Android Developer for at least 5 years

• Expert in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Git

• Experience with Material Design 3 for Jetpack Compose and Design Systems in general

• Strong experience to build reusable, testable, composable UI components

• Proficiency to write unit tests, screenshot tests, Compose UI tests

• Deep knowledge of implementing accessibility best practices (A11y) in Jetpack Compose

• RTL Knowledge

Bonus skills:

• Vivid interest in modern technology trends and best practices

• Curiosity in domains outside of Android: iOS development, Cross-platform solutions knowledge.

• Innersourced products experience

• Engagement in dev communities, community management, active contribution to open s

descriptionByLocale.it:
Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme! Combinando i nostri punti di forza unici, ridefiniamo la salute attraverso l'azione sostenibile e l'innovazione. Per uno sguardo dietro le quinte, controllare questo video per vedere come siamo a Roche stanno rendendo l'assistenza sanitaria personalizzata una realtà. La mySugr GmbH è stata acquisita da Roche nel 2017 e il nostro ufficio di Vienna è uno dei siti globali di Roche. Ti troverai qui, nel cuore di Vienna, non importa se lavori su mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® o qualsiasi altro prodotto o soluzione Roche. Potete leggere di più sulla storia di mySugr & Roche qui . Ecco cosa stiamo cercando: Roche utilizza un sistema di progettazione unificato per semplificare le interfacce utente dei suoi prodotti digitali e fornire un'esperienza utente coerente e armonizzata per i nostri clienti. Il sistema One Design comprende tutte le applicazioni web e mobile sviluppate presso la Roche Diagnostics. Il nostro team di ingegneria sta cercando un esperto Android in grado di condurre lo sviluppo di componenti Android Mobile garantendo la corretta progettazione e implementazione di interfacce utente all'avanguardia per applicazioni mobili Android. Siete in grado di tradurre i requisiti UX e dei clienti in soluzioni tecniche e viceversa, e guiderete lo sviluppo di tali componenti. Vi troverete sia a Vienna, sia a Sant Cugat (vicino a Barcellona). La vostra prossima missione: Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:
• Architetto, sviluppare, mantenere i componenti e i modelli di interazione di Design System per il mobile, coerente con le strategie di piattaforma, la politica di governance e gli standard.
• Scrivere e rivedere codice pulito, testabile e scalabile allineato con le migliori pratiche e modelli di progettazione.
• Mantenere la qualità del codice attraverso test automatizzati, revisione del codice e pipeline di integrazione continua.
• Fornire la valutazione tecnica dello sviluppo dei componenti di progettazione in mobile, assicurando che l'approccio è di qualità, è centrico cliente, pensiero futuro e facile da usare.
• Partecipa attivamente alla creazione dell'architettura per applicazioni mobili, coerente con le strategie di piattaforma, la politica di governance e gli standard. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaborazione:
• Collaborare con i team di progettazione e sviluppo per allineare obiettivi, obiettivi e risultati aziendali.
• Assicurare la documentazione sui componenti mobili e sostenere la comunità di sviluppo mobile in adozione, implementazione, test e manutenzione.
• Lavorare con i clienti Roche (progetti, architetti, progettisti, sviluppatori di front-end) per stabilire la collaborazione, comprendere le loro esigenze e risolvere i loro dubbi.
• Campione dell'adozione del sistema di progettazione insieme al cliente e agli ingegneri di usabilità attraverso Roche. Attività creative / strategiche:
• Miglioramenti del Brainstorm e proporre soluzioni innovative per migliorare il coinvolgimento della comunità.
• Valutare le nuove tecnologie, i modelli e i quadri per una potenziale adozione.
• Contribuire alla revisione di progettazione, ai prototipi e agli standard di esperienza dell'utente mobile. Sistema di progettazione alimentato AI:
• Creare documentazione per gli agenti AI per garantire che gli utenti del sistema di progettazione possano intuire il codice con la libreria
• Creare applicazioni di test utilizzando la codifica delle vibrazioni per garantire la compatibilità della libreria con AI
• Documentare tutti i componenti del codice Fiigma connettersi Competenze essenziali per la vostra missione:
• Sviluppatore Android per almeno 5 anni
• Esperto in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose e Git
• Esperienza con Material Design 3 per Jetpack Compose e Design Systems in generale
• Forte esperienza nella costruzione di componenti UI riutilizzabili, testabili e componibili
• Proficienza di scrivere test di unità, test di screenshot, Compose UI test
• Conoscenza profonda dell'attuazione delle migliori pratiche di accessibilità (A11y) in Jetpack Compose
• RTL conoscenza Competenze bonus:
• Vivid interesse per le moderne tendenze tecnologiche e le migliori pratiche
• Curiosità nei domini al di fuori di Android: sviluppo iOS, conoscenza delle soluzioni Cross-platform.
• Esperienza di prodotti in risorse interne
• Engagement in comunità di sviluppo, gestione della comunità, contributo attivo all'apertura
