descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung

Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Wir konzentrieren uns auf langfristige Investitionen in Forschung und Entwicklung und streben danach, das Leben heute und für kommende Generationen zu verbessern. Polen spielt die Rolle des Technology Co-creation and Acceleration Hub und baut Fähigkeiten auf, die digitale Innovationen vorantreiben. Bei Roche Informatics sind wir ein vielfältiges Team offener und freundlicher Menschen, die sich für technologische Neuheiten und optimale IT-Lösungen begeistern.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Beschreibung des Gebiets

Der Demand-to-Pay-Wertstrom (D2P) ist dafür verantwortlich, die End-to-End-Daten- und KI-Strategien für Beschaffung, Kreditorenbuchhaltung und Reise- und Spesenmanagement voranzutreiben, indem er funktionale Strategien in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse übersetzt.

Die Rolle ist Teil des ERP-Source-to-Procure-Teams innerhalb des ERP-Demand-to-Pay-Wertstroms (D2P). In dieser Rolle stehen Sie an vorderster Front bei der Transformation von Source-to-Contract-Architektur und -Prozessen. Diese praktische Rolle erfordert eine proaktive und strategische Denkweise, bei der Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung von Lösungen und End-to-End-Implementierungen spielen.

In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie eng mit Geschäftsinteressenten, IT-Kollegen und Produktmanagern zusammen, insbesondere am Source-to-Contract-Prozess (S2C), verstehen die Geschäftsanforderungen und bieten umfassende Lösungen für die strategische/taktische Beschaffung bis hin zum Vertragsmanagement in einer skalierbaren technischen Lösung für unsere wichtigsten Stakeholder – Global Procurement, Diagnostics Direct Procurement und RSS (Roche Services and Solutions).

Diese Position bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit, durch die Identifizierung und Skalierung von KI-Innovationen zur Entwicklung der Source-to-Contract-Architekturstrategie beizutragen. Bereitstellung cloudfähiger Strategien für eine nachhaltige Technologieeinführung im Einklang mit den strategischen Prioritäten von Roche.

Die Gelegenheit

- Definieren und besitzen Sie den Architecture Runway und stellen Sie sicher, dass er strikt an der langfristigen Zielarchitektur ausgerichtet bleibt. Arbeiten Sie mit Solution Trains und Agile Release Trains (ARTs) zusammen, um technische Roadmaps mit Geschäftsprioritäten zu synchronisieren.

- Entwerfen Sie End-to-End-Integrationsstrategien in einer heterogenen Landschaft (z. B. SAP S/4HANA, GEP Smart, ORO, Deployed und andere CLM-Plattformen).

- Fördern Sie umfassende End-to-End-Lösungsdesigns und verwalten Sie komplexe Integrationen und nahtlose Datenflüsse im gesamten Ökosystem. Übersetzen Sie hochrangige Geschäftsanforderungen in detaillierte Lösungs-/Systementwürfe und umsetzbare Rückstände. Verwaltet nichtfunktionale Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen.

- Setzen Sie eine „Clean Core“-Strategie durch und halten Sie sich an etablierte Erweiterbarkeitsprinzipien, um die Langlebigkeit des Systems sicherzustellen. Verfechten Sie einen Fit-to-Standard-Ansatz, um technische Schulden zu minimieren und die WRICEF-Komplexität (Workflow, Berichte, Schnittstellen, Konvertierungen, Erweiterungen und Formulare) proaktiv zu reduzieren. Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus weiter und stimmt sie mit der Architektur-Community ab, um eine ordnungsgemäße Governance zu gewährleisten.

- Identifizieren und mindern Sie technische Risiken und Abhängigkeiten über mehrere ARTs (Agile Release Trains) hinweg. Sorgen Sie für die allgemeine technische Integrität und Architekturkonsistenz in der gesamten Unternehmenslandschaft.

- Identifizieren, entwerfen und skalieren Sie KI-gesteuerte Innovationen (z. B. automatisiertes Vertrags-Redlining, Vertragsanalyse usw.).
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descriptif

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste

Nous nous concentrons sur des investissements de premier plan à long terme dans la recherche et le développement, en nous efforçant d'améliorer la vie d'aujourd'hui et des générations à venir. La Pologne joue le rôle de centre de co-création et d’accélération technologique en renforçant les capacités de stimulation de l’innovation numérique. Chez Roche Informatics, nous sommes une équipe diversifiée de personnes ouvertes et amicales, passionnées par les nouveautés technologiques et les solutions informatiques optimales.

Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs.

Description de la zone

La chaîne de valeur Demand to Pay (D2P) est chargée de piloter les stratégies de bout en bout en matière de données et d'IA en matière d'approvisionnement, de comptes fournisseurs et de gestion des voyages et des dépenses, en traduisant les stratégies fonctionnelles en résultats commerciaux mesurables.

Le rôle fait partie de l'équipe ERP Source to Procure au sein de la chaîne de valeur ERP Demand to Pay (D2P). Dans ce rôle, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la transformation de l'architecture et des processus source en contrat. Ce rôle pratique nécessite un état d'esprit proactif et stratégique, dans lequel vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conduite de solutions et de mises en œuvre de bout en bout.

Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise, les homologues informatiques et les chefs de produits spécifiquement sur le processus Source to Contract (S2C), en comprenant les besoins de l'entreprise et en fournissant des solutions complètes pour l'approvisionnement stratégique/tactique jusqu'à la gestion des contrats dans une solution technique évolutive pour nos principales parties prenantes - Achats mondiaux, Achats directs de diagnostic et RSS (Services et solutions Roche).

Ce poste offre une opportunité passionnante de contribuer au développement de la stratégie architecturale Source to Contract grâce à l'identification et à la mise à l'échelle des innovations en matière d'IA. Fournir des stratégies prêtes pour le cloud pour une adoption technologique durable, alignées sur les priorités stratégiques de Roche.

L'opportunité

- Définir et s'approprier la piste d'architecture, en veillant à ce qu'elle reste strictement alignée sur l'architecture cible à long terme. Collaborez avec Solution Trains et Agile Release Trains (ART) pour synchroniser les feuilles de route techniques avec les priorités commerciales.

- Concevoir des stratégies d'intégration de bout en bout dans un paysage hétérogène (par exemple SAP S/4HANA, GEP Smart, ORO, Deployed et autres plateformes CLM).

- Piloter des conceptions de solutions complètes de bout en bout, en gérant des intégrations complexes et des flux de données transparents à travers l'écosystème. Traduire les exigences commerciales de haut niveau en conceptions détaillées de solutions/systèmes et en backlogs exploitables. Gère les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de remise en forme.

- Appliquer une stratégie « Clean Core » et adhérer aux principes d'extensibilité établis pour assurer la longévité du système. Promouvoir une approche adaptée aux normes pour minimiser la dette technique et réduire de manière proactive la complexité du WRICEF (workflow, rapports, interfaces, conversions, améliorations et formulaires). Documente et fait évoluer l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, et s'aligne sur la communauté des architectes pour une gouvernance appropriée.

- Identifier et atténuer les risques techniques et les dépendances entre plusieurs ART (Agile Release Trains). Maintenir l’intégrité technique globale et la cohérence architecturale dans l’ensemble du paysage de l’entreprise.

- Identifier, concevoir et mettre à l'échelle des innovations basées sur l'IA (par exemple, révision automatisée des contrats, analyse des contrats, etc.)

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) operations, including invoice processing (PO/non-PO), payments, reconciliations, and query resolution.

• Support month-end closing activities, including accrual analysis, balance sheet reconciliations, and preparation of financial and KPI reports.

• Ensure compliance and accuracy through duplicate checks, sanction screening, audit support, and maintenance of process documentation.

• Handle stakeholder communication by resolving internal and external queries and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

• Support operational excellence through system troubleshooting, process improvements, training, and participation in projects, system integration, and UAT.

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English language.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• SAP skill & AP related process knowledge is added advantage

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Referendariat - Juristische Wahlstation am Standort Penzberg (m/w/d)

Dein Team
Roche ist eines der weltweit führenden Biotechnologieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Medikamente, Diagnostika und digitale Lösungen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig zu verbessern. Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an.

Unser Team am Standort Penzberg besteht aus 4 Legal Counsel sowie 4 Paralegal, wobei wir standortübergreifend, Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Mannheim und der Schweiz, agieren.

Unser Arbeitsstil ist von Wertschätzung, Technologie-Offenheit, guter Teamarbeit, Kreativität sowie nicht zuletzt Spaß an den Aufgaben geprägt. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Dein Referendariat
Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.

• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.

• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.

• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt.

Deine Benefits
Eingebettet zwischen der Großstadt München und dem schönen Voralpenland liegt unser Standort Penzberg mit gut 7.700 Mitarbeitenden. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)

• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung

• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um deine berufliche Karriere

• Sehr gute Anbindung an das ÖPNV-Netz im Penzberger

Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an.

Unser Team am Standort Penzberg besteht aus 4 Legal Counsel sowie 4 Paralegal, wobei wir standortübergreifend, Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Mannheim und der Schweiz, agieren.

Unser Arbeitsstil ist von Wertschätzung, Technologie-Offenheit, guter Teamarbeit, Kreativität sowie nicht zuletzt Spaß an den Aufgaben geprägt. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Dein Referendariat
Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.

• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.

• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.

• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt.

Deine Benefits
Eingebettet zwischen der Großstadt München und dem schönen Voralpenland liegt unser Standort Penzberg mit gut 7.700 Mitarbeitenden. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)

• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung

• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um deine berufliche Karriere

• Sehr gute Anbindung an das ÖPNV-Netz im Penzberger

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - Genesys
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Description of the area
The Customer Interaction Platform and Services team is part of the Enterprise Platforms group. We provide Contact Center and Telephony services to all Roche divisions globally, including Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics. Our team supports critical communication channels for both internal staff (such as Service Desk and other internal services) and external customers (including Patients, HCPs, and other partners).
We are currently transforming our Contact Center platform into a solution that allows us to innovate faster, deliver solutions to our consumers more quickly, and enable new AI transformative use cases.
Our team works closely with other architects within Enterprise Platforms, such as the Salesforce and ServiceNow teams. This collaboration ensures our systems are aligned, follow proper governance, and work together to provide a great user experience across the entire technology ecosystem.
We are a global team with a presence in all regions, supporting the Roche community wherever they are located.

The Role: Your day-to-day at Roche
In this position, you will lead the architectural vision for complex, large-scale products that serve both our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions.

• Architectural Leadership: You will design standards-based solutions that balance product requirements with Roche’s Enterprise standards. You’ll be the "guardian" of the roadmap, managing technical debt and ensuring our landscape remains agile.

• Innovation & AI: You’ll drive the adoption of AI transformative use cases within our CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) environment, evaluating new technologies and conducting vendor assessments to keep us at the forefront of the industry.

• Strategic Collaboration: You will work side-by-side with other architects and product teams, providing technical oversight and ensuring our data models, ontologies, and integration pathways are world-class.

• Mentorship & Influence: As a senior expert, you’ll mentor others and help evolve our global Architecture Practices. You’ll be a master at explaining complex concepts to stakeholders and negotiating solutions that drive real value.

Who You Are: Your Profile
You are someone who thrives in complex, global environments. You are a natural problem-solver who uses analytical depth to find innovative paths forward. You are passionate about people, technology, and change.

Your technical toolkit should include:

• Extensive Experience: Proven track record as a Solution Architect in complex, multi-product environments.

• CCaaS Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with cloud-based telephony products, specifically Genesys Cloud (CCaaS) . You understand End-to-End voice topologies.

• Tech Savvy: Expert knowledge in Cloud Foundation, Security & Compliance, and a strong passion for AI & Conversational Technologies .

• Architectural Craft: Proficiency in creating Data

jobs.title: Senior Director, Translational Medicine China
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead the Translational Medicine (TM) and Development Sciences (DevSci) Teams in China for Roche. The TM China team works with our global partners to primarily lead biomarker development efforts as well as support activities across Bioanalytical sciences, Clinical Pharmacology and Safety Assessment. This role directly oversees clinical development projects in China and the Asia Pacific region for programs in early and late stage clinical development spanning multiple therapeutic modalities and areas including Oncology, Hematology, Neuroscience,, Immunology, Cardiovascular, Metabolism and Ophthalmology.

The Senior Director role serves as the site head for Translational Medicine and Development Sciences China, leading a lab enabled team of 13+ talented researchers and scientists. In this role the Senior Director represents TM China on local development and study teams as well as global teams and will develop and execute the biomarker, CDx and translational research strategies for the respective therapeutic modalities. This role plays an important part in communicating to and developing collaborative relationships with key investigators and thought leaders in China and APAC, which will be essential in driving our translational sciences forward.

The Senior Director and Site Head for Translational Medicine and Development Sciences China will report to the Head of Translational Medicine Oncology with a dotted reporting line the the Head of Development Sciences within Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) based in South San Francisco, USA and is a member of the Roche Product Development China Leadership Team. This role requires an individual who possesses a cross-enterprise (borderless) mindset with outstanding communication and leadership skills that enable collaboration across the Roche organization and the ability to build and facilitate strong relationships internally and externally.

Responsibilities:

• Communicate and collaborate globally with Translational Medicine (TM) and Development Sciences (Dev Sci) leadership across Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED).

• Provide exceptional scientific leadership to team and peers across the organization

• Lead and drive China biomarker strategies and collaborations, data analysis and interpretation, and presentation to review forums and governance committees

• Participate and lead as a key member of Roche Leadership activities including the Product Development China Leadership team, Roche Human Genetics Resources Administration of China (HGRAC) monitoring committee, China PHC working group, and China Medical affairs

• Contribute to the biomarker regulatory strategy for China/APAC, participate in interactions with health authorities in China and contribute to preparation of relevant regulatory documents

• Develop and lead biomarker strategy and plan for medical affairs sponsored activities in China collaboration with the International medical leaders for the respective programs and the country medical affairs organization

• Develop and lead biomarker collaborations with key investigators and thought leaders

This role directly oversees clinical development projects in China and the Asia Pacific region for programs in early and late stage clinical development spanning multiple therapeutic modalities and areas including Oncology, Hematology, Neuroscience,, Immunology, Cardiovascular, Metabolism and Ophthalmology.

The Senior Director role serves as the site head for Translational Medicine and Development Sciences China, leading a lab enabled team of 13+ talented researchers and scientists. In this role the Senior Director represents TM China on local development and study teams as well as global teams and will develop and execute the biomarker, CDx and translational research strategies for the respective therapeutic modalities. This role plays an important part in communicating to and developing collaborative relationships with key investigators and thought leaders in China and APAC, which will be essential in driving our translational sciences forward.

The Senior Director and Site Head for Translational Medicine and Development Sciences China will report to the Head of Translational Medicine Oncology with a dotted reporting line the the Head of Development Sciences within Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) based in South San Francisco, USA and is a member of the Roche Product Development China Leadership Team. This role requires an individual who possesses a cross-enterprise (borderless) mindset with outstanding communication and leadership skills that enable collaboration across the Roche organization and the ability to build and facilitate strong relationships internally and externally.

Responsibilities:

• Communicate and collaborate globally with Translational Medicine (TM) and Development Sciences (Dev Sci) leadership across Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED).

• Provide exceptional scientific leadership to team and peers across the organization

• Lead and drive China biomarker strategies and collaborations, data analysis and interpretation, and presentation to review forums and governance committees

• Participate and lead as a key member of Roche Leadership activities including the Product Development China Leadership team, Roche Human Genetics Resources Administration of China (HGRAC) monitoring committee, China PHC working group, and China Medical affairs

• Contribute to the biomarker regulatory strategy for China/APAC, participate in interactions with health authorities in China and contribute to preparation of relevant regulatory documents

• Develop and lead biomarker strategy and plan for medical affairs sponsored activities in China collaboration with the International medical leaders for the respective programs and the country medical affairs organization

• Develop and lead biomarker collaborations with key investigators and thought leaders

• Strategic oversight of DevSci-wide goals and activities in China (BioAnalytical Sciences and Clinical Pharmacology), including oversight over local external bioanalytical service providers and local Health Authority engagements, strategic vision for making an impact across programs in China, and ways to increase PTS or acc

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag#LI-DNI

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist (Fixed-term contract till end Sep. 2027)

Position summary
The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for executing HR system data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner, in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, and several local and global benefits. etc.

You will support the following countries for the Polaris implementation:

• Bosnia and Herzegovina

• North Macedonia

• Albania

• Georgia

Responsibilities:
Service Delivery

• Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, several local and global benefits administration, etc.

• Provide customer service on pay, time and benefits related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting.

• Understand and have working knowledge of local time/absence policies.

• Correspondence with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time/absence entry.

• Manage, process and reconcile mass upload files for all pay frequencies.

• Monitor data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy

• Ensure integrations are processed timely and resolve any errors ensuring accurately processed

• Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.

• Supports P&C Chapters in system maintenance activities.

• Provide guidance and advisory to first level P&C support teams.

• Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (KA, SWIs).

• Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced.

• Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

• Ensure end to end ownership of resolution

• Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and ServiceNow OKRs.

• Support country non-PTB activities upon the business needs if applicable.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build relationships with P&C colleagues as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

• Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support Solutions network provides consistent and effective services to our customers.

• Achieve our P&C vision by driving local consistency through collaboration.

Outputs & Deliverables

• Continuous contribution to the improvement of the performance of People Support Solutions

• Reaching high customer satisfaction through consistent, high quality delivery and application of customer care principles (measured by defined stakeholder feedback)

Who you are
In this role you will be working within a team focusing on a customer group from one of the regions and across various functions and levels within the organization.
You bring the following experience :

• 1-2 years of experience in payroll services and benefits administration, in a shared service center environment preferably.

• Knowledge

jobs.title: Complaint Handling Engineer - Sequencing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Complaint Handling Engineer - Sequencing

As a Complaint Handling Engineer you will be dealing with queries concerning Digital Solutions quality and product performance of Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions. data communication, apps algorithms.

As a member of the Digital Solutions Chapter, you will be working in a very transversal software environment having the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies and different programming languages for on-premise and cloud-based software. You need to be able to read and understand source code in order to find out the root cause/causal factor of a SW malfunction/SW issue, and also be able to learn about software requirements, fixing bugs process (even if you will not fix them) and general code maintenance. All of it in an Agile environment where you could contribute with your own ideas and proposals in a team continuously improving

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for the timely handling of individual cases (Inquiry, Complaint, Potential Reportable and Safety issues) according to ISO Quality System requirements and regulations, and needs of the Country Organizations including creation, acceptance, classification, investigation, complete documentation, on-site trouble-shooting and resolution of cases.

• Resolves cases in the assigned area, potentially requiring consultation with more senior team members on technical or process-related aspects.

• Interface with Affiliates and assumes responsibility for timely communication of quality related information to the Country Organizations. Supports initiatives and measures to maintain enhanced interfaces with country organizations and regional representatives.

• Analyzes data using statistical measures for determining a potential product performance issue.

• Responsible for escalating cases which cannot be directly resolved to appropriate levels and initiating further investigation and communicating case derived information as appropriate.

• Ensures cases are compliant and conform to established quality processes, standards, and regulations.

• May be required to perform other duties as assigned to meet the PMQ goals and objectives as appropriate

Who you are:

• You own a degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science (with knowledge on bioinformatics or genomics will be a plus), or a related field. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential

• Work experience in the area of bioinformatics and/or in support related functions is desired.

• Experience reading source code and working with Linux/Unix operating systems for working with sequencing pipelines is desired.

• Experience with workflow management tools like Nextflow, Snakemake, CWL, or similar is desired.

• Understanding of cloud computing platforms as well as experience managing on premise infrastructure (including servers and high performance computing clusters) is desired.

• Knowledge of containerization technologies is desired.

• You are able to read and or debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues.

What you get:

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Abteilung Communications & Public Affairs arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, aus den vielfältigen Inhalten unseres Unternehmens spannende Geschichten zu entwickeln und diese mit kreativen Ideen und Formaten für unsere Mitarbeitenden, Medienvertreter und unser Umfeld kommunikativ umzusetzen. So unterstützen wir die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens und machen die Identität von Roche erlebbar. Als Volontär:in erhältst Du Einblicke in die inhaltlichen und organisatorischen Abläufe der internen und externen Unternehmenskommunikation und lernst unser kommunikatives Tagesgeschäft kennen.

Unser 18-monatiges, bezahltes Volontariat im Bereich Communications & Public Affairs bietet Dir eine solide Ausbildung „on-the-Job“ sowie gezielte und unterstützende theoretische Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten. Unser Ausbildungsprogramm ist DAPR-zertifiziert und so können wir unseren Volontären eine bestmögliche Qualifizierung parallel zum Job anbieten. Unsere Volontär:innen profitieren von der theoretisch fundierten und stets auf den praktischen Kommunikationsalltag ausgerichteten Seminargestaltung der DAPR, die die Anwendbarkeit im Job sicherstellt.

Für diese abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben suchen wir Dich:

• Kommunikation mit Konzept: Du erstellst Kommunikationskonzepte und lernst, wie man Projekte organisiert und umsetzt. Dabei betreust Du eigenständig Kommunikationsprojekte unter unserer Anleitung.

• Texte, die ankommen: Du verfasst Texte aller Art - von der Pressemitteilung über Intranet-News bis hin zu Artikeln für interne und externe Medien.

• Gute Inhalte, viele Formen: Du setzt Themen für verschiedene Kanäle und in verschiedenen Formaten um: vom Podcast bis zur tagesaktuellen News-App. Dabei berücksichtigst Du unterschiedliche Perspektiven, planst zielgruppengerecht und bist kreativ bei der Aufbereitung.

• Event mit Planung: Du unterstützt bei der Organisation und kommunikativen Begleitung von externen und internen Events oder Pressegesprächen.

• Kommunikation in allen Facetten: Du erhältst Einblicke in die verschiedenen Aufgabengebiete der Kommunikationsabteilung wie Produkt- und Diseasekommunikation, interne Kommunikation, Executive-Kommunikation, Change-Kommunikation, Medienarbeit oder Eventkommunikation

Je nach Vorerfahrung wird eine begleitende, personalisierte Ausbildung bei der DAPR oder eine weiterführende Ausbildung durch flexible Trainings angeboten. Dabei wird die Auswahl der Weiter- und Fortbildungen gemeinsam mit Dir getroffen und so perfekt auf Deine Bedürfnisse abgestimmt. Die Ausbildungskosten werden von Roche übernommen.

Wer Du bist
Du möchtest selbst entscheiden, wie Du Dich entwickelst. Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Unternehmen, in dem Du als Mitglied eines agilen Teams Deinen Interessen nachgehen kannst und in dem die Stellenausschreibung nicht die endgültige Definition, sondern nur den Ausgangspunkt Deiner Rolle darstellt? Dann haben wir die perfekte Stelle für Dich.

Für dieses Volontariat bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Deinen Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) hast Du bereits abgeschlossen. Die Fachrichtung ist nicht entscheidend. Wichtiger ist uns, dass Du Dich für das Kommunikationsfach begeisterst, aufgeschlossen bist für die Vielfalt der Themen und diese attraktiv und zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten weißt.

• Du hast Freude am Texten, Konzeptionieren, grafischen Gestalten und Organisieren.

• Du bringst Kenntnisse über die Anwendung digitaler Medien in der Kommunikation mit und hast erste Erfahrungen in der Produktio

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

A Roche si può essere se stessi, abbracciando le qualità uniche che si portano. La nostra cultura incoraggia le espressioni personali, i dialoghi aperti e le connessioni genuine, pur essendo valorizzati, accettati e rispettati come chi siete, e si può sviluppare personalmente e professionalmente. Così cerchiamo di prevenire, fermare e guarire le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Come dipartimento Comunicazione & Affari Pubblici, lavoriamo insieme per sviluppare storie emozionanti dai diversi contenuti della nostra azienda e per implementarle comunicativamente con idee e formati creativi per i nostri dipendenti, rappresentanti dei media e il nostro ambiente. Sosteniamo l'orientamento strategico dell'azienda e rendiamo l'identità di Roche esperta. Come volontario: in voi ottenere informazioni sui contenuti e processi organizzativi della comunicazione aziendale interna ed esterna e conoscere il nostro business quotidiano comunicativo.

Compiti

- Comunicazione con concetto: Inizi a creare concetti di comunicazione e a imparare ad organizzare e realizzare progetti. Gestisci in modo indipendente i progetti di comunicazione sotto la nostra guida. - Testi che arrivano: Scrivi testi di ogni genere - dal comunicato stampa alle notizie Intranet agli articoli per i media interni ed esterni. - Buon contenuto, molte forme: Implementi argomenti per diversi canali e in diversi formati: dal podcast alla news app quotidiana.

Si tengono conto di diverse prospettive, si pianifica il proprio target e si è creativi nella preparazione. - Evento con pianificazione: Si sostiene l'organizzazione e il supporto comunicativo di eventi esterni ed interni o di discussioni stampa. - Comunicazione in tutti i aspetti: Si ottiene approfondimenti sulle diverse aree di responsabilità del dipartimento di comunicazione come la comunicazione di prodotti e malattie, comunicazione interna, comunicazione esecutiva, cambiamento di comunicazione, lavoro sui media o comunicazione di eventi

Requisiti

- Hai già completato la tua laurea (Bachelor o Master) e l'area tematica non è decisiva. Per noi è più importante che tu sia entusiasta del tema della comunicazione, che sia aperto alla varietà di argomenti e che sia in grado di prepararli in modo attraente e mirato a gruppi. - Ti piace scrivere, concettualizzare, progettare grafica e organizzare. - Porta conoscenza dell'applicazione dei media digitali nella comunicazione e hai la prima esperienza nei processi di produzione e pubblicazione.

Offriamo

- Il nostro volontario retribuito di 18 mesi nel settore Comunicazione & Affari Pubblici vi offre una formazione solida sul posto di lavoro, nonché opportunità di formazione teorica mirate e di supporto. - Il nostro programma di formazione è certificato DAPR e quindi possiamo offrire ai nostri volontari la migliore qualifica possibile in parallelo con il lavoro. - A seconda dell'esperienza precedente, un accompagnamento, formazione personalizzata presso il DAPR o un ulteriore formazione è offerto attraverso formazione flessibile.

La scelta di formazione continua e di perfezionamento professionale è effettuata insieme a voi e quindi perfettamente adattata alle vostre esigenze. - I costi di formazione sono coperti da Roche.

Contatto

Chi sei Vuoi decidere da solo come stai sviluppandoti. Stai cercando un'azienda dove puoi perseguire i tuoi interessi come membro di un team di una piccola azienda e dove la pubblicità del lavoro non è la definizione finale, ma solo il punto di partenza del tuo ruolo? Allora abbiamo il lavoro perfetto per te.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

At Roche you can be yourself, encompassing the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expressions, open dialogues and genuine connections, while being valued, accepted and respected as who you are, and you can develop yourself personally and professionally. This is how we try to prevent, stop and heal diseases and ensure that everyone has access to healthcare today and for future generations. Join Roche, where every voice counts.

The position

As a Communications & Public Affairs department, we work together to develop exciting stories from the diverse content of our company and to implement them communicatively with creative ideas and formats for our employees, media representatives and our environment. We support the strategic orientation of the company and make the identity of Roche experienceable. As a volunteer:in you get insights into the content and organizational processes of internal and external corporate communication and get to know our communicative day-to-day business.

Tasks

- Communication with concept: You start to create communication concepts and learn how to organize and implement projects. You independently manage communication projects under our guidance. - Texts that arrive: You write texts of all kinds - from the press release to Intranet news to articles for internal and external media. - Good content, many forms: You implement topics for different channels and in different formats: from podcast to daily news app.

You take different perspectives into account, plan your own target group and are creative in the preparation. - Event with planning: You support the organization and communicative support of external and internal events or press discussions. - Communication in all facets: You get insights into the different areas of responsibility of the communication department such as product and disease communication, internal communication, executive communication, change communication, media work or event communication

Requirements

- You have already completed your degree (Bachelor or Master's degree) and the subject area is not decisive. More important to us is that you are enthusiastic about the communication subject, are open to the variety of topics and are able to prepare them attractively and target group-oriented. - You enjoy texting, conceptualizing, graphic design and organizing. - You bring knowledge about the application of digital media in communication and have first experience in the production and publication processes.

We offer

- Our 18-month paid volunteer in the area of Communications & Public Affairs offers you a solid training „on-the-job, as well as targeted and supporting theoretical training opportunities. - Our training program is DAPR certified and so we can offer our volunteers the best possible qualification in parallel with the job. - Depending on the previous experience, an accompanying, personalized training at the DAPR or a further training is offered through flexible training.

The selection of further training and further training is taken together with you and thus perfectly adapted to your needs. - The training costs are covered by Roche.

Contact

Who you are You want to decide for yourself how you are developing. You are looking for a company where you can pursue your interests as a member of a team of a small company and where the job advertisement is not the final definition, but only the starting point of your role? Then we have the perfect job for you.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Chez Roche, vous pouvez être vous-même, en englobant les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage les expressions personnelles, les dialogues ouverts et les liens authentiques, tout en étant appréciés, acceptés et respectés comme vous êtes, et vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous essayons de prévenir, d'arrêter et de guérir les maladies et de garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures.

La position

En tant que service de communication et d'affaires publiques, nous travaillons ensemble pour développer des histoires passionnantes à partir du contenu varié de notre entreprise et les mettre en œuvre de manière interactive avec des idées et des formats créatifs pour nos employés, représentants des médias et notre environnement. Nous soutenons l'orientation stratégique de l'entreprise et rendons l'identité de Roche plus agréable.

Tâches

- Communication avec concept : Vous commencez à créer des concepts de communication et apprendre à organiser et à mettre en œuvre des projets. Vous gérez des projets de communication de manière indépendante sous notre direction. - Textes qui arrivent : Vous écrivez des textes de toutes sortes - du communiqué de presse aux nouvelles intranet aux articles pour les médias internes et externes. - Bon contenu, de nombreux formulaires : Vous implémentez des sujets pour différents canaux et dans différents formats : du podcast au quotidien.

Vous prenez en compte différentes perspectives, planifiez votre propre groupe cible et êtes créatif dans la préparation. - Événement avec planification: Vous soutenez l'organisation et le soutien communicatif d'événements externes et internes ou de discussions de presse. - Communication sous toutes ses facettes: Vous obtenez des informations sur les différents domaines de responsabilité du service de communication tels que la communication produit et maladie, communication interne, communication exécutive, communication changement, travail média ou communication événementiel

Besoins

- Vous avez déjà terminé votre diplôme (Bachelor ou Master) et le domaine n'est pas décisif. Plus important pour nous est que vous êtes enthousiastes au sujet de la communication, sont ouverts à la variété des sujets et sont en mesure de les préparer attrayantement et cible-orienté groupe. - Vous aimez le texte, conceptualisation, conception graphique et organisation. - Vous apportez des connaissances sur l'application des médias numériques dans la communication et avez une première expérience dans les processus de production et de publication.

Nous offrons

- Notre volontaire rémunéré de 18 mois dans le domaine de la communication et des affaires publiques vous offre une formation solide en cours d'emploi, ainsi que des opportunités de formation théorique ciblées et de soutien. - Notre programme de formation est certifié DAPR et nous pouvons ainsi offrir à nos bénévoles la meilleure qualification possible en parallèle avec le travail. - Selon l'expérience précédente, une formation accompagnée, personnalisée au DAPR ou une formation complémentaire est offerte par une formation flexible.

La sélection de la formation continue et de la formation continue est prise en charge avec vous et donc parfaitement adaptée à vos besoins. - Les coûts de formation sont pris en charge par Roche.

Personne à contacter

Qui vous êtes Vous voulez décider par vous-même comment vous développez. Vous recherchez une entreprise où vous pouvez poursuivre vos intérêts en tant que membre d'une équipe d'une petite entreprise et où la publicité d'emploi n'est pas la définition finale, mais seulement le point de départ de votre rôle? Ensuite, nous avons le travail parfait pour vous.

jobs.title: (副）大客户经理 - MCE
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称： （副）大客户经理

您是谁：
根据公司业务发展需求，聚焦区域内创新业务模式拓展、医院准入、新业极项目推进及相关策略制定与实施，并协助招标/价格谈判等相关工作，以患者为中心驱动业务增长和生态体系的搭建与增值。

您的机会：
1：负责跟进经销商和零售商管理要求。
1.1 根据公司及部门策略，制定区域经销商/药店拜访计划，确保公司及经销商/药店达成一致目标，助力区域业务发展 。
1.2 严格准确执行商业/药店合作项目，定期跟进目标成果
2：负责所属区域医院准入计划的制定与推动 。
2.1 根据每年确定医院开发目标，制定区域的医院准入目标开发计划和时间表，保障医院准入目标达成 。
2.2 主导推动相关医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学、院管等决策部分的解决方案 。
2.3 确保所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医务、医保等合作 。
3：制定区域项目相关策略及项目实施计划，实现项目助力业务目标达成。
3.1 学习研究医药行业领域相关政策和知识，收集内外部客户需求反馈，发掘创新业务机会。
3.2 根据MCE总部年度计划，分解落地区域计划，确保总部项目在区域的执行和产出评估。
3.3 负责项目实施（含流程申请）和外部沟通，建立较完善的项目管理回顾机制，包括项目目标、范围、进度、沟通、风险管理、成本、监控与产出分析。
3.4 推动建立区域品牌项目, 包括在渠道、医院、药店以及三医联动等区域品牌的建立,跨团队品牌项目的实施。
4：结合公司战略与内外部资源，拓展以患者诊疗需求为中心新业极服务创新模式
4.1 根据公司和部门策略，探索围绕患者为中心的新业极方案迭代优化。
4.2 依据总部策略，完成年度新业极各项KPI考核。
5: 协助执行所属省/市招标和价格谈判：
5.1 协助招标团队在所属省/市招标工作，收集与反馈招标信息、递交招标资料和网上操作、招标申诉跟进、组织当地内部会议协调分工、反馈招标结果等。
5.2 收集与反馈价格谈判信息，协助制定价格谈判方案，递交资料（如果需要）和议价工作，与内部外沟通相关议价结果。
6：日常工作管理
6.1 按时按质提交各类数据报表，包括工作计划、项目/准入数据、费用计划和回顾分析等内容。
6.2 按照要求完成各项KPI目标。
6.3 严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策。
我们期待这样的您加入：
• 既往有销售管理岗、KA岗、区域市场经验的优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
职位名称： （副）大客户经理

您是谁：
根据公司业务发展需求，聚焦区域内创新业务模式拓展、医院准入、新业极项目推进及相关策略制定与实施，并协助招标/价格谈判等相关工作，以患者为中心驱动业务增长和生态体系的搭建与增值。

您的机会：
1：负责跟进经销商和零售商管理要求。
1.1 根据公司及部门策略，制定区域经销商/药店拜访计划，确保公司及经销商/药店达成一致目标，助力区域业务发展 。
1.2 严格准确执行商业/药店合作项目，定期跟进目标成果
2：负责所属区域医院准入计划的制定与推动 。
2.1 根据每年确定医院开发目标，制定区域的医院准入目标开发计划和时间表，保障医院准入目标达成 。
2.2 主导推动相关医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学、院管等决策部分的解决方案 。
2.3 确保所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医务、医保等合作 。
3：制定区域项目相关策略及项目实施计划，实现项目助力业务目标达成。
3.1 学习研究医药行业领域相关政策和知识，收集内外部客户需求反馈，发掘创新业务机会。
3.2 根据MCE总部年度计划，分解落地区域计划，确保总部项目在区域的执行和产出评估。
3.3 负责项目实施（含流程申请）和外部沟通，建立较完善的项目管理回顾机制，包括项目目标、范围、进度、沟通、风险管理、成本、监控与产出分析。
3.4 推动建立区域品牌项目, 包括在渠道、医院、药店以及三医联动等区域品牌的建立,跨团队品牌项目的实施。
4：结合公司战略与内外部资源，拓展以患者诊疗需求为中心新业极服务创新模式
4.1 根据公司和部门策略，探索围绕患者为中心的新业极方案迭代优化。
4.2 依据总部策略，完成年度新业极各项KPI考核。
5: 协助执行所属省/市招标和价格谈判：
5.1 协助招标团队在所属省/市招标工作，收集与反馈招标信息、递交招标资料和网上操作、招标申诉跟进、组织当地内部会议协调分工、反馈招标结果等。
5.2 收集与反馈价格谈判信息，协助制定价格谈判方案，递交资料（如果需要）和议价工作，与内部外沟通相关议价结果。
6：日常工作管理
6.1 按时按质提交各类数据报表，包括工作计划、项目/准入数据、费用计划和回顾分析等内容。
6.2 按照要求完成各项KPI目标。
6.3 严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策。
我们期待这样的您加入：
• 既往有销售管理岗、KA岗、区域市场经验的优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Part of the Microbiology/ Environmental Monitoring (EM) team responsible for the following:

• Test EM / product stream samples to meet release timelines, in accordance with cGMP regulations and Roche standards.

• Support manufacturing operations with timely completion of testing and disposition.

• Continuous improvement of processes and technology, in collaboration with ASAT, to drive right first time and efficiencies.

• Qualification and validation of test methods.

• Support investigations of microbial contamination in production processes, classified environments and critical utility systems.

• Ensure test methods and data are generated in a cGMP, compliant manner.

The Opportunity:
Technical:

• Understand basic microbiological principles (Bioburden, LAL, plating and counting techniques, etc) and execution of intermediate techniques (DET, AET)

• Test and review routine and non-routine environmental, raw material, product related samples in accordance to the Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Test Methods (TM).

• Perform EM, including HVAC/ BSC/ HLFH/ VLFH sampling, fingertips monitoring, compressed gases and water/ clean steam sampling in accordance to cGMP procedures.

• Document and review results in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and/ or documents in accordance to cGMP procedures.

• Review routine data and logbooks.

• Prepare trend graph for product lot release and trend data analysis.

Functional:

• Perform sample receipt, Chain of Custody and storage of QC samples.

• Manage life-cycle process for retain and reserve/ reference samples.

• Managed and prepare shipment of samples to Receiving labs.

• General lab support including housekeeping, document archival, maintaining logbooks and inventory of lab supplies, etc.

• Initiate discrepancy record.

Others functional:

• Ensuring timely completion of training required to support/ perform cGMP activities.

• Raise Work Notifications, follow-up on planned receipt, delivery orders, invoices, etc.

• Participate in process improvement works.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of laboratory procedures and processes to ensure compliance to cGMPs.

• Participates in internal/ external audits and regulatory inspections.

Teamwork:

• Cooperates with the Head of Microbiology Operations, QC Ops Lead and teammates to create an environment with strong team spirit.

• Strive towards team's objectives/goals.

• Demonstrates initiative and proactively turn ideas into action — to make things happen.

• Engage in proactive measures to promote a positive safety culture and follows applicable Safety, Health and Environment requirements.

• Embody PT behaviors, lean principles and methods while fostering a continuous improvement mindset.

• Good team player with willingness to cover other colleagues in continued support of the Micro/EM operations.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO's Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements.

• Observe all RSTO's site security measures at all times.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), with a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors.

Who You are

• Degree holder with little or no prior relevant work experience.

• cGMP standards and laboratory safety procedures

• A collaborative and proactive team player

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English

Preferred

• Willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link (Company shuttle bus is provided).

• Must be able to work weekend

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose:
Maintain the site’s Right to Operate and enable excellence in manufacturing by providing validation support to the production organization that results in safe, high quality, and continuously improving production.

Own, execute and improve the validation lifecycle from Plan to Retire, for manufacturing processes and equipment. This includes, but is not limited to oversight of Equipment, Facility, and Utility Qualification, Cleaning Validation, Shipping Validation in partnership with Distribution, and administration of the Periodic Review and Revalidation Program. Accountable for ensuring compliance with PQS and HA requirements.

Key
• Responsibilities:
Support the day-to-day operation of approved Validation SOPs / Plan / Policies for a multi-platform, multi-product, GMP biotech contract manufacturing facility.
·Develop Validation SOPs, templates, guidelines, Validation Protocols and Reports including supporting site discrepancies and deviations investigation / closure in line with corporate policies and standards.
· Provide guidance and direction on all validation activities at the Singapore site.
· Ensure that all validation activities with respect to process, cleaning, facilities/equipment and computerized system stated in validation plan/ protocol are carried out in accordance with relevant policies, standards, procedures and guidelines, and completed in a timely fashion.
· Participate actively in investigations or troubleshooting discrepancies/ deviation encountered during commissioning and qualification.
·Generate training materials and to conduct workshops on general validation activities.
· Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) in support of department functions.
· Participate in site Validation Maintenance Program.
· Prepare and review Turnover / Vendor Packages.
· Support Change Implementation on site.
· Support Validation / QA Audits as required, including Material Traceability Audits.
· Participate in external regulatory inspections as SME.
· Contribute, whenever possible, to raising the site awareness on the importance of validation at the Singapore site and within the industry.
· Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.
·Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.
· Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.
· Any other tasks as and when assigned by Supervisor.

Qualifications:
· Degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or equivalent
· 0-3 years of related working experience for degree holders or equivalent holders with combination of education and relative work experience
· Related working experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical operation environment is preferred
· Familiarity with Regulatory requirements and local Codes & Standards (e.g., FDA, EMEA, GAMP and ICHQ7).
· Good knowledge and experience of the practical and theoretical requirement of validation program in GMP facility
· Good oral and written communication skills
·Meticulous and Systematic
· Ability to adapt to rapidly changing priorities and the flexibility to support operations in accordance with the manufacturing schedule

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Position Summary
We are seeking a motivated Utilities Project Engineer trainee to support the planning, construction, and commissioning of pure water, cooling tower and wastewater utility projects.
The role combines technical engineering, project coordination, and field oversight to ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and in compliance with codes and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Support design and engineering for utility projects: prepare drawings, calculations, specifications, and cost estimates.

• Coordinate with cross functional stakeholders, contractors, vendors, permitting authorities, and internal teams.

• Develop and review construction plans, shopfloor drawings, and contractor submittals.

• Perform site visits and construction observation; track progress, quality, and safety compliance.

• Manage project schedules and project documentation.

• Prepare technical reports, as-built drawings, operation/maintenance manuals, and close-out packages.

• Assist with permitting, regulatory compliance, and utility coordination (easements, ROW permits).

• Apply engineering standards, codes, and best practices; provide technical guidance to junior staff.

• Support commissioning, start-up, testing, and handover activities.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental, or Electrical Engineering (or related).

• 3+ years’ experience in utilities design/construction (municipal utilities, water/wastewater, gas, or power distribution).

• Familiarity with BAS, PCS (DeltaV), SCADA, P&ID, pipeline design, pump/station design, or electrical distribution as relevant.

• Proficient in CMMS SAP system and MS Office; Project Management software.

• Knowledge of local/state/federal permitting and utility standards/codes.

• Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

The Position
Reporting to the Head of QC Support Operation, support projects within QC functions for QC equipments and master data maintenace of Laboratory Execution system within schedule and
according to the company policy.

Key Responsibilities:

• As part of the QC Support Operations Team to provide support for routine QC activities including:

- Purchasing, qualification/re-qualification of laboratory equipment and computer systems
- All other tactical support activities required to support the business needs

• Execute projects which encompass QC equipment qualification related activities following cGMP requirements.

• Perform data documentation for executed projects following cGMP procedures.

• Support routine management of equipment and reagent master data in Laboratory Execution Systems (LES)

• Perform development, verification and deployment of LES recipes or other QC systems

• Ensure that data, documentation and laboratory processes are in a constant state of regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.

• Timely resolution of issues, including raising discrepancies, investigations and implementation of CAPAs.

Education:

• Degree in Chemistry, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Life Science or equivalent

Experience:

• 0 - 3 years of related working experience for degree holders or equivalent holders with combination of education and relative work experience is preferred

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies:

• Strong problem solving capability. Able to determine when to escalate issue.

• Ability to organize and plan effectively. Effective resource management.

The Position
1) Key
• Responsibilities
· Responsible for engineering maintenance, repair of all utilities and manufacturing equipment/systems serving the entire manufacturing facility and the execution of all job orders.
· Troubleshoot and provide technical support to a team of maintenance and calibration specialists on shift to perform engineering maintenance and repair of facilities and manufacturing equipment in support of plant operations..
· Provide support to manufacturing, utility and engineering services during routine and shutdown maintenance work; and product change over in support of plant operations.
· Performs timely review and technical completion of work orders, initiate follow up work order and notification as required.
· Provide support to Project Engineering Team to deliver project within stipulated timeline and budget.
· Partner with Quality and Deviation owner to ensure timely closure of deviation records and related follow up actions.
· Analyze/create preventive maintenance procedures and/or practices to comply with regulatory codes, specifications, standards and corporate guidelines for the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the plant to ensure validity, efficiency, maximum production equipment uptime.
· Work with Reliability team to establish predictive maintenance program for the facility such as Thermal Scanning (IR), Ultrasonic, Vibration Monitoring etc
· Increase the mean time between failure (MTBF) of equipment by identifying and eliminating the causes for recurring issues and to implement robust solutions.
· Partner with the Maintenance and Calibration team to reduce mean time to repair (MTTR).
· Assist with continuous improvement project (Kaizen) and initiate change request to optimize maintenance/calibration activities if required.
· Review engineering specifications and design modification proposals to improve reliability within cost and other performance requirements.
· Coordinate with MRO storeroom personnel to establish and maintain the proper stocking levels of parts and equipment required to provide maximum equipment uptime at the lowest possible costs.
· Carries out any other work and task as directed by Supervisor.

Safety, Health & Environment :
· Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.
· Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System :
· Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

· Strong background in Operation and Maintenance of equipment and instruments in the production and utility area will be preferred.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This position supports facilities operations, optimization and improvement initiatives in facilities management operations, programs and site procedures, with the facilitation of cross-functional collaboration.

Key
• Responsibilities
● Support F&E contract reviews in collaboration with F&E internal stakeholders
● Be a central contact for timely Shopping Cart and Purchase Order creation using the appropriate platform.
● Participate in discussions and site visits to identify areas of Continuous Improvements and bring about value enhancements to F&E operations.
● Perform critical thinking/review for harnessing new technologies and methodologies to bring about facility operation enhancements to meet the needs of RSTO community and manufacturing operations.
● Support Facilities operations in delivering site services, such as gathering and analyzing user data, performing Gemba walks, monitoring key conditions and deliverables for supporting Make-Assess-Release activities.
● Manage GMP/Non-GMP change management activities and documentation for improvement initiatives in collaboration with various site functional groups.
● Support engagement communications and activities to internal stakeholders.
● Use of Visual Management tools to provide visibility of project/program status updates.
● Support in reviewing project documentation in adherence to Roche Engineering Manual Lite for expense/capital projects.
● Assist in project coordination and site inspection with internal and external project members.
● Perform any other tasks as assigned by the supervisor.

Safety, Health & Environment:
● Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.
● Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:
● Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience
● Diploma/ Degree in Engineering or Science discipline is preferred.
● Fresh graduates/ mid-career professionals who are switching out of other industries.
● Able to and preferably with experience working across different functions within an organization.
● Flexible and adaptable to work with various project teams and contractors on site.
● Able to work independently, manage multiple tasks/priorities and have good communication and organizational skills
● Excellent knowledge and experience in the use of MS Office tools.
● Have customer service skills, attention to details, accurate and thorough.
● Be self-motivated, able to lead and take initiative.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Purpose:
This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks:
• Comply with all RSTO's Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.
• Observe all RSTO's site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious
characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.
• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.
• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small
equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and
operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.
• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.
• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.
• Support process improvement efforts.
• Operate computers for process control and data entry.
• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift
personnel and external support groups.

investigation.

improvement mindset and behaviours through the use and application of LPS
tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

skills.
