jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

jobs.title: Process Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

• Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con tecnici e ingegneri di produzione per diventare altamente competenti nel funzionamento, processi e procedure della linea di produzione dei sensori
• Monitoraggio del supporto dei dati dei prodotti e dei processi utilizzando tecniche di analisi statistica
• Diagnosi rapida ed efficace e risoluzione dei problemi utilizzando un approccio metodologico e riferire i progressi in modo strutturato
• Condurre test CTQ e tecniche di analisi dei materiali / prodotti
• Indagare e risolvere non conformità e contribuire a sviluppare misure di prevenzione e di OCAP robuste
• Sostenere i progetti NPD attraverso il trasferimento di lavori pilota alla fabbricazione di volumi elevati
• Supportare le attività di validazione e il completamento della documentazione di validazione in linea con le esigenze aziendali
• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso l'impegno del team di produzione a turni
• Garantisce elevati livelli di qualità e conformità sono mantenuti
• Aggiornamenti di controllo delle modifiche di piombo/supporto alla documentazione di produzione. Chi sei: Educazione Essenziale/ Qualifiche:
• Processo Eccellenza Giallo o Verde cintura ulteriore vantaggio.
• Preferibilmente Laurea esperienza qualificata o rilevante.
• Esperienza nella conversione rotante e/o bobina nella stampa a bobina (schermo rotatorio / flessografico ecc.) ulteriore vantaggio
• Conoscenza dei metodi / tecniche di analisi statistica Requisiti (incl. competenze chiave):
• Esperienza GMP
• Un tecnico di processo pratico con un buon livello di esperienza industriale rilevante (preferibilmente dispositivo medico correlato)
• Esperienza di ottimizzazione dei prodotti e dei processi
• Alti livelli di alfabetizzazione del computer
• Giocatore di squadra e tiene conto delle sfide di produzione
• Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre l'analisi del processo / del prodotto per garantire il raggiungimento di CTQ
• Forte capacità di problem solving e senso di urgenza
• Dettagli orientati e assicura elevati livelli di qualità e produttività sono mantenuti ogni giorno Processo di assunzione Fase I:
• Presentazione di Cover Letter & CV: Valutazione delle competenze tecniche e della motivazione. Fase II:
• Intervista in persona a Athena Motherwell (sarà condivisa con i candidati più brevi in seguito) Scopo - la nostra attenzione

• Sfondo professionale sostanziale che include almeno un decennio di ingegneria del software, con un minimo di cinque anni focalizzati sulla leadership architettonica.
• Esperienza di dominio strategico nella progettazione architettonica e distribuzione su larga scala delle catene di approvvigionamento dei contenuti commerciali .
• Adobe Platform Mastery, in particolare per quanto riguarda la competenza tecnica negli stack di tecnologia integrati AEM e AEP.
• Eccellenza ingegneristica nella realizzazione di applicazioni su misura attraverso lo sviluppo avanzato di Java , Python e JavaScript.
• AI-Driven Innovation ha dimostrato attraverso l'esecuzione riuscita di implementazioni GenAI che catalizzano il valore aziendale significativo e ROI.

• Gamma di indennità 19 075-35 425 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.

• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. In disease areas like Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis, you will be responsible for shaping and executing on strategies that allow us to increase R&D productivity using digital clinical outcome assessments, digital biomarkers and exploratory digital measures collected from wearables, smartphones and other sensor-based digital health technologies (DHTs). You will be part of a team of experts located in Basel and South San Francisco and report to the Sensor Data Insights group lead in the Computational Biology and Medicine department.

The Opportunity:

• Partner with drug development teams to shape high-impact opportunities that drive clinical trial productivity improvements with sensor-based DHTs; embed them into disease area, clinical development, and biomarker strategies.

• Develop comprehensive roadmaps to realize these opportunities, including assessing unmet measurement needs; evaluating, developing, validating sensor-based DHTs; driving towards community and regulatory acceptance

• Lead the delivery of these roadmaps. This includes securing governance endorsement and resourcing; leading CoE matrix team delivery; managing vendor/technology partnerships; ensuring seamless integration of sensor-based DHTs into clinical trials, including study designs, operations, data analyses; supporting results interpretation.

La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. All'interno del CoE, la Medicina Computazionale si concentra sullo sviluppo e l'applicazione di soluzioni di analisi dei dati innovative per supportare lo sviluppo clinico, migliorando la nostra comprensione della malattia, della progressione della malattia e della risposta individuale del paziente al trattamento. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED e gRED, creiamo farmaci migliori aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura data-driven. Come Digital Measures Lead , si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'integrazione di tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori nel cuore dei nostri programmi di sviluppo di droga pRED e gRED. Sarete parte di un team di esperti che si trova a Basilea e nel sud di San Francisco e riferirete al gruppo Sensor Data Insights leader nel reparto Biologia e Medicina Computazionale. L'opportunità:
• Collaborare con i team di sviluppo della droga per creare opportunità ad alto impatto che favoriscano i miglioramenti della produttività di trial clinici con DHT basati sui sensori; integrarli in aree di malattia, sviluppo clinico e strategie di biomarcatore.
• Sviluppare mappe stradali complete per realizzare queste opportunità, compresa la valutazione delle esigenze di misura non soddisfatte; valutare, sviluppare, convalidare i DHT basati sui sensori; guidare verso l'accettazione della comunità e della regolamentazione
• Guidare la consegna di queste roadmap. Ciò include la garanzia di approvazione e risourcing della governance; la consegna del team di matrice CoE leader; la gestione dei partenariati di fornitori/tecnologie; l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei DHT basati sui sensori in studi clinici, tra cui progetti di studio, operazioni, analisi dei dati; l'interpretazione dei risultati di supporto.
• Promuovere partnership esterne con industria, fornitori di tecnologia, centri accademici, regolatori e pazienti per rafforzare e accelerare questi sforzi.
• Guidare la comunicazione scientifica e la leadership di pensiero sia all'interno che all'esterno di Roche attraverso conferenze e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, mentre sostenere il rigore scientifico e la concentrazione dei pazienti in tutte le attività. Chi sei?
• Ha un Ph.D. o un'esperienza equivalente in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience o una disciplina correlata accoppiata con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale sfruttando DHT basati sui sensori per migliorare la produttività R&D nelle prove di Fase I-IV
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza in neuroscienze, tra cui la malattia di Alzheimer e la sclerosi multipla, e capire come i DHT basati sui sensori possono essere applicati per i casi di uso di prova clinica in queste aree (ad esempio l'efficacia/sicurezza

Als Digital Measures Lead spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Einbettung von sensorbasierten digitalen Gesundheitstechnologien in das Herz unserer PRED- und GRED-Drogenentwicklungsprogramme. In Krankheitsgebieten wie der Alzheimer-Krankheit und der Multiple-Sklerose sind Sie für die Gestaltung und Durchführung von Strategien verantwortlich, die es uns ermöglichen, die R&D-Produktivität mithilfe digitaler klinischer Ergebnisbeurteilungen, digitaler Biomarker und explorativer digitaler Maßnahmen zu erhöhen, die von Wearables, Smartphones und anderen sensorbasierten digitalen Gesundheitstechnologien (DHTs) gesammelt werden. Sie werden Teil eines Expertenteams in Basel und South San Francisco sein und der Sensor Data Insights Gruppe Lead in der Abteilung Computational Biology and Medicine berichten. Die Gelegenheit:
• Partner mit Arzneimittelentwicklungsteams, um hocheffiziente Möglichkeiten zu gestalten, die die Produktivitätsverbesserung der klinischen Studien mit sensorbasierten DHTs steigern; sie in den Krankheitsbereich, die klinische Entwicklung und Biomarker-Strategien einbetten.
• Erarbeiten Sie umfassende Roadmaps, um diese Möglichkeiten zu realisieren, einschließlich der Bewertung der ungenutzten Messanforderungen; Auswertung, Entwicklung, Validierung sensorbasierter DHTs; Fahren in Richtung der gemeinschaftlichen und regulatorischen Akzeptanz
• Führen Sie die Lieferung dieser Fahrpläne. Dazu gehört die Sicherung von Governance-Befürwortung und -Ressourcen; führende CoE-Matrix-Team-Lieferung; Verwaltung von Anbieter- und Technologiepartnerschaften; Sicherstellung einer nahtlosen Integration sensorbasierter DHTs in klinische Studien, einschließlich Studiendesigns, Operationen, Datenanalysen; Unterstützung der Ergebnisseinterpretation.
• Externe Partnerschaften mit Industrie, Technologieanbietern, akademischen Zentren, Regulierungsbehörden und Patienten zu stärken und zu beschleunigen.
• Förderung der wissenschaftlichen Kommunikation und des Denkens sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb von Roche durch Konferenzen und peer-reviewed Publikationen, wobei die wissenschaftliche Strenge und die Patientenzentrierung in allen Aktivitäten aufrecht erhalten. Wer sind Sie?
• Sie halten eine Doktor- oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheit, Life Sciences, Informatik, Neurowissenschaften oder einer verwandten Disziplin, gekoppelt mit mindestens 5+ Jahren Berufserfahrung mit sensorbasierten DHTs zur Verbesserung der FuE-Produktivität in Phase I-IV-Studien
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in der Neurowissenschaften, einschließlich der Alzheimer-Krankheit und der Multiple-Sklerose, und verstehen, wie sensorbasierte DHTs für klinische Anwendungsfälle in diesen Bereichen angewendet werden können (z.B. Wirksamkeit/Sicherheit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED ) Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CdE) est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches (PRED et GRED) de devenir plus axées sur les données, plus performantes sur le plan numérique et mieux préparées aux défis de l'avenir. Au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, la médecine computationnelle met l'accent sur l'élaboration et l'application de solutions innovantes d'analyse de données pour soutenir le développement clinique. Nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en partenariat avec nos scientifiques dans les domaines de la R-D et de la R-D, grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. En tant que chef de file en matière de mesures numériques, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'intégration des technologies de santé numériques basées sur des capteurs au cœur de nos programmes de développement de médicaments PRED et GRED. Dans des domaines comme la maladie d'Alzheimer et la sclérose en plaques, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies qui nous permettent d'accroître la productivité de la R-D à l'aide d'évaluations de résultats cliniques numériques, de biomarqueurs numériques et de mesures numériques exploratoires recueillies à partir de portables, de smartphones et d'autres technologies numériques de santé basées sur des capteurs. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe d'experts située à Bâle et à South San Francisco et relèverez du groupe Sensor Data Insights, responsable du département de biologie et de médecine computationnelles. La possibilité :
• S'associer à des équipes de développement de médicaments pour créer des possibilités à fort impact qui favorisent l'amélioration de la productivité des essais cliniques avec des DHT à base de capteurs; les intégrer dans les stratégies de lutte contre la maladie, de développement clinique et de biomarqueur.
• Élaborer des feuilles de route complètes pour exploiter ces possibilités, notamment en évaluant les besoins non satisfaits en matière de mesure; en évaluant, en développant et en validant les DHT basés sur des capteurs; en conduisant vers une acceptation communautaire et réglementaire;
• Diriger la livraison de ces feuilles de route. Il s'agit notamment d'obtenir l'approbation et le ressourcement en matière de gouvernance; de diriger la mise en oeuvre de la matrice du Conseil de l'Europe; de gérer les partenariats fournisseurs/technologies; d'assurer l'intégration harmonieuse des DHT fondés sur des capteurs dans les essais cliniques, y compris les conceptions d'études, les opérations, les analyses de données; d'appuyer l'interprétation des résultats.
• Favoriser des partenariats externes avec l'industrie, les fournisseurs de technologie, les centres universitaires, les régulateurs et les patients pour renforcer et accélérer ces efforts.
• Encourager la communication scientifique et le leadership de la pensée, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur de Roche, par le biais de conférences et de publications évaluées par les pairs, tout en préservant la rigueur scientifique et la concentration des patients dans toutes les activités. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat ou d'une expérience équivalente en santé numérique, sciences de la vie, informatique, neurosciences ou une discipline connexe associée à au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en utilisant des DHT basés sur des capteurs pour améliorer la productivité de la R-D dans les essais de phase I-IV
• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie en neurosciences, y compris la maladie d'Alzheimer et la sclérose en plaques, et vous comprenez comment des DHT basés sur des capteurs peuvent être appliqués à des cas d'utilisation d'essais cliniques dans ces domaines (p. ex. efficacité/sécurité

jobs.title: PRACTICANTE DE TALLER
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante de taller , te unirás a nuestro equipo técnico para aprender sobre el mantenimiento de equipos de diagnóstico médico de vanguardia . Esta es una oportunidad única para desarrollar tus habilidades técnicas en un entorno ágil, colaborativo y con un impacto real en la salud de los pacientes .

Oportunidad

• Apoyas las actividades del taller, adquiriendo conocimientos profundos sobre equipos de diagnóstico médico y procesos de gestión .

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .

• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .

• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .

• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .

• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .

• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .

• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente .

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .

• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

• Te caracterizas por tu proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y orientación al detalle .

• Eres una persona con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo y una fuerte ética profesional .

• Experiencia previa o conocimientos en gestión de laboratorios clínicos sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
Bei Roche können Sie so sein, wie Sie sind – mit all den einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Entfaltung, offene Dialoge und aufrichtige Beziehungen. Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position:

• Die Abstimmung des Projektportfolios mit den Kapazitäten und Fähigkeiten von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ist die Kernaufgabe

• Als Projekt-Liaison sind Sie die primäre Kontaktperson für Projekte aus Forschung und Entwicklung (REDs), Einlizensierungen sowie für lokale und globale Planungsrollen und -gremien. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern wie Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenik, Regulatory und Quality gewährleisten Sie, dass die jeweiligen Projektziele abgestimmt sind.

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung für strategische Projektplanung & Machbarkeit und führen somit die langfristige strategische Planung aus, insbesondere eine 5-Jahres-Ausblicks für Betriebsanlagen und Personal, sowie Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Kapazitätsbewertungen.

• In der Rolle des Ressourcenkoordinators stimmen Sie Ressourcen in Kollaboration mit den Sektionen innerhalb von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ab und überwachen die Planung innerhalb der Abteilung.

• Sie fungieren als Fachexperte und Berater für Herstellungsprozesse und/oder -anlagen und stellen Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme sowie strategischer Fragestellungen bereit. Sie leiten komplexe Untersuchungen, identifizieren Ursachen und implementieren wirksame Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen.

• Als Mentor und Coach unterstützen Sie unsere Mitarbeiter bei deren kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer beruflichen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.

• Treten Sie als treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung auf , indem Sie innovative Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung und Produktivitätssteigerung identifizieren, Lean-Prinzipien und digitale Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Abläufe nutzen und implementieren.

• Fungieren Sie als Matrix-Lead , welcher die strategische Planung und Zielsetzung der Abteilung gestaltet und der einen starken Teamgeist und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Dringlichkeit sowie der hohen Motivation fördert, um diese Ziele zu erreichen.

Wer Sie sind:

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Chemie oder Chemieingenieurwesen und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozesschemie für synthetische Moleküle.

• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deuts

• Come mentore e allenatore, i nostri dipendenti sostengono il loro continuo sviluppo delle loro competenze e conoscenze professionali.
• Essere una forza trainante per il miglioramento continuo individuando soluzioni innovative per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e il miglioramento della produttività, utilizzando principi magre e implementando soluzioni digitali per migliorare i processi.

• Hanno una laurea in chimica o ingegneria chimica e almeno 10 anni di esperienza nella chimica di processo per molecole sintetiche.
• Hanno una profonda conoscenza della sintesi chimica, delle tecnologie di processo chimico e della produzione in un ambiente cGMP.
• Come esperto tecnico, si capisce motivare i team in un'organizzazione matrice e creare una forte coesione per avere successo insieme.
• I loro punti di forza sono in cooperazione: mantengono eccellenti relazioni con gli stakeholder e navigano abilmente attraverso negoziati e progetti interfunzionali.
• Sono un impulso attivo per il cambiamento, creando una cultura flessibile e aperta per nuove opportunità.
• Sono una forza trainante per un miglioramento continuo e incontrano nuove sfide con passione.
• Comunica senza intoppi in Deuts

jobs.title: Decision Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of innovation. As a Decision Analytics Consultant , you won’t just be analyzing requirements; you will be a trusted advisor and a strategic bridge between complex technical landscapes and business outcomes.
You will lead end-to-end business analysis workstreams, leveraging advanced analytics and statistical modeling to tackle ambiguity and transform complex clinical or operational data into actionable insights. Your mission is to ensure that every solution we build provides demonstrable value to our patients and our organization.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

• Strategic Advisory & Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams. You will act as a consultant to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and aligning project goals with long-term solution roadmaps.

• Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret complex datasets (quantitative and qualitative) to inform product and UX decisions; Experience translating user behavior, metrics, and feedback into actionable insight; Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, or Tableau

• Solution Design & Product Development: Translate complex business requirements into strategic implementation plans. You will design data products (datasets, KPI frameworks) and evaluate vendor solutions to ensure they meet our technical and business standards.

• User Behavior & Experience Analysis: Strong capability to analyze user journeys, pain points, and interaction patterns; Experience with usability testing, A/B testing, and heuristic evaluations; Familiarity with UX research tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Mixpanel

• Requirements Elicitation & Problem Structuring: Expertise in breaking down ambiguous business problems into structured requirements and hypotheses; Ability to synthesize stakeholder needs, technical constraints, and user expectations into clear functional and non-functional requirements; Skilled in creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows

• Process Excellence & Mentorship: As a senior member of our Community of Practice, you will mentor junior and intermediate BAs, proactively shaping our methodologies and driving continuous improvement in our operational workflows.

• Technical Integrity: Drive the analysis and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability, maintaining a focus on data governance and change management.

Who You Are
You are someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves tackling "gray areas," and is passionate about the intersection of technology and human health. You bring structure to chaos and are a natural communicator.
Qualifications & Experience:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy, with at least 3+ years within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields - Information Systems / Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on IT, Analytics, or Operations), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or UX-related discipline, Data Analytics / Data Science. Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in - MBA (Information Systems or Product Management focus), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),Data Analytics / Business Analytics is highly desirable.

• Analytical Mastery: SQL, BI tools (Tableau/Power BI), UX analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel), and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence). Familiarity

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

jobs.title: Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il gruppo di analisi e flussi di lavoro all'interno del Centro di eccellenza (CoE) è dedicato a trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili che anticipano la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Ci avvaliamo di tecnologie all'avanguardia ad alto rendimento e modelli di machine learning multimodali fondamentali per analizzare i dati chimici e biologici su larga scala, consentendo una comprensione più approfondita del comportamento molecolare e l'identificazione di nuove opportunità terapeutiche. Nonostante i progressi in questi campi, tuttavia, la trasformazione dei dati grezzi e dei modelli computazionali in insight significativi rimane una sfida chiave. In questo ruolo, lavorerai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della chimica medica e dell'ingegneria per costruire strumenti analitici innovativi che colmano il divario tra la generazione dei dati e l'interpretazione, aiutando a sbloccare nuovi viali per la scoperta scientifica e l'impatto. L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) per progettare e costruire strumenti interattivi per la scoperta della droga di piccole molecole, con una particolare attenzione ai dati chimici, ai flussi di lavoro di progettazione molecolare e all'interpretazione del modello. Potrai modellare la direzione tecnica e del prodotto di piattaforme che permettono ai chimici medicinali e computazionali di esplorare i dati, le ipotesi di test e progettare farmaci migliori. Questo ruolo è fullstack, con una forte enfasi sulla visualizzazione dei dati scientifici, la progettazione del flusso di lavoro e l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali. Il successo sarà misurato non solo dalla consegna tecnica, ma dall'impatto su come gli scienziati progettano e valutano i candidati alla piccola molecola. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà:
• Collaborare direttamente con chimici medicinali, cheminformatici e scienziati dell'IA per comprendere i flussi di lavoro di progettazione e analisi molecolari del mondo reale, comprese le esigenze ambigue o in evoluzione.
• Progettazione e costruzione di piattaforme end-to-end: interfaccia front-end, servizi backend e integrazioni dei dati, che permettono agli scienziati di eseguire analisi, esplorare i dati e interpretare le uscite dei modelli.
• Conducendo lo sviluppo di esperienze utente intuitive ed estensibili per complessi flussi di lavoro scientifici, con un focus sulla visualizzazione interattiva, l'usabilità e la fedeltà scientifica.
• Architettare e implementare API, modelli di dati e servizi che supportano applicazioni scalabili, ad alta intensità di dati, tra cui l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali e sistemi di machine learning.
• Valutazione e applicazione delle tecnologie emergenti (inclusi gli strumenti di sviluppo assistiti dall'IA) per accelerare l'iterazione, esplorando nuovi approcci allo scient

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès dans l'IA, les données et les sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, en tirant parti des données et des nouveaux modèles de calcul pour stimuler l'impact. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le nouveau Centre d'Excellence des Sciences Computationnelles (CdE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est de tirer parti de cette puissance transformatrice de données et d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques en pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et transformatifs pour les patients du monde entier. Le groupe Analytics and Workflows au sein du Centre d'excellence (CdE) se consacre à transformer des données complexes en idées concrètes qui favorisent la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Nous mettons à profit des technologies de pointe à haut débit et des modèles d'apprentissage de machines multimodales fondamentales pour analyser les données chimiques et biologiques à grande échelle, permettant une meilleure compréhension du comportement moléculaire et l'identification de nouvelles opportunités thérapeutiques. Toutefois, malgré les progrès réalisés dans ces domaines, la transformation des données brutes et des modèles de calcul en données probantes demeure un défi majeur. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la chimie médicinale et de l'ingénierie pour construire des outils analytiques novateurs qui comblent l'écart entre la production de données et l'interprétation, aidant à débloquer de nouvelles pistes de découverte scientifique et d'impact. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur scientifique principal (Fullstack) pour concevoir et construire des outils interactifs pour la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en mettant l'accent sur les données chimiques, les workflows de conception moléculaire et l'interprétation des modèles. Vous façonnerez la direction technique et produit des plates-formes qui permettent aux chimistes médicaux et calculateurs d'explorer les données, de tester les hypothèses et de concevoir de meilleurs médicaments. Ce rôle est complet, l'accent étant mis sur la visualisation des données scientifiques, la conception des flux de travail et l'intégration avec les pipelines informatiques. Le succès sera mesuré non seulement par l'exécution technique, mais aussi par l'impact sur la façon dont les scientifiques conçoivent et évaluent les candidats aux petites molécules. Votre travail comprendra :
• Établir des partenariats directs avec des chimistes, des chimistes et des scientifiques de l'IA pour comprendre les processus de conception moléculaire et d'analyse du monde réel, y compris les besoins ambigus ou en évolution.
• Concevoir et construire des plates-formes de bout en bout, des interfaces front-end, des services de backend et des intégrations de données, qui permettent aux scientifiques d'effectuer des analyses, d'explorer des données et d'interpréter les résultats des modèles.
• Diriger le développement d'expériences utilisateur intuitives et extensibles pour des workflows scientifiques complexes, en mettant l'accent sur la visualisation interactive, la convivialité et la fidélité scientifique.
• Architecte et mise en œuvre d'API, de modèles de données et de services qui prennent en charge des applications évolutives et à forte intensité de données, y compris l'intégration avec des pipelines de calcul et des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique.
• Évaluer et appliquer les nouvelles technologies (y compris les outils de développement assistés par l'IA) pour accélérer l'itération, tout en explorant de nouvelles approches de la science

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICHE

-Academico/Scientifico/Clinico:
- MD richiesto
- Sono richieste conoscenze terapeutiche nell'ambito del metabolismo, dell'obesità e del diabete con rilevante esperienza clinica, scientifica e di sperimentazione/sviluppo clinico
- Il background accademico/didattico costituisce un plus
- Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica dei dati
- È preferibile l'esperienza nella pubblicazione dei risultati di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed
- Normativa: è preferibile la conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione di prodotti farmaceutici per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti
- Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea
- Fino al 30% di viaggi globali

Competenze e comportamenti chiave

- Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, i valori Roche
- Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
- Senso degli affari: ha una conoscenza pratica del settore farmaceutico/biotecnologico, delle molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo dei farmaci. Conduce regolarmente lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia
- Organizzazione: può dare priorità a più attività e obiettivi nel rispetto dei tempi, degli obiettivi e del budget
- Abilità interpersonali: buone capacità interpersonali, di comunicazione verbale e di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità
- Scrittura: forti capacità di comunicazione scritta
- Capacità di presentazione: buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta agli altri, internamente o esternamente. Fiducioso e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e puntuale, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
- Abilità di negoziazione: buone capacità di negoziazione: sa come completare i risultati finali lavorando in modo efficace con gli altri internamente ed esternamente
- Processo decisionale: sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso bilanciando etica ed efficacia
- Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra

DOVERI E RESPONSABILITÀ SPECIFICHE

Strategia e pianificazione CDP

- Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per le molecole/indicazioni assegnate
- Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD
- Collabora con altri membri CST e sottoteam pertinenti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)
- Collabora con CST e altri team pertinenti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/risorse necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD
- Rimane al passo con gli sviluppi interni ed esterni, le tendenze e le altre dinamiche rilevanti per il lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali delle influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per le aree terapeutiche e patologiche assegnate
- Se appropriato, partecipa ad informazioni sulla concorrenza e/o ad altre attività e progetti di valutazione del mercato/settore
- Mantiene gli standard e i livelli più elevati di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nelle specifiche aree terapeutiche e patologiche di incarico
- Collabora con una varietà di partner e parti interessate interni ed esterni, come ricercatori clinici, medici, scienziati e opinion leader chiave (KOL), nonché gruppi interni multidisciplinari, inclusi altri gruppi nel campo della malattia di Parkinson, della ricerca, dello sviluppo aziendale, delle attività commerciali

Die Position

ERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATIONEN

- Akademisch/wissenschaftlich/klinisch:
- M.D. erforderlich
- Therapeutisches Wissen in den Bereichen Stoffwechsel, Fettleibigkeit und Diabetes mit einschlägiger klinischer, wissenschaftlicher und klinischer Studien-/Entwicklungserfahrung erforderlich
- Akademischer/pädagogischer Hintergrund ist von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Prinzipien und Techniken der Datenanalyse, Interpretation und klinischen Relevanz
- Erfahrung in der Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen einer wissenschaftlichen Studie in einer Fachzeitschrift mit Peer-Review ist wünschenswert
- Regulierung: Kenntnisse der medizinischen Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA und anderen relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften werden bevorzugt
- Dauer der Erfahrung: 2 oder mehr Jahre akademische oder klinische Erfahrung nach Abschluss des Studiums
- Bis zu 30 % weltweite Reisen

Schlüsselkompetenzen und Verhaltensweisen

- Ethik: Hat eine einwandfreie Ethik. Zeigt die Roche-Werte bzw. weist die Fähigkeit nach, dies zu demonstrieren
- Liebe zum Detail: Hervorragende Liebe zum Detail
- Geschäftssinn: Verfügt über praktische Kenntnisse der Pharma-/Biotech-Branche sowie der vielfältigen Funktionen und Rollen, die im Arzneimittelentwicklungsprozess involviert sind. Leitet regelmäßig die Entwicklung von Krankheitsstrategien und -plänen
- Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele pünktlich, zielgerichtet und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren
- Zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten: Gute zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikations- und Einflussfähigkeiten: Kann ohne Autorität Einfluss nehmen
- Schreiben: Starke schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Gute geschäftliche Präsentationsfähigkeiten; ist angenehm und effektiv bei Präsentationen vor anderen, sei es intern oder extern. Selbstbewusst und kompetent im internen und externen Umgang mit anderen: Bleibt konzentriert und sachlich, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen auf produktive und reife Weise anzusprechen
- Verhandlungsgeschick: Gutes Verhandlungsgeschick: weiß, wie man Ergebnisse durch effektive interne und externe Zusammenarbeit mit anderen abschließt
- Entscheidungsfindung: Weiß, wie man Kompromissentscheidungen trifft und dabei Ethik und Wirksamkeit in Einklang bringt
- Teamarbeit: Starke Ausrichtung auf Teamarbeit

CDP-Strategie und -Planung

- Beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugewiesene Moleküle/Indikationen.

- Arbeitet mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Unterteams zusammen, um CD-Plankomponenten zu entwickeln (z. B. Analyse-/Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)
- Arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Input für Budget-/Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die für die Implementierung und Ausführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
- Bleiben Sie über interne und externe Entwicklungen, Trends und andere Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit von CD relevant sind, auf dem Laufenden, um jederzeit eine vollständig aktuelle Sicht und Perspektive interner/externer Einflüsse und/oder Implikationen für die zugewiesenen Therapie- und Krankheitsbereiche aufrechtzuerhalten.
- Nimmt gegebenenfalls an Wettbewerbsanalysen und/oder anderen Markt-/Branchenbewertungsaktivitäten und -projekten teil
- Hält die höchsten Standards und Niveaus an wissenschaftlichem und klinischem Wissen in den spezifischen Therapie- und Krankheitsgebieten des Auftrages aufrecht
- Arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl interner und externer Partner und Stakeholder zusammen, wie z. B. klinischen Forschern, Klinikern, Wissenschaftlern und wichtigen Meinungsführern (KOLs), sowie multidisziplinären internen Gruppen, einschließlich anderer Gruppen in den Bereichen PD, Forschung, Geschäftsentwicklung und Handel

- Réglementaire : la connaissance des aspects médicaux des BPC (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des exigences techniques pour l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres directives et réglementations pertinentes est préférable.
- Durée de l'expérience : 2 années ou plus d'expérience académique ou clinique postuniversitaire
- Jusqu'à 30% de voyages dans le monde

Compétences et comportements clés

- Éthique : A une éthique irréprochable. Démontre, ou capacité avérée à démontrer, les valeurs de Roche
- Souci du détail : Souci exceptionnel du détail
- Sens des affaires : possède une connaissance pratique de l'industrie pharmaceutique/biotechnologique, des multiples fonctions et rôles impliqués dans le processus de développement de médicaments. Dirige régulièrement l’élaboration de stratégies et de plans de lutte contre les maladies
- Organisation : peut prioriser plusieurs tâches et objectifs dans les délais, dans les délais et dans les limites du budget
- Compétences interpersonnelles : Bonnes capacités de communication interpersonnelle et verbale et d'influence : peut influencer sans autorité
- Rédaction : Solides compétences en communication écrite
- Compétences en présentation : Bonnes compétences en matière de présentation commerciale ; est confortable et efficace lorsqu’il se présente aux autres, en interne ou en externe. Confiant et compétent dans ses interactions avec les autres en interne et en externe : reste concentré et précis, est capable de soulever des problèmes ou des défis de manière productive et mature.
- Compétences en négociation : Bonnes compétences en négociation : sait comment réaliser les livrables en travaillant efficacement avec les autres en interne et en externe
- Prise de décision : sait comment prendre des décisions de compromis tout en équilibrant éthique et efficacité
- Travail d'équipe : Forte orientation vers le travail d'équipe

DEVOIRS ET RESPONSABILITÉS SPÉCIFIQUES

Stratégie et planification du CDP

- Participe à l'élaboration du plan CD pour la ou les molécules/indications assignées
- Rassemble et analyse les données et informations nécessaires à la création du plan CD
- Travailler avec d'autres membres du CST et les sous-équipes concernées pour développer les composants du plan CD (par exemple, stratégie d'analyse/données, développement de KOL, stratégie de publications, etc.)
- Travaille avec CST et d'autres équipes concernées pour développer et fournir des informations et des contributions aux exigences en matière de budget/ressources nécessaires à la mise en œuvre et à l'exécution du plan de CD.
- Se tenir au courant des développements internes et externes, des tendances et autres dynamiques pertinentes pour le travail du CD afin de maintenir, à tout moment, une vision et une perspective pleinement actuelles des influences internes/externes et/ou des implications pour le(s) domaine(s) thérapeutique(s) et pathologique(s) assigné(s)
- Le cas échéant, participe à la veille concurrentielle et/ou à d'autres activités et projets d'évaluation du marché/de l'industrie.
- Maintenir les normes et les niveaux les plus élevés de connaissances scientifiques et cliniques dans le(s) domaine(s) thérapeutique(s) et pathologique(s) spécifique(s) de mission
- Collabore avec une variété de partenaires et de parties prenantes internes et externes, tels que des enquêteurs cliniques, des cliniciens, des scientifiques et des leaders d'opinion clés (KOL), ainsi qu'avec des groupes internes multidisciplinaires, y compris d'autres groupes en PP, recherche, développement commercial, commercial.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally

• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results

• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System.

In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche.

Description of the area:
Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.

• Background in logistics or supply chain.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation.

Technical Skills

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring.
