The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapte r is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist I to join our global service and support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how—understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools, enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Your key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems. You may be the primary contact for R&D scientists and engineers in the use of our internal enterprise systems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Business Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, training system data, change requests) for timely and accurate execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Education : Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

Experience : 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing the complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist II to join our global internal service and support team. In this mid-level role, you will apply your conceptual knowledge and significant working experience to perform a range of assignments with limited guidance. You will act as a reliable service provider with a customer-oriented mindset to handle critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.
Rather than just managing system change requests, you will manage the integrity of the business process within our internal tools. By developing a deep understanding of the R&D organization and unique team needs, you will translate diverse business needs into effective system and data configurations. You will handle complex requests, ensuring that as our internal digital infrastructure evolves, our global R&D teams remain compliant, organized, and productive.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute System Requests with Limited Guidance: Fulfill customer requests and generate business metrics by performing a range of assignments related to your discipline, ensuring that enterprise system tool configurations / data updates align with actual R&D workflows / needs.

• Anticipate and Solve Complex Problems: Understand the impact of system changes on the broader level to anticipate issues. Analyze possible solutions to operational issues and system problems by relying on your experience, judgment, and established precedents.

• Functional Decision-Making: Use your knowledge of your internal customers (the R&D teams) and their diverse needs to make informed decisions on system logic, such as grouping training curricula based on learner job functions, or making logical document hierarchies based on your learned organisational knowledge.

• Organizational Transition Management: Execute structural data migrations and updates within system tools driven by acquisitions, reorganizations, and digitalization projects to ensure user permissions, configurations, access, and data reflect the current state of the company.

• Mentorship and Guidance: Provide guidance to new team members and R&D internal customers. Based on your expertise navigating our enterprise tool workflows, configurations, and data - you provide guidance and oversight of system usage. You routinely will need to explain information to others in a straightforward manner, and deliver presentations when needed to support training, onboarding, and engaging stakeholders participation in our projects.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Understand key organizational drivers and areas of expertise to proactively anticipate needs, accomplish your work, and represent internal customers' needs to global project teams.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes

• Provide data monitoring and statistics You may be asked to support audits by showing adherence to our quality management systems and pr

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa mazowieckiego .

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa mazowieckiego

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)

• Stock share purchase additions;

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in

The Position As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms. Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software. Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement. The Opportunity:
• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).
• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.
• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.
• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues
• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data Who you are:
• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.
• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired
• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly
• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)
• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus What you get:

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

A Roche, potete presentarsi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove siete apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Scopo del ruolo

- Il responsabile della trasformazione sanitaria serve da pietra angolare per far progredire l'impegno di Roche Diagnostics per migliorare l'assistenza ai pazienti. Sintassi delle prove cliniche, quadri di accesso e difesa governativa con lo sviluppo delle imprese, questo leader assicura che la diagnostica di innovazione ottenere l'ingresso sul mercato, riconoscimento clinico e sostenibilità finanziaria all'interno di Taiwan. Questo ruolo esecutivo evolve fondamentalmente il paesaggio medico locale, mentre la creazione di Roche come partner kicker nell'ecosistema sanitario.

- Un obiettivo primario consiste nella valutazione e nel perfezionamento dei percorsi sanitari e della politica pubblica per promuovere solidi partenariati interni ed esterni, modernizzando così l'ambiente locale per stimolare una crescita commerciale sostanziale. Il raggiungimento di un cambiamento sistemico richiede l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra definizione delle politiche, approfondimenti medici e competenze in materia di rimborso.

Inoltre, potrete individuare e coltivare opportunità di business emergenti che rispondono alle mutevoli tendenze cliniche, supervisionando il lancio di programmi che migliorano la fornitura di assistenza sanitaria e garantire la disponibilità duratura di strumenti diagnostici innovativi.

- Possesso un profondo senso dello scopo, l'operatore storico mobiliterà i team per ottenere risultati superiori sotto la visione "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan," contribuendo direttamente all'esecuzione della roadmap strategica RDTW 1000 giorni.

- In questa veste, si dimostrerà uno spirito imprenditoriale e una prospettiva di sistema, convertendo concetti visionari in strategie disciplinari e ad alto impatto che garantiscono il successo organizzativo in orizzonti sia immediati che futuri.

- Come membro del team di leadership di RD Taiwan, potrai svolgere un ruolo modello di comportamento VACC e sostenere la dichiarazione di intenti LT. Una stretta collaborazione con i pari in tutto il team di leadership è essenziale per realizzare gli obiettivi più ampi dell'azienda. Questo approccio di leadership si concentra sulla coltivazione di team ad alte prestazioni, customer-centric all'interno di una cultura organizzativa able e in continua evoluzione.

- In definitiva, è necessario mostrare la determinazione e la resilienza necessaria per trasformare il paesaggio sanitario di Taiwan, incarnando la missione principale Roche: "Fare ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno di prossimo."

Responsabilità chiave

- Leadership strategica: sviluppare ed attuare una strategia integrata in materia di salute, accesso al mercato e politica, in linea con gli orientamenti globali/regionali e gli obiettivi aziendali locali.

- Strategia per gli affari medici: guidare la generazione e la diffusione di prove scientifiche, promuovere relazioni strategiche con i leader chiave dell'opinione (KOL) e le società mediche, e garantire l'accuratezza scientifica in tutte le attività.

- Accesso al mercato e rimborso: Guidare successo NHI (National Health Insurance) elenco e strategie di prezzi ottimali per i principali prodotti diagnostici, utilizzando l'economia sanitaria e la ricerca sui risultati (HEOR).

- Politica pubblica e affari governativi: monitorare proattivamente il panorama della politica sanitaria. Coinvolgere in collaborazione con le autorità governative (ad esempio, MOHW, NHIA), associazioni di settore e gruppi di sostegno dei pazienti per definire politiche favorevoli per le innovazioni diagnostiche.

- Sviluppo di imprese: individuare, sviluppare e gestire opportunità commerciali e partnership strategiche emergenti che promuovano la crescita e l'innovazione e garantiscano l'erogazione di soluzioni sanitarie di tipo "bassa" e "impatto."

- Team Leadership & Cultura VACC: guida, allenatore e ispirare un team di assistenza medica, accesso al mercato, politica e sviluppo aziendale per liberare il loro pieno potenziale e sostenere la cultura VACC.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, sich für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen, einsetzen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Ausdrucksweisen, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, damit Sie persönlich und professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position

Aufgabenbereich

- Der Leiter der Healthcare Transformation ist ein Eckpfeiler für die Weiterentwicklung des Engagements von Roche Diagnostics für die Verbesserung der Patientenversorgung. Durch die Synthese klinischer Evidenz, Zugangsrahmen und staatliches Engagement für die Geschäftsentwicklung sorgt dieser Marktführer dafür, dass bahnbrechende Diagnosen in Taiwan Markteintritt, klinische Anerkennung und finanzielle Nachhaltigkeit gewinnen. Diese Führungsrolle entwickelt die lokale medizinische Landschaft grundlegend weiter und etabliert Roche als führenden Partner im Gesundheitsökosystem.

- Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Bewertung und Verfeinerung der Gesundheitswege und der öffentlichen Politik, um robuste interne und externe Partnerschaften zu fördern und damit die lokale Umwelt zu modernisieren, um ein substanzielles kommerzielles Wachstum zu fördern.

Darüber hinaus werden Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und pflegen, die auf die Verschiebung der klinischen Trends reagieren, die Einführung von Programmen überwachen, die die Gesundheitsversorgung verbessern und die dauerhafte Verfügbarkeit innovativer Diagnoseinstrumente gewährleisten.

- Die Entscheidung über einen tiefen Sinn für eine bestimmte Aufgabe wird die etablierten Teams mobilisieren, um im Rahmen der Vision "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die direkt zur Umsetzung der strategischen Roadmap RDTW 1000 Tage beitragen.

- In dieser Funktion zeigen Sie unternehmerischen Geist und systemweite Perspektive, visionäre Konzepte in disziplinierte, hochwirksame Strategien umzuwandeln, die organisatorischen Erfolg sowohl über unmittelbare als auch über zukünftige Horizonte sichern.

- Als Mitglied des RD Taiwan Leadership Teams werden Sie modellhaft VACC-Verhaltensverhaltens und die LT-Zweckerklärung aufrecht erhalten. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gleichaltrigen im gesamten Leadership Team ist unerlässlich, um die breiteren Ziele des Unternehmens zu verwirklichen. Dieser Führungsansatz konzentriert sich auf die Kultivierung hochperformanter, kundenorientierter Teams innerhalb einer agilen und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Organisationskultur.

- Letztlich müssen Sie die Entschlossenheit und Widerstandsfähigkeit aufweisen, die erforderlich sind, um Taiwans Gesundheitslandschaft zu verändern, und die Kernaufgabe von Roche verkörpern: "Tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen."

Wichtige Aufgaben

- Strategische Führung: Entwicklung und Durchführung einer integrierten medizinischen, Marktzugangs- und Politikstrategie, die mit globalen/regionalen Leitlinien und lokalen Geschäftszielen abgestimmt ist.

- Strategie für medizinische Angelegenheiten: Führen Sie die Generierung und Verbreitung wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse, fördern Sie strategische Beziehungen zu Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und medizinischen Gesellschaften und gewährleisten Sie wissenschaftliche Genauigkeit in allen Aktivitäten.

- Marktzugang & Rückzahlung: Führen Sie die erfolgreiche NHI-Liste (National Health Insurance) und optimale Preisstrategien für wichtige diagnostische Produkte durch, indem Sie Gesundheitsökonomie und Ergebnisforschung (HEOR) nutzen.

- Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proaktiv die Gesundheitspolitiklandschaft überwachen. Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden (z.B. MOHW, NHIA), Industrieverbänden und Patientengruppen zur Gestaltung günstiger Strategien für diagnostische Innovationen.

- Business Development: Ermittlung, Entwicklung und Verwaltung von strategischen aufstrebenden Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Partnerschaften, die Wachstum und Innovation fördern und die Bereitstellung skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller Gesundheitslösungen gewährleisten.

- Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Führen, coachen und inspirieren Sie ein funktionsübergreifendes Team aus den Bereichen Medizin, Marktzugang, Politik und Business Development, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten und die VACC-Kultur zu wahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

La position

Rôle Objet

- Le chef de la transformation des soins de santé est la pierre angulaire de l'engagement de Roche Diagnostics à améliorer les soins aux patients. En synthétisant les données cliniques, les cadres d'accès et la défense des intérêts des gouvernements avec le développement des entreprises, ce chef de file s'assure que les diagnostics révolutionnaires obtiennent l'entrée sur le marché, la reconnaissance clinique et la viabilité financière à Taiwan.

- L'évaluation et le perfectionnement des voies de soins de santé et des politiques publiques pour favoriser des partenariats internes et externes solides, modernisant ainsi l'environnement local pour stimuler une croissance commerciale substantielle.

De plus, vous identifierez et cultiverez les nouvelles occasions d'affaires qui répondent aux tendances cliniques changeantes, superviserez le lancement de programmes qui améliorent la prestation des soins de santé et assureront la disponibilité durable d'outils de diagnostic novateurs.

- S'appuyant sur un profond sens de l'objectif, le titulaire mobilisera des équipes pour obtenir des résultats supérieurs dans le cadre de la vision « Diagnostics de Pioneering et façonner des soins de santé efficaces à Taiwan », contribuant directement à l'exécution de la feuille de route stratégique de 1000 jours de la Stratégie.

- En cette qualité, vous démontrerez un esprit d'entreprise et une perspective à l'échelle du système, en convertissant des concepts visionnaires en stratégies disciplinées et à fort impact qui assurent le succès organisationnel dans l'immédiat et dans l'avenir.

- En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership RD Taiwan, vous jouerez un rôle de modèle de comportement VACC et de maintien de l'énoncé de but LT. Une collaboration étroite avec les pairs de l'équipe de leadership est essentielle pour réaliser les objectifs plus généraux de l'entreprise.

- En fin de compte, vous devez faire preuve de la détermination et de la résilience nécessaires pour transformer le paysage de la santé de Taiwan, en incarneant la mission de Roche : « Faire ce dont les patients ont besoin ensuite. »

Principales responsabilités

- Leadership stratégique : Élaborer et exécuter une stratégie intégrée en matière de santé, d'accès aux marchés et de politique générale, alignée sur les orientations mondiales/régionales et les objectifs commerciaux locaux.

- Stratégie relative aux affaires médicales : Diriger la production et la diffusion de données scientifiques, favoriser les relations stratégiques avec les leaders clés de l'opinion (KOL) et les sociétés médicales, et assurer la précision scientifique de toutes les activités.

- Accès au marché et remboursement : faire en sorte que l'INS (assurance-maladie nationale) soit bien cotée et que les stratégies de tarification optimales pour les principaux produits diagnostiques soient utilisées à l'aide de la recherche sur l'économie et les résultats de la santé (HEOR).

- Politique publique et affaires gouvernementales : surveiller de façon proactive le paysage des politiques de santé.

- Développement des entreprises : Identifier, développer et gérer des opportunités et des partenariats stratégiques émergents qui favorisent la croissance et l'innovation et assurent la fourniture de solutions de santé évolutives et efficaces.

- Leadership d'équipe et culture VACC : Diriger, entraîner et inspirer une équipe interfonctionnelle de développement des politiques, des politiques et des affaires médicales et de l'accès aux marchés afin de libérer tout leur potentiel et de maintenir la culture VACC.

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: IT Business Analista - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence
titleByLocale.en: IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence
titleByLocale.de: IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrie und klinische Beweise
titleByLocale.fr: Analyste des affaires TI - DDT Biométrie et preuves cliniques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. Sono instancabilmente curiosi, orientati all'innovazione e appassionati di utilizzare la tecnologia per trasformare come le sperimentazioni cliniche sono concepite e eseguite - alla fine accelerando le terapie ai pazienti. • Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.

• Collaboration clinique et scientifique : agir comme premier lien entre les équipes cliniques/scientifiques et l'ingénierie des produits, établir des relations à long terme et faciliter des ateliers de découverte avec des experts médicaux pour bien comprendre la conception des essais et représenter la voix de l'utilisateur clinique.
• Caractéristiques du produit Innovation: Définir et posséder la feuille de route des caractéristiques en conciliant les besoins commerciaux, scientifiques et techniques; encourager l'innovation par des sprints de réflexion de conception pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités, créer des analyses de rentabilisation convaincantes et suivre les caractéristiques de réussite métriques/KPI après la sortie.
• Conception des caractéristiques et exigences Excellence : Auteur d'histoires d'utilisateurs précises, exploitables, épopées et critères d'acceptation ; partenaire avec UX pour créer des trames filaires et des prototypes, filtrer impitoyablement les requêtes en fonction de la valeur et maintenir une spécification de produit vivante traçable aux besoins de l'utilisateur.
• Partenariat technologique et ingénierie : agir en tant que traducteur technique en convertissant des flux de travail cliniques complexes en exigences structurées, en tirant parti d'une solide connaissance de l'architecture, de la modélisation des données et des API pour collaborer avec les ingénieurs sur les risques techniques, les dépendances et les solutions.
• Assurance qualité et soutien de l'UAT: Partenaire avec les architectes, les ingénieurs seniors et l'AQ mène tout au long du cycle de construction de développement pour assurer l'évolutivité et la qualité des fonctionnalités, tout en soutenant la conception et l'exécution de l'UAT pour répondre aux objectifs scientifiques et aux normes d'utilisation.
• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Diriger la livraison itérative, la rétroaction rapide et le développement basé sur l'hypothèse; propre et préparer un produit prêt au sprint backl

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

Roche Pharmaceutical

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. • Relevante Erfahrung in einer medizinischen Rolle in der Pharma-, Diagnostik-, Gesundheits-, Biotechnologie- oder verwandten Bereichen.
• Die Erfahrung der Arbeit in seltenen Krankheiten wäre sehr wünschenswert.
• Starkes Datenverständnis, kritische Beurteilungs-, Synthese- und Lieferfähigkeiten.
• Ein "System Thinker" Mindset, in der Lage, starke interne/externe Kollaborationen zu bauen, um Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Customer-Centric-Ansatz, Co-Creating-Lösungen, um Bedürfnisse zu lösen und klinische Praxis zu transformieren.
• Eine Kultur der Menschlichkeit, Neugier und Verantwortung, die in einem bestärkten, dynamischen und agilen Arbeitsumfeld blüht.
• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz von Gebäuden, Führungen und Beiträgen zu hochperformierenden, vielfältigen, agilen / Matrix-Teams.
• MD-Abschluss; PhD oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Biologie, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften oder gleichwertig bevorzugt. Klinische Erfahrung in seltenen Krankheiten ist ein Plus. Dies ist eine unglaubliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeit, um Ihr wissenschaftliches Know-how anzuwenden, mit Kollegen und Kunden aus aller Welt zusammenzuarbeiten und zu Innovationen beizutragen, die Familien mit seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien und darüber hinaus beeinflussen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutique Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par un engagement urgent à fournir des solutions médicales aujourd'hui tout en innovant pour demain. Notre nouveau modèle d'exploitation A2 audacieux met à profit les capacités collectives de l'entreprise pour créer des solutions rapides et efficaces pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale. Nous croyons en des soins de santé personnalisés et durables et sommes particulièrement bien placés pour intégrer les produits pharmaceutiques, les diagnostics, la santé numérique et les mégadonnées. Nous cherchons un activateur médical passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique APAC maladies rares. Ce rôle permanent à temps plein est un poste de ressource commun au-dessus du pays, exigeant un engagement de 80 à 100% ETP au-dessus du pays au sein de notre réseau. Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. Où

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a team member of Roche Services (Europe) Ltd. Site Services Department, the Procurement & Car Fleet Management Intern is responsible for:

• Supporting the work of the Strategic Procurement Partner and the Office Executives in administration regarding Procurement tasks and Car Fleet Management.

Responsibilities
Car fleet:

• Managing administrative duties including: monitoring car fleet contract start/end dates, highway tickets, penalties etc.

• Keeping contact with the Leasing companies and following up the incoming messages.

• Informing the employees about the car policy and assisting them with any car fleet related questions.

• Managing and updating the database containing comprehensive car fleet details.

• Supporting the car handover process and performing regular car condition checks.

• Assisting with the request, distribution, and record-keeping of fuel cards and motorway vignettes.

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed.

• Supporting system related activities in MyBuy, eg.: PO creation, reports.

Procurement:

• Supporting the Strategic Procurement Partner providing administrative assistance during the bidding process and organizing tender documentation.

• Analyzing supplier offers and maintaining data accuracy to support decision-making.

• Creating Purchase Orders (POs) and ensuring all transaction details are correct.

• Following up on orders and deliveries with vendors.

• Partnering with various departments to ensure their procurement needs are met efficiently and Ensuring all activities and documentation align with the official Procurement Policy.

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

What you can bring to our team

• Fluency in English & Hungarian

• You are currently studying in Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis

• B category driving license with active driving experience

• Stakeholder management skills, ability to multi-task

• Strong service orientation and communication skills

• Precise, focused, accountable way of working, high level of organizational and problem solving skills

• Proactive mindset

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Team player attitude, accuracy, ability to meet deadlines and set the right priorities

• Ability to adapt changes quickly

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life.

The opportunity
Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future.
Your impact:

• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.

• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.

• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.

• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.

• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).

• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.

• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes.

Who You Are

• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.

• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.

• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.

• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.

• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support.

Essential Skills

• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Must be able to design and implement global value-based pricing strategies, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability. Deep financial and commercial understanding is critical.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Posizione IT GRC Expert - Qualità RDT, Rischio e conformità In qualità di IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Qualità, Risk & Compliance progetta e implementa una resilienza IT completa, gestione del rischio e strategie di conformità allineate agli obiettivi aziendali. Conduci valutazioni di rischio complesse, sviluppi programmi di audit e continuità raffinati, e stabilisci le migliori pratiche per gestire le interruzioni critiche e la conformità alle normative. Facendo da consulente esperto per gli stakeholder di alto livello, si guidano le risposte agli incidenti critici e assicurano la scalabilità e la protezione futura delle soluzioni di rischio e continuità a livello aziendale. Opportunità - svilupperai e raffinerai strategie di gestione, conformità e continuità a livello aziendale per migliorare i nostri piani di recupero globale. - Guidare la risposta agli eventi critici relativi al rischio IT, all'audit e alla continuità, stabilendo le migliori pratiche globali per la gestione delle interruzioni. - Condurre revisioni post-incidenti e "deep-dives" per identificare guasti sistemici e implementare quadri di miglioramento continuo. - Gestire relazioni di stakeholder di alto livello, agendo come consulente strategico per allineare le politiche di rischio con le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione. - Fornire informazioni strategiche basate sulle best practice del settore per garantire che i nostri quadri di conformità rimangano di livello mondiale. - supervisionare la scalabilità delle soluzioni di resilienza IT, integrando politiche complesse con sistemi enterprise esistenti. - Valutare e selezionare strumenti avanzati per la gestione aziendale a prova di futuro il nostro paesaggio di resilienza tecnica. - Facilitare sessioni di formazione avanzate per team interfunzionali sulle best practice BCM e tecniche avanzate di problem solving. Chi sei? - Possiedi un'ampia esperienza nell'archiviare le strategie di resilienza IT a livello aziendale e di gestione dei rischi a livello strategico. - Esperto nelle normative Life Sciences, tra cui GxP, SOX e HIPAA, con una profonda comprensione della convalida dei sistemi informatici (CSV). - Altamente conoscibile in IT General Controls (ITGC) e strutture come SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, e DORA. - Tecnicamente competente in ambienti AWS e Azure, in particolare per quanto riguarda i modelli di responsabilità condivisa e l'orchestrazione DR nativo cloud. - Prove capacità di stabilire guardrails di governance per le tecnologie emergenti come AI Generativo, RPA e SaaS. - Compliance-as-Code. - Titolare di un Bachelor o Master in IT o Cybersecurity, e almeno una credenziale attiva: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, o ISO 22301. Cosa? - Campo d'insalatura 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle tue prestazioni. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo). - Prendere Tempo per la Carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta). - Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport. - Aggiunti di acquisto azionario. - Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! Contatto Applicare direttamente e unirsi a noi per plasmare il futuro della salute. Se lo sentite fuori
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this off

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Sie führen komplexe Risikobewertungen, entwickeln verfeinerte Audit- und Kontinuitätsprogramme und etablieren Best Practices für die Behandlung kritischer Störungen und regulatorischer Compliance. Als kompetenter Berater für hochrangige Stakeholder führen Sie Antworten auf kritische Vorfälle und sichern die Skalierbarkeit und Zukunftssicherheit von unternehmensweiten Risiko- und Kontinuitätslösungen. Chi sei - Sie verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrung in der betriebsweiten IT-Belastung und Risikomanagementstrategien auf strategischer Ebene. - Experte für Life Sciences Vorschriften, einschließlich GxP, SOX und HIPAA, mit einem tiefen Verständnis der Computersysteme Validierung (CSV). - Hochqualifiziert in IT General Controls (ITGC) und Frameworks wie SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2 und DORA. - Technisch kompetent in AWS und Azure Umgebungen, speziell in Bezug auf gemeinsame Verantwortungsmodelle und cloud-native DR-Orchestrierung. - Bewiesene Fähigkeit, Governance-Guardrails für aufstrebende Technologien wie Generative AI, RPA und SaaS zu etablieren. - Skilled in sicheren SDLC und DevOps Stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) mit der Fähigkeit, Compliance-as-Code implementieren. - Inhaber eines Bachelor- oder Master-Abschlusses in IT oder Cybersecurity und mindestens eines aktiven Anmelders: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP oder ISO 22301.
• Cosa offriamo - Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrages. - Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung. - Dediziertes Ausbildungsbudget (Ausbildung, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, diversifizierte Karrierewege usw.). - Freitagserneuerung (2 Freitage pro Quartal verfügbar). - Nehmen Sie Zeit Programm (bis zu 3 Monate Urlaub zu jedem Zweck zu verwenden). - Aufenthaltskosten. - Flex Location (die Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeit von verschiedenen Orten der Welt für einen bestimmten Zeitraum durchzuführen). - Nehmen Sie Zeit für Charity (zusätzliche bezahlte Urlaub von maximal 2 Wochen, um sich in die Wohltätigkeitsaktion Ihrer Wahl zu engagieren). - Privates Gesundheitswesen (LuxMed Pakete), Gruppenlebensversicherung (UNUM) und Multisport. - Aktienbeschaffungszusätze. - Jährlicher Vertrieb von Laptops und Autos und vieles mehr! Contattoo Bewerben Sie sich direkt und begleiten Sie uns bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung. Wenn du das fühlst
