Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Posizione Expert en TI GRC - RDT Qualité, risque et conformité En tant qu'expert en TI GRC (Gouvernance, Risque et Conformité) - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Qualité, Risque et Conformité, vous concevez et implémentez des stratégies complètes de résilience, de gestion des risques et de conformité conformes aux objectifs opérationnels. Vous dirigez des évaluations des risques complexes, élaborez des programmes de vérification et de continuité améliorés et établissez des pratiques exemplaires pour gérer les perturbations critiques et la conformité réglementaire. En tant que conseiller expert auprès des intervenants de haut niveau, vous dirigez les interventions en cas d'incident critique et vous assurez l'évolutivité et la protection future des solutions de risque et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Annexe - Vous développerez et affinerez des stratégies de gestion des risques, de conformité et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise afin d'améliorer nos plans de redressement mondiaux. - Diriger la réponse aux risques critiques liés aux TI, à la vérification et à la continuité tout en établissant les meilleures pratiques mondiales pour gérer les perturbations. - Procéder à des examens post-incident et à des « directives profondes » pour déceler les défaillances systémiques et mettre en place des cadres d'amélioration continue. - Gérer les relations de haut niveau avec les intervenants, agir à titre de conseiller stratégique pour harmoniser les politiques sur les risques avec l'évolution des besoins opérationnels. - Fournir des renseignements stratégiques fondés sur les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie pour s'assurer que nos cadres de conformité demeurent de calibre mondial. - Surveiller l'évolutivité des solutions de résilience informatique, en intégrant des politiques complexes aux systèmes d'entreprise existants. - Évaluer et sélectionner des outils avancés pour la gestion d'entreprise pour mettre à l'épreuve notre paysage de résilience technique. - Faciliter les séances de formation avancée à l'intention des équipes interfonctionnelles sur les meilleures pratiques de la BCM et les techniques avancées de résolution de problèmes. Les - Vous possédez une vaste expérience dans l'architecture de stratégies de résilience informatique et de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise au niveau stratégique. - Expert en sciences de la vie, y compris GxP, SOX et HIPAA, avec une compréhension approfondie de la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV). - Haute connaissance des contrôles généraux des TI (ITGC) et des cadres tels que SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2 et DORA. - Techniquement compétent dans les environnements AWS et Azure, en particulier en ce qui concerne les modèles de responsabilité partagée et l'orchestration de RD native en nuage. - Capacité éprouvée d'établir des garde-corps de gouvernance pour les technologies émergentes telles que Generative AI, RPA et SaaS. - Compétence dans les piles SDLC et DevOps sécurisées (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) avec la capacité de mettre en œuvre la conformité comme code. - Titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique ou cybersécurité, et au moins un titre actif : CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP ou ISO 22301.
• Cosa offriamo - Barème des salaires 19 000 - 35 400 PLN g ross sur la base du contrat de travail. - Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance. - Budget dédié à la formation (formation, certifications, conférences, parcours professionnels diversifiés, etc.). - Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre disponible). - Prendre du temps Programme (jusqu'à 3 mois de congé à utiliser à n'importe quelle fin). - Allocation de vacances disponible. - Flex Location (possibilité d'effectuer notre travail à partir de différents endroits du monde pour une certaine période de temps). - Prenez du temps pour l'organisme de bienfaisance (un congé payé supplémentaire de 2 semaines maximum pour participer à l'action de bienfaisance de votre choix). - Soins de santé privés (paquets LuxMed), assurance-vie collective (UNUM) et multisports. - Ajouts d'actions. - Ventes annuelles d'ordinateurs portables et de voitures d'entreprise et beaucoup plus! Contatto Appliquer directement et nous rejoindre pour façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. Si vous sentez ça

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
Customer Partner

Role Purpose
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will
Account Management

• Responsible in solution/technical/consultative selling.

• Leads sales process including prospecting, qualification, quantification, needs assessment, competitive differentiation, presentation, closing, contracting and implementation and ensuring after sales support is maintained and of the highest standard.

• Build long-term value-based relationships through continuously uncovering customers’ changing needs, improving customer experience, anticipating new opportunities for their business in the future and adding values through creative solutions / products

• Build credibility with customers and other stakeholders at different levels through demonstrating business acumen and professional expertise, confidence and effective communication.

• Develop and build strategic engagement and partnering with KOLs and relevant stakeholders in key accounts. Be a partner/consultant in shaping their plans, decisions and supporting their professional objectives to achieve RDMY business strategy and goals.

• Understand the customers’ working / communication styles and flex one’s style to adapt to that.

• Identify and develop business opportunities within the area of responsibility and collaborate across teams to ensure attainment.

• Implement a sales management process to assist the team in identifying and prioritizing customers and prospects.

• Responsible for developing and leading implementation of annual territorial plans with the goal of achieving sales objectives and future growth.

• Identify new accounts in line with the marketing strategy.

• Retain, extend and acquire customers and accounts through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Responsible for profiling accounts, placing RDMY in the strongest position to win tenders and new accounts.

• Update Accounts and contacts in Salesforce regularly to ensure accuracy of data

• Ensure Salesforce activities, business opportunities are entered in REXIS on a weekly basis.

• Monitor all Opportunities to ensure they are up to date.

• Able to conduct Basic troubleshooting.

• Proficient in Global Deal Calculator (GDC) in preparing sales proposal.

• Participation in relevant marketing events/exhibition/trade.

• Responsible for arranging and conducting relevant training or presentation sessions for customers.

Product Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of assigned product portfolio to manage sales process, involving cross function team’s expertise, as needed

• Promote co-positioning of cross-BA products, where applicable, with the objective to maximize RDMY total revenues and profitability

Teamwork

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. Unisciti al nostro team Data e Digital Catalyst come Software Engineer, dove svilupperai gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi che sono fondamentali per la nostra ricerca. Costruirete sistemi robusti e scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando direttamente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento della vita per i pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per potenziare i nostri scienziati e promuovere la scienza dei dati attraverso la tecnologia innovativa. L'opportunità
• Costruire e migliorare un ecosistema moderno e scalabile di applicazioni e strumenti per catturare, spostare e preparare i dati scientifici per l'analisi.
• Progettare e fornire applicazioni e tubazioni di dati complesse e facili da usare che integrano diversi set di dati in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Levare modelli standard come microservizi e architettura orientata agli eventi per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'ecosistema delle applicazioni.
• Campione di eccellenza tecnica assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano innovative, di classe migliore e perfettamente integrate.
• Integrare diversi set di dati per alimentare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), l'apprendimento automatico (ML), e le capacità di ricerca della lingua naturale.
• Collaborare direttamente con gli scienziati computazionali e di ricerca per comprendere le loro sfide e tradurli in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Fornire leadership tecnica sulle iniziative in corso e identificare nuove opportunità per costruire soluzioni comuni e riutilizzabili.
• Mentor junior sviluppatori, promuovendo la loro crescita professionale e mantenendo elevati standard di ingegneria. Chi sei Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere software appassionato e collaborativo con un talento per la costruzione di piattaforme scalabili e affidabili. Si prospera sul coinvolgimento di partner scientifici per risolvere la conformità

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Das Solutions-Team innerhalb der DDC-Organisation entwickelt modernisierte und vernetzte Rechen- und Datenökosysteme. Das Data Ecosystem ist ein Fundament für den Aufbau von Lösungen, die die Arbeit unserer Computational- und Bench-Wissenschaftler beschleunigen und die Erstellung und Annahme von ML/AI-Tools ermöglichen. Unser Team ist spezialisiert auf den Aufbau von Data Pipelines und Applikationen für Datenerfassung, Sammlung, Speicherung, Transformation, Verknüpfung und Weitergabe. Registrieren Sie sich bei unserem Data- und Digital Catalyst-Team als Software Engineer, wo Sie die modernisierten und vernetzten Rechen- und Datenökosysteme entwickeln, die für unsere Forschung von grundlegender Bedeutung sind. Sie bauen robuste und skalierbare Systeme auf, die das Potenzial unserer vielfältigen wissenschaftlichen Daten freischalten und die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von lebensverändernden Behandlungen für Patienten direkt beschleunigen. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, unsere Wissenschaftler zu stärken und datengetriebene Wissenschaft durch innovative Technologie zu fördern. Die Chance
• Erstellen und verbessern Sie ein modernes, skalierbares Ökosystem von Anwendungen und Werkzeugen, um wissenschaftliche Daten für die Analyse zu erfassen, zu bewegen und vorzubereiten.
• Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von komplexen, benutzerfreundlichen Datenanwendungen und Pipelines, die verschiedene Datensätze über wichtige wissenschaftliche Domänen integrieren.
• Nutzen Sie Standardmuster wie Mikroservices und ereignisgesteuerte Architektur, um unsere Daten-Workflows und Anwendungs-Ökosystem zu verbessern.
• Champion technische Exzellenz durch die Gewährleistung unserer Lösungen sind innovative, erstklassige und nahtlos integriert.
• Integrieren Sie verschiedene Datensätze, um die Fähigkeiten der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI), des maschinellen Lernens (ML) und der Natural Language Search zu stärken.
• Direkt mit Rechen- und Forschungswissenschaftlern zusammenarbeiten, um ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen und in effektive Technologielösungen umzusetzen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. L'équipe Solutions de l'organisation DDC développe des écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés. L'écosystème des données est fondamental pour construire des solutions qui accélèrent le travail de nos chercheurs en informatique et en banque et permettent la création et l'adoption d'outils ML/AI. Notre équipe est spécialisée dans la construction de pipelines de données et applications pour l'acquisition, la collecte, le stockage, la transformation, le couplage et le partage de données. Rejoignez notre équipe Data and Digital Catalyst en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, où vous développerez les écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés qui sont fondamentaux pour notre recherche. Vous allez construire des systèmes robustes et évolutives qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques, accélérant directement la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients. C'est une occasion unique d'habiliter nos scientifiques et de faire progresser la science axée sur les données grâce à une technologie novatrice. L'opportunité
• Construire et améliorer un écosystème moderne et évolutif d'applications et d'outils pour capturer, déplacer et préparer des données scientifiques à analyser.
• Concevoir et fournir des applications et des pipelines de données complexes et conviviaux qui intègrent divers ensembles de données dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Tirer parti des modèles standard comme les microservices et l'architecture événementielle pour améliorer nos flux de données et l'écosystème d'application.
• Championne l'excellence technique en s'assurant que nos solutions sont innovantes, de qualité supérieure et parfaitement intégrées.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'intelligence artificielle (AI), l'apprentissage automatique (ML) et la recherche en langage naturel.
• Collaborer directement avec les chercheurs et les chercheurs pour comprendre leurs défis et les traduire en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Fournir un leadership technique sur les initiatives en cours et identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'élaborer des solutions communes et réutilisables.
• Mentor junior développeurs, favorisant leur croissance professionnelle et le maintien de normes d'ingénierie élevées. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel passionné et collaboratif avec un talent pour construire des plateformes évolutives et fiables. Vous prospèrez en vous engageant avec des partenaires scientifiques pour résoudre

Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. In qualità di Ingegnere software del nostro team di Ingegneria Soluzioni, costruirai funzionalità robuste, scalabili e riutilizzabili per la nostra piattaforma dati condivisa. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Data Engineers, Product Leaders e partner scientifici per progettare e implementare sistemi che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente ad accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento di vita per i pazienti costruendo l'ecosistema moderno che cattura, si muove e prepara i dati scientifici per l'analisi. L'opportunità
• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica offrendo flussi di dati innovativi e di alta qualità e tubazioni in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Promuovere l'adozione di tendenze e tecnologie chiave applicando un approccio Open Source, Cloud First, API First e AI First alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'architettura delle applicazioni sfruttando modelli standard come microservizi e design orientato agli eventi.
• Integra diversi set di dati per alimentare AI/ML, Natural Language Search e strumenti di visualizzazione e analisi a valle.
• Facilitare l'implementazione di modelli AI all'avanguardia che sfruttano i progressi nell'apprendimento automatico.
• Influenza delle decisioni tecniche sui flussi di lavoro dei dati e sullo sviluppo delle applicazioni in collaborazione con partner chiave.
• Imparare e comprendere profondamente il nostro Data Ecosystem per promuovere un miglioramento continuo e un'innovazione. Chi sei Sei un ingegnere appassionato che si preoccupa dell'eccellenza tecnica e del prodotto, con l'obiettivo di costruire soluzioni altamente utilizzabili. Si prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, sfruttando le pratiche di sviluppo moderne per tradurre sfide complesse in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

As a Software Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will build robust, scalable, and reusable capabilities for our shared data platform. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Leaders, and scientific partners to design and implement systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients by building the modern ecosystem that captures, moves, and prepares scientific data for analysis.

The Opportunity

• Ensure technical excellence by delivering innovative, best-in-class data flows and pipelines across key scientific domains.

• Promote the adoption of key trends and technologies by applying an Open Source, Cloud First, API First, and AI First approach to problem-solving.

• Improve our data workflows and application architecture by leveraging standard patterns like microservices and event-driven design.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power AI/ML, Natural Language Search, and downstream visualization and analytics tools.

• Facilitate the implementation of cutting-edge AI models that take advantage of advances in machine learning.

• Influence technical decisions around data workflows and application development in collaboration with key partners.

• Learn and deeply understand our Data Ecosystem to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Who You Are

You are a passionate engineer who cares about technical and product excellence, with a drive to build highly usable solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, leveraging modern development practices to translate complex challenges into effective technology solutions.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technica

• Assurer l'excellence technique en fournissant des flux de données et des pipelines innovants et de qualité supérieure dans des domaines scientifiques clés.

• Améliorer nos flux de travail de données et l'architecture d'application en tirant parti des modèles standard tels que les microservices et la conception d'événements.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'IA/ML, la recherche en langage naturel et les outils de visualisation et d'analyse en aval.
• Faciliter la mise en œuvre de modèles d'intelligence artificielle de pointe qui tirent parti des progrès de l'apprentissage automatique.
• Influencer les décisions techniques sur les flux de données et le développement des applications en collaboration avec les principaux partenaires.
• Apprenez et comprenez profondément notre écosystème de données pour stimuler l'amélioration continue et l'innovation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur passionné qui se soucie de l'excellence technique et des produits, avec un moteur pour construire des solutions hautement utilisables. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement collaboratif, en tirant parti des pratiques de développement modernes pour traduire les défis complexes en solutions technologiques efficaces.

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Country Medical Director is a senior leader who easily navigates between science, data and business in service of our vision at Roche. You are an experienced professional with a solid scientific background. You are confident in playing a key role in developing the local medical strategy to enable future success of the organization and you have experience in transforming complex healthcare challenges into clear and compelling actions that benefit patients.

Building relationships and scientific partnerships with our stakeholders is your second nature. Considering the nature of Bosnia and Herzegovina healthcare system, the Medical Director will bring understanding of the operating environment (or comparable market) and its challenges. You come with a strong vision on evidence generation and data enabled healthcare. You are passionate about innovation and can envision how healthcare data and science can have a sustainable impact on the healthcare system.

As a member of the Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina Enabling/Leadership Team, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and achieving company objectives within the Affiliate and Medical Chapter, including strategic decision making and empowering teams. You will serve as a role model to the entire organization, lead the functional chapter, and focus on upskilling and coaching team members, while also co-creating organizational strategies and fostering agility and cultural change. Additionally, you will collaborate with other Country Medical Directors, Chapter Heads and Squad Leads to allocate resources and support professional development within the Network, Affiliate and Chapter.

Who are we looking for?

Beyond strong focus on external engagement, strategic partnerships, data and science you have the following responsibilities:

• Shape and develop the overall affiliate medical strategy based on external insights and Roche’s product portfolio developments

• Drive above-brand medical strategy and alignment

• Represents Roche medical authority with key external stakeholders

• As a member of the Enabling /Leadership Team, develop and implement the vision, mission and overarching strategy for Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure it adheres to the highest scientific and ethical standards and fulfills all regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Ensure excellence in scientific consulting with stakeholders, patient safety, quality, compliance, regulatory, evidence generation and medical information

• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance acting as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO ensuring business integrity and company reputation.

• Drive early health data gap identification, prioritization and integrated evidence planning inclusion by being actively involved and by collaborating with strong medical enablers

• Bring clinical practice perspective and act as a sparring partner to decide how (and which) data should be used / generated to build the medical narrative in the respective disease areas

• Work closely with local, cross-country and global compliance networks, strong cross-functional partnership with other affiliate (and network) functions and actively engage with Roche global functions and group members.

• Being a servant leader to the entire affiliate and network acting with courage and integrity. Role model creative leadership and network mindset supporting transparency across the organization.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Qualification Manager (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la mise en service et des qualifications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

Job Summary:
As the Operations Quality Site Head for Suzhou, you are fully accountable for the quality of the products manufactured at the site and for ensuring end-to-end compliance with global specifications, local Health Authority regulations, and corporate quality standards. You serve as a key member of the Global perations
Quality Leadership Team (GOQLT) and the Site Leadership Team, modeling Agile behaviors and driving operational excellence.

Main Tasks & 
• Responsibilities:
Drive business results and customer value
a) Responsible for ensuring that manufactured products in Suzhou meet Health Authority regulations, Notified Body requirements, Company standards and expectations. Establish and support inspection readiness to ensure successful outcomes. Prepare adequate and timely responses to any inspection
observations and implement appropriate and thorough corrections, as necessary.
b) Engage and influence the organization to ensure that Product Quality is our focus by ensuring that products manufactured in Suzhou meet regulatory requirements and product specifications. products, ensure our right to operate and continuously improve.

Accountable for ensuring the site’s technical documentation, quality management systems,
and regulatory filings are meticulously drawn up, maintained up-to-date, and fully aligned with NMPA, FDA, and European regulations to safeguard our right to operate.

2. Advance the work of the Network, making tradeoffs and breaking silos
a) Partner with the Operations Site Head on strategic business direction and decisions. dependencies, as well as rebalance work & help in line with greater strategic priorities.
b) Build and maintain strong partnerships with other site and network leaders to assure alignment around strategic projects and day-to-day activities and to assure mutually successful working relationships.
c) Coordinate with Functional Partners to aggregate upcoming LCTs’ needs and upcoming priorities, to better understand upcoming resource demands on the Network.

Empower and enable the Network
a) Develop and communicate organizational strategies, which ensure the GMP compliance of the site, continuous improvements and achievement of long-term goals.
b) Negotiate with Senior Leadership across the organization to influence decision making.
c) Lead,

- Costruire e mantenere solide partnership con altri leader di sito e rete per assicurare l'allineamento intorno a progetti strategici e attività quotidiane e per garantire relazioni di lavoro reciprocamente di successo. - Coordinare con i Partner Funzionali per aggregare le future esigenze LCT e le prossime priorità, per comprendere meglio le future esigenze di risorse sulla rete.

Potenziare e consentire la rete - Sviluppare e comunicare strategie organizzative, che garantiscono la conformità GMP del sito, continui miglioramenti e il raggiungimento di obiettivi a lungo termine. - Negoziare con Senior Leadership in tutta l'organizzazione per influenzare il processo decisionale. - Lead,

Sie dienen als Schlüsselmitglied des Global perations Quality Leadership Teams (GOQLT) und des Site Leadership Teams, Modellierung von Agile-Verhalten und Antriebsleistung betrieblicher Exzellenz.

Verantwortungen Antrieb von Geschäftsergebnissen und Kundenwert - Verantwortlich dafür, dass die hergestellten Produkte in Suzhou den Gesundheitsbehörden-Vorschriften, den Anforderungen der benannten Stelle, den Standards und Erwartungen des Unternehmens entsprechen. Stellen Sie die Inspektionsbereitschaft fest und unterstützen Sie sie, um erfolgreiche Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

- Engagement und Einfluss der Organisation, um sicherzustellen, dass die Produktqualität ist unser Schwerpunkt, indem wir sicherstellen, dass Produkte in Suzhou hergestellt entsprechen regulatorischen Anforderungen und Produktspezifikationen. Arbeitet direkt in einem komplexen, globalen Umfeld mit den Kapiteln und dem anderen Netzwerk führt zu liefern qualitativ hochwertige Produkte, sicherstellen unser Recht auf Betrieb und kontinuierlich verbessern. - Führen und Beratung für Mitarbeiter Regie Qualitätsfunktionen, die Leistung und Entwicklung von direkten Berichten, um die Erreichung der organisatorischen, und Abteilungsziele und ein produktives Umfeld zu gewährleisten.

- Aufrechterhaltung einer effektiven Qualität Governance und kontinuierlich verbessern die Governance, um die Bedürfnisse der Unternehmen und Compliance gerecht zu werden. Kommunizieren Sie signifikante Qualitäts- oder regulatorische Fragen und Risiken, die Produktqualität oder regulatorische Einhaltung in einer rechtzeitigen Weise beeinflussen können Executive Management. - Entwickeln Sie jährliche Budgets, Revision Prognosen, um die Bedürfnisse der Unternehmen zu erfüllen und überwachen / zu kontrollieren Ausgaben, um eine effiziente Nutzung der Unternehmensressourcen zu gewährleisten.

- Als Standort-Management-Beauftragter und Verantwortlicher für die Einhaltung der Vorschriften (PRRC) gemäß den chinesischen Vorschriften für Medizinprodukte GMP und internationalen Normen (z.B. ISO 13485:2016) ernannt. Verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der Website, die technische Dokumentation, Qualitätsmanagementsysteme und regulatorischen Einreichungen werden sorgfältig erstellt, aktualisiert und vollständig mit NMPA, FDA und europäischen Vorschriften abgestimmt, um unser Recht auf Betrieb zu wahren.

Die Arbeit des Netzwerks voranbringen, Kompromisse eingehen und Silos brechen - Partner mit dem Operations Site Head für strategische Geschäftsführung und Entscheidungen. Silos abbauen und die Arbeitseffizienz als Integrator in der gesamten Organisation verbessern, wie nötig; insbesondere durch die Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Networks Leaders und Stakeholdern, um eskalierte Engpässe und Abhängigkeiten zu lösen, sowie die Arbeit und Hilfe im Einklang mit größeren strategischen Prioritäten neu ausbalancieren.

- Aufbau und Pflege starker Partnerschaften mit anderen Betreibern von Websites und Netzwerken, um die Ausrichtung auf strategische Projekte und alltägliche Aktivitäten zu gewährleisten und um gegenseitig erfolgreiche Arbeitsbeziehungen zu gewährleisten. - Koordinierung mit Functional Partners, um die kommenden LCTs, Bedürfnisse und kommenden Prioritäten zusammenzuführen, um die anstehenden Ressourcenanforderungen an das Netzwerk besser zu verstehen.

Empower und ermöglichen das Netzwerk - Entwickeln und kommunizieren organisatorische Strategien, die die GMP-Konformität des Standorts, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und die Erreichung der langfristigen Ziele gewährleisten. - Verhandeln Sie mit Senior Leadership in der gesamten Organisation, um Entscheidungsfindung zu beeinflussen. - Lead,

Description Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

Le poste Sommaire du poste : En tant que responsable du site de la qualité des opérations pour Suzhou, vous êtes pleinement responsable de la qualité des produits fabriqués sur le site et de la conformité de bout en bout avec les spécifications mondiales, les règlements locaux des autorités sanitaires et les normes de qualité de l'entreprise.

Responsabilités Conduire les résultats commerciaux et la valeur client - Veiller à ce que les produits fabriqués à Suzhou respectent les règlements de l'autorité sanitaire, les exigences de l'organisme notifié, les normes et les attentes de l'entreprise. Établir et appuyer la préparation à l'inspection pour assurer les résultats positifs.

- Faire en sorte que les produits fabriqués à Suzhou répondent aux exigences réglementaires et aux spécifications des produits et les influencer dans un environnement mondial complexe, avec les chapitres et les autres réseaux mène à la prestation de produits de haute qualité, assure notre droit de fonctionner et d'améliorer continuellement. - Assurer le leadership et l'orientation du personnel qui dirige les fonctions de qualité, gérer le rendement et l'élaboration de rapports directs pour assurer la réalisation des objectifs organisationnels et ministériels et un environnement productif.

- Maintenir une gouvernance efficace de la qualité et améliorer continuellement la gouvernance pour répondre aux besoins des entreprises et de la conformité. Communiquer aux cadres supérieurs des questions et des risques importants de qualité ou de réglementation qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur la qualité des produits ou la conformité à la réglementation en temps opportun.

- Nommé représentant de la gestion du site et responsable de la conformité réglementaire (PRRC) équivalent en vertu des règlements China Medical Device BPF et des normes internationales (par exemple, ISO 13485:2016). Responsable de la sécurité du site, la documentation technique, les systèmes de gestion de la qualité et les dépôts réglementaires sont soigneusement établis, tenus à jour et entièrement conformes aux règlements NMPA, FDA et européens pour protéger notre droit d'exploitation.

Faire progresser le travail du Réseau, faire des compromis et briser les silos - Partenaire avec le site opérationnel Responsable de la direction stratégique et des décisions. Décomposer les silos et améliorer l'efficacité de travail en tant qu'intégrateur, au besoin dans l'organisation; en particulier par la collaboration avec d'autres leaders de réseaux et les parties prenantes pour résoudre les goulets d'étranglement et les dépendances en hausse, ainsi que rééquilibrer le travail et l'aide en fonction des priorités stratégiques plus grandes.

- Établir et maintenir des partenariats solides avec d'autres responsables de sites et de réseaux afin d'assurer l'alignement autour des projets stratégiques et des activités quotidiennes et d'assurer des relations de travail fructueuses entre eux. - Coordonner avec les partenaires fonctionnels pour regrouper les prochaines ELC, les besoins et les priorités à venir, afin de mieux comprendre les besoins futurs en ressources du Réseau.

Donner au réseau les moyens de s'acquitter de ses fonctions - Élaborer et communiquer des stratégies organisationnelles qui garantissent la conformité des BPF au site, des améliorations continues et la réalisation des objectifs à long terme. - Négocier avec les cadres supérieurs de l'organisation afin d'influencer la prise de décisions. - Chef de file,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations is focused on delivering professional IT support for our Roche affiliates in the EMEA region and globally as well in cooperation with our service centers in Costa Rica and Malaysia. Our teams consist of English, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish and French speaking Service Desk Specialists from beginners to highly skilled professionals.

Disclosure Note: The final job title is Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist.

The Opportunity

• Provide first-level support for software and hardware incidents and service requests across Mac, Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google environments.

• Engage with users across multiple channels, including phone, chat, and self-service portal.

• Thrive as a key member of a truly AI-powered IT support operations team.

• Champion the end-users' needs, escalating critical situations as required to ensure swift resolution.

• Keep users updated on their request status, guiding them toward the best solutions for their productivity and satisfaction.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University education in IT or related discipline is preferred

• 1.5 - 2 years of experience in call center, service desk, or IT desk-side support

• Experience with Apple and Microsoft operating systems, Google suite, Microsoft Office products, SAP, corporate networks, and video conferencing systems

• Strong troubleshooting, task prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in German and English

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

​ Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions

The Position
We are looking for an enthusiastic and agile successor for our People Support Solutions Team Lead position within the People Support Solutions German Network . In this role, you will lead a team of HR generalists providing first-line support to our German-based employees, managing a diverse and high-impact portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a team of HR specialists providing first-line support across the entire German network.

• Manage a diverse portfolio encompassing Employee Lifecycle Management, Compensation, Payroll, Time & Benefits, and Compliance.

• Navigate an extensive stakeholder network , partnering closely with Business & Talent Acquisition Partners and various Project Teams.

• Drive operational excellence by supporting your team in solving complex cases and engaging in demanding professional conversations.

• Benefit from a broad professional scope , moving beyond a single vertical to master a diversified P&C service landscape.

• Empower your team to take E2E accountability, fostering an environment where self-management and initiative are the norms.

• Act as a catalyst for growth , helping team members navigate transformations and reorganizations with confidence.

Who You Are

• A seasoned People Leader with at least 1 year of direct Line Management experience and a passion for developing others.

• Fluent in German (near-native/C1-C2) with the ability to communicate with sophistication and nuance in a regulated business environment.

• Highly proficient in English , enabling you to collaborate effectively within our global corporate structure.

• An empathetic leader who prioritizes empowerment, coaching, and a people-first mindset in your daily leadership practice.

• A strategic navigator comfortable managing complex stakeholder networks and diagnosing organizational needs.

• A disciplined professional with a university degree (HR or Business preferred) and a strong grasp of logical reasoning.

• An agile specialist who may come from a Second Level background but is ready to master the diverse, fast-paced world of Front Line HR.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we commit ourselves to achieving access to medical and diagnostics innovations for all. Together with our regional and country organizations, we are building health systems ready to provide the future of care and make access a reality, thus, enabling people and patients around the world to live their best lives.

This global leadership position is responsible for bringing our diagnostics solutions to the forefront of care and growing access, reimbursement and funding effectively for our established portfolio as well as our ground breaking innovations.
The incumbent will closely collaborate with the global functions in Medical, Commercial, Market Access and Health System Policy enabling our affiliates to effectively co-design and apply the global tools, setting specific access targets in their respective environments and pulling through effective plans for their realization in mutual accountability.
As you are versatile in many environments and wish to impact external access delivery, you will closely accompany affiliates in their efforts to build the health system of tomorrow. Through this lived proximity to market realities, you will enable better global tools and deliverables, always pushing for the next level in furthering our affiliate support.

The Opportunity

Your responsibilities include:

• Market Analysis and Opportunity Identification : Research and analyze access coverage, reimbursement levels, health and payer policies, competitive access landscapes to identify business opportunities enabled through access and assess the probability and impact of affecting positive change.

• Access Insight and Strategy Development : Apply expertise in consolidating and providing relevant access insights and supporting the development and execution of global access strategies and impactful access tools including the Access Reimbursement Toolkit.

• Strategic Access Engagement Leadership : Act as a catalyst and coach for regional and affiliate implementation of global access strategies, identifying gaps, tailoring approaches, and accelerating time to reimbursement and the effective funding for your prioritized products.

• Global-Regional-Affiliate Interface : Create frameworks for efficient transfer of global strategies and catalyze learning, sharing, and collaboration across organizations and territories by leading the Access Nexus pilot of your area - our key interface to the Regions and Countries driving your work in achieving reimbursement and funding.

• Affiliate Support : Support regions and affiliates in executing payer-relevant access approaches, addressing access, reimbursement and funding barriers holistically, and leading projects to enhance local access capabilities with delivering tangible business growth through the realization of access opportunities.

• Shaping Sustainable Healthcare Systems : Support regions and affiliates in building plans and networks that aim for the creation of sustainable Health Care Systems in affecting the regulatory frameworks of payers, Health Technology Assessment bodies and their advising network.

• Requires travel of up to 20%

Who you are

• Master’s degree in business economics, life sciences, public health, marketing, or a related discipline; additional educational programs in market access preferred

• 5+ years of commercial and/or access experience in the diagnostic/pharmaceutical or related industry. Additional experience in related functions such as Strategy, Marketing, or Health Policy preferred.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu. Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Du rotierst durch kaufmännische und technische Bereiche wie IT, Logistik oder Finance und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk auf.

• Du bildest die direkte Brücke zwischen den Fachbereichen und der IT und koordinierst spannende gemeinsame Projekte.

• Du entwickelst smarte IT-Lösungen von der ersten Idee über die Programmierung bis zur Einführung mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum.

• Du optimierst aktiv betriebswirtschaftliche Prozesse und steuerst Abläufe – sei es in der Logistik, der Produktion oder im Controlling.

Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim abgehalten.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert Dein Duales Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung. Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Stai cercando un programma di studio doppio diversificato e orientato al futuro? Allora reinventa insieme a noi il futuro dell’assistenza sanitaria. In Roche sviluppiamo strumenti diagnostici e medicinali innovativi per consentire alle persone di vivere una vita migliore e più lunga. Entra a far parte di questa missione e dai un contributo cruciale ai pazienti di tutto il mondo fin dall'inizio.

Compiti
- Ruoti attraverso aree commerciali e tecniche come IT, logistica o finanza e costruisci una forte rete.
- Costituisci il ponte diretto tra i dipartimenti e l'IT e coordini entusiasmanti progetti comuni.
- Sviluppi soluzioni IT intelligenti dall'idea iniziale attraverso la programmazione fino all'implementazione utilizzando metodi agili come Scrum.

Descriptif
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste
Êtes-vous à la recherche d’un programme d’études en alternance diversifié et tourné vers l’avenir ? Alors réinventez l’avenir des soins de santé avec nous. Chez Roche, nous développons des diagnostics et des médicaments innovants pour permettre aux gens de vivre plus longtemps et mieux. Faites partie de cette mission et apportez dès le début une contribution cruciale aux patients du monde entier.

Tâches

- Finances : Rémunération attractive ainsi que primes de vacances et de Noël.
- Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : 30 jours de vacances, sports d'entreprise et soins de santé complets.
- Développement : préparation intensive aux examens, diplôme d'entrée au collège technique (facultatif) et large gamme de formations continues.
- Extras : environnement de travail international, missions à l'étranger et repas à la cantine à prix réduit.

Exigences
- Diplôme général d'entrée à l'université
- Diplôme d'entrée à l'université spécifique à une matière
- Diplôme d'entrée à l'université et preuve de réussite au test d'aptitude de l'Université coopérative d'État du Bade-Wurtemberg

Détails
Combien de temps dure votre cursus en alternance ?
3 ans. Ceci est précédé d'un stage d'un mois spécifique à l'entreprise

Contacter
Postulez maintenant – téléchargez un CV, une lettre de motivation et vos deux derniers bulletins scolaires sous forme de fichier PDF avec votre candidature.

Important : Veuillez vous assurer que votre candidature est complète. Aucun document ne pourra être téléchargé ultérieurement.

Nous attendons votre candidature avec impatience !

Veuillez consulter nos FAQ, vous les trouverez via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent au progrès de la science, garantissant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts ont permis de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et de réaliser plus de 30 milliards de tests à l'aide de nos produits de diagnostic. Nous nous donnons les moyens d'explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir proposer des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Bâtissons ensemble un avenir plus sain.
