descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Richiesto

• Conoscenza terapeutica all'interno del metabolismo, l'obesità e il diabete con esperienza clinica, scientifica e clinica di sperimentazione / sviluppo necessario

• Sfondo accademico / insegnamento è un plus

• Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi dei dati, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica

• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito

• Regolazione: Conoscenza degli aspetti medici del GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito

• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica post-laurea o clinica

• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale

Abilità e comportamenti chiave

• Etica: Ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche

• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli

• Business Acumen: Ha la conoscenza del settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga. Regolarmente conduce lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia

• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget

• Competenze interpersonali: buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità

• Scrittura: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta

• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo

• Competenze di negoziazione: Buone competenze di negoziazione: sa come completare i consegnabili lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente

• Decision Making: Sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso mentre bilanciare l'etica e l'efficacia

• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra

DUTI SPECIFICHE E RESPONSABILITÀ:
Strategia e pianificazione CDP

• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per molecola/indicazioni assegnate

• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD

• Funziona con altri membri del CST e sub-team rilevanti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)

• Funziona con CST e altri team rilevanti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/resource necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD

• Rimangono al di fuori degli sviluppi interni ed esterni, delle tendenze e di altre dinamiche rilevanti per il lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali di influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e malattia assegnata(i)

• Come opportuno, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione dell'intelligence competitiva e/o di altri mercati/industria

• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nella specifica area terapeutica e malattia di assegnazione

• Collabora con una varietà di partner e stakeholder interni ed esterni, come investigatori clinici, clinici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), così come gruppi interni multidisciplinari, tra cui altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo aziendale, ope commerciale
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
ERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• Akademisch/wissenschaftlich/klinisch:
• M.D. erforderlich

• Therapeutisches Wissen über Stoffwechsel, Fettleibigkeit und Diabetes mit relevanter klinischer, wissenschaftlicher und klinischer Studien- / Entwicklungserfahrung erforderlich

• Akademischer / Lehrhintergrund ist ein Plus

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Prinzipien und Techniken der Datenanalyse, Interpretation und klinischen Relevanz

• Erfahrungen mit der Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen einer wissenschaftlichen Studie in einer Peer-Review-Zeitschrift werden bevorzugt

• Regulatory: Kenntnisse der medizinischen Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA und anderen relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften werden bevorzugt

• Dauer der Erfahrung: 2 oder mehr Jahre postgraduale akademische oder klinische Erfahrung

• Bis zu 30% globale Reisen

Schlüsselkompetenzen und -verhalten

• Ethik: Hat eine tadellose Ethik. Nachweis oder Nachweisfähigkeit von Roche Values

• Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail: Hervorragende Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail

• Business Acumen: Hat Kenntnisse in der Pharma- / Biotech-Industrie, den verschiedenen Funktionen und Rollen, die an der Arzneimittelentwicklung beteiligt sind. Führt regelmäßig die Entwicklung von Krankheitsstrategien und -plänen

• Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele rechtzeitig, zielgenau und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren

• Zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten: Gute zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten: kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen

• Schreiben: Starke schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Gute Geschäftspräsentationsfähigkeiten; ist komfortabel und effektiv, wenn sie sich intern oder extern anderen präsentieren. Selbstsicher und kompetent, wenn man intern und extern mit anderen interagiert: bleibt konzentriert und punktgenau, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen produktiv und reif zu stellen

• Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: Gute Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: weiß, wie man Ergebnisse durch effektive interne und externe Zusammenarbeit mit anderen erledigt

• Entscheidungsfindung: Wissen, wie man Kompromissentscheidungen trifft, während man Ethik und Wirksamkeit in Einklang bringt

• Teamwork: Starke Orientierung an Teamwork

BESONDERE ZÖLLE UND ZUSTÄNDIGKEITEN:
CDP Strategie und Planung

• Beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugeordnete Moleküle/Indikationen

• Sammelt und analysiert Daten und Informationen, die für die Erstellung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind

• Arbeitet mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Subteams zusammen, um CD-Plankomponenten zu entwickeln (z. B. Analyse- / Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)

• Arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Input für Budget- / Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die für die Implementierung und Ausführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind

• Bleibt auf dem Laufenden über interne und externe Entwicklungen, Trends und andere Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit der CD relevant sind, um jederzeit eine vollständig aktuelle Ansicht und Perspektive der internen / externen Einflüsse und / oder Implikationen für die zugewiesenen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereiche zu erhalten

• Gegebenenfalls nimmt er an wettbewerbsrelevanten Informationen und/oder anderen Markt-/Industriebewertungsaktivitäten und -projekten teil.

• Bewahrt die höchsten Standards und Niveaus der wissenschaftlichen und klinischen Kenntnisse in den spezifischen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereichen der Zuordnung auf

• Arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl von internen und externen Partnern und Stakeholdern zusammen, wie klinischen Prüfern, Klinikern, Wissenschaftlern und wichtigen Meinungsführern (KOLs) sowie multidisziplinären internen Gruppen, einschließlich anderer Gruppen in den Bereichen PD, Forschung, Geschäftsentwicklung und kommerzieller Forschung.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
EXPÉRIENCE ET QUALIFICATIONS :

• Études/sciences/cliniques :
• M.D. Requis

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

CDP Strategy and Planning

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICHE:

• Conoscenze terapeutiche nel metabolismo, obesità e diabete con esperienza clinica, scientifica e clinica/sviluppo richiesta

• Il background accademico/didattico è un plus

• Esperienza lavorando con i principi e le tecniche di analisi dei dati, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica

• Si preferisce l'esperienza nell'editoria dei risultati di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed

• Regolazione: Conoscenza degli aspetti medici del GCP (Buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei prodotti farmaceutici per uso umano), FDA, EMA, e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito

• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea

• Fino al 30% di viaggi globali

Capacità e benefici chiave

• Etica: ha etica impeccabile. Demostra, o capacità comprovata di dimostrare, Roche Valori

• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli

• Business Acumen: ha conoscenza del lavoro del settore farmaceutico / biotech, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga.

• Organizzazione: può dare priorità a molteplici compiti e obiettivi in tempo, in base all'obiettivo e entro il budget

• Capacità interpersonali: Buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e competenze influenzanti: può influenzare senza autorità

• Scrittura: Forte abilità di comunicazione scritta

• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente.Confidente e competente quando si interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane focalizzato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo

• Capacità di negoziazione: Buone capacità di negoziazione: sa come completare i risultati lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente

• Processo decisionale: sa prendere decisioni di compromesso, bilanciando etica ed efficacia

• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra

DAZI E RESPONSIBILITA' SPECIFICHE: Strategia e pianificazione del CDP

• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per le molecole assegnate (s)/indicazioni (s)

• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD

• Lavora con altri membri del CST e con le relative sub-team per sviluppare componenti di CD plan (ad esempio, strategia analitica/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)

• Lavora con CST e altri team pertinenti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di bilancio/risorse necessari per l'attuazione e l'esecuzione del piano CD

• Resta al passo con gli sviluppi interni ed esterni, le tendenze e altre dinamiche rilevanti per il lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva pienamente attuali di influenze interne/esterni e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e di malattia assegnata (s)

• Se del caso, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione di mercato/industria e/o di intelligence competitiva

• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenze scientifiche e cliniche nell'area terapeutica e di malattia specifica (s) di assegnazione

• Il gruppo ha avuto una serie di partner interni ed esterni e di parti interessate, quali ricercatori clinici, medici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), nonché gruppi interni multidisciplinari, compresi altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo commerciale, ope commerciale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Sales Account Manager you will be responsible for achieving regional sales targets for our Near Patient Care (NPC) Roche Diagnostics portfolio. You will manage the full customer lifecycle, from prospecting new clients to maintaining relationships with existing ones through proactive communication.
Key responsibilities include providing demand-driven sales and after-sales support, conducting customer training, and installing NPC products, all while ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. You will also monitor market trends and competitor activity.
Our NPC covers healthcare customers such as physicians (General practitioners, ambulatory specialists - diabetologists, internal medicine doctors, cardiologists, pneumologists) and hospitals. The NPC portfolio consists of various POCT devices, professional/hospital and patient blood glucose meters and CGM.

Preferred location: Southern Moravia, e.g. Brno / Olomouc
Readiness to active business trips is required
Employment contract: initially fixed-term 2 years with a possibility to extend, contract with a vendor of service of Roche

The Opportunity

Customer Relationship & Sales Management:

• Proactively engage customers to identify needs, suggest solutions, and resolve issues, ensuring high satisfaction through exceptional after-sales support

• Drive sales growth by negotiating new business, promoting and installing products (instruments, reagents), and expanding the customer portfolio

• Manage the full sales process, including preparing, presenting, and negotiating quotations using designated tools and processes.

Portfolio Promotion & Training:

• Promote NPC portfolio by conducting customer training seminars and representing the company at key conferences

Market Intelligence & Personal Development:

• Monitor and report on regional competitor behavior and market trends

• Proactively engage in continuous self-learning to maintain expert knowledge of relevant publications and industry information

Compliance & Collaboration:

• Ensure strict compliance with all Complaint Management procedures, including accurate and timely reporting in our CRM and other global systems

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues within the NPC team and other departments to achieve shared goals

Who You Are

• Secondary education as a minimum, Natural or Health Sciences field preferred

• Proven customer-facing within commercial functional area experience (1+ years of experience as a minimum)

• Sales experience in the healthcare field of medical devices or In-vitro diagnostics is desired

• Czech language fluent and English at intermediate level

• Demonstrated communication skills to be able to present complex topics in concise and clear manner

• Negotiation and influencing skills with solution-orientated mindset

• Able to handle conflicting priorities with value-generating outlook

• PC Skills (experience working in Google Workplace, MS Office)

• Team player mindset to challenge colleagues but also support them grow in line with achieving common goals

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Gestión global de proyectos relacionados con la instalación, soporte y mantenimiento del software de gestión integral del Tratamiento Anticoagulante Oral (y otros productos POC). El dispositivo informático facilita la gestión integral descentralizada de los pacientes en tratamiento anticoagulante oral, gracias a una aplicación web ágil y flexible (y otros productos POC como CGM y NaPOC Operations. Asimismo facilita la integración de la información con otros sistemas del Área Sanitaria gracias al uso de estándares de comunicación.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de instalaciones y actualizaciones.

• Formación al cliente final.

• Apoyo al cliente en incidencias, dudas, nuevos proyectos, etc.

• Gestión Documental de los proyectos e instalaciones

• Gestión de las conexiones de instrumentos.

• Soporte a la red de ventas

Perfil requerido:

• Ingeniería Técnica o superior de Informática de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones

• Inglés Nivel Medio

• Conocimientos mínimo técnicos de BBDD

• Conocimientos de sistemas Windows y Linux

• Persona comunicativa

• Disponibilidad para viajar (esporádicamente)

Perfil Deseado:

• Conocimientos técnicos de BBDD (SQL, MysQL y Oracle)

• Conocimientos mensajería HL7 y Motor integración Mirth

• Conocimientos de herramientas de ticketing

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: R&D Business Tools Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.
We are seeking a R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist to join our global support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how —understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools , enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, change requests) for high-accuracy execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

• Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• System Proficiency: Ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

•
• Prior experience in enterprise business applications is desirable (e.g., Electronic Document Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, or Project Management tools).

• Education a

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

• Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• System Proficiency: Ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

• Prior experience in enterprise business applications is desirable (e.g., Electronic Document Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, or Project Management tools).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Software Developer (C#) for a hybrid engineering (75%) and Scrum Master (25%) role in Spain. You will take ownership of the full software development lifecycle - leveraging your deep expertise in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 to build high-performance applications - while also guiding the development team through Agile principles as a servant leader.
If you thrive on navigating ambiguity, utilizing modern AI-supporting tools, and are passionate about both exceptional code quality and team empowerment, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting technical impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering & Development (75%)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Participate fully in all phases of software development, including feasibility studies, design, development, testing, bug fixing, and ongoing software maintenance.

• Design & Implementation: Produce unit and subsystem specifications based on software requirements, project architecture, and guidelines. Accurately design and implement code, including the necessary tests to verify functionality against specifications.

• Team Collaboration & Planning: Self-organizing and proactive in defining, estimating, planning, and implementing work packages within the development team. Provide timely work status updates and issue notifications to the team and project management.

• Quality Assurance & Review: Conduct thorough reviews and analysis of personal source code and, upon request, the source code of peers. Review application design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive enhancements.

• Ambiguity Management: Possess the ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain forward progress.

• Role Type: Function as a Fullstack Developer.

Scrum Master Responsibilities (25%)

• Act as a servant leader for the development team, applying Scrum principles to facilitate progress, resolve conflicts, and increase transparency.

• Empower the team by removing blockers and applying proven Agile techniques to drive continuous improvement.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who excels at navigating ambiguity and taking end-to-end ownership of technical problems. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about data-heavy infrastructure, and thrive when facilitating team progress and empowering others to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

Education and General Experience

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Chi siamo a Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare prima, sviluppare più velocemente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. In ambito Computational Science & Informatica (CSI), siamo il ponte tra la nostra origine e il nostro futuro, plasmando la prossima era della salute umana attraverso una diagnostica precisa e basata sui dati e la medicina di precisione.

Eccellente nel fornire analisi rigorose e clinicamente attuabili dei dati attraverso il nostro portafoglio di diagnostica, credendo che l'avanzamento dei metodi computazionali e delle soluzioni informatiche è essenziale per sfruttare i dati dinamici sulla salute umana. Ascoltando attentamente i pazienti e i medici, e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le tecnologie all'avanguardia, lavoriamo collaborativamente per trasformare le informazioni in impatto.

Questo spirito condiviso crea un ambiente dove le idee crescono, si sperimentano nuovi approcci e i prodotti competitivi raggiungono i pazienti più velocemente.Sostentatamente realizzando la visione DIA di 10 anni e le nostre ambizioni One Roche in modo che tutti possano accedere a soluzioni sanitarie personalizzate.

L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un Senior Software Developer (C#) per un ruolo di ingegneria ibrida (75%) e Scrum Master (25%) in Spagna. Prenderai la proprietà del ciclo completo di sviluppo del software - sfruttando la tua profonda esperienza in C#, WPF e.NET 8.0 per costruire applicazioni ad alte prestazioni - guidando anche il team di sviluppo attraverso i principi Agile come leader servo.

Se si prospera sulla navigazione ambiguità, utilizzando moderni strumenti di supporto AI, e sono appassionati sia di qualità eccezionale codice e di empowerment team, questa è l'occasione perfetta per fare un impatto tecnico duraturo.

Responsabilità chiave:

Ingegneria e sviluppo (75%)

• Sviluppo software Ciclo di vita: Partecipare pienamente a tutte le fasi di sviluppo del software, compresi studi di fattibilità, progettazione, sviluppo, testing, bug fixing e manutenzione software in corso.

• Progettazione e attuazione: Produrre specifiche di unità e sottosistema basate su requisiti software, architettura di progetto e linee guida. Progettare e implementare correttamente il codice, compresi i test necessari per verificare la funzionalità rispetto alle specifiche.

• Team di sviluppo: auto-organizzazione e proattiva nella definizione, stima, pianificazione e attuazione di pacchetti di lavoro all'interno del team di sviluppo. Fornire aggiornamenti tempestivi sullo stato del lavoro e dare notifiche al team e alla gestione dei progetti.

• Garanzia di qualità e revisione: effettuare revisioni approfondite e analisi del codice sorgente personale e, su richiesta, del codice sorgente dei pari.

• Ambiguity Management: presenta la capacità di navigare nell'ambiguità e di mantenere il progresso in avanti.

• Tipo di ruolo: Funzione come sviluppatore Fullstack.

Responsabilità del comandante dello scrum (25%)

• Agire come capo serve per il team di sviluppo, applicando i principi Scrum per facilitare il progresso, risolvere i conflitti e aumentare la trasparenza.

• Potenziare il team rimuovendo i bloccanti e applicando tecniche Agile collaudate per guidare il miglioramento continuo.

Chi sei Sei un ingegnere software proattivo e collaborativo che eccelle nella navigazione ambiguità e nella gestione end-to-end dei problemi tecnici. Hai una forte mentalità analitica, sei appassionato di infrastruttura pesante per i dati e prospera quando facilita il progresso del team e dà il potere agli altri di avere successo.

Qualificazioni e competenze:

Istruzione ed esperienza generale

• Formazione: Laurea in Informatica, IT,

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position

Wer wir sind Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: Früher zu diagnostizieren, schneller zu entwickeln und die Behandlung zu personalisieren, weil jeder Patient einzigartig ist. In Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) sind wir die Brücke zwischen unserem Ursprung und unserer Zukunft und gestalten die nächste Ära der menschlichen Gesundheit durch präzise, datengesteuerte Diagnostik und Präzisionsmedizin.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass eine strenge, klinisch umsetzbare Datenanalyse in unserem Diagnoseportfolio von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Nutzung dynamischer Gesundheitsdaten ist. Durch das aufmerksame Zuhören von Patienten und Ärzten sowie die Nutzung von Digitalisierung und Spitzentechnologien arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, Erkenntnisse in Wirkung zu bringen.

Dieser gemeinsame Geist schafft ein Umfeld, in dem Ideen wachsen, neue Ansätze erprobt werden und wettbewerbsfähige Produkte Patienten schneller erreichen – und die Vision von DIA 10 Jahre und unsere Ambitionen von One Roche, damit jeder auf personalisierte Gesundheitslösungen zugreifen kann.

Die Chance Wir suchen einen Senior Software Developer (C#) für eine hybride Engineering- (75 %) und Scrum Master (25 %) Rolle in Spanien. Sie übernehmen den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Softwareentwicklung - mit Ihrer tiefen Expertise in C#, WPF und.NET 8.0, um leistungsstarke Anwendungen zu erstellen - und führen das Entwicklungsteam durch Agile-Prinzipien als Dienerführer.

Wenn Sie auf der Navigation von Mehrdeutigkeit gedeihen, mit modernen KI-Unterstützungs-Tools, und sind leidenschaftlich sowohl für außergewöhnliche Code-Qualität und Team-Empowerment, Dies ist die perfekte Gelegenheit, um eine dauerhafte technische Wirkung zu machen.

Wichtige Aufgaben:

Ingenieurwesen und Entwicklung (75 %)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Nehmen Sie voll in allen Phasen der Software-Entwicklung, einschließlich Machbarkeitsstudien, Design, Entwicklung, Testen, Fehlerbehebung und laufende Software-Wartung.

• Design & Implementierung: Spezifikationen für die Einheit und das Teilsystem von Gas, basierend auf Softwareanforderungen, Projektarchitektur und Richtlinien. Genaue Gestaltung und Implementierung von Code, einschließlich der erforderlichen Tests, um die Funktionalität mit Spezifikationen zu überprüfen.

• Team Collaboration & Planning: Selbstorganisieren und proaktiv bei der Definition, Estimierung, Planung und Umsetzung von Arbeitspaketen innerhalb des Entwicklungsteams. Bereitstellung von zeitnahen Arbeitsstatus-Updates und Benachrichtigungen an das Team und Projektmanagement.

• Qualitätssicherung & Überprüfung: Durchführung gründlicher Überprüfungen und Analyse des persönlichen Quellcodes und, auf Anfrage, des Quellcodes von Peers. Überprüfung Anwendungsdesign, Funktionalität, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Leistung, um Verbesserungen zu treiben.

• Ambiguity Management: Besteht in der Fähigkeit, die Mehrdeutigkeit zu navigieren und Fortschritt zu sichern.

• Rollentyp: Funktion als Fullstack-Entwickler.

Scrum Master Responsibilities (25%)

• Als Dienerführer für das Entwicklungsteam handeln, Scrum-Prinzipien anwenden, um Fortschritt zu erleichtern, Konflikte zu lösen und die Transparenz zu erhöhen.

• Ermächtigen Sie das Team durch Entfernen von Blockern und Anwendung bewährter Agile-Techniken, um kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu treiben.

Wer Sie sind Sie sind ein proaktiver, kollaborativer Software-Ingenieur, der sich über die Navigation von Mehrdeutigkeit und die Übernahme von End-to-End-Eigenschaft von technischen Problemen hinaus auszeichnet. Sie besitzen eine starke analytische Denkweise, sind leidenschaftlich für datenlastige Infrastruktur und gedeihen, wenn es um den Teamfortschritt und die Ermächtigung anderer zum Erfolg geht.

Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten:

Bildung und allgemeine Erfahrungen

• Ausbildung: Bachelor, s Studium Informatik, IT,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

La position

Qui sommes-nous?Les solutions de diagnostic Roche (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Au sein de la science informatique et informatique (CSI), nous sommes le pont entre notre origine et notre avenir, façonnant la prochaine ère de la santé humaine par des diagnostics précis et fondés sur des données et la médecine de précision.

Nous sommes excellents dans la prestation d'analyses de données rigoureuses et cliniquement réalisables dans notre portefeuille de diagnostics, croyant que faire progresser les méthodes de calcul et les solutions informatiques est essentiel pour exploiter des données dynamiques sur la santé humaine.

Cet esprit partagé crée un environnement où les idées grandissent, de nouvelles approches sont testées et des produits compétitifs atteignent les patients plus rapidement – réalisant finalement la vision décennale de DIA et nos ambitions One Roche pour que chacun puisse accéder à des solutions de santé personnalisées.

L'Opportunity Nous recherchons un développeur de logiciels senior (C#) pour un rôle d'ingénierie hybride (75%) et de Scrum Master (25%). Vous vous approprierez le cycle de vie complet du développement logiciel - en tirant parti de votre expertise profonde en C#, WPF et.NET 8.0 pour construire des applications hautes performances - tout en guidant l'équipe de développement à travers les principes Agile comme leader de service.

Si vous vous développez sur la navigation ambiguë, en utilisant des outils modernes de soutien de l'IA, et êtes passionnés par la qualité exceptionnelle du code et l'autonomisation de l'équipe, c'est l'occasion parfaite pour faire un impact technique durable.

Principales responsabilités :

Ingénierie et développement (75 %)

• Cycle de vie du développement logiciel : Participer pleinement à toutes les phases du développement logiciel, y compris les études de faisabilité, la conception, le développement, les essais, la correction des bogues et la maintenance continue des logiciels.

• Conception et mise en œuvre: produire des spécifications d'unité et de sous-système basées sur les exigences logicielles, l'architecture de projet et les lignes directrices.

• Collaboration et planification des équipes : auto-organisation et proactivité dans la définition, l'estimation, la planification et la mise en oeuvre des modules de travail au sein de l'équipe de développement.

• Assurance de la qualité et examen : procéder à des examens et à une analyse approfondis du code source personnel et, sur demande, du code source des pairs.

• Gestion de l'ambiguïté : Capacité de naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et de maintenir les progrès en avant.

• Type de rôle: Fonction comme développeur Fullstack.

Responsabilités principales de Scrum (25 %)

• Agir en tant que chef de service pour l'équipe de développement, en appliquant les principes de Scrum pour faciliter les progrès, résoudre les conflits et accroître la transparence.

• Empower l'équipe en supprimant les bloqueurs et en appliquant des techniques Agiles éprouvées pour conduire à l'amélioration continue.

Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur logiciel proactif et collaboratif qui excelle dans la navigation d'ambiguïté et la prise en main de bout en bout des problèmes techniques.Vous possédez un fort état d'esprit analytique, êtes passionné par l'infrastructure de données-heavy, et prospèrent en facilitant le progrès d'équipe et en donnant aux autres la possibilité de réussir.

Qualifications et compétences :

Éducation et expérience générale

• Éducation: baccalauréat, diplôme en informatique, informatique,

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a visionary Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer to shape the future of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this hybrid leadership role, you will be the driving force behind the user interfaces and complex dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

Operating at the intersection of UX design and high-performance frontend engineering, you will translate complex bioinformatics, PCR, and sequencing data into intuitive, lightning-fast web applications. If you are passionate about building scalable UI architectures and graphing millions of data points to drive scientific innovation, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture:

• Act as the bridge between UX, Frontend, and Backend teams, driving architecture and design discussions to establish robust technical solutions and API designs (REST/GraphQL).

• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.

• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning.

UX Engineering & System Design:

• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.

• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements.

Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:

• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.

• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.

• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements.

Who You Are
You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.

• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur principal de la méthodologie statistique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is in the Statistical Methodology group, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that strives to enable the most impactful use of quantitative methodology at Roche through internal collaboration, external outreach, and continuous capability building.

The Opportunity
The Statistical Methodology group is a core function within Product Development Data Sciences, enabling the impactful use of quantitative methodology across Roche through internal collaboration, external outreach and continuous capability building.
As a Senior Statistical Methodology Data Scientist, you will play a strategic role in advancing the adoption of fit-for-purpose statistical methodologies that strengthen scientific rigor, evidence generation and decision-making across clinical development programs and portfolios. Acting as a methodological thought partner, you will collaborate with study teams, biostatisticians and cross-functional stakeholders to identify needs, prototype solutions and support scalable adoption through training, templates, frameworks and tools.

In this role, you will:

• Provide expert methodological guidance to study teams on complex study design, analysis strategies and quantitative decision-making across programs.

• Lead the development and implementation of innovative statistical approaches, such as estimand frameworks, trial simulations, covariate adjustment strategies, model-based projections and quantitative go/no-go frameworks.

• Translate methodological insights into scalable solutions, including templates, training, open-source tools and best practices that strengthen analytical excellence across the organization.

• Support portfolio-level analyses, scenario modeling and quantitative frameworks that inform clinical strategy, optimize development decisions and enable evidence-based prioritization.

• Represent Roche externally through scientific collaborations, consortia, working groups, publications or regulatory-facing initiatives, helping the organization stay at the forefront of methodological advances.

Who You Are

• You hold a PhD, in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science or another related quantitative discipline.

• You have 2+ years of experience designing and applying advanced statistical or data science methods to complex biomedical data, ideally in clinical trial research or pharmaceutical development.

• You bring strong expertise in statistical computing, advanced modeling and the development of novel or fit-for-purpose analytical solutions for complex datasets.

• You are recognized as a technical expert and trusted thought partner, with the ability to translate complex methodology into clear recommendations for scientific, clinical and cross-functional stakeholders.

• You have experience contributing to internal standards, capability building, training or strategic initiatives, and you enjoy mentoring others to strengthen methodological understanding and adoption.

• You bring a collaborative and inclusive mindset, show respect for cultural differences in a global environment, and ideally have a track record of publications, presentations or thought leadership in emerging areas such as AI/ML, real-world data integration or predictive biomarkers.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo è nel gruppo di Metodologia statistica, una funzione di base all'interno di Scienze dei dati di sviluppo del prodotto (PDD) che si sforza di consentire l'uso più efficace della metodologia quantitativa a Roche attraverso la collaborazione interna, la outreach esterna e la costruzione di capacità continua. L'opportunità Il gruppo di Metodologia statistica è una funzione fondamentale all'interno delle Scienze dei dati di sviluppo del prodotto, consentendo l'uso efficace della metodologia quantitativa attraverso la collaborazione interna, l'accesso esterno e la costruzione di capacità continua. In qualità di Senior Statistics Methodology Data Scientist, si svolgerà un ruolo strategico nel promuovere l'adozione di metodologie statistiche fit-for-purpose che rafforzano il rigore scientifico, la generazione di prove e il processo decisionale attraverso programmi e portafogli di sviluppo clinico. Agendo come partner di pensiero metodologico, collaborerai con team di studio, biostatisti e stakeholder interfunzionali per identificare esigenze, soluzioni prototipi e supportare l'adozione scalabile attraverso formazione, modelli, framework e strumenti. • Fornire una guida metodologica esperta per studiare i team sulla progettazione di studi complessi, le strategie di analisi e il processo decisionale quantitativo attraverso i programmi.
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di approcci statistici innovativi, quali i quadri estimand, le simulazioni di prova, le strategie di aggiustamento covariato, le proiezioni basate sui modelli e i quadri di go/no-go quantitativi.
• Tradurre approfondimenti metodologici in soluzioni scalabili, tra cui modelli, strumenti di formazione, open source e best practice che rafforzano l'eccellenza analitica in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Rappresentare Roche esternamente attraverso collaborazioni scientifiche, consorzi, gruppi di lavoro, pubblicazioni o iniziative regolamentari, aiutando l'organizzazione a rimanere in prima linea di progressi metodologici. Chi sei
• Lei possiede un PhD, in Statistica, Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica o un'altra disciplina quantitativa relativa.
• Hai 2 anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nell'applicazione di metodi avanzati di statistica o di scienza dei dati a dati biomedici complessi, idealmente nella ricerca clinica o nello sviluppo farmaceutico.
• Portate una forte esperienza nel calcolo statistico, nella modellazione avanzata e nello sviluppo di soluzioni analitiche innovative o fit-for-purpose per set di dati complessi.
• Sei riconosciuto come esperto tecnico e partner di pensiero di fiducia, con la capacità di tradurre una metodologia complessa in chiare raccomandazioni per gli stakeholder scientifici, clinici e interfunzionali.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ce rôle fait partie du groupe de la méthodologie statistique, une fonction essentielle au sein des Sciences des données de développement de produits (DDP) qui s'efforce de permettre l'utilisation la plus efficace de la méthodologie quantitative à Roche par la collaboration interne, la sensibilisation externe et le renforcement continu des capacités. L'opportunité Le groupe de la méthodologie statistique est une fonction essentielle au sein des Sciences des données de développement de produits, permettant l'utilisation efficace de la méthodologie quantitative à Roche par la collaboration interne, la sensibilisation externe et le renforcement continu des capacités. En tant que chercheur principal en données de méthodologie statistique, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique dans l'adoption de méthodes statistiques adaptées à l'usage qui renforcent la rigueur scientifique, la production de données probantes et la prise de décisions dans tous les programmes et portefeuilles de développement clinique. En tant que partenaire de réflexion méthodologique, vous collaborerez avec les équipes d'étude, les biostatisticiens et les intervenants interfonctionnels pour identifier les besoins, les solutions prototypes et soutenir l'adoption évolutive par la formation, les modèles, les cadres et les outils. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Fournir des conseils méthodologiques spécialisés aux équipes d'étude sur la conception d'études complexes, les stratégies d'analyse et la prise de décisions quantitatives dans l'ensemble des programmes.
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre d'approches statistiques novatrices, telles que les cadres d'estimation, les simulations d'essai, les stratégies d'ajustement covariables, les projections fondées sur des modèles et les cadres quantitatifs aller/aller.
• Traduire les idées méthodologiques en solutions évolutives, y compris les modèles, la formation, les outils libres et les meilleures pratiques qui renforcent l'excellence analytique dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Appuyer les analyses de portefeuille, la modélisation de scénarios et les cadres quantitatifs qui éclairent la stratégie clinique, optimisent les décisions de développement et permettent l'établissement de priorités fondées sur des données probantes.
• Représenter Roche à l'extérieur par des collaborations scientifiques, des consortiums, des groupes de travail, des publications ou des initiatives axées sur la réglementation, aidant l'organisation à rester à l'avant-garde des avancées méthodologiques. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en statistique, informatique, informatique ou autre discipline quantitative connexe.
• Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans la conception et l'application de méthodes avancées de statistique ou de science des données à des données biomédicales complexes, idéalement dans la recherche clinique ou le développement pharmaceutique.
• Vous apportez une forte expertise dans le calcul statistique, la modélisation avancée et le développement de solutions d'analyse innovantes ou adaptées pour des ensembles de données complexes.
• Vous êtes reconnu comme un expert technique et un partenaire de pensée de confiance, avec la capacité de traduire la méthodologie complexe en recommandations claires pour les acteurs scientifiques, cliniques et interfonctionnels.
• Vous avez de l'expérience en matière de normes internes, de renforcement des capacités, de formation ou d'initiatives stratégiques, et vous aimez encadrer d'autres personnes pour renforcer la compréhension méthodologique et l'adoption.
• Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif et inclusif, montrez le respect des différences culturelles dans un environnement mondial, et idéalement avoir un bilan de publications, de présentations ou de leadership de pensée dans des domaines émergents tels que l'IA/ML, l'intégration de données dans le monde réel ou les biomarqueurs prédictifs. Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

岗位职责：
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Islamabad
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love
Your Opportunity ​

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products)

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• Responsible to report incident/accident immediately to SHE department. Attend / complete all requisite on-line and F2F trainings (Role specific, Safety Responsibility and Compliance) within specified time limit to ensure the learning outcome after the training has been implemented.

• Responsible to own the SHE goals as individual goals and play his/her part to achieve the goal in line with strategies/action plan.

• Identifies, collects and immediately reports all safety related information on Roche products to Local

• Safety Responsible as per Roche requirements and local regulations.

• Responsible for maintenance of records (electronic and physical as per the Local Core Map policy.

• Any other duties that maybe assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Who you are
EDUCATION

• Science degree ( Pharm D / Dentistry will be an added advantage)

• Business Degree is a plus

EXPERIENCE & KNOWLEDGE

• Minimum 3 years of relevant therapeutic area experience

• Consistent track record of achieving objectives, collaboration and team work

• Experience in agile ways of working is a plus

• Cross functional experience

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience

• excellence.

• Growth mindset

• Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling

• engagement at the specialist level.

• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on

• future-based solutions.

• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders.

Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. We strive for excellence and extraordinary results and take a genuine interest in our people and their well-being, and our patients.

Take pride in knowing you can make a difference to millions of patients worldwide in developing diagnostics and treatments for oncology, neuroscience, inflammation, immunology, ophthalmology, rare disease

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer/Scrum Master C#
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this unique role, you will combine high-impact hands-on engineering with servant leadership to guide your development team toward continuous improvement. You will join a highly collaborative team environment where you will drive the full software development lifecycle while championing Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, from feasibility studies and application design to testing, bug fixing, and software maintenance.

• Design, implement, and test high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Act as a Scrum Master and servant leader for the development team, facilitating progress, resolving blockers, and increasing workplace transparency.

• Empower the team by applying proven Agile techniques, fostering conflict resolution, situational awareness, and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate proactively within self-organizing teams to define, estimate, and plan high-impact work packages.

• Leverage modern AI-supporting tools throughout the entire development lifecycle to optimize coding, testing, and troubleshooting workflows.

• Review application designs, functionality, and source code to champion technical excellence and drive ongoing enhancements.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative technical professional who excels at navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are deeply passionate about exceptional code quality, and thrive when empowering cross-functional teams to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a strong background in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator for a software development team diligently applying Scrum practices and theory.

• Certification in Scrum methodologies (such as CSM or PSM I) alongside deep knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, and team empowerment techniques.

• Solid experience with SQL Server, including database design and utilizing ORMs like Entity Framework.

• Practical understanding of modern development ecosystems, including Git/GitHub version control and setting up basic build environments.

• Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural ability to connect teams and resolve conflicts.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

At Ro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this foundational role, you will act as our premier Rust expert, spearheading the strategic migration of our core execution engines, algorithms, and high-performance systems from C# to Rust. You will join a forward-thinking and collaborative environment where your technical vision shapes the future of our engineering stack.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the strategic migration of legacy C# (.NET) codebases, execution engines, and complex algorithms into highly optimized, safe, and concurrent Rust applications.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance software components throughout the full software development lifecycle.

• Define all aspects of development for the new stack, establishing rigorous coding standards, workflows, and appropriate build and CI/CD environments.

• Provide technical guidance, expertise, and coaching to developers, playing a central role in upskilling the team and building internal Rust expertise from the ground up.

• Monitor team progress to ensure consistency with the initial architectural design, technical vision, and quality standards.

• Ensure all software strictly complies with requirements for quality, security, modifiability, and extensibility while leveraging modern AI-supporting tools to optimize efficiency.

Who You Are
You are a visionary technical leader and a passionate educator who thrives when navigating ambiguity and driving technological evolution. You possess deep engineering intuition, love tackling complex architectural challenges, and excel at empowering others to adopt new modern paradigms.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production-grade Rust applications.

• Exceptional, production-level proficiency in Rust, including a deep mastery of its memory safety guarantees, lifetimes, async runtimes (such as Tokio), concurrency models, and standard tooling (Cargo, Clippy).

• Strong foundational knowledge of C# and .NET architectures to effectively understand, reverse-engineer, and transition existing codebases.

• Demonstrated architectural skills with a proven ability to design complex, scalable software systems and define clear technical visions.

• Exceptional talent for coaching, mentoring, and providing high-level technical guidance to engineering teams while navigating ambiguity with a forward-progress mindset.

• Excellent interpersonal and English
