jobs.title: Study Start Up Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose, Objectives and Scope of Position
As a member of the PDG Country Study Start Up Team, your primary focus is to drive and facilitate efficient study start-up processes to contribute to the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You will enable innovative clinical trial delivery, address study start up needs across various therapeutic areas, and ensure seamless trial execution for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff. Collaboration with local country teams, global study teams, and CROs is essential to this role.

Key
• Responsibilities
This role focuses on the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials by executing effective start-up strategies while maintaining regulatory compliance. Additionally, this role involves managing amendments throughout the study lifecycle. You will bring subject matter expertise and may work cross functionally in the following areas below:

Study Start Up Strategy & Execution:
Support and execute study start-up strategies for faster site activations, collaborating with internal and external teams, CROs, and sites. Help identify issues, follow regulations/SOPs, and assist with Health Authority/Ethics Committee communication. Track submissions in relevant systems and stay updated on regulatory requirements.

Informed Consent Form (ICF) Management:
Assist in preparing/adapting ICFs, supporting IRB/EC/HA submissions and changes, and archiving approvals.

Clinical Trial Submissions & Regulatory Coordination:
Prepare and manage submission packages for regulatory bodies and health authorities. Assist in responding to RFIs and ensure timely document submission to the TMF. Support study amendments and notifications.

Site Documentation & Compliance:
Collect and verify site documents (CVs, etc.). Assist with translations, patient materials, and biobank details. Learn local document needs and timelines. Support local vendors (excluding CROs) if needed.

Budgeting & Contract Management:
Provide assistance with contract negotiations & execution (confidentiality, indemnity, amendments). Collaborate with internal/external partners on financial/legal compliance. Help update contract system data for planning.

Payment Oversight:
Assist in overseeing site payments, escalations, and reporting via shared service centers and in compliance with site contracts. Help ensure financial/regulatory compliance for local operations. Participate in accrual/purchase order planning and reconciliation.

Qualifications
● Degree (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in life sciences or equivalent. Postgraduate degree or master’s degree highly desirable

Skills and Competencies
● Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
● Fluency in written and spoken language(s) of the host country is mandatory.

IMPACT LEVELS
Acquires basic knowledge to assist with study start-up in clinical trials and drug development, including learning about the clinical trial industry and how trials work. Completes tasks following standard procedures and guidance.
Gains practical skills in clinical trial study start-up by assisting with the execution of country clinical trial start-up activities.
Assists with process improvements and changes by completing assigned tasks. Offers basic input based on observations.
Follows directions for clinical trial study start-up projects. Can organize simple tasks.
Works with other groups within PDG to complete assigned tasks in delivering projects.
Learns about and follows ICH, GCP, and regulatory guidelines for cli

titleByLocale.en: HR Intern - Early in Career Intern (APAC)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As an intern on the global Early in Career (EiC) team, you will have the opportunity to participate in challenging and impactful business-critical projects. You will be a key member of the Integrated Workforce Strategy (IWS) organization of the Human Resources Department at Roche which encompasses many critical areas of talent attraction, talent pipelining and recruitment. The EiC team is key to executing on the company’s investment in early talent (internships, rotational programs and other entry-level opportunities) for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

The intern will be based in Selangor, Malaysia and support the APAC EiC Partner and Specialist in the daily creation of unparalleled EiC experiences that foster development, networking, and community for interns at Roche and its affiliates.

• Help EiC Partner and Specialist in daily operations and execution of various strategies across the region and/or globe

• Develop university mapping across the region to share Roche opportunities with students

• Maintain the Job Portal Account in Universities across the region

• Support in the analysis of intern data and generating data insights

• Support online and offline university career fair and engagement event management, including event planning, logistic preparation and onsite support

• Research the EiC best practices in across the region and/or globe

Required qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master’s degree or related experience in HR management, organizational development, communications and or business/related field

• Student organization and/or leadership experience is preferred

• Experience in HR, Marketing or recruiting experience via coursework or previous internship is preferred

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Mandarin

• Demonstrated good communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills

• Knowledge of MS Office, Google Suite is a plus

• Available for the internship duration between 3 - 6 months

Program highlights:

• Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry

• Lead or participate to design and coordinate program events and initiatives for the EiC candidate experience

• Create new professional & personal development curriculum, including hosting networking opportunities, workshops, and panel discussions

• Participate in volunteer projects, social events, and team-building activities

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
Job Summary :
Responsible for RDSL Tax related operations including Head Office and Branch Offices, to ensure company tax compliance, mitigate company tax risk, and optimize tax savings.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

• Perform tax analysis, tax advice, planning and filing

• Communicate with tax authorities in different cities in China periodically and build up good relationship with tax authorities

• Review company internal process and transactions, take actions to control the tax risk

• Monitor TP fluctuations, document and defend TP positions, and manage the rationality of pricing adjustments with local authorities

• Answer Tax related inquiries and provide advice and solutions proactively

• Support company projects/global projects, self-initiate projects for process improvement

• Learn and distribute updated information on tax laws and regulations to finance team and related operation team (include proper training)

• Support Internal Audit / KPMG audit and ensure RDSL tax area meet Internal Audit/KPMG audit/ICFR requirement /KPMG

• Prepare & update Tax related SOP in time SOP Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager

• Conduct business in full compliance including but not limited to Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, Roche Safety, Security Health and Environmental Protection

Basic Requirements of the Job :

Education & Qualifications :

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

• Accountant certification, CPA/CTA is preferred

• Good computer knowledge: excel/word/PowerPoint

• Good command of English, both oral/written

• SAP experience is a plus

• Familiarity with automation and AI tools

• Open to cross functional projects and opportunities

Experience :

• At least 5 years’ accounting/auditing/tax related experience in multinational or accounting firms

• Familiar with IAS & PRC Accounting Standard /PRC Tax laws , regulations

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

titleByLocale.en: Lead IT Expert - RDT Data Platforms
titleByLocale.fr: Expert en TI - Plateformes de données RDT

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Lead IT Expert - RDT Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

The Lead IT Expert (Tech Lead) for DataOps will drive the technical direction of our custom platform engineering solutions. You will not be building standard data pipelines; instead, you will architect, maintain, and evolve DataOps.Roche—the critical CI/CD ecosystem, infrastructure, and deployment tooling that enables hundreds of data engineers to process data safely across our global organization.
This role requires deep expertise in Python, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and modern CI/CD ecosystems to lead massive architectural shifts, including migrating to an orchestrator-agnostic framework and transitioning from GitLab to GitHub. You will ensure the resilience of our platform while seamlessly integrating enterprise tools like Snowflake, Collibra, Monte Carlo, and HashiCorp Vault.

We are a platform team within RDT Data Platforms at Roche, operating under a decentralized Data Mesh architecture. Our core mission is to act as the foundational platform team, delivering the custom DataOps solution to various data product teams across the enterprise. We treat our internal tools, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as a product, empowering these decentralized teams to build, deploy, and scale their data products efficiently and securely within a highly regulated environment. We are currently expanding our mission to serve additional platforms beyond the initial scope, making this a pivotal time for the team.

The Opportunity

• Scope : Lead the technical roadmap for the DataOps.Roche platform. Drive the critical refactoring of our core solution from native GitLab CI structures into an orchestrator-agnostic Python framework. Establish a centralized data modeling service for the broader ecosystem.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Manage and maintain our complex Terraform-based infrastructure, which provisions GitLab/GitHub groups, projects, HashiCorp Vault engines, and dedicated runners. Ensure regulated releases are seamless by maintaining our automated validation processes and custom autovalidate package.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as a product owner for the platform. Liaise with decentralized data product teams to understand developer experience (DevEx) bottlenecks. Guide senior leadership on platform strategy, tooling evaluation, and infrastructure investments.

• Impact/Strategy: Lead high-impact strategic initiatives, including the complex migration from GitLab to GitHub and the evaluation/implementation of Dagster as our next-generation data orchestrator. Identify and integrate applied AI into the DataOps lifecycle to boost developer efficiency.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage an enterprise-grade platform integrating multiple major technologies: Snowflake (data platform), Collibra (data catalog), Monte Carlo (observability), HashiCorp Vault (secrets management), and Talend

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Manage and maintain our complex Terraform-based infrastructure, which provisions GitLab/GitHub groups, projects, HashiCorp Vault engines, and dedicated runners. Ensure regulated releases are seamless by maintaining our automated validation processes and custom autovalidate package.
• Stakeholder Management: Act as a product owner for the platform. Liaise with decentralized data product teams to understand developer experience (DevEx) bottlenecks. Guide senior leadership on platform strategy, tooling evaluation, and infrastructure investments.
• Impact/Strategy: Lead high-impact strategic initiatives, including the complex migration from GitLab to GitHub and the evaluation/implementation of Dagster as our next-generation data orchestrator. Identify and integrate applied AI into the DataOps lifecycle to boost developer efficiency.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage an enterprise-grade platform integrating multiple major technologies: Snowflake (data platform), Collibra (data catalog), Monte Carlo (observability), HashiCorp Vault (secrets management), and Talend

jobs.title: Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner, you will act as an expert in marketing, digital marketing, and strategy, while providing integrated systems thinking and leadership. Your responsibilities include developing, owning, and jointly implementing team outcomes with pod members, co-defining portfolio strategy, and leading or contributing to related work packages and initiatives.

In terms of Omnichannel capabilities, you are expected to serve as a powerful lever to deliver a seamless customer experience across face-to-face and digital channels, having demonstrated experience in creating and delivering Omnichannel campaigns that blend our “traditional” activities with digital touchpoints in an orchestrated way, with a focus on effective messaging, customer satisfaction, speed, and cost-effectiveness.

Although hired into a country affiliate, this role requires you to be part of an APAC collaboration, working across borders to realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross-border, cross-functional work package teams.

Roche expects all employees to hold high standards of compliance with both external and internal policies and regulations and actively participate in SHE initiatives within the Company.

Key Responsibilities

• Co-own and pursue outcomes alongside assigned, empowered self organized teams (such as pods and work package teams) in an agile work environment with a fluid resourcing model (i.e., assignment to one or more teams that can change over time, contribution to work packages on local and international level).

• Contribute expertise in digital marketing and product strategy development to create a cohesive customer experience across all touchpoints.

• Lead comprehensive marketing efforts, including market analysis and market research that informs both traditional and digital channels.

• Define and implement customer segmentation strategies that operate seamlessly across all channels.

• Manage campaigns that leverage both traditional and digital engagement methods for maximum reach.

• Collaborate with PPOCs (eg. PJPs) and relevant stakeholders to identify and analyze insights aligned to outcome defined by the Disease Area team, owning the space relating to EpicX and relevant qualitative & quantitative insights to optimize the overall customer experience.

• Establish KPIs that measure the effectiveness and performance of integrated campaigns across all platforms.

• Ensure all business activities within the ecosystem comply with relevant company SOPs, PHARMA Code of Conduct, iFPMA, Symphony (and of equivalence) and are of high ethical standard

• Work closely with subject matter experts for Access and other team members on outcomes and initiatives aiming to increase access for patients to our medicines and other healthcare solutions, including coordination and support of advocacy building as well as listing and funding initiatives.

• Any other duties that may be assigned from time as required by the business.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor degree (marketing, scientific, technical, digital, economic or business degree)

• Proven knowledge and skills in Marketing, including Digital Marketing (digital transformation, omni-channel marketing, content marketing, data analytics)

• In-depth knowledge of digital marketing channels, strategies, and best practices.

• Proficiency in utilizing digital marketing tools, analytics platforms, and content management systems.

• Significant experience in a comme

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.
Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Digital Compliance und Sicherheit: Du lernst, wie man IT-Systeme sicher managt und dabei die strengen regulatorischen Anforderungen der Pharmaindustrie rechtlich sicher umsetzt.

• Business Analytics mit Big Data: Du wertest große Datenmengen aus und entwickelst mathematische Modelle, um unsere Geschäftsprozesse datenbasiert zu optimieren.

• Innovation durch Schlüsseltechnologien: Du beschäftigst dich mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien wie KI, um neue digitale Geschäftsmodelle zu entwickeln und innovative Ansätze voranzutreiben.

• Strategisches Finance und Controlling: Du unterstützt die Unternehmensplanung durch präzise Analysen im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und lieferst so die Basis für wichtige Management-Entscheidungen.

• Marktforschung und Marketing: Du analysierst Entwicklungen auf dem Gesundheitsmarkt für unsere Marketingstrategien, um diese zu schärfen und Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten.

Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Pharma in Grenzach statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Lörrach abgehalten.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen : Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung : Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert Dein Duales Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung. Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global imp

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Stai cercando un programma di studio doppio diversificato e orientato al futuro? Allora reinventa insieme a noi il futuro dell’assistenza sanitaria.
In Roche sviluppiamo strumenti diagnostici e medicinali innovativi per consentire alle persone di vivere una vita migliore e più lunga. Entra a far parte di questa missione e dai un contributo cruciale ai pazienti di tutto il mondo fin dall'inizio.

Quali compiti ti aspettano?

- Conformità e sicurezza digitale: imparerai come gestire i sistemi IT in modo sicuro e implementare legalmente i severi requisiti normativi dell'industria farmaceutica.
- Analisi aziendale con big data: valuti grandi quantità di dati e sviluppi modelli matematici per ottimizzare i nostri processi aziendali basati sui dati.
- Innovazione attraverso tecnologie chiave: lavori con tecnologie orientate al futuro come l'intelligenza artificiale per sviluppare nuovi modelli di business digitali e promuovere approcci innovativi.
- Finanza strategica e controllo: supporti la pianificazione aziendale attraverso analisi precise in ambito finanziario e contabile, fornendo così la base per importanti decisioni gestionali.
- Ricerche di mercato e marketing: analizzi gli sviluppi nel mercato sanitario per le nostre strategie di marketing al fine di affinarle e rendere i processi più efficienti.

La tua formazione pratica si svolgerà presso Roche Pharma a Grenzach. Le lezioni si tengono presso l'Università statale cooperativa del Baden-Württemberg a Lörrach.

I tuoi vantaggi con noi:
- Puntiamo sul modello di formazione personalizzato: tu definisci attivamente i tuoi contenuti formativi in stretta collaborazione con i tuoi formatori.
- Questo è ciò che ti offriamo anche:
- Finanze: retribuzione interessante e bonus per ferie e Natale.
- Conciliazione vita-lavoro: 30 giorni di ferie, sport aziendali e assistenza sanitaria completa.
- Sviluppo: preparazione intensiva agli esami, qualificazione per l'ammissione all'istituto tecnico (facoltativo) e un'ampia gamma di formazione continua.
- Extra: Ambiente lavorativo internazionale, incarichi all'estero e pasti mensa scontati.

Quali requisiti devi soddisfare?
- Titolo generale di ammissione all'università
- Qualifica di ammissione all'università specifica per materia
- Titolo di ammissione all'università e prova del superamento del test attitudinale presso l'Università statale cooperativa del Baden-Württemberg

Quanto dura il tuo percorso di studio duale?
3 anni. Questo è preceduto da uno stage di un mese specifico per l'azienda

Candidati ora: carica un CV, una lettera di presentazione e le ultime due pagelle scolastiche come file PDF insieme alla tua domanda.

Importante: assicurati che la tua domanda sia completa. Nessun documento potrà essere caricato successivamente.

Aspettiamo con ansia la tua candidatura!

In caso di domande o problemi, contattare deutschland.recruiting_bildung@roche.com.

Il tuo contatto con noi! Con le persone. Per le persone.

Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto?

Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste

Êtes-vous à la recherche d’un programme d’études en alternance diversifié et tourné vers l’avenir ? Alors réinventez l’avenir des soins de santé avec nous.
Chez Roche, nous développons des diagnostics et des médicaments innovants pour permettre aux gens de vivre plus longtemps et mieux. Faites partie de cette mission et apportez dès le début une contribution cruciale aux patients du monde entier.

Quelles tâches vous attendent ?

- Etudes de marché et marketing : Vous analysez les évolutions du marché de la santé pour nos stratégies marketing afin de les affiner et de rendre les processus plus efficaces.

- Finances : Rémunération attractive ainsi que primes de vacances et de Noël.
- Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : 30 jours de vacances, sports d'entreprise et soins de santé complets.
- Développement : préparation intensive aux examens, diplôme d'entrée au collège technique (facultatif) et large gamme de formations continues.
- Extras : environnement de travail international, missions à l'étranger et repas à la cantine à prix réduit.

À quelles exigences devez-vous répondre ?
- Diplôme général d'entrée à l'université
- Diplôme d'entrée à l'université spécifique à une matière
- Diplôme d'entrée à l'université et preuve de réussite au test d'aptitude de l'Université coopérative d'État du Bade-Wurtemberg

Combien de temps dure votre cursus en alternance ?
3 ans. Ceci est précédé d'un stage d'un mois spécifique à l'entreprise

Postulez maintenant – téléchargez un CV, une lettre de motivation et vos deux derniers bulletins scolaires sous forme de fichier PDF avec votre candidature.

Important : Veuillez vous assurer que votre candidature est complète. Aucun document ne pourra être téléchargé ultérieurement.

Nous attendons votre candidature avec impatience !

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent au progrès de la science, garantissant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts ont permis de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et de réaliser plus de 30 milliards de tests à l'aide de nos produits de diagnostic. Nous nous donnons les moyens d'explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir proposer des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

jobs.title: Legal/Compliance Partner（社内弁護士）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
募集要項：社内弁護士（法務・コンプライアンス部門）

職務の目的と使命
ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社の「Doing now what patients need next」という企業理念のもと、法務・コンプライアンス部門の一員として会社の法的及びコンプイアンスリスクを適切に管理し、事業の発展に貢献する職種です。 私たちの組織は、チームワークで貢献することを大切にしています。単なる法律解釈にとどまらず、組織一丸となって、業務の仕組み化やAIの活用や法務DXの推進を含めた運用の改善にも積極的に関わっていただける方を募集します。

主な職務内容
法務業務とコンプライアンス（法令遵守・企業倫理）業務の双方において、幅広い領域をバランスよくお任せします。

• 法務相談・契約関連業務

• 各事業部門からの法務相談への対応、および事業推進における良き相談相手としての支援

• 契約書の作成、審査、交渉の支援（高度な専門領域、海外や特定の法域が関わる契約、紛争の危険がある案件などへの対応）

• 外部弁護士との連携および委託業務の管理

• コンプライアンス・組織基盤への貢献

• 法令遵守・企業倫理全般の推進、各種研修や監査実務の実施

• 内部通報（適切な通報対応）に関する調査の支援

• 「判断基準の共有書庫」の整備など、部内の仕組み化（法務運用の効率化）への参画

求める経験・能力

• 必須要件

• 日本の弁護士資格 をお持ちの方

• ネイティブレベルの日本語 ：複雑な法的文書の対応や、社内ステークホルダーとの調整を行えるレベル

• 仕事で使える水準の英語力（英語に対し高い学習意欲のある者でも可）

• 組織の一員としてお互いに「補い合い」、協調して業務を進められる高い協調性

• 法律知識だけでなく、組織への貢献や事業への深い理解を前向きに楽しめる姿勢

• 歓迎要件

• 弁護士としての実務経験 （3〜7年程度を想定していますが、意欲や潜在能力も考慮します）

• 業界経験者、未経験者共に歓迎です

求める人物像

• 組織として働くことに楽しみを感じる方

• チームワークを発揮することが好きな方

• 会社全体の変化を楽しみ、柔軟に適応・推進できる方

• 事業に寄り添い、会社の発展のために法律の観点から自発的に提案・貢献ができる方

Job Description: In-House Counsel (Legal & Compliance Department)
Purpose and Mission of the Role

Under Roche Diagnostics K.K.'s corporate philosophy of "Doing now what patients need next," this role contributes to business development by appropriately managing the company's legal and compliance risks as a member of the Legal & Compliance Department. Our organization values contributing through teamwork. We are seeking an individual who will not only interpret the law but also work as part of a united team to actively engage in operational improvements, including process institutionalization, AI utilization, and the promotion of legal DX (Digital Transformation).

Key Responsibilities
You will be entrusted with a well-balanced and wide range of responsibilities in both legal and compliance (legal compliance and corporate ethics) operations.
Legal Consultation and Contract-Related Matters

• Responding to legal consultations from various business divisions and providing support as a trusted partner to advance business initiatives.

• Supporting the drafting, reviewing, and negotiation of contracts (handling highly specialized areas, contracts involving overseas parties or specific jurisdictions, and matters with potential litigation risks).

• Collaborating with external counsel and managing outsourced services.

Compliance and Organizational Foundation

• Promoting overall legal compliance and corporate ethics, and conducting various training sessions and audit operations.

• Supporting investigations related to internal whistleblowing (ensuring appropriate response to reports).

• Participating in internal systematization (improving the efficiency of legal operations), such as maintaining a "shared repository for judgment criteria."

Required Experience and Skills
Required Qualifications

• Bengoshi Qualification: Must hold a Japanese lawyer qualification (licensed to practice law in Japan).

• Japanese Proficiency: Native-level to handle complex legal documentation and manage internal stakeholders

• English Proficiency: Business-level English proficiency or willing to learn English (used for global collaboration, investigation responses, etc.; Guide: ability to communicate effectively in meetings in addition to reading and writing).

• Collaboration: Strong collaboration skills to work harmoniously and complement each other as a member of the organization

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
募集要項：社内弁護士（法務・コンプライアンス部門）

職務の目的と使命
ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社の「Doing now what patients need next」という企業理念のもと、法務・コンプライアンス部門の一員として会社の法的及びコンプイアンスリスクを適切に管理し、事業の発展に貢献する職種です。 私たちの組織は、チームワークで貢献することを大切にしています。単なる法律解釈にとどまらず、組織一丸となって、業務の仕組み化やAIの活用や法務DXの推進を含めた運用の改善にも積極的に関わっていただける方を募集します。

主な職務内容
法務業務とコンプライアンス（法令遵守・企業倫理）業務の双方において、幅広い領域をバランスよくお任せします。

• 法務相談・契約関連業務

• 各事業部門からの法務相談への対応、および事業推進における良き相談相手としての支援

• 契約書の作成、審査、交渉の支援（高度な専門領域、海外や特定の法域が関わる契約、紛争の危険がある案件などへの対応）

• 外部弁護士との連携および委託業務の管理

• コンプライアンス・組織基盤への貢献

• 法令遵守・企業倫理全般の推進、各種研修や監査実務の実施

• 内部通報（適切な通報対応）に関する調査の支援

• 「判断基準の共有書庫」の整備など、部内の仕組み化（法務運用の効率化）への参画

求める経験・能力

• 必須要件

• 日本の弁護士資格 をお持ちの方

• ネイティブレベルの日本語 ：複雑な法的文書の対応や、社内ステークホルダーとの調整を行えるレベル

• 仕事で使える水準の英語力（英語に対し高い学習意欲のある者でも可）

• 組織の一員としてお互いに「補い合い」、協調して業務を進められる高い協調性

• 法律知識だけでなく、組織への貢献や事業への深い理解を前向きに楽しめる姿勢

• 歓迎要件

• 弁護士としての実務経験 （3〜7年程度を想定していますが、意欲や潜在能力も考慮します）

• 業界経験者、未経験者共に歓迎です

求める人物像

• 組織として働くことに楽しみを感じる方

• チームワークを発揮することが好きな方

• 会社全体の変化を楽しみ、柔軟に適応・推進できる方

• 事業に寄り添い、会社の発展のために法律の観点から自発的に提案・貢献ができる方

Job Description: In-House Counsel (Legal & Compliance Department)
Purpose and Mission of the Role

Under Roche Diagnostics K.K.'s corporate philosophy of "Doing now what patients need next," this role contributes to business development by appropriately managing the company's legal and compliance risks as a member of the Legal & Compliance Department. Our organization values contributing through teamwork. We are seeking an individual who will not only interpret the law but also work as part of a united team to actively engage in operational improvements, including process institutionalization, AI utilization, and the promotion of legal DX (Digital Transformation).

Key Responsibilities
You will be entrusted with a well-balanced and wide range of responsibilities in both legal and compliance (legal compliance and corporate ethics) operations.
Legal Consultation and Contract-Related Matters

• Responding to legal consultations from various business divisions and providing support as a trusted partner to advance business initiatives.

• Supporting the drafting, reviewing, and negotiation of contracts (handling highly specialized areas, contracts involving overseas parties or specific jurisdictions, and matters with potential litigation risks).

• Collaborating with external counsel and managing outsourced services.

Compliance and Organizational Foundation

• Promoting overall legal compliance and corporate ethics, and conducting various training sessions and audit operations.

• Supporting investigations related to internal whistleblowing (ensuring appropriate response to reports).

• Participating in internal systematization (improving the efficiency of legal operations), such as maintaining a "shared repository for judgment criteria."

Required Experience and Skills
Required Qualifications

• Bengoshi Qualification: Must hold a Japanese lawyer qualification (licensed to practice law in Japan).

• Japanese Proficiency: Native-level to handle complex legal documentation and manage internal stakeholders

• English Proficiency: Business-level English proficiency or willing to learn English (used for global collaboration, investigation responses, etc.; Guide: ability to communicate effectively in meetings in addition to reading and writing).

• Collaboration: Strong collaboration skills to work harmoniously and complement each other as a member of the organization

Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Chi siamo

Roche impiega più di 100.000 persone in tutto il mondo, all'avanguardia nel campo della diagnostica e dei prodotti farmaceutici per creare un futuro più sano per tutti. L'azienda è cresciuta fino a diventare una delle più grandi aziende biotecnologiche al mondo, nonché un fornitore leader di diagnostica in vitro e un fornitore globale di soluzioni innovative per vaste aree terapeutiche. In Germania circa 18.600 dipendenti lavorano ogni giorno per il benessere dei pazienti.

Il nostro successo si basa sull’innovazione, sulla curiosità e sulla diversità e sul considerare le nostre differenze come un vantaggio. Per far progredire l'assistenza sanitaria attraverso l'innovazione, vogliamo continuare a imparare e crescere. Per questo cerchiamo nuovi colleghi che perseguano i nostri stessi ambiziosi obiettivi.

Comunicazioni di gruppo

Facciamo parte di Group Communications come comunicazione aziendale centrale di Roche. Il dipartimento è responsabile della creazione di un'immagine sostenibile e positiva di Roche e rappresenta la voce dell'azienda a livello di gruppo. Ciò significa: comunichiamo la strategia di Roche e l’attuazione del nostro obiettivo “Fare ora ciò di cui i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo” ai colleghi Roche e a diversi gruppi target esterni. Gestiamo campagne integrate e globali e forniamo piattaforme attraverso le quali i nostri partner commerciali e le nostre filiali possono comunicare con i gruppi target. Aiutiamo a costruire la fiducia dei principali stakeholder nella nostra azienda, a preservare il marchio e la reputazione di Roche e a creare un ambiente favorevole per la nostra attività. Ci sforziamo inoltre di essere innovativi, lungimiranti, creativi e audaci, rappresentando un marchio aziendale forte e integrato e un'esperienza positiva per il pubblico. Lavoriamo in un ambiente in cui le persone possono prosperare, apprendere nuove competenze, creare grandi cose e divertirsi insieme.

La nostra visione comunicativa è ambiziosa e semplice: ispirare il mondo sul contributo di Roche alla salute delle persone.

Siti Rete Comunicazioni Germania

Il team di comunicazione tedesco di Sites Network è responsabile dell'implementazione di strategie e misure di comunicazione che contribuiscono alla percezione positiva di Roche e delle nostre sedi, sia tra i nostri dipendenti attuali e futuri che nelle comunità in cui operiamo. Grazie alla nostra esperienza e alla nostra rete locale, promuoviamo la comunicazione integrata all'interno del Group Communications e costruiamo ponti tra le esigenze locali e le priorità globali per massimizzare l'impatto del nostro lavoro di comunicazione.

Come dipartimento di comunicazione di Sites Network Germany, lavoriamo insieme per sviluppare storie emozionanti dai diversi contenuti della nostra azienda e per implementarle in modo comunicativo con idee e formati creativi per i nostri dipendenti, i rappresentanti dei media e il nostro ambiente. In questo modo sosteniamo la direzione strategica dell'azienda e diamo vita all'identità di Roche.

Come volontario, acquisirai informazioni sui contenuti e sui processi organizzativi della comunicazione aziendale e conoscerai la nostra attività comunicativa quotidiana. Aiuterai a comprendere la trasformazione del business e le storie delle nostre sedi a Mannheim, Penzberg e Ludwigsburg, mettendo le persone al centro. Nel team puoi contribuire con le tue idee e contribuire attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo delle nostre strategie di comunicazione.

Group Communications

We are part of Group Communications as Roche's central corporate communications division. Our communication vision is ambitious and simple: we inspire the world to contribute to the health of people.

As a volunteer, you will gain insights into the content and organizational processes of corporate communication and learn about our daily communicative business. You will help to understand the transformation of business and the stories of our locations Mannheim, Penzberg and Ludwigsburg and to put people at the centre of the project. Descriptif

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste

Qui nous sommes

Roche emploie plus de 100 000 personnes dans le monde, pionnier dans les domaines du diagnostic et des produits pharmaceutiques pour créer un avenir plus sain pour chacun. La société est devenue l'une des plus grandes sociétés de biotechnologie au monde, ainsi qu'un fournisseur leader de diagnostics in vitro et un fournisseur mondial de solutions innovantes pour de vastes domaines thérapeutiques. En Allemagne, environ 18 600 collaborateurs travaillent chaque jour pour le bien-être des patients.

Notre succès repose sur l’innovation, la curiosité et la diversité – et sur le fait de considérer nos différences comme un avantage. Pour faire progresser les soins de santé grâce à l’innovation, nous voulons continuer à apprendre et à grandir. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons de nouveaux collègues qui poursuivent les mêmes objectifs ambitieux que nous.

Communication du groupe

Nous faisons partie de Group Communications en tant que centre de communication d'entreprise de Roche. Le département est chargé de créer une image durablement positive de Roche et représente la voix de l'entreprise au niveau du groupe. Cela signifie : nous communiquons la stratégie de Roche et la mise en œuvre de notre objectif « Faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin ensuite » aux collègues de Roche et à divers groupes cibles externes. Nous menons des campagnes intégrées et mondiales et fournissons des plateformes via lesquelles nos partenaires commerciaux et filiales peuvent communiquer avec des groupes cibles. Nous contribuons à renforcer la confiance des principales parties prenantes de notre entreprise, à maintenir la marque et la réputation de Roche et à créer un environnement favorable à notre entreprise. Nous nous efforçons également d’être innovants, avant-gardistes, créatifs et audacieux, en représentant une marque d’entreprise forte et intégrée et une expérience positive pour le public. Nous travaillons dans un environnement où les gens peuvent s'épanouir, acquérir de nouvelles compétences, créer de grandes choses et s'amuser ensemble.

Notre vision de communication est ambitieuse et simple : inspirer le monde sur la contribution de Roche à la santé des individus.

Sites Réseau Communications Allemagne

L'équipe de communication allemande de Sites Network est chargée de mettre en œuvre des stratégies et des mesures de communication qui contribuent à une perception positive de Roche et de nos sites, tant auprès de nos employés actuels et futurs que des communautés dans lesquelles nous opérons. Grâce à notre expertise et à notre réseau locaux, nous favorisons la communication intégrée au sein des communications du groupe et construisons des ponts entre les besoins locaux et les priorités mondiales afin de maximiser l'impact de notre travail de communication.

En tant que service de communication de Sites Network Germany, nous travaillons ensemble pour développer des histoires passionnantes à partir des divers contenus de notre entreprise et les mettre en œuvre de manière communicative avec des idées et des formats créatifs pour nos employés, les représentants des médias et notre environnement. Nous soutenons ainsi l'orientation stratégique de l'entreprise et donnons vie à l'identité de Roche.

En tant que bénévole, vous aurez un aperçu du contenu et des processus organisationnels de la communication d'entreprise et découvrirez notre activité de communication quotidienne. Vous contribuerez à comprendre la transformation de l'entreprise et les histoires de nos sites de Mannheim, Penzberg et Ludwigsburg, tout en mettant l'humain au centre. Au sein de l’équipe, vous pouvez apporter vos idées et contribuer activement au développement ultérieur de nos stratégies de communication.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En Roche Diagnostics nos mueve el propósito de transformar la salud de los pacientes. Para contribuir a este objetivo, buscamos incorporar dos Técnicos/as Junior para nuestro Repair Center mediante un Contrato Formativo para la Obtención de la Práctica Profesional.
Se trata de una oportunidad dirigida a personas recientemente tituladas que deseen desarrollar una carrera profesional en el ámbito del mantenimiento, reparación e instalación de equipamiento de diagnóstico clínico de alta tecnología, adquiriendo experiencia práctica en un entorno innovador y altamente especializado.

Durante el programa formativo, la persona seleccionada desarrollará progresivamente sus conocimientos técnicos bajo la supervisión y acompañamiento de profesionales experimentados, participando en distintas áreas estratégicas del Repair Center.

Principales responsabilidades

• Reacondicionamiento de equipos.

• Participar en el diagnóstico, reparación, mantenimiento preventivo y preconfiguración de instrumentos de diagnóstico clínico.

• Colaborar en actividades de reacondicionamiento de equipos pertenecientes a diferentes líneas de producto como SWA (Serum Work Area), Molecular, Tissue y Coagulación.

• Aprender procedimientos técnicos, estándares de calidad y metodologías de trabajo aplicadas al entorno de reparación y mantenimiento.

• Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua orientadas a la optimización de procesos y flujos de trabajo dentro del taller.

Soporte técnico en campo

• Acompañar a técnicos especialistas e ingenieros de servicio en intervenciones realizadas en hospitales, laboratorios y centros sanitarios.

• Colaborar en actividades de instalación, puesta en marcha y verificación de sistemas de diagnóstico clínico.

• Adquirir experiencia práctica en entornos reales de cliente, siempre bajo supervisión y acompañamiento técnico.

Desarrollo profesional

• Participar en un itinerario formativo estructurado que combine aprendizaje técnico, desarrollo de competencias profesionales y conocimiento del sector de diagnóstico in vitro.

• Contribuir activamente a la identificación de oportunidades de mejora operativa y eficiencia dentro del Repair Center.

Perfil requerido

• Titulación universitaria obtenida en los últimos años compatible con la formalización de un Contrato Formativo para la Obtención de la Práctica Profesional.

• Grado en Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática, Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Biomédica, Ingeniería Mecatrónica, Ingeniería de Tecnologías Industriales o titulaciones afines.

• Alternativamente, Ciclo Formativo de Grado Superior en Electromedicina Clínica, Automatización y Robótica Industrial, Mecatrónica Industrial o especialidades equivalentes.

• Interés por el mantenimiento, reparación e instalación de equipamiento tecnológico.

• Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

• Interés por la mejora continua y la excelencia operativa.

• Capacidad de aprendizaje, trabajo en equipo y adaptación a entornos dinámicos.

• Disponibilidad para realizar desplazamientos puntuales acompañando a técnicos e ingenieros de servicio.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Contrato Formativo para la Obtención de la Práctica Profesional.

• Acompañamiento continuo por parte de profesionales senior.

• Exposición a tecnología de vanguardia en el sector de diagnóstico clínico.

• Participación en proyectos con impacto directo en la atención sanitaria.

• Entorno colaborativo e innovador orientado al aprendizaje y al crecimiento profesional.

En R

jobs.title: Project Management Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la gestion des projets

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities :
China Strategy Formulation

• Strategic Framework Design: Formulate and continuously iterate a comprehensive, end-to-end strategic framework for Pharma China across the entire value chain, establishing the foundational roadmap for the organization's long-term vision.

• Data-Driven Narrative Architecture ("The China Story"): Architect and evolve a compelling, data-driven strategic narrative that clearly communicates local market realities, structural shifts, and future growth opportunities to global stakeholders.

• Connecting the Dots & Insight Generation: Effectively connect distinct business elements and generate high-value strategic insights.

• Executive Synthesis & Global Communication: Translate complex local market, clinical, and regulatory nuances into clear business contexts, gathering and preparing critical information to craft high-impact briefings, executive presentations, and strategic speeches/slides for the General Manager and global leadership.

Corporate Project Management

• Project Governance Framework: Design, standardize, and govern the PMO framework for various company projects, embedding a robust "closed-loop" management approach to monitor execution and maintain full visibility across the portfolio.

• Outcome-Driven Delivery: Maintain a strong focus on project outcomes, implementing tracking mechanisms that ensure high-quality, seamless coordination, and timely delivery across all value chains.

• Leadership Dialogue Facilitation: Organize and manage the operational structure for regular leadership review meetings, CNET activities, and strategic dialogues to facilitate quick, data-backed business decisions.

• Resource & Risk Management: Proactively identify project delivery risks, dependencies, and resource bottlenecks, optimizing resource mobilization across competing enterprise initiatives to keep core priorities on track.

Cross-Functional Project Leadership & Delivery

• Lead High-Complexity Initiatives: Manage cross-functional projects, organizing agile project squads to solve complex operational challenges.

• Process Optimization: Diagnose systemic operational friction points across the organization and establish optimized project management workflows to increase delivery speed and efficiency.

• Matrix Stakeholder Management: Master stakeholder management by influencing and aligning diverse, cross-functional teams toward shared corporate goals

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education & Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or above. An MBA or background in a top-tier strategy consulting firm is highly preferred.

• Professional Expertise: Recognized expert in corporate strategy, marketing, or access within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional verbal and written communication in Mandarin and English. Ability to craft compelling narratives and high-impact speeches for executive audiences.

• Strategic Agility: Proven track record of handling high levels of complexity and ambiguity. Ability to see the "big picture" while maintaining extreme sensitivity to critical tactical details.

• Leadership Track Record: Demonstrated ability to lead large, or cross-functional teams and influence senior management to adopt new perspectives or strategic shifts.

Leadership Mindset and Attributes

• VACC Leader: A role model for Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach leadership styles.

• Courageous Authenticity: Willin

jobs.title: Principal Bioinformatics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Sequencing is not only changing science, but we are changing lives. Our software teams are laying the groundwork for the future by developing powerful bioinformatics algorithms, data analysis tools, and software/systems infrastructures so researchers and clinicians can make better health decisions faster. The path to curing cancer lies in ones and zeros as we work with next-generation genomic sequencing, a new frontier.

Do you want to develop software products that scientists and others in the life sciences will use to diagnose, find treatments, and eventually beat diseases like cancer? Our team builds highly scalable, reliable software and secure systems for better diagnostics. Come join us!

The Opportunity

• As a Bioinformatics Software Engineer, you will design and develop automated verification tests for the bioinformatics components and pipelines that are used in Roche Sequencing products. You will be part of the team developing cutting-edge, distributed, scale-out Next-Generation Sequencing data analysis software to ensure the highest possible software quality for gene sequencing research and disease diagnostics.

• Work closely with research and algorithm experts, accelerating bioinformatics techniques using GPU hardware. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The opportunity

• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)

• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.

• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.

• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.

• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs.

Who you are

• You hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.

• You bring hands-on experience applying data analytics to pharmaceutical development, CMC, formulation, stability or process development datasets, including scripting in Python, R or similar tools.

• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.

• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come scienziato nello sviluppo farmaceutico, fai parte del Dipartimento “Sviluppo farmaceutico” di Pharma Technical Development (PTD) di Basilea, Svizzera. Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali ( molecole sintetiche e biologiche) dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il lancio del mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo ai siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto commerciale del prodotto e lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea. L'opportunità
• Sviluppo leader: sviluppo farmaceutico delle formulazioni parenterali per lo sviluppo e il mercato clinico (comprese le estensioni di linea). Comprendere il comportamento della stabilità (ad esempio biofisica, degradazione chimica)
• Gestione dei dati: garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei dati strutturati e non strutturati in tutto il dipartimento.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilizzare tecniche di statistica e machine learning avanzate per eseguire l'estrazione di dati in profondità. Identificare le tendenze e le correlazioni associate ai dati scientifici.
• Competenze funzionali come project management: Rappresentanza dello Sviluppo Farmaceutico come responsabile del progetto farmaceutico nei team CMC globali, rappresentante funzionale in team interfunzionali e comitati globali all'interno di Roche.
• Inserimenti normativi: autorizzare sezioni di prodotti farmaceutici per IND/IMPDs clinici e MAAs. Chi sei Come candidato di successo si possiede un dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati O si possiede un master in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale (industria) in un'azienda farmaceutica.
• Provata esperienza di stabilire e gestire grandi set di dati, compresa l'esposizione a script associati all'analisi dei dati.
• Profonda comprensione della modellazione statistica, tra cui regressione lineare/logistica, analisi dei cluster, previsione delle serie temporali, analisi dei dati di studio longitudinale e test multivariato.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo dei prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti associati.
• Comprensione dei requisiti normativi per diverse fasi cliniche e commerciali di sviluppo.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comportamenti collaborativi, con il pensiero end-to-end e globale, nonché eccellenti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme. L'opportunité
• Développement avancé: Développement pharmaceutique de formulations parentérales pour le développement clinique et le marché (y compris les extensions de lignées). Comprendre le comportement de stabilité (par exemple biophysique, dégradation chimique)
• Gestion des données : assurer une intégration transparente des données structurées et non structurées dans l'ensemble du département.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilisez des techniques avancées de statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour effectuer l'extraction de données en profondeur. Déterminer les tendances et les corrélations associées aux données scientifiques.
• Expertise fonctionnelle en tant que gestion de projet : Représentation du développement pharmaceutique en tant que chef de projet pharmaceutique dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités mondiaux au sein de Roche.
• Présentations réglementaires : Autoriser les sections des produits pharmaceutiques pour les ID/IMPD cliniques et les AAM. Qui vous êtes En tant que candidat retenu, vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes. Ou vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle (industrie) dans une entreprise pharmaceutique.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'établissement et de la gestion de grands ensembles de données, y compris l'exposition à des scripts associés à l'analyse des données.
• Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation statistique, y compris la régression linéaire/logistique, l'analyse en grappes, la prévision de séries chronologiques, l'analyse longitudinale des données des études et les essais multivariés.
• Connaissance du développement des produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences connexes.
• Compréhension des exigences réglementaires pour les différents stades cliniques et commerciaux du développement.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et comportement collaboratif, avec une réflexion de bout en bout et globale, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Head of MSAT Technology Transfer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is seeking a highly skilled and top-tier talent—a leader who demands excellence and possesses the competency and experience in both greenfield engineering projects and routine operations. This position will spearhead end-to-end technology transfer and operational readiness efforts at our state-of-the-art greenfield biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Shanghai. This strategic role entails driving complex technical transfers, developing advanced processes, and ensuring the successful design, qualification, and start-up of the site, culminating in ramp-up and sustained operational excellence.

The MSAT Tech Transfer (TT) Manager is a pivotal technical and leadership role responsible for driving end-to-end technical transfer projects in a cGMP environment. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional leadership, capable of guiding a high-performing team to deliver critical projects in a tightly regulated and complex biopharmaceutical setting. This role emphasizes seamless collaboration across internal and external stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and Roche’s global network to ensure alignment, best practice implementation, and operational excellence. A strong focus on precious tech transfer, continuous technological innovation, robust process establishment, and strict compliance with GMP/SHE standards will be essential to achieving successful production, strategic project milestones, and long-term organizational success.
Technology Transfer & Operations:

• Lead Tech Transfer, PPM introduction, and compliance to ensure successful manufacturing readiness.

• The role plays a critical part in strategic project realization including qualification, manufacturing readiness and start up.

• Oversee all operations tied to technology transfer, including process design and troubleshooting, adherence to strict cGMP standards, and maintaining compliance with all Roche quality policies and international regulatory requirements.

• Drive technical innovation by identifying, evaluating, and implementing advanced technologies and methodologies to enhance process control, automation capabilities, and product quality consistency.
Strategic Leadership & Global Interaction:

• Enable and empower your team to deliver our vision through demonstrating VACC (Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) leadership behaviors and focusing on strategic project development in China.

• The role is key interface with the MFG, QA, ENG to ensure successful process alignment, production readiness, and drive collaboration across cross-functional teams.
Facilitate robust interaction and collaboration with global team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners, ensuring seamless execution of internal and external technology transfers. Provide timely updates, promote effective knowledge sharing, and establish efficient coordination mechanisms to drive alignment on key initiatives and project milestones.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Leadership & People Management

• Exhibit exceptional leadership aligned with the VACC model, demonstrating a capacity to craft and execute forward-thinking strategies. Cultivate a high-impact environment by systematically eliminating barriers, advancing both people and technical capabilities, and enabling individuals to perform at their peak potential.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, with a strong emphasis on people development, fostering individual growth, and enhancing collective skillsets to meet evolvin
