jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of non-oncology therapeutic areas (immunology, neurology, CVRM, ophthalmology)

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice; clinical expertise in immunology preferred

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience, early development experience in immunology preferred

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research sites, and interpreting early development clinical trial data

• You have a very good understanding of global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are

You will shape stakeholder perspectives, champion accountability by taking on security incident lead or project owner roles, and foster continuous improvement in security operations and best practices

Description of the area
The Identity Management Support Team manages and operates the solutions and components used to provide customers with Directory and Identity Management Services using SailPoint. We are part of a global Roche Digital Technology group (RDT).

Job Responsibilities
In this role, you are mainly responsible for the multi-cloud Identity Management environment, focusing specifically on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while maintaining consistency with AWS. This includes the design of new solutions, consultancy, maintenance, performance, tactical lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies.

Scope

• Strong background in IAM concepts at design level and evolution in Cloud environments, Azure and/or GCP.

• Contributes to the design of new solutions based on SailPoint and PingFederate, AD, Privilege Access Management.

• Access Governance and Controls: Enforce strong security controls across cloud environments, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Identity Protection. Implement Least Privilege policies, often involving custom roles and organizational-level controls. Implement IAM Deny Policies to strictly block high-risk actions, ensuring separation of duties

• Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and support Just-in-Time (JIT) Access mechanisms, ensuring no standing privileges for administrators, using tools like Cyberark for Just-in-Time access

• Operational Excellence: Act as an expert in the release management activities, providing 2nd and 3rd level support for the Identity Management Infrastructure. Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management

Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Senior Safety, Health, and Environmental Spécialiste

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche's Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) Department as a Senior SHE Specialist and make a meaningful impact on workplace safety and environmental stewardship. In this pivotal role, you'll identify and evaluate risks to employee safety and the environment while establishing robust controls to mitigate those hazards. Working collaboratively across the R&D department and throughout the business, you'll leverage detailed analysis, expert problem-solving skills, and extensive SHE expertise to protect our employees, our environment, and Roche's right to operate. Through strategic risk identification, comprehensive incident investigation and management, accident prevention, compliance management, and innovative program development, you'll help build and maintain a safe, compliant, and resilient workplace culture.

The Opportunity

As an expert leader with strong business acumen and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, you'll demonstrate mastery in executing and evaluating SHE risk assessments—including job hazard assessments, equipment safety evaluations, PPE assessments, and ergonomic risk assessments. Your proficiency in interpreting regulatory and technical documents, combined with your extensive knowledge of industrial environmental management and emergency response procedures, will be instrumental in driving compliance and protecting our workforce. With a background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology, along with your demonstrated expertise in biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, and chemical hygiene, you'll bring the technical depth needed to excel in our science-driven medical device R&D environment.

• Provide SHE business partner support for the R&D department of a dynamic medical diagnostic device company

• Lead or facilitate investigation of SHE incidents to identify root causes and implement corrective and preventative actions to reduce risk of recurrence

• Develop, review, and revise SHE programs through technical writing to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations

• Manage action plans to ensure incident follow-up is complete, effective, and timely

• Prepare, coordinate, and conduct regular SHE-related meetings, inspections, and training sessions

• Maintain comprehensive SHE documentation, incident databases, injury and illness records, and required permits in accordance with compliance standards

• Develop metrics, summaries, and communications to provide accurate and timely reporting of SHE-related data and trend analysis

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in occupational health and safety, engineering, or related technical field with minimum 8 years of dedicated professional SHE experience

• Extensive experience in highly regulated and science-driven industries (e.g., medical device, clinical diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or R&D environments) with demonstrated expertise in executing SHE risk assessments and emergency response procedures

• Demonstrated expertise in medical device R&D environments, including biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, chemical hygiene, and preferred background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology

• Proven ability to autonomously manage complex SHE projects, lead incident response and management, interpret regulatory and technical documents, and develop business-wide SHE programs in matrixed organizations

• Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with expert ability to manage complex workloads, deliver high-quality work with meticulous

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al Dipartimento Sicurezza, Salute e Ambientale di Roche (SHE) come Senior SHE Specialist e avere un impatto significativo sulla sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e sulla gestione ambientale. In questo ruolo fondamentale, identificherai e valuterai i rischi per la sicurezza dei dipendenti e per l'ambiente, stabilendo controlli robusti per mitigare tali rischi. Lavorando in collaborazione attraverso il reparto R&D e in tutto il mondo del business, potrete sfruttare analisi dettagliate, competenze di problem solving esperti e una vasta esperienza SHE per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, il nostro ambiente e il diritto di Roche di operare. Attraverso l'identificazione strategica del rischio, l'indagine completa degli incidenti e la gestione, la prevenzione degli incidenti, la gestione della conformità e lo sviluppo di programmi innovativi, vi aiuterà a costruire e mantenere una cultura di lavoro sicura, conforme e resiliente. L'opportunità In qualità di leader esperto con un forte acume aziendale e una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni, dimostrerai la padronanza nell'esecuzione e nella valutazione delle valutazioni dei rischi SHE, comprese le valutazioni dei rischi di lavoro, le valutazioni sulla sicurezza delle attrezzature, le valutazioni dei PPE e le valutazioni ergonomiche del rischio. La vostra competenza nell'interpretare documenti normativi e tecnici, unitamente alla vostra vasta conoscenza delle procedure di gestione ambientale industriale e di risposta alle emergenze, sarà determinante per la conformità alla guida e la protezione della nostra forza lavoro. Con uno sfondo in chimica, elettrochimica, o microbiologia, insieme con la vostra esperienza dimostrata in biosicurezza, patogeni e igiene chimica, porterete la profondità tecnica necessaria per eccellere nel nostro ambiente R&D dispositivo medico guidato dalla scienza.
• Fornire il supporto del partner commerciale SHE per il reparto R&D di una società di dispositivi diagnostici dinamici
• condurre o facilitare l'indagine di incidenti SHE per identificare le cause di root e implementare azioni correttive e preventive per ridurre il rischio di ricorrenza
• Sviluppare, rivedere e rivedere i programmi SHE relativi attraverso la scrittura tecnica per garantire la conformità dei dati federali, di stato e di regolamentazioni locali applicabili
• Gestire i piani di azione per garantire il follow-up degli incidenti è completo, efficace e comportamento tempestivo
•
• Una vasta esperienza in settori altamente regolamentati e orientati alla scienza (ad esempio, dispositivi medici, diagnostica clinica, prodotti farmaceutici o ambienti R&D) con una comprovata competenza nell'esecure le valutazioni del rischio SHE e le procedure di risposta di emergenza
• Competenze dimostrate negli ambienti R&D del dispositivo medico, comprese le procedure di analisi del rischio SHE e di risposta di emergenza

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Treten Sie als Senior SHE Specialist der Roche-Abteilung für Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umwelt (SHE) bei und leisten Sie einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf die Sicherheit am Arbeitsplatz und die Umweltverantwortung. In dieser zentralen Rolle identifizieren und bewerten Sie Risiken für die Sicherheit der Mitarbeiter und die Umwelt, während Sie robuste Kontrollen einrichten, um diese Gefahren zu mindern. In Zusammenarbeit mit der gesamten F & E-Abteilung und im gesamten Unternehmen nutzen Sie detaillierte Analysen, kompetente Problemlösungskompetenzen und umfangreiches SHE-Know-how, um unsere Mitarbeiter, unsere Umwelt und das Recht von Roche zu schützen. Durch strategische Risikoidentifizierung, umfassende Untersuchung und Management von Vorfällen, Unfallverhütung, Compliance-Management und innovative Programmentwicklung helfen Sie beim Aufbau und der Aufrechterhaltung einer sicheren, konformen und widerstandsfähigen Arbeitsplatzkultur. Die Chance Als erfahrene Führungskraft mit starkem Geschäftssinn und einer proaktiven, lösungsorientierten Denkweise beweisen Sie, dass Sie SHE-Risikobewertungen - einschließlich Arbeitsplatzrisikobewertungen, Sicherheitsbewertungen von Geräten, PPE-Bewertungen und ergonomische Risikobewertungen - beherrschen. Ihre Kenntnisse in der Interpretation von regulatorischen und technischen Dokumenten, kombiniert mit Ihrem umfassenden Wissen über industrielles Umweltmanagement und Notfallmaßnahmen, werden dazu beitragen, die Einhaltung der Vorschriften zu fördern und unsere Mitarbeiter zu schützen. Mit einem Hintergrund in Chemie, Elektrochemie oder Mikrobiologie, zusammen mit Ihrer nachgewiesenen Expertise in Biosicherheit, durch Blut übertragenen Krankheitserregern und chemischer Hygiene, bringen Sie die technische Tiefe, die erforderlich ist, um in unserer wissenschaftsgetriebenen F & E-Umgebung für medizinische Geräte zu übertreffen.
• Unterstützung von SHE-Geschäftspartnern für die F&E-Abteilung eines dynamischen Unternehmens für medizinische Diagnosegeräte Führen oder erleichtern Sie die Untersuchung von SHE-Vorfällen, um die Ursachen zu identifizieren und korrigierende und präventive Maßnahmen zu ergreifen, um das Wiederholungsrisiko zu verringern
• Entwicklung, Überprüfung und Überarbeitung von SHE-Programmen durch technisches Schreiben, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Bundes-, Landes- und lokalen Vorschriften sicherzustellen
• Verwalten von Aktionsplänen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Nachverfolgung von Vorfällen vollständig, effektiv und zeitnah ist
• Vorbereitung, Koordination und Durchführung regelmäßiger SHE-bezogener Treffen, Inspektionen und Schulungen
• Pflegen Sie umfassende SHE-Dokumentationen, Vorfalldatenbanken, Verletzungs- und Krankheitsaufzeichnungen und erforderliche Genehmigungen in Übereinstimmung mit Compliance-Standards
• Entwicklung von Metriken, Zusammenfassungen und Kommunikationen, um eine genaue und zeitnahe Berichterstattung über SHE-bezogene Daten und Trendanalysen zu ermöglichen Wer du bist
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Arbeitssicherheit, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten technischen Bereich mit mindestens 8 Jahren dedizierter Berufserfahrung Umfangreiche Erfahrung in stark regulierten und wissenschaftsgetriebenen Branchen (z. B. Medizinprodukte, klinische Diagnostik, Pharmazeutika oder F & E-Umgebungen) mit nachgewiesener Expertise bei der Durchführung von SHE-Risikobewertungen und Notfallreaktionsverfahren
• Demonstrierte Expertise in F & E-Umgebungen für Medizinprodukte, einschließlich Biosicherheit, durch Blut übertragene Pathogene, chemische Hygiene und bevorzugter Hintergrund in Chemie, Elektrochemie oder Mikrobiologie
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe SHE-Projekte autonom zu verwalten, Incident Response und Management zu leiten, regulatorische und technische Dokumente zu interpretieren und unternehmensweite SHE-Programme in matrixisierten Organisationen zu entwickeln
• Starke Führungs-, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten mit fachkundiger Fähigkeit, komplexe Workloads zu verwalten und qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit mit akribischer Sorgfalt zu liefern

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Joignez-vous au ministère de la Sécurité, de la Santé et de l'Environnement (SHE) de Roche à titre de spécialiste principal de la SHE et avoir un impact significatif sur la sécurité en milieu de travail et la gérance environnementale. Dans ce rôle central, vous identifierez et évaluerez les risques pour la sécurité des employés et l'environnement tout en établissant des contrôles robustes pour atténuer ces risques. En travaillant en collaboration dans l'ensemble du département de R-D et dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, vous tirerez parti d'une analyse détaillée, de compétences spécialisées en résolution de problèmes et d'une vaste expertise de la SHE pour protéger nos employés, notre environnement et le droit d'exploitation de Roche. Grâce à l'identification des risques stratégiques, aux enquêtes et à la gestion exhaustives des incidents, à la prévention des accidents, à la gestion de la conformité et à l'élaboration de programmes innovateurs, vous contribuerez à bâtir et à maintenir une culture de travail sécuritaire, conforme et résistante. L'opportunité En tant que chef de file expert avec un sens des affaires et un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur les solutions, vous démontrerez la maîtrise de l'exécution et de l'évaluation des évaluations des risques de la SHE, y compris les évaluations des risques liés au travail, les évaluations de la sécurité des équipements, les évaluations des EPI et les évaluations ergonomiques des risques. Votre compétence dans l'interprétation des documents réglementaires et techniques, combinée à votre connaissance approfondie de la gestion de l'environnement industriel et des procédures d'intervention en cas d'urgence, contribuera à la conformité et à la protection de notre effectif. Avec vos connaissances en chimie, en électrochimie ou en microbiologie, ainsi que votre expertise démontrée en biosécurité, en pathogènes transmissibles par le sang et en hygiène chimique, vous apporterez la profondeur technique nécessaire pour exceller dans notre environnement de R-D des instruments médicaux dirigé par la science.
• Fournir un soutien aux partenaires commerciaux de la SHE pour le département de R-D d'une entreprise dynamique d'appareils de diagnostic médical
• Diriger ou faciliter l'enquête sur les incidents de la SHE afin d'identifier les causes profondes et de mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives pour réduire les risques de récidive
• Élaborer, examiner et réviser les programmes de la SHE par la rédaction technique afin d'assurer le respect des règlements fédéraux, des États et locaux applicables
• Gérer les plans d'action pour s'assurer que le suivi des incidents est complet, efficace et opportun
• Préparer, coordonner et mener régulièrement des réunions, des inspections et des séances de formation liées à la SHE
• Tenir à jour la documentation complète, les bases de données sur les incidents, les dossiers sur les blessures et les maladies et les permis requis conformément aux normes de conformité
• Élaborer des mesures, des résumés et des communications pour fournir des rapports exacts et opportuns sur les données et l'analyse des tendances relatives à la SHE Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat en santé et sécurité au travail, en génie ou dans un domaine technique connexe avec un minimum de 8 ans d'expérience spécialisée en SHE
• Expérience étendue dans des industries hautement réglementées et axées sur la science (p. ex. dispositifs médicaux, diagnostics cliniques, produits pharmaceutiques ou environnements de R-D) ayant une expertise démontrée dans l'exécution des évaluations des risques et des procédures d'intervention d'urgence de SHE
• Expertise démontrée dans des environnements de R-D d'instruments médicaux, y compris la biosécurité, les agents pathogènes transmissibles par le sang, l'hygiène chimique et les antécédents privilégiés en chimie, en électrochimie ou en microbiologie
• Capacité éprouvée de gérer de façon autonome des projets complexes de SHE, de diriger l'intervention et la gestion d'incidents, d'interpréter des documents réglementaires et techniques et de développer des programmes de SHE à l'échelle de l'entreprise dans des organisations matricielles
• Compétences solides en leadership, en résolution de problèmes et en prise de décisions avec une capacité experte de gérer des charges de travail complexes, de fournir un travail de haute qualité avec méticule

You will champion our OTC (Over the counter) and OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription) portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.

• Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona impulsar el futuro del diagnóstico sanitario? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist dinámico/a para unirse a nuestro equipo. En este rol, serás la cara estratégica de Roche Diagnostics dentro del ecosistema del laboratorio hospitalario, estableciendo relaciones sólidas y comprendiendo las necesidades técnicas y emocionales más profundas de nuestros clientes.
Tu misión irá más allá de la venta tradicional: realizarás análisis de situación exhaustivos para posicionar estratégicamente nuestro Portfolio de Near Patient Care y Diabetes. Promoviendo la eficiencia de los procesos, la innovación en los flujos de trabajo y la diferenciación de nuestros productos, ayudarás a los laboratorios a superar sus desafíos actuales, acelerando y mejorando el impacto en el paciente.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución Estratégica y Crecimiento: Implementar las actividades comerciales definidas para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganar participación de mercado y cumplir con los KPI estratégicos en cuentas actuales y potenciales.

• Co-creación de Valor: Identificar las necesidades y retos en los laboratorios, así como en las áreas de compras, finanzas y gerencia hospitalaria. Propondrás soluciones diferenciadoras que ilusionen y enganchen al cliente.

• Gestión del Ciclo de Vida del Cliente (360°): Liderar todo el ciclo de vida del cliente, asegurando los máximos niveles de satisfacción y construyendo relaciones de confianza a largo plazo.

• Experto/a en el Portfolio: Desarrollar un profundo conocimiento de nuestras soluciones diagnósticas, realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto efectivas que comuniquen con claridad nuestras ventajas competitivas.

Who You Are (The skills you need)
Buscamos un/a profesional estructurado/a, metódico/a, con un fuerte empuje comercial y una gran pasión por el sector salud.

• Formación y Trasfondo: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en tareas docentes/formativas.

• Experiencia: Mínimo de 3 a 4 años de experiencia contrastada en venta consultiva dentro del ámbito comercial del Sector Salud.

• "Hunter Mindset": Ambición, compromiso y un hambre clara por ganar nuevas cuentas, respaldado por un track record tangible de éxito comercial.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Conocimiento profundo de la industria del diagnóstico, competidores, regulaciones y el funcionamiento de la Administración Sanitaria (licitaciones y concursos públicos).

• Enfoque Analítico: Capacidad para tomar decisiones basadas en datos y utilizar herramientas comerciales metodológicas para identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en el territorio asignado.

• Orientación al Cliente: Alta capacidad de escucha activa para entender las necesidades técnicas y emocionales, asegurando que el valor diferencial de Roche sea evidente en cada interacción.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español; se valorarán positivamente los conocimientos de inglés para interactuar con redes globales y formaciones.

• Residencia en Castilla y León. Disponibilidad para viajar más de un 50% del tiempo.

What is here for You?

• Un Propósito Real: Conectar tu día a día con una misión global: transformar la medicina personalizada y mejorar los resultados de salud desde el corazón del laboratorio hospitalario.

• Innovación a Gran Escala: Trabajar con el portafolio líder del mercado, introduciendo la automatización y la eficiencia en lo

The Position

担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 福岡オフィス　〒812-0011 福岡県福岡市博多区博多駅前1-4-4 東京建物博多ビル 12F
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・社会保険 ：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。 2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。
• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。 2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携
• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。
• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。 【応募資格（必須要件）】
• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方
• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験
• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験
• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可） 【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】
• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。
• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。 【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】
• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方
• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方
• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

jobs.title: Learning Specialist (German speaking)- Fixed term
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please note that this is a fixed term opportunity until 31/05/2028.

The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist - German speaking you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team: ​

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken German & English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office day/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you alway

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Au sein du hub français du Regional Customer Support Center basé à Meylan, le(la) Spécialiste Application RCSC avec une expertise en biologie moléculaire , apporte aux clients et aux collaborateurs de Roche Diagnostics l’assistance et le support demandés afin de garantir le fonctionnement optimal des systèmes Roche et ainsi le niveau de satisfaction des clients.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Assurer l’assistance téléphonique des clients (France, Belgique, Suisse francophone) sur les systèmes Roche Diagnostics et le support de second niveau aux collaborateurs des pays concernés et de la Division Export

• Réceptionne et traite toutes les demandes (téléphone, email), depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu’au déclenchement des actions correctives adaptées, y compris le déclenchement d’interventions sur le terrain.

• Priorise les demandes selon la politique de service définie.

• Recherche activement la satisfaction des clients en apportant des réponses claires, précises et rapides.

• Documente précisément dans le logiciel CRM les symptômes décrits/observés et les actions réalisées.

• Escalade, si nécessaire, les problèmes traités vers l’équipe de support de niveau n+1.

Contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• Communique avec ses collègues terrain sur la situation d’un client en cas de problème ou de demande complexe.

• Alimente régulièrement la base de connaissances.

• Contribue aux lancements de nouveaux produits et/ou aux modifications des produits existants.

Assurer la progression de ses propres compétences

• Met à jour de manière régulière ses connaissances par la lecture des notes internes, mails et forums.

• Identifie les actions permettant d’accroître son autonomie.

• Prend en charge des problèmes complexes en collaboration active avec ses collègues référents.

Qui vous êtes:

• Licence Professionnelle ou Master scientifique idéalement en biologie moléculaire et ayant un attrait pour la technique également​

• 2 à 3 années d’expérience professionnelle dans un environnement applicatif et technique, acquises dans les domaines du service client.

• Compétences en biologie moléculaire : connaissance et interprétation des tests réalisés au laboratoire ( tests PCR, techniques d’extractions et d’amplifications et tests oncologie, virologie...)

• Sens du service client et pédagogie: aptitudes à la communication par téléphone, capacité à gérer les situations difficiles

• Bon niveau d’anglais

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当
　　　　　　（小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート）

【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）

• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供

【応募資格（必須要件）】
医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験
（対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等）
具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方：

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Lead Data Architect – Clinical Imaging and AI Platforms will lead the design, governance, and evolution of enterprise imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, FAIR, and clinical data governance frameworks. This role serves as the strategic bridge between scientific, business, and technology organizations across Research, Product Development, RIS, and RDT, translating business priorities into scalable, secure, and interoperable data architectures.
The role is responsible for defining enterprise data architecture strategy and establishing standards for metadata, interoperability, lineage, and AI-ready data models. It will enable scalable analytics and AI/ML workflows for Research (REDs) and Product Development(PD) while driving modernization of imaging data platforms in partnership with engineering, informatics, and governance teams.

Job Responsibilities

• Define and execute the enterprise data architecture strategy and roadmap for multi-modal imaging and research data within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP ).

• Design scalable and interoperable data architectures supporting Radiology, Digital Pathology, AI/ML, clinical, and translational research workflows.

• Establish and enforce standards for data modeling, metadata management, lineage, interoperability, cataloging, and governance across structured and unstructured datasets in close partnership with the Data managers and Study teams.

• Lead the design and implementation of cloud-native data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, and distributed analytics ecosystems supporting global R&D and clinical initiatives.

• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical stakeholders to translate business and research requirements into scalable, compliant, and reusable data solutions.

• Act as the primary architecture lead for imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, RIS, and enterprise IT functions.

• Ensure alignment with GxP, FAIR standards, HIPAA/GDPR, security, privacy, and enterprise governance standards across all data architecture initiatives.

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of common data models, interoperability standards, APIs, and semantic frameworks to improve data accessibility and reusability.

• Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to design robust data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access patterns optimized for AI/ML and advanced analytics, focussed on biomarker research and analysis of Imaging data.

• Define architecture patterns for high-volume imaging and pathology data, including metadata indexing, streaming, archival, and federated access strategies.

• Lead modernization efforts for legacy data environments towards scalable and efficient hybrid architectures.

• Drive automation and standardization across data lifecycle management, data quality monitoring, observability, and governance workflows.

• Oversee architecture reviews, technical governance, and cross-functional design decisions to ensure consistency, scalability, and operational excellence.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve scalability, cost optimization, performance, automation, and operational efficiency across enterprise data platforms.

• Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends in data platforms, imaging data formats, AI/ML ecosystems, digital pathology, interoperability, and data standards to guide innovation and future-state architecture.

• Drive the evolution of AI-ready and semantically enriched

• Drive the evolution of AI-ready and semantically enriched

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Manufacturing Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Security Engineer plays a vital role in protecting Roche Manufacturing systems and networks against cybersecurity threats. This role is responsible for local architecture and engineering support, helping system owners and administrators in keeping their manufacturing environment up to date with the latest Roche Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards, baselines and industry best practices. Some of this role’s responsibilities are:

• Taking part in technical design reviews, integration, testing, and documentation activities concerning new OT systems and/or changes to existing manufacturing system or infrastructure

• Supporting development of Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards and baselines OT Cybersecurity Advisor during OT System planning phase and OT System Risk Assessment process

• Advising System Owners in selecting appropriate security measures to mitigate risk

• Coordinating of OT services and activities delivered by Vendors

• Reviewing local technical designs as part of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Requests (in ServiceNow)

• Designing and sustaining OT Security Monitoring (IIDS) at the Manufacturing Site

• Providing technical support during Incident Response process including steps to minimize the impact, conducting a technical and forensic investigation into how the breach happened and the extent of the damage

• Working closely with System Owners, Cybersecurity Site Representative and is a catalyst for cross-site collaboration on topics related to Manufacturing Cybersecurity

The Senior Security Engineer is a member of the Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering team led by the Head of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering and part of the Security Platforms subfunction in the Information Security function at Roche.

Job Responsibilities

• Independently manages end-to-end security analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

• Stakeholder Management

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

• Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team processes Complexity

• Manages business analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain

• Capable of handling ambiguous requirements, navigating intricate stakeholder environments, and evaluating solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain

• Business/Technical ability

• Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies

• Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, effectively managing interconnections to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que spécialiste commercial d’une/plusieurs gammes de produit (Core Lab), vous êtes responsable du développement et de l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et de part de marché de vos gamme de produits en coopération avec les Key Account Managers (KAM) / Customer Success Managers (CSM)
Vous interagissez en tant qu'expert(e) auprès des KAM / CSM en définissant et en présentant au client les solutions techniques envisagées.

Lieu d’habitation : Région de Paris

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez et maintenez une connaissance très forte de la gamme de produits/solutions dont vous avez la charge, grâce à une forte interaction avec le marketing et les experts produits du groupe; est en mesure de répondre à toutes les questions des clients sur ces produites, en autonomie et sait promouvoir la Valeur ajoutée différenciante de l’offre Roche vs les compétiteurs.

• Vous partagez les informations et tendance concurrence /marché que vous identifiez aux équipes marketing Roche. A ce titre, vous pouvez Identifier et informer le marketing des solutions de

• Vous soutenez les KAM et CSM d'un point de vue technique, médical ou scientifique sur le sujet dont vous êtes l'expert dans une perspective de développement du compte concerné

• Vous collaborez avec les CSM et le KAM à la construction de la stratégie commerciale des comptes sur ces gammes en identifiant les opportunités de croissance.

• Vous portez avec votre équipe la responsabilité de l’atteinte des objectifs de CA et de profitabilité associés à la/les gammes dont vous avez la charge - channel filling inclus.

• Vous construisez des offres spécifiques basées sur la compréhension des besoins clients en incluant les tierces parties nécessaires et en vous assurant notamment de la bonne adéquation entre l'offre commerciale et l'environnement opérationnel du client (CQ, repasse, volume, interface avec les autres chapters). Pour les dossiers AO publics - vous collaborez à la réponse financière et au pricing de la solution.

• Vous contribuez au sein de son équipe à l’amélioration de la performance de la/les gammes dont vous avez la responsabilité.

• Vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation scientifique ou technique, vous maîtrisez l'environnement de la santé et les enjeux de l'industrie du Diagnostic In Vitro (DIV).

• Reconnu pour votre intelligence situationnelle et votre aisance relationnelle, vous maîtrisez l'art de la négociation et de la contractualisation de haut niveau.

• Doté d'une écoute active, vous savez traduire les demandes clients en solutions concrètes, conseiller avec valeur ajoutée et aligner vos interlocuteurs autour d'une vision stratégique commune.

• Vous possédez une forte capacité à inspirer, engager et influencer positivement. Vous excellez dans la collaboration transversale et la coopération hors lien hiérarchique.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).

• Mindset:

• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.

• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.

• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.

• Skills:
Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).

• Education & Language:
Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 64,900.00 EUR - 120,540.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

jobs.title: System Shaping Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the Health System Shaping Lab as a System Shaping Partner . This pivotal role is your opportunity to drive large-scale, long-term national health system reform. Leverage your deep policy expertise and strategic agility to proactively influence legislation, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure sustainable access to cutting-edge healthcare for patients.

As the strategic analyst and implementation expert, you will report to the Government & External Affairs Lead. Your core mission is to shape a resilient market environment by addressing systemic healthcare challenges and championing policy changes that directly support our organization's strategic vision—both current and future.

Key Accountabilities

• Policy and Legislative Foresight: Conduct advanced Legislative Monitoring and Policy Analysis to deliver strategic intelligence, mitigate risks, and uncover opportunities for healthcare innovation.

• National Advocacy: Design and execute high-impact advocacy initiatives, including the development of compelling narratives, position papers, and white papers to advance our National Policy Shaping strategy.

• Stakeholder Ecosystem Collaboration: Build and maintain strategic partnerships with critical external stakeholders—policymakers, thought leaders, payers, and academic institutions—to build evidence and co-create solutions that generate mutual value for patient care and system efficiency.

• Integrated Strategy Execution: Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercialization Community to ensure a unified "OneRoche" approach in all external engagements and communications.

Candidate Profile
Education and Professional Experience

• Education: Master’s degree (required) in Business, Economy, Health Economics, Medicine, Pharmacy, or an equivalent academic background in Life Sciences.

• Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Reimbursement, Market/Patient Access, or Health Policy, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of healthcare financing, reimbursement systems, and relevant compliance frameworks.

• Minimum 7 years of professional experience within the Health Care sector in Slovakia.

Required Mindset and Competencies

• Strategic Agility: Ability to maintain a clear focus on the long-term vision while effectively navigating ambiguity, complexity, and uncertainty.

• System Thinking: Capacity to think and operate at an enterprise level, looking beyond organizational boundaries to achieve optimal outcomes for the local health environment.

• Impactful Communication: Exceptional skill in articulating complex value propositions and translating external insights into actionable intelligence for internal teams.

• Agile Mindset: Enthusiastic adoption of agile, self-managed working models based on trust, continuous learning, and adaptability.

• VACC Leadership: Embodies the principles of Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst, driving change both externally and internally.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 44,390.00 EUR - 82,450.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the Health System Shaping Lab as a System Shaping Partner . This pivotal role is your opportunity to drive large-scale, long-term national health system reform. Leverage your deep policy expertise and strategic agility to proactively influence legislation, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure sustainable access to cutting-edge healthcare for patients.

As the strategic analyst and implementation expert, you will report to the Government & External Affairs Lead. Your core mission is to shape a resilient market environment by addressing systemic healthcare challenges and championing policy changes that directly support our organization's strategic vision—both current and future.

Key Accountabilities

• Policy and Legislative Foresight: Conduct advanced Legislative Monitoring and Policy Analysis to deliver strategic intelligence, mitigate risks, and uncover opportunities for healthcare innovation.

• National Advocacy: Design and execute high-impact advocacy initiatives, including the development of compelling narratives, position papers, and white papers to advance our National Policy Shaping strategy.

• Stakeholder Ecosystem Collaboration: Build and maintain strategic partnerships with critical external stakeholders—policymakers, thought leaders, payers, and academic institutions—to build evidence and co-create solutions that generate mutual value for patient care and system efficiency.

• Integrated Strategy Execution: Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercialization Community to ensure a unified "OneRoche" approach in all external engagements and communications.

Candidate Profile
Education and Professional Experience

• Education: Master’s degree (required) in Business, Economy, Health Economics, Medicine, Pharmacy, or an equivalent academic background in Life Sciences.

• Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Reimbursement, Market/Patient Access, or Health Policy, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of healthcare financing, reimbursement systems, and relevant compliance frameworks.

• Minimum 7 years of professional experience within the Health Care sector in Slovakia.

Required Mindset and Competencies

• Strategic Agility: Ability to maintain a clear focus on the long-term vision while effectively navigating ambiguity, complexity, and uncertainty.

• System Thinking: Capacity to think and operate at an enterprise level, looking beyond organizational boundaries to achieve optimal outcomes for the local health environment.

• Impactful Communication: Exceptional skill in articulating complex value propositions and translating external insights into actionable intelligence for internal teams.

• Agile Mindset: Enthusiastic adoption of agile, self-managed working models based on trust, continuous learning, and adaptability.

• VACC Leadership: Embodies the principles of Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst, driving change both externally and internally.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 44,390.00 EUR - 82,450.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 大宮オフィス　〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16シーノ大宮ノースウイング　10F
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
I. Sales Target Setting and Management
• Support the preparation of annual and quarterly sales target-setting by providing historical data, market trends, and performance insights.

• Maintain and update sales performance against targets daily/weekly/monthly, identifying variances and provide data summaries to Sales Leadership for follow-up actions.

• Ensure targets are equitably distributed and clearly communicated across the sales force.

• Manage the sales performance relevant process(contract fillment, sales rebate, allowance)
II. Territory Design and Management
• Partner with sales leaders to develop and optimize sales territory structures to ensure fair opportunity distribution, minimize channel conflict, and maximize market coverage and penetration.

• Develop and maintain territory assignment rules and policies, performing regular audits and re-alignments based on business changes, market potential, and sales force size.

• Provide analysis and recommendations on optimal sales resource deployment and headcount planning.
III. Sales Performance Management and Market intelligence Analytics
• Develop, maintain, and disseminate key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards that provide clear, actionable insights into the health of the sales pipeline and overall performance.

• Conduct deep-dive analysis on sales trends, productivity metrics, and funnel conversion rates to identify bottlenecks and areas for process improvement.

• Support regular business review preparation and follow-up, including identifying performance gaps and tracking improvement actions.
IV. Tender coordination
• Partner with sales leaders to build the systematic approach to monitor and capture tender opportunities and follow up with the sales team.

• Filter the tender by portfolio and dispatch to the respective territory sales team

• Support sales team to prepare tender documentation and compilation .

V. Process Improvement and Enablement
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize core sales processes (e.g., forecasting, pipeline management, account planning).

• Partner with Sales Enablement to translate best practices and process improvements into effective training content and tools.
Compliance & Additional Tasks

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

• Perform other tasks as assigned by the line manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate.
To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

We create chemistry! Based on modern analytical methods and synthesis procedures we design and develop a great variety of chemical assay components for Dia and Pharma. With our domain knowledge and our wide spectrum of methods, we also accompany the whole lifecycle of active diagnostics ingredients.

We provide in “Chemistry Technologies” a full spectrum of chemical technologies from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers to find the right solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We design tailor-made molecules and develop lab scale procedures to provide a competitive advantage for our products.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Development of synthesis strategies within projects that require particularly complex nucleic acid chemical and organic syntheses

• Conducting these syntheses in the laboratory

• Observing the field of nucleic acid chemistry and modern preparative organic chemistry through literature and patent studies, and attending conferences

• Building and maintaining a network through contacts with external and internal experts

• Collaborating with cooperating partners, e.g., in the USA

• Ensuring the required technology through the generation of own IP

• Adhering to internal and external regulations regarding occupational safety and environmental protection, quality management, labor law, confidentiality, etc.

• Representing the team leadership at project meetings and assisting in the professional supervision of employees

Who you are

• You have completed a university degree in chemistry and additionally a PhD in the field of organic chemistry

• You are an expert in oligonucleotide synthesis and preparative organic synthesis as well as in the purification of synthesis products. You gained this special knowledge by working in the pharmaceutical industry for at least 3 -5 years.

• Ideally, you have experience with non-standard oligo building blocks and ultra high purity reagents for the synthesis of highly pure oligonucleotides and experience with large scale, high quality oligonucleotide synthesis

• At the same time, you bring good knowledge in nucleic acids, excellent chemical knowledge, and basic knowledge in biochemistry

• You are strong in communication, both in German and English

• To build a network, you know how to use and maintain your contacts to establish a good relationship of trust

• You also place a high value on good teamwork to find the best solutions and to assist in the professional supervision of employees

• Projektmanagement in an industrial setting is even so well known to you

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only your updated CV and your latest certificates.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .
