jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

• Str

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analizzatore senior Roche India – Servizi e Soluzioni Roche Chennai o Hyderabad Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche ha stabilito Global Analytics e Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) per guidare le soluzioni analitiche e tecnologiche, collaborando con gli affiliati Roche in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Senior Analyst, collaborerai a stretto contatto con il team Strategic Analytics & Insights con sede negli Stati Uniti, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads e il team GATE più ampio. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di fornire analisi avanzate e approfondimenti attuabili che supportano le priorità strategiche, in ultima analisi, mirando al massimo impatto con clienti e pazienti. La tua opportunità
• Progetti complessi di piombo e iniziative nelle operazioni commerciali di farmaci, concentrandosi sul monitoraggio delle prestazioni di marca, Panoramica del mercato delle malattie, Viaggi dei pazienti (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Previsione, Supporto e valutazione del lancio del prodotto, Aderenza paziente, Targeting del medico / Account, Payer Mix, Impatto di marketing e ROIs
• Collaborare con Therapy area manager, Ecosystem insights conduce e altri stakeholder aziendali per comprendere dinamiche di mercato e comportamenti dei clienti, sfruttando questa conoscenza per supportare le strategie basate sui dati
• Comprehend requisiti delle parti interessate, priorità dei compiti e gestire efficacemente le responsabilità quotidiane, tra cui liaising e il coordinamento con il team interno GATE per la consegna
• Guidare le discussioni di team e stakeholder, agire come partner di pensiero e fornire loro soluzioni e raccomandazioni di analisi di alta qualità
• Creare presentazioni efficaci per trasmettere informazioni e raccomandazioni cruciali agli stakeholder in modo efficace
• Partecipare alle riunioni con i team in diversi fusi orari per garantire una consegna regolare delle richieste analitiche e operative relative ai partner commerciali
• Prendere una mentalità aziendale, collegare le responsabilità individuali con un'organizzazione più ampia, concentrarsi sui risultati che forniscono la maggior parte del valore aziendale e paziente
• Sii flessibile per partecipare all'incontro durante le ore di lavoro sovrapposte IST/PST
• Fornire mentorship e formazione ai membri del team junior e agli stagisti sui principi di analisi e sul dominio Pharma, promuovendo lo sviluppo di set di competenze e capacità Chi sei
• Hai una laurea in Tecnologia o una disciplina rilevante, con una preferenza per Computer Science, Software, Statistica, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering e campi correlati e 4-8 anni di analisi / consulenza esperienza, con 2-5 anni specificamente nei progetti di analisi Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare. Preferibilmente, Master’s Degree o qualsiasi certificazione su analytics o data science sarebbe un vantaggio aggiuntivo.
• Deve dimostrare esperienza nelle operazioni commerciali di farmacia degli Stati Uniti e possedere un forte background in analisi delle vendite, analisi dei reclami, analisi dei prodotti, analisi dei pazienti, previsione e analisi ROI
• Esperienza con una serie di set di dati secondari, compresi i dati di vendita IQVIA, 867 dati, reclami LAAD, affiliazioni, interazioni sul campo, Veeva, dati medici, e altro ancora, è un vantaggio significativo
• L'esposizione a aree terapeutiche come oncologia, neurologia, immunologia, ecc., insieme a una conoscenza di lavoro di Salesforce o Veeva, è una valida qualifica aggiuntiva

• Diriger les discussions entre l'équipe et les intervenants, agir en tant que partenaire de réflexion et leur fournir des solutions et des recommandations d'analyse de haute qualité
• Créer des présentations efficaces pour transmettre aux intervenants des idées et des recommandations cruciales
• Assister à des réunions d'équipes dans différents fuseaux Prendre une attitude d'entreprise, relier les responsabilités individuelles à une organisation plus large, se concentrer sur les résultats qui fournissent la plus grande valeur aux entreprises et aux patients
• Être flexible pour assister à des réunions pendant les heures de travail recoupant IST/PST
• Offrir un mentorat et une formation aux membres de l'équipe junior et aux stagiaires sur les principes d'analyse et le domaine Pharma, favorisant le développement des compétences et des capacités Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en technologie ou d'une discipline pertinente, avec une préférence pour l'informatique, les logiciels, les statistiques, la science des données, l'IA, l'apprentissage automatique, le génie des données et les domaines connexes et 4-8 ans d'expérience en analyse / conseil, avec 2-5 ans spécifiquement dans les projets d'analyse Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare. De préférence, le diplôme de maîtrise ou toute certification en analyse ou en science des données serait un avantage supplémentaire.
• Doit faire preuve d'expertise dans les opérations commerciales de Pharma US et posséder une solide expérience dans l'analyse des ventes, l'analyse des revendications, l'analyse des produits, l'analyse des patients, la prévision et l'analyse du ROI
• Expérience avec une gamme de données secondaires, y compris les données de vente IQVIA, 867 données, les revendications LAAD, les affiliations, les interactions sur le terrain, Veeva, les données médicales, et plus encore, est un avantage significatif
• L'exposition à des domaines thérapeutiques comme l'oncologie, la neurologie, l'immunologie, etc., ainsi qu'une connaissance pratique de Salesforce ou Veeva, est une qualification supplémentaire précieuse

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员_ BC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:

• Products for the respective area of responsibility shall obtain Regulatory approvals in defined markets in close cooperation with other functions.

• The documents/deliverables for submissions are coordinated and compiled in a timely manner to support planned product registration timelines.

• The obtained Regulatory approvals/licenses products are maintained throughout the life cycle of the product by applying successful Regulatory change controls.

• The efficiency and the success of the Regulatory activities and strategies are maintained by clear agreements with other functions, stakeholders and external partners (authorities, companies, NBs etc).

• The regulatory requirements and strategic aspects are understood, communicated and implemented, kept up to date and are transparent within the organization.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory document and submission compilation:

• Oversees the development of submission/product registration dossiers of more complex products/programs. Develops and manages at least parts of comprehensive global regulatory submissions and registration plans. May act as mentor for more junior team members in this area.

2. External interface management:

• Understands the structure, key roles and responsibilities of external customers/stakeholders. Understands and communicates timely and effectively the needs of external customers/stakeholders. Builds effective and enduring external relationships and applies effective stakeholder management practices. Actively contributes to audits by supporting preparation, execution and follow up.

3. Regulatory knowledge and strategy:

• Leads the organization to adapt to evolving regulatory environment and requirements.

• Experience in solving complex, critical health authority issues or equivalent.

• Understanding of external environmental changes, precedents, to navigate complex situations and influence strategies and decision making.

• Ability to interpret and apply understanding of the regulators' thinking to projects and apply strategies to the different needs of different regions without significant guidance.

• Proactively creates unique/innovative regulatory strategies and influencing approaches to avoid regulatory obstacles and accelerate worldwide approvals.

4. Stakeholder management and influencing:

• Effectively partners with stakeholders to understand and provide best solutions. Takes initiative to address problems or opportunities and involves stakeholders for best solutions. Develops relationships that significantly influence the current and future direction for Roche and our products. Understands what motivates other people to perform at their best. Is skilled at managing and influencing peers. Fosters an exchange of ideas amongst key stakeholders to be able to shift perspectives to reach a common agreeable outcome. Negotiates with stakeholders and creates win-win compromises.

5. Decision making: :

• Has courage to make decisions even outside of scope/comfort zone.

• Proactively Initiates activities independently and initiates interactions across departments as applicable. Embrace the good decision making principles. Pushes decision making to the lowest appropriate level. Commits to decisions that have been made. Shows good judgment in decision making. Makes good decisions without necessarily having all the information in a timely manner.

6. Innovation and problem solving: :

• Drives innovation across the organization/sites. Advocates for and

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer within the AI Innovation workstream, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for the hands-on execution of our AI/ML security strategy. Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks.

Job Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).

• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.

• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​

2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory

• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.

• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.

• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams.

​
3. Proactive Defense & Automation

• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.

• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape.

​

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Educational Bac

A Field Services Engineer is responsible for performing the field service activities for Professional Diagnostics by provision and co-ordination of all activities relating to instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, software and hardware modification’s, relating to both pre and post sales requirements.
This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Support

• Take accountability for cases being resolved by receiving cases, contacting clients, providing telephonic support

• Coordinate the resolution of escalated technical cases by identifying issues that require escalation, referring to appropriate escalation processes, providing feedback to customers, internal sales and line manager, following up until resolved and closing cases within customer expectations.

• Proactively provide technical support to customers by receiving ad-hoc customer support requests while on site, after hours etc., by receiving request for support from customers, logging case on system, providing technical support and closing case or distributing case correctly immediately.

Modifications

Installations & De-Installations

• Initiate project installations / de-installations by being appointed as project installation lead, engaging with Project Manager, agreeing installation requirements and specifications, conducting site inspection, understanding customer expectations and Customer Service and Support

• Maintain a customer centric approach with all customer engagements by aligning with the Roche values, maintaining professionalism, providing quality technical support and advice and delivering according to their expectations and SLA at all times.

• Proactively resolve customer issues by conducting courtesy visits, identifying potential issues and resolving and taking preventative action at all times.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) .

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi mostrarti come be, assegnato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi essere, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come vogliono prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare che tutti hanno accesso tutti cura oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Cosa ti aspetta: La diagnostica laboratoristica è il cuore del nostro sistema sanitario e di fondamentale importanza per ogni singolo paziente. Stime approssimative che il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basano su test di diagnostica in vitro. La assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi la condizione base per diagnostica sicurezza e scelte mediche. Per il nostro programma di tirocinio stiamo cercando studenti motivati, tecnologicamente care e curiosi, che siano in grado di supportare concretamente il nostro team di servizio e di costruire con noi le basi per una di successo a Roche. Unisciti alla nostra organizzazione di servizio! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo portando avanti la diagnostica laboratoristica in Germania e stiamo attivamente plasmare il futuro del sistema sanitario. A Roche puoi portare ogni giorno le do idee e il tuo sapere teorico e pratico per risolvere questioni complesse nel team. Come tirocinante (m/w/d) seguirai i nostri collaboratori esperti nella pianificazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, immergerai profondamente la connessione IT dei nostri sistemi. Durante le do missioni quotidiane in diversi ospedali e laboratori privati, la tua iniziativa personale, la tua orientamento al cliente e le do abilità tecniche saranno richieste. Il tuo perfetto inizio: all'inizio del tuo tirocinio riceve un'addestramento fondato sulle nostre immunologia cobas®-systeme e sarai seguito da un mentore fermo o una mentore durante tutto il tuo impiego esterno. Sarai impiegato nella regione di Niedersachsen, Amburgo, Brema e potrai godere della libertà di scegliere il tuo luogo di residenza all'interno di questo territorio (ideale che sia nella regione di Amburgo, Hannover, Brema). I seguenti punti saranno al centro del tuo tirocinio nel servizio esterno:
• Formazione professionale: assolverai un addestramento di manutenzione specializzata a due moduli di immuno (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801) nel mese di settembre (28.09. - 02.10.2026).
• Pratica tecnica: dimostraerai le do abilità manuali e tecniche direttamente durante le installazioni di apparecchiature e le manutenzioni pregiudizi.
• Risoluzione dei problemi: ricevere una profonda comprensione dell'analisi e della risoluzione di complesse questioni tecniche e applicative e supporterai attivamente il nostro team nella ricerca delle cause.
• Cambio di prospettiva: ti concentrerai sui settori di chimica clinica e immunologia, ma avrai sempre la possibilità di conoscere altri settori interessantii dell'azienda attraverso le visite di ospitalità.
• Tema di futuro IT: i reti di rete IT e la sicurezza IT ti eccitano - durante l'installazione di firewall imparerai direttamente dagli esperti IT.
• Autonomia personale: porterai le do abilità organizzative e assumerai compiti di lavoro autonomi definiti (ad esempio, l'addestramento professionale dei nostri clienti nella utilizzazione della nostra piattaforma online Navify).
• Abilità di comunicazione: affinerai le do abilità di comunicazione nel dialogo diretto con i nostri clienti e nella discussione collettiva nel team.
• Flessibilità: compilauterai piccoli progetti autonomiamente a casa, ma la maggior parte del tempo sarai là dove si trovano le nostre apparecchiature: direttamente presso i nostri clienti.
• Campo di crescita: offriamo un ambiente di crescita e rispettoso, dove puoi sviluppare le do abilità e realizzare i tuoi obiettivi. Requisiti - Studente motivato, tecnologicamente esposti e curiosi - Abilità di comunicazione e di lavoro in team - Abilità di risoluzione dei problemi e pensiero di critico - Flessibilità e capacità di adattamento - Buone praticheve e di gestione del tempo - Conoscenza di base di IT e di rete - Disponibilità a lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione Cosa? - Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in continua evoluzione - Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale - Formazione professionale e continua - Collaborazione con un team di esperti - Accesso a risorse e strumenti di lavoro avanzato - Opportunità di partecipazione a progetti e iniziative innovative - Un ambiente di lavoro rispettoso e inclusivo Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarti al nostro programma di tirocinio, contattare a [inserisci il tuo indirizzo smalto o il tuo numero di telefono].

Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

jobs.title: Solution Architect, Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In alignment with our core corporate purpose—"Doing now what patients need next"—the Solution Architect provides strategic technical leadership and architectural governance to optimize our global supply chain and logistics systems. This critical role acts as the primary conduit between complex operational requirements and enterprise digital ecosystems, ensuring our warehouse management, material tracking, and cold-chain infrastructure remain scalable, resilient, and fully compliant.

The Opportunity
This position champions an integrated, system-wide approach focused on three core imperatives:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Design and govern the end-to-end technical architecture for warehouse operations, integrating ERP, WMS, and automated data monitoring tools.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure all technical platforms satisfy regulatory compliance boundaries while safeguarding the continuity of supply.

• Digital Transformation: Catalyze the modernization of legacy supply chain systems, introducing advanced automation, predictive data models, and unified communication matrices across local and external partner networks.

What You Do

• Formulate and articulate a compelling, long-term technical vision for our supply chain infrastructure, ensuring software systems scale seamlessly with product portfolio growth.

• Actively monitor and anticipate shifts in enterprise cloud capabilities, digital compliance requirements, and IoT tracking frameworks to engineer future-proof architectures.

• Author comprehensive architectural blueprints that seamlessly unify operational warehouse management systems (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) with global material planning frameworks (ERP / SAP), optimizing data synchronization and transaction velocity

• Partner with the Data Insights team to design well structured and real-time metric dashboards, enabling automated reporting.

• Act as an enterprise technical advisor to cross-functional teams, translating complex architectural choices into practical, operational realities for business stakeholders.

• Influence internal development teams and third-party vendors to adhere to rigid architectural standards, prioritizing continuous system refinement and robust cyber-security posture.

• Serve as the core technical connector bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics, and Corporate IT networks to eliminate digital friction.

• Lead the technical risk mitigation strategies required during the deployment of automated high-density storage platforms, cloud migrations, or shifting network structures.

• Design and maintain scalable system architectures that integrate core warehouse operations with peripheral data layers, emphasizing system uptime, data redundancy, and robust API frameworks.

• Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with enterprise software vendors and external integrators, ensuring deliverables satisfy rigorous service level agreements (SLAs).

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 5-8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise solution architecture and/or data engineering with documented success designing integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP) and modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) within high-density logistics networks.

Preferred Technical Credentials & Skills

• Architectural Frameworks: Certified in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In linea con il nostro scopo principale aziendale – "Doing now what clients need next" – Solution Architect fornisce leadership tecnica strategica e governance architettonica per ottimizzare la nostra supply chain globale e sistemi logistici. Questo ruolo critico agisce come il principale condotto tra complessi requisiti operativi e ecosistemi digitali aziendali, garantendo la nostra gestione del magazzino, il monitoraggio dei materiali e l'infrastruttura a catena fredda rimangono scalabili, resilienti e pienamente conformi.

L'opportunità
Questa posizione sostiene un approccio integrato a livello di sistema focalizzato su tre imperativi fondamentali:

• Progettazione e gestione dell'architettura tecnica end-to-end per le operazioni di magazzino, integrando ERP, WMS e strumenti di monitoraggio automatizzati dei dati.

• Integrità operativa: Assicurarsi che tutte le piattaforme tecniche soddisfino i limiti di conformità normativi, salvaguardando la continuità dell'offerta.

• Trasformazione digitale: catalizzare l'ammodernamento di sistemi di supply chain legacy, introducendo l'automazione avanzata, modelli di dati predittivi e matrici di comunicazione unificate attraverso le reti partner locali ed esterne.

Che cosa fai

• Formulare e articolare una visione tecnica convincente e a lungo termine per la nostra infrastruttura della supply chain, assicurando che i sistemi software si ingrandiscano senza soluzione di continuità con la crescita del portafoglio prodotti.

• Monitorare e anticipare attivamente i cambiamenti nelle capacità del cloud aziendale, nei requisiti di conformità digitale e nei framework di monitoraggio IoT per progettare architetture a prova di futuro.

• Autore di progetti architettonici completi che unificano senza soluzione di continuità i sistemi operativi di gestione del magazzino (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) con i framework di pianificazione dei materiali globali (ERP / SAP), ottimizzando la sincronizzazione dei dati e la velocità delle transazioni

• Collabora con il team Data Insights per progettare dashboard metriche ben strutturate e in tempo reale, consentendo una reportistica automatizzata.

• Agire come consulente tecnico aziendale per i team interfunzionali, traducendo scelte architettoniche complesse in realtà pratiche e operative per gli stakeholder aziendali.

• Influenza team di sviluppo interno e fornitori di terze parti per aderire a rigidi standard architettonici, dando priorità alla raffinatezza del sistema continuo e alla robusta postura della sicurezza informatica.

• Servire come il core connettore tecnico bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics e reti IT aziendali per eliminare l'attrito digitale.

• Guidare le strategie di mitigazione del rischio tecnico necessarie durante l'implementazione di piattaforme automatizzate di archiviazione ad alta densità, migrazioni cloud o strutture di rete di spostamento.

• Progettare e mantenere architetture di sistema scalabili che integrano le operazioni di magazzino core con gli strati di dati periferici, enfatizzando i tempi di uptime del sistema, la ridondanza dei dati e i framework API robusti.

• Valutare, selezionare e gestire le relazioni con i fornitori di software aziendali e gli integratori esterni, assicurando ai clienti di soddisfare rigorosi accordi di livello di servizio (SLA).

Chi sei

• Corso di laurea o master in informatica, tecnologia dell'informazione, ingegneria del software, sistemi di supply chain, o una disciplina tecnica correlata.

• 5-8 anni di esperienza progressiva nell'architettura delle soluzioni aziendali e/o nell'ingegneria dei dati con il successo documentato che progetta integrazioni per ERP (ad esempio SAP) e i moderni sistemi di gestione del magazzino (WMS) all'interno di reti logistiche ad alta densità.

Credenziali e competenze tecniche

• Quadri architettonici: Certificati in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, o

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
In Übereinstimmung mit unserem zentralen Unternehmenszweck - "Jetzt tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen" - bietet der Solution Architect strategische technische Führung und architektonische Governance zur Optimierung unserer globalen Lieferketten- und Logistiksysteme. Diese entscheidende Rolle fungiert als Hauptkanal zwischen komplexen betrieblichen Anforderungen und digitalen Ökosystemen von Unternehmen und stellt sicher, dass unser Lagermanagement, die Materialverfolgung und die Kühlketteninfrastruktur skalierbar, belastbar und vollständig konform bleiben.

Die Chance
Diese Position setzt sich für einen integrierten, systemweiten Ansatz ein, der sich auf drei zentrale Imperative konzentriert:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Konzipieren und verwalten Sie die durchgängige technische Architektur für den Lagerbetrieb und integrieren Sie ERP-, WMS- und automatisierte Datenüberwachungstools.

• Betriebliche Integrität: Sicherstellen, dass alle technischen Plattformen die gesetzlichen Compliance-Grenzen einhalten und gleichzeitig die Kontinuität der Versorgung gewährleisten.

• Digitale Transformation: Katalysieren Sie die Modernisierung von bestehenden Lieferkettensystemen, indem Sie fortschrittliche Automatisierung, prädiktive Datenmodelle und einheitliche Kommunikationsmatrizen in lokalen und externen Partnernetzwerken einführen.

Was Sie tun

• Formulieren und artikulieren Sie eine überzeugende, langfristige technische Vision für unsere Supply-Chain-Infrastruktur und stellen Sie sicher, dass Softwaresysteme nahtlos mit dem Wachstum des Produktportfolios skalierbar sind.

• Überwachen und antizipieren Sie aktiv Verschiebungen in den Enterprise-Cloud-Fähigkeiten, digitalen Compliance-Anforderungen und IoT-Tracking-Frameworks, um zukunftssichere Architekturen zu entwickeln.

• Autor umfassender architektonischer Entwürfe, die operative Lagerverwaltungssysteme (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) nahtlos mit globalen Materialplanungs-Frameworks (ERP / SAP) vereinheitlichen und die Datensynchronisation und Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit optimieren

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Data Insights-Team zusammen, um gut strukturierte und metrische Echtzeit-Dashboards zu entwerfen, die ein automatisiertes Reporting ermöglichen.

• Handeln Sie als technischer Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams und übersetzen Sie komplexe architektonische Entscheidungen in praktische, operative Realitäten für Geschäftsbeteiligte.

• Beeinflussen Sie interne Entwicklungsteams und Drittanbieter, um starre Architekturstandards einzuhalten und eine kontinuierliche Systemverfeinerung und eine robuste Cybersicherheitshaltung zu priorisieren.

• Dienen Sie als zentraler technischer Konnektor, der Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics und Corporate IT-Netzwerke verbindet, um digitale Reibung zu beseitigen.

• Führen Sie die technischen Risikominderungsstrategien, die bei der Bereitstellung automatisierter Speicherplattformen mit hoher Dichte, Cloud-Migrationen oder wechselnden Netzwerkstrukturen erforderlich sind.

• Konzipieren und pflegen Sie skalierbare Systemarchitekturen, die Core-Warehouse-Operationen mit peripheren Datenschichten integrieren, wobei Systemuptime, Datenredundanz und robuste API-Frameworks hervorgehoben werden.

• Bewerten, Auswählen und Verwalten von Beziehungen zu Anbietern von Unternehmenssoftware und externen Integratoren, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ergebnisse strenge Service Level Agreements (SLAs) erfüllen.

Wer du bist

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin.

• 5-8+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Unternehmenslösungsarchitektur und/oder Datentechnik mit dokumentiertem Erfolg bei der Gestaltung von Integrationen für ERP (z. B. SAP) und moderne Lagerverwaltungssysteme (WMS) in Logistiknetzwerken mit hoher Dichte.

Bevorzugte technische Credentials & Fähigkeiten

• Architectural Frameworks: Zertifiziert nach TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional oder

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Conformément à notre objectif principal – « Faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin » – l'architecte Solution fournit un leadership technique stratégique et une gouvernance architecturale pour optimiser notre chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et nos systèmes logistiques. Ce rôle essentiel sert de premier passage entre les exigences opérationnelles complexes et les écosystèmes numériques d'entreprise, assurant ainsi la gestion de notre entrepôt, le suivi des matériaux et l'infrastructure de la chaîne du froid.

L'opportunité
Ce poste appuie une approche intégrée à l'échelle du système axée sur trois impératifs fondamentaux :

• Plan d'architecture : Concevoir et gouverner l'architecture technique de bout en bout pour les opérations d'entrepôt, intégrer les outils ERP, WMS et de surveillance automatisée des données.

• Intégrité opérationnelle : Veiller à ce que toutes les plateformes techniques respectent les limites de conformité réglementaires tout en préservant la continuité de l'approvisionnement.

• Transformation numérique : catalysez la modernisation des anciens systèmes de chaîne d'approvisionnement, en introduisant une automatisation avancée, des modèles de données prédictives et des matrices de communication unifiées sur les réseaux partenaires locaux et externes.

Ce que vous faites

• Formuler et articuler une vision technique convaincante et à long terme de notre infrastructure de chaîne d'approvisionnement, en assurant l'échelle des systèmes logiciels sans heurt avec la croissance du portefeuille de produits.

• Surveiller et anticiper activement les changements dans les capacités cloud d'entreprise, les exigences de conformité numérique et les cadres de suivi IoT pour concevoir des architectures à l'épreuve de l'avenir.

• Auteur de plans architecturaux complets qui unifient de façon transparente les systèmes de gestion des entrepôts opérationnels (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) avec des cadres de planification des matériaux globaux (ERP / SAP), optimisant la synchronisation des données et la vitesse de transaction

• S'associer à l'équipe de Data Insights pour concevoir des tableaux de bord métriques bien structurés et en temps réel, permettant des rapports automatisés.

• Agir en tant que conseiller technique de l'entreprise auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles, transformant des choix architecturaux complexes en réalités pratiques et opérationnelles pour les intervenants commerciaux.

• Influencer les équipes de développement interne et les fournisseurs tiers sur le respect de normes architecturales rigides, en accordant la priorité au raffinement continu du système et à la robuste posture de cybersécurité.

• Servez-vous de la liaison technique de base Opérations d'entrepôt, Assurance de qualité, Global Logistics, et les réseaux informatiques d'entreprise pour éliminer la friction numérique.

• Diriger les stratégies techniques d'atténuation des risques requises lors du déploiement de plates-formes de stockage automatisées à haute densité, de migration des nuages ou de déplacement des structures réseau.

• Concevoir et maintenir des architectures de système évolutives qui intègrent les opérations d'entrepôt central avec les couches de données périphériques, en mettant l'accent sur le temps de disponibilité du système, la redondance des données et des cadres d'API robustes.

• Évaluer, sélectionner et gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs de logiciels d'entreprise et les intégrateurs externes, en veillant à ce que les produits livrables répondent à des accords de niveau de service rigoureux.

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, technologie de l'information, génie logiciel, systèmes de chaîne d'approvisionnement, ou une discipline technique connexe.

• 5-8 ans d'expérience progressive en architecture de solutions d'entreprise et/ou en ingénierie de données avec succès documenté conception d'intégrations pour ERP (p. ex. SAP) et systèmes modernes de gestion d'entrepôt (WMS) dans les réseaux logistiques à haute densité.

Titres de compétence et compétences techniques préférés

• Cadres architecturaux : certifiés en TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, ou

jobs.title: Marketing Support (Working Student)

titleByLocale.fr: Soutien à la commercialisation (étudiant en cours d'emploi)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and organized Working Student to join our Marketing department. In this part-time role, you will support our team across various marketing initiatives, from administrative tasks to digital media campaigns and creative coordination. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic diagnostics environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Administrative Support:

• Purchase Order (PO) creation and new vendor setup.

• General administrative support.

• Marketing Coordination:

• Coordinating product-related updates and communications across the Product Management team.

• Coordinating Marketing Team Meetings and corresponding tasks.

• Digital & Social Media:

• Creating content for social media channels and influencer campaigns.

• Facilitating communication with agencies and external partners.

• Marketing Materials Creation:

• Executing simple graphic design tasks.

• Performing translation checks.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a university degree program (e.g., Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field).

• Interested in healthcare and diagnostics.

• Fluent in English.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to balance administrative tasks with creative projects.

• Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected minimum hourly rate for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is From 7 EUR gross / hour. Pay for this position will be pro-rated for the contracted working hours. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

We believe in the potential of science, data and insights to improve the standard of care for humankind. We also believe the right to privacy is a fundamental human right. We process personal data with due care. Team members of the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team contribute their talents with a strong focus on collaboration and teamwork to support Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, North America affiliates and Group colleagues on privacy and digital legal matters.

As Senior Counsel, US Privacy, you would join our North America Digital & Privacy team to play a key role in providing legal advice on a wide range of matters related to data protection, digital initiatives, US privacy laws and regulations, and data governance.

The Opportunity

○ Provide guidance to key stakeholders including, other Legal and Compliance colleagues, the business and the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team in order to support the organizations’ compliance with US state and federal privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, TCPA), and other applicable data protection and privacy laws and regulations. Such guidance may include:
• ○ Review privacy impact assessments for new projects and technologies and advise on risk mitigation strategies.
• ○ Support the Diagnostics US Privacy Office in developing and maintaining policies, procedure and communications.
• ○ Develop and conduct training programs for our Legal and Compliance colleagues and other workforce members on compliance with data privacy laws and best practices for data governance.
• ○ Review and negotiate contracts with third parties, ensuring that data protection and privacy clauses align with Roche’s policies and positions.
• ○ Advise and support during the response to a suspected Breach or other data privacy incidents, including internal investigations and advising on notification and reporting obligations.
• ○ Stay updated on applicable cybersecurity requirements, new digital technologies like blockchain, AI, and the Internet of Things and advise on their legal implications.
○ Develop and maintain networks by working closely with other Legal and Compliance colleagues, IT security, People & Culture, Finance, Support Services, and other business teams to ensure a cohesive approach to US data protection and digital operations.

Who You Are

You are someone who has:

● A Doctor of Jurisprudence from an ABA-accredited law school, licensed to practice law in one or more of the 50 states in good standing.
● At least eight (8) years’ experience practicing law at a large- to medium-sized law firm or experience within a privacy, compliance, legal or contracting department in a Life Sciences company (i.e., Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech).
● Knowledge of, and working experience advising on data privacy and digital matters, federal, state, and international information security and privacy laws, rules, regulations, and industry standards (such as HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR).
● Experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating; experience with information security and privacy provisions in agreements, Business Associate Agreements and data transfer or processing agreements is preferred.
● A demonstrated ability to establish and maintain open, candid, collaborative, and trusting work relationships.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Crediamo nel potenziale della scienza, dei dati e delle intuizioni per migliorare lo standard di cura per l'umanità. Crediamo anche che il diritto alla privacy sia un diritto umano fondamentale. Elaboriamo i dati personali con la dovuta cura. I membri del team Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy contribuiscono al loro talento con una forte attenzione alla collaborazione e al lavoro di squadra per supportare le aree clienti diagnostiche Roche, le affiliate del Nord America e i colleghi del Gruppo sulla privacy e questioni legali digitali. B. HIPAA, CCPA / CPRA, TCPA) und anderer anwendbarer Datenschutz- und Datenschutzgesetze und -vorschriften zu unterstützen. Unterstützung des Diagnostics US Privacy Office bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Kommunikation. - Entwicklung und Durchführung von Schulungsprogrammen für unsere Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen und andere Mitarbeiter zur Einhaltung der Datenschutzgesetze und Best Practices für Data Governance. - Überprüfung und Verhandlung von Verträgen mit Dritten, um sicherzustellen, dass Datenschutz- und Datenschutzklauseln mit den Richtlinien und Positionen von Roche übereinstimmen. - Beratung und Unterstützung bei der Reaktion auf einen vermuteten Verstoß oder andere Datenschutzvorfälle, einschließlich interner Untersuchungen und Beratung bei Benachrichtigungs- und Berichtspflichten. Bleiben Sie über die geltenden Cybersicherheitsanforderungen, neue digitale Technologien wie Blockchain, KI und das Internet der Dinge auf dem Laufenden und beraten Sie über ihre rechtlichen Auswirkungen. - Aufbau und Pflege von Netzwerken durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen, IT-Sicherheit, People & Culture, Finanzen, Support Services und anderen Geschäftsteams, um einen kohärenten Ansatz für den Datenschutz und den digitalen Betrieb in den USA zu gewährleisten.
• Requisiti - Ein Doktor der Jurisprudenz von einer ABA-akkreditierten juristischen Fakultät, lizenziert, um Recht in einem oder mehreren der 50 Staaten in gutem Ansehen zu üben. - Mindestens acht (8) Jahre Erfahrung in der Rechtspraxis in einer großen bis mittleren Anwaltskanzlei oder Erfahrung in einer Datenschutz-, Compliance-, Rechts- oder Vertragsabteilung in einem Life Sciences-Unternehmen (d. H. Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech). - Kenntnis und Berufserfahrung in Bezug auf Datenschutz und digitale Angelegenheiten, Bundes-, Landes- und internationale Informationssicherheits- und Datenschutzgesetze, Regeln, Vorschriften und Industriestandards (wie HIPAA, CCPA, DSGVO). - Erfahrung bei der Überprüfung, Erstellung und Verhandlung; Erfahrung mit Informationssicherheits- und Datenschutzbestimmungen in Vereinbarungen, Geschäftspartnervereinbarungen und Datenübertragungs- oder Verarbeitungsvereinbarungen wird bevorzugt. Eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, offene, offene, kooperative und vertrauensvolle Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten. - Die Fähigkeit, ein unabhängiges Urteilsvermögen auszuüben und eine konsistente Botschaft angesichts von Druck oder Widrigkeiten zu vermitteln und mit Vertrauen zu arbeiten und zu pflegen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Nous croyons au potentiel de la science, des données et des idées pour améliorer le niveau de soins pour l'humanité. Nous croyons également que le droit à la vie privée est un droit fondamental de la personne. Nous traitons les données personnelles avec soin. Les membres de l'équipe de Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy apportent leurs talents en mettant fortement l'accent sur la collaboration et le travail d'équipe pour soutenir Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, les affiliés nord-américains et les collègues du Groupe sur les questions de confidentialité et de droit numérique. En tant qu'avocat principal, United States Privacy, vous vous joindriez à notre équipe North America Digital & Privacy pour jouer un rôle clé dans la prestation de conseils juridiques sur un large éventail de questions liées à la protection des données, aux initiatives numériques, aux lois et règlements américains sur la protection de la vie privée et à la gouvernance des données. Opportunità - Fournir des conseils aux intervenants clés, y compris aux autres collègues juridiques et de conformité, à l'entreprise et à l'équipe de Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy afin de soutenir les organisations. Ces lignes directrices peuvent comprendre : - Examiner les évaluations des répercussions sur la vie privée des nouveaux projets et des nouvelles technologies et donner des conseils sur les stratégies d'atténuation des risques. - Soutenir le Diagnostics US Privacy Office dans l'élaboration et le maintien de politiques, procédures et communications. - Élaborer et diriger des programmes de formation à l'intention de nos collègues juridiques et de conformité et d'autres membres de l'effectif sur la conformité aux lois sur la protection des données et aux pratiques exemplaires en matière de gouvernance des données. - Examiner et négocier des contrats avec des tiers, en veillant à ce que les clauses de protection des données et de protection de la vie privée soient conformes aux politiques et aux positions de Roches. - Conseiller et appuyer pendant la réponse à une infraction présumée ou à d'autres incidents liés à la confidentialité des données, y compris les enquêtes internes et donner des conseils sur les obligations de notification et de déclaration. - Restez à jour sur les exigences applicables en matière de cybersécurité, les nouvelles technologies numériques comme la blockchain, l'IA et l'Internet des objets et donnez des conseils sur leurs implications juridiques. - Développer et maintenir les réseaux en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec d'autres collègues juridiques et de conformité, la sécurité informatique, People & Culture, Finance, Services de soutien, et d'autres équipes d'affaires pour assurer une approche cohérente de la protection des données américaines et des opérations numériques.
• Requisiti - Docteur en droit d'une école de droit agréée par l'ABA, autorisée à pratiquer le droit dans un ou plusieurs des 50 États en règle. - Oui. Au moins huit (8) ans d'expérience pratique du droit dans un grand ou moyen cabinet d'avocats ou expérience au sein d'un service de protection de la vie privée, de conformité, juridique ou contractuel dans une entreprise des sciences de la vie (p. ex., Pharma, Diagnostics, Appareils, Biotech). - Connaissance des lois, des règles, des règlements et des normes de l'industrie sur la protection des données et les questions numériques, ainsi que sur la sécurité de l'information et la protection de la vie privée à l'échelle fédérale, des États et internationale (comme HIPAA, CCPA, RGPD). - Expérience de l'examen, de la rédaction et de la négociation; l'expérience des dispositions relatives à la sécurité de l'information et à la protection des renseignements personnels dans les accords, les accords commerciaux associés et les accords de transfert ou de traitement de données est privilégiée. - Une capacité démontrée d'établir et de maintenir des relations de travail ouvertes, franches, collaboratives et confiantes. - Oui. Capacité à exercer un jugement indépendant et à transmettre un message cohérent face à la pression ou à l'adversité, et à travailler avec et maintenir la confiance

jobs.title: （Senior) Specialist - Filling/分装(高级)专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Product Owner for our Source-to-Procure (S2P) ecosystem, you bridge the gap between technical execution and business objectives. Working at an advanced professional level alongside Senior Product Managers, you own the product backlog and drive the execution of our digital procurement roadmap. You join a collaborative, forward-thinking Informatics team focused on delivering enterprise-scale value.
In this role, you will:

• Own and prioritize the S2P product backlog, translating strategic business goals into actionable technical user stories.

• Lead the end-to-end scope and execution of large-scale S2P initiatives, managing dependencies across cross-functional teams.

• Optimize delivery methodologies by tailoring frameworks like Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or ITSM to maximize efficiency and maintain high quality.

• Act as a trusted advisor to a diverse group of stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments to align expectations and build consensus.

• Diagnose system bottlenecks and lead root-cause analysis to design and validate technical or workflow enhancement plans.

• Mentor team members , fostering a collaborative spirit, driving mutual accountability, and guiding the team through ambiguity.

Who You Are

You are a versatile, analytical professional who thrives at the intersection of agile delivery and procurement technology. You are a natural facilitator who handles uncertainty with a pragmatic mindset and communicates effortlessly with both technical and business partners.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• 6-8 years of experience working with procurement platforms (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting, or Requisition-to-Pay), including at least 2 years supporting the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• A proven track record of leading the delivery of complex features, major product releases, or service transitions within a product ownership or delivery management capacity.

• Versatile framework expertise with hands-on experience navigating environments as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Agile Coach.

• Strong strategic acumen with a demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into structured implementation roadmaps and technical delivery strategies.

• Advanced problem-solving skills and proficiency with modern delivery tools to analyze dependencies, run root-cause analysis, and optimize workflows.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills , with a coaching mindset

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
LEL 区域生态圈负责人
Local Ecosystem Lead

生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Data Ingegnere - Security Insights and Automation

titleByLocale.de: Data Ingenieur - Security Insights and Automation
