jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Security Insights and Automation Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure within the Roche’s DataOne ecosystem. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, implementing decentralized Data Products following Data Mesh principles, utilizing strong programming skills in Python, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Snowflake.

Job Responsibilities:

• Data Architecture & Pipeline Engineering : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable end-to-end data pipelines using Talend, dbt, and Python. Ensure all architectures are scalable, secure, and aligned with the Data Mesh standards. .

• Security Intelligence Support: Transform raw security telemetry and vulnerability data into high-quality feature sets for predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and automated risk scoring. .

• Stakeholder Management: Engages directly with broader business units and data scientists to thoroughly understand and meet their data needs. Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Visualization & Insights: Support the mastery of Tableau and ThoughtSpot by ensuring underlying data structures and schemas are optimized for intuitive executive narratives and self-service analytical apps.

• System Optimization: Solve complex data ingestion problems and perform expert-level Snowflake table optimizations and schema designs. Leads high-impact, large-scale data engineering initiatives by implementing robust strategies and integrating complex, diverse infrastructures to ensure seamless organizational data flow.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data engineering projects and managing complex, large-scale data systems.

• Proven track record of independently building ETL/ELT processes and optimizing data storage solutions such as data warehouses and data lakes.

• Experience ensuring data quality, reliability, and monitoring data systems

Technical Skills

• Expert SQL & Snowflake : Advanced proficiency in designing Snowflake data structures, schemas, and performance optimizations.

• Advanced Programming: Expert-level Python or Scala for data engineering and Gitlab for version control and orchestration.

• Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with dbt for transformation and Talend for integration.

• Data Mesh & AI/ML: Solid understanding of decentralized Data Mesh principles and preparing data for AI/ML initiatives (e.g., feature engineering).

• BI Tooling: Technical capability to support advanced visualizations in Tableau and ThoughtSpot.

• API Integration: Expertise in consuming and exposing APIs to integrate security insights across the enterprise ecosystem

Additional Qualifications
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to engage effectively with both technical audiences (like data scientists) and non-technical business stakeholders.

jobs.title: (Sr) AI Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Serving as the Lead Architect of AI Transformation, this role is the visionary and technical engine behind redefining how the organization builds software. Much like a technical evangelist and researcher, you will bridge the gap between "Research AI" and "Applied AI Engineering." Your mission is to revolutionize the engineering lifecycle through AI, establish world-class methodologies for AI-native product development, and act as a high-impact coach to transition the entire engineering team into an AI-augmented powerhouse. You will ensure we don't just "use AI," but fundamentally change how we engineer for the future.

The Opportunity:

AI-Driven Engineering Transformation

• Methodology Research: Deeply research and define the next generation of software engineering workflows (e.g., Software 2.0, Agentic Workflows, AI-assisted coding architectures).

• Process Redesign: Diagnose existing engineering bottlenecks and deploy AI tools/frameworks to automate and optimize the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), achieving radical efficiency gains.

• Evolutionary Catalyst: Serve as a "Strategic Catalyst" to steer the engineering culture toward an AI-Native mindset.

Product Engineering & AI Integration

• AI Engineering Excellence: Design and oversee the implementation of robust, scalable AI engineering patterns (LLMOps, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning pipelines) to bring AI capabilities into the core product portfolio.

• Agile Prototyping: Rapidly translate the latest breakthroughs in AI research (from multi-modal models to reasoning-step optimizations) into production-ready features with an agile, hands-on approach.

• Technical Interpretation: Translate complex algorithmic logic and technical constraints into actionable business roadmaps and product strategies.

Capability Building & Knowledge Hub

• Master Educator: Design and lead high-level AI training programs for senior engineers and architects, focusing on Prompt Engineering, model evaluation, and AI-native architecture.

• AI Knowledge Hub: Build and iterate an enterprise-level repository of AI best practices, reusable code patterns, and internal benchmarks to ensure consistent technical excellence.

• Talent Coaching: Mentor engineering leads on how to leverage AI to scale their own teams’ output and creative capacity.

Who you are:

Education & Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

• A proven track record of open-source contributions or technical thought leadership in the AI space.

Experience

• 5+ years of senior engineering experience, with at least 3+ years specifically focused on deploying AI/ML systems at scale.

• Experience in Digital Transformation or leading large-scale engineering team transitions is highly preferred.

Professional Capabilities/Skills

• AI Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in LLMs, Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and modern AI infrastructure (GPU orchestration, vector databases).

• Engineering Methodology: Strong opinions, weakly held, on software architecture, clean code in the age of AI, and "Human-in-the-loop" engineering systems.

• Business Acumen: The ability to match bleeding-edge AI capabilities with specific market pain points and IVD/Tech business scenarios.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional communication and "Change Management" capabilities—the ability to inspire a team to unlearn old habits an

AI-Driven Engineering Transformation

• Process Redesign: Diagnose existing engineering bottlenecks and deploy AI tools/frameworks to automate and optimize the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), achieving radical efficiency gains.

La position de votre ministère

Dans le cadre d'une organisation matricielle mondiale, la division «Pharma Operations Penzberg» développe et produit des ingrédients actifs biotechnologiques pour des médicaments innovants pour le bénéfice de nos patients de plus de 1 000 employés. Afin d'assurer une production optimale et efficace, nous fournissons la production active avec des milieux purs (WFI, CI, vapeur pure, gaz) et en cas d'une activité majeure d'entretien et d'entretien autour de nos installations de production et bâtiments.

Nous sommes une équipe de 7 employés et travaillons sur toute la gamme de sujets BPF (gestion de documents, déviations, formation, contrôle du changement, gestion du risque de qualité).Après une introduction intensive aux exigences de base BPF, nous voulons vous impliquer dans les sujets de la gestion de documents et de la gestion du risque de qualité.

Vos tâches

En tant que stagiaire, vous accompagnez les employés du Service Services et Ingénierie GMP et vous exécutez les activités suivantes par vous-même, selon vos instructions ou spécifications:

- Création de documents de gestion des risques de qualité - activités d'assurance de la qualité supplémentaires au besoin

Cette activité est également largement possible sur demande, principalement sous la forme d'un ordinateur à distance. Un ordinateur portable est fourni. Il n'y a aucune réclamation pour l'équipement supplémentaire pour le travail mobile.

Votre profil

- Vous êtes actuellement inscrit à un baccalauréat ou à une maîtrise en sciences naturelles ou vous êtes dans une année de pointe - Vous avez idéalement une première connaissance dans le domaine des services publics propres et des connaissances théoriques et pratiques de base dans l'analyse et la préparation des questions techniques - Vous aimez travailler dans la matrice - Vous pouvez bien vous organiser, travailler structuré et avoir de très bonnes compétences en communication - Très bonnes compétences allemandes sont une condition préalable - Vous êtes bon en anglais

Vos avantages

- Temps partagé flexible - 2268 € par mois pour un stage à temps plein - Réseautage avec d'autres étudiants (en ligne/hors ligne) - Prix réduits (-5%) dans notre cantine - Centre de fitness sur le campus de Roche - Possibilités de formation et présentations d'invités passionnants - Possibilité d'hébergement à la Maison de Pension Roche - Liaison bien-être-organisationd à Munich avec notre navette Roche

Votre demande

Rappelez-vous que ce stage s'adresse aux étudiants (m/p/p) qui sont inscrits tout au long de la période du stage ou, à défaut, aux personnes dans un maximum d'une année de congé (entre le baccalauréat et la maîtrise), où il peut être démontré par écrit à laquelle université/université et exactement quand (mois/année) les études sont poursuivies dans un délai d'un an.

Veuillez noter que les recommandations pour toutes les activités des étudiants (par exemple les stages, les thèses, etc.) sont exclues.

Période : désormais ou par accord pour une période de 6 mois (jusqu'à 37,5 h/semaine) ou 12 mois (20 h/semaine)

jobs.title: Planning and Logistics Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
As the Planning and Logistics Partner, you will work together with the Supply Chain Lead to manage the availability of supply of goods in the Malaysia market, logistics operation, inventory management and material master maintenance.
You will analyze and challenge their inputs to ensure sufficient inventory in Malaysia market, while balancing write-off levels error-free and ensure smooth process from importation all the way to the custom clearance of goods into our designated warehouse.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will

• Support the Supply Chain lead in various topics to ensure confidence in RDMY Supply Chain function.

• Drive S&OP meetings with Sales and Marketing to understand demand and forecasts of the market.

• Work closely with the sales and marketing for demand forecasting.

• Manage operations for inter-company purchases & order placement.

• Manage and monitor the performance of 4PL and forwarding agent.

• Manage the import and custom clearance operation ensuring all goods arrive at the warehouses without delay.

• Manage instruments and spare parts warehouse operation and deliveries.

• Material master and install base record creation and maintenance.

• Perform monthly inventory reconciliation.

• Monitor EDI process for goods receiving and material movement by 4PL.

• Work together with internal RA/QA team to maintain Global quality standards for operations.

• Identify process gaps and improvements to be implemented to improve the financial health of the company.

• Support and implement Global tools/projects.

Any other tasks or projects assigned from time to time.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Stagiaire - Relations Sociales (f/h/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En tant que stagiaire au sein de l'équipe Relations Sociales de la Direction People & Culture de l'entreprise Roche France, votre rôle consistera à contribuer à la réussite des projets RH.

Quel sera ton impact ?
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Responsables des Relations Sociales de deux entités (Roche Diagnostics, Roche Pharma) pour notamment:

• Aider à l'organisation des réunions des instances en conformité avec les réglementations légales.

• Mener des etudes spécifiques liées notamment a la Base de Données Économique et Sociale et Environnement (BDESE) et autres rapports sociaux.

• Aider à la gestion des dossiers individuels de rupture de contrat.

• Organiser et animer une veille juridique sociale.

Ton ADN :
En formation de niveau bac+5 dans le domaine du Droit social (Master 2 ou école avocat), vous :

• Souhaitez acquérir une expérience dans un environnement international.

• Êtes une personne rigoureuse, curieuse, autonome dans votre travail.

• Êtes capable de travailler en équipe et de faire preuve de polyvalence.

• Êtes connu(e) pour votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, votre capacité rédactionnelle, et votre écoute.

Poste basé à Meylan (Isère, 38)
Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /

Chez Roche, nous considérons que la diversité est source d'innovation. Nous sommes ouverts à tous les profils et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail agréable et inclusif.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires / les alternants comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature !

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: SHE (Safety, Health, & Environment) Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Diagnostics' dynamic Carlsbad and San Diego operations as an experienced SHE (Safety, Health, and Environment) leader ready to make a meaningful impact. In this strategic leadership role, you'll direct comprehensive safety, health, and environmental initiatives across our thriving 24/6 manufacturing and R&D facilities, building a culture of proactive protection that safeguards our people, environment, and business continuity. Reporting to the Director of Sites, SHE, & Security, you'll lead a dedicated SHE team and collaborate cross-functionally to embed best practices throughout the organization—transforming strategic vision into operational excellence.

The Opportunity

• Lead day-to-day and long-term strategic SHE operations at a 24/6 manufacturing and Research & Development business, while leading a team of SHE professionals to protect employees, environment, property, and business continuity.

• Develop, implement, and lead a comprehensive SHE management system aligned with Roche corporate directives and all local, regional, state, and federal regulatory requirements.

• Develop and drive business goals that promote a proactive SHE culture tailored to local needs while meeting Roche SHE objectives.

• Drive continual improvement within the SHE team to develop internal capabilities and capacities through individual growth, team development, and process optimization.

• Monitor, document, and report SHE KPIs, trends, and implementation progress while ensuring risk management and assessment guide continual improvement in site performance.

• Lead or participate in investigations into critical incidents affecting the company, including injuries, environmental releases, and security events, and provide site leadership during SHE inspections and audits.

• Manage financial provisions for the SHE department and establish/maintain relationships with local SHE authorities, professional organizations, and regulatory bodies.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Science and/or Engineering-related field, with professional certifications such as CIH, CSP, CBSP, or REM preferred.

• 8+ years in a similar SHE leadership role with demonstrated technical expertise and people leadership experience.

• Extensive project management, organizational change management, and experience working in matrix and multi-cultural environments.

• Substantial experience working with diverse senior leaders and ability to communicate effectively in spoken and written English.

• Regular travel between local sites required; occasional travel to US and International locations necessary.

This position is not eligible for relocation.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $105,000 - $195,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility

titleByLocale.it: フィールドカイエンティスト(東京)
titleByLocale.en: フィールドサイエンティスト（検査センター）
titleByLocale.de: フィールドサイエンティスト（東京）
titleByLocale.fr: フィールドサイエンティスト（東京）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。
診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。
学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。

titleByLocale.it: Senior Cybersecurity Ingegnere for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.en: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.de: Senior Cybersecurity Ingenieur for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Cybersecurity Ingénieur for Secure Access Network

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee ingress and egress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are delivered through leading-edge security platforms, automation, and orchestration .
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Network Security), you will act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access Network Services, leading the evolution of Network Access Control, identity-driven security, segmentation and authentication services across Roche's global enterprise.
Your mission is to ensure that Roche’s network remains resilient and compliant through the continuous evolution of our "Defense in Depth" strategy.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Technical Leadership

• Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access technologies, providing deep technical expertise in the evaluation and selection of emerging security tools.

• Drive the long-term technical roadmap for network access, ensuring all initiatives are strictly aligned with Roche's Zero Trust security architecture and strategy.

• Partner with business units to translate high-level security requirements into actionable, scalable technical initiatives and functional policies.

• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence within the team.

Identity-Based Access and Authentication

• Design, deploy, and maintain robust authentication solutions utilizing protocols such as 802.1X, EAP-TLS, EAP-TEAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, SAML, and MFA.

• Integrate disparate security platforms with enterprise Identity Providers (IdPs) to ensure a seamless and secure authentication flow across the environment.

• Architect and manage highly available authentication services to support Roche's global workforce and critical business operations.

Network Access Control (NAC) and Segmentation

• Lead the end-to-end lifecycle management of Cisco ISE deployments, including software upgrades, capacity planning, and platform optimization.

• Develop and refine endpoint profiling techniques to accurately identify and secure corporate, medical, and IoT devices.

• Implement advanced access control mechanisms , including Dot1x, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), Guest Access, and posture-based authorization.

• Design and oversee the implementation of Cisco TrustSec and Scalable Group Tag (SGT)-based micro-segmentation to reduce the network attack surface.

Operational Excellence and Automation

• Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex technical incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive observability, monitoring, and reporting dashboards to track platform health and security compliance.

• Advocate for and implement Infrastruct

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du willst an Lösungen arbeiten, die wirklich etwas bewegen – für Menschen, Umwelt und Zukunft? Dann werde Teil unseres Energy Supply Teams am Roche-Standort Mannheim und hilf mit, unsere ambitionierten Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen.
Hier arbeitest du mit an der Umsetzung unserer Dekarbonisierungsstrategie, der Optimierung von Energieverbräuchen und der Weiterentwicklung innovativer Versorgungssysteme – direkt an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Nachhaltigkeit und Industrie. Du unterstützt mit deiner Arbeit das Team, das als zentraler Dienstleister für die Energie- und Medieninfrastruktur des Werks Mannheim verantwortlich ist.

Wer wir sind:
Roche ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Pharma und Diagnostik mit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, das durch Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit die Lebensqualität der Menschen verbessert. An unserem Standort Mannheim arbeiten rund 9.000 Mitarbeitende an innovativen Lösungen für eine bessere Gesundheitsversorgung.
In unserer Abteilung Energy Supply arbeiten wir daran, den ökologischen Fußabdruck unseres Produktionsstandortes zu minimieren – durch technische Innovationen, intelligente Energiemonitoringsysteme und konkrete Maßnahmen zur CO₂-Reduktion.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du entwickelst smarte Energie-KPIs und Dashboards zur Visualisierung von Verbräuchen, um Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

• Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung einer mobilen Energiemessungen, um auf Anlagenebene Verbräuche darzustellen.

• Du unterstützt bei der Identifikation von Ineffizienzen (z.B. gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen).

• Du hilfst mit der grafischen Aufbereitung von Verbrauchsdaten zur Überprüfung der Wirksamkeit umgesetzter technischer Maßnahmen.

• Du übernimmst die Erstellung von Entwürfen für die jährlichen Kurzberichte sowie die Abschlussberichte nach Ende der Optimierungsphase gemäß Prozessvorgabe.

• Du übernimmst eigenständig kleine Teilprojekte und setzt deine Ideen direkt um.

Das bringst Du mit:

• Studium: Du studierst im Bereich Energie-, Umwelt-, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Versorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und bist für die Dauer des Praktikums immatrikuliert.

• Begeisterung: Du bringst Leidenschaft mit für die Themen der Nachhaltigkeit und Technik.

• Sprachen: Du besitzt sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch

Deine Vorteile:

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche) & attraktive Vergütung von 2.268 €/Monat > 3 Monate

• Home-Office Möglichkeit

• Rabatt von -50 % auf Kantinenessen

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Umfassendes Onboarding und Mentoring & Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Erfahre mehr über unseren Standort Penzberg:
https://www.roche.de/unternehmen/unsere-standorte/mannheim

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf, ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse/Bescheinigungen online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Start: ab August 2026
Dauer des Praktikums : max. 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future dr

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Vuoi lavorare su soluzioni che facciano davvero la differenza – per le persone, l’ambiente e il futuro? Allora entra a far parte del nostro team Energy Supply presso la sede di Roche Mannheim e aiutaci a raggiungere i nostri ambiziosi obiettivi di sostenibilità.
Qui lavorerai all'attuazione della nostra strategia di decarbonizzazione, all'ottimizzazione del consumo energetico e all'ulteriore sviluppo di sistemi di fornitura innovativi, direttamente nell'interfaccia tra tecnologia, sostenibilità e industria. Con il vostro lavoro sostenete il team che, in qualità di fornitore di servizi centrale, è responsabile dell'infrastruttura energetica e dei media dello stabilimento di Mannheim.

Chi siamo:

Roche è un leader globale nel settore farmaceutico e diagnostico con oltre 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, migliorando la qualità della vita delle persone attraverso l'innovazione e la sostenibilità. Nella nostra sede di Mannheim, circa 9.000 dipendenti lavorano su soluzioni innovative per una migliore assistenza sanitaria.
Nel nostro reparto Energy Supply, lavoriamo per ridurre al minimo l’impronta ecologica del nostro sito produttivo – attraverso innovazioni tecniche, sistemi intelligenti di monitoraggio energetico e misure concrete per ridurre la CO₂.

I tuoi compiti:

- Sviluppi KPI e dashboard energetici intelligenti per visualizzare i consumi al fine di identificare il potenziale di ottimizzazione.
- Sostieni l'implementazione e l'ulteriore sviluppo di misurazioni energetiche mobili per visualizzare i consumi a livello di sistema.
- Supporti l'identificazione delle inefficienze (ad esempio riscaldamento e raffreddamento simultanei).
- Aiuterai nella preparazione grafica dei dati di consumo per verificare l'efficacia delle misure tecniche implementate.
- Sei responsabile della creazione di bozze per i brevi rapporti annuali e dei rapporti finali dopo la fine della fase di ottimizzazione in conformità con le specifiche del processo.
- Ti occupi autonomamente di piccoli sottoprogetti e realizzi direttamente le tue idee.

Questo è quello che porti con te:

- Studi: stai studiando nel campo dell'energia, dell'ambiente, dell'ingegneria industriale, dell'ingegneria meccanica, dell'ingegneria delle forniture o di un corso di studi comparabile e sei iscritto per la durata dello stage.
- Entusiasmo: hai passione per i temi della sostenibilità e della tecnologia.
- Lingue: hai ottime competenze linguistiche in tedesco e inglese

I tuoi vantaggi:

- Orario di lavoro flessibile (37,5 ore settimanali) e remunerazione interessante di € 2.268/mese > 3 mesi
- Opzione ufficio a casa
- Sconto del -50% sul cibo della mensa
- Centro fitness nel campus Roche
- Onboarding, tutoraggio e networking completi con altri studenti

Scopri di più sulla nostra sede a Penzberg:
https://www.roche.de/unternehmen/unsere-standorte/mannheim

La tua candidatura

Carica online il tuo CV, una breve lettera di motivazione e le relative referenze/certificati.

Si ricorda che questo tirocinio è rivolto a studenti (m/f/d) attualmente iscritti o in alternativa a persone in gap year (tra studi triennali e magistrali).

Inizio: da agosto 2026
Durata dello stage: max. 6 mesi

Aspettiamo con ansia la tua candidatura!

Si ricorda che sono escluse le segnalazioni per tutte le attività svolte dagli studenti (es. tirocini, tesi, ecc.).

Il tuo contatto con noi! Con le persone. Per le persone.

Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto?
Dai un'occhiata alle nostre domande frequenti, le troverai tramite https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Un futuro più sano

The Position

You want to work on solutions that really make a difference – for people, the environment and the future? Then join our Energy Supply team at the Roche site in Mannheim and help achieve our ambitious sustainability goals. Here you are working on the implementation of our decarbonization strategy, the optimization of energy consumption and the further development of innovative supply systems – directly at the interface of technology, sustainability and industry.

With your work, you support the team, which is responsible for the energy and media infrastructure of the Mannheim plant as a central service provider.

Who we are:

Roche is a global leader in the pharmaceutical and diagnostics sector with over 100,000 employees worldwide, which improves people's quality of life through innovation and sustainability. Around 9,000 employees at our Mannheim site work on innovative solutions for better healthcare. In our Energy Supply department, we are working to minimize the ecological footprint of our production site – through technical innovations, intelligent energy monitoring systems and concrete measures for reducing CO2 emissions.

Your tasks:

- You develop smart energy KPIs and Dashboards to visualize consumptions in order to identify optimization potentials. - You support the implementation and further development of mobile energy measurements to represent consumptions at plant level. - You support the identification of inefficiencies (e.g. simultaneous heating and cooling). - You help with the graphical processing of consumption data to verify the effectiveness of implemented technical measures.

- You will take over the preparation of drafts for the annual short reports as well as the final reports after the end of the optimization phase according to process specification. - You will take over small subprojects and implement your ideas directly.

You bring this with you:

- Studies: You are a student in the field of energy, environmental, industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, utility technology or a comparable degree program and are enrolled for the duration of the internship. - Enthusiast: You are passionate about sustainability and technology. - Languages: You have very good language skills in German and English.

Your advantages:

- Flexible working hours (37.5 hours week) & attractive remuneration of 2,268 €/month > 3 months - Home Office Possibility - Discount of -50% on canteen dinners - Fitness centre on Roche-Campus - Comprehensive onboarding and mentoring & networking with other students

Learn more about our location in Penzberg: https://www.roche.de/business/our sites/mannheim

Your application

Please upload your CV, a short letter of motivation and relevant certificates online.

Remember that this internship is aimed at students (m/w/d) with ongoing enrolment or alternatively at persons in the Gap-Year (between Bachelor and Master's degree programmes).

Start: from August 2026 Duration of the internship : max. 6 months

We look forward to receiving your application!

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you see what it takes to make it happen? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find it via https://careers.roche.com/ global/en/faq.

C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste

Voulez-vous travailler sur des solutions qui font réellement la différence – pour les personnes, l’environnement et l’avenir ? Alors rejoignez notre équipe d'approvisionnement en énergie sur le site de Roche Mannheim et aidez-nous à atteindre nos objectifs ambitieux en matière de développement durable.
Ici, vous travaillerez à la mise en œuvre de notre stratégie de décarbonisation, à l'optimisation de la consommation d'énergie et au développement de systèmes d'approvisionnement innovants - directement à l'interface de la technologie, de la durabilité et de l'industrie. Par votre travail, vous soutenez l'équipe qui, en tant que prestataire de services central, est responsable de l'infrastructure énergétique et médiatique de l'usine de Mannheim.

Qui nous sommes :

Roche est un leader mondial des produits pharmaceutiques et des diagnostics avec plus de 100 000 employés dans le monde, améliorant la qualité de vie des gens grâce à l'innovation et au développement durable. Sur notre site de Mannheim, environ 9 000 collaborateurs travaillent sur des solutions innovantes pour de meilleurs soins de santé.
Dans notre département Approvisionnement en énergie, nous nous efforçons de minimiser l'empreinte écologique de notre site de production – grâce à des innovations techniques, des systèmes intelligents de surveillance de l'énergie et des mesures concrètes pour réduire les émissions de CO₂.

Vos tâches :

- Vous développez des KPI et des tableaux de bord énergétiques intelligents pour visualiser les consommations afin d'identifier les potentiels d'optimisation.
- Vous soutenez la mise en œuvre et le développement ultérieur de mesures d'énergie mobiles afin d'afficher la consommation au niveau du système.
- Vous soutenez l'identification des inefficacités (par exemple chauffage et refroidissement simultanés).
- Vous participez à la préparation graphique des données de consommation pour vérifier l'efficacité des mesures techniques mises en œuvre.
- Vous êtes responsable de la création des ébauches des rapports courts annuels ainsi que des rapports finaux après la fin de la phase d'optimisation conformément aux spécifications du processus.
- Vous prenez en charge de manière indépendante de petits sous-projets et mettez en œuvre directement vos idées.

Voici ce que vous apportez avec vous :

- Etudes : Vous étudiez dans le domaine de l'énergie, de l'environnement, du génie industriel, du génie mécanique, de l'ingénierie des approvisionnements ou dans une filière d'études comparable et êtes inscrit pour la durée du stage.
- Enthousiasme : Vous êtes passionné par les thèmes de la durabilité et de la technologie.
- Langues : Vous avez de très bonnes compétences linguistiques en allemand et en anglais

- Horaires de travail flexibles (semaine de 37,5 heures) & rémunération attractive de 2 268 €/mois > 3 mois
- Option bureau à domicile
- Remise de -50% sur la nourriture de la cantine
- Centre de remise en forme sur le campus Roche
- Intégration, mentorat et réseautage complets avec d'autres étudiants

https://www.roche.de/unternehmen/unsere-standorte/mannheim

Durée du stage : max. 6 mois

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer is a highly skilled, technology-agnostic expert responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. In this role, you will leverage your deep knowledge of IT infrastructure's impact on Roche's business to make critical technical decisions with considerable independence. As a leader, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor global teams, and ensure that all technical designs and deliveries align with long-term organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Acts as a multi-disciplinary, technology-agnostic solution architect, designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated and resilient solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. Demonstrates a broad view of how different solutions work together and adapt to business demands, taking accountability for ultimate decision-making in technical design and delivery with considerable independent judgment.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Utilizes outstanding problem-solving skills to develop innovative technological ideas and guide them into final products. Follows industry advancements closely to evaluate promising technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) across technology domains. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions, maintains related component standards, and provides internal escalation support to resolve major incidents proactively.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex information and potential solutions across the organization, including to the most senior levels of the business, in non-technical terms. Leads as a consultant to senior managers on technology strategy, policies, and objectives, while managing relationships with line-of-business stakeholders. Influences technology vendors and collaborates extensively with IT partners, such as Enterprise Architects and Solution Owners, to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes strategic decisions that significantly affect departmental goals and leads large to enterprise-level project teams to ensure successful implementation. Ensures that all solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF). Plays a pivotal role in project planning by estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Drives success across multiple product lines within a domain by collaborating effectively with diverse, virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts, acting as a recognized expert with proven depth and breadth across many areas. Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of multiple Roche business areas beyond IT infrastructure, understanding exactly how infrastructure impacts business processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting and implementing Azure cloud network solutions , in depth knowledge of advanced Azure networking architectures and interconnectivity options

• General network engineering experience

• Infrastructure as code software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

La posizione Descrizione del lavoro L'Ingegnere di rete per infrastrutture IT di Azure Cloud è un esperto altamente qualificato e diagnostico della tecnologia responsabile della soluzione di problemi aziendali insolitamente complessi con soluzioni innovative in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. In questo ruolo, potrete sfruttare la vostra profonda conoscenza dell'impatto dell'infrastruttura IT sul business di Roche per prendere decisioni tecniche critiche con notevole indipendenza. In qualità di leader, influenzerai proattivamente la strategia tecnologica, tutor team globali, e ti assicurerai che tutti i progetti tecnici e le consegne si allineino agli obiettivi organizzativi a lungo termine e agli standard normativi. Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Scope / (Content Leadership): agisce come architetto di soluzioni multidisciplinari e diagnostiche, progettando, costruendo, testando e implementando soluzioni integrate e resilienti in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. Dimostra un ampio punto di vista sul modo in cui le diverse soluzioni lavorano insieme e si adattano alle esigenze aziendali, tenendo conto della responsabilità del processo decisionale definitivo nella progettazione tecnica e nella consegna con un giudizio indipendente considerevole.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: utilizza eccezionali capacità di problem solving per sviluppare idee tecnologiche innovative e guidarle nei prodotti finali. Segui i progressi del settore per valutare le tecnologie promettenti tramite Proofs of Concept (PoCs) attraverso i domini tecnologici. Conduce la progettazione end-to-end di soluzioni infrastrutturali, mantiene i relativi standard di componenti, e fornisce supporto di escalation interno per risolvere i principali incidenti proattivamente.
• Stakeholder Management: Comunica informazioni complesse e potenziali soluzioni in tutta l'organizzazione, compresi i livelli più anziani del business, in termini non tecnici. Leader come consulente per i senior manager sulla strategia, le politiche e gli obiettivi della tecnologia, mentre la gestione dei rapporti con le parti interessate della linea di business. Influenza fornitori di tecnologia e collabora ampiamente con partner IT, come Enterprise Architects e Solution Owners, per integrare i feedback.
• Impatto/Strategia: Prende decisioni strategiche che influiscono significativamente sugli obiettivi dipartimentali e porta grandi team di progetto a livello aziendale per garantire una corretta implementazione. Assicura che tutte le soluzioni siano conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione e aderiscano al Framework di Architettura Tecnica dell’organizzazione (TAF). Svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella pianificazione del progetto valutando risorse ingegneristiche, dipendenze, rischi e tempistiche.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): consente di ottenere il successo su più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio collaborando efficacemente con diverse squadre virtuali provenienti da varie sedi e background culturali. Conduce team geo-distribuiti attraverso l'influenza e la mentorship, fornendo una guida specializzata per ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'innovazione.
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: si basa su principi tecnici avanzati, teorie e concetti, che agiscono come esperto riconosciuto con profondità e larghezza comprovate in molte aree. Dimostra la conoscenza approfondita di più aree aziendali Roche oltre l'infrastruttura IT, capire esattamente come l'infrastruttura influisce sui processi aziendali. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Dimostrata esperienza nell'architettura e nell'implementazione di soluzioni di rete cloud Azure, conoscenza approfondita delle architetture avanzate di rete Azure e delle opzioni di interconnessione
• Esperienza di ingegneria della rete generale
• Infrastrutture come software di codice: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Der Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer ist ein hochqualifizierter, technologieunabhängiger Experte, der für die Lösung ungewöhnlich komplexer Geschäftsprobleme mit innovativen Lösungen im gesamten Bereich der Infrastrukturtechnologie verantwortlich ist. In dieser Funktion nutzen Sie Ihr fundiertes Wissen über die Auswirkungen der IT-Infrastruktur auf das Geschäft von Roche, um kritische technische Entscheidungen mit erheblicher Unabhängigkeit zu treffen. Als Führungskraft beeinflussen Sie proaktiv die Technologiestrategie, beraten globale Teams und stellen sicher, dass alle technischen Entwürfe und Lieferungen mit langfristigen organisatorischen Zielen und regulatorischen Standards übereinstimmen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Aufgabenbereich
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Agiert als multidisziplinärer, technologieunabhängiger Lösungsarchitekt und entwirft, baut, testet und implementiert integrierte und belastbare Lösungen für den gesamten Technologiebereich der Infrastruktur. Zeigt einen breiten Überblick darüber, wie verschiedene Lösungen zusammenarbeiten und sich an geschäftliche Anforderungen anpassen, wobei die Verantwortung für die endgültige Entscheidungsfindung in der technischen Gestaltung und Lieferung mit erheblichem unabhängigem Urteilsvermögen übernommen wird.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Nutzt herausragende Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, um innovative technologische Ideen zu entwickeln und sie in Endprodukte zu leiten. Verfolgt die Fortschritte der Industrie, um vielversprechende Technologien über Proofs of Concept (PoCs) in allen Technologiebereichen zu bewerten. Leitet das End-to-End-Design von Infrastrukturlösungen, unterhält die zugehörigen Komponentenstandards und bietet interne Eskalationsunterstützung, um große Vorfälle proaktiv zu lösen. Stakeholder-Management: Kommuniziert komplexe Informationen und potenzielle Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen, einschließlich der obersten Ebenen des Unternehmens, in nicht-technischen Begriffen. Führt als Berater für leitende Manager zu Technologiestrategien, -richtlinien und -zielen und verwaltet gleichzeitig die Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern aus der Branche. Beeinflusst Technologieanbieter und arbeitet intensiv mit IT-Partnern wie Enterprise Architects und Solution Ownern zusammen, um Feedback zu integrieren. Impact/Strategie: Trifft strategische Entscheidungen, die die Abteilungsziele erheblich beeinflussen und führt zu großen Teilen zu Projektteams auf Unternehmensebene, um eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen. Stellt sicher, dass alle Lösungen den Qualitäts- / Regulierungsstandards entsprechen und dem Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) der Organisation entsprechen. Spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Projektplanung, indem es technische Ressourcen, Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Zeitpläne abschätzt. Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Fördert den Erfolg über mehrere Produktlinien innerhalb einer Domäne hinweg, indem es effektiv mit verschiedenen, virtuellen Teams von verschiedenen Standorten und kulturellen Hintergründen zusammenarbeitet. Führt geo-verteilte Teams durch Einfluss und Mentoring und bietet spezialisierte Anleitung zur Optimierung von Leistung und Innovation.
• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Wendet fortgeschrittene technische Prinzipien, Theorien und Konzepte an und handelt als anerkannter Experte mit nachgewiesener Tiefe und Breite in vielen Bereichen. Demonstriert fundierte Kenntnisse über mehrere Roche-Geschäftsbereiche jenseits der IT-Infrastruktur und versteht genau, wie sich die Infrastruktur auf Geschäftsprozesse auswirkt. Qualifikationen Bildung / Erfahrung
• Demonstrierte praktische Erfahrung bei der Architektur und Implementierung von Azure-Cloud-Netzwerklösungen, fundierte Kenntnisse über fortschrittliche Azure-Netzwerkarchitekturen und Interkonnektivitätsoptionen
• Allgemeine Network Engineering Erfahrung
• Infrastruktur als Code-Software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is working to improve DNA sequencing data analysis. Roche is innovating new approaches that fundamentally change when and where DNA sequencing gets processed. Our goal is to analyze data as it's generated, where it’s generated.

We are seeking a visionary and deeply technical leader to champion the customer-facing bioinformatics and software strategy for our revolutionary Axelios sequencing platform. As we launch XOOS —our cutting-edge ecosystem of bioinformatics tools—you will be the bridge between our pioneering new customers and our internal development teams.

This is not a traditional role. You will lead an elite team of bioinformatics scientists and software engineers to create bespoke, high-impact solutions, resolve sophisticated technical roadblocks, and even engage in collaborative research with early adopters. Because the Axelios platform operates on a completely different paradigm than traditional Sequencing-by-Synthesis (SBS), you will be instrumental in educating the market, ensuring seamless migration to our tools, and translating complex customer feedback into actionable development pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Customer Advocacy & Technical Enablement: Serve as the primary executive-level technical contact for new customers, driving deep adoption of the XOOS bioinformatics ecosystem across major clinical and research applications.

• Team Leadership: Build, inspire, and manage a high-performing team of customer-facing bioinformatics scientists and solutions architects.

• Bespoke Solution Engineering: Lead the creation of customized workflows, data analysis pipelines, and software integrations to solve unique customer pain points and accelerate Axelios platform adoption.

• Collaborative Research: Partner with strategic early-adopter customers on collaborative research projects, co-authoring whitepapers, and demonstrating the unique capabilities of Axelios non-SBS data.

• Cross-Functional Feedback Loop: Act as a critical strategic partner to internal Bioinformatics and Software R&D teams, synthesizing market requirements, feature requests, and technical friction points into the product roadmap.

• Commercial & Technical Strategy: Collaborate with Sales and Product Management to support high-value customer engagements, technical evaluations, and complex contract closures.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA or San Diego, CA. (This is a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

• You have a Ph.D.in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 4+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 6+ years of industry experience.

• You have 8+ years of progressive experience in next-generation sequencing (NGS) bioinformatics, with a demonstrated track record of leadership in an industry setting.

• You have a significant level of expertise and comprehensive knowledge of the NGS landscape, clinical genomics space, and secondary/tertiary data analysis pipelines.

• You demonstrated leadership experience.

• You have a high level of proficiency with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern software development practices, pipeline frameworks (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake), and scripting languages (Python, R).

jobs.title: Subchapter Lead, Head of Pathology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies.

The Opportunity
As the Subchapter Lead in Clinical Development, Head of Pathology, you will stand at the intersection of cutting-edge science and people leadership. Based in our Tucson, AZ campus, you will lead a world-class team of pathologists dedicated to shaping the future of diagnostics and targeted cancer therapies.
In this role, you provide strategic and scientific leadership while overseeing pathology operations that support more than 100 new and existing product development initiatives and enhancements annually across Primary Antibodies, Special Stains, Digital Pathology, Companion Diagnostics and Instruments. Your team plays a critical role in enabling innovative diagnostics that support precision medicine and targeted cancer therapies worldwide.

In this role, you aren't just managing—you are mentoring, inspiring, and working hands-on with leading-edge technologies to transform patient care globally.

• People Leadership & Development: Direct, mentor, and foster the professional growth of Instrua highly specialized team of pathologists and 6-7 team leaders. Drive a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Medical oversight for day to day Path Lab activities.

• Scientific & Clinical Strategy: Serve as the pathology subject matter expert within the Companion Diagnostics & Oncology business unit, ensuring scientific rigor and clinical relevance in all assay development programs.

• Advanced Assay Development: Guide the team in the development, validation, and implementation of complex assays utilizing top-tier technologies including:

• Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and in situ hybridization (ISH)

• Immunofluorescence (IF) and Multiplex assays

• Digital Pathology and AI-driven image analysis

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with life science companies, clinical trial teams, regulatory bodies, and internal R&D stakeholders

• Innovation Champion: Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging pathology technologies to maintain Roche’s position as the market leader in companion diagnostics and oncology

Who You Are:

You are a visionary leader who balances deep clinical expertise with a passion for developing people. You thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the tangible impact your work has on cancer patients worldwide.

• You are a MD with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology

• You have 10+ years of people management and leadership within a pharmaceutical, diagnostics, or major academic or medical center environment.

• You have deep expertise in oncology pathology and hands-on experience with tissue-based biomarkers (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).

• You have strong familiarity with development processes including digital pathology workflows, image analysis tools, Clinical Case and CAP/CLIA

Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche è il fornitore numero 1 del mondo di diagnostica dei compagni e offre un'esperienza impareggiabile nello sviluppo e nella commercializzazione di diagnostica predittiva che consentono strategie di trattamento personalizzate per i pazienti con cancro. Offriamo opportunità uniche per i patologi interessati a svolgere un ruolo nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di nuovi saggi critici al nostro obiettivo di fornire un accesso più paziente a nuove terapie innovative. L'opportunità Come il Subchapter Lead in Sviluppo Clinico, Capo di Patologia, si starà all'incrocio di scienza all'avanguardia e la leadership della gente. Con sede nel nostro campus di Tucson, AZ, guiderai un team di patologi di livello mondiale dedicato a plasmare il futuro della diagnostica e terapie mirate al cancro. In questo ruolo, si fornisce leadership strategica e scientifica, supervisionando le operazioni di patologia che supportano più di 100 nuove e esistenti iniziative di sviluppo del prodotto e miglioramenti ogni anno attraverso gli anticorpi primari, le macchie speciali, la patologia digitale, la diagnostica e gli strumenti di Companion. Il vostro team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel consentire una diagnostica innovativa che supporta la medicina di precisione e terapie mirate per il cancro in tutto il mondo. In questo ruolo, non si sta solo gestendo—si sta guidando, ispirando e lavorando hands-on con tecnologie all'avanguardia per trasformare la cura del paziente a livello globale.
• People Leadership & Development: Diretto, mentore e promuovere la crescita professionale di Instrua team altamente specializzato di patologi e 6-7 team leader. Guidare una cultura dell'innovazione, della collaborazione e dell'apprendimento continuo. Supervisione medica per le attività di Path Lab di giorno in giorno.
• Strategia scientifica e clinica: servire come esperto di materia patologia all'interno dell'unità di business Companion Diagnostics & Oncology, assicurando rigore scientifico e rilevanza clinica in tutti i programmi di sviluppo di saggi.
• Sviluppo del saggio avanzato: Guida il team nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di saggi complessi che utilizzano tecnologie di alto livello tra cui:
• Immunohistochimica (IHC) e ibridazione in situ (ISH)
• Immunofluorescenza (IF) e saggi Multiplex
• Patologia digitale e analisi dell'immagine guidata dall'IA
• Collaborazione trasversale: collaborare a stretto contatto con le aziende di scienze della vita, i team di sperimentazione clinica, gli organismi normativi e gli stakeholder R&D interni
• Campione dell’Innovazione: Restate davanti alle tendenze del settore e alle tecnologie di patologia emergenti per mantenere la posizione di Roche come leader di mercato nella diagnostica dei compagni e nell’oncologia Chi sei? Sei un leader visionario che bilancia profonda esperienza clinica con la passione per lo sviluppo delle persone. Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e veloci e sono motivati dall'impatto tangibile che il vostro lavoro ha sui pazienti tumorali in tutto il mondo.
• Sei un MD con certificazione US Board in Patologia Anatomica
• Hai 10 anni di gestione e leadership delle persone all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico, diagnostico, o principale centro accademico o medico.
• Hai una profonda esperienza nella patologia oncologica e nell'esperienza pratica con biomarcatori basati sui tessuti (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).
• Hai una forte familiarità con i processi di sviluppo, inclusi i flussi di lavoro di patologia digitale, gli strumenti di analisi delle immagini, il caso clinico e CAP/CLIA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Data Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes.

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others.

Technical Skills

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Strong understanding of modern data engineering architectures and patterns, including cloud-based data platforms, batch and streaming data pipelines, and analytics layers

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomie

jobs.title: Clinical Data Standards and Master Data Digital Solution Lead

titleByLocale.it: Standard clinici di dati e Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.en: Clinical Data Standards and Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.de: Clinical Data Standards und Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Normes relatives aux données cliniques et solution numérique de base

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.
