jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . The Information Architect will do this by identifying, classifying, standardizing information objects and creating information flows, working closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners, and Business Analysts .

The Opportunity:

• Design and maintain the comprehensive information landscape and streamline both incoming and outgoing information flows for MRHub .

• Establish and enforce critical standards and governance for information objects in close partnership with the Data Engineering Lead .

• Drive quality assurance by performing periodic reviews on the compliance and integrity of all information objects and architectural flows .

• Provide strategic leadership on information modeling to project and operational teams, ensuring alignment with global informatics goals .

• Identify and organize complex information requirements and objects for MRHub to ensure seamless traceability and easy access .

• Support remediation of sub-optimal data flows within business processes to enhance overall system efficiency and performance .

• Ensure architectural accuracy by maintaining up-to-date automated flows in Archimedes and creating conceptual designs that fit IT/Business strategies .

• Collaborate with Agile teams and Solution Architects to document governance, compliance, and master data standards within solution architecture .

Who you are:

• Extensive experience leading complex data science and information architecture projects from end-to-end with a drive for significant business impact .
Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions and data frameworks .

• Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks, information lifecycles, and governance best practices .

• Deep technical proficiency in programming languages such as Python and R, coupled with the ability to architect and maintain complex version control workflows using Git.

• Comprehensive expertise in cloud-native database manageme

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Il ruolo di un architetto dell'informazione è comprendere i processi aziendali e gli oggetti informativi e lavorare con i membri del team informatico e aziendale per identificare e progettare flussi di informazioni e standard informativi che soddisfino le esigenze aziendali. L'Architetto dell'Informazione lavora per garantire la coerenza all'interno e tra i gruppi e promuove il riutilizzo e la semplicità degli oggetti informativi. L'architetto dell'informazione lo farà identificando, classificando, standardizzando gli oggetti informativi e creando flussi di informazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate aziendali, gli architetti di soluzioni, gli architetti di software, i partner commerciali IT e gli analisti aziendali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare e mantenere il panorama informativo completo e semplificare i flussi di informazioni in entrata e in uscita per MRHub.
• Stabilire e applicare standard critici e governance per gli oggetti informativi in ​​stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'ingegneria dei dati.
• Promuovere la garanzia della qualità eseguendo revisioni periodiche sulla conformità e l'integrità di tutti gli oggetti informativi e dei flussi architettonici.
• Fornire leadership strategica sulla modellazione delle informazioni ai team operativi e di progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi informatici globali.
• Identificare e organizzare requisiti di informazioni e oggetti complessi per MRHub per garantire tracciabilità senza soluzione di continuità e facile accesso.
• Supportare la correzione dei flussi di dati non ottimali all'interno dei processi aziendali per migliorare l'efficienza e le prestazioni complessive del sistema.
• Garantire l'accuratezza dell'architettura mantenendo flussi automatizzati aggiornati in Archimedes e creando progetti concettuali che si adattino alle strategie IT/aziendali.
• Collaborare con team Agile e Solution Architect per documentare gli standard di governance, conformità e dati master all'interno dell'architettura della soluzione. Chi sei:
• Vasta esperienza nella guida di progetti complessi di data science e architettura dell'informazione dall'inizio alla fine con una spinta verso un impatto aziendale significativo. Comprovata esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con la leadership senior per informare e influenzare decisioni aziendali strategiche di alto livello e strutture di dati.
• Competenza dimostrata nella progettazione e implementazione di strutture di data science, cicli di vita delle informazioni e best practice di governance a livello aziendale.
• Profonda competenza tecnica nei linguaggi di programmazione come Python e R, unita alla capacità di progettare e mantenere flussi di lavoro complessi di controllo delle versioni utilizzando Git.
• Competenza completa nella gestione di database nativi del cloud

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Rolle eines Informationsarchitekten besteht darin, Geschäftsprozesse und Informationsobjekte zu verstehen und mit Mitgliedern des Informatik- und Geschäftsteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Informationsflüsse und Informationsstandards zu identifizieren und zu entwerfen, die den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen. Der Informationsarchitekt strebt die Konsistenz innerhalb und zwischen Gruppen an und fördert die Wiederverwendung und Einfachheit von Informationsobjekten. Der Informationsarchitekt wird dies tun, indem er Informationsobjekte identifiziert, klassifiziert, standardisiert und Informationsflüsse erstellt und dabei eng mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Lösungsarchitekten, Softwarearchitekten, IT-Geschäftspartnern und Geschäftsanalysten zusammenarbeitet. Die Chance:
• Entwerfen und pflegen Sie die umfassende Informationslandschaft und optimieren Sie sowohl den eingehenden als auch den ausgehenden Informationsfluss für MRHub.
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Engineering Lead kritische Standards und Governance für Informationsobjekte etablieren und durchsetzen.
• Fördern Sie die Qualitätssicherung durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen der Konformität und Integrität aller Informationsobjekte und Architekturabläufe.
• Bereitstellung strategischer Führung bei der Informationsmodellierung für Projekt- und Betriebsteams und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf globale Informatikziele.
• Identifizieren und organisieren Sie komplexe Informationsanforderungen und -objekte für MRHub, um eine nahtlose Rückverfolgbarkeit und einen einfachen Zugriff sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Behebung suboptimaler Datenflüsse innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, um die Effizienz und Leistung des Gesamtsystems zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Abläufe in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die zu IT-/Geschäftsstrategien passen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit agilen Teams und Lösungsarchitekten zusammen, um Governance, Compliance und Stammdatenstandards innerhalb der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Anfang bis Ende mit dem Streben nach erheblichen geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, um strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen und Datenrahmen auf hoher Ebene zu informieren und zu beeinflussen.
• Nachgewiesene Fachkenntnisse in der Gestaltung und Implementierung unternehmensweiter Data-Science-Frameworks, Informationslebenszyklen und Best Practices für die Governance.
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und R, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Versionskontroll-Workflows mit Git zu entwerfen und zu verwalten.
• Umfassende Expertise im Cloud-nativen Datenbankmanagement
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Architecte de données/informations - Plateformes de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation rencontre l'objectif. En tant qu’équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues à l’esprit commercial engagés à contribuer à façonner l’avenir numérique des soins de santé de demain. Notre mission est de propulser Roche grâce à des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Le rôle d'un architecte de l'information est de comprendre les processus métier et les objets d'information et de travailler avec les membres de l'équipe informatique et commerciale pour identifier et concevoir des flux d'informations et des normes d'information qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise. L'architecte de l'information travaille à la cohérence au sein et entre les groupes et favorise la réutilisation et la simplicité des objets d'information. Pour ce faire, l'architecte de l'information identifiera, classifiera, standardisera les objets d'information et créera des flux d'informations, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise, les architectes de solutions, les architectes logiciels, les partenaires commerciaux informatiques et les analystes commerciaux. L'opportunité :
• Concevoir et maintenir un paysage d'informations complet et rationaliser les flux d'informations entrants et sortants pour MRHub.
• Établir et appliquer des normes et une gouvernance critiques pour les objets d'information en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'ingénierie des données.
• Piloter l'assurance qualité en effectuant des examens périodiques sur la conformité et l'intégrité de tous les objets d'information et flux architecturaux.
• Fournir un leadership stratégique sur la modélisation de l'information aux équipes de projet et opérationnelles, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs informatiques mondiaux.
• Identifiez et organisez les exigences et les objets d'informations complexes pour MRHub afin de garantir une traçabilité transparente et un accès facile.
• Prise en charge de la correction des flux de données sous-optimaux au sein des processus métier afin d'améliorer l'efficacité et les performances globales du système.

jobs.title: Clinical Scientist in neurosciences
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel in the Early Development department in the Neuroscience and Rare Disease DTA. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities.

We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the neuroscience community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, and rare disease community.

The Opportunity

• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). Present at appropriate internal meetings, e.g. Study Leadership Team. Contributes to abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings.

• Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.

• Work as medical monitor of phase 1 and phase 2 clinical trials in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• Work on advanced imaging technique to measure neurodegeneration (e.g. neuromelanin-MRI) in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions.

Who you are

• Degree in Medicine required (e.g. MD, MBBS). An advanced clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).

• 1 to 3 years of clinical development experience. While prior experience is a plus, we are primarily looking for someone with high potential, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn

• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.

• Good understanding of the multidisciplinary functions involved in drug development. Some therapeutic area relevant clinical trial experience or clear potential to assimilate with some support.

• Strong collaborative skills with the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed global team.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel in the Early Development department in the Neuroscience and Rare Disease DTA. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities.

We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the neuroscience community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, and rare disease community.

The Opportunity

• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). Present at appropriate internal meetings, e.g. Study Leadership Team. Contributes to abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings.

• Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.

• Work as medical monitor of phase 1 and phase 2 clinical trials in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• Work on advanced imaging technique to measure neurodegeneration (e.g. neuromelanin-MRI) in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions.

Who you are

• Degree in Medicine required (e.g. MD, MBBS). An advanced clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).

• 1 to 3 years of clinical development experience. While prior experience is a plus, we are primarily looking for someone with high potential, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn

• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.

• Good understanding of the multidisciplinary functions involved in drug development. Some therapeutic area relevant clinical trial experience or clear potential to assimilate with some support.

• Strong collaborative skills with the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed global team.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir suchen derzeit einen klinischen Wissenschaftler, der unserem globalen Team mit Sitz in Basel in der Frühentwicklungsabteilung für Neurowissenschaften und seltene Erkrankungen beitritt. Diese Rolle wird in erster Linie unsere jüngsten Entwicklungsprioritäten unterstützen. Wir sind ein engagiertes, kooperatives Team, das sich auf sinnvolle Lifecycle-Innovationen konzentriert, die sich direkt auf die neurowissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft auswirken. Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, einen Beitrag zur etablierten Wissenschaft zu leisten und gleichzeitig unerfüllte Bedürfnisse in der Parkinson-, Alzheimer-, Multiple Sklerose- und Seltenen Krankheitsgemeinschaft zu berücksichtigen. Die Chance
• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und / oder Vorbereitung klinischer Wissenschaftsinformationen für die Aufnahme in den klinischen Entwicklungsplan.

Prüfertreffen, Interaktionen vor Ort, Patienteninformationen, Studiennewsletter). Teilnahme an geeigneten internen Meetings, z.B. Study Leadership Team. • Arbeit als medizinischer Monitor von klinischen Studien der Phase 1 und Phase 2 bei Parkinson und Alzheimer
• Arbeiten an fortschrittlicher Bildgebungstechnik zur Messung der Neurodegeneration (z. B. Neuromelanin-MRT) bei Parkinson und Alzheimer

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un Clinical Scientist pour rejoindre notre équipe mondiale basée à Bâle dans le département de développement précoce de la DTA des neurosciences et des maladies rares. Ce rôle appuiera principalement nos dernières priorités de développement. Nous sommes une équipe dévouée et collaborative axée sur des innovations significatives du cycle de vie qui ont une incidence directe sur la communauté des neurosciences. Ce poste offre la possibilité de contribuer à la science établie tout en répondant aux besoins non satisfaits dans la communauté des Parkinson, des Alzheimer, de la sclérose en plaques et des maladies rares. L'opportunité
• Fournir un appui pour l'élaboration et/ou la préparation d'information scientifique clinique à inclure dans le Plan de développement clinique.

Présenter aux réunions internes appropriées, p. ex. Équipe de leadership d'étude. Contribue aux résumés, aux affiches, au contenu des réunions scientifiques.

• Travail sur la technique d'imagerie avancée pour mesurer la neurodégénérescence (par exemple neuromélanine-IRM) chez Parkinson et la maladie d'Alzheimer
• Avec des conseils, contribuer à la demande d'essai clinique (DEC)/Comité d'éthique (CE) des interactions écrites, des dossiers d'information, des réponses écrites aux questions de l'Autorité sanitaire (HA), des données/préparations scientifiques cliniques pour les interactions avec les AP et des données cliniques entrées dans les présentations réglementaires. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme de médecine requis (p. ex. MD, MBBS). Un diplôme clinique/science avancé est très préféré (p. ex. doctorat, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).
• 1 à 3 ans d'expérience clinique. Bien que l'expérience antérieure soit un atout, nous cherchons surtout une personne qui a un potentiel élevé, une forte motivation et une volonté d'apprendre.
• Il est nécessaire de se familiariser avec les lois, les règlements et les directives régissant l'exécution des essais cliniques à l'échelle mondiale et de connaître certains aspects médicaux du GCP (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des prescriptions techniques relatives à l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres directives et règlements pertinents.
• Bonne compréhension des fonctions multidisciplinaires liées au développement de la drogue. L'expérience d'essais cliniques pertinents dans certains domaines thérapeutiques ou un potentiel évident d'assimilation avec un certain soutien.
• De solides compétences en collaboration avec la capacité de travailler efficacement au sein d'une équipe mondiale géographiquement répartie. Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir bei Roche Pharma Österreich setzen uns täglich dafür ein, dass Patientinnen und Patienten in Österreich Zugang zu innovativen Therapien aus dem Roche-Portfolio erhalten.

Als Patient Journey Partner:in (Außendienst) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Produkte in der Hämostaseologie . Du erkennst die Bedürfnisse deiner Kund:innen, entwickelst strategische Ansätze und setzt diese gemeinsam mit deinem Team in wirkungsvolle Aktivitäten um. Du kennst deinen Markt genau und stellst die Verbesserung des Kund:innenerlebnisses konsequent in den Mittelpunkt. Das Gebiet umfasst den Westen von Österreich .

Was dich erwartet:

• Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere extramural erstatteten Produkte in der Hämostaseologie, mit klarem Fokus auf die Betreuung der Spezialist:innen im Spitalsbereich.

• Du bringst Patient:innen- und Kund:innenperspektiven aktiv in dein Team ein, um gemeinsam Hürden zu überwinden und Chancen zu nutzen

• Du betrachtest die gesamte Patient Journey ganzheitlich – von Indikation und Diagnose über die Behandlungslandschaft bis hin zu Patientenpotenzial

• Du identifizierst gemeinsame Interessen, Bedürfnisse und Ziele von Stakeholdern und entwickelst gemeinsam Lösungen mit klarem Mehrwert für Patient:innen

• Du betreust Roche-Produkte entlang ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus unter Einhaltung aller Compliance-Richtlinien sowie gesetzlicher Vorgaben

• Du unterstützt die Vorbereitung und Umsetzung von Produkteinführungen

• Bei Bedarf ziehst du Expert:innen aus der medizinischen Kommunikation für vertiefte wissenschaftliche Diskussionen hinzu

Wer du bist:

• Du hast ein starkes persönliches Interesse an der Verbesserung der Patient:innenversorgung und eine ausgeprägte Leidenschaft für nachhaltige Wertschöpfung im Gesundheitssystem

• Du verfügst über die Pharmareferentenprüfung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Human- oder Veterinärmedizin bzw. Pharmazie sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Hämostaseologie

• Du bringst eine unternehmerische Denkweise sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur partnerschaftlichen Zusammenarbeit mit

• Du überzeugst durch deine kommunikative Fähigkeiten und dein Verhandlungsgeschick

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Roche-Netzwerk

• Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Tools und Systemen um (z. B. CRM, Datenanalyse, Accountplanung)

Es erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt ab €77.000 brutto (Vollzeitbasis), abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Zusätzlich bieten wir einen leistungsorientierten Bonus sowie attraktive Benefits wie Pensionskasse, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Angebote zur betrieblichen Gesundheitsförderung .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Supporti la preparazione e l'attuazione dei lanci dei prodotti
• Se necessario, portare esperti di comunicazione medica per approfondite discussioni scientifiche Chi sei:
• Hai un forte interesse personale nel migliorare la cura del paziente e una forte passione per la creazione di valore sostenibile nel sistema sanitario
• Lei ha l'esame ufficiale farmaceutico o uno studio completo di medicina umana o veterinaria o farmacia e diversi anni di esperienza professionale in emostaseologia
• Porti una mentalità imprenditoriale e una forte capacità di lavorare in partnership
• Convinci le tue capacità di comunicazione e le tue capacità di negoziazione
• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese per la cooperazione nella rete internazionale Roche
• Sei sicuro con strumenti e sistemi digitali (ad esempio CRM, analisi dati, pianificazione account) Si può aspettare uno stipendio annuale da € 77.000 lordi (base a tempo pieno), a seconda della qualificazione e dell'esperienza. Inoltre, offriamo un bonus orientato alle prestazioni e benefici interessanti come il fondo pensione, orari di lavoro flessibili, opportunità di formazione e offerte per la promozione della salute sul lavoro. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Expert (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites, making it the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland with more than 2,700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare, working together as one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups where success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusion, striving to identify and create opportunities that enable all people to bring their unique selves to Roche, while offering extensive development and training opportunities, flexible working options, 18 weeks of maternity leave, 10 weeks of gender independent partnership leave, and multiple on-site services such as child-care facilities, medical services, restaurants, cafeterias, and various employee events.
In this highly specialized permanent, full-time role as Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) within the DODINL Production Laboratory & QC line organisation led by Eric Wanko, you will be the key technical anchor for the critical technology transfer of advanced genetic sequencing workflows. As part of Roche’s global Dual-Site Strategy, we are expanding our manufacturing footprint to establish parallel production capabilities, where this transfer to Rotkreuz, Switzerland, is designed to complement and work in tandem with our existing operations in Santa Clara, USA, ensuring long-term global supply security and scaling our production capacity across both key sites. In this position, you will act as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical execution, optimization, and scaling of our proprietary sequencing consumable portfolios in Europe, leveraging your deep, pre-existing technical knowledge of our US-developed manufacturing lines to ensure seamless cross-site standardization as a central part of a genius team and shaping role.

The Opportunity

• Technology Transfer & Site Alignment: Drive the technical transfer of RUO (Research Use Only) and regulated genetic sequencing workflows (specifically SBX sequencing chemistry) from Roche Santa Clara (US) to the Rotkreuz site, ensuring absolute process alignment between both operating sites.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the primary technical authority for drafting, reviewing, and auditing site-specific operating procedures (SOPs), batch record templates, and work instructions for critical consumable components.

• Process Optimization & Scaling: Manage and execute complex experiments throughout the product lifecycle, from initial feasibility and stability testing through to official launch and routine manufacturing transfer.

• Advanced Quality Control: Oversee high-priority investigations into complex process failures or manufacturing deviations, applying advanced statistical techniques and data analysis to implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

• Cross-Functional Training: Translate development workflows into standardized work procedures, providing deep technical guidance and training local operators on complex reagent handling, raw material formulation, automated dispensing, and data analyzation.

• End-to-End Quality Inspectio

A Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della sanità, lavorando insieme come uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca in cui il successo è costruito su innovazione, curiosità e diversità. In questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno altamente specializzato come Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) all'interno dell'organizzazione della linea DODINL Production Laboratory & QC guidata da Eric Wanko, sarete l'ancora tecnica chiave per il trasferimento di tecnologia critica dei flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico avanzati. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites, making it the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland with more than 2,700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare, working together as one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups where success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusion, striving to identify and create opportunities that enable all people to bring their unique selves to Roche, while offering extensive development and training opportunities, flexible working options, 18 weeks of maternity leave, 10 weeks of gender independent partnership leave, and multiple on-site services such as child-care facilities, medical services, restaurants, cafeterias, and various employee events.
In this highly specialized permanent, full-time role as Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) within the DODINL Production Laboratory & QC line organisation led by Eric Wanko, you will be the key technical anchor for the critical technology transfer of advanced genetic sequencing workflows. As part of Roche’s global Dual-Site Strategy, we are expanding our manufacturing footprint to establish parallel production capabilities, where this transfer to Rotkreuz, Switzerland, is designed to complement and work in tandem with our existing operations in Santa Clara, USA, ensuring long-term global supply security and scaling our production capacity across both key sites. In this position, you will act as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical execution, optimization, and scaling of our proprietary sequencing consumable portfolios in Europe, leveraging your deep, pre-existing technical knowledge of our US-developed manufacturing lines to ensure seamless cross-site standardization as a central part of a genius team and shaping role.

The Opportunity

• Technology Transfer & Site Alignment: Drive the technical transfer of RUO (Research Use Only) and regulated genetic sequencing workflows (specifically SBX sequencing chemistry) from Roche Santa Clara (US) to the Rotkreuz site, ensuring absolute process alignment between both operating sites.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the primary technical authority for drafting, reviewing, and auditing site-specific operating procedures (SOPs), batch record templates, and work instructions for critical consumable components.

• Process Optimization & Scaling: Manage and execute complex experiments throughout the product lifecycle, from initial feasibility and stability testing through to official launch and routine manufacturing transfer.

• Advanced Quality Control: Oversee high-priority investigations into complex process failures or manufacturing deviations, applying advanced statistical techniques and data analysis to implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

• Cross-Functional Training: Translate development workflows into standardized work procedures, providing deep technical guidance and training local operators on complex reagent handling, raw material formulation, automated dispensing, and data analyzation.

• End-to-End Quality Inspectio

• Contrôle avancé de la qualité: Surveiller les enquêtes hautement prioritaires sur les défaillances complexes des procédés ou les écarts de fabrication, en appliquant des techniques statistiques avancées et des analyses de données pour mettre en œuvre des actions correctives et préventives robustes (CAPA).
• Formation interfonctionnelle : Traduire les flux de travail de développement en procédures de travail normalisées, fournir une orientation technique approfondie et former les opérateurs locaux à la manipulation complexe des réactifs, à la formulation des matières premières, à la distribution automatisée et à l'analyse des données.

jobs.title: R&D Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) functions as a center of excellence for research and early development, and CICoR Oncology group is looking for a motivated and curious intern student majoring in Biotechnology or related fields to join our team. This role offers a unique cross-functional experience, combining dry-lab data analysis, wet-lab experimental support, and creative science communication. You will work closely with senior scientists and bioinformaticians, gaining hands-on industry experience.

• The main responsibilities of the position include:
• Bioinformatics & Data Analysis Support
• Assist in basic bioinformatics workflows.

• Support the team in data visualization, creating charts, and organizing datasets for internal research projects.

• Learn and utilize internal platforms or open-source tools to assist in literature mining and biological database searches.

• Wet-Lab Experimental Assistance
• Support routine laboratory operations, including reagent preparation, sample archiving, and inventory management under strict safety guidelines.

• Assist scientists in executing basic molecular biology or cell culture experiments (training will be provided).

• Science Communication & Video Creation

Brainstorm, script, and produce short promotional or educational videos to showcase team achievements, lab technologies, or internal scientific events.

• Qualifications / Discipline:
Bachelor of Biotechnology degree in relevant fields.

• Skills:
Strong motivation and leadership in pursuing challenging scientific questions.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

Others:

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Preferred
Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Fresh Graduate with degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or Diploma or NITEC or equivalent holders. Diploma holders with at least 3 years of experience. NITEC or equivalent holders with 7 years of experience. Biologics experience is a plus.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts.
As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization.
You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business.
You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.

• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.

• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.

• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.

• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.

• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies.

Who you are

• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.

• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.

• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.

• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.

• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Owner

titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire principal de produits de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a passionate and experienced Data Product Owner ready to drive business value through innovative data solutions? Join Roche's PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) organization as a Senior Data Product Owner!

At Roche, our 10-year Pharma vision is centered on delivering new data analytics solutions to scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). PTE is catalyzing PT's digital transformation, activating data citizenship, and building a FAIR data ecosystem. In this role, you will be pivotal in building, maintaining, and sustaining data products that drive operational excellence and enable impactful decision-making for our patients' benefit.

In this role, you will:

• Define & Communicate Product Vision: Lead the vision and roadmap for data products, aligning with organizational goals and stakeholder needs.

• Lead Data Product Development: Manage the full lifecycle of data products, from ideation to deployment, leveraging Roche’s IT/OT ecosystems for stable, automated solutions.

• Drive Value Delivery & Prioritization: Develop prioritized product backlogs, guiding teams to deliver scalable, reusable data products that achieve measurable business outcomes.

• Ensure Governance & Compliance: Guarantee data products adhere to Roche’s data quality standards, governance policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, GxP).

• Champion Collaboration & Mentorship: Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, fostering harmonization and mentoring other Data Product Owners.
Who You Are:

• 7+ years of agile experience designing and delivering complex data solutions, including 4+ years as a Product Owner or Data Analyst, preferably in the pharma or healthcare industry.

• Proven track record of data management on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake)

• Strong understanding of data architectures, data modeling, data integration (e.g., data mesh, data warehousing), and SDLC/CSV.

• Excellent ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and lead teams in an agile setting.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins opérationnels, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des mairies, des réunions d'équipes et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Vous résoudrez des problèmes complexes, prendrez des décisions indépendantes au niveau des produits, fournirez une supervision technique et rapporterez au niveau des produits ou des gammes de produits. En apportant des connaissances avancées en ERP, une expertise approfondie dans des domaines clés et des compétences analytiques solides, vous contribuerez activement à l'amélioration continue et au développement d'équipes.
• Stratégie produit : Évaluer les processus de développement durable existants pour identifier les possibilités d'optimisation, en particulier dans les domaines du traitement automatisé des commandes et de l'analyse en temps réel.

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

As the Business Analytics Lead , you will be the strategic architect of the data roadmap shaping the Patient Insights portfolio and strategy at Roche Information Solutions (RIS). You will serve as the single source of truth for the RIS Patient Insights portfolio metrics and act as the orchestrator of Patient Insights-wide business analytics. You will create effective strategies to collect data, analyze information, conduct research and implement analytics. You will bring a keen strategic focus and ability to translate data into actionable insights, championing data-driven decision making and the journey at RIS Patient Insights to become the leading chronic disease management company.

We are looking for a proven business leader. You demonstrate energy, passion, courage, vision and the drive to be part of an organization at the forefront of the industry, delivering benefits for patients, our people, and our business. Moreover, you bring:

The Business Analytics Lead will report to the Head of Business Analytics & Competitive Intelligence and be a member of the wider Strategy & Growth team. The Position is based in Vienna, Austria. This is a global role and up to 30% travel (largely international) is required.

Your upcoming mission:
Within this role, your responsibilities will fall into these main areas:

Business Analytics & KPI Strategy & Orchestration

• You explore, develop, implement and evaluation innovative business analytic solutions to meet customer needs (internal and external)

• You act as a bridge between traditionally siloed data sets (e.g. Finance, Portfolio, CX, Sales) in order to inform RIS Patient Insights business decisions and promote alignment with RIS Patient Insights Strategy

• You lead key strategic initiatives related to RIS Patient Insights-wide data analytics (e.g. executive dashboard creation; transversal governance data requirement / definition) – developing and coordinating project plans with stakeholders to deliver to expectations

• You collaborate with other business intelligence functions (incl. Finance, Commercial) to harmonize and simply the KPI identification, gathering, collection and visualization processes

• You work with technical colleagues in R&D and IT, identifying business requirements related to data analytics and supporting development of solutions that meet customer requirements (internal and external)

• Customer Solution Business Analytics & KPIs

• You serve as the single source of truth for RIS Patient Insights customer portfolio metrics

• You collaborate with product, service and solution development and pipeline key stakeholders to define key performance metrics for all RIS Patient Insights solutions – tracking product development, commercialization and use

• You serve as the accountable business owner of key reporting solutions (e.g. Tableau), serving as a ‘super user’ able to interrogate data and translate it into actionable insight

• You provide expertise with respect to portfolio analytics and key strategic recommendations that facilitate trade-off discussions

• Leadership & Growth Mindset

• You serve as a coach and mentor, building competencies in business analytics via training, education of methods, tools and frameworks

• You promote insights-backed development and data-driven decision making, developing content and delivering presentations (internal and extern

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unser 14-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der molekularbiologischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen.

Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ im Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Umfeld geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren.

Deine Aufgaben

• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care

• Analytik von molekularbiologischen und biochemischen und Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen diesen beiden

• Kenntnisse in der molekularbiologische / biochemische Analytik (insbesondere qPCR & Nukleinsäureaufreinigung, wie auch Zellkultur )

• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Dich und Deine Ideen einbringen

• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten für Deine weitere Karriereplanung

• Vergünstigte Preise in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Zugang zu unserem Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House während des Praktikums

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte beachte, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium.

Für Deine Bewerbung benötigen wir ausschließlich Deinen vollständigen Lebenslauf.

Zeitraum: Flexibel im Zeitraum August bis Oktober für die Gesamtdauer des Praktikums von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifi
