jobs.title: Customer Support Partner (Engineer)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
As the Customer Support Partner (Engineer), you will be responsible for performing instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventive maintenance, and other instrument after-sales service issues to the satisfaction of the customer base and organization's procedures and policies.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will

• Maintain and perform necessary support at customer site, such as troubleshooting, corrective and preventive maintenance, and installation hardware and software modification.

• Provide service training to the customer and peers.

• Conduct workshop activities as required.

• Handles trouble shooting for customers and carry out root cause analysis, and liaises with GCS to manage technical issues when required.

• Well documented all customers’ touchpoints in the CRM system correctly in a timely manner.

• Monitor spare part movement in individual storage location and ensure part used is written off via the CRM system in a timely manner.

• Responsible to ensure (together with Regulatory and Product team) that customer is informed of safety / quality issues and technical updates via Customer Notification timely.

• Cooperate with the cross-functional support team to help customers solve the problem effectively.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their needs and identifying shared purpose in order to create fruitful partnerships.

• Represent Roche in engagement opportunities, collect and compiling insights, positions and feedback to inform our access and policies strategies.

• Regularly check the intranet/emails and all available channels to keep up-to-date service information including instrument operation and application related information.

• Meet customer service KPI and participate in continuous improvements.

• Actively promote and provide digital service, proactive and remote support through Remote CareGiver.

• May act as a coach for colleagues with less experience and provide guidance. Proactively identify opportunities to improve and enhance the target audience experience. Work autonomously; complete work with minimal supervision or guidance but maintain communication with supervisor regarding progress.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are
You are someone who are/have:

• Strong troubleshooting and multi-tasking skills.

• Efficient, organized, details oriented and result driven.

• Customer-oriented individual and an outstanding problem-solver.

• Able to efficiently prioritise tasks in a fast-changing environment.

Role Purpose
As the Customer Support Partner (Engineer), you will be responsible for performing instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventive maintenance, and other instrument after-sales service issues to the satisfaction of the customer base and organization's procedures and policies.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

• Conduct workshop activities as required.

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. Join a team at the forefront of the "Quality Unites Us" program, where you will design the digital backbone of our global pharma quality and compliance systems. This role is a unique chance to lead the shift toward a paperless, predictive quality ecosystem, ensuring our life-saving medicines reach patients faster. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Solution Architect (Quality & Compliance) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Unisciti a un team all'avanguardia del programma "Quality Unites Us", dove potrai progettare la spina dorsale digitale dei nostri sistemi di qualità e conformità di farmaci globali. Questo ruolo è un'occasione unica per portare lo spostamento verso un ecosistema di qualità senza carta, predittivo, assicurando che i nostri farmaci salvavita raggiungano i pazienti più velocemente. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente ad alto impatto, bilanciando tecnologie di laboratorio all'avanguardia con standard aziendali robusti. L'opportunità:
• Scope/(Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali. Gestisce i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance. Riguarda i quadri in una soluzione complessa o multipla o nel contesto del prodotto.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: porta altri a risolvere problemi complessi; utilizza un sofisticato pensiero analitico per esercitare giudizio e identificare soluzioni innovative. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per soluzioni multiple. Assesse e consultazioni sugli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie, ontologie e percorsi di integrazione per il prodotto. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness, assicurando che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) siano registrate e pubblicate per più soluzioni o il prodotto. Guida le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e valuta la fattibilità, comprese le valutazioni dei fornitori.
• Gestione degli Stakeholder: Comunica chiaramente concetti difficili e negozia con altri per adottare un punto di vista diverso. Guida la condivisione delle informazioni attraverso il prodotto completo.
• Impatto/Strategia: sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali all'interno di un Contesto Complesso o Soluzione Multiple o Prodotto.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): funziona all'interno di una soluzione complessa o multipla o Contesto del prodotto.
• Capacità aziendale /tecnica: si basa su una conoscenza approfondita ed esperta in più aree tecnologiche. Proattivamente contribuisce alle pratiche di architettura

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Small Molecule Drug Design. You will develop and apply ML methods and models to accelerate small-molecule drug design with a focus on structure-driven approaches, working hand in hand with world-class computational and medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

The Opportunity

• Design, build, and apply cutting-edge ML models for small-molecule drug design, focused on protein–ligand interactions, binding affinity and key molecular properties.

• Train and fine-tune foundation models for structure prediction, using internally developed and open-source models on internal datasets.

• Validate and refine ML-generated hypotheses alongside world-class computational and medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and conference talks.

• Collaborate widely with computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and hands-on experience designing & implementing machine learning approaches such as graph neural networks, sequence models, and reinforcement learning.

• You have structure-driven modelling experience with co-folding methods, binding-affinity prediction, and structural-biology datasets.

• You are fluent in Python and cheminformatics with toolkits such as RDKit and OpenEye, and modern ML frameworks like PyTorchor JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab)..

Preferred:

• Hands-on experience building structure-prediction foundation models.

• Experience collaborating directly with medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Basel, Switzerland (preferred) or Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If using AI to design the medicines patients need next inspires you, apply now and help accelerate small-molecule discovery at Roche.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al team di piccole-molecole all'interno di AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), precedentemente Prescient Design, presso il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Roche e Genentech come Scienziato per l'Apprendimento della Macchina / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Small Molecule Drug Design. Svilupperai e applicherai metodi e modelli ML per accelerare la progettazione di farmaci di piccola molecola con un focus sugli approcci struttura-driven, lavorando mano in mano con chimici computazionali e medicinali di livello mondiale e biologi strutturali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare, costruire e applicare modelli ML all'avanguardia per la progettazione di farmaci di piccola molecola, focalizzati sulle interazioni proteina-ligand, l'affinità vincolante e le proprietà molecolari chiave.
• Modelli di fondazione per la predizione della struttura, con modelli interni sviluppati e open source su dataset interni.
• convalidare e affinare le ipotesi generate da ML insieme a chimici computazionali e medicinali di livello mondiale e biologi strutturali.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e conferenze.
• Collaborare ampiamente con ricercatori computazionali e sperimentali a Roche e con partner accademici. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e l'esperienza hands-on progettazione e applicazione di approcci di machine learning come reti neurali grafici, modelli di sequenza e apprendimento di rinforzo.
• Hai esperienza di modellazione struttura-driven con metodi di co-folding, predizione di binding-affinity e dataset di biologia strutturale.
• Sei fluente in Python e cheminformatics con strumenti come RDKit e OpenEye, e moderni framework ML come PyTorchor JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Hands-on esperienza costruzione modelli di fondazione struttura-predizione.
• Esperienza di collaborazione direttamente con chimici medicinali e biologi strutturali. Se si utilizza l'IA per progettare i farmaci che i pazienti bisogno dopo ti ispira, applicare ora e aiutare ad accelerare la scoperta di piccole molecole a Roche. #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Quantum Chemistry. You will combine machine learning methods and quantum chemistry to build fast, accurate models that power small-molecule drug discovery. You will work with world-class computational and experimental scientists and leverage proprietary datasets and state-of-the-art compute.

The Opportunity

• Create cutting-edge solutions that combine quantum chemistry and machine learning algorithm development to model small-molecule energetics and protein–ligand interactions, from conformation and reactivity to binding affinity and free energy.

• Build synthetic datasets using quantum mechanics and related methods to shape novel research directions in ML.

• Develop deployable pipelines that are robust, scalable and reproducible, and feed directly into molecular-design tools used across Roche.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and talks at internal and external conferences.

• Collaborate widely with world-class computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong theoretical foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and you build models from first principles.

• You have hands-on quantum chemistry experience and fluency in toolkits such as Psi4, PySCF and ORCA, as well as semi-empirical methods like xTB.

• You are fluent in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab).

Preferred

• Experience in scientific software development, scaling ML training, and applying models to drug discovery.

• Experience generating large-scale synthetic datasets.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom (preferred) or Basel, Switzerland. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If building physics-grounded machine learning models that bring better medicines to patients faster is your calling, apply now and help shape the future of small-molecule drug discovery.

• Sei fluente in Python e moderni framework ML come PyTorch o JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Esperienza nello sviluppo del software scientifico, scalare la formazione ML e applicare modelli alla scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza generando set di dati sintetici su larga scala. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
The Position

At Roche, we are building a scalable and compliant omnichannel engagement ecosystem that enables personalized, data-driven interactions across channels.
As an IT Business Analyst within Omnichannel Orchestration, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, affiliate teams, and technology delivery teams. You will play a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, supporting onboarding and adoption of omnichannel capabilities, and ensuring successful delivery of customer engagement use cases across markets.
A major focus of this role will be supporting the rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement of omnichannel engagement capabilities across Pharma International affiliates.
This role will work closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Business Stakeholders, you will help shape requirements, improve processes, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value.

The Opportunity
Business Analysis & Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for omnichannel engagement, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation use cases.

• Translate business needs into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement gathering activities with global and affiliate stakeholders.

• Support backlog refinement and prioritization activities with Product Owners and delivery teams.

Affiliate Engagement & Omnichannel Adoption

• Act as a key point of contact for affiliate teams adopting omnichannel capabilities.

• Understand affiliate business processes, pain points, and market-specific requirements.

• Support onboarding activities, capability demonstrations, training sessions, and business readiness efforts.

• Identify opportunities to improve adoption, operational efficiency, and user experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Vendors to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented.

• Support testing, validation, and user acceptance activities.

• Help manage dependencies across business, process, data, and technology workstreams.

Continuous Improvement

• Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and standardization.

• Contribute to documentation, governance practices, templates, and best practices.

• Support reporting, insights, and measurement activities to evaluate business outcomes and adoption.

Who You Are
You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Consulting, Product Delivery, CRM, Marketing Technology, Omnichannel Engagement, or Digital Transformation domains.

• Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and translating them into scalable technology solutions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs.

• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams.

• Strong understanding of omnichannel engagement, campaign execution, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation workflows.

• Familiarity with

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.
The Onsite Enablement organization is the heartbeat of our physical presence. We are the bridge between digital strategy and local execution, ensuring that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. As part of this team, you will oversee a team of individual contributors who are the primary points of accountability for onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and user experience within their respective sites. Our mission is to provide a "frictionless" workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards.

• Sets clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps.

• Actively removes impediments and roadblocks to progress, escalating when necessary to protect the team's focus.

• Manages and aligns stakeholders' expectations and needs, providing regular updates on progress and risks.

• Creates efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible across teams and functions.

•

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Descrizione della zona Workforce Enablement (WE) è la casa per i dipendenti che affrontano prodotti, servizi e esperienze all'interno di RDT. Forniamo strumenti digitali, adottiamo e forniamo il supporto necessario per consentire l'intera forza lavoro, ovunque si trovino, ogni singolo giorno. L'organizzazione Insite Enablement è il battito cardiaco della nostra presenza fisica. Siamo il ponte tra la strategia digitale e l'esecuzione locale, assicurando che ogni sito, dai laboratori R&D ai hub aziendali, funzioni con servizi tecnologici all'avanguardia. Nell'ambito di questo team, supervisionerai un team di singoli collaboratori che sono i principali punti di responsabilità per l'eccellenza dei servizi in loco, la stabilità delle infrastrutture e l'esperienza degli utenti all'interno dei rispettivi siti. La nostra missione è quella di fornire un luogo di lavoro "a frizione" in cui la tecnologia consente al nostro popolo di concentrarsi su ciò che conta di più: migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Questo leader RDT è responsabile per le persone, budget e servizi necessari per fornire un'offerta di alta qualità per i dipendenti. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
• Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione.
• Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso.
• Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili.
• Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.
• Salute e sostenibilità del team
• Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team.
• Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta.
• Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra.
• Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.
• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
• Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale.
• Affidabile per la consegna end-to-end del team di funzionalità come parte dello sviluppo del prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con la roadmap del prodotto e gli standard di qualità.
• Imposta la messa a fuoco chiara e le priorità per il lavoro di consegna del team, garantendo l'allineamento con le roadmap del prodotto.
• Rimuove attivamente gli impedimenti e i blocchi stradali per progredire, aumentando quando necessario per proteggere l'attenzione del team.
• Gestisce e allinea le aspettative e le esigenze degli stakeholder, fornendo aggiornamenti regolari sui progressi e sui rischi.
• Crea efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile tra team e funzioni. •

Sie unterstützen die Software- und/oder Servicebereitstellung als Führungskraft, indem Sie Hindernisse beseitigen, Stakeholder verwalten und wo immer möglich Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit schaffen. Als Teil dieses Teams betreuen Sie ein Team von einzelnen Mitwirkenden, die die Hauptverantwortungspunkte für Vor-Ort-Service-Exzellenz, Infrastrukturstabilität und Benutzererfahrung in ihren jeweiligen Standorten sind. • Stellt sicher, dass die Teammitglieder mit den notwendigen, relevanten Fähigkeiten ausgestattet sind und dass die Rollen klar definiert sind.

• Verantwortlich für die End-to-End-Bereitstellung der Funktionen des Teams im Rahmen der Produktentwicklung, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Produkt-Roadmap und den Qualitätsstandards sicherzustellen.
• Legt klare Schwerpunkte und Prioritäten für die Lieferarbeit des Teams fest und stellt die Abstimmung mit Produkt-Roadmaps sicher.
• Entfernt aktiv Hindernisse und Hindernisse für den Fortschritt und eskaliert, wenn es notwendig ist, um den Fokus des Teams zu schützen.
• Verwaltet und richtet die Erwartungen und Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder aus und bietet regelmäßige Updates zu Fortschritt und Risiken.
• Schafft Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit, wo immer möglich, über Teams und Funktionen hinweg. •

The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

jobs.title: Internship - ERP Transformation Project

titleByLocale.fr: Stage - Projet de transformation du PGI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship - ERP Transformation Project
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented ERP Transformation Project Intern to join our global transformation team. In this role, you will sit at the heart of our SAP S/4HANA & EWM deployment, gaining hands-on exposure to a large-scale digital + business transformation. You will directly support the Project Management Office (PMO) and work cross-functionally across critical workstreams - including system integration, system testing master data, user training, organizational change management, and technical/business go live.
This is an exceptional opportunity to learn how a multi-million dollar technology implementation operates from the ground up and build highly marketable enterprise project management skills.
Key Responsibilities
1. PMO & Governance Support

• Track Project Milestones: Support PMO in maintaining and updating the master deployment project plan, tracking deliverables across various workstreams.

• Meeting Coordination: Organize, document, and distribute action items/minutes for critical workstream syncs and steering committee updates.

• RAID Log Management: Assist in maintaining the Risk, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (RAID) log, ensuring owners update their mitigation plans weekly.
2. Integration & Partner System Readiness

• Interface Tracking: Maintain the master integration matrix, tracking the development, testing, and sign-off status of all inbound and outbound interfaces connecting to S/4HANA & EWM.

• Partner Coordination: Act as a liaison with external third-party partners, vendors, and business users to coordinate connectivity setup and end-to-end interface testing schedules.

• Cutover Planning for Systems: Support the Integration Lead in mapping out the precise transition activities for all partner system’s interfaces.
2. Master Data Readiness

• Data Readiness Tracking: Assist Data Lead and business data owners in tracking the progress of data collection and verification cycles across all data objects.

• Data Dictionary & Governance Documentation : Assist in documenting data definitions, field-level requirements, data loading and verification strategy in a Data Input Plan to support future data governance processes.

• Data Reconciliation Support: Help document pre- and post-load data reconciliation reports, ensuring loaded SAP data perfectly matches approved source files.
4. Testing Coordination

• Status & Defect Tracking: Monitor status and defect metrics during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and System Acceptance Testing (SAT) using tools like Solman, .

• Tester Support: Help coordinate testing schedules, ensuring business testers have the correct access, test scripts, and data variants required.

• Test Logistics & Environment Readiness: Coordinate the logistics of testing cycles, including booking testing rooms, tracking daily tester attendance, and confirming that necessary test data and environment connectivity are ready prior to execution.
5. Training, Authorizations & Organizational Change Management (OCM)

• Training Logistics: Coordinate the scheduling of end-user training sessions, tracking completion rates across different business units.

• Role Mapping: Support the security team in mapping business users to specific SAP security roles and authorizations based on organizational design.

• Engagement & Event Coordination: Plan, organize, and facilitate change management events - including town halls, roadshows, leadership alignment workshops,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Internship - ERP Transformation Project Panoramica del ruolo Stiamo cercando un ERP Transformation Project Intern altamente motivato e orientato al dettaglio per unirsi al nostro team di trasformazione globale. In questo ruolo, ti siederai al cuore della nostra distribuzione SAP S/4HANA & EWM, ottenendo un'esposizione pratica a una trasformazione digitale + business su larga scala. Sosterrai direttamente il Project Management Office (PMO) e lavorerai cross-functionally attraverso i flussi di lavoro critici - tra cui l'integrazione di sistema, i dati master di test di sistema, la formazione degli utenti, la gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi e tecnico/business andare in diretta. Questa è un'opportunità eccezionale per imparare come un'implementazione di tecnologia multi-milioni di dollari opera da zero e costruire competenze di gestione di progetti aziendali altamente commercializzabili. Principali responsabilità 1. Supporto PMO & Governance
• Track Project Milestones: Supporto PMO per il mantenimento e l'aggiornamento del piano di progetto di distribuzione master, tracciamento dei risultati attraverso vari flussi di lavoro.
• Coordinamento meeting: Organizzare, documentare e distribuire oggetti d'azione/minuti per sincronizzazioni a flusso di lavoro critiche e aggiornamenti del comitato direttivo.
• RAID Log Management: Assist nel mantenimento del registro Risk, Assunzioni, Problemi e Dipendenze (RAID), assicurando ai proprietari di aggiornare i loro piani di mitigazione settimanalmente. 2. Integrazione e disponibilità del sistema partner
• Interface Tracking: Mantenere la matrice di integrazione master, tracciando lo stato di sviluppo, test e sign-off di tutte le interfacce inbound e outbound che si collegano a S/4HANA & EWM.
• Coordinamento dei partner: agire come collegamento con partner esterni di terze parti, fornitori e utenti aziendali per coordinare la configurazione della connettività e i programmi di test dell'interfaccia end-to-end.
• Pianificazione di taglio per i sistemi: Supporta l'integrazione Piombo nella mappatura delle attività di transizione precise per tutte le interfacce del sistema partner. 2. Sostenibilità dei dati
• Monitoraggio: Assist Data Lead e proprietari di dati aziendali nel tracciare il progresso della raccolta e dei cicli di verifica dei dati in tutti gli oggetti di dati.
• Documentazione: Assistere nel documentare le definizioni dei dati, i requisiti di livello del campo, il caricamento dei dati e la strategia di verifica in un Piano di Input per supportare i futuri processi di governance dei dati.
• Supporto per la riconciliazione dei dati: Documento di aiuto report di riconciliazione dei dati pre- e post-carico, assicurando che i dati SAP caricati corrispondano perfettamente ai file sorgente approvati. 4. Coordinamento di prova
• Status & Defect Tracking: Monitorare lo stato e le metriche di difetti durante il test di accettazione dell'utente (UAT) e il test di accettazione del sistema (SAT) utilizzando strumenti come Solman, .
• Supporto del tester: aiuta a coordinare i programmi di test, assicurando che i tester aziendali abbiano l'accesso corretto, gli script di test e le varianti di dati richieste.
• Prova Logistica & Ambiente Promozione: Coordinare la logistica dei cicli di test, comprese le sale di prova di prenotazione, tracciare la frequenza quotidiana del tester e confermare che i dati di prova e la connettività ambientale necessari sono pronti prima dell'esecuzione. 5. Formazione, Autorizzazione e Gestione dei Cambiamenti Organizzativi (OCM)
• Training Logistics: Coordinare la pianificazione delle sessioni di formazione degli utenti finali, monitorare i tassi di completamento in diverse unità aziendali.
• Role Mapping: Supporta il team di sicurezza nella mappatura degli utenti aziendali per specifici ruoli di sicurezza SAP e autorizzazioni basate sulla progettazione organizzativa.
• Coordinamento Engagement & Event: Pianificare, organizzare e facilitare eventi di gestione dei cambiamenti - tra cui sale comunali, roadshow, workshop di allineamento di leadership,

La position Stage - Projet de transformation du PGI Aperçu du rôle Nous recherchons un stagiaire de projet de transformation ERP hautement motivé et axé sur les détails pour rejoindre notre équipe de transformation mondiale. Dans ce rôle, vous vous retrouverez au cœur de notre déploiement SAP S/4HANA & EWM, en profitant de l'exposition pratique à une transformation digitale et commerciale à grande échelle. Vous soutiendrez directement le Bureau de gestion de projet (BGP) et travaillerez de manière interfonctionnelle dans tous les secteurs de travail critiques - y compris l'intégration du système, les données de base d'essai du système, la formation des utilisateurs, la gestion du changement organisationnel et la mise en oeuvre des techniques et des activités. C'est une occasion exceptionnelle d'apprendre comment une mise en oeuvre technologique de plusieurs millions de dollars fonctionne depuis le début et d'acquérir des compétences hautement commercialisables en gestion de projets d'entreprise. Principales responsabilités 1. PMO & Soutien à la gouvernance
• Suivre les jalons du projet : aider le BGP à maintenir et à mettre à jour le plan directeur du projet de déploiement, à suivre les produits livrables dans divers secteurs de travail.
• Coordination de la réunion : Organiser, documenter et distribuer les points/minutes d'action pour les synchronisations essentielles du cycle de travail et les mises à jour du comité directeur.
• Gestion des registres RAID : Aider à maintenir le registre des risques, des hypothèses, des problèmes et des dépendances (RAID), en veillant à ce que les propriétaires mettent à jour leurs plans d'atténuation chaque semaine. 2. Intégration et préparation du système partenaire
• Suivi de l'interface: Maintenez la matrice d'intégration principale, suivi du développement, des tests et de l'état de signature de toutes les interfaces entrantes et sortantes se connectant à S/4HANA & EWM.
• Coordination des partenaires : agir en tant que liaison avec les partenaires externes, les fournisseurs et les utilisateurs commerciaux pour coordonner la configuration de la connectivité et les calendriers de tests d'interface de bout en bout.
• Cutover Planning for Systems: Supportez le responsable de l'intégration dans la cartographie des activités de transition précises pour toutes les interfaces du système partenaire. 2. Maîtrise de la préparation aux données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

The Head of Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management will lead RDT’s strategic technology vendor governance and Software Asset Management practice across a complex global technology landscape.

The role covers vendors across software, SaaS, cloud, platforms, on-premise infrastructure, infrastructure services and managed services. It is accountable for creating a transparent, stable, commercially disciplined and risk-managed vendor ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a large-scale technology vendor portfolio representing several hundred million CHF in spend and a team of around a dozen professionals.
The role combines vendor governance, SAM, licensing compliance, vendor risk management, service performance, operational stability, commercial oversight and senior stakeholder engagement.

Description of the area

Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management ensures that RDT’s critical technology vendors operate within clear standards, controls and performance expectations.
The function owns vendor governance frameworks and the SAM operating model, covering vendor lifecycle management, service performance, risk monitoring, license compliance, spend transparency and value realization.
It partners with RDT functions, IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture and Operations to ensure technology vendor relationships are compliant, stable, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise priorities.

Job responsibilities:

• Lead the Technology Vendor Management and Software Asset Management function, including strategy, operating model, standards, governance forums and team development.

• Govern a high-value technology vendor ecosystem across software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, platform and managed service providers.

• Define and implement baseline standards for technology vendor management, including SLAs, governance blueprint, escalation model, performance expectations and minimum control requirements.

• Own the SAM roadmap and lifecycle governance across entitlement, deployment, usage, compliance, optimization and remediation.

• Define and implement the technology vendor lifecycle model, from onboarding and classification through performance management, risk monitoring, renewal governance and exit planning.

• Establish dashboards and reporting for RDT leadership covering vendor performance, SAM status, license compliance, risk exposure, operational stability and key actions.

• Lead or coordinate vendor audit defense and remediation of licensing, contractual or compliance deviations.

• Drive software and technology spend optimization through usage analysis, renewal governance, license harvesting, reclaim, rightsizing, contract review and demand alignment.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on vendor risk, software compliance, licensing exposure, operational stability and technology vendor value.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in Technology Vendor Management, Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, supplier governance, software licensing, IT sourcing, technology procurement, service provider management or enterprise IT governance.

• Proven experience governing large-scale technology vendor portfolios involving complex contracts, critical vendors, material spend and senior stakeholder accountability.

• Strong understanding of vendor governance models, vendor lifecycle management, SLAs, perfor

La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Conoscenza esperta delle strutture SAM e dei principali modelli di licenza del fornitore. - Leadership: Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza e la partnership. Forte capacità di mentore un team tecnico in un ecosistema di stakeholder complesso e globale. Cosa? - Gamma di insalata 23.300 - 43.300 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 20%). - Indennità di automobile o di automobile. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Posizione Flex (possibilità) Contatto *(Nessun recapito fornito nel testo originale)*

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the microbiological testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely data to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.
● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of microbiology supplies

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• CCS Support: Support the establishment of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) for the aseptic production line.

• Environmental Monitoring (EM): Support EMPQ execution according to the project timeline.

• Microbiology Method Validation: Support the microbiology methods transfer, including supporting the confirmation of cleaning and disinfection processes, and the efficacy of disinfectants.

• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies
● 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on microbiology and aseptic processes. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and microbiological testing.
● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.
● Fluent communications skills in English
● Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab per completare GMP Self-Inspection e la relativa CAPAs per mantenere il livello globale di conformità GMP.

• Supporta iniziative magre nel campo delle operazioni di laboratorio, esecuzione dei metodi di prova, aggiornamento della documentazione e qualificazione delle attrezzature Supporto del progetto di ingegneria e la disponibilità di funzionamento:

L'esperienza MNC Biopharma è preferita ● Conoscenza sonora delle procedure di controllo della qualità e degli standard legali, con esperienza nella garanzia asettica e test microbiologici. ● Esperienza in QC nuova disponibilità di avvio della struttura e la rampa di funzionamento è preferito. ● Capacità di comunicazione fluida in inglese ● Le competenze di gestione del progetto sono preferite. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior IT Data Scientist is responsible for leading, developing, and implementing data-driven AI and GenAI solutions to complex business problems. This role involves independently identifying analytical opportunities, conducting in-depth data exploration and analysis, and building, testing, and deploying predictive models using various machine learning techniques. You will own projects from inception to deployment, leveraging strong programming, statistical modeling, and data visualization skills, while clearly communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Description of the area
The Demand to Pay (D2P) Data & Analytics area is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes. We’re looking for a hands-on Full-Stack AI Developer (Generalist) to join a small, fast-moving team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building end-to-end products, thrives in ambiguity, and is excited about applying AI in practical, user-facing applications.
This role seeks a broad skillset, strong foundational knowledge, and tech stack flexibility over deep specialization. You will support Roche's Data & AI strategies by working with global platforms.
This position involves collaboration with key stakeholders, including Global Procurement, Diagnostics Direct Procurement, and RSS Operations.

Job Responsibilities

• Design, build, and ship AI-powered applications from concept to production

• Develop backend services and APIs using Python

• Build responsive frontend interfaces using JavaScript / TypeScript

• Integrate LLMs into products for real-world use cases

• Build and improve RAG pipelines, prompt workflows, and agentic AI systems

• Work with modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and delivery

• Collaborate closely with product and business stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

• Take ownership of features across architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred

• Equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable

• Demonstrated experience in independently identifying analytical opportunities, conducting in-depth data exploration, and owning projects from inception to deployment.

• Proven track record of driving medium-sized projects that influence business decisions and align with strategic objectives.

• A strong portfolio / GitHub profile with personal projects is highly valued

Technical Skills

• Strong experience in Python backend development

• Solid experience with JavaScript / TypeScript frontend development

• Comfortable working across the full stack and shipping complete features

• Snowflake CORTEX AI or Dataiku (Optional)

AI / GenAI Experience

• Practical experience building AI-powered applications

• Strong understanding of:

• Prompt engineering

• RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines

• LLM integrations

• AI agents / agentic workflows

• Experience with frameworks/tools such as:

• LangChain

• LangGraph

• or similar AI orchestration frameworks

AI Coding Tools

You should actively use AI-assisted coding tools as part of your daily workflow. This is a key requirement and will significantly amplify all other capabilities.
For Examples:

• Claude Code

• OpenAI Codex

• Cursor

• GitHub Copilot

Additional Qualifica

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le spécialiste principal des données informatiques est chargé de diriger, de développer et de mettre en œuvre des solutions d'IA et de GenAI axées sur les données à des problèmes opérationnels complexes. Ce rôle consiste à identifier de manière indépendante les possibilités d'analyse, à effectuer des travaux approfondis d'exploration et d'analyse de données, à construire, à tester et à déployer des modèles prédictifs à l'aide de diverses techniques d'apprentissage automatique. Vous posséderez des projets depuis le début jusqu'au déploiement, en tirant parti de solides compétences en programmation, en modélisation statistique et en visualisation des données, tout en communiquant clairement les résultats aux intervenants techniques et non techniques. Description de la zone Le secteur des données et de l'analyse de la demande de paiement (D2P) est chargé de diriger les stratégies d'approvisionnement, de comptabilité à payer et de gestion des voyages et des dépenses en transformant les stratégies fonctionnelles en résultats opérationnels mesurables. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un développeur d'IA (généraliste) pour rejoindre une petite équipe en mouvement rapide. Ce rôle est idéal pour quelqu'un qui aime construire des produits de bout en bout, prospère dans l'ambiguïté et est impatient d'appliquer l'IA dans des applications pratiques et orientées vers l'utilisateur. Ce rôle vise une vaste gamme de compétences, de solides connaissances fondamentales et la flexibilité de la pile technologique par rapport à une spécialisation profonde. Vous soutiendrez les stratégies Data & AI de Roche en travaillant avec des plateformes mondiales. Ce poste comprend la collaboration avec les principaux intervenants, y compris l'approvisionnement mondial, l'approvisionnement diagnostique direct et les opérations RSS. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Concevoir, construire et expédier des applications alimentées par l'IA du concept à la production
• Développer des services de backend et des API en utilisant Python
• Construire des interfaces frontend réactives en utilisant JavaScript / TypeScript
• Intégrer les LLM dans des produits pour des cas d'utilisation réels
• Construire et améliorer les pipelines RAG, les flux de travail rapides et les systèmes d'intelligence artificielle agentique
• Travailler avec des outils modernes de codage de l'IA pour accélérer le développement et la livraison
• Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants du secteur des produits et des entreprises dans un environnement rapide
• Prise en charge des fonctionnalités dans l'architecture, la mise en œuvre, les essais et le déploiement Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel ou domaine connexe préféré
• Une expérience pratique équivalente est pleinement acceptable
• Expérience démontrée en ce qui a trait à l'identification indépendante des possibilités d'analyse, à l'exploration approfondie des données et à la possession de projets depuis le début jusqu'au déploiement.
• Expérience éprouvée de la conduite de projets de taille moyenne qui influent sur les décisions des entreprises et s'harmonisent avec les objectifs stratégiques.
• Un solide portfolio / profil GitHub avec des projets personnels est très apprécié Compétences techniques
• Forte expérience dans le développement du moteur Python
• Solid expérience avec JavaScript / TypeScript développement frontend
• Travail confortable sur la pile complète et l'expédition des fonctionnalités complètes
• CORTEX AI ou Dataiku (facultatif) Expérience AI / GenAI
• Expérience pratique pour la construction d'applications alimentées par l'IA
• Forte compréhension de :
• Ingénierie rapide

• Intégrations LLM

jobs.title: Country Medical Manager (BC)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base
