La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Scopo primario di lavoro (Riepilogo del lavoro) Il Country Medical Manager (CMM) è un partner affidabile, esternamente focalizzato, scientificamente fondato all'interno del nostro modello di customer engagement. Con la costruzione e il mantenimento di connessioni profonde e affidabili con i clienti di alto livello chiave in un periodo di tempo significativo, il CMM genererà l'impatto anticipando e ottimizzando proattivamente la pratica medica, e assicurarsi che Roche è un partner preferito nelle nostre aree di malattia chiave. La funzione medica funge da motore critico di competitività per garantire che le nostre innovazioni raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale per i pazienti con una prospettiva finale. Il ruolo del CMM è progettato per massimizzare le attività mediche e scientifiche locali e di fondo per accelerare la consegna della nostra pipeline, differenziare il nostro portafoglio in base ai dati, guidare l'advocacy strategica, l'impegno della comunità, l'adozione della pratica medica, e l'accesso al nostro portafoglio mediante la capitalizzazione proattiva su "Momenti che Matter" attraverso il ciclo di vita degli asset. Principio ruoli e responsabilità / responsabilità 1. Contribuire con Medical Expertise (core & common):
• Competenza medica: responsabile per contribuire attivamente a una forte competenza scientifica, medica e terapeutica nell'ambito delle pertinenti malattie che informano la differenziazione della nostra pipeline e del nostro portafoglio. Agire come esperto medico per la pipeline e il portafoglio durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Strategia di forma: Guidare la parte medica della strategia integrata, modellare una storia di valore, scientificamente sana e differenziata localmente e comunicare i contributi di Roche in aree chiave di malattia, riflettendo una prospettiva aziendale end-to-end che tira attraverso la strategia con impatto. 2. Impegno e opinioni dei clienti attivi (core & common):
• Impegno medico mirato attivo: come funzione medica la nostra ambizione è quella di trascorrere la maggior parte del nostro tempo attivamente coinvolgendo con i clienti esterni come partner nella strategia di coinvolgimento del cliente integrata. Il CMM funge da esperto scientifico e medico, attivando proattivamente TAE di alto livello e altri principali stakeholder in pieno allineamento strategico e operativo con altri ruoli in campo. Nella fase pre-lancio è la priorità di guidare strategie E2E proattive che offrono un'esperienza superiore, anticipare il futuro e modellare la pratica medica di conseguenza. Nella fase post-launch l'impegno continua a garantire che i pazienti giusti siano trattati al momento giusto e la portata di fidanzamento si espande sulle popolazioni dei pazienti non servite. Il coinvolgimento in campo serve come componente fondamentale di questa strategia di overarching per il coinvolgimento scientifico mirato. Si capisce che in base alle esigenze aziendali il CMM può servire come punto di contatto primario per alcuni clienti con l'ambizione di guidare i cambiamenti del sistema sanitario richiesti e dove possibile prima e più ampia adozione del nostro portafoglio trasformativo.
• Partenariato medico & Istruzione: Stabilire e mantenere efficaci relazioni tra pari e genitori con gli stakeholder esterni e identificare / sviluppare collaborazioni scientifiche conTAEs. Fornire corrente, di alta qualità, piano di educazione medica integrata e differenziare le informazioni scientifiche ai clienti esterni, sostenere la formazione scientifica dei team interni e garantire la formazione continua sulle conoscenze mediche per i ruoli PPoC. Condurre scambi scientifici internazionali e nazionali di alta qualità, non promozionali per diffondere i dati pertinenti, promuovere la fiducia del medico e la base di approvazione clinica
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Hauptzweck des Jobs (Job Summary) Der Country Medical Manager (CMM) ist ein vertrauenswürdiger, extern fokussierter, wissenschaftlich fundierter Partner in unserem Kundenbindungsmodell. Durch den Aufbau und die Pflege tiefer und zuverlässiger Verbindungen zu wichtigen Top-Kunden über einen sinnvollen Zeitraum hinweg wird das CMM durch die Antizipation und proaktive Optimierung der medizinischen Praxis Wirkung erzielen und sicherstellen, dass Roche ein bevorzugter Partner in unseren wichtigsten Krankheitsgebieten ist. Die medizinische Funktion dient als entscheidender Motor der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Innovationen ihr volles Potenzial für Patienten mit einer End-to-End-Perspektive erreichen. Die Rolle des CMM wurde entwickelt, um die lokalen und länderübergreifenden medizinischen und wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten zu maximieren, um die Lieferung unserer Pipeline zu beschleunigen, unser Portfolio auf der Grundlage von Daten zu differenzieren, strategische Interessenvertretung, Community-Engagement, Adoption in der medizinischen Praxis und den Zugang zu unserem Portfolio zu fördern, indem proaktiv "Moments that Matter" über den gesamten Asset-Lebenszyklus hinweg genutzt wird. Grundlegende Rollen & Verantwortlichkeiten / Verantwortlichkeiten 1. Beitrag mit medizinischer Expertise (core & common):
• Medizinische Expertise: verantwortlich für die proaktive Einbringung starker wissenschaftlicher, medizinischer und therapeutischer Expertise innerhalb der relevanten Krankheiten, die die Differenzierung unserer Pipeline und unseres Portfolios beeinflussen. Als medizinischer Experte für die Pipeline und das Portfolio während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
• Strategie gestalten: Führen Sie den medizinischen Teil der integrierten Strategie, gestalten Sie eine zukunftsorientierte, wissenschaftlich fundierte und differenzierte Wertgeschichte vor Ort und kommunizieren Sie die Beiträge von Roche in den wichtigsten Krankheitsbereichen und spiegeln Sie eine End-to-End-Geschäftsperspektive wider, die die Strategie mit Wirkung durchzieht. 2. Proaktives Customer Engagement & Insights (Core & Common):
• Proaktives gezieltes medizinisches Engagement: Als medizinische Funktion ist es unser Ziel, den Großteil unserer Zeit proaktiv mit externen Kunden als Partnern in der integrierten Kundenbindungsstrategie zu verbringen. Das CMM dient als wissenschaftlicher und medizinischer Experte, der proaktiv hochrangige TAEs und andere wichtige Interessengruppen in voller strategischer und operativer Ausrichtung mit anderen Rollen vor Ort einbezieht. In der Pre-Launch-Phase ist es die Priorität, proaktive E2E-Strategien voranzutreiben, die überlegene Erfahrungen liefern, die Zukunft antizipieren und die medizinische Praxis entsprechend gestalten. In der Post-Launch-Phase sorgt das Engagement weiterhin dafür, dass die richtigen Patienten zur richtigen Zeit behandelt werden und der Umfang des Engagements auf ungenutzte Patientenpopulationen erweitert wird. In-Field-Engagement ist eine wichtige Komponente dieser übergreifenden Strategie für gezieltes wissenschaftliches Engagement. Es versteht sich, dass die CMM auf der Grundlage der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse als primäre Anlaufstelle für bestimmte Kunden dienen kann, die die erforderlichen Veränderungen des Gesundheitssystems vorantreiben und, wo möglich, unser transformatives Portfolio früher und breiter einführen wollen.
• Medical Partnership & Education: Aufbau und Pflege effektiver Peer-to-Peer-Beziehungen mit externen Stakeholdern und Identifizierung / Entwicklung wissenschaftsgetriebener Kooperationen mit TAE. Bereitstellung eines aktuellen, qualitativ hochwertigen, integrierten Medical Education-Plans und differenzierender wissenschaftlicher Informationen für externe Kunden, Unterstützung der wissenschaftlichen Ausbildung interner Teams und Gewährleistung einer kontinuierlichen Schulung zu medizinischem Wissen für PPoC-Rollen. Durchführung eines qualitativ hochwertigen, nicht werbeorientierten internationalen/nationalen wissenschaftlichen Austauschs zur Verbreitung relevanter Daten, zur Förderung des Vertrauens von Ärzten und der klinischen Unterstützungsbasis
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position But principal de l'emploi (résumé de l'emploi) Le Country Medical Manager (CMM) est un partenaire fiable, axé sur l'extérieur, scientifiquement basé dans notre modèle d'engagement client. En établissant et en maintenant des liens profonds et fiables avec des clients clés de premier plan sur une période de temps significative, le MMC générera de l'impact en anticipant et en optimisant de façon proactive la pratique médicale, et en veillant à ce que Roche soit un partenaire privilégié dans nos domaines de maladies clés. La fonction médicale est un moteur essentiel de la compétitivité pour assurer que nos innovations atteignent leur plein potentiel pour les patients dans une perspective de bout en bout. Le rôle du MMC est conçu pour maximiser les activités médicales et scientifiques locales et internationales afin d'accélérer la mise en oeuvre de notre pipeline, de différencier notre portefeuille en fonction des données, de stimuler la sensibilisation stratégique, l'engagement communautaire, l'adoption de pratiques médicales et l'accès à notre portefeuille en capitalisant proactivement sur les « Mouvements qui comptent » tout au long du cycle de vie des actifs. Rôles, responsabilités et responsabilités 1. Contribution à l'expertise médicale (essentielle et courante) :
• Expertise médicale : responsable de la contribution proactive d'une expertise scientifique, médicale et thérapeutique solide au sein des maladies pertinentes pour la différenciation de notre pipeline et de notre portefeuille. Agir comme expert médical pour le pipeline et le portefeuille tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Stratégie de forme : Diriger la partie médicale de la stratégie intégrée, façonner localement une histoire de valeur prospective, scientifiquement solide et différenciée et communiquer les contributions de Roches dans les domaines clés de la maladie, reflétant une perspective commerciale de bout en bout qui tire à travers la stratégie avec impact. 2. Engagement et points de vue proactifs des clients (de base et communs):
• Engagement médical ciblé proactif: En tant que fonction médicale, notre ambition est de passer la majorité de notre temps à s'engager proactivement avec des clients externes en tant que partenaires dans la stratégie intégrée d'engagement client. Le CGM est l'expert scientifique et médical, en faisant participer de façon proactive les TAE de haut niveau et d'autres intervenants clés à l'harmonisation stratégique et opérationnelle complète avec d'autres rôles sur le terrain. Dans la phase de pré-lancement, il est prioritaire de conduire des stratégies proactives d'E2E qui fournissent une expérience supérieure, anticipent l'avenir et façonnent la pratique médicale en conséquence. Au cours de la phase postérieure au lancement, l'engagement continue de garantir que les bons patients sont traités au bon moment et que la portée de l'engagement s'étend aux populations de patients non desservis. L'engagement sur le terrain constitue une composante essentielle de cette stratégie globale d'engagement scientifique ciblé. Il est entendu qu'en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, le MMC peut servir de point de contact principal pour certains clients ayant l'ambition de provoquer les changements requis du système de santé et, si possible, d'adopter plus tôt et plus largement notre portefeuille de transformation.
• Partenariat médical et éducation: Établir et maintenir des relations efficaces entre les pairs et les intervenants externes et identifier et développer des collaborations fondées sur la science avec les EAT. Fournir un plan d'éducation médicale intégré et de haute qualité et différencier l'information scientifique aux clients externes, appuyer la formation scientifique des équipes internes et assurer une formation continue sur les connaissances médicales pour les rôles du PPOC. Mener des échanges scientifiques internationaux/nationaux de haute qualité et non promotionnels afin de diffuser les données pertinentes, de favoriser la confiance des médecins et de favoriser l'approbation clinique

jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Edge Defense
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area
The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats.
The core stack of this team includes:

• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation

• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services

• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP

​
Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").

• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.

• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).

• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes.

Who You Are

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset

• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset

• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams

​
Education

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience

• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM)

​
Technical Skills

• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions

• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus

• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies

• Automation

La posizione Come Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Descrizione della zona Il team Edge Defense appartiene all'organizzazione Network Security, una pietra angolare della sicurezza dell'informazione. Forniamo le tecnologie e i servizi che proteggono l'intera rete da incidenti IT Security e minacce digitali. Lo stack principale di questa squadra include:
• Difesa perimetrale: Network Firewalls e DDoS Mitigation
• Architettura moderna: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) servizi
• Sicurezza della rete cloud in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Responsabilità del lavoro
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Definire la roadmap digitale per la difesa dei perimetri (Firewalls, DDoS) e l'architettura moderna (Zero Trust) attraverso i segmenti di rete più esterni, sia in ambienti multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Eccellenza operativa & Automation: Guidare una mentalità "Automation First" per la sicurezza della rete esterna, sfruttando API e scripting per sostituire il lavoro manuale con codice di sicurezza scalabile ("Shift Left").
• Cloud-Native Security: Guida la strategia di sicurezza per la complessa impronta multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), concentrandosi sulla sicurezza del perimetro e del bordo di rete nel cloud.
• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Proprio il ciclo di vita end-to-end per le tecnologie Edge Defense, dalla scoperta a scala globale, garantendo il rispetto delle normative pertinenti (ad esempio, GDPR, escludendo GxP per la messa a fuoco non manifatturiera).
• Business Translation: Collegare le prestazioni di sicurezza tecnica della rete esterna ai risultati aziendali più ampi, assicurando che la sicurezza sia un acceleratore per R&D e altri ambienti non produttivi.
• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Profondamente capire cliente e business ha bisogno di modellare la direzione strategica e la roadmap digitale per il prodotto Edge Defense, concentrandosi sulla fornitura di risultati di alto valore. Chi sei Esperienza
• 5+ anni di esperienza in Information Security è un bene
• 3+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata è un bene
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella leadership delle persone, nella gestione del prodotto/servizio, nella gestione del programma o in un ruolo simile, con una comprovata esperienza nella costruzione di team ad alte prestazioni ​ Istruzione
• Laurea o laurea in Scienze informatiche, sicurezza informatica, tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo di ingegneria correlato o esperienza equivalente
• Le certificazioni professionali di sicurezza sono un plus (ad esempio CISSP, CISM) ​ Competenze tecniche
• Sfondo collaudato e solida fondazione in Information Security specificamente in Network Firewalls (ad esempio, Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (ad esempio, Cisco ISE) e soluzioni ZTNA
• L'esperienza in ambienti multi-cloud è un plus
• Eccellenza Operativa: Forte comprensione dei framework ITIL (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) e metodologie di miglioramento continuo
• Automazione

Sie werden sie dabei unterstützen, Hindernisse zu beseitigen und sich auf ihr Leistungsmanagement zu konzentrieren. • Bachelor oder Advanced Degree in Informatik, Cyber Security, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Engineering-Bereich oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• Professionelle Informationssicherheitszertifizierungen sind ein Plus (z.B. CISSP, CISM) ​ Technische Fähigkeiten
• Bewährter Hintergrund und solides Fundament in der Informationssicherheit speziell in Netzwerk-Firewalls (z. B. Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (z. B. Cisco ISE) und ZTNA-Lösungen

• Automatisierung

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint.
PTE catalyzes the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Manufacturing Specialist – Cyber Security to join our PTE organization. In this role, you will serve as the key liaison between the global TechOps cyber security function and our local manufacturing sites across the globe.
Your mission will be to ensure compliance, secure operations, elevate Operational Technology (OT) security awareness, and achieve seamless integration of enterprise-level initiatives with site-specific needs. This position requires a strong blend of manufacturing knowledge, cyber security awareness, and exceptional stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities:

• PT Representation at Site: Act as the primary liaison and strategic bridge between manufacturing site operations and the PTE cyber security / digital teams.

• Site Compliance: Ensure site-level compliance with corporate cyber security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

• Security Integration: Drive the seamless roll-out of global enterprise security initiatives, adapting them effectively to local manufacturing needs without disrupting operations.

• Awareness & Culture: Elevate OT (Operational Technology) security awareness among site staff, fostering a culture of cyber-vigilance.

Who You Are
You are someone who shares our passion for science, technology, and people. You bring structure, collaboration, and a secure-by-design mindset to manufacturing environments.
To be successful in this role, you should bring:

• A proven track record or strong background in manufacturing operations combined with a solid awareness of Cyber Security/OT Security.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between global strategies and local site execution.

• A proactive approach to compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement.

• Fluency in English (global team collaboration).

Who We Are
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

Who we are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team.
This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.

• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.

• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.

• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.

• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

La position Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. La section Ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sécuritaires qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Dans ce rôle, vous participerez à une vaste collaboration interfonctionnelle, en particulier avec des équipes d'assurance de la qualité (AQ), d'affaires réglementaires, cliniques et commerciales. De plus, vous assumerez des responsabilités stratégiques et contribuerez aux efforts menés par l'équipe de direction du génie des appareils. • Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour assurer des conceptions conformes aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 et 21 CFR 820.30) Qui vous êtes :
• Vous avez une formation de niveau universitaire (diplôme d'ingénierie ou discipline connexe).

• Vous avez une expertise pratique de développement d'injecteurs Pen / Auto.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
The Medical Network Expert/Lead is a key role that brings the Medical Scientific Affairs (MSA) strategy to life for a given disease area by serving as the interface between China Medical Affairs teams, China cross-functional strategy teams, Regional, and Global teams to deliver an integrated medical strategy plan that incorporates short-, mid- and long-term perspectives. The Medical Strategy Partner works hand in hand with the Medical Affairs team members to understand and address customer needs, leverages external stakeholder generated insights, and collaborate with the Global teams to provide China-specific insights into products in development.

医疗网络专家/经理是一个关键角色，通过作为中国医疗事务团队、中国跨职能战略团队、区域和全球团队之间的桥梁，为特定疾病领域带来医学科学事务（MSA）战略，以提供包含短期、中期和长期视角的综合医学战略计划。医学网络专家/经理与医学事务团队成员携手合作，了解并满足客户需求，利用外部利益相关者提出的见解，并与全球团队合作，为正在开发的产品提供中国市场特有的洞见

Main Tasks & Responsibilities主要工作职责 :
1. Bring clinical insights to all disease area medical squad conversations
在所有疾病领域医学相关讨论中提供临床见解
2. Works within the cross functional core team, in close collaboration with the MSA stakeholders to develop the medical components of the overall China integrated strategy for a given disease area (and related assets/services) leveraging external stakeholder generated insights/needs
在跨职能核心团队中工作，与MSA团队伙伴密切合作利用外部利益相关者提出的见解/需求，针对特定疾病领域制定中国整体综合战略
3. Coordinate medical strategy plan development for a particular disease area to include: INSIGHTS, INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE, GUIDELINES and EDUCATION & SCIENTIFIC EXCHANGES
协调特定疾病领域的医学战略计划制定，包括：见解、创新、证据、指南以及教育和科学交流
4. Develop a robust KOL network outside of the company that can be strategically tapped for medical insights and advocacy work
在公司外部建立强大的 KOL 网络并战略性地利用该网络进行医学见解宣传
5. Review outputs of internal partners for medical accuracy and patient centricity
审查内部合作伙伴的交付成果以确保医学准确性以及以患者为中心的宗旨被充分贯彻
6. Supports the creation of an inspiring team environment with agile, open, and inclusive culture
支持创建具有敏捷、开放和包容文化的鼓舞人心的团队环境
7. May support Medical Affairs work in the specific disease area as needed and respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, or off-label information.
按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。
8. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional cooperation to maximize utilization of resources
识别跨职能合作的机会以最大限度地利用资源

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:
Education & Qualifications教育背景与专业资格:
MD, PhD or PharmD and working experience in relevant disease areas
医学、科学或药学博士及相关疾病领域的工作经验
Experience工作经验:
1. 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing medical strategies for various diseases in the medical or pharmaceutical industry
4年以上在医学或制药行业，具备针对各种疾病制定和实施医疗策略的经验
2. Clinical research and trial management experience, and the ability to interact with KOLs with sufficient knowledge, expertise and confidence.
临床研究试验管理经验，及拥有丰富的知识，专长及自信与KOL 进行互动的能力
3. Must maintain knowledge of applicable research and literature
对适用的研究文献有知识储备
4. Fluent English skills and excellent presentation and teaching skills and the ability to represent the company in a professional manner at medical, scientific and public events.
流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力
Values & Core Competencies 价值观与核心能力：
• Demonstrate Roche values of Integrity, Courage, Passion
体现罗氏的价值观：真诚,勇气,激情
• Follow Roche Operating Principles
遵循罗氏运营准则
• Equip with the core skill sets as required by this role

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Das Site Management stellt Rahmenbedingungen und Infrastruktur für unsere rund 16.000 Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim & Penzberg in Deutschland zur Verfügung, um mit diagnostischen und medizinischen Lösungen wertschöpfend für Patienten tätig sein zu können.
Das Chapter Engineering ist mit 160 Mitarbeitenden für die strategische Entwicklung und die erfolgreiche Planung sowie Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte in Bezug auf Gebäude & Anlagenbau in Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Aktuell setzen wir ca. 100 Projekte mit einem Volumen von wenigen Millionen Euro bis hin zu einigen hundert Millionen Euro um. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten. Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Senior Projekt Manager Capex (m/w/d) führst du Investitionsprojekte größer 100 mEUR, sowohl im Green- als auch Brownfield. Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für hochgradig komplexe Projekte im Umfeld Pharma, Health Care und Diagnostica. Im Detail beinhaltet dies folgende spannende Tätigkeiten:

• Du bist für das Abwicklungsmodell und alle Ressourcen und Verträge während der strategischen Projektphase, der Planung, der Umsetzung sowie der Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierung verantwortlich.

• Durch Deine technologische und prozessuale Expertise, Deine Fähigkeit Business Strategien in Lösungsoptionen zu übersetzen, präzises Anforderungsmanagement und die Sicherstellung eines stabilen Designs, sicherst Du unsere ambitionierten Projektziele ab.

• Du hast sehr ausgeprägte Präsentationsfähigkeiten und kannst andere begeistern, identifizierst relevante Stakeholder und bindest diese zum richtigen Zeitpunkt ein. Steering Committees und Gremien für finanzielle Genehmigungen überzeugst Du durch das richtige Detaillevel und gleichzeitig hohe Transparenz. Auf dem “politischen Parkett” fühlst Du Dich zu Hause.

• Als Vordenker treibst Du Innovationen voran, indem du neue Technologien und Prozesse identifizierst, entwickelst und erfolgreich implementierst.

• Du führst Dein Team mit Empathie und Klarheit, verteilst Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten gemäß den individuellen Stärken und Fähigkeiten Deiner Teammitglieder und sorgst Du für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit und einen optimalen Informationsfluss – auch über externe Dienstleister hinweg.

• Dein Wissen und deine Expertise gibst du gerne in Form von Mentoring und Ausbildung an Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Tiefe Expertise und Berufserfahrung (10+ Jahre, vorzugsweise in den Branchen Pharma, Health Care, Anlagenbau)

• Führungskompetenz und erfolgreicher Abschluss von großen und komplexen Investitionsprojekten

• Ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium (Uni, FH, oder gleichwertig)

• Anerkannte Zertifizierung im Projektmanagement

• Generalisten Fähigkeiten mit tiefgreifender Expertise in Projektmanagement (agile, klassische und hybride Ansätze), Sinn für ein erfolgreiches Stakeholdermanagement sowie Expertise in und Offenheit für verschiedene Abwicklungs- und Vertragsmodelle

• Kenntnis von Qualifizierungsprozessen und Anforderungen im GMP-Umfeld

• Analytisches und kritisches Denken, Selbstreflektion, hohe Problemlösungskompetenz

• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Wiss

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Site Management fornisce condizioni quadro e infrastrutture per i nostri circa 16.000 dipendenti nei siti di Mannheim & Penzberg in Germania per poter lavorare con soluzioni diagnostiche e mediche che aggiungono valore ai pazienti. Con 160 dipendenti, Chapter Engineering è responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e della riuscita pianificazione e realizzazione di tutti i principali progetti di investimento relativi agli edifici e alla costruzione di impianti a Mannheim e Penzberg. Al momento mettiamo ca. 100 progetti con un volume di pochi milioni di euro fino a poche centinaia di milioni di euro. Attraverso il nostro lavoro, garantiamo la fornitura dei nostri pazienti con prodotti innovativi. Siamo un'unità con gerarchie piatte e attribuiamo grande importanza alla responsabilità personale, una cultura aziendale aperta e divertimento sul lavoro. Il lavoro di squadra, il sostegno reciproco e i gradi di libertà nello sviluppo del progetto sono una questione naturalmente per noi. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta Come Senior Project Manager Capex (m/f/d) si guidano progetti di investimento di oltre 100 mEUR, sia a Greenfield che a Brownfield. Si assume la responsabilità generale per progetti altamente complessi nei settori farmaceutico, sanitario e diagnostico. In dettaglio, questo include le seguenti attività interessanti:
• Sei responsabile del modello di esecuzione e di tutte le risorse e i contratti durante la fase strategica del progetto, la pianificazione, l'implementazione, la messa in servizio e la qualificazione.
• Attraverso la vostra esperienza tecnologica e di processo, la vostra capacità di tradurre le strategie aziendali in opzioni di soluzione, la gestione precisa dei requisiti e garantire un design stabile, garantite i nostri obiettivi di progetto ambiziosi.
• Hai competenze di presentazione molto forti e puoi ispirare gli altri, identificare gli stakeholder rilevanti e coinvolgerli al momento giusto. Commissioni e organi direttivi per l'approvazione finanziaria Si attraversa il giusto livello di dettaglio e allo stesso tempo elevata trasparenza. Sul “piano politico” ci si sente a casa.
• Come leader di pensiero, si guida l'innovazione identificando, sviluppando e implementando con successo nuove tecnologie e processi.
• Guida il tuo team con empatia e chiarezza, distribuisci compiti e responsabilità in base ai punti di forza e alle capacità individuali dei membri del tuo team e garantisci una cooperazione fluida e un flusso ottimale di informazioni, anche attraverso i fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Sei felice di trasmettere le tue conoscenze e competenze ai colleghi sotto forma di mentoring e formazione. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti
• Profonda competenza e esperienza professionale (10+ anni, preferibilmente nei settori farmaceutico, sanitario, ingegneria vegetale)
• Competenze di leadership e completamento di grandi e complessi progetti di investimento
• Laurea in ingegneria (uni, FH, o equivalente)
• Certificazione riconosciuta nella gestione del progetto
• Competenze generalistiche con competenze approfondite nella gestione del progetto (approccio agile, classico e ibrido), senso di gestione degli stakeholder di successo e competenza e apertura a vari modelli di regolamento e contratto
• Conoscenza dei processi e dei requisiti di qualificazione nell'ambiente GMP
• pensiero analitico e critico, autoriflessione, elevata competenza di problem solving
• Forte comprensione di Wiss

The Position Site Management provides framework conditions and infrastructure for our approximately 16,000 employees at the Mannheim & Penzberg sites in Germany in order to be able to work with diagnostic and medical solutions that add value to patients. With 160 employees, Chapter Engineering is responsible for the strategic development and the successful planning and implementation of all major investment projects relating to buildings and plant construction in Mannheim and Penzberg. At the moment we put approx. 100 projects with a volume of a few million euros up to a few hundred million euros. Through our work, we ensure the supply of our patients with innovative products. We are a unit with flat hierarchies and attach great importance to personal responsibility, an open corporate culture and fun at work. Teamwork, mutual support and degrees of freedom in project development are a matter of course for us. Responsibility | This is what awaits you As Senior Project Manager Capex (m/f/d) you lead investment projects of more than 100 mEUR, both in Greenfield and Brownfield. You assume overall responsibility for highly complex projects in the pharmaceutical, health care and diagnostics sectors. In detail, this includes the following exciting activities:
• You are responsible for the execution model and all resources and contracts during the strategic project phase, planning, implementation, commissioning and qualification.
• Through your technological and process expertise, your ability to translate business strategies into solution options, precise requirements management and ensuring a stable design, you secure our ambitious project goals.
• You have very strong presentation skills and can inspire others, identify relevant stakeholders and engage them at the right time. Steering committees and bodies for financial approval You through the right level of detail and at the same time high transparency. On the “political floor” you feel at home.
• As a thought leader, you drive innovation by identifying, developing and successfully implementing new technologies and processes.
• You lead your team with empathy and clarity, distribute tasks and responsibilities according to the individual strengths and abilities of your team members and ensure smooth cooperation and an optimal flow of information – also across external service providers.
• You are happy to pass on your knowledge and expertise to colleagues in the form of mentoring and training. Qualifications | This is what you bring
• Deep expertise and professional experience (10+ years, preferably in the pharmaceutical, health care, plant engineering sectors)
• Leadership skills and successful completion of large and complex investment projects
• Engineering degree (uni, FH, or equivalent)
• Recognized certification in project management
• Generalist skills with in-depth expertise in project management (agile, classical and hybrid approaches), sense of successful stakeholder management, and expertise in and openness to various settlement and contract models
• Knowledge of qualification processes and requirements in the GMP environment
• Analytical and critical thinking, self-reflection, high problem-solving competence
• Strong understanding of Wiss

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

Who you are

We look for curious, inclusive, and innovative change agents with a pro

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the global Demand-to-Pay landscape and drive the tactical execution of digital procurement innovations? As our Business Process Expert (BPE) located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take tactical and strategic ownership over complex business processes in the Demand-to-Pay space for DOP. In this role, you will analyze, design, and implement innovative solutions - including adjoining IT ecosystems like SAP and myBuy - to increase stability, reduce errors, and drive seamless process adoption across the global network.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external service providers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role blending tactical process execution with strategic design elements.

• Impact: You drive departmental efficiency, process compliance, and effective change management. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Optimization & System Integration: Managing and further developing complex business processes within the Demand-to-Pay landscape and designing efficient interfaces to other business processes.

• Innovation & Automation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process improvements, automation, and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

• Project Leadership: Leading partial and overall projects independently, contributing to large local and global cross-functional teams, and independently designing workshops and training courses.

• Innovative Solution Design: Developing and analyzing innovative approaches to complex problems and system optimizations, verifying them at a global level, and guiding their local implementation.

• Process Optimization: Analyzing and implementing area-specific solutions to reduce critical errors, increase stability and productivity, and integrate Best Practices for optimal usage.

• Strategic Process Development & Knowledge Transfer: Driving continuous improvement through simple, fast, and agile business processes while acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to ensure robust know-how transfer across the organization.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix conflicts regarding competing project priorities or process expectations, while delivering high-frequency (monthly/quarterly) KPI updates - such as cycle times and compliance - to the CoE LT and DPLT.

Who you are

We look for positive, self-reflecting professionals with a solution-oriented "Can-Do" attitude and a clear focus on end-to-end perspectives.

• Education: A University degree with a business or life scie

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a ottimizzare il panorama globale della domanda-a-Pay e a guidare l'esecuzione tattica delle innovazioni di approvvigionamento digitale? Come nostro Business Process Expert (BPE) situato a Sant Cugat, Spagna, si prende la proprietà tattica e strategica su complessi processi aziendali nello spazio Demand-to-Pay per DOP. In questo ruolo, si analizza, progetta e implementa soluzioni innovative - tra cui gli ecosistemi IT come SAP e myBuy - per aumentare la stabilità, ridurre gli errori, e guidare l'adozione di processo senza soluzione di continuità in tutta la rete globale.
• Reporting Line: Report direttamente al Digital & Process Management Lead e fa parte del Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholder: gestirai relazioni interfunzionali attraverso il DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement e fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale fondendo l'esecuzione tattica del processo con elementi di progettazione strategici.
• Impatto: Lei guida l'efficienza dipartimentale, la conformità del processo e la gestione efficace del cambiamento. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Ottimizzazione del processo & Integrazione del sistema: Gestione e sviluppo di processi aziendali complessi all'interno del paesaggio di Demand-to-Pay e progettazione di interfacce efficienti ad altri processi aziendali.
• Innovazione & Automazione: individuare attivamente le opportunità di miglioramento del processo, automazione e digitalizzazione in stretta collaborazione con Delivery, Categoria, Digital & Process Management e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Leadership del progetto: Leader di progetti parziali e globali in modo indipendente, contribuendo a grandi team interfunzionali locali e globali, e progettazione indipendente di workshop e corsi di formazione.
• Innovative Solution Design: sviluppo e analisi di approcci innovativi a problemi complessi e ottimizzazione del sistema, verificandoli a livello globale e guidando la loro implementazione locale.
• Ottimizzazione del processo: analizzare e implementare soluzioni specifiche per l'area per ridurre gli errori critici, aumentare la stabilità e la produttività e integrare le Best Practices per un utilizzo ottimale.
• Trasferimento strategico di processo e conoscenza: Guidare il miglioramento continuo attraverso processi aziendali semplici, veloci e agili, agendo come esperto di materia (SME) soggetto per garantire un trasferimento di know-how robusto in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Conflict & Exposure: Risolvere i conflitti di matrice per quanto riguarda le priorità del progetto in competizione o le aspettative di processo, offrendo al contempo aggiornamenti KPI ad alta frequenza (mese / trimestrale) - come tempi di ciclo e conformità - al CoE LT e DPLT. Chi sei Cerchiamo professionisti positivi e auto-riflettenti con un atteggiamento "Can-Do" orientato alla soluzione e un chiaro focus sulle prospettive end-to-end.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria con una scienza aziendale o di vita

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à optimiser le paysage global de la demande à la paye et à conduire l'exécution tactique des innovations en matière d'approvisionnement numérique? En tant qu'expert en processus d'affaires (BPE) situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous prendrez la propriété tactique et stratégique des processus d'affaires complexes dans l'espace de demande à paiement pour DOP. Dans ce rôle, vous analyserez, concevoirez et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes - y compris des écosystèmes informatiques adjacents comme SAP et myBuy - pour augmenter la stabilité, réduire les erreurs et conduire à l'adoption de processus sans faille dans tout le réseau mondial.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement du responsable de la gestion numérique et des processus et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et intervenants : Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), le COE LT, la catégorie du DOP, la livraison du DOP, les équipes d'approvisionnement du DOP, la demande de paiement du RSS, l'approvisionnement mondial et les fournisseurs de services externes.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel rôle combinant l'exécution de processus tactiques avec des éléments de conception stratégique.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'efficacité ministérielle, la conformité des processus et une gestion efficace du changement. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Optimisation des processus et intégration des systèmes : gérer et développer des processus opérationnels complexes dans le contexte de la demande à la paye et concevoir des interfaces efficaces avec d'autres processus opérationnels.
• Innovation et automatisation : identifier proactivement les possibilités d'amélioration des processus, d'automatisation et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Leadership du projet : Diriger les projets partiels et globaux de façon indépendante, contribuer à la création de grandes équipes locales et mondiales interfonctionnelles, et concevoir des ateliers et des cours de formation de façon indépendante.
• Conception de solutions innovantes : Développer et analyser des approches novatrices pour résoudre des problèmes complexes et optimiser les systèmes, les vérifier au niveau mondial et guider leur mise en œuvre locale.
• Optimisation du processus : Analyser et mettre en œuvre des solutions spécifiques à une zone afin de réduire les erreurs critiques, d'accroître la stabilité et la productivité et d'intégrer les meilleures pratiques pour une utilisation optimale.
• Développement des processus stratégiques et transfert des connaissances : Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des processus opérationnels simples, rapides et agiles tout en agissant en tant qu'expert en matière (EMS) pour assurer un transfert solide de savoir-faire dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Conflits et exposition : Résoudre les conflits de matrice concernant les priorités concurrentes du projet ou les attentes en matière de processus, tout en fournissant des mises à jour de l'ICP à haute fréquence (mensuelle ou trimestrielle) - comme les temps de cycle et la conformité - au CdE LT et au DPLT. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des professionnels positifs et auto-réfléchissants avec une attitude « Can-Do » orientée vers la solution et un accent clair sur les perspectives de bout en bout.
• Éducation: Diplôme universitaire avec une entreprise ou une scie de vie

jobs.title: Business Capability Lead - Source-to-Pay

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la capacité opérationnelle - source à paiement

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to architect the global digital process landscape and lead the strategic optimization of systems that drive our end-to-end global procurement operations? As our Business Capability Lead (BCL) located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take strategic and operational ownership over critical segments of the global Demand-to-Pay process landscape. In this high-impact role, you will define process governance, integrate complex interfaces across corporate ecosystems, and serve as a vital change agent to accelerate the myBuy solution adoption across the enterprise. myBuy is Roche's digital procurement platform, designed to enhance the procure-to-pay process by providing transparency, timely transactions, and automation for our buying operations.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to our Sourcing Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Leads a global Business Capability Community formed by SMEs. You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external technology providers.

• Role Type: As BCL, you represent DOP`s business interests globally in relevant forums, and you are responsible for the development and continuous improvement of DOP`s procure-to-pay strategy.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Design & Strategy: Developing and deploying the DOP roadmap for myBuy, in alignment with functional partners like DIA Global Supply Chain and RSS Demand to Pay.

• Automation & Innovation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process automation and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

• SME Analysis & Governance: Acting as a deep subject matter expert to analyze, elaborate options, and design solutions that resolve process, system, performance indicator, or data concerns, while supporting data and rule definitions.

• Transformation Project Delegation: Serving as a responsible delegate on major corporate initiatives (such as the ASPIRE program; our overarching process and digital transformation) to support global template adoption and evaluate localized change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement: Leading continuous improvement initiatives, managing global requirement alignment, and partnering with fellow BCLs and Business Capability Owners (BCOs) to optimize end-to-end cross-functional performance.

• Community & ARTS Representation: Leading the Business Capability Community of SMEs and representing DOP in communities and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Knowledge Management: Governing the development, structural maintenance, and delivery of global system process doc

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Sei pronto a progettare il panorama globale del processo digitale e guidare l'ottimizzazione strategica dei sistemi che guidano le nostre operazioni di approvvigionamento globale end-to-end? Come il nostro Business Capability Lead (BCL) situato a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, si prenderà la proprietà strategica e operativa sui segmenti critici del panorama globale di processo Demand-to-Pay. In questo ruolo ad alto impatto, definirete la governance del processo, integrare interfacce complesse in ecosistemi aziendali e servire come agente di cambiamento vitale per accelerare l'adozione della soluzione myBuy in tutta l'impresa. myBuy è la piattaforma di approvvigionamento digitale di Roche, progettata per migliorare il processo procure-to-pay fornendo trasparenza, transazioni tempestive e automazione per le nostre operazioni di acquisto.
• Reporting Line: Report direttamente al nostro Sourcing Lead e fa parte del Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Il team Wider e le parti interessate: conduce una comunità globale di responsabilità aziendale costituita dalle PMI. Potrai gestire relazioni interfunzionali attraverso il DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement e fornitori di tecnologie esterne.
• Tipo di ruolo: Come BCL, tu rappresenti gli interessi aziendali di DOP a livello globale nei forum pertinenti, e sei responsabile per lo sviluppo e il miglioramento continuo della strategia di DOP.
• Impatto: Guida l'efficienza operativa globale, la conformità dei processi e l'adozione digitale su larga scala. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Process Design & Strategy: Sviluppo e distribuzione della roadmap DOP per myBuy, in allineamento con partner funzionali come DIA Global Supply Chain e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automation & Innovation: individuare attivamente le opportunità per l'automazione dei processi e la digitalizzazione in stretta collaborazione con Delivery, Categoria, Digital & Process Management e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Analisi e Governance delle PMI: Agire come esperto di materia profonda per analizzare, elaborare opzioni e soluzioni di progettazione che risolvono problemi di processo, sistema, indicatori di performance o dati, supportando al contempo le definizioni dei dati e delle regole.
• Delegazione del progetto di trasformazione: servire come delegato responsabile per le principali iniziative aziendali (come il programma ASPIRE; il nostro processo di overarching e la trasformazione digitale) per sostenere l'adozione di modelli globali e valutare gli impatti di cambiamento localizzati.
• Miglioramento continuo: Conducendo iniziative di miglioramento continuo, gestendo l'allineamento dei requisiti globali e collaborando con altri BCL e Business Capability Owners (BCOs) per ottimizzare le prestazioni interfunzionali end-to-end.
• Rappresentanza comunitaria & ARTS: Leader della Comunità per la CapacitÃ aziendale delle PMI e rappresenta il DOP nelle comunitÃ e nei Treni di rilascio Agile (ART).
• Gestione della conoscenza: Governare lo sviluppo, la manutenzione strutturale e la consegna del processo di sistema globale doc

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die globale digitale Prozesslandschaft zu gestalten und die strategische Optimierung von Systemen zu leiten, die unsere globalen End-to-End-Beschaffungsprozesse vorantreiben? Als Business Capability Lead (BCL) mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, übernehmen Sie strategische und operative Verantwortung für kritische Segmente der globalen Demand-to-Pay-Prozesslandschaft. In dieser einflussreichen Rolle definieren Sie Prozess-Governance, integrieren komplexe Schnittstellen in Unternehmens-Ökosysteme und dienen als wichtiger Change Agent, um die Einführung der myBuy-Lösung im gesamten Unternehmen zu beschleunigen. myBuy ist die digitale Beschaffungsplattform von Roche, die den Procure-to-Pay-Prozess durch Transparenz, zeitnahe Transaktionen und Automatisierung für unsere Einkaufsaktivitäten verbessern soll.
• Reporting Line: Berichtet direkt an unseren Sourcing Lead und ist Teil des Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Leitet eine globale Business Capability Community, die von KMU gebildet wird. Sie verwalten funktionsübergreifende Beziehungen zwischen dem DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement und externen Technologieanbietern.
• Rollentyp: Als BCL vertreten Sie die Geschäftsinteressen von DOP weltweit in relevanten Foren und sind für die Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Procure-to-Pay-Strategie von DOP verantwortlich.
• Auswirkungen: Sie fördern die globale Betriebseffizienz, die Compliance von Prozessen und die groß angelegte digitale Einführung. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Prozessdesign & Strategie: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung der DOP-Roadmap für myBuy in Abstimmung mit funktionalen Partnern wie DIA Global Supply Chain und RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automation & Innovation: Proaktive Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten für Prozessautomatisierung und Digitalisierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management und RSS Demand to Pay.
• KMU-Analyse und -Governance: Als tiefer Fachexperte fungieren, um Optionen zu analysieren, auszuarbeiten und Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Prozess-, System-, Leistungsindikator- oder Datenprobleme lösen und gleichzeitig Daten- und Regeldefinitionen unterstützen.
• Transformationsprojektdelegation: Als verantwortlicher Delegierter bei wichtigen Unternehmensinitiativen (wie dem ASPIRE-Programm, unserem übergreifenden Prozess und der digitalen Transformation) zur Unterstützung der globalen Vorlageneinführung und zur Bewertung der Auswirkungen lokalisierter Veränderungen.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Leitung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen, Verwaltung der globalen Anforderungsausrichtung und Partnerschaft mit anderen BCLs und Business Capability Ownern (BCOs), um die durchgängige funktionsübergreifende Leistung zu optimieren.
• Community & ARTS Representation: Leitung der Business Capability Community von KMU und Vertretung von DOP in Communities und Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
• Wissensmanagement: Steuerung der Entwicklung, strukturellen Wartung und Lieferung von globalen Systemprozess Doc
