jobs.title: Associate Category Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the long-term supplier strategies and project pipelines that deliver medical innovation to patients worldwide? As our Associate Category Manager (ACM) in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will support the development, validation, and execution of global category strategies and annual strategic initiatives. In this role, you will leverage rigorous procurement analytics to transform market intelligence into actionable category guidance, ensuring global supply resilience and portfolio value.
We are looking to fulfill one Associate Category Manager position per team. Successful candidates will be aligned to support one of the following dedicated procurement categories: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Mechanicals, Logistics.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the respective Category Lead within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Collaborates closely with Category Managers, Sourcing Managers, Delivery Managers, Finance, Legal, and external market intelligence providers. Participates in a global ACM Community of Practice (CoP) coordinated by the Category Integration & Excellence Lead to ensure consistency of methodologies, reporting standards, strategic planning processes, and cross-category collaboration.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role in support of the allocated Category, focused on strategic enablement, market data intelligence, and stakeholder management.

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Supporting contract drafting and vendor negotiations for strategic, key, or bottleneck suppliers by delivering comprehensive analytics, fact-bases, and market benchmarks.

About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the long-term supplier strategies and project pipelines that deliver medical innovation to patients worldwide? As our Associate Category Manager (ACM) in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will support the development, validation, and execution of global category strategies and annual strategic initiatives. In this role, you will leverage rigorous procurement analytics to transform market intelligence into actionable category guidance, ensuring global supply resilience and portfolio value.
We are looking to fulfill one Associate Category Manager position per team. Successful candidates will be aligned to support one of the following dedicated procurement categories: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Mechanicals, Logistics.

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. • Type de rôle : Un participant individuel à l'appui de la catégorie attribuée, axé sur l'habilitation stratégique, l'information sur le marché et la gestion des intervenants.
• Impact: Vous conduisez la conformité de catégorie, l'intégrité des données, et l'exécution stratégique dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial d'opérations. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Soutien à la stratégie et au pipeline : Collation de données sur les fournisseurs, les marchés et les entreprises internes afin d'aider à formuler la stratégie de catégorie à long terme et de créer un pipeline proactif d'initiatives futures.
• Déploiement de l'initiative stratégique : Aider les gestionnaires de catégorie, l'exécution des projets, la prestation et l'approvisionnement à exécuter et à déployer des projets complexes en stricte conformité avec les normes et procédures mondiales.
• Négociation et préparation des marchés : Appuyer la rédaction des contrats et les négociations des fournisseurs pour les fournisseurs stratégiques, clés ou en difficulté en fournissant des analyses complètes, des bases de données et des repères du marché.
• Sourcing stratégique : Appuyer certaines initiatives d'approvisionnement stratégique de grande valeur et des activités complexes de RFx pour convertir les cibles de pipeline en valeur opérationnelle réalisée.
• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborer avec des experts en analyse de données pour générer des informations spécifiques aux catégories, générer des mesures mensuelles de dépenses/économies et effectuer la validation des données pour préserver la gouvernance.
• Appui à la mise en oeuvre : Conversion des résultats stratégiques en documents d'orientation et documents d'appui clairs pour s'assurer que les stratégies de catégorie peuvent être mises en oeuvre efficacement dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. • 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Internship | Finance & Accounting (Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Finance & Accounting Intern (Supply Chain) based in Sunway Pinnacle , you will support manufacturing and commercial sites by ensuring financial compliance, executing month-end close activities, and delivering standard cost and inventory-related activities. You will play a vital role in our finance operations, collaborating globally to continuously improve processes, systems, and standards across the network.

The Opportunity

• Execute month-end close activities, including the preparation of Manual Journal Entries as requested by the global team.

• Manage standard costing execution, ensuring the timely delivery of results while maintaining strict data quality.

• Investigate relevant accounts (such as inventory, variances, and allowances) and recommend actionable solutions to management.

• Ensure system and procedure compliance with company policies, acceptable accounting practices, and applicable financial regulations.

• Collaborate globally across the Roche network to improve financial operations and standardize processes

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing a Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline at a Malaysian university or professional body (e.g., ACCA, CPA).

• You possess a solid foundation in finance and accounting principles and are eager to apply them practically.

• You have strong proficiency in computerized applications, especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, and G-Suite (experience with financial databases is a distinct advantage).

• You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills in English to effectively collaborate with international stakeholders.

• Pinnacle Management InsightsYou are available for a full-time internship and are comfortable working in an agile, structured corporate environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role for 2 years.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Digital Campaigns Chapter in the Global Digital Hub, you play a crucial role in driving the end-to-end orchestration of campaign content delivery across all channels and request types. You ensure seamless coordination between global and local teams, and achieve consistent messaging throughout the organization. You contribute to global and local content delivery, promote the adoption of global content and templatization.

In this role, you act as a content production coordinator, as well as an advisor to support affiliates in achieving their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision. You build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in the affiliate network, serving as the first point of contact for questions, ideas, and challenges.

The Opportunity:

• Content production management: Drive the end-to-end orchestration of campaign and content delivery, across all channels and request types. Ensure delivery standards are met, and capture relevant feedback from stakeholders.

• Content network facilitator: Initiate conversations between global and local teams to reflect needs, insights and learnings and achieve consistent messaging across the organization. Collaborate with the global brand engagement team on global/local content plans and reuse.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback from stakeholders, revise digital campaign content requests accordingly, and ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with the relevant stakeholders in the affiliate network by staying up-to-date with digital trends, industry innovations, and sharing best practices across affiliates.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist nel Digital Campaigns Chapter nel Global Digital Hub, si gioca un ruolo cruciale nel guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della distribuzione dei contenuti della campagna in tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Garantisci un coordinamento senza interruzioni tra team globali e locali e ottieni messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Contribuisci alla fornitura di contenuti globali e locali, promuovi l'adozione di contenuti globali e la templatizzazione. In questo ruolo, si agisce come coordinatore della produzione di contenuti, così come un consulente per sostenere gli affiliati nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche. Costruisci e mantieni forti relazioni con gli stakeholder della rete di affiliazione, servendo come primo punto di contatto per domande, idee e sfide. L'opportunità:
• Gestione della produzione dei contenuti: guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della campagna e la distribuzione dei contenuti, attraverso tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Assicurare gli standard di consegna sono soddisfatti e catturare feedback rilevanti da parte degli stakeholder.
• Contenuti facilitatore di rete: avviare conversazioni tra team globali e locali per riflettere le esigenze, le intuizioni e gli insegnamenti e ottenere messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Collabora con il team di brand engagement globale sui piani e il riutilizzo dei contenuti globali/locali.
• Stakeholder Communication: incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder, rivedere le richieste di contenuti della campagna digitale e garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro efficaci con le parti interessate rilevanti nella rete di affiliazione, rimanendo aggiornati con le tendenze digitali, le innovazioni del settore e la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra le affiliate.
• Incoraggiare gli affiliati a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche.
• Sostenere gli affiliati con argomenti di pianificazione della domanda di contenuti e integrare gli input di previsione della domanda locale nella metodologia di pianificazione globale della domanda di Roche per garantire l'allineamento strategico e la disponibilità.

• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business o un campo correlato; sei altamente creativo, innovativo, avanzato marketing di pensiero con la capacità di dimostrare la consapevolezza delle tendenze digitali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 1-3 anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali in lingua inglese, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le Global Digital Hub a été créé au sein du Roche Services & Solutions Center à Budapest. Notre objectif principal est de renforcer les capacités numériques de Roche dans le monde entier en soutenant des initiatives centrales avec Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting et Creative Design. En tant que spécialiste de la livraison de campagnes numériques au chapitre des campagnes numériques du Global Digital Hub, vous jouez un rôle crucial dans l'orchestration de bout en bout de la livraison de contenu de campagne sur tous les canaux et types de demandes. Vous assurez une coordination harmonieuse entre les équipes mondiales et locales et réalisez des messages cohérents dans toute l'organisation. Vous contribuez à la livraison de contenu mondial et local, promouvoir l'adoption de contenu mondial et la templatisation. Dans ce rôle, vous faites office de coordonnateur de la production de contenu, ainsi que de conseiller pour aider les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs en matière de contenu tout en s'harmonisant avec la vision numérique de Roche. Vous établissez et maintenez des relations solides avec les intervenants du réseau d'affiliation, servant de premier point de contact pour les questions, les idées et les défis. La possibilité :
• Gestion de la production de contenu : Diriger l'orchestration de bout en bout de la campagne et de la diffusion de contenu, sur tous les canaux et types de demandes. Veiller à ce que les normes de prestation soient respectées et recueillir les commentaires pertinents des intervenants.
• Animateur de réseau de contenu : Entreprendre des conversations entre les équipes mondiales et locales afin de refléter les besoins, les idées et les apprentissages et d'obtenir des messages cohérents dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'engagement de la marque mondiale sur les plans de contenu mondial/local et la réutilisation.
• Communication avec les parties intéressées : Intégrer les commentaires des parties intéressées, réviser les demandes de contenu de campagne numérique en conséquence et assurer l'alignement sur leurs attentes.
• Établir et maintenir des relations de travail efficaces avec les intervenants pertinents du réseau des filiales en se tenant au courant des tendances numériques, des innovations de l'industrie et du partage des pratiques exemplaires entre les filiales.
• Autoriser les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs de contenu tout en s'aligneant sur la vision numérique de Roche.
• Soutenir les affiliés avec des sujets de planification de la demande de contenu et intégrer les données de prévision de la demande locale dans la méthodologie de planification de la demande mondiale de Roche pour assurer l'alignement stratégique et la préparation.
• Rapport et conseils: Recueillir des informations sur les progrès de la localisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe mondiale de la marque pour communiquer les principales idées et recommandations. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires, ou un domaine connexe; vous êtes très créatif, innovateur, de la pensée avant marché avec la capacité de démontrer la sensibilisation aux tendances numériques.
• Vous avez une solide compréhension des principes du marketing numérique, de la création de contenu et de la gestion de campagne et de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans la production de contenu, la gestion de projet ou la gestion de campagne numérique, l'accent étant mis sur la coordination des initiatives de marketing numérique sur plusieurs canaux.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles en anglais, et vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion des intervenants et l'intégration de la rétroaction dans les stratégies de contenu.
• Vous avez un comportement axé sur le client dans tout ce que vous faites et la capacité de créer et de maintenir des relations efficaces avec les intervenants internes et d'autres fournisseurs de tiers.
• Vous maîtrisez les outils et les logiciels de gestion de projet, et vous êtes prêt à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes au besoin.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Responsable Commercial Territorial Multi-gammes (Sud Ests), rattaché(e) au Service Excellence Commercial, vous êtes la voix de nos clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers pour l’ensemble de nos gammes.

Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous identifiez parfaitement les interlocuteurs clés, les processus de décision, l'environnement et les enjeux de vos clients. Vous définissez et assumez la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes territoriaux (existants ou futurs), tout en participant activement à celle des comptes nationaux.

Localisation idéale: Montpellier & alentours

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Garantir la couverture terrain et assurer le rôle d’interlocuteur privilégié : Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les structures clientes, comprendre leurs processus décisionnels, identifier leurs besoins, coordonner les actions et piloter rigoureusement les informations dans le CRM.

• Assurer la conquête, la fidélisation et le développement des comptes : Élaborer et piloter les account plans, gérer le pipeline d'opportunités de vente, négocier les contrats, construire les offres commerciales, veiller au respect des engagements et résoudre les éventuels litiges.

• Garantir la transversalité et la synergie interne : Développer les échanges et la communication entre les différents services de l'entreprise, assurer la complétude des dossiers contractuels et mettre votre expertise terrain au service de la satisfaction client globale.

• Maintenir et développer vos compétences métier : Suivre activement les formations internes, intégrer les nouveautés du marché et maîtriser les outils mis à disposition afin d'apporter un conseil à forte valeur ajoutée aux clients.

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous excellez dans les techniques de négociation commerciale et la gestion de projet. Une solide culture scientifique et la connaissance du marché de la biologie médicale sont des atouts majeurs pour réussir dans ce rôle.

• Vous établissez des relations interpersonnelles solides et possédez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse, ainsi qu'une maîtrise de la gestion des données.

• Votre sens des affaires vous permet d'analyser et de comprendre les enjeux stratégiques et commerciaux de l'industrie du DIV (Diagnostic In Vitro) et du secteur de la santé au sens large.

• Vos compétences en conseil se manifestent par une écoute attentive, la capacité de traduire les demandes en besoins, l'alignement des parties prenantes autour d'une vision commune, le conseil expert et la contractualisation efficace.

• Vous faites preuve d'un leadership inspirant, capable d'engager et d'influencer, tout en collaborant et en coopérant de manière transversale.

• Votre niveau d'anglais courant vous permet de communiquer aisément dans un environnement international.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Sie zeigen inspirierende Führung, können sich engagieren und beeinflussen, während Sie bereichsübergreifend zusammenarbeiten.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Poste basé à Meylan (38) Au sein du hub français du Regional Customer Support Center basé à Meylan, le(la) Spécialiste Technique RCSC apporte aux clients et aux collaborateurs de Roche Diagnostics l’assistance et le support demandés afin de garantir le fonctionnement optimal des systèmes Roche et ainsi le niveau de satisfaction des clients.

Vos principales responsabilités :

Assurer l’assistance téléphonique/ par télémaintenance des clients (France, Belgique, Suisse francophone) sur les systèmes Roche Diagnostics et le support de second niveau aux collaborateurs des pays concernés et de la Division Export

• Réceptionne et traite toutes les demandes (téléphone et online), depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu’au déclenchement des actions correctives adaptées, y compris le déclenchement d’interventions sur le terrain.

• Priorise les demandes selon la politique de service définie.

• Recherche activement la satisfaction des clients en apportant des réponses claires, précises et rapides.

• Documente précisément dans le logiciel CRM les symptômes décrits/observés et les actions réalisées.

• Escalade, si nécessaire, les problèmes traités vers l’équipe de support de niveau n+1.

​ Contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• Communique avec ses collègues terrain sur la situation d’un client en cas de problème ou de demande complexe.

• Alimente régulièrement la base de connaissances.

• Contribue aux lancements de nouveaux produits et/ou aux modifications des produits existants.

• Participe aux informations techniques ponctuelles auprès des clients et à la gestion des réclamations officielles.

Assurer la progression de ses propres compétences

• Met à jour de manière régulière ses connaissances par la lecture des notes internes, mails et forums.

• Identifie les actions permettant d’accroître son autonomie.

• Prend en charge des problèmes complexes en collaboration active avec ses collègues référents et ses collègues du global.

Qui vous êtes:

• Formation supérieure initiale dans les domaines de l’automatisme, de l’instrumentation, de l’électronique/électrotechnique et de l’informatique.

• Bonnes connaissances techniques et méthodologies de maintenance (identification de problème, élaboration de solutions, etc.)

• Expérience dans un environnement de Laboratoire médical ou d’analyses serait un plus.

• Connaissances en électronique, fluidique et pneumatique.

• Connaissances informatique et basique en infrastructure réseau.

• Aptitudes à la communication par téléphone, capacité à gérer les situations difficiles afin de répondre aux attentes des clients et ainsi accroître leur satisfaction

• Bon niveau d’anglais.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions :
L'ingénieur(e) Service & Maintenance réalise les installations (& désinstallation) , les maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives chez les clients sur l’ensemble du portfolio de Roche .

Localisation idéale: Paris - Ile de France

Responsabilités principales :

• Piloter l'installation, la pré-installation, la validation technique et le transfert des équipements.

• Garantir la continuité de service des systèmes via des interventions de maintenance préventives et curatives efficaces.

• Réaliser les mises à niveau logicielles et matérielles (retrofits) ainsi que les désinstallations.

• Assurer un reporting précis de l'activité dans le strict respect des standards QSE.

• Piloter la mise à niveau continue de vos connaissances techniques.

Qui vous êtes:

• Compétences multi techniques : électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique et électronique.

• Fort sens de la relation client, adaptabilité et sens aigu du service.

• Maîtrise éprouvée des outils et techniques de résolution de problèmes.

• Anglais technique opérationnel

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office day/week on average).
We are conducting web-based interviews.

What we do:
The Record to Report Department, often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Finance and Accounting (General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting) and Supply Chain Finance. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounting Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level.
As a qualified expert, you:

• Process General Ledger bookings (and any other local request)

• Clear customer and GL accounts

• Contribute to month-end closing tasks

• Provide help of other team members in need of assistance due to workload

• Assist in investigating account discrepancies involving inventory, variances, and allowances

• Gain practical, real-world exposure to enterprise-level financial systems within a shared services environment

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Ongoing university studies in the field of Economics - specialized in Accounting

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Available for 25-30 hours per week

• Customer focused mindset

• Proactive mindset

• Proficiency in English

• A solid academic foundation in accounting and finance principles (GAAP or IFRS)

• Proficient with spreadsheet applications and standard office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite)

• Bonus Points: Prior exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP modules like FI, CO/PA, MM, PP) or financial close software

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office day/week on average).
We are conducting web-based interviews.

What we do:
The Record to Report Department, often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Finance and Accounting (General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting) and Supply Chain Finance. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounting Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level.
As a qualified expert, you:

• Process General Ledger bookings (and any other local request)

• Clear customer and GL accounts

• Contribute to month-end closing tasks

• Provide help of other team members in need of assistance due to workload

• Assist in investigating account discrepancies involving inventory, variances, and allowances

• Gain practical, real-world exposure to enterprise-level financial systems within a shared services environment

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Ongoing university studies in the field of Economics - specialized in Accounting

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Available for 25-30 hours per week

• Customer focused mindset

• Proactive mindset

• Proficiency in English

• A solid academic foundation in accounting and finance principles (GAAP or IFRS)

• Proficient with spreadsheet applications and standard office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite)

• Bonus Points: Prior exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP modules like FI, CO/PA, MM, PP) or financial close software

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Account Executive - Core Lab Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di vendita attrezzature capitale. Responsabile per la riunione e il superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati su territori specificati. Tipicamente responsabile per i conti medio-grandi o hanno un contingente medio-grande/territorio. Deve sviluppare le prospettive del cliente e creare e mantenere le relazioni con i decisori. Contatti/visita clienti esistenti e potenziali. Minimo di 10 a 15 in persona chiamate di vendita a settimana richiesto in territorio assegnato, sia esistente e prospettive. In grado di fare notti come necessario. Lavora per costruire e mantenere una rete di colleghi, partner e clienti per condividere informazioni e ottenere prospettive. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti. Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita della linea di prodotto e avere una conoscenza più approfondita di altri prodotti o servizi. Un professionista esperto e esperto con una piena comprensione della zona del laboratorio clinico. Risolve una vasta gamma di problemi in modi creativi. Questo lavoro è una posizione completamente qualificata, orientata alla carriera. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e servizi aziendali. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior nella propria area di competenza. Responsabile della vendita dei prodotti o servizi dell'azienda, dello sviluppo di nuovi conti e/o dell'espansione dei conti esistenti. Normalmente riceve piccole istruzioni sul lavoro quotidiano, istruzioni generali su nuovi incarichi. Responsabile per il mantenimento di business e lavoro esistenti in modi che garantiranno obiettivi di vendita, risultati e crescita. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo che copre la zona di Greater Boston. I candidati devono risiedere entro 50 miglia del territorio. Fatti di lavoro
• Contatti nuovi e già esistenti clienti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati (ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento), sviluppando nuove attività, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e la risoluzione dei problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche (chimica, immunoassay e automazione), il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.
• Minimo di 10 a 15 persone chiamate di vendita a settimana
• Genera la domanda e massimizza la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando con e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti (diagnosi di laboratorio).
• Implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare (attrezzatura di capitale) il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• Lavora con altri, come necessario o richiesto, per preparare (attrezzatura di credito e capitale) proposte per i conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• Conduce e organizza la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessari per l'efficienza.
• Comunica competitivo (chimica, immunoassay, middleware e laboratorio automatio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join us and make a difference for patients.

As part of Pharma International’s Commercialization Operating Model Effectiveness Team (COMET), this role will drive operational and commercial excellence by shaping and evolving Roche’s operating model to meet future challenges and opportunities. The Strategic Operating Model Partner will serve as a seasoned expert, blending deep industry knowledge with advanced consulting skills to deliver measurable business outcomes and accelerate progress in delivering medical solutions to patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Business Acumen

• Industry Expertise: Apply an expert-level understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, including growth drivers, priority assets, regulatory landscapes, and competitive dynamics.

• Trusted Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing nuanced insights and strategic perspectives that align with Roche’s commercial priorities.
Customer Engagement Continuous Improvement

• Model Optimization: Evaluate and optimize existing customer engagement models to maximize operational efficiency and customer impact.

• Pragmatic Innovation: Foster an environment of continuous learning and innovation by scaling proven commercial tactics, facilitating cross-border learning, and accelerating future omnichannel capabilities across the ecosystem.
Operating Model Mastery & Systemic Design

• Strategic Change Execution: Architect strategies to optimize operating model effectiveness and execute complex organizational changes, balancing long-term vision with immediate business needs.

• Systemic Connectivity: Act as a systemic thinker to identify patterns and interdependencies across global teams, markets, and regions, ensuring strategic initiatives scale to deliver measurable, agile business outcomes.

• Global-to-Local Bridge: Serve as a pragmatic bridge between global strategy and frontline implementation, ensuring operating model adjustments reduce local operational friction and leverage existing regional successes.
Executive Influence & Leadership Engagement

• Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as a respected thought partner and coach to senior leaders, bringing rigor to strategic discussions and constructively challenging decisions with evidence-based recommendations.

• High-Stakes Facilitation: Facilitate critical discussions with precision and impact, seamlessly navigating diverse perspectives to foster alignment and enhance commercial effectiveness.
Consulting Excellence & Stakeholder Governance

• Problem Solving & Execution: Apply advanced consulting methodologies and project management capabilities to structure and solve complex, multi-faceted problems with rigor and precision.

• Framework & Alignment Design: Design robust decision-making frameworks and build trusted relationships across diverse stakeholders to streamline governance and sustain momentum for change.

• Impactful Communication: Craft compelling narratives and deliver high-impact communication frameworks tailored to influence senior decision-makers.

• Operational Rhythm Stewardship: Establish, steward, and maintain critical operational rhythms and meeting protocols for leadership forums, ensuring teams remain focused on out

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

The Opportuniity:

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von Sequenziersystemen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir auch den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Hindernisse für die Annahme. Von robusten Werkzeugen zur Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für Sequenzierungs-Workflows der nächsten Generation. Wir suchen einen talentierten und hochmotivierten Postdoktoranden mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung neuartiger Technologien für biologische Anwendungen. Bei unserer Systems Technology Group werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der Forschung und frühen Entwicklung neuer Technologien, Geräte und Instrumente spielen, die mit unseren DNA-Sequenzierungs- und Molekulardiagnostikplattformen der nächsten Generation verbunden sind. Herzstück dieser Instrumente sind hochintegrierte mikrofluidische Systeme, die komplizierte Arbeitsabläufe automatisieren und komplexe Biochemie handhaben können. Um sich auf diese ehrgeizigen Ziele vorzubereiten, wird Ihr kurzfristiger Fokus eine tiefe, praktische Schulung mit unseren grundlegenden Bemühungen beinhalten. Sie unterstützen bei aktuellen Projekten, um unsere Chemie, Materialien und Methoden zu beherrschen, indem Sie kritisches Fachwissen darüber erwerben, wie wir komplexe Systeme und Prozesse entwerfen, herstellen, verbinden, simulieren, betreiben, charakterisieren und beheben. Dies ist eine praktische, interdisziplinäre Rolle, die die Lücke zwischen biochemischen Anwendungen und modernster Instrumentierung schließen soll. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem kleinen, agilen Team und der breiteren Organisation lösen Sie anspruchsvolle Probleme, erfinden neue Technologien und bringen letztendlich den neuesten Stand der Technik in DNA-Sequenzierungssystemen voran. Die Gelegenheit:
• Sie entwerfen, fertigen und montieren benutzerdefinierte Geräte, Armaturen und Brotbretter mit verschiedenen Rapid Prototyping-Tools, einschließlich benutzerdefinierter Geräte.
• Sie entwickeln und implementieren Mikrofabrikationsprozesse, einschließlich Photolithographie, Ätzen, Bohren, Kleben und Würfeln - und verwenden Präzisionsmessgeräte, um Komponenten zu charakterisieren und Fertigungsmethoden zu bewerten.
• Sie erstellen und charakterisieren neue Materialien und Klebemethoden.
• Sie testen, charakterisieren und beheben komplexe fluidische Systeme und Geräte. Entwickeln und optimieren Sie Workflows auf diesen Systemen, während Sie Daten sammeln, analysieren und interpretieren, um den technischen Fortschritt voranzutreiben.
• Sie erstellen umfassende Testpläne, Protokolle, technische Berichte und Erfindungsangaben, um Ergebnisse und Methodik zu dokumentieren.

• Sie haben einen Ph.D. in Bioengineering oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin mit einer Dissertation, die sich auf die Lösung eines molekularbiologischen Problems mit cleverem Engineering konzentriert.
• Sie haben ein solides Verständnis von Physik, Technik, Chemie, Molekularbiologie und Sequenzierung Grundlagen.
• Sie haben Erfahrungen mit fortschrittlichen Mikrofabrikationstechniken (Lithographie, Dünnfilmabscheidung, Nass-/Trockenätzung und thermische Fusionsbonding-Prozesse) nachgewiesen.
• Sie haben den Erfolg gezeigt, komplexe biochemische Assays oder Workflows auf neuartige fluidische Systeme zu übertragen und die Leistung mit einem systematischen Ansatz zu optimieren.
• Sie haben eine solide Publikationsbilanz, einschließlich mindestens einer Erstautoren- und Peer-Review-Publikation in einem Top-Tier-Journal.
• Sie haben Erfahrungen mit Python-Scripting für instru gezeigt

• Vous concevez, fabriquez et assemblez des appareils, des accessoires et des planches à pain personnalisés à l'aide de divers outils de prototypage rapides, y compris des équipements personnalisés.
• Vous développerez et mettrez en œuvre des processus de microfabrication, y compris la photolithographie, la gravure, le forage, le collage et le dictage, et utiliserez des instruments de métrologie de précision pour caractériser les composants et évaluer les méthodes de fabrication.
• Vous créerez et caractériserez de nouveaux matériaux et méthodologies de liaison.
• Vous allez tester, caractériser et dépanner des systèmes et des appareils fluidiques complexes. Développer et optimiser les flux de travail sur ces systèmes tout en recueillant, analysant et interprétant des données pour stimuler le progrès technique.
• Vous générerez des plans d'essai complets, des protocoles, des rapports techniques et des divulgations d'inventions pour documenter les conclusions et la méthodologie.
• Vous sélectionnerez, vous procurerez, installerez, validerez, exploiterez, réparerez et entretenirez des équipements de laboratoire/fab et des instruments personnalisés. Qui vous êtes : (Requis)
• Vous avez un doctorat en bioingénierie ou une discipline étroitement liée avec une thèse axée sur la résolution d'un problème de biologie moléculaire avec l'ingénierie intelligente.
• Vous avez une solide compréhension de la physique, de l'ingénierie, de la chimie, de la biologie moléculaire et du séquençage des fondamentaux.
• Vous avez démontré votre expérience avec des techniques de microfabrication avancées (lithographie, dépôt de film mince, gravure à sec/humide et processus de collage thermique).
• Vous avez démontré votre succès en transférant des essais ou des workflows biochimiques complexes sur de nouveaux systèmes fluidiques et en optimisant les performances grâce à une approche systématique.

• Vous avez un vif intérêt à stimuler la croissance du marché, en mettant l'accent sur l'établissement de relations, la génération de la demande et l'exécution de stratégies marketing.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Quality Manager - RDT Diagnostics Commercial

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Operating within our Commercial Operations division, you will join a team focused on advancing digital healthcare solutions globally. Our department utilizes a sophisticated framework centered on end-to-end quality monitoring and proactive problem-solving. In this role, you will take autonomous ownership of diverse quality initiatives to ensure our technical deliveries consistently meet strategic business objectives. By balancing rigorous product standards with a practical understanding of our current technology stack, you will have a unique opportunity to lead process enhancements and generate measurable impact.

The opportunity:

• Take independent ownership of end-to-end quality assurance across multiple capabilities, ensuring every deliverable yields tangible business value.

• Lead the development of holistic testing strategies, promoting and expanding automated testing while ensuring comprehensive solution validation across the existing landscape.

• Oversee complex technical interdependencies and process links to enhance operational efficiency and assess solution impacts over the short and long term.

• Collaborate closely with Business and RDT stakeholders to align on vision and strategy while driving the successful execution of quality assurance initiatives.

• Refine internal best practices and processes, actively participating in Communities of Practice (CoPs), leading by example, and coaching junior colleagues.

Who you are:

To ensure a seamless fit for this quality-driven environment, candidates will be evaluated against the following criteria:

• Required Quality Management Experience: Proven track record of defining, establishing, and executing end-to-end Quality Assurance (QA) strategies and governance frameworks across complex digital solution portfolios.

• Required Testing & Automation Mastery: Deep expertise in modern testing methodologies, with a strong balance between scaling robust automated testing frameworks and ensuring thorough overall functional validation.

• Required Lifecycle Integration (Best Practice): Solid experience embedding shift-left testing practices and strategic quality gates directly into Agile delivery models and continuous deployment pipelines.

• Required Collaboration & Delivery Alignment: Demonstrated ability to work alongside Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Delivery/Service Managers, and Business units to align testing cycles with release schedules.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Quality Manager - RDT Diagnostics Commercial

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Operating within our Commercial Operations division, you will join a team focused on advancing digital healthcare solutions globally. Our department utilizes a sophisticated framework centered on end-to-end quality monitoring and proactive problem-solving. In this role, you will take autonomous ownership of diverse quality initiatives to ensure our technical deliveries consistently meet strategic business objectives. By balancing rigorous product standards with a practical understanding of our current technology stack, you will have a unique opportunity to lead process enhancements and generate measurable impact.

The opportunity:

• Take independent ownership of end-to-end quality assurance across multiple capabilities, ensuring every deliverable yields tangible business value.

• Lead the development of holistic testing strategies, promoting and expanding automated testing while ensuring comprehensive solution validation across the existing landscape.

• Oversee complex technical interdependencies and process links to enhance operational efficiency and assess solution impacts over the short and long term.

• Collaborate closely with Business and RDT stakeholders to align on vision and strategy while driving the successful execution of quality assurance initiatives.

• Refine internal best practices and processes, actively participating in Communities of Practice (CoPs), leading by example, and coaching junior colleagues.

Who you are:

To ensure a seamless fit for this quality-driven environment, candidates will be evaluated against the following criteria:

• Required Quality Management Experience: Proven track record of defining, establishing, and executing end-to-end Quality Assurance (QA) strategies and governance frameworks across complex digital solution portfolios.

• Required Testing & Automation Mastery: Deep expertise in modern testing methodologies, with a strong balance between scaling robust automated testing frameworks and ensuring thorough overall functional validation.

• Required Lifecycle Integration (Best Practice): Solid experience embedding shift-left testing practices and strategic quality gates directly into Agile delivery models and continuous deployment pipelines.

• Required Collaboration & Delivery Alignment: Demonstrated ability to work alongside Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Delivery/Service Managers, and Business units to align testing cycles with release schedules.

• Preferred Certifications & Methodologies: Active indu

• Expérience requise en gestion de la qualité : Expérience éprouvée de la définition, de l'établissement et de l'exécution de stratégies d'assurance de la qualité (AQ) de bout en bout et de cadres de gouvernance dans des portefeuilles de solutions numériques complexes.
• Maîtrise de test et d'automatisation requise : Expertise approfondie dans les méthodes de test modernes, avec un bon équilibre entre la mise à l'échelle de solides cadres de test automatisé et la garantie d'une validation fonctionnelle complète.
• Intégration nécessaire du cycle de vie (meilleure pratique): Expérience solide intégrant les pratiques d'essai à gauche et les barrières de qualité stratégique directement dans les modèles de livraison Agile et les pipelines de déploiement continu.
• Collaboration et alignement requis : Capacité démontrée de travailler aux côtés des ingénieurs en formation à la libération, des gestionnaires de la prestation et des services et des unités opérationnelles pour aligner les cycles d'essai sur les calendriers de libération.

• Vendor Management: A proven track record of managing and driving accountability with outsourced/managed services delivery partners.

• Domain Expertise: Strong, demonstrable understanding of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C), CPQ, and Commercial business domains.

• Methodologies: Active ITIL, Agile (Scrum, SAFe)

What you get:

• Salary range 19.000-35.000PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy avail

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:
This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As an Intern , you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying general procurement knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

You will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

• Applying your fast-learning skills to assist the team with ad-hoc business projects, continuous improvement initiatives, and new process implementations.

• Acting as a key point of contact to coordinate with external suppliers, track project progress, and help resolve day-to-day operational queries.

• Executing daily system operations, maintaining data accuracy, and ensuring smooth transactional flows within the SAP system.

Who you are:

• You are enrolled at university (preferably in business or a related discipline; preferably as a graduate)

• You demonstrate strong learning agility and a proactive willingness to quickly grasp new concepts, processes, and systems in a dynamic environment.

• You are capable of quickly getting hands-on with SAP systems, and ideally have some basic knowledge or practical exp

Il gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena del valore o che hanno una comunitÃ, tra cui ricerca e sviluppo, servizi commerciali e aziendali, tecnologia digitale e servizi. Le comunità sono i principali abilitatori di una forte competenza di categoria, consentendo la flessibilità nella risposta di consegna degli appalti alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti. Come Intern , si porterà il pensiero analitico, la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la messa a fuoco per l'area di approvvigionamento sourcing e capacità di consegna. Applicando conoscenze o competenze generali di approvvigionamento in una specifica area merce o di spesa, garantirai una consegna efficace ed efficiente dei servizi di approvvigionamento di base e un miglioramento continuo dell'automazione e della disponibilità di contenuti. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con gli appalti interni (vale a dire i capitoli e le aree di capacità come la gestione delle relazioni con i clienti, la contrazione, le soluzioni, l'analisi, ecc.) e gli stakeholder aziendali per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in attività di sourcing e spendere attività di gestione e valorizzazione dei contenuti. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altri membri del team per supportare la domanda del cliente, migliorare l'esperienza di acquisto del cliente, fornire attività operative quotidiane, e fornire capacità e competenze per fornire produttività e altri progetti / soluzioni orientate al cliente. Si svolgerà una varietà di ruoli in base alla vostra esperienza, conoscenza e requisiti aziendali generali, tra cui ma non limitato a:
• Si sviluppano contenuti e automazione, traducendo risultati e opportunità di approvvigionamento in contenuti e canali di acquisto automatizzati che migliorano l'adozione aziendale, la soddisfazione e l'efficienza complessiva.
• Applicando le tue capacità di apprendimento rapido per aiutare il team con progetti di business ad-hoc, iniziative di miglioramento continuo e nuove implementazioni di processo.
• Agire come punto di contatto chiave per coordinare con fornitori esterni, monitorare i progressi del progetto e aiutare a risolvere le domande operative quotidiane.
• Eseguire operazioni di sistema quotidiane, mantenere l'accuratezza dei dati e garantire flussi transazionali lisci all'interno del sistema SAP. Chi sei:
• Sei iscritto all'università (preferibilmente in affari o una disciplina relativa; preferibilmente come laureato)
• Si dimostra una forte agilità di apprendimento e una proattiva disponibilità a cogliere rapidamente nuovi concetti, processi e sistemi in un ambiente dinamico.
• Siete in grado di ottenere rapidamente hands-on con i sistemi SAP, e idealmente avere alcune conoscenze di base o pratico exp

Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats entre entreprises et fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de façon proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon vitale à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. La possibilité : Ce rôle fait partie du groupe de la livraison indirecte d'approvisionnements, qui couvre les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation de marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution. Le groupe de la livraison d'approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreuses collectivités regroupant des catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant des points communs, y compris la recherche et le développement, les services commerciaux et ministériels, le numérique et la technologie et les installations. Les collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant une souplesse dans la prestation des approvisionnements répondant aux besoins changeants de nos clients.
