jobs.title: Sourcing Lead - APAC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead the strategic gateway that bridges APAC innovation with global healthcare demand? As our Asia Sourcing Office Lead in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will drive global sourcing and operational excellence for DOP. In this role, you will lead a dedicated regional team across APAC, champion digital procurement transformation, and navigate complex global markets to ensure our supply networks remain highly competitive and resilient.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a global, cross-cultural matrix team of up to 15 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. You manage key interfaces across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, and external suppliers.

• Role Type: A leadership position evenly split between strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution, focusing on regional sourcing expertise and talent empowerment.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and digital governance across APAC. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times), tracking stakeholder/supplier satisfaction, and managing your team's OPEX budget.

• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Finding potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Overseeing compliant global and regional sourcing, benchmarking (RfX), and detailed procurement analyses alongside NPI and Delivery managers.

• Contracts & SLAs: Ensuring template-based contract execution (CDAs, SOWs), repository health, and defining KPIs to guarantee on-time, in-full (OTIF) portfolio delivery.

• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) to drive platform governance, policy, continuous improvement, and knowledge management alongside RSS.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix priority and supplier selection conflicts, representing DOP at external events, and delivering monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

Who you are
We look for leaders who can drive high-performance cultures, break down silos, and eliminate operational friction.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences required); MBA and CIPS certification highly preferred.

• Experience: 5-7+ years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, etc.), including 3-5 years within a Shared Service or CoE environment.

• Market Expertise: Strong regional sourcing and NPI experience across complex direct categories (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, or Biologics/Chemicals).

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regard

• Istruzione: laurea universitaria (Business / Life Sciences richiesto); certificazione MBA e CIPS altamente preferito.
• Esperienza: 5-7 anni in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, ecc.), compresi 3-5 anni all'interno di un servizio condiviso o ambiente CoE.
• Esperienza di mercato: Forte sourcing regionale e esperienza NPI in categorie dirette complesse (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, o Biologics/Chemicals).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Senior Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will be a key part of our APAC sourcing operations. You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead APAC and is part of
the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will be part of a regional team of Senior Sourcing Managers and Sourcing Managers, managing relationships with other DOP stakeholders (Category, Delivery) as well as external suppliers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor with responsibilities to mentor junior team members.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics - including PPV savings, preferred supplier share, and shortened cycle times - to deliver bottom-line value while tracking stakeholder satisfaction.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and NPI managers.

• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.

• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to simplify workflows, analyze site user requirements for best-value methods, and ensure strict compliance with global policies.

• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnering with support functions like Accounts Payable (AP) to clear supplier-related administrative bottlenecks, while championing supply base CSR initiatives (diversity, sustainability, ethical practices).

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing high-stakes conflicts regarding competing project priorities or supplier selections, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to the CoE LT and DPLT.

Who you are
We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can embrace collaboration, provide direction and mentor colleagues across different locations.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or equivalent and professional certifications (e.g., CIPS, ISM) are desirable.

• Experience: 5-7+ years of experience in sourcing and end-to-end contract management. You have a proven track record of driving procurement projects (e.g., cost-reduction initiatives and value-improvement programs).

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à concevoir la stratégie globale d'approvisionnement et commander les réseaux de fournisseurs de bout en bout pour les composants électroniques qui alimentent nos appareils de diagnostic de prochaine génération? En tant que Global Category Manager pour e-Components à Kuala Lumpur, en Malaisie, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies et des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie de dépenses critiques. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez des fournisseurs de composants électroniques de premier ordre, naviguerez dans les complexités de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et traduireez les objectifs de catégorie en création de valeur de base.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de l'organisation principale de la catégorie Global Lead Electronics & Systems au sein de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : S'engage directement auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, de la livraison, du centre d'excellence en achats et de partenaires commerciaux mondiaux. Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel occupant un poste de dirigeant de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, l'élaboration de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur le marché, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles pour formuler un pipeline officiel de la catégorie mondiale et de l'initiative, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.
• Écosystèmes fournisseurs : Gestion des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établissement de programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveillance des objectifs de valeur et gestion des risques pour les fournisseurs.
• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues en approvisionnement et les utilisateurs commerciaux.
• Partenariat d'affaires : Établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants de haut niveau, mettre en doute la demande et les particularités afin de maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RCS.
• Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Encadrer les collègues en approvisionnement, assurer le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des champions stratégiques en matière d'approvisionnement qui possèdent une vaste connaissance des marchés mondiaux de l'approvisionnement en électronique et des compétences de leadership matricielle nécessaires pour favoriser un changement organisationnel complexe.
• Études : Diplôme universitaire requis (priorité de l'accent sur les affaires ou les sciences de la vie); une qualification liée aux affaires de troisième cycle est préférée.
• Expérience: 5 ans et plus d'expérience approfondie en matière d'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel avec une connaissance approfondie

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager - Asia Sourcing Office (Malaysia)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.

We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will be a vital part of our APAC sourcing operations. In this high-impact role, you will execute end-to-end, medium- to high-complexity sourcing projects while acting as a key mechanism for the Asia Sourcing Office - identifying regional suppliers, performing initial due diligence, and translating transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Asia Sourcing Office Lead, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, regional operations stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Asia Supplier Discovery: Identifying potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing Execution: Compliantly executing regional sourcing projects, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and eSourcing tools for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing site user requirements, aggregating regional demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources) and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and accurately managing their lifecycle repository, renewals, and potential contractual improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) and master data management to simplify workflows and ensure strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times and compliance) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Collaboration & Exposure: Partnering with support functions (like Accounts Payable) to clear administrative bottlenecks and presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and regional stakeholders.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3–5+ years in procurement or sourcing,

• Aggregazione della domanda: Analizzando i requisiti degli utenti del sito, aggregando la domanda regionale per massimizzare la leva e intensificando le richieste non standard alla gestione della categoria.
• Project & Risk Management: Sviluppo di piani di progetto completi (linee temporali, pietre miliari, risorse) e identificazione proattiva e mitigazione dei rischi per gli obiettivi.
• Contratto ciclo di vita: Impostazione di contratti basati su modelli (come CDAs e SOWs) e gestione accurata del loro archivio del ciclo di vita, rinnovi e potenziali miglioramenti contrattuali.
• Eccellenza operativa: Utilizzo di strumenti aziendali (SAP, myBuy) e gestione dei dati master per semplificare i flussi di lavoro e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche di approvvigionamento globale.
• Metrics & CSR: Monitorare gli obiettivi operativi e le metriche del servizio clienti (come i tempi di ciclo e la conformità) e sostenere la diversità dei fornitori, la sostenibilità e le pratiche etiche.
• Collaborazione & Exposure: Partner con funzioni di supporto (come Accounts Payable) per eliminare i colli di bottiglia amministrativi e presentare regolarmente KPI e aggiornamenti di progetto al Sourcing Lead e agli stakeholder regionali. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare i problem-solvers analitici con una forte attenzione al servizio clienti.
• Istruzione: laurea (Business / Scienze della vita preferita) è richiesto; una certificazione MBA o CIPS è altamente auspicabile.
• Esperienza: 3–5+ anni di approvvigionamento o approvvigionamento,

• Élargir l'équipe et les intervenants : Partenaires avec la catégorie DOP, la livraison DOP, la demande de RSS à payer, les intervenants opérationnels régionaux et les fournisseurs externes pour résoudre les goulets d'étranglement administratifs et éclairer les stratégies futures.
• Type de rôle : Un rôle de contributeur individuel axé sur l'exécution de l'approvisionnement de bout en bout, la gestion des données et la création de valeur.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'excellence globale de l'approvisionnement, la valeur financière et la conformité à l'échelle de l'APAC. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Découverte des fournisseurs en Asie : Identifier les fournisseurs potentiels dans toute l'Asie, effectuer une première diligence raisonnable et effectuer des comparaisons régionales ciblées.
• Exécution de l'approvisionnement : Exécution compatible de projets d'approvisionnement régionaux, de processus standard (RfI, RfQ, RfP) et d'outils eSourcing pour les produits sur le marché et les nouvelles introductions de produits (NPI).
• Agrégation de la demande : Analyse des besoins des utilisateurs du site, regroupement de la demande régionale pour maximiser l'effet de levier et augmentation des demandes non standard à la gestion de catégorie.
• Gestion des projets et des risques : Élaborer des plans de projets détaillés (échéanciers, jalons, ressources) et déterminer de façon proactive et atténuer les risques pour les objectifs.
• Cycle de vie des contrats : Établissement de contrats fondés sur des modèles (tels que les CDA et les SOW) et gestion précise de leur dépôt, renouvellements et améliorations contractuelles potentielles.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Utiliser les outils d'entreprise (SAP, myBuy) et la gestion des données pour simplifier les flux de travail et assurer le strict respect des politiques mondiales d'approvisionnement.
• Mesures et RSE : Suivi des objectifs opérationnels et des mesures du service à la clientèle (telles que les cycles et la conformité) tout en défendant la diversité des fournisseurs, la durabilité et les pratiques éthiques.
• Collaboration et exposition : Partenariat avec les fonctions de soutien (comme les comptes à payer) pour éliminer les goulets d'étranglement administratifs et présenter régulièrement des mises à jour de l'ICP et du projet au responsable de l'approvisionnement et aux intervenants régionaux. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de rechercher des solutions analytiques aux problèmes avec une forte orientation client-service.
• Éducation : Un diplôme universitaire (de préférence en sciences des affaires et de la vie) est requis; une certification MBA ou CIPS est hautement souhaitable.
• Expérience : de 3 à 5 ans dans l'approvisionnement ou l'approvisionnement,

jobs.title: Sales Specialist Core Lab - Cataluña
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona conectar la innovación científica con la eficiencia hospitalaria? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist Core para liderar y expandir nuestra presencia en el territorio de Cataluña. En este rol, serás el socio estratégico de los laboratorios y centros sanitarios de la región, estableciendo relaciones de confianza profunda y comprendiendo los retos del ecosistema de salud local.
Tu misión será impulsar el éxito del negocio basándote en la innovación de nuestro porfolio de especialidades diagnósticas y en la optimización de los flujos de trabajo de nuestros clientes. Si tienes una mentalidad estratégica, te apasiona el desarrollo de negocio y quieres transformar la atención al paciente a través de diagnósticos de vanguardia, ¡este es tu lugar!

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución y Estrategia Comercial: Implementar los planes de acción y estrategias definidas en tu zona para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganando cuota de mercado y cumpliendo con los KPI del negocio.

• Identificación de Retos y Co-creación: Detectar las necesidades tanto de los profesionales del laboratorio como de las direcciones económicas y gerenciales de los centros, proponiendo soluciones diferenciadoras que aporten un valor real.

• Gestión de Stakeholders (360°): Construir y mantener relaciones estrechas con el personal técnico del laboratorio y con áreas clave del hospital (adquisiciones, finanzas y gestión hospitalaria), garantizando la satisfacción del cliente en todo su ciclo de vida.

• Enlace y Colaboración Interna: Tras la firma de los acuerdos, asegurarás que los equipos y reactivos se implementen a la perfección en los laboratorios, colaborando estrechamente con nuestros equipos de soporte técnico y aplicaciones.

• Expertise y Demostraciones Técnicas: Desarrollar un conocimiento profundo del porfolio de Core Lab , realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto de alto impacto que resuelvan las dudas de los clientes y destaquen nuestro valor diferencial.

Who You Are (The skills you need)

Buscamos un perfil dinámico, con un fuerte background técnico o comercial en el sector salud y una alta capacidad de influencia.

• Formación: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en el ámbito de la docencia/formación técnica.

• Apertura al Talento Diverso: En Roche creemos en el valor de las perspectivas únicas; por ello, también valoraremos aquellos perfiles que, aun no cumpliendo estrictamente con la formación o experiencia técnica tradicional, aporten un trasfondo comercial relevante y diferencial para la organización.

• Competencias Clave:

• Alta capacidad estratégica y habilidad técnica y de negocio para navegar en entornos hospitalarios complejos.

• Orientación a la consecución de resultados , con autonomía y toma de decisiones ágiles.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación , con capacidad de inspiración e influencia .

• Mentalidad colaborativa, fuerte orientación al trabajo en equipo y apertura para dar y recibir feedback y coaching .

• Un perfil promotor de la innovación y con competencias sólidas en gestión del cambio para acompañar al cliente en su transformación digital y organizativa.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español y catalán; se valorarán conocimientos de inglés .

• Ubicación : Barcelona y alrededores.

What is here for You?

• Propósito Elevado: Trabajar en una compañía líder donde tu actividad diaria impa

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Serves as strategic thought partner and leader in driving value creation through entrepreneurial mindset and in-depth business understanding, bringing finance expertise. Enables transparency and insights to make good business decisions highly complex in nature. Builds networks across the organization to support the oneRoche enterprise mindset. May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviours.

As the Finance Enterprise Partner, you are responsible for:

Business Partnering

• Serve as a finance enterprise partner, providing insights through financial analysis, and advice to meet business objectives or solve business problems.

• Serve as thought partner and leader in driving value creation in our portfolio, drive transparency to make smart business decisions in support of our ambition.

• Seek opportunities to self-align interests with business needs and impact, while committing to action

• Use analysis techniques to build and maintain shared understanding between team and stakeholders

• Advice and counsel the different stakeholders on financial implications of strategies, actions and decisions; looking for innovative solutions with the team

• Work with relevant stakeholders in business planning (sales and resources)

• Review of monthly financial result and analysis with key stakeholders to derive insights that value adds in meeting business needs and supports decisions making.

• Ensure compliance to internal controls, policies & procedures on management reporting

• Collaborate with other key Finance players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services), ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g. CoFI, Champions and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.

• Seek and build opportunities to partner and collaborate with local and global networks

• May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviors.

Who You Are:

• Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in financial planning, budgeting and analysis; as a proven business partner is preferred.

• Knowledge around ERP systems/SAP preferred

• Experience in pharmaceutical preferred

• Knowledge/ exposure to agile principles or working methodology will be of advantage

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skill

• Experience in delivering innovative solutions (example: process simplifications in RPA & etc would be of advantage)

Competencies, mindset and behaviors expected

• Models Integrity

• Entrepreneurial spirit & enterprise thinking

• Adaptable to changes in a dynamic environment

• Outcomes oriented

• Fast Learner, with a growth mindset

• Fosters leadership principles

• Business acumen with end-to-end thinking

• Focus on value and customer-centricity

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Serves as strategic thought partner and leader in driving value creation through entrepreneurial mindset and in-depth business understanding, bringing finance expertise. Enables transparency and insights to make good business decisions highly complex in nature. Builds networks across the organization to support the oneRoche enterprise mindset. May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviours.

As the Finance Enterprise Partner, you are responsible for:

Business Partnering

• Serve as a finance enterprise partner, providing insights through financial analysis, and advice to meet business objectives or solve business problems.

• Serve as thought partner and leader in driving value creation in our portfolio, drive transparency to make smart business decisions in support of our ambition.

• Seek opportunities to self-align interests with business needs and impact, while committing to action

• Use analysis techniques to build and maintain shared understanding between team and stakeholders

• Advice and counsel the different stakeholders on financial implications of strategies, actions and decisions; looking for innovative solutions with the team

• Work with relevant stakeholders in business planning (sales and resources)

• Review of monthly financial result and analysis with key stakeholders to derive insights that value adds in meeting business needs and supports decisions making.

• Ensure compliance to internal controls, policies & procedures on management reporting

• Collaborate with other key Finance players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services), ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g. CoFI, Champions and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.

• Seek and build opportunities to partner and collaborate with local and global networks

• May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviors.

Who You Are:

• Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in financial planning, budgeting and analysis; as a proven business partner is preferred.

• Knowledge around ERP systems/SAP preferred

• Experience in pharmaceutical preferred

• Knowledge/ exposure to agile principles or working methodology will be of advantage

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skill

• Experience in delivering innovative solutions (example: process simplifications in RPA & etc would be of advantage)

Competencies, mindset and behaviors expected

• Models Integrity

• Entrepreneurial spirit & enterprise thinking

• Adaptable to changes in a dynamic environment

• Outcomes oriented

• Fast Learner, with a growth mindset

• Fosters leadership principles

• Business acumen with end-to-end thinking

• Focus on value and customer-centricity

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Pharmacology (CP) Scientist is responsible for developing and implementing quantitative Clinical Pharmacology strategies across early to late phases of clinical drug development to ensure that the right drug is administered to the right patient at the right dosing regimen and to deliver an optimal therapeutic benefit/risk profile for the patients. The CP Scientist uses state of the art modeling and simulation tools and is able to implement model-informed drug development strategies to address critical questions that are aligned with project needs. The CP Scientist is an active member of cross-functional drug development teams, and works in close partnership with Pharmacometricians, Biostatisticians, Clinicians, Biomarker Scientists, Toxicologists, Preclinical Pharmacologists, and other function) to support drug development decisions through registration and post-marketing commitments. The Senior/Principal CP Scientist represents CP function on filing teams and fosters effective collaboration and communications with regulatory agencies to support efficient drug development of drug candidates.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the design and review of clinical study protocols for the development of novel therapeutic agents with particular focus on China development (all drug and delivery modalities);

• Leading the planning and conduct of PK/PD data analyses and setting strategy to foster the appropriate use of modeling and simulations to inform clinical drug development decisions;

• CP functional representation and leadership at functional and cross-functional China development focused meetings internally and externally (eg. cross-functional teams, department meetings, governance review meetings, scientific conferences, etc.);

• Implementing strategic agility and effective project management to align critical CP deliverables according to the rapidly evolving regulatory and project needs in China;

• Authorship of regulatory documents and meeting background packages to support key clinical development milestones in China;

• Lead CP representation at health-authority meetings in China, and contribute to the planning, implementation and organization of regulatory filings (e.g. IND, BLA, NDA, sNDA);

• Support the global development strategies for clinical pharmacology and M&S as needed.

Technical Skills:
Required:

• The ability to plan, organize, interpret, and/or perform PK/PD data analyses.

• Familiarity with clinical drug development and clinical study design options for development of different drug and delivery modalities.

• Familiarity with quantitative modeling approaches in drug development and working knowledge of relevant modeling software (e.g. NONMEM, WinNonlin, R, SimCYP, GastroPlus, PKSim, Matlab, etc).

• Familiarity with agentic approaches for work streamlining and integrating agent-based workflows to improve efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches as they apply to clinical study design and analysis.

Desired:

• Experience in leading regulatory filing strategy as a CP lead to support the totality of CP filing package, dose/regimen justification, and drug labeling is highly desired.

Communication Skills:

• Excellent written communication skills, in order to deliver high quality protocols, publications, and regulatory documents for team and management review.

• Excellent oral communications to make clear presentations and foster effective stakeholder engagemen

The Position
Job description
The Cybersecurity Analyst investigates security incidents, performs vulnerability assessments, and contributes to improving security operations
You will be capable of independent work on defined tasks, independently handling less complex tasks and contributing to various stages of the analysis lifecycle
By taking ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible security solutions, you will proactively identify solution-level issues and maintain a mindset of continuous improvement within the security domain

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities / Scope

• Independently handles less complex tasks and provides input to solution design by defining and managing requirements for small-scale problem areas

• Focuses on understanding the problem domain, recommending solution options, and proactively identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies to improve products or processes

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Takes ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible solutions for specific features or components

• Independently analyzes less complex security technical problems, defines problem scope, contributes to identifying root causes, and provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems

• Evaluates change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, diagnoses gaps, and applies analytical and logical reasoning independently to identify discrepancies and challenge assumptions

Stakeholder Management

• Identifies key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk

• Primarily interacts within security product teams/squads and across Security Operations functions, while establishing rapport and managing realistic security expectations

• Develops and delivers tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates, facilitates meetings, and proactively engages with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements

Impact/Strategy

• Contributes to projects or workgroups by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives within their specified area

• Demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise within their specific domain by translating requirements into a strategic plan with supervision, and may identify opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope

Complexity

• Works on a product or larger contexts, handling requirements and analysis for specific features or components

• Can navigate moderate levels of complexity in requirements and stakeholder landscapes

• Begins to understand sources of influence and analyze business problems/opportunities within this product context, starting to map basic interconnections

Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Experience in conducting stakeholder interviews, synthesizing requirements, and mapping/analyzing current processes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo si basa nel Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale che si dedica a fornire eccellenza aiutando il personale di laboratorio a utilizzare i nostri prodotti. Operiamo con un approccio olistico, il che significa che ci occupiamo del nostro portafoglio prodotti dall'idea attraverso lo sviluppo e il lancio di mercato a phase-out. L'eccezionale varietà di tecnologie applicate in questo settore offre grandi opportunità di apprendimento. Specialista di supporto tecnico (lingua slovacca e ceca) Località: Varsavia, Praga o Bratislava (La tua scelta!) Sei pronto a passare dall'esperienza tecnica all'impatto che cambia la vita? Il nostro Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale (RCSC) è il motore intellettuale dietro l'eccellenza di laboratorio in Europa Centrale. Stiamo cercando un talento ceco e/o slovacco che ha fame di conoscenza, gode di problem solving, ed è pronto a padroneggiare le tecnologie diagnostiche più avanzate del mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità: Più di un semplice supporto Questo non è un tipico ruolo di helpdesk. Si tratta di una posizione di consulenza ingegneristica e applicativa in cui si diventa il "guardiano" dell'accuratezza diagnostica.
• Master the Complexity: lavorerai con sistemi IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) di fascia alta che combinano robotica, biochimica complessa e IT avanzato.
• Crescita continua: forniamo un programma intensivo di formazione di livello mondiale. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia tutto il primo giorno, ma ci aspettiamo che tu sia quello che non smette mai di chiedere "perché?".

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who we are

At Roche, 80,000 people across 150 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity, and on seeing each other’s differences as an advantage. To innovate healthcare, Roche has ambitious plans to keep learning and growing – and is seeking people who have the same goals for themselves.

The headquarters in Basel is one of Roche’s largest sites. It is home to the Corporate Executive Committee, the Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics Divisions and the global business functions. Roche Basel also covers the entire business chain from research, development and production through to marketing. Over 8,000 people from more than 60 countries work at the site.

The Position

IT Business Analyst - Business Analysis For Master Data Management - RDT Pharma R&D Informatics you will be responsible for making decisions with impact at the process, organization, or program as well as at an operational level.

Your will help drive successful completion of major projects/programs across portfolios as analytical or design lead. Your impact may be within or across multiple portfolios and you will champion accountability by example.

The IT BA is an active role in the product’s lifecycle management. The primary role is to drive the application of strategies and concepts and determine the best course of action in PharmaCoviligence Master Data technology solutions. You serve as primary consultant to senior business Leads and internal/external subject matter experts for the organization on significant matters pertaining to strategic business and technology solutions.

Some of your regular activities also include scoping, planning and supporting the successful implementation of solutions. In addition you will be required to work closely with Business Users, Product Owners, Product Managers, IT Business Partners and IT Architects to develop a conceptual architecture for the solutions.

What you’ll be expected to work on:

• Contribute to and influence the structure and completion of major programs. Develop advanced technological ideas and guide their development into a final solution. Establish new principles and concepts to independently address strategic business problems with technology solutions that are novel in their innovation and drive organizational change in the business to adopt new approaches to strategy and delivery.

• Communicates strategic information, issues and solution options across the enterprise or multiple large business portfolios. Enable great participation by all individuals on the team by creating a safe environment that empowers participants and challenges them at the same time. Foster healthy disagreements and discussions and ensure convergence and agreement.

• Lead large enterprise or multi portfolio initiatives. Able to influence inter-departmental decisions. Viewed as an area expert beyond our group . Act as team lead of a functional group. Able to represent managers at meetings and make basic decisions. Can influence decisions within an area. GI area expert

• May provide guidance and manage work of others for specific programs or objectives. Leads prioritization and planning for large strategic initiatives.

• High quality Master Data is a part of a strong AI foundation, and this role will contribute to developing and maintaining the data foundations for Safety AI enablement. Apply advanced

Lavorando insieme, siamo diventati uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca al mondo. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità, e sul vedere le differenze tra loro come un vantaggio. Per innovare la salute, Roche ha progetti ambiziosi per continuare a imparare e crescere – e sta cercando persone che hanno gli stessi obiettivi per se stessi. La sede di Basilea è uno dei più grandi siti di Roche. È sede del Comitato Esecutivo Aziendale, delle Divisioni Farmaceutiche e Diagnostiche e delle funzioni aziendali globali. Roche Basel copre anche l'intera catena aziendale dalla ricerca, sviluppo e produzione fino al marketing. Oltre 8.000 persone provenienti da più di 60 paesi lavorano sul sito. La posizione IT Business Analyst - Analisi aziendale per la gestione dei dati master - RDT Pharma R&D Informatica sarete responsabili di prendere decisioni con impatto al processo, organizzazione, o programma, così come a livello operativo. Il vostro aiuterà a guidare il completamento di grandi progetti / programmi su portafogli come piombo analitico o di progettazione. Il vostro impatto può essere all'interno o attraverso più portafogli e sarete campione di responsabilità per esempio. La IT BA è un ruolo attivo nella gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto. Il ruolo principale è quello di guidare l'applicazione di strategie e concetti e determinare il miglior corso di azione nelle soluzioni di tecnologia PharmaCoviligence Master Data. Sei consulente primario per aziende senior Leads e esperti di materia interna / esterna per l'organizzazione su questioni significative relative a soluzioni strategiche di business e tecnologia. Alcune delle vostre attività regolari includono anche scoping, pianificazione e supporto alla riuscita implementazione di soluzioni. Inoltre sarà necessario lavorare a stretto contatto con gli utenti aziendali, i proprietari di prodotti, i responsabili dei prodotti, i partner IT e gli architetti IT per sviluppare un'architettura concettuale per le soluzioni. Su cosa ti aspettavi di lavorare:
• Contribuire e influenzare la struttura e il completamento dei programmi principali. Sviluppare idee tecnologiche avanzate e guidare il loro sviluppo in una soluzione finale. Stabilire nuovi principi e concetti per affrontare in modo indipendente problemi di business strategici con soluzioni tecnologiche che sono nuovi nella loro innovazione e guidare il cambiamento organizzativo nel business per adottare nuovi approcci alla strategia e alla consegna.
• Comunica informazioni strategiche, problemi e opzioni di soluzione in tutta l'impresa o più grandi portafogli aziendali. Abilita grande partecipazione di tutti gli individui del team creando un ambiente sicuro che consente ai partecipanti e li sfida allo stesso tempo. Promuovere disaccordi e discussioni sane e garantire la convergenza e l'accordo.
• Condurre grandi iniziative aziendali o multi portafoglio. In grado di influenzare le decisioni interdipartimentali. Visto come un esperto di area oltre il nostro gruppo. Agire come team lead di un gruppo funzionale. In grado di rappresentare i manager nelle riunioni e prendere decisioni di base. Può influenzare le decisioni all'interno di un'area. Esperto di area GI
• Può fornire guida e gestire il lavoro di altri per programmi o obiettivi specifici. Conduce priorità e pianificazione per grandi iniziative strategiche.
• Master Data di alta qualità è una parte di una forte fondazione AI, e questo ruolo contribuirà a sviluppare e mantenere le basi di dati per l'attivazione AI di sicurezza. Applicare avanzato

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing?
We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on
this mission.

The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research.

Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams.

Your tasks

• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis

• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes

• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance

• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects

• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry

• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team

Your profile

• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.

• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)

• You are well experienced in organic synthesis

• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.

• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.

• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.

• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory.

When does it start?
This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years.

Have we aroused your interest?
# If we are convinced, a virtual interview will take place
# If you also manage to convince us here, the last step is an interview and presentation in the
Penzberg area

Your application
Please submit your application by sending an updated CV (including publication list and
references) together with your latest certificates. Before sending your application, please note
that no further documents can be added subsequently.

We are looking forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei interessato a sviluppare nuovi reagenti e flussi di lavoro per il sequenziamento di prossima generazione? Stiamo cercando un compagno postdoctoral altamente talentuoso e motivato (m/f/d) per unirsi alla nostra squadra questa missione. Il dipartimento di Chemistry Technologies fornisce la gamma completa di reagenti diagnostici chimici, che vanno da piccole molecole a biooligomeri e polimeri. Sfruttando moderni metodi sintetici e analitici progettiamo e sviluppiamo molecole su misura per trovare le soluzioni giuste per le domande diagnostiche e oltre. Lavoriamo come team, siamo guidati dalla passione per la scienza e dall'impegno per l'apprendimento continuo a rimanere in prima linea nella ricerca. La nostra cultura è definita dalla fiducia, dalla trasparenza e da un forte spirito collaborativo. Stiamo cercando un collega proattivo che bilancia il pensiero critico indipendente con lo spirito di squadra e la flessibilità di collaborare tra diversi dipartimenti e team interdisciplinari. I tuoi compiti
• Progettazione e sintetizzazione di oligonucleotide-congiunti complessi da tecniche di bioconiugazione contemporanee e piccole entità molecolari per sintesi chimica
• Stabilire le reazioni di prossimità modellate dal DNA per il test iniziale delle nuove classi di reagente
• Collaborare proattivamente con i partner di progetto di biologia, analisi e i team di sviluppo del test di sequenziamento per acquisire una profonda conoscenza del rapporto tra progettazione strutturale e performance di analisi
• Pianificare in modo indipendente, eseguire e analizzare gli esperimenti per avanzare efficacemente i progetti
• L'attuale progresso scientifico attraverso incontri interni e visite a conferenze scientifiche per garantire la conoscenza all'avanguardia nel campo della sintesi bioorganica, della biologia chimica e della chimica superficiale
• Partecipa a un team altamente motivato e interfunzionale Il tuo profilo
• Si tiene un dottorato nel campo della chimica organica (bio), biologia chimica o scienza della vita.
• Possiedi profonda conoscenza nella sintesi di oligonucleotide-congiurati, preferibilmente in contesto di biomolecole (proteine, peptidi, acidi nucleici)
• Siete ben sperimentati nella sintesi organica
• Esperienza pratica nel campo delle reazioni di DNA-templati, reazioni di prossimità e rilevazione di acido nucleico completa il tuo profilo.
• La tua qualifica dovrebbe essere chiaramente dimostrata da almeno un primo autore pubblicato o accettato in una rivista ad alto impatto.
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali sono la vostra forza. Sei sensibile alle questioni interculturali e interdisciplinari - lavorare in un team diventa naturale per te.
• Sei un individuo proattivo con passione e impegno a innovare la salute attraverso il nostro Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.
• Sono richieste eccellenti competenze in inglese, il tedesco non è obbligatorio. Quando inizia? Questa posizione sarà riempita con effetto settembre 2026 ed è limitata a 2 anni. Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? # Se siamo convinti, un'intervista virtuale avrà luogo # Se riuscite anche a convincerci qui, l'ultimo passo è un'intervista e una presentazione nel Penzberg area La tua richiesta Invia la tua richiesta inviando un CV aggiornato (incluso l'elenco delle pubblicazioni e riferimenti) insieme ai tuoi ultimi certificati. Per inviare la domanda, si prega di notare che non si possono aggiungere ulteriori documenti in seguito. Siamo lieti della vostra applicazione! Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. • Établir des réactions de proximité à l'ADN pour le test initial de vos nouvelles classes de réactif
• Collaborer de façon proactive avec des partenaires de projets issus d'équipes de développement de la biologie, de l'analyse et du séquençage pour mieux comprendre la relation entre la conception structurale et la performance des essais
• Planifier, exécuter et analyser des expériences pour faire avancer efficacement les projets
• Présenter les progrès scientifiques grâce à des réunions internes et visiter des conférences scientifiques afin d'assurer les connaissances les plus récentes dans le domaine de la synthèse bioorganique, de la biologie chimique et de la chimie de surface
• Faire partie d'une équipe hautement motivée et interfonctionnelle Votre profil
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en chimie (bio)organique, en biologie chimique ou en sciences de la vie.
• Vous possédez une connaissance profonde de la synthèse des oligonucléotides conjugués, de préférence dans le contexte des biomolécules (protéines, peptides, acides nucléiques)
• Vous êtes bien expérimenté dans la synthèse organique
• L'expérience pratique dans le domaine des réactions à l'ADN, des réactions de proximité et de la détection d'acide nucléique complète votre profil.
• Votre qualification devrait être clairement démontrée par au moins un premier article publié ou accepté dans une revue à fort impact.
• Une excellente communication et des compétences interpersonnelles sont votre force. Vous êtes sensible aux questions interculturelles et interdisciplinaires - travailler en équipe vous est naturel.
• Vous êtes un individu proactif avec passion et engagement pour innover les soins de santé grâce à notre programme de diagnostic postdoc.
• D'excellentes compétences en anglais sont requises, l'allemand n'est pas obligatoire. Quand ça commence ? Ce poste sera comblé avec effet Septmber 2026 et est limité à 2 ans. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics Central Asia and Caucasian countries.

Location: Kazakhstan, Almaty

• What will you do?
• · You will join the healthcare innovation team.
• · You will be responsible for growing the portfolio; delivering on the marketing plan and working cross functionally with related colleagues.
• · You will prepare short term (annual) and medium term business/marketing plans for the products.
• · You will be expected to maintain and communicate a high level of market and product knowledge.
• · You will organize training programs for commercial team about products, product marketing strategies and competition.
• · You will organize product related marketing events (congresses, conferences, etc) in cooperation with related parties

• Who are you?
• · Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry
• · Preferably 1-2 years’ experience of product management in the diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or related industry
• · Budget management and product launch experience preferred
• · Strong communication, analytical and presentation skills
• · At least upper-intermediate level of English and fluent Russian
• · Having driving license and willing to travel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo cercando un Product Manager presso Roche Diagnostics Central Asia e paesi caucasici. Ubicazione: Kazakistan, Almaty
• Cosa farai?
• · Ti unirai al team di innovazione sanitaria.
• · Sarete responsabili della crescita del portafoglio; consegnando il piano di marketing e la croce di lavoro funzionale con colleghi correlati.
• · preparerete a breve termine (annuale) e piani commerciali/marketing a medio termine per i prodotti.
• · Sarete tenuti a mantenere e comunicare un alto livello di conoscenza del mercato e del prodotto.
• · Organizzerai programmi di formazione per team commerciale su prodotti, strategie di marketing del prodotto e concorrenza.
• · Organizzerai eventi di marketing relativi ai prodotti (congressi, conferenze, ecc.) in collaborazione con le parti correlate
• Chi sei?
• · Laurea in medicina, biologia, chimica
• · Preferibilmente 1-2 anni di esperienza di gestione del prodotto nel settore diagnostico, farmaceutico o relativo
• · Gestione del bilancio e esperienza di lancio del prodotto preferito
• · Forte capacità comunicative, analitiche e di presentazione
• · Almeno il livello intermedio superiore del russo inglese e fluente
• · Avere patente di guida e disposto a viaggiare Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

titleByLocale.fr: Stage de six mois axé sur l ' éducation des adultes (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Als Learning-Abteilung verantworten wir die Einarbeitung und das Training neuer und bestehender Mitarbeitender in unserem Pharma-Bereich mit über 2000 Beschäftigten (Produktion, Quality, Entwicklung, Cell & Gene). Damit Lernen ein echtes Erlebnis wird und den Teilnehmenden sowie Trainern noch mehr Spaß macht, suchen wir Dich für 6 Monate in Vollzeit (37,5 h/Woche) als Unterstützung in unserem Team!

Unser Ziel

Wir möchten weg von „Read and Understood“ hin zu kompetenzbasierten, praxisorientierten Trainingsformaten (On-the-Job) – idealerweise gestützt von modernen digitalen und automatisierten Lösungen. Auf dieser Reise unterstützt du uns und leistest deinen Beitrag zu unserer Vision: „Jeder findet, was er sucht, versteht, was er findet, und lernt, was er braucht. “

Deine Aufgaben

Innerhalb der folgenden Tätigkeiten können sich deine Aufgaben und Einsatzmöglichkeiten bei uns wiederfinden:

• Didaktische Konzeption: Du unterstützt unsere Learning Partner bei der Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von Trainings-Konzepten basierend auf unserer Strategie sowie dem Feedback aus der Organisation.

• State-of-the-Art Erwachsenenbildung: Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten entwickelst du Trainings nach modernen Ansätzen der Bildungswissenschaft und Psychologie weiter. Du unterstützt bei der Methodenauswahl, der didaktischen Strukturierung sowie der konzeptionellen und visuellen Gestaltung.

• Digitale Innovation & Automatisierung: Du treibst die Digitalisierung unserer Lerninhalte voran. Dazu gehört die eigenständige Entwicklung von Softwareanwendungen, Apps oder Tools auf Low-Code-Plattformen (z. B. UiPath) sowie die Arbeit mit Content-Lifecycle-Management-Systemen.

• Prozessanalyse & Visualisierung: Gemeinsam im Team identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale, führst Datenanalysen durch und visualisierst Prozesse in entsprechenden Tools, um die Stabilität und Effizienz im Learning-Bereich zu erhöhen.

• Workshop- und Content-Erstellung: Du bereitest interaktive Workshops und Präsentationsunterlagen vor, führst diese mit durch und breitest die Ergebnisse professionell auf.

Wer du bist

• Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte:r Student:in der Fachrichtungen Pädagogik, Bildungswissenschaften, Sozialpädagogik, Psychologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik (oder vergleichbar) bzw. befindest dich im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.

• Didaktisches Fundament: Du bringst theoretisches Wissen oder erste praktische Erfahrungen aus der Didaktik, Lernpsychologie oder Erwachsenenbildung mit und weißt, wie man Wissen nachhaltig und inspirierend vermittelt.

• Digitale Affinität: Du besitzt eine hohe IT- und Tech-Affinität. Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office/Google Workspace sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit E-Learning- und Kollaborations-Tools (Articulate, Synthesia, Miro, Trello, Lucid, Tableau) oder Low-Code-Plattformen (UiPath) zeichnen dich aus.

• Sprachkompetenz: Da wir in einem internationalen Pharma-Umfeld agieren, fließen dir gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift leicht von der Hand; sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

• Persönlichkeit: Du bist kommunikativ, organisierst gerne und liebst es, im Team zu arbeiten und andere für deine kreativen Ideen zu begeistern.

• Präsenz: Es ist dir möglich, rund 80 % deiner Arbeitszeit vor Ort im Büro am Standort Penzberg zu verbringen.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• attraktive Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-
