The Position
Wer wir sind

Als Learning-Abteilung verantworten wir die Einarbeitung und das Training neuer und bestehender Mitarbeitender in unserem Pharma-Bereich mit über 2000 Beschäftigten (Produktion, Quality, Entwicklung, Cell & Gene). Damit Lernen ein echtes Erlebnis wird und den Teilnehmenden sowie Trainern noch mehr Spaß macht, suchen wir Dich für 6 Monate in Vollzeit (37,5 h/Woche) als Unterstützung in unserem Team!

Unser Ziel

Wir möchten weg von „Read and Understood“ hin zu kompetenzbasierten, praxisorientierten Trainingsformaten (On-the-Job) – idealerweise gestützt von modernen digitalen und automatisierten Lösungen. Auf dieser Reise unterstützt du uns und leistest deinen Beitrag zu unserer Vision: „Jeder findet, was er sucht, versteht, was er findet, und lernt, was er braucht. “

Deine Aufgaben

Innerhalb der folgenden Tätigkeiten können sich deine Aufgaben und Einsatzmöglichkeiten bei uns wiederfinden:

• Didaktische Konzeption: Du unterstützt unsere Learning Partner bei der Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von Trainings-Konzepten basierend auf unserer Strategie sowie dem Feedback aus der Organisation.

• State-of-the-Art Erwachsenenbildung: Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten entwickelst du Trainings nach modernen Ansätzen der Bildungswissenschaft und Psychologie weiter. Du unterstützt bei der Methodenauswahl, der didaktischen Strukturierung sowie der konzeptionellen und visuellen Gestaltung.

• Digitale Innovation & Automatisierung: Du treibst die Digitalisierung unserer Lerninhalte voran. Dazu gehört die eigenständige Entwicklung von Softwareanwendungen, Apps oder Tools auf Low-Code-Plattformen (z. B. UiPath) sowie die Arbeit mit Content-Lifecycle-Management-Systemen.

• Prozessanalyse & Visualisierung: Gemeinsam im Team identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale, führst Datenanalysen durch und visualisierst Prozesse in entsprechenden Tools, um die Stabilität und Effizienz im Learning-Bereich zu erhöhen.

• Workshop- und Content-Erstellung: Du bereitest interaktive Workshops und Präsentationsunterlagen vor, führst diese mit durch und breitest die Ergebnisse professionell auf.

Wer du bist

• Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte:r Student:in der Fachrichtungen Pädagogik, Bildungswissenschaften, Sozialpädagogik, Psychologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik (oder vergleichbar) bzw. befindest dich im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.

• Didaktisches Fundament: Du bringst theoretisches Wissen oder erste praktische Erfahrungen aus der Didaktik, Lernpsychologie oder Erwachsenenbildung mit und weißt, wie man Wissen nachhaltig und inspirierend vermittelt.

• Digitale Affinität: Du besitzt eine hohe IT- und Tech-Affinität. Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office/Google Workspace sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit E-Learning- und Kollaborations-Tools (Articulate, Synthesia, Miro, Trello, Lucid, Tableau) oder Low-Code-Plattformen (UiPath) zeichnen dich aus.

• Sprachkompetenz: Da wir in einem internationalen Pharma-Umfeld agieren, fließen dir gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift leicht von der Hand; sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

• Persönlichkeit: Du bist kommunikativ, organisierst gerne und liebst es, im Team zu arbeiten und andere für deine kreativen Ideen zu begeistern.

• Präsenz: Es ist dir möglich, rund 80 % deiner Arbeitszeit vor Ort im Büro am Standort Penzberg zu verbringen.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• attraktive Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will complete your internship/Master's thesis in the Near Patient Care Research & Early Development chapter. The chapter's mission is the pre-development of near patient care systems for subsequent product development.
Your task will consist of developing a novel flow-through biosensor and characterizing its performance. To accomplish this, you will:

• Build up a fluidic test setup for whole blood processing

• Develop new sensor layouts and methods for layer construction, employing state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques

• Integrate functional sensor components into the fluidic test setup.

• Synthesize/assemble and characterize different functional sensor components, including thick-film sensors

• Evaluate measurement data using newly developed algorithms and advanced analytical methods

• Work independently on assigned work packages: plan and execute experiments, document results, and prepare detailed technical analyses

Who You Are

We are looking for a highly motivated student with the following educational background:

• Currently enrolled in a Master’s program, with a B.Sc. degree in Biomedical Engineering, Microsystems Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Physics, Electrochemistry, or a related field (very good grades required)

Technical Experience & Knowledge:

• Ideally, you bring knowledge and experience in prototyping of microfluidic devices and manufacturing or characterization of (bio)sensors

• You are experienced in instrument control programming and fluidics control engineering

• You are familiar with the fundamentals of optical, spectroscopic and electrochemical measurement techniques

• Ideally, you have knowledge of micromachining processes

• Ideally, you possess not only basic knowledge of statistics, but also experience with methods for filtering and fitting measurement data

• Familiarity with various analytical and characterization methods is advantageous

• Willingness to work with human material, e.g., whole blood samples, plasma, serum, and interstitial fluid is required

Personal Qualities:

• High technical interest, especially in interdisciplinary work

• Enthusiasm and passion for microfluidics and biosensor development

• Independence, strong commitment, and goal-oriented mindset

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills; approachability and sociability

• Advanced level of English and at least an Upper-Intermediate level of German

• Eager to gain practical experience in an industrial setting

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours (37.5 hours/week)

• Attractive recognition grant

• Discounted meal prices (- 50%) in our staff canteen

• Sport Center on campus

• Online/Offline student networking events

Your application

Please upload your resume and motivation letter.

Please remember that this opportunity is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled in a master's program and will maintain their student status for the entire period of the internship.

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

Period: from November 2026 for a period of 6+6 months.

We are looking forward to your application!

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will complete your internship/Master's thesis in the Near Patient Care Research & Early Development chapter. The chapter's mission is the pre-development of near patient care systems for subsequent product development.
Your task will consist of developing a novel flow-through biosensor and characterizing its performance. To accomplish this, you will:

• Build up a fluidic test setup for whole blood processing

• Develop new sensor layouts and methods for layer construction, employing state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques

• Integrate functional sensor components into the fluidic test setup.

• Synthesize/assemble and characterize different functional sensor components, including thick-film sensors

• Evaluate measurement data using newly developed algorithms and advanced analytical methods

• Work independently on assigned work packages: plan and execute experiments, document results, and prepare detailed technical analyses

Who You Are

We are looking for a highly motivated student with the following educational background:

• Currently enrolled in a Master’s program, with a B.Sc. degree in Biomedical Engineering, Microsystems Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Physics, Electrochemistry, or a related field (very good grades required)

Technical Experience & Knowledge:

• Ideally, you bring knowledge and experience in prototyping of microfluidic devices and manufacturing or characterization of (bio)sensors

• You are experienced in instrument control programming and fluidics control engineering

• You are familiar with the fundamentals of optical, spectroscopic and electrochemical measurement techniques

• Ideally, you have knowledge of micromachining processes

• Ideally, you possess not only basic knowledge of statistics, but also experience with methods for filtering and fitting measurement data

• Familiarity with various analytical and characterization methods is advantageous

• Willingness to work with human material, e.g., whole blood samples, plasma, serum, and interstitial fluid is required

Personal Qualities:

• High technical interest, especially in interdisciplinary work

• Enthusiasm and passion for microfluidics and biosensor development

• Independence, strong commitment, and goal-oriented mindset

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills; approachability and sociability

• Advanced level of English and at least an Upper-Intermediate level of German

• Eager to gain practical experience in an industrial setting

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours (37.5 hours/week)

• Attractive recognition grant

• Discounted meal prices (- 50%) in our staff canteen

• Sport Center on campus

• Online/Offline student networking events

Please remember that this opportunity is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled in a master's program and will maintain their student status for the entire period of the internship.

Period: from November 2026 for a period of 6+6 months.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Territory Manager - Jabalpur , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Mahakoushal Area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity

• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.

• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.

• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.

• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.

• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.

• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.

Who You Are

• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.

• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in FMCG, OTC, or Retail sales .

• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Vadodara/Surat market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.

• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.

• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.

• Eccellenza del cliente: Rivolgiti a tutte le denunce e suggerimenti dei distributori e dei clienti coordinandoti con l'assistenza clienti. Si organizzano incontri di dealer in allineamento con strategie di marketing per garantire la coerenza del marchio e partnership forti.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) is a global organisation of app. 3,000 colleagues across six Innovation Centres covering multiple disease areas, with the aim of translating science into transformative medicines for patients. Within this exciting and dynamic environment, pRED Communications operates as a high-impact team of strategic business partners.

We are seeking a dynamic Senior Communications Business Partner who embodies a strategic and collaborative mindset. In this role, you will lead on a diverse portfolio of communication responsibilities across the pRED landscape. You will serve as a core member of at least one pRED Leadership Team, deploying your strategic expertise where it is most needed to drive business outcomes and organisational alignment.

​The opportunity

• Strategic advisory: Act as a core communications strategic adviser and valued Leadership Team member for a designated portfolio within pRED. You will translate business strategy into high-impact communication blueprints that resonate from the lab benches to the leadership community and beyond. You will provide strategic counsel to senior leaders and ensure communications are integrated into the business decision-making process.

• Cross-functional impact: Identify the need for, lead and execute both internal and external communication strategies to continue to position pRED and Roche at the forefront of science in healthcare. You will work as part of a Business Partnering team to align across a global network to deliver a unified communications approach.

• Culture and change catalyst: pRED is a highly dynamic and innovative part of our Roche Pharma business that requires communications to match its needs. You will lead communications initiatives around organisational transformation and development, as well as behavioral and culture evolution across different parts of the pRED network.

• Collaborative partnership: Work in partnership with colleagues from across Roche Group Communications (GC), bringing in additional expertise from distinct ‘’Centres of Excellence’’, for example in media relations, social media or employee engagement, as well as collaborating with colleagues from the wider Pharma Communications team, to co-create world class communications.

Who you are
The ideal candidate is more than a communications specialist - they are also a business leader and someone who is deeply energised by how we develop and deliver medicines. A profound curiosity and passion for science and its role in improving healthcare is key to success in this role.

• Experience: 8+ years in scientific, technical, or corporate communications within the Pharma/Biotech or related highly regulated industries; direct experience in a science or healthcare communications environment is strongly preferred.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required (Journalism, Communications, Science, or Business); Master’s degree desirable.

• Executive influence: Proven track record of navigating matrixed environments and advising c-Suite, with the ability to challenge status quo thinking constructively.

• Operational passion: You have a genuine interest in the "how" of pharma—the science, the manufacturing, and the complexity of end-to-end processes that serve our patients.

• Architect and catalyst mindset: You don’t just deliver messages; you design communication strategies that facilitate change, make impact and foster rigorous professional debate, both inside and outside of

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) è un'organizzazione globale di app. 3.000 colleghi in sei Centri di innovazione che coprono più aree di malattia, con l'obiettivo di tradurre la scienza in farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti. All'interno di questo ambiente emozionante e dinamico, pRED Communications opera come un team di partner commerciali strategici ad alto impatto.

Siamo alla ricerca di un dinamico Senior Communications Business Partner che incarna una mentalità strategica e collaborativa. In questo ruolo, si porterà su un portafoglio diversificato di responsabilità di comunicazione attraverso il paesaggio pRED. Potrai servire come membro principale di almeno un team di Leadership pRED, implementando la tua esperienza strategica in cui è più necessario guidare i risultati aziendali e l'allineamento organizzativo.

L'opportunità

• Consulenza strategica: agire come consulente strategico per le comunicazioni di base e valutare il membro del Team Leadership per un portafoglio designato all'interno di pRED. Tradurrai la strategia aziendale in progetti di comunicazione ad alto impatto che risonano dalle panche di laboratorio alla comunità di leadership e oltre. Potrai fornire consulenza strategica ai leader senior e garantire che le comunicazioni siano integrate nel processo decisionale aziendale.

• Impatto cross-funzionale: Identificare la necessità, guidare ed eseguire strategie di comunicazione interne ed esterne per continuare a posizionare pRED e Roche all'avanguardia della scienza nel settore sanitario. Potrai lavorare come parte di un team di Business Partnering per allinearsi in una rete globale per fornire un approccio di comunicazione unificato.

• Cultura e cambiamento catalizzatore: pRED è una parte altamente dinamica e innovativa del nostro business Roche Pharma che richiede comunicazioni per soddisfare le sue esigenze. Condurrai iniziative di comunicazione intorno alla trasformazione e allo sviluppo organizzativo, nonché all'evoluzione comportamentale e culturale in diverse parti della rete pRED.

• Partenariato collaborativo: Lavorare in collaborazione con i colleghi di tutta la Roche Group Communications (GC), apportare ulteriori competenze da distinti “centri di eccellenza”, ad esempio nelle relazioni con i media, nei social media o nell’impegno dei dipendenti, oltre a collaborare con i colleghi del più ampio team di Pharma Communications, per creare comunicazioni di livello mondiale.

Chi sei
Il candidato ideale è più di uno specialista di comunicazione - sono anche un leader di affari e qualcuno che è profondamente eccitato da come sviluppiamo e forniamo farmaci. Una profonda curiosità e passione per la scienza e il suo ruolo nel miglioramento della salute è fondamentale per il successo in questo ruolo.

• Esperienza: 8+ anni di comunicazione scientifica, tecnica o aziendale all'interno delle industrie Pharma/Biotech o connesse altamente regolamentate; l'esperienza diretta in un ambiente di comunicazione scientifica o sanitaria è fortemente preferita.

• Istruzione: Corso di laurea o equivalente richiesto (Journalism, Comunicazioni, Scienza, o Business); laurea auspicabile.

• Influenza esecutiva: comprovata traccia di navigazione degli ambienti matrici e consulenza c-Suite, con la capacità di sfidare lo status quo pensando costruttivamente.

• Passione operativa: Hai un vero interesse per il "come" del farmaco, la scienza, la produzione e la complessità dei processi end-to-end che servono i nostri pazienti.

• Architetto e catalizzatore mindset: Non basta consegnare messaggi; progetta strategie di comunicazione che facilitano il cambiamento, l'impatto e favoriscono un rigoroso dibattito professionale, sia all'interno che all'esterno

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) ist eine globale Organisation der App. 3.000 Kollegen in sechs Innovationszentren, die mehrere Krankheitsbereiche abdecken, mit dem Ziel, Wissenschaft in transformative Medikamente für Patienten zu übersetzen. In diesem spannenden und dynamischen Umfeld agiert pRED Communications als einflussreiches Team strategischer Geschäftspartner.

Wir suchen einen dynamischen Senior Communications Business Partner, der eine strategische und kollaborative Denkweise verkörpert. In dieser Rolle führen Sie ein vielfältiges Portfolio an Kommunikationsverantwortlichkeiten in der gesamten pRED-Landschaft. Sie werden als Kernmitglied von mindestens einem pRED-Führungsteam tätig sein und Ihre strategische Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie am dringendsten benötigt wird, um Geschäftsergebnisse und organisatorische Ausrichtung zu fördern.

Die Chance

• Strategische Beratung: Handeln Sie als strategischer Berater der Kernkommunikation und geschätztes Mitglied des Führungsteams für ein bestimmtes Portfolio innerhalb von pRED. Sie werden Geschäftsstrategie in wirkungsvolle Kommunikationsblaupausen übersetzen, die von den Laborbänken bis zur Führungsgemeinschaft und darüber hinaus ankommen. Sie bieten leitenden Führungskräften strategische Beratung und stellen sicher, dass die Kommunikation in den Geschäftsentscheidungsprozess integriert wird.

• Funktionale Auswirkungen: Identifizieren Sie die Notwendigkeit, führen Sie und führen Sie sowohl interne als auch externe Kommunikationsstrategien durch, um pRED und Roche weiterhin an der Spitze der Wissenschaft im Gesundheitswesen zu positionieren. Sie arbeiten als Teil eines Business-Partnering-Teams, um sich in einem globalen Netzwerk auszurichten und einen einheitlichen Kommunikationsansatz zu liefern.

• Kultur- und Change-Katalysator: pRED ist ein hochdynamischer und innovativer Teil unseres Roche Pharma-Geschäfts, der Kommunikation benötigt, um seinen Bedürfnissen gerecht zu werden. Sie werden Kommunikationsinitiativen rund um organisatorische Transformation und Entwicklung sowie Verhaltens- und Kulturentwicklung in verschiedenen Teilen des pRED-Netzwerks leiten.

• Zusammenarbeit: Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus allen Bereichen der Roche Group Communications (GC), indem zusätzliches Fachwissen aus verschiedenen „Centres of Excellence, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Medienarbeit, Social Media oder Mitarbeiterengagement, sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus dem breiteren Pharma Communications-Team eingebracht wird, um eine erstklassige Kommunikation zu schaffen.

Wer du bist
Der ideale Kandidat ist mehr als ein Kommunikationsspezialist - er ist auch ein Wirtschaftsführer und jemand, der durch die Art und Weise, wie wir Medikamente entwickeln und liefern, stark motiviert ist. Eine tiefe Neugier und Leidenschaft für die Wissenschaft und ihre Rolle bei der Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Rolle.

• Erfahrung: 8+ Jahre in der wissenschaftlichen, technischen oder Unternehmenskommunikation in der Pharma / Biotech oder verwandten stark regulierten Industrien; direkte Erfahrung in einer Wissenschafts- oder Gesundheitskommunikationsumgebung wird stark bevorzugt.

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig erforderlich (Journalismus, Kommunikation, Wissenschaft oder Business); Master-Abschluss wünschenswert.

• Exekutiver Einfluss: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Navigation in matrixisierten Umgebungen und der Beratung von c-Suite mit der Fähigkeit, das konstruktive Denken des Status Quo in Frage zu stellen.

• Operationelle Leidenschaft: Sie haben ein echtes Interesse am "Wie" der Pharmaindustrie - der Wissenschaft, der Herstellung und der Komplexität von End-to-End-Prozessen, die unseren Patienten dienen.

• Architekten- und Katalysator-Mentalität: Sie liefern nicht nur Botschaften; Sie entwerfen Kommunikationsstrategien, die Veränderungen ermöglichen, Auswirkungen haben und strenge professionelle Debatten fördern, sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche. An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 41 Nationen.
Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die vielfältigen Genuss bieten, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Darüber hinaus gibt es Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Wir suchen per sofort eine:n Chef de Partie, Tournant für die Tavero AG in Basel.

Deine Aufgaben

• Abwechselnder Arbeitseinsatz auf allen Posten in den Betrieben Gäste- und Direktionsrestaurant Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli und Science Club

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Ideenreichtum und Kreativität sind deine Antreiber

• Du bringst die Liebe zum Beruf auf den Teller

• Selbstständiges Führen eines Postens

• Erstellen der benötigten Mise en Place und verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf auf deinem Posten

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftlicher und korrekter Umgang mit Lebensmittel bei der Lagerung und/sowie bei deren Verarbeitung

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Arbeitszeiten in der Regel zwischen 6.00 und 22.00 Uhr, mit Ausnahmen auch Abendeinsätze möglich

Dein Profil

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ) und verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre) in der gehobenen Gastronomie

• Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen in allen Küchenbereichen

• Du entwickelst gerne neue Rezepte und bist kreativ in der Angebotsplanung

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healt

La nostra offerta comprende sia i ristoranti del personale che offrono una varietà di piaceri, così come i ristoranti di Fine Dining con cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Grab'n'Go offre da sushi a Burger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Inoltre, offriamo ai nostri ospiti sala riunioni e catering per eventi fino a 1.500 persone. La gastronomia pubblica, lo Schöpfli nel parco e il Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely completano la nostra offerta. Stiamo cercando un:n Chef de Partie, Tournant per Tavero AG a Basilea. I tuoi compiti
• Cambio di lavoro su tutti gli articoli nelle aziende Ristorante Guest and directors Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli e Science Club
• Fornitura e produzione di tutti i componenti di fornitura
• Preparazione secondo la ricetta, tra cui degustazione e processo di miglioramento continuo
• Idee ricche e creatività sono i vostri piloti
• Portate l'amore a lavorare sul piatto
• Autogovernare un post
• Creare la mise necessaria in atto e responsabile della corsa liscia sul tuo post
• Manutenzione delle norme igieniche (TQM / HACCP)
• Gestione economica e corretta del cibo durante lo stoccaggio e/o la lavorazione
• Gestione sicura dei beni e ordini interni ed esterni
• Ore lavorative di solito tra 6.00 e 22.00, con eccezioni anche serate possibili Il tuo profilo
• Hai una formazione completa di cucina (EFZ) e hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale (esclusi anni di formazione)
• Hai esperienza rilevante in tutte le aree della cucina
• Ti piace sviluppare nuove ricette e sono creativi nell'offerta di pianificazione
• Sei un'istituzione organizzativa e hai un forte senso di responsabilità
• Hai una capacità di esecuzione
• Avete un modo indipendente di lavorare e di assumersi la responsabilità
• Le abilità di squadra e l'affidabilità sono autoevidenti
• Conoscete la legislazione alimentare svizzera
• Hai una buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura per essere in grado di consigliare i tuoi clienti in modo competente
• In un mondo digitale, vogliamo anche garantire una gestione sicura dei programmi informatici (MS Office) Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un guaritore

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Foodlicious est notre affaire quotidienne En plus de 30 ans, Taverne Roche a développé une entreprise gastronomique réussie. Tavero AG est une filiale à 100% de F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Aux sites de Bâle et Kaiseraugst, nous employons environ 350 employés de plus de 41 pays. Notre offre comprend les deux restaurants du personnel qui offrent une variété de plaisirs, ainsi que des restaurants gastronomiques avec une cuisine fine et un excellent service. En outre, il y a des restaurants avec des spécialités du monde entier, du café dans toutes les variantes, enchantés par nos baristi, ainsi que les salons les plus haut de gamme en Suisse - des endroits fantastiques après-vente sur les toits de la ville. Les offres Grab'n'Go de sushi à Burger et le premier et seul club de l'histoire de Roche complètent notre offre. En outre, nous offrons à nos invités une salle de réunion et un événement pour accueillir jusqu'à 1 500 personnes. La gastronomie publique, le Schöpfli dans le parc et le Chez Jeannot au Musée Tinguely complètent notre offre. Nous recherchons un:n Chef de Partie, Tournant pour Tavero AG à Bâle. Vos tâches
• Changer de travail sur tous les articles dans les entreprises Invités et Directions Restaurant Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli et Science Club
• Livraison et production de tous les composants d'approvisionnement
• Préparation selon la recette, y compris la dégustation et le processus d'amélioration continue
• Idées riches et créativité sont vos moteurs
• Vous apportez l'amour à la profession sur l'assiette
• Autogérer un poste
• Créer la mise en place nécessaire et responsable du bon fonctionnement de votre poste
• Maintenir les règles d'hygiène (TQM / HACCP)
• Manipulation économique et correcte des aliments dans le stockage et/ou le traitement
• Gestion sécuritaire des biens et commandes internes et externes
• Heures de travail habituellement entre 6h00 et 22h00, sauf en soirée inserts possible votre profil
• Vous avez une formation de cuisine complète (EFZ) et avez au moins plus. 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle (années de formation exclusives) dans la gastronomie de haute qualité
• Vous avez une expérience pertinente dans tous les espaces de cuisine
• Vous aimez développer de nouvelles recettes et être créatif dans la planification
• Vous êtes une institution organisationnelle et avez un fort sens des responsabilités
• Vous avez une capacité d'exécution
• Vous avez une façon indépendante de travailler et de prendre la responsabilité
• Compétences d'équipe et fiabilité sont naturelles pour vous
• Vous avez une connaissance de la législation alimentaire suisse
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture pour fournir des conseils compétents à vos clients
• Dans un monde numérique, nous souhaitons également développer une gestion sécuritaire des programmes informatiques (MS Office) Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitieux au sommet, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. jobs.title: Investor Relations Officer (Finance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Welcome to a highly dedicated team where you will have the unique opportunity to gain deep insight into all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company. Our team focuses on maintaining strong relations with the capital market while offering a dynamic and fast-paced environment with ample opportunities for professional development.

As an Investor Relations Officer, your core responsibilities will be to analyze financial community expectations and market sentiment, provide vital internal performance updates, and ensure a continuous information flow to shareholders and bondholders. By doing so, you will strengthen their understanding and appreciation of Roche’s business while gaining extensive experience in internal and external communications directed at senior management and the financial community.

The Opportunity

• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Manage the preparation of quarterly results presentations for the management team with a strong focus on finance, specifically supporting the CFO, and actively participate in the preparation of the Finance Report.

• Investor & Analyst Relations: Act as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all finance and sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests, while building and maintaining an internal network of subject matter experts.

• Fixed-Income Management: Lead all fixed-income related activities, which includes handling requests from bondholders, supporting the issuance of new debt, and supporting annual reviews with rating agencies in close collaboration with Group Treasury.

• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitor sell-side reports, contextualize consensus estimates, and maintain an internal company valuation model in close collaboration with Group Planning.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise closely with Group Finance, Legal, BD, and Communications on a variety of strategic topics, such as business development, the implementation of regulatory changes, and the ad-hoc release process.

• Capital Market Events: Participate in the preparation of capital market days (e.g., Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) by developing compelling storylines and building slide decks for individual speakers.

• IR Infrastructure: Oversee and run the day-to-day operations of the Investor Relations (IR) website and its associated digital tools.

Who You Are

• Experience & Industry Background: You bring a strong finance, accounting, or business background with at least five years of working experience at the group level of a global Pharma/Biotech company, including hands-on involvement in the quarterly and annual results review process.

• Capital Markets Expertise: You possess a deep interest in capital markets, a validated understanding of company valuations (especially within the healthcare sector), and a solid foundational understanding of accounting policies.

• Technical Skillset: You have strong proficiency in standard business tools such as Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in specialized analytical tools like Bloomberg is considered a distinct asset.

• Communication & Articulation: You are fluent in English (both written and spoken), with German language skills being a clear advantage. You back this up with excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, enabling you to clearly explain financial value drivers and complex business concepts.

Il nostro team si concentra sul mantenimento di forti relazioni con il mercato del capitale, offrendo un ambiente dinamico e veloce con ampie opportunità di sviluppo professionale. In qualità di Investor Relations Officer, le vostre responsabilità principali saranno di analizzare le aspettative della comunità finanziaria e il sentimento di mercato, fornire aggiornamenti vitali delle prestazioni interne e garantire un flusso continuo di informazioni agli azionisti e agli obbligazionisti. Così facendo, rafforzerete la loro comprensione e apprezzamento del business di Roche, acquisendo una vasta esperienza nelle comunicazioni interne ed esterne dirette alla gestione senior e alla comunità finanziaria. L'opportunità
• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Gestire la preparazione di presentazioni trimestrali di risultati per il team di gestione con un forte focus sulla finanza, specificamente sostenere il CFO, e partecipare attivamente alla preparazione del Finance Report.
• Investor & Analyst Relations: Agire come punto chiave di contatto per analisti e investitori per elaborare tutte le richieste relative alla finanza e alla sostenibilità (ESG: Ambientale, Sociale, Governance), costruendo e mantenendo una rete interna di esperti in materia.
• Gestione dei proventi fissi: portare tutte le attività connesse a reddito fisso, che include la gestione delle richieste da parte degli obbligazionisti, sostenere l'emissione di nuovi debiti, e sostenere le recensioni annuali con agenzie di rating in stretta collaborazione con il Tesoro del Gruppo.
• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitorare i rapporti sul mercato, contestualizzare le stime del consenso e mantenere un modello di valutazione aziendale interno in stretta collaborazione con la Pianificazione del Gruppo.
• Collaborazione trasversale: Liaise a stretto contatto con le Finanze del Gruppo, Legale, BD e Comunicazioni su una varietà di argomenti strategici, come lo sviluppo aziendale, l'attuazione dei cambiamenti normativi e il processo di rilascio ad-hoc.
• Capital Market Events: Partecipa alla preparazione dei giorni del mercato dei capitali (ad esempio, Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) sviluppando storie convincenti e ponti di scorrimento per i singoli diffusori.
• IR Infrastructure: supervisionare ed eseguire le operazioni quotidiane del sito Investor Relations (IR) e dei relativi strumenti digitali associati. Chi sei
• Experience & Industry Background: Lei porta una forte finanza, contabilità o background aziendale con almeno cinque anni di esperienza lavorativa a livello di gruppo di una società globale Pharma/Biotech, compreso il coinvolgimento pratico nel processo di revisione trimestrale e annuale dei risultati.
• Competenza sui mercati dei capitali: Lei possiede un profondo interesse nei mercati dei capitali, una valida comprensione delle valutazioni aziendali (soprattutto nel settore sanitario) e una solida comprensione fondamentale delle politiche contabili.
• Technical Skillset: Hai una forte competenza in strumenti di business standard come Excel e PowerPoint; la competenza in strumenti analitici specializzati come Bloomberg è considerato un bene distinto.
• Comunicazione & Articulation: Lei è fluente in inglese (sia scritto che parlato), con le competenze linguistiche tedesche è un chiaro vantaggio. Si sostiene questo con eccellenti capacità interpersonali, di presentazione e di comunicazione, consentendo di spiegare chiaramente i driver di valore finanziario e concetti aziendali complessi.

By doing so, you will strengthen their understanding and appreciation of Roche’s business while gaining extensive experience in internal and external communications directed at senior management and the financial community.

The Opportunity

• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Manage the preparation of quarterly results presentations for the management team with a strong focus on finance, specifically supporting the CFO, and actively participate in the preparation of the Finance Report.

• Investor & Analyst Relations: Act as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all finance and sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests, while building and maintaining an internal network of subject matter experts.

• Fixed-Income Management: Lead all fixed-income related activities, which includes handling requests from bondholders, supporting the issuance of new debt, and supporting annual reviews with rating agencies in close collaboration with Group Treasury.

• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitor sell-side reports, contextualize consensus estimates, and maintain an internal company valuation model in close collaboration with Group Planning.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise closely with Group Finance, Legal, BD, and Communications on a variety of strategic topics, such as business development, the implementation of regulatory changes, and the ad-hoc release process.

• Capital Market Events: Participate in the preparation of capital market days (e.g., Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) by developing compelling storylines and building slide decks for individual speakers.

• IR Infrastructure: Oversee and run the day-to-day operations of the Investor Relations (IR) website and its associated digital tools.

Who You Are

• Experience & Industry Background: You bring a strong finance, accounting, or business background with at least five years of working experience at the group level of a global Pharma/Biotech company, including hands-on involvement in the quarterly and annual results review process.

• Capital Markets Expertise: You possess a deep interest in capital markets, a validated understanding of company valuations (especially within the healthcare sector), and a solid foundational understanding of accounting policies.

• Technical Skillset: You have strong proficiency in standard business tools such as Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in specialized analytical tools like Bloomberg is considered a distinct asset.

• Communication & Articulation: You are fluent in English (both written and spoken), with German language skills being a clear advantage. You back this up with excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, enabling you to clearly explain financial value drivers and complex business concepts.

• Networking & Collaborative Spirit: You have

Notre équipe se concentre sur le maintien de relations solides avec le marché des capitaux tout en offrant un environnement dynamique et rapide avec de nombreuses possibilités de développement professionnel. En tant qu'agent des relations avec les investisseurs, vos principales responsabilités consisteront à analyser les attentes de la communauté financière et le sentiment du marché, à fournir des mises à jour essentielles du rendement interne et à assurer un flux continu d'information aux actionnaires et aux détenteurs d'obligations. • Rapports financiers et présentations : Gérer la préparation de présentations trimestrielles des résultats à l'intention de l'équipe de gestion, en mettant l'accent sur les finances, en appuyant spécifiquement le DPF, et participer activement à la préparation du rapport financier.

• Expertise en marchés de capitaux: Vous avez un intérêt profond sur les marchés de capitaux, une compréhension validée des évaluations des entreprises (surtout dans le secteur de la santé), et une compréhension fondamentale solide des conventions comptables.

• Communication & Articulation: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais (écrit et parlé), les compétences linguistiques en allemand étant un avantage évident. Vous soutenez cela avec d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, de présentation et de communication, vous permettant d'expliquer clairement les facteurs de valeur financière et les concepts d'affaires complexes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​ Eine gesündere Zukunft. Diese Vision treibt unsere Innovationen an. Unsere Disziplin Process Engineering trägt mit der Realisierung von Investitionsprojekten von z.B. Clean Utility und GMP-Produktionsanlagen für die Herstellung von Einsatz- und Wirkstoffen bis zu einem dreistelligen Millionenbereich maßgeblich dazu bei.

Dein neues Team
Das Chapter Engineering RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten. Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Das Chapter Engineering RDG verantwortet die erfolgreiche Planung und Realisierung aller Großinvestitionsprojekte an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Senior Projektingenieur:in (m/w/d) - Prozesstechnik verstärkst du unser interdisziplinäres Team. Du leitest und managt große lokale und/oder globale CAPEX-Projekte mit hoher Komplexität und übernimmst die Anleitung großer Fachteams. Dabei verantwortest du die verfahrenstechnischen Prozessanlagen von der ersten Projektidee bis zum Handover mit Schwerpunkt in der Pharma-Produktion.
Das passt? Dann suchen wir genau Dich für folgende Aufgaben:

• Projektkoordination und -leitung : Du koordinierst das Projektteam aus Betrieb, (externen) Planer und Lieferanten über die gesamte Dauer von CAPEX-Projekten mit hoher Komplexität. Dies reicht von der Erstellung von Leistungsbeschreibungen für Planung und Ausführung, über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Abnahme externer Leistungen.

• Verantwortung in allen Projektphasen: Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung notwendiger technischer Konzepte und Dokumente, das Risikomanagement, Erstellung/Prüfung von Kostenschätzungen sowie die Fortschrittskontrolle des Teilprojektes. Dabei berücksichtigst du stets den Gesamtterminplan, das Budget, den Scope und die Qualitätsanforderungen.

• Schnittstellenmanagement und Beratung: Du pflegst eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Gewerken (u.a. Prozessautomation, Qualifizierung, SHE) und berätst Business Partner:innen sowie Projektmanager:innen und Kolleg:innen.

• Anforderungssicherung und Change Management: Du stellst die Einhaltung und Umsetzung der User Requirements (URB/URS) sicher und bewertest mögliche Änderungen im Projektverlauf (Change Management) hinsichtlich ihrer Auswirkungen auf Kosten und Termine.

• Innovation und Prozessoptimierung: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwirfst, entwickelst, verbesserst und implementierst du neue Technologien, Systeme, Tools, Vorlagen und Prozesse von wirtschaftlicher Relevanz.

• Wissensaustausch und Netzwerkpflege: Du tauschst dich in der Engineering Community aus und baust aktiv ein Experten-Netzwerk auf.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Qualifikation: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (z.B. Biotechnologie, Chemieingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau o.ä.)

• Projekterfahrung: Du bringst langjährige Erfahrung (>5 Jahre) in Engineering und Projektmanagement komplexer CAPEX-Projekte im GMP-Bereich mit Fokus auf Prozess-/Verfahrenstechnik, sowohl im Brownfield- als auch im Greenfield-Bereich mit.

• Fachexpertise: Du hast tiefgreifende Kenntnisse i

Chapter Engineering RDG è responsabile della progettazione e realizzazione di tutti i principali progetti di investimento nei siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. Guida e gestisci grandi progetti locali e/o globali CAPEX con elevata complessità e acquisisci la guida di grandi team specializzati. Sarete responsabili per gli impianti di processo di ingegneria dal primo progetto idea di consegnare con un focus sulla produzione farmaceutica. Ti sta bene? Allora ti stiamo cercando per i seguenti compiti:
• Coordinamento e gestione del progetto: coordina il team di progetto da progettisti (esterni) e fornitori per tutta la durata dei progetti CAPEX con elevata complessità. Questo va dalla creazione di descrizioni dei servizi per la pianificazione e l'esecuzione, attraverso la messa in servizio al successo di accettazione dei servizi esterni.
• Responsabilità in tutte le fasi del progetto: Lei è responsabile per la creazione di concetti e documenti tecnici necessari, la gestione del rischio, la creazione/esame di stime dei costi e il monitoraggio del progresso del sottoprogetto. Si tiene sempre conto dei requisiti generali di pianificazione, budget, portata e qualità.
• Gestione delle interfacce e consulenza: Mantenete una stretta collaborazione con gli scambi rilevanti (ad esempio l'automazione dei processi, la qualificazione, SHE) e consigliate i partner commerciali e i project manager: all'interno e ai colleghi.
• Garanzia dei requisiti e gestione dei cambiamenti: l'utente garantisce la conformità e l'attuazione dei requisiti dell'utente (URB/URS) e valuta le eventuali modifiche nel corso del progetto (gestione dei cambiamenti) per quanto riguarda il loro impatto sui costi e le scadenze.
• Innovazione e ottimizzazione dei processi: Insieme al team, progettare, sviluppare, migliorare e implementare nuove tecnologie, sistemi, strumenti, modelli e processi di rilevanza economica.
• Scambio di conoscenza e manutenzione della rete: scambiate idee nella comunità ingegneristica e create attivamente una rete di esperti. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti con te
• Qualificazione: Hai completato con successo gli studi universitari (ad esempio biotecnologia, ingegneria chimica, ingegneria meccanica, ecc.)
• Esperienza di progetto: Lei porta molti anni di esperienza (> 5 anni) nell'ingegneria e nella gestione del progetto di complessi progetti CAPEX nell'area di GMP con un focus sull'ingegneria di processo/processo, sia nel campo marrone che nel campo verde.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. Cette vision conduit à nos innovations. Notre discipline d'ingénierie des procédés y contribue de façon significative en mettant en œuvre des projets d'investissement tels que des installations de production d'utilitaires propres et de BPF pour la production d'ingrédients actifs jusqu'à concurrence de trois millions de chiffres. Votre nouvelle équipe Avec 170 employés, Chapter Engineering RDG est responsable de la planification et de la mise en œuvre de tous les grands projets d'investissement sur les sites de Mannheim et Penzberg. Grâce à notre travail, nous assurons l'approvisionnement de nos patients en produits innovants. Nous sommes une unité avec des hiérarchies plates et attachons une grande importance à la responsabilité personnelle, une culture d'entreprise ouverte et le plaisir au travail. Le travail d'équipe, le soutien mutuel et les degrés de liberté dans l'élaboration de projets sont bien sûr une question pour nous. Chapitre Ingénierie RDG est responsable de la planification et de la réalisation de tous les grands projets d'investissement sur les sites de Mannheim et Penzberg. Responsabilité C'est ce qui vous attend. En tant qu'ingénieur principal de projet : en (m/f/d) - technologie de processus, vous renforcez notre équipe interdisciplinaire. Vous dirigez et gérez de grands projets CAPEX locaux et/ou mondiaux avec une grande complexité et prenez en charge les conseils de grandes équipes spécialisées. Vous serez responsable des usines de procédés d'ingénierie de processus de la première idée de projet au transfert avec un accent sur la production pharmaceutique. Ça va ? Ensuite, nous vous recherchons pour les tâches suivantes:
• Coordination et gestion du projet: Vous coordonnez l'équipe du projet à partir des opérations, des planificateurs (externes) et des fournisseurs pendant toute la durée des projets CAPEX avec une grande complexité. Cela va de la création de descriptions de services pour la planification et l'exécution, en passant par la mise en service et l'acceptation réussie de services externes.
• Responsabilité dans toutes les phases du projet : Vous êtes responsable de la création des concepts et documents techniques nécessaires, de la gestion des risques, de la création/examen des estimations de coûts et du suivi des progrès du sous-projet. Vous prenez toujours en compte le calendrier global, le budget, la portée et les exigences de qualité.
• Gestion des interfaces et conseil: Vous maintenez une coopération étroite avec les métiers concernés (par exemple, l'automatisation des processus, la qualification, SHE) et conseillez les partenaires commerciaux ainsi que les gestionnaires de projets: à l'intérieur et les collègues.
• Assurance des exigences et gestion du changement: Vous veillez au respect et à la mise en œuvre des exigences des utilisateurs (URB/URS) et évaluez les changements éventuels dans le cours du projet (gestion du changement) en ce qui concerne leur impact sur les coûts et les échéances.
• Innovation et optimisation des processus : Avec l'équipe, vous concevez, développez, améliorez et implémentez de nouvelles technologies, systèmes, outils, modèles et processus d'intérêt économique.
• Échange de connaissances et maintenance du réseau : Vous échangez des idées dans la communauté de l'ingénierie et créez activement un réseau d'experts. Qualités C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous
• Qualification : Vous avez réussi des études universitaires (p. ex. biotechnologie, génie chimique, génie mécanique, etc.)
• Expérience du projet : Vous apportez de nombreuses années d'expérience (> 5 ans) en ingénierie et en gestion de projets complexes CAPEX dans le domaine des BPF, en mettant l'accent sur l'ingénierie des processus et des procédés, tant dans les zones de friches industrielles que dans les zones de friches vertes.
• Expertise technique: Vous avez une connaissance approfondie i

jobs.title: Marketing Partner- IVD
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Marketing Partner

Role Purpose
As the Marketing Partner, you will be required to have deep understanding and
experience with In-Vitro Diagnostics Solutions and technology trends in the Healthcare industry. Heavily focused on strategic products marketing and identifying qualified opportunities for Roche Diagnostics product lines. Work closely with sales, healthcare consultants and technical product specialists to identify market opportunities, drive sales, and maintain relationships in key accounts.
You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.
In this role, you will
Laboratory Marketing

• Analyses the evolving market environment, develops the strategy such as customer segmentations, positioning, branding, messaging, PR/communications, pricing strategy and ensures effective rollout of strategy to the marketplace.

• Assist in the development of a yearly Marketing Plan which outlines marketing

• strategies and initiatives for the products responsible.

• Laboratory KOL management and development.

• Strategic partnership with 3rd party vendors and medical associations.

Product Management

• Portfolio Management including inventory and product lifecycle management of instrument and reagents.

• Support in product quality issues and implementation.

• Support in the planning and execution of marketing activities

- Product campaigns/promotions
- Exhibition booth
- Digital marketing initiatives

• Product Training and development of selling aids and value stories.

• Provide 2nd line technical/application support e.g. evaluations, projects, troubleshooting.

• Support field force with Customer presentation/CMEs, Market intelligence, Formulation of sales arguments, Product information updates

Market Access

• Assist in the development and implementation of business strategies to achieve profitable relationships and identify potential opportunities with major accounts across the Business Area.

• Cross BA selling as One Roche approach.

Market Intelligence and Trends

• Continuously collect and analyse relevant market and competitor information and trends to assess market position and long term opportunities, translate into actionable information and shape the market.

• Feedback market trends and needs to the relevant internal stakeholders.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.
Who you are
You are someone who are/have:

• Strong organizational, communication and interpersonal skills

• Good analytical, problem solving, creative thinking and time management skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and strong business acumen together with the ability to manage ambiguity and drive for results

• Ability to perform under pressure while juggling multiple tasks

• An independent and a team player, has positive attitude and a willingness to learn

• Ability to adhere to deadlines and work in a team

• Resourceful, detail-oriented, proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast paced environment

Qualification and Experience

• More than 4 years of experience designing and delivering healthcare solutions

• Passion for the healthcare industry –good understanding of how the healthcare industry operates and the unique characteristics of the industry ecosyst

Fortemente focalizzato sul marketing strategico dei prodotti e l'individuazione di opportunità qualificate per le linee di prodotti Roche Diagnostics. Lavorare a stretto contatto con le vendite, i consulenti sanitari e gli specialisti dei prodotti tecnici per identificare le opportunità di mercato, guidare le vendite e mantenere le relazioni nei conti chiave. Lei dimostra lo scopo personale intorno a migliorare l'ecosistema sanitario pensando da un livello di impresa, al di là dei confini e dei confini, per portare i migliori risultati possibili all'ambiente di salute; la creazione di migliori risultati di salute per più pazienti più veloce, e portando una forte mentalità imprenditoriale con capacità di partner eccezionali. In questo ruolo, lo farai Marketing del laboratorio
• Analizza l'ambiente di mercato in evoluzione, sviluppa la strategia come segmentazioni dei clienti, posizionamento, branding, messaggistica, PR/comunicazioni, strategia dei prezzi e assicura un efficace rollout della strategia al mercato.
• Assistere nello sviluppo di un Piano di Marketing annuale che delinea il marketing
• strategie e iniziative per i prodotti responsabili.
• Gestione e sviluppo del laboratorio KOL.
• Partenariato strategico con fornitori di terze parti e associazioni mediche. Gestione dei prodotti
• Gestione Portfolio tra cui inventario e gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto di strumenti e reagenti.
• Sostegno ai problemi di qualità del prodotto e implementazione.
• Sostegno alla pianificazione e all'esecuzione delle attività di marketing - Campagne/promozioni del prodotto - Stand espositivi - Iniziative di marketing digitale
• Formazione del prodotto e sviluppo di aiuti di vendita e storie di valore.
• Fornire supporto tecnico/applicazione di seconda linea, ad esempio valutazioni, progetti, risoluzione dei problemi.
• Supporta la forza di campo con la presentazione del cliente/CME, l'intelligenza di mercato, la formulazione di argomenti di vendita, aggiornamenti di informazioni sul prodotto Accesso al mercato
• Assistere nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di business per raggiungere relazioni vantaggiose e identificare le potenziali opportunità con i principali account in tutto l'Area Business.
• Cross BA che vende come approccio One Roche. Intelligenza e tendenze del mercato
• Raccogliere e analizzare costantemente le informazioni e le tendenze rilevanti del mercato e dei concorrenti per valutare la posizione del mercato e le opportunità a lungo termine, tradurre in informazioni attuabili e modellare il mercato.
• Tendenze del mercato del feedback e necessità per le parti interessate interne rilevanti. Eventuali altri compiti o progetti assegnati di volta in volta. Chi sei Sei qualcuno che è/ha:
• Forte capacità organizzative, comunicative e interpersonali
• Buone capacità analitiche, problem solving, pensiero creativo e gestione del tempo.
• Mindset imprenditoriale e forte acume aziendale insieme alla capacità di gestire l'ambiguità e guidare per i risultati
• Capacità di eseguire sotto pressione durante il gioco di più attività
• Un giocatore indipendente e di squadra, ha un atteggiamento positivo e una volontà di imparare
• Capacità di rispettare le scadenze e lavorare in un team
• Risorsa, dettagliata, comprovata capacità di soddisfare le scadenze in un ambiente veloce Qualificazione ed esperienza
• Oltre 4 anni di esperienza nella progettazione e fornitura di soluzioni sanitarie
• Passione per l'industria sanitaria – buona comprensione di come l'industria sanitaria opera e le caratteristiche uniche dell'ecosyst del settore

jobs.title: MD Clinical Fellow
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Clinical Fellowship in Product Development Oncology/Haematology (PDOH)
Summary

This Roche Clinical Fellowship is aimed at medically qualified individuals with a specific interest in haematology or oncology, either before or immediately post specialist training.
Established in 2013, the program was designed to diversify and broaden clinical training through exposure to clinical research methodology from the pharmaceutical medicine perspective. The fellowship will be 1 year in duration, primarily based at Roche Products Ltd in Welwyn Garden City, UK. The position is within the Clinical Development Group, which is responsible for the strategy, design and execution of late phase clinical trials in oncology, haemato-oncology and non-malignant haematology disease areas. Every attempt will be made to accommodate your specific areas of interest and expertise, but available projects will likely need to be determined by the development timelines of each disease area programme There will be the opportunity for direct interaction across Roche/Genentech. There may be opportunities to attend scientific conferences, depending on the project and programme. Your supervisor will be an experienced member of the Clinical Development Group working in Welwyn. In addition, you will be assigned a mentor who is a UK accredited Physician. If successful, you need to be available to start the role before the end of this year.

There is 1 MD Fellow position in:-

• Oncology/Haematology (PDOH), which incorporates the following areas of specialty:
• Oncology

• Haemato-oncology (lymphoid and myeloid)

• Non-malignant haematology (haemophilia and allied bleeding disorders, gene therapy, thrombosis)

As a Fellow in the Global Clinical Development Group you may:

• Be involved in the design, execution, data review, analysis and interpretation of data from clinical studies for molecules in development as well as marketed compounds.

• Interact with globally recognised academic experts and clinical investigators

• Participate in key clinical strategy, implementation and molecule management meetings in order to gain a deeper understanding of the complexities and challenges of the development of medicines

• Provide clinical expertise in the disease area for cross functional pharmaceutical development teams

• Contribute to the generation of abstracts and oral presentations for key external conferences and other specialty meetings as well as publication opportunities.

• Be involved in discussions and initiatives around Personalised Health Care (PHC) and patient selection for different therapeutic interventions

Who is the Roche Clinical Research Fellowship suitable for?
Essential Criteria:

• GMC Registration: Must hold active registration with the General Medical Council (GMC) at the time of application.

• Clinical Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of direct clinical experience post-qualification.

• Specialty Experience: Proven experience working within haematology or oncology settings.

• An individual looking to diversify their training. While some previous clinical research experience is preferred, it is not essential.

• An individual interested in further understanding and influencing the development and approval of medicines for patients within the specific disease area. Note: this is not intended to be a basic science fellowship leading to a post graduate degree, although the clinical research could supplement or inform existing basic research if appropriate.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Fellowship clinica in Oncologia dello sviluppo del prodotto/Haematology (PDOH) Sintesi Questo Roche Clinical Fellowship è rivolto a persone medicalmente qualificate con un interesse specifico per l'ematologia o l'oncologia, prima o immediatamente post formazione specialistica. Fondato nel 2013, il programma è stato progettato per diversificare e ampliare la formazione clinica attraverso l'esposizione alla metodologia di ricerca clinica dalla prospettiva della medicina farmaceutica. La borsa sarà di 1 anno di durata, principalmente con sede a Roche Products Ltd a Welwyn Garden City, Regno Unito. La posizione è all'interno del Gruppo di Sviluppo Clinico, che è responsabile della strategia, progettazione ed esecuzione di studi clinici di fase avanzata in oncologia, emato-oncologia e aree non maligne di ematologia. Ogni tentativo sarà fatto per soddisfare le vostre specifiche aree di interesse e di competenza, ma i progetti disponibili probabilmente dovranno essere determinati dai tempi di sviluppo di ogni programma di area malattia Ci sarà l'opportunità di interazione diretta tra Roche/Genentech. Ci possono essere opportunità di partecipare a conferenze scientifiche, a seconda del progetto e del programma. Il vostro supervisore sarà un membro esperto del gruppo di sviluppo clinico che lavora a Welwyn. Inoltre, vi verrà assegnato un mentore che è un medico accreditato nel Regno Unito. In caso di successo, è necessario essere disponibili per iniziare il ruolo prima della fine di quest'anno. C'è 1 MD Fellow posizione in:-
• Oncologia/Haematologia (PDOH), che incorpora le seguenti aree di specialità:
• Oncologia
• Emato-oncologia (limphoide e mieloide)
• Ematologia non maligna (emofilia e disturbi sanguinanti alleati, terapia genica, trombosi) Come Fellow nel Global Clinical Development Group puoi:
• Essere coinvolti nella progettazione, esecuzione, recensione dei dati, analisi e interpretazione dei dati da studi clinici per molecole in sviluppo e composti commercializzati.
• Interagire con esperti accademici riconosciuti a livello globale e ricercatori clinici
• Partecipa a importanti incontri di strategia clinica, implementazione e gestione delle molecole al fine di ottenere una comprensione più approfondita delle complessità e delle sfide dello sviluppo dei farmaci
• Fornire competenze cliniche nell'area della malattia per i team di sviluppo farmaceutico funzionale
• Contribuire alla generazione di astratti e presentazioni orali per conferenze esterne chiave e altre riunioni di specialità e opportunità di pubblicazione.
• Essere coinvolti in discussioni e iniziative inerenti la Personalised Health Care (PHC) e la selezione dei pazienti per diversi interventi terapeutici Chi è il Roche Clinical Research Fellowship adatto per? Criteri essenziali:
• GMC Registrazione: deve tenere la registrazione attiva con il Consiglio medico generale (GMC) al momento della domanda.
• Esperienza clinica: un minimo di 3+ anni di esperienza clinica diretta post-qualifica.
• Esperienza di specializzazione: Esperienza comprovata che lavora all'interno delle impostazioni di ematologia o oncologia.
• Un individuo che cerca di diversificare la propria formazione. Mentre alcune precedenti esperienze di ricerca clinica è preferito, non è essenziale.
• Un individuo interessato a comprendere e influenzare ulteriormente lo sviluppo e l'approvazione dei farmaci per i pazienti all'interno dell'area malattia specifica. Nota: questo non è destinato ad essere una borsa di studio di base che porta a un diploma post-laurea, anche se la ricerca clinica potrebbe integrare o informare la ricerca di base esistente se necessario.

• Onkologie
• Hämatoonkologie (Lymphoid und Myeloid)
• Nichtmaligne Hämatologie (Hämophilie und verwandte Blutungsstörungen, Gentherapie, Thrombose) Als Fellow in der Global Clinical Development Group können Sie:
