Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Bourse de recherche clinique en oncologie/hématologie (PDOH) Résumé Cette bourse clinique Roche s'adresse aux personnes médicalement qualifiées qui s'intéressent particulièrement à l'hématologie ou à l'oncologie, avant ou immédiatement après une formation spécialisée. Créé en 2013, le programme a été conçu pour diversifier et élargir la formation clinique par l'exposition aux méthodes de recherche clinique du point de vue de la médecine pharmaceutique. La bourse durera un an, principalement chez Roche Products Ltd, à Welwyn Garden City, au Royaume-Uni. Le poste fait partie du Groupe de développement clinique, qui est responsable de la stratégie, de la conception et de l'exécution des essais cliniques en phase tardive en oncologie, en hémato-oncologie et dans les zones de maladies hématologiques non malignes. Tout sera fait pour répondre à vos besoins et à vos compétences, mais les projets disponibles devront probablement être déterminés en fonction des délais d'élaboration de chaque programme. Il y aura la possibilité d'une interaction directe entre Roche et Genentech. Il peut y avoir des occasions d'assister à des conférences scientifiques, selon le projet et le programme. Votre superviseur sera un membre expérimenté du Groupe de développement clinique travaillant à Welwyn. De plus, un mentor accrédité au Royaume-Uni vous sera assigné. Si vous réussissez, vous devez être disponible pour commencer le rôle avant la fin de cette année. Il y a 1 MD Fellow en :-
• Oncologie/hématologie (PDOH), qui comprend les domaines de spécialité suivants:
• Oncologie
• Hémato-oncologie (lymphoïde et myéloïde)
• Hématologie non maligne (hémophilie et troubles hémorragiques connexes, thérapie génique, thrombose) En tant que Fellow du Groupe mondial de développement clinique, vous pouvez :
• Participer à la conception, à l'exécution, à l'examen, à l'analyse et à l'interprétation des données issues des études cliniques sur les molécules en développement et les composés commercialisés.
• Interagir avec des experts universitaires et des chercheurs cliniques mondialement reconnus
• Participer à des réunions clés sur la stratégie clinique, la mise en oeuvre et la gestion des molécules afin de mieux comprendre la complexité et les défis du développement des médicaments
• Fournir une expertise clinique dans le domaine de la maladie aux équipes de développement pharmaceutique interfonctionnel
• Contribuer à la production de résumés et de présentations orales pour des conférences externes clés et d'autres réunions spécialisées ainsi que des occasions de publication.
• Participer aux discussions et aux initiatives concernant les soins de santé personnalisés (SSP) et la sélection des patients pour différentes interventions thérapeutiques Pour qui la bourse de recherche clinique Roche convient-elle? Critères essentiels :
• Enregistrement GMC : Doit être inscrit activement auprès du Conseil médical général (CGM) au moment de la demande.
• Expérience clinique : Un minimum de 3 ans et plus d'expérience clinique directe après la qualification.
• Expérience de spécialité: Expérience éprouvée de travail dans des contextes d'hématologie ou d'oncologie.
• Une personne cherchant à diversifier sa formation. Bien que certaines expériences cliniques antérieures soient préférées, elles ne sont pas essentielles.
• Une personne intéressée à mieux comprendre et influencer le développement et l'approbation de médicaments pour les patients dans la zone de maladie spécifique. Remarque : il ne s'agit pas d'une bourse de sciences fondamentales menant à un diplôme d'études supérieures, bien que la recherche clinique puisse compléter ou informer la recherche fondamentale existante, le cas échéant.
• Les candidats doivent présenter une demande d'admission.

The Position
As an Intern in Roche Pharma Malaysia, you may be assigned to a variety of tasks and/or projects relevant for the assigned team/function.

The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organization, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance.

Assignments will vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modeling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc.

For assignments in Digital Marketing, key responsibilities of an intern may include but not limited to the following (with appropriate guidance from experienced colleagues):

• Collaborating closely with field-facing and office-based colleagues to understand customer/patient/healthcare ecosystem needs as well as Roche strategies and products in the assigned disease area

• Adapting materials/assets/content from global or other countries to local context and needs

• Creating new materials/assets/content

• Support planning, project management and implementation for (digital) marketing campaigns,

• Support development of content/channel strategies and tactics​

Education & Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a degree in a Medical, Scientific, or Biotechnology-related field (e.g., Science, Medical, Biotechnology).

• Collaborer étroitement avec des collègues sur le terrain et des collègues de bureau pour comprendre les besoins des clients, des patients et des écosystèmes de soins de santé ainsi que les stratégies et les produits Roche dans la région désignée
• Adapter les matériaux/actifs/contenus du monde entier ou d'autres pays au contexte et aux besoins locaux
• Création de nouveaux matériaux/actifs/contenu
• soutenir la planification, la gestion de projet et la mise en œuvre de campagnes de marketing (numériques),
• Appuyer l'élaboration de stratégies et de tactiques de contenu/canal Éducation et qualifications :
• Il est actuellement titulaire d'un diplôme dans un domaine lié à la médecine, à la science ou à la biotechnologie (p. ex. sciences, médecine, biotechnologie).
• Familiariser avec Canva et démontrer la capacité d'apprendre rapidement et de s'adapter aux nouveaux outils numériques. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

I nostri servizi riguardano la gestione finanziaria, la chiusura di fine periodo, la contabilità di capitale e di locazione, il credito e i crediti, la finanza di produzione e la rendicontazione divisionale, assicurando la conformità per 263 entità di reporting in 96 paesi con gli standard contabili (IFRS, GAAP) e fornendo garanzia di integrità finanziaria. L'opportunità In qualità di Senior Financial Accountant effettuerai attività quotidiane e di chiusura in collaborazione con dipartimenti interfunzionali, secondo scadenze predefinite con piena proprietà dei loro compiti e nel rispetto delle Documentazioni di Processo del rispettivo sottoprocesso aziendale. • Calcolo e emissione di fatture manuali AR
• Definizione e calcolo dei costi e delle entrate nel controllo
• Condurre la chiusura del prodotto nel modulo Gestione dei Materiali di SAP
• Esecuzione di chiusura e reporting mensile per il consolidamento e per le divisioni

Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avete: Laurea universitaria, preferibilmente in Finanza / Contabilità disciplina relativa
• 2-4 anni di esperienza in una posizione rilevante
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità analitiche
• Ottimi orientamenti e messa a fuoco dei servizi
• Forte abilità interpersonali e atteggiamento del giocatore di squadra
• Proficienza in inglese In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto concentrata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Chi siamo

Roche Pharma AG a Grenzach è una delle aziende farmaceutiche leader e sta ora cercando uno stagista motivato (m/f/d) per supportare il nostro team Site Services nei settori Fleet & Mobility. Con questo stage ti offriamo l'opportunità di acquisire una preziosa esperienza nella conversione della nostra flotta aziendale alla mobilità elettrica, nonché nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di concetti di mobilità per la nostra sede e i nostri dipendenti.

I tuoi compiti principali

- Supporto nell'implementazione di una Fleet Management Company (FMC), coordinamento efficiente e documentazione degli appuntamenti di coordinamento regolari con i fornitori per garantire un flusso regolare di informazioni
- Collaborazione alla creazione di concetti di mobilità per il luogo, tenendo conto della sostenibilità, dell'efficienza e dell'ottimizzazione dei costi (ad es. stazioni di ricarica, bici da lavoro, veicolo UVV, test della patente di guida, ecc.)
- Analisi dei dati sulla mobilità e sviluppo di soluzioni per migliorare la mobilità dei dipendenti
- Partecipazione attiva a progetti per migliorare i processi di flotta, mobilità e viaggio
- Supporto amministrativo per il team, oltre a contribuire a progettare e sviluppare una struttura di archiviazione sostenibile per una gestione coerente della conoscenza

Chi sei

- Studi avanzati nei settori dell'amministrazione aziendale, della gestione dei progetti, dell'informatica aziendale, della gestione della mobilità o di un campo correlato
- Interesse per l'elettromobilità e la mobilità sostenibile
- Pensiero analitico e capacità di comprendere relazioni complesse e sviluppare soluzioni
- Buone capacità comunicative e spirito di squadra
- Iniziativa, indipendenza e un modo strutturato di lavorare
- Buona conoscenza degli applicativi MS Office e Google
- Buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese parlata e scritta

Ti offriamo l'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo in cui puoi contribuire e realizzare le tue idee. Sarai supportato da esperti esperti e acquisirai informazioni sugli ultimi sviluppi nel campo dell'elettromobilità e delle soluzioni di mobilità sostenibile.

Cosa ti offriamo

- Pianificazione flessibile
- Stipendio mensile di € 2268 per uno stage a tempo pieno
- Prezzi ridotti (-50%) nella nostra mensa

La tua candidatura

Ti invitiamo a caricare il tuo CV solo on-line.

Si ricorda che il presente tirocinio è rivolto esclusivamente agli studenti (m/f/d) attualmente iscritti durante l'intero periodo del tirocinio o, in alternativa, a persone che si trovano in un gap year massimo di un anno (tra studi Bachelor e Master), dove sia comprovabile per iscritto presso quale università/college ed esattamente quando (mese/anno) nell'arco di un anno si proseguiranno gli studi.

Periodo: dal 1 luglio 2026 per un periodo di 6 mesi.

Si ricorda che sono escluse le segnalazioni per tutte le attività svolte dagli studenti (es. tirocini, tesi, ecc.).

Aspettiamo con ansia la tua candidatura!

contatto

Il tuo contatto con noi! Con le persone. Per le persone.
Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto?
Dai un'occhiata alle nostre domande frequenti, le troverai tramite https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si impegnano a far progredire la scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato al trattamento di oltre 26 milioni di persone

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist as part of the Global Customer Experience (GCX) department will maintain and support the daily activities of the Travel and Entertainment associated with Roche. This role is expected to offer a high level of customer service as this is the first point of contact for our internal customers.

As a team member of Roche Services Solutions - Global Customer Experience Department you will be responsible for providing customer service support to Roche affiliates in relations to the Travel & Expense Application (SAP Concur). You will follow the instructions in the timely manner of the Cluster Section Lead and key contacts regarding the daily work coordination. You will contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche Services Solutions.

The Opportunity:

• Deliver Exceptional Customer Support – Serve as the first point of contact for Travel & Expense (SAP Concur) inquiries via phone, live chat, and ServiceNow, providing timely, accurate, and customer-focused support.

• Manage Travel & Expense Operations – Perform day-to-day administration of the SAP Concur system, resolve user issues, process access requests, and ensure service delivery meets established SLAs and KPIs.

• Drive Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement – Investigate and resolve first-level system issues, maintain accurate documentation, monitor system performance, and identify opportunities to enhance processes and user experience.

• Collaborate Across Global Teams – Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including T&E Compliance and Concur Technical Support, to ensure efficient issue resolution and seamless service delivery.

• Support Business Excellence – Deliver end-user training, prepare operational reports, contribute to knowledge management, and actively participate in new initiatives to improve Travel & Expense services and operations.

Who you are:

• You hold a college or University degree in finance, informatics, business administration or economics subject is desirable

• 1-3 years of related experience in T&E System Support

• Communicate effectively both verbally and written in English and Mandarin (to support China counterpart). Additional language skills is a plus.

• Demonstrate strong customer service skills including timeliness, and follow-ups

• Collaborative and team-oriented; you have the ability to work with cross functional team with different cultures

• Familiar with ticketing tools - ServiceNow, good numerical and analytical skills with a strong attention to details

• React to problems fast and easy and in an appropriate manner and behavior

• Ability to work in a fast paced environment

• Experience and knowledge of expense reporting software, preferably Concur and in Shared Service or Customer Service Centre in a support function is a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist nell'ambito del dipartimento Global Customer Experience (GCX) manterrà e sosterrà le attività quotidiane del Travel and Entertainment associate a Roche. Questo ruolo è previsto per offrire un alto livello di servizio al cliente in quanto questo è il primo punto di contatto per i nostri clienti interni. In qualità di membro del team di Roche Services Solutions - Global Customer Experience Department sarai responsabile di fornire assistenza clienti agli affiliati Roche nelle relazioni con l'applicazione Travel & Expense (SAP Concur). Seguirete le istruzioni nel modo tempestivo della sezione del cluster Lead e i contatti chiave per quanto riguarda il coordinamento quotidiano del lavoro. Contribuirai continuamente al miglioramento delle prestazioni di Roche Services Solutions. L'opportunità:
• Fornire il supporto clienti eccezionale – Servire come primo punto di contatto per le richieste di viaggio e spesa (SAP Concur) via telefono, chat dal vivo e ServiceNow, fornendo il supporto tempestivo, preciso e orientato al cliente.
• Gestisci le operazioni di viaggio e di spesa – Eseguire l'amministrazione quotidiana del sistema SAP Concur, risolvere i problemi dell'utente, le richieste di accesso ai processi e garantire la consegna dei servizi soddisfa le SLA e i KPI consolidati.
• Risoluzione dei problemi di trasmissione e miglioramento continuo – Indagare e risolvere problemi di sistema di primo livello, mantenere la documentazione accurata, monitorare le prestazioni del sistema e identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi e l'esperienza degli utenti.
• Collaborate Across Global Teams – Collaborate a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali, tra cui T&E Compliance e Concur Technical Support, per garantire una risoluzione efficiente dei problemi e una consegna senza interruzioni dei servizi.
• Support Business Excellence – Offrire formazione agli utenti finali, preparare report operativi, contribuire alla gestione della conoscenza e partecipare attivamente a nuove iniziative per migliorare i servizi e le operazioni di Travel & Expense. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in finanza, informatica, amministrazione aziendale o soggetto economico è auspicabile
• 1-3 anni di esperienza in T&E System Support
• Comunicare efficacemente sia verbalmente che scritto in inglese e mandarino (per sostenere la controparte cinese). Ulteriori competenze linguistiche è un plus.
• Dimostrare forti competenze di servizio al cliente tra cui tempestività, e follow-up
• Collaborativo e orientato al team; si ha la capacità di lavorare con team cross funzionale con culture diverse
• Familiare con strumenti di biglietteria - ServiceNow, buone capacità numeriche e analitiche con una forte attenzione ai dettagli
• Reagire a problemi veloci e facili e in modo appropriato e comportamento
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce
• Esperienza e conoscenza del software di reporting delle spese, preferibilmente Concur e in Servizio condiviso o Centro assistenza clienti in una funzione di supporto è un plus Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv sowohl mündlich als auch in Englisch und Mandarin (um das chinesische Pendant zu unterstützen). Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
• Demonstrieren Sie starke Kundenservice-Fähigkeiten einschließlich Aktualität und Follow-ups
• Kollaborativ und teamorientiert; Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams mit verschiedenen Kulturen zu arbeiten
• Vertraut mit Ticketing-Tools - ServiceNow, gute numerische und analytische Fähigkeiten mit großer Aufmerksamkeit für Details

• Erfahrung und Kenntnis der Spesenabrechnungssoftware, vorzugsweise Concur und in Shared Service oder Customer Service Center in einer Supportfunktion ist ein Plus Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. jobs.title: Sr Trade Compliance Analyst (Import/Export)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Opportunity:

• Manage and monitor the company's compliance with global trade regulations, including but not limited to export controls, customs regulations, sanctions, and embargoes

• Stay updated on relevant trade compliance laws and regulations, and provide guidance to internal stakeholders on compliance requirements

• Conduct audits and assessments to identify areas of risk and develop strategies to mitigate potential compliance issues

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop, implement and improve trade compliance policies and procedures

• Oversee the classification of products by ensuring accurate tariff codes, export controls, and partner government agencies (PGA) information.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on trade compliance, providing training and guidance to employees across the organization

• Handle import and export licensing processes, including applications, renewals, and record keeping

• Effectively communicate with external partners, such as customs brokers, freight forwarders, and regulatory agencies, to ensure smooth and compliant movement of goods

• Monitor and investigate potential violations of trade compliance regulations, and assist in implementing corrective actions

Who You Are:

• BS or BA degree and at least 5 years in an import/export position or 3 years with Masters.

Knowledge/Skills & Abilities:

• Knowledge of global trade regulations, including export controls, customs regulations, and sanctions

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to steer the long-term category roadmap and command the high-value supplier ecosystems that drive our global Instrument development projects? As our Global Category Manager for Engineering Services based out of Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this complex, high-value category. In this role, you will manage major engineering consultancies, technical suppliers, and service networks to ensure maximum value delivery across global business sites.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category,, Procurement Center of Excellence, R&D and other global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders in R&D.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, particularly in R&D, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of the global instruments development (SW development and HW engineering) markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operat

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a guidare la roadmap di categoria a lungo termine e a comandare gli ecosistemi fornitori ad alto valore che guidano i nostri progetti globali di sviluppo degli strumenti? Come nostro Global Categoria Manager per i Servizi di Ingegneria con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, si terrà la massima responsabilità per lo sviluppo di strategie e principali iniziative strategiche per questa categoria complessa e di alto valore. In questo ruolo, gestirete importanti consulenze ingegneristiche, fornitori tecnici e reti di servizi per garantire il massimo valore di consegna nei siti aziendali globali.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente al Global Categoria Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Engages direttamente con team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Categoria,, Centro di Eccellenza, R&D e altri partner commerciali globali. Serve come punto di contatto chiave del partner commerciale per gli stakeholder senior funzionali e aziendali in R&D.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale con la posizione di leadership di categoria globale focalizzata sulla visione strategica, lo sviluppo di categoria, la costruzione di pipeline e la gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione
• Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, dati dei fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare un pipeline di strategia e iniziativa di categoria formalizzata e globale, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione.
• Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici all'interno della categoria.
• Ecosistemi del fornitore: Gestire fornitori globali chiave, stabilire programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitorare obiettivi di valore e gestire i rischi dei fornitori.
• Orientamento e contenuto: Sviluppare e mantenere i documenti di orientamento della categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per l'approvvigionamento di colleghi e utenti aziendali.
• Business Partnering: Costruire relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder senior, in particolare in R&D, sfidando la domanda/specificazioni per massimizzare il valore e gestire le recensioni di rischio/CSR.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching colleghi di approvvigionamento, fornendo lo sviluppo professionale, la gestione di un Associate Categoria Manager condiviso all'interno del team, e il monitoraggio della spesa di bilancio. Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali di sviluppo degli strumenti (SW development and HW engineering) e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die langfristige Kategorie-Roadmap zu steuern und die hochwertigen Lieferanten-Ökosysteme zu beherrschen, die unsere globalen Instrument-Entwicklungsprojekte vorantreiben? Als Global Category Manager für Engineering Services mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, übernehmen Sie die ultimative Verantwortung für die Entwicklung von Strategien und strategischen Initiativen für diese komplexe, hochwertige Kategorie. In dieser Funktion verwalten Sie wichtige Ingenieurberatungen, technische Lieferanten und Servicenetzwerke, um eine maximale Wertschöpfung an globalen Geschäftsstandorten zu gewährleisten.
• Reporting Line: Direkt an die Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT innerhalb der Kategorieorganisation berichtet.
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Engagiert direkt mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, die sich aus Vertretern der Kategorie, des Procurement Center of Excellence, der F & E und anderer globaler Geschäftspartner zusammensetzen. Funktioniert als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Geschäftspartner für leitende funktionale und geschäftliche Stakeholder in Forschung und Entwicklung.
• Rollentyp: Rolle eines einzelnen Mitwirkenden mit globaler Führungsposition in den Bereichen strategische Vision, Kategorieentwicklung, Pipelineaufbau und Beziehungs-Ökosystemmanagement
• Auswirkungen: Sie erzielen kommerzielle Auswirkungen, indem Sie Kosten verankern und eine Resilienz-Pipeline von Projekten entwickeln, zusätzlich zur Sicherung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Strategie & Jahrespipeline: Zusammenstellung von Marktinformationen, Lieferantendaten und Geschäftsanforderungen, um eine formalisierte, globale Kategoriestrategie und Initiativespipeline zu formulieren, die an Führungskräften im gesamten Unternehmen ausgerichtet ist.
• Kommerzielle Verhandlungen: Führen von hochwertigen kommerziellen und vertraglichen Verhandlungen für strategische Lieferanten innerhalb der Kategorie.
• Lieferanten-Ökosysteme: Management wichtiger globaler Lieferanten, Einrichtung von Entwicklungs- und Innovationsprogrammen, Überwachung von Wertzielen und Management von Lieferantenrisiken.
• Anleitung & Inhalt: Entwicklung und Pflege von Category Guidance-Dokumenten, um die Strategie in klare, ausführbare Inhalte für Beschaffungskollegen und Geschäftsanwender zu übersetzen.
• Business Partnering: Aufbau enger Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern, insbesondere in der Forschung und Entwicklung, Herausforderung der Nachfrage/Spezifikationen zur Wertmaximierung und Verwaltung von Risiko-/CSR-Bewertungen.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching von Beschaffungskollegen, Bereitstellung professioneller Entwicklung, Verwaltung eines gemeinsamen Associate Category Managers innerhalb des Teams und Verfolgung von Budgetausgaben. Wer du bist Wir suchen strategische Beschaffungs-Champions mit umfassenden Kenntnissen der globalen Instrumentenentwicklung (SW-Entwicklung und HW-Engineering) Märkte und der Matrix-Führungskompetenzen, die erforderlich sind, um komplexe organisatorische Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Ausbildung: Universitätsabschluss erforderlich (Business oder Life Sciences Schwerpunkt bevorzugt); eine Post-Graduate Business-bezogene Qualifikation wird bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre vertiefte Strategie und Oper

De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. En tant que Global Category Manager pour les services d'ingénierie basés à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous aurez la responsabilité ultime de développer des stratégies et de diriger des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie complexe et de grande valeur. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez les principaux cabinets de conseil en ingénierie, fournisseurs techniques et réseaux de services afin d'assurer une prestation de valeur maximale sur les sites d'affaires mondiaux.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de la catégorie mondiale Capex/Services d'ingénierie/TI au sein de l'organisation de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : S'engage directement auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement, de R-D et d'autres partenaires commerciaux mondiaux. Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux en R-D.
• Type de rôle : Un intervenant individuel avec un poste de leadership de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, le développement de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur les marchés, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles afin de formuler un pipeline officiel de la Stratégie et de l'initiative de catégorie mondiale, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.
• Écosystèmes fournisseurs : gérer les principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établir des programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveiller les cibles de valeur et gérer les risques pour les fournisseurs.
• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues et les utilisateurs commerciaux.
• Partenariats d'affaires : Établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants supérieurs, en particulier en R-D, mettre la demande et les particularités au défi pour maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RSC.
• Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Encadrer les collègues en approvisionnement, assurer le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des champions stratégiques de l'approvisionnement possédant une connaissance approfondie des marchés mondiaux du développement d'instruments (développement de SW et ingénierie de HW) et des compétences de leadership matriciel nécessaires pour stimuler un changement organisationnel complexe.
• Études : Diplôme universitaire requis (priorité de l'accent sur les affaires ou les sciences de la vie); une qualification liée aux affaires de troisième cycle est préférée.
• Expérience : 5 ans et plus de stratégie et d'opéra en profondeur

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to spearhead the long-term category roadmap and command our high-value IT supplier landscape that drives the functioning of our Diagnostics Instruments? As our Global Category Manager for IT Software & Hardware in Sant Cugat, Spain (or in Indianapolis, U.S.), you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this rapidly evolving spend category. In this role, you will manage tier-one global technology providers, negotiate complex commercial frameworks, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global IT Hardware and off-the-shelf software supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operational procu

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a testare la roadmap di categoria a lungo termine e comandare il nostro paesaggio di fornitori IT ad alto valore che guida il funzionamento dei nostri strumenti diagnostici? Come nostro Global Categoria Manager per IT Software & Hardware a Sant Cugat, Spagna (o negli Stati Uniti), si terrà la massima responsabilità per lo sviluppo di strategie e le principali iniziative strategiche per questa categoria di spesa in rapida evoluzione. In questo ruolo, si gestirà tier-one fornitori di tecnologia globale, negoziare complessi framework commerciali, e tradurre gli obiettivi di categoria nella creazione di valore di linea inferiore.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente al Global Categoria Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Engages direttamente con team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Categoria, Consegna, Centro di Eccellenza e partner commerciali globali. Serve come punto di contatto chiave del partner commerciale per gli stakeholder senior funzionali e aziendali.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale con la posizione di leadership di categoria globale focalizzata sulla visione strategica, lo sviluppo di categoria, la costruzione di pipeline e la gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione
• Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, dati dei fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare un pipeline di strategia e iniziativa di categoria formalizzata e globale, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione.
• Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici all'interno della categoria.
• Ecosistemi del fornitore: Gestire fornitori globali chiave, stabilire programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitorare obiettivi di valore e gestire i rischi dei fornitori.
• Orientamento e contenuto: Sviluppare e mantenere i documenti di orientamento della categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per l'approvvigionamento di colleghi e utenti aziendali.
• Business Partnering: Costruire relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder senior, sfidare la domanda / specifiche per massimizzare il valore, e gestire le recensioni di rischio / CSR.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching colleghi di approvvigionamento, fornendo lo sviluppo professionale, la gestione di un Associate Categoria Manager condiviso all'interno del team, e il monitoraggio della spesa di bilancio. Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali dell'hardware IT e dell'offerta software off-the-shelf e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

jobs.title: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist , you will be responsible for acting as the strategic bridge between regulatory science and technology, driving digital transformation within the PDR organization. In this role, you will design, develop, and implement intelligent automation and generative AI solutions, eliminating repetitive tasks and optimizing operational processes to bring efficiency and agility to a global community of over 500 regulatory professionals.

The Opportunity

• Design, develop, and deploy scalable automation solutions (such as RPA, Python scripts, UiPath workflows, or No-Code/Low-Code tools) to optimize global regulatory processes.

• Research, experiment with, and implement applications based on Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, and natural language processing (NLP) tailored to regulatory document management.

• Partner closely with business analysts, regulatory subject matter experts, and global leaders to map current operational processes and identify critical automation opportunities.

• Provide ongoing technical support, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting for automation and AI solutions already deployed in production.

• Author and maintain rigorous technical documentation, including solution architecture, source code, user guides, and testing methodologies.

• Design and deliver internal training programs to empower regulatory teams in the adoption and effective use of AI and automation technologies.

• Present performance metrics, project updates, and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and organizational leadership (with a scope of influence aligned to the experience level).

Who you are

• University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Health Sciences with a strong technological focus, or a related field.

• Proven experience in designing and developing process automation (RPA) solutions, workflows, and implementing AI tools (minimum 2–3 years for a Junior profile; 4+ years for a Senior profile).

• Solid technical and programming skills in languages such as Python, SQL, and automation environments (UiPath, Power Automate, or Cloud platforms), along with familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Agile).

• Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks and industry registration procedures is highly valued.

• Fluent and advanced English language skills (both written and spoken) to effectively interact, influence, and present findings to global teams across multiple time zones.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, a system-thinking mindset, resilience, and a strong passion for innovation focused on radically simplifying business processes.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist , you will be responsible for acting as the strategic bridge between regulatory science and technology, driving digital transformation within the PDR organization. In this role, you will design, develop, and implement intelligent automation and generative AI solutions, eliminating repetitive tasks and optimizing operational processes to bring efficiency and agility to a global community of over 500 regulatory professionals.

The Opportunity

• Design, develop, and deploy scalable automation solutions (such as RPA, Python scripts, UiPath workflows, or No-Code/Low-Code tools) to optimize global regulatory processes.

• Research, experiment with, and implement applications based on Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, and natural language processing (NLP) tailored to regulatory document management.

• Partner closely with business analysts, regulatory subject matter experts, and global leaders to map current operational processes and identify critical automation opportunities.

• Provide ongoing technical support, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting for automation and AI solutions already deployed in production.

• Author and maintain rigorous technical documentation, including solution architecture, source code, user guides, and testing methodologies.

• Design and deliver internal training programs to empower regulatory teams in the adoption and effective use of AI and automation technologies.

• Present performance metrics, project updates, and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and organizational leadership (with a scope of influence aligned to the experience level).

Who you are

• University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Health Sciences with a strong technological focus, or a related field.

• Proven experience in designing and developing process automation (RPA) solutions, workflows, and implementing AI tools (minimum 2–3 years for a Junior profile; 4+ years for a Senior profile).

• Solid technical and programming skills in languages such as Python, SQL, and automation environments (UiPath, Power Automate, or Cloud platforms), along with familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Agile).

• Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks and industry registration procedures is highly valued.

• Fluent and advanced English language skills (both written and spoken) to effectively interact, influence, and present findings to global teams across multiple time zones.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, a system-thinking mindset, resilience, and a strong passion for innovation focused on radically simplifying business processes.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid based medicines.

As Subject Matter Expert (SME) you will lead the identification of the optimal solid-state form, ensuring that early-stage candidates possess the necessary solubility and stability to succeed in the clinic. You will serve as the central hub, coordinating complex screening and characterization activities across internal labs and global external partners. You will lead cross-functional efforts to de-risk drug candidates and define the "Golden Form" that carries our therapies from the lab to the patient.

The opportunity

• Scientific Leadership: Act as the single point of accountability for the solid-state strategy of assigned projects, ensuring the selection of optimal salt, polymorph, and particle forms to support both stability and bioavailability.

• End-to-End Ownership: Assume full responsibility for the lifecycle management of materials, from the initial integration of biopharmaceutical assessments to the final definition of robust crystallization processes.

• Cross-Functional Integration: Orchestrate the interface between Chemistry, Analytics, and Formulation teams to harmonize the material science narrative throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Strategic Oversight: Spearhead the evaluation, technical vetting, and selection of global external CRO/CMO partners. You will orchestrate these collaborations, governing the seamless exchange of scientific methodologies while ensuring data generation meets our rigorous standards for quality and project milestones. You will manage the balance between internal technical services and external outsourcing partners, ensuring high-quality data generation and proactive risk mitigation.

• Innovation Driver: Champion the adoption of digitalization and automated screening tools to enhance data analysis throughput and accelerate project cycle times.

Who you are

• Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Material Science, or a related field, with a strong focus on solid-state characterization and crystallization.

• Deep understanding of solid-state analytical techniques (e.g., XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopy) and their application in a pharmaceutical development context.

• Proven ability to lead complex projects in a matrix environment, with the communication skills necessary to translate technical data into strategic decisions for non-expert stakeholders.

• Experience managing external CRO/

A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. L'organizzazione di Modalities terapeutici (TMo), responsabile per la traduzione della biologia delle malattie in candidati di droga di alta qualità attraverso piccole molecole, molecole di grandi dimensioni, oligonucleotidi e medicine genomiche. Integrando una profonda esperienza di modalità con la collaborazione interdisciplinare, TMo guida l'innovazione all'interno e attraverso piattaforme per consentire un impatto terapeutico differenziato e sostenibile. Siamo esperti CMC e costruiamo la nostra forza su una vasta gamma di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione della formulazione, scienza materiale e chimica analitica, fornendo e innovando nello spazio di piccole molecole, peptidi e farmaci a base di acido nucleico. Come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) si porterà l'identificazione della forma di stato solido ottimale, assicurando che i candidati all'inizio del palco possiedono la solubilità e la stabilità necessarie per avere successo nella clinica. Potrai fungere da hub centrale, coordinando complesse attività di screening e caratterizzazione in laboratori interni e partner esterni globali. Condurrai gli sforzi interfunzionali per de-rischiare i candidati alla droga e definire la "forma d'oro" che trasporta le nostre terapie dal laboratorio al paziente. L'opportunità
• Leadership scientifica: agire come unico punto di responsabilità per la strategia a stato solido di progetti assegnati, garantendo la selezione di forme ottimali di sale, polimorfo e particella per supportare sia la stabilità che la biodisponibilità.
• ProprietÃ end-to-End: Assume la piena responsabilitÃ per la gestione del ciclo di vita dei materiali, dall'integrazione iniziale delle valutazioni biofarmaceutiche alla definizione finale di robusti processi di cristallizzazione.
• Integrazione Cross-Functional: Orchestra l'interfaccia tra i team di Chimica, Analytics e Formulazione per armonizzare la narrazione della scienza materiale durante il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo della droga.
• Supervisione strategica: testa la valutazione, il controllo tecnico e la selezione dei partner CRO/CMO esterni globali. Potrai orchestrare queste collaborazioni, regolando lo scambio senza soluzione di problemi di metodologie scientifiche, garantendo al tempo stesso la generazione dei dati soddisfa i nostri rigorosi standard per le pietre miliari di qualità e progetto. Potrai gestire l'equilibrio tra servizi tecnici interni e partner esterni di outsourcing, garantendo una generazione di dati di alta qualità e una mitigazione del rischio proattivo.
• Driver per l'innovazione: Campione l'adozione di strumenti di digitalizzazione e screening automatizzati per migliorare l'analisi dei dati attraverso la produzione e accelerare i tempi del ciclo di progetto. Chi sei
• Ph.D. in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Chimica, Scienza dei Materiali, o un campo correlato, con un forte focus sulla caratterizzazione e cristallizzazione dello stato solido.
• Profonda comprensione delle tecniche analitiche a stato solido (ad esempio, XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopia) e la loro applicazione in un contesto di sviluppo farmaceutico.
• Prove capacità di condurre progetti complessi in un ambiente matrice, con le competenze di comunicazione necessarie per tradurre i dati tecnici in decisioni strategiche per gli stakeholder non esperti.
• Gestione dell'esperienza CRO/

Sie verwalten die Balance zwischen internen technischen Services und externen Outsourcing-Partnern und gewährleisten eine qualitativ hochwertige Datengenerierung und proaktive Risikominderung.
• Innovationstreiber: Verfechten Sie die Einführung von Digitalisierungs- und automatisierten Screening-Tools, um den Datenanalysedurchsatz zu verbessern und die Projektzykluszeiten zu beschleunigen. Wer du bist
• Ph.D. in Pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften, Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Gebiet, mit einem starken Fokus auf Festkörpercharakterisierung und Kristallisation.
• Tiefes Verständnis der analytischen Festkörpertechniken (z. B. XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Mikroskopie) und ihrer Anwendung in einem pharmazeutischen Entwicklungskontext.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Projekte in einer Matrixumgebung zu leiten, mit den Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um technische Daten in strategische Entscheidungen für nicht-fachkundige Interessengruppen zu übersetzen.
• Erfahrung im Management externer CRO/

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid based medicines.

As Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Oral Enabling Formulation Technologies . This is a high-impact, technical leadership role focused on overcoming the challenges of poorly soluble or poorly permeable drug candidates. You will lead the strategy, design, and execution of advanced formulation platforms to drive our pipeline from discovery through clinical proof-of-concep

The Opportunity

Enabling Formulation Mastery:

• Establish a high-impact technical network to maintain state-of-the-art oral enabling formulation technologies for delivery of complex synthetic modalities.

• Design and execute specialized formulations (e.g., lipid based-delivery systems such as SMEDDS/SNEDDS, amorphous solid dispersion spray-dried, hot-melt extrusion) to maximize exposure in PK, PD, and safety studies.

• Drive the advancement of global formulation strategies by integrating novel delivery technologies to enhance absorption and therapeutic efficacy

• Lead the technical profiling of NCEs and conduct rigorous Developability Assessments to identify and mitigate risks in molecular properties early in the pipeline

Internal Advisory Collaboration:

• You act as subject matter expert (SME) for internal pRED scientists, advising on formulation strategies for complex synthetic molecules and foster collaborative innovation across the organization.

Portfolio Execution & Excellence:

• Act as pCMC Drug Product lead within research project teams, guiding the end to end CMC scientific strategy until transfer to the Technical Development Department.

• Plan, coordinate and effectively communicate with research teams, function, stakeholders and governance boards.

• Master Modeling & Simulation and AI/ML tools to predict drug performance, optimize formulation selection, and bridge in vitro data to in vivo outcomes.

• Ensure scientific excellence and operational efficiency while meeting dynamic portfolio needs through effective internal and external supply strategies.

Who You Are

You possess a very strong background in Pharmaceutical Research and Development, Chemistry or related field. Ideally you have obtained a PhD in Pharmaceutical Technology and got at least 8 years of industry experience in Drug Discovery/Development, with at least 3-5 years specifically focused on Enabling Formulation Technologies for Oral Drug Delivery.

• A strong knowledge and experience in Enabling Formul

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.
