jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an Investigative Toxicology Associate , you play a pivotal role in the development, validation, implementation, and execution of nonclinical in vitro cell culture-based assays for translational safety assessment. In this hands-on laboratory role, you leverage modern scientific tools to maximize insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline within a highly collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Deliver high-quality scientific data for modern regulated and non-regulated toxicology in vitro assays to inform risk assessment across discovery and development projects.

• Support the development, implementation, and data analysis of novel predictive in vitro safety models.

• Conduct precise data analysis, manage internal reporting within the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), and present key findings to internal stakeholders.

• Optimize laboratory processes continuously to increase quality, efficiency, and safety standards.

• Engage proactively with cross-functional matrix teams within Pharmaceutical Sciences to align on project milestones and prioritize laboratory schedules.

• Establish and maintain professional relationships with external vendors and technology providers to assess and onboard next-generation laboratory technologies.

Who You Are

You are a curious, collaborative, and detail-oriented laboratory professional passionate about advancing healthcare through cutting-edge science. You bring a strong foundational knowledge of cell biology and thrive in dynamic, matrix-organized environments.

Qualifications & Competencies:

• An apprenticeship as a biology laboratory technician, or a B.Sc. / M.Sc. degree in cell biology, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, pharmacology, toxicology, or a related scientific discipline.

• A minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience operating within a Biosafety Level 2 (BSL2) cell culture laboratory with handling of primary cells and/or iPSCs.

• Demonstrated expertise in mammalian cell culture techniques, including experience with complex in vitro models, organoids or organs-on-a-chip systems.

• Proficiency with state-of-the-art imaging technologies, such as high-content imaging or confocal imaging, alongside familiarity with im

All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. L'opportunità Come Investigative Toxicology Associate , si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo, nella validazione, nell'implementazione e nell'esecuzione di saggi non clinici basati sulla cultura delle cellule vitro per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. In questo ruolo pratico di laboratorio, si sfruttano moderni strumenti scientifici per massimizzare le intuizioni, guidare l'innovazione e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica all'interno di un ambiente altamente collaborativo. • Fornire dati scientifici di alta qualità per la tossicologia moderna regolamentata e non regolamentata in test vitro per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso i progetti di scoperta e sviluppo.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e l'analisi dei dati di nuovi modelli di sicurezza in vitro.
• Condurre analisi precise dei dati, gestire la reportistica interna all'interno del sistema di gestione delle informazioni del laboratorio (LIMS), e presentare i risultati chiave per gli stakeholder interni.
• Ottimizzare i processi di laboratorio continuamente per aumentare la qualità, l'efficienza e gli standard di sicurezza.
• Impegnarsi proattivamente con i team di matrice interfunzionali all'interno delle Scienze Farmaceutiche per allineare sulle pietre miliari del progetto e priorizzare gli orari di laboratorio.
• Stabilire e mantenere relazioni professionali con fornitori esterni e fornitori di tecnologia per valutare e a bordo tecnologie di laboratorio di nuova generazione. Chi sei Sei un curioso, collaborativo e professionale di laboratorio orientato al dettaglio appassionato di promuovere la salute attraverso la scienza all'avanguardia. Porti una forte conoscenza fondamentale della biologia cellulare e prosperi in ambienti dinamici e matrice-organizzati. Qualifiche e competenze:
• Un apprendistato come tecnico di laboratorio di biologia, o una laurea in biologia cellulare, biotecnologia, ingegneria biomedica, farmacologia, tossicologia, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.
• Un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza pratica operante all'interno di un laboratorio di cultura cellulare Biosafety Level 2 (BSL2) con gestione delle cellule primarie e/o iPSC.
• Competenza dimostrata nelle tecniche di coltura cellulare mammifero, compresa l'esperienza con modelli complessi in vitro, organoidi o sistemi organi-on-a-chip.
• Proficienza con tecnologie di imaging all'avanguardia, come immagini ad alto contenuto o immagini confocali, insieme alla familiarità con l'im

L'opportunité En tant qu'associé en toxicologie d'investigation, vous jouez un rôle central dans l'élaboration, la validation, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution d'essais non cliniques de culture cellulaire in vitro pour l'évaluation de l'innocuité translationnelle. Dans ce rôle pratique de laboratoire, vous exploitez des outils scientifiques modernes pour maximiser les connaissances, stimuler l'innovation et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique dans un environnement hautement collaboratif. Principales responsabilités :
• Fournir des données scientifiques de haute qualité pour les essais de toxicologie in vitro réglementés et non réglementés modernes afin d'éclairer l'évaluation des risques dans l'ensemble des projets de découverte et de développement.
• Appuyer l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et l'analyse de données de nouveaux modèles prédictifs de sécurité in vitro.
• Effectuer une analyse précise des données, gérer les rapports internes au sein du Système de gestion de l'information de laboratoire (SGGI) et présenter les principales constatations aux intervenants internes.
• Optimiser les processus de laboratoire en continu pour améliorer la qualité, l'efficacité et les normes de sécurité.
• S'engager de façon proactive auprès d'équipes de matrices interfonctionnelles des sciences pharmaceutiques afin de s'aligner sur les jalons du projet et de hiérarchiser les calendriers des laboratoires.
• Établir et entretenir des relations professionnelles avec des fournisseurs externes et des fournisseurs de technologie pour évaluer et intégrer les technologies de laboratoire de prochaine génération. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel de laboratoire curieux, collaboratif et axé sur les détails passionné par l'avancement des soins de santé par la science de pointe. Vous apportez une solide connaissance fondamentale de la biologie cellulaire et vous prospèrez dans des environnements dynamiques et organisés en matrice. Qualifications et compétences :
• Un apprentissage comme technicien de laboratoire de biologie, ou un baccalauréat en biologie cellulaire, en biotechnologie, en génie biomédical, en pharmacologie, en toxicologie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.
• Un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience pratique dans un laboratoire de culture cellulaire de niveau de biosécurité 2 (BSL2) avec manipulation de cellules primaires et/ou iPSC.
• Expertise démontrée dans les techniques de culture cellulaire des mammifères, y compris l'expérience de modèles in vitro complexes, d'organoïdes ou de systèmes d'organes sur puce.
• Connaissance des technologies d'imagerie de pointe, telles que l'imagerie à haut contenu ou l'imagerie confocale, ainsi que de la familiarité avec l'imagerie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. All'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa, questa posizione opera a livello globale, è profondamente incorporata all'interno di team di progetto di matrice multifunzionale e può supportare più aree di malattia di fuoco di Roche (CVRM, Immunologia, Neuroscienze, Oncologia e Oftalmologia). L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si porterà l'avanzamento scientifico dei programmi clinici servendo come il nucleo quantitativo e farmacologia clinica piombo all'interno di team di progetto interfunzionali. Potrai guidare tutti gli aspetti della Farmacologia Clinica (CP) in tutte le fasi di sviluppo e applicare strategicamente Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approcci per ottimizzare i progetti di prova, giustificare le selezioni di dose, informare le decisioni di sviluppo e mitigare i rischi sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio di sviluppo. Il vostro scopo sarà la modalità-agnostica, dando la supervisione che abbraccia piccole molecole, grandi molecole, e nuove piattaforme.
• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: contribuisce attivamente allo sviluppo di strategie di sviluppo clinico, tra cui la progettazione di studi clinici e condurre lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e l'esecuzione delle strategie di Farmacologia Clinica e MIDD per le attività assegnate in tutte le fasi di sviluppo. Traduci i principi clinici di Farmacologia in modelli predittivi che guidano la selezione di dosi / regimi, interazioni farmaco-droga (DDI), strategie di popolazione speciali, estrapolazioni pediatrico e ponteggio geografico / etnico.
• Modellazione & Simulazione Mastery: Applicare metodologie farmacometriche (come la popolazione PK/PD, PBPK o QSP) per eseguire simulazioni di prova clinica, caratterizzare le relazioni di esposizione-risposta e definire criteri quantitativi per le decisioni di go/no-go iniziali e data-driven. Porti la competenza nel software farmacometrico (ad esempio, NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Regolazione & Asset Maximization: Guidare le sezioni CP dei principali documenti normativi (compresi IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Assicurare documenti di presentazione fit-for-purpose di alta qualità utilizzando iniziative Roche come l'autore magra dello sviluppo e l'eccellenza della presentazione digitale. Rappresentare l'azienda come esperto di materia in interazioni dell'autorità sanitaria.
• Sviluppo aziendale: fornire analisi farmacologiche cliniche e quantitative

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Innerhalb der Sektion Klinische Pharmakologie in der Abteilung Quantitative Klinische Pharmakologie ist diese Position weltweit tätig, tief in funktionsübergreifende Matrix-Projektteams eingebettet und kann mehrere Schwerpunktbereiche von Roche unterstützen (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie). Die Chance In dieser Rolle werden Sie die wissenschaftliche Weiterentwicklung der klinischen Programme führen, indem Sie als Hauptleiter der quantitativen und klinischen Pharmakologie in funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams fungieren. Sie werden alle Aspekte der klinischen Pharmakologie (CP) über alle Entwicklungsphasen hinweg vorantreiben und MIDD-Ansätze strategisch anwenden, um Studiendesigns zu optimieren, Dosisauswahlen zu rechtfertigen, Entwicklungsentscheidungen zu treffen und Risiken sowohl in der frühen als auch in der späten Entwicklungsphase zu mindern. Ihr Umfang wird modalitätsunabhängig sein und Ihnen einen Überblick über kleine Moleküle, große Moleküle und neuartige Plattformen geben.
• Strategische und quantitative Planausführung: Tragen Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungsstrategien bei, einschließlich der Gestaltung klinischer Studien, und leiten Sie die Entwicklung, Implementierung und Durchführung der klinischen Pharmakologie- und MIDD-Strategien für zugewiesene Vermögenswerte in allen Entwicklungsphasen. Klinische Pharmakologie Prinzipien in prädiktive Modelle zu übersetzen, die Dosis / Regime-Selektion, Arzneimittel-Wechselwirkungen (DDI), spezielle Populationsstrategien, pädiatrische Extrapolationen und geographische / ethnische Brücken führen.
• Modellierung und Simulationsbeherrschung: Wenden Sie pharmakometrische Methoden (wie Populations-PK/PD, PBPK oder QSP) an, um klinische Studiensimulationen durchzuführen, Expositions-Wirkungs-Beziehungen zu charakterisieren und quantitative Kriterien für frühe, datengesteuerte Go/No-Go-Entscheidungen zu definieren. Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse in pharmakometrischer Software (z. B. NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Regulatory & Asset Maximierung: Führen Sie die CP-Abschnitte der wichtigsten regulatorischen Dokumente (einschließlich IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Sicherstellung hochwertiger, zweckgerechter Einreichungsdokumente unter Verwendung von Roche-Initiativen wie Lean Development Authoring und Digital Submission Excellence. Repräsentieren Sie das Unternehmen als Fachexperte für Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden.
• Business Development: Bieten klinische und quantitative Pharmakologie exp

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation Recherche Pharmaceutique et Développement Débutal (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Au sein de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative, ce poste fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale, est profondément ancré dans les équipes de projets de matrices interfonctionnelles et peut soutenir plusieurs des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie). L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'avancement scientifique des programmes cliniques en servant de chef de file en pharmacologie quantitative et clinique au sein des équipes de projets interfonctionnelles. Vous dirigerez tous les aspects de la pharmacologie clinique (PC) dans toutes les phases de développement et appliquerez stratégiquement des approches de développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (PDIM) pour optimiser les conceptions d'essais, justifier la sélection des doses, éclairer les décisions de développement et atténuer les risques au début et à la fin du développement. Votre portée sera agnostique de modalité, vous donnant une surveillance qui couvre de petites molécules, de grandes molécules et de nouvelles plateformes.
• Exécution du plan stratégique et quantitatif : Contribuer activement à l'élaboration de stratégies de développement clinique, y compris la conception d'essais cliniques et diriger l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution des stratégies de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les actifs attribués à toutes les phases de développement. Traduire les principes de pharmacologie clinique en modèles prédictifs qui guident la sélection des doses/régimes, les interactions médicamenteuses (DDI), les stratégies démographiques spéciales, les extrapolations pédiatriques et les transitions géographiques/ethniques.
• Modélisation et maîtrise de la simulation : Appliquer des méthodologies pharmacométriques (telles que PK/PD, PBPK ou QSP) pour effectuer des simulations d'essais cliniques, caractériser les relations exposition-réponse et définir des critères quantitatifs pour les décisions d'aller/de ne pas aller fondées sur les données. Vous apportez des compétences en logiciel pharmacométrique (p. ex. NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Maximisation de la réglementation et des actifs : Diriger les sections du CP des principaux documents réglementaires (y compris IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Veiller à ce que des documents de présentation de haute qualité et adaptés à l'usage soient utilisés à l'aide d'initiatives Roche comme l'auteur de développement maigre et l'excellence de la soumission numérique. Représenter l'entreprise en tant qu'expert en matière d'interactions avec les autorités sanitaires.
• Développement des affaires : Exp. pharmacologie clinique et quantitative

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacology Lead - Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les populations de patients appropriées et d'accélérer le développement des traitements sûrs et efficaces de demain. Au sein de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative, ce poste fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale, est profondément intégré dans les équipes de projets multi-fonctionnels et peut soutenir plusieurs domaines de maladies de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neurosciences, oncologie et ophtalmologie). o Vous dirigerez tous les aspects de la pharmacologie clinique (PC) dans toutes les phases de développement et appliquerez stratégiquement des approches de développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (MDDM) pour optimiser les modèles d'essai, justifier la sélection des doses, éclairer les décisions de développement et atténuer les risques au début et à la fin du développement. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity:

The Analytical Data Science Programmer is a key contributor to the clinical study team, responsible for transforming statistical analysis plans into high-quality, traceable programming deliverables. This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard

I team di PDD Analytical Data Science sono mobilitati in tutto il portafoglio per generare informazioni basate sui dati, identificare le opportunità di scala e implementare soluzioni efficaci. PDD Analytical Data Science è riconosciuto come un hub leader per i migliori talenti del settore, operante come una forza lavoro agile per fornire impegni normativi in tutto il portafoglio. Identifichiamo, influenziamo e adottiamo soluzioni digitali e di automazione leader del settore, sviluppiamo approcci analitici per sostenere le analisi esplorative e allineiamo le pratiche di programmazione statistica sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio dello sviluppo clinico. L'opportunità: Il programmatore Analytical Data Science è un contributore chiave al team di studio clinico, responsabile della trasformazione dei piani di analisi statistica in materiali di programmazione tracciabili di alta qualità. Questo include uscite sia statiche che dinamiche, come tabelle, elenchi, figure, e visualizzazioni interattive dei dati o dashboard. Il ruolo riguarda la creazione e la convalida di set di dati in conformità con gli standard del Modello di Scheda di Studio e del Modello di Dati di Analisi, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e degli standard Roche. Oltre a sostenere le presentazioni regolamentari, il programmatore ADS svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella generazione di informazioni sui dati attraverso piattaforme come il Insight Engine, consentendo l'esplorazione in tempo reale e l'interpretazione di diversi dati clinici ed esplorativi. Questo ruolo contribuisce a un ambiente di sviluppo moderno, orientato all'intuizione, facilitando l'analisi robusta, tempestiva e decisionale attraverso i programmi clinici.
• L'utente sviluppa, convalida e mantiene in modo indipendente set di dati e output statistici per gli studi clinici, inclusi i dataset del Modello di Tabulazione dei Dati di Studio (SDTM), i dataset del Modello di analisi (ADaM) e le tabelle, gli elenchi e le cifre (TLF), garantendo precisione di programmazione, tracciabilità e conformità ai processi interni e alle aspettative normative
• Sviluppi e supporti gli output di programmazione in una vasta gamma di tipi di dati, compresi i dati di biomarcatori esplorativi e i dati del mondo reale, per supportare obiettivi sia normativi che scientifici
• Collabori su analisi esplorative che abbracciano aree di malattia e aree terapeutiche, consentendo una generazione di informazioni per informare le strategie di sviluppo della droga
• Supporti la creazione e la raffinatezza di strumenti interattivi e applicazioni analitiche (ad esempio, dashboard o piattaforme di dati visivi) che consentono l'esplorazione dinamica di dataset integrati da parte di team scientifici e clinici
• Fornite la leadership di programmazione per gli studi assegnati, coordinando i deliverable tra i partner di programmazione interni ed esterni per soddisfare le tempistiche e i requisiti di studio
• Lei interpreta i piani di analisi statistica e li traduce in specifiche di programmazione eseguibili per garantire rigore scientifico nelle uscite
• La risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione delle sfide di programmazione tecnica con una supervisione limitata, l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi e l'implementazione di soluzioni efficaci durante la riunione dei termini
• Contribuisci alla progettazione e manutenzione di standard

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity:

The Analytical Data Science Programmer is a key contributor to the clinical study team, responsible for transforming statistical analysis plans into high-quality, traceable programming deliverables. This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard

• Vous développez et supportez des extrants de programmation pour un large éventail de types de données, y compris des données exploratoires de biomarqueurs et des données du monde réel, pour soutenir des objectifs à la fois réglementaires et scientifiques
• Vous collaborez à des analyses exploratoires qui couvrent les domaines de la maladie et des domaines thérapeutiques, ce qui permet de générer des connaissances pour éclairer les stratégies de développement des médicaments.
• Vous soutenez la création et le raffinement d'outils interactifs et d'applications analytiques (p. ex. tableaux de bord ou plateformes de données visuelles) qui permettent une exploration dynamique des ensembles de données intégrés par les équipes scientifiques et cliniques
• Vous dirigez la programmation des études assignées, coordonnez les produits livrables entre les partenaires de programmation internes et externes afin de respecter les échéances et les exigences de l'étude.
• Vous interprètez les plans d'analyse statistique et les traduisez en spécifications de programmation exécutables pour assurer la rigueur scientifique dans les extrants
• Vous dépannez et résolvez les défis de programmation technique avec une supervision limitée, identifiez les risques de manière proactive et mettez en œuvre des solutions efficaces tout en respectant les délais
• Vous contribuez à la conception et à l'entretien de la norme

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position sits within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department in pRED / Pharmaceutical Sciences, but maintains a company-wide footprint. The scope of influence transcends individual teams, regularly partnering across major organisational boundaries and cross-entities (e.g., pRED, gRED, PDR) to shape institutional knowledge.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as a senior enterprise leader and expert in Clinical Pharmacology, including Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Quantitative Medicine, solving high-risk development challenges and embedding advanced computational capabilities to accelerate the R&D pipeline. Operating on a senior strategic and scientific track, you will hold high accountability for shaping long-term scientific and development strategies and capital allocation for entire disease areas or global functions. Additionally, you will drive high-stakes corporate due diligence for licensing opportunities, lead complex global health authority negotiations, and act as a strategic mentor across the wider organisation.

• High-Impact Strategic and Scientific Leadership : Formulate and evolve overarching Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for high-profile molecules or portfolio segments (e.g. Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology), ensuring alignment with end-to-end development goals.

• Pioneering Technical Innovation : Identify, develop, and integrate state-of-the-art computational methodologies into workflows, stimulating the broader scientific community to experiment and challenge development paradigms.

• Complex Submissions & Regulatory Defence : Provide authoritative guidance on highly complex or unprecedented submission strategies (e.g., pediatric extrapolations, novel modalities) and serve as a primary counter-partner to health authorities and KOLs.

• Strategic Business Development : Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling evaluations and actively contribute to the development of Clinical Development Plans for high-stakes due diligence, in-licensing, and out-licensing opportunities to assess the path to value as well as the technical viability and risks of external

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova all'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa in Scienze pRED / Farmaceutiche, ma mantiene un'impronta aziendale. La portata dell'influenza trascende i singoli team, collaborando regolarmente tra i principali confini organizzativi e le intersezioni (ad esempio, pRED, gRED, PDR) per plasmare le conoscenze istituzionali. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si servirà come leader di impresa senior e esperto in Farmacologia Clinica, tra cui Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) e Quantitative Medicine, risolvendo sfide di sviluppo ad alto rischio e incorporando capacità computazionali avanzate per accelerare la pipeline R&D. Operando su una traccia strategica e scientifica senior, si terrà alta responsabilitÃ per la definizione di strategie scientifiche e di sviluppo a lungo termine e allocazione di capitale per intere aree di malattia o funzioni globali. Inoltre, guiderai le due diligence aziendali ad alto livello per le opportunità di licenza, guiderai negoziazioni di autorità sanitarie globali complesse e agirai come mentore strategico in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Leadership strategica e scientifica di alto impatto: formulare ed evolvere le strategie cliniche di farmacologia e MIDD per le molecole di alto profilo o segmenti di portafoglio (ad esempio Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) delle aree di malattia di punta di Roche (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology e Ophthalmology), garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi di sviluppo end-to-end.
• Identificare, sviluppare e integrare metodologie computazionali all'avanguardia nei flussi di lavoro, stimolando la più ampia comunità scientifica a sperimentare e sfidare i paradigmi dello sviluppo.
• Submissions & Regulatory Defence: Fornire una guida autorevole su strategie di presentazione altamente complesse o senza precedenti (ad esempio, estrapolazioni pediatriche, nuove modalità) e servire come contro-partner primario alle autorità sanitarie e KOL.
• Sviluppo Strategico delle Imprese: Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling assessments e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di Piani di Sviluppo Clinico per un elevato fabbisogno di diligenza, in-licenziamento e opportunità per la valutazione del percorso di valore, nonché la fattibilità tecnica e i rischi di esterna

Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position liegt in der Sektion Klinische Pharmakologie in der Abteilung Quantitative Klinische Pharmakologie in pRED / Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften, unterhält aber einen unternehmensweiten Fußabdruck. Der Einflussbereich geht über einzelne Teams hinaus und arbeitet regelmäßig über große organisatorische Grenzen und übergreifende Einheiten (z. B. pRED, gRED, PDR) hinweg zusammen, um institutionelles Wissen zu gestalten. Die Chance In dieser Rolle werden Sie als leitender Unternehmensleiter und Experte für klinische Pharmakologie tätig sein, einschließlich Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) und Quantitative Medicine, um risikoreiche Entwicklungsherausforderungen zu lösen und fortschrittliche Rechenfunktionen einzubetten, um die F & E-Pipeline zu beschleunigen. Mit einem hochrangigen strategischen und wissenschaftlichen Kurs haben Sie eine hohe Verantwortung für die Gestaltung langfristiger wissenschaftlicher und Entwicklungsstrategien und die Kapitalzuweisung für ganze Krankheitsbereiche oder globale Funktionen. Darüber hinaus werden Sie die Corporate Due Diligence mit hohem Einsatz für Lizenzierungsmöglichkeiten vorantreiben, komplexe globale Verhandlungen der Gesundheitsbehörden leiten und als strategischer Mentor in der gesamten Organisation fungieren.
• Strategische und wissenschaftliche Führungsrolle mit hohem Einfluss: Formulierung und Entwicklung übergreifender klinischer Pharmakologie- und MIDD-Strategien für hochkarätige Moleküle oder Portfoliosegmente (z. B. Antikörper-Wirkstoff-Konjugate) der Roche-Fokus-Krankheitsbereiche (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie), um die Ausrichtung auf die End-to-End-Entwicklungsziele sicherzustellen.
• Pionierhafte technische Innovation: Identifizieren, entwickeln und integrieren Sie modernste Computermethoden in Workflows, um die breitere wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft zu ermutigen, Entwicklungsparadigmen zu experimentieren und herauszufordern.
• Komplexe Einreichungen und regulatorische Verteidigung: Geben Sie maßgebliche Leitlinien für hochkomplexe oder beispiellose Einreichungsstrategien (z. B. pädiatrische Extrapolationen, neuartige Modalitäten) und dienen Sie als primärer Gegenpartner für Gesundheitsbehörden und KOLs.
• Strategische Geschäftsentwicklung: Führen Sie klinische Pharmakologie- und Modellbewertungen und tragen Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungspläne für High-Stakes-Due-Diligence-, In-Licensing- und Out-Licensing-Möglichkeiten bei, um den Weg zum Wert sowie die technische Lebensfähigkeit und die Risiken externer Unternehmen zu bewerten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste fait partie de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative en sciences pRED / Pharmaceutiques, mais conserve une empreinte à l'échelle de l'entreprise. L'étendue de l'influence transcende les équipes individuelles, s'associant régulièrement entre les grandes frontières organisationnelles et les entités (p. ex., pRED, gRED, PDR) pour façonner les connaissances institutionnelles. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez le rôle de chef d'entreprise principal et d'expert en pharmacologie clinique, y compris le développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (PDIM) et la médecine quantitative, en résolvant les défis de développement à risque élevé et en intégrant des capacités informatiques avancées pour accélérer le pipeline de R-D. Dans le cadre d'une démarche stratégique et scientifique de haut niveau, vous serez fortement responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies scientifiques et de développement à long terme et de l'affectation des capitaux pour l'ensemble des domaines de maladie ou des fonctions mondiales. De plus, vous dirigerez une diligence raisonnable de l'entreprise pour les possibilités d'octroi de licences, dirigerez des négociations complexes sur les autorités sanitaires mondiales et agirez comme un mentor stratégique dans toute l'organisation.
• Leadership stratégique et scientifique à haut impact : Formuler et développer des stratégies globales de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les molécules ou les segments de portefeuille à haut rayonnement (p. ex. anticorps-drogue-conjugués) des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie), en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs de développement de bout en bout.
• Innovation technique pionnière : Identifier, développer et intégrer des méthodologies informatiques de pointe dans les flux de travail, en stimulant la communauté scientifique à expérimenter et à défier les paradigmes de développement.
• Soumissions complexes et défense réglementaire : Fournir des lignes directrices faisant autorité sur les stratégies de présentation très complexes ou sans précédent (p. ex. extrapolations pédiatriques, nouvelles modalités) et servir de principal contre-partenaire aux autorités de la santé et aux KOL.
• Développement stratégique des affaires : Diriger les évaluations de la pharmacologie clinique et de la modélisation et contribuer activement à l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique pour la diligence raisonnable élevée, l'octroi de licences et les possibilités de sous-licence pour évaluer la voie de la valeur ainsi que la viabilité technique et les risques de l'extérieur

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), our Ophthalmology teams are redefining how precision medicine can transform the detection and treatment of complex retinal diseases. This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up — establishing an Ophthalmology Precision Medicine group at our Welwyn site that brings together biomarker science, advanced imaging, clinical expertise, and artificial intelligence. You will have the platform, pipeline, and resources to shape something truly new in one of the most dynamic areas of ophthalmic research.
The Opportunity

• Build a new Ophthalmology Precision Medicine function from the ground up — defining the vision, structure, and scientific direction for a group that integrates biomarkers, advanced imaging, clinical science, and AI across the pRED Ophthalmology portfolio.

• Lead a cross-functional expert team spanning translational medicine, imaging, clinical development, data science, and biomarker disciplines — ensuring precision medicine is at the heart of our Ophthalmology strategy.

• Bridge laboratory science and clinical practice by steering the generation of robust fluid- and imaging biomarker strategies that enable project and disease area decisions.

• Advance innovation in imaging science by directing cutting-edge ophthalmic imaging approaches including OCT, OCT-A, and FA to inform future clinical practice and therapeutic development.

• Enable translational insights through AI and data by integrating preclinical and clinical datasets using classical and next-generation analytical approaches.

• Influence portfolio strategy across multiple retinal diseases including neovascular AMD, diabetic macular edema, geographic atrophy, and intermediate AMD — driving the direction and future of clinical development and research.

• Represent Roche externally through strong partnerships with scientific experts, investigators, and the broader ophthalmology community — remaining at the forefront of innovation.

Who you are

• You are a board-certified ophthalmologist (MD or MD/PhD) with deep expertise in ophthalmology, translational medicine, or biomedical sciences.

• You are a recognised expert in the retina space, with a strong scientific publication record and standing as a key opinion leader in your field.

• You have deep knowledge of ophthalmic imaging technologies (OCT, OCT-A, FA) and experience with imaging analysis or Reading Centre environments.

• You are experienced in integrating preclinical and clinical data to support proof of biology, efficacy, and safety strategies, with some exposure to clinical trials.

• You are a collaborative scientific leader who thrives in matrix environments, energised by innovation and the opportunity to build something new.

Preferred

• Experience applying AI or machine learning to ophthalmic imaging analysis or clinical data interpretation.

• Prior experience in pharmaceutical drug development programmes for retinal diseases.

• Flexible working arrangements may be available for exceptional candidates who wish to maintain some clinical activity alongside this role.

If building a world-class precision medicine function and shaping the future of ophthalmic therapy development is the kind of challenge that excites you — apply now and help us bring transformative medicines to patients faster.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Questa è una rara opportunità di costruire una nuova funzione da zero — che stabilisce un gruppo di Medicina di Precisione di Oftalmologia nel nostro sito di Welwyn che riunisce la scienza del biomarcatore, l'imaging avanzato, la competenza clinica e l'intelligenza artificiale. Avrete la piattaforma, la pipeline e le risorse per modellare qualcosa di veramente nuovo in una delle aree più dinamiche della ricerca oftalmica. L'opportunità
• Costruire una nuova funzione di medicina di precisione di Oftalmologia da zero — definendo la visione, la struttura e la direzione scientifica per un gruppo che integra biomarcatori, imaging avanzato, scienza clinica e AI attraverso il portafoglio di oftalmologia pRED.
• Guidare un team esperto interfunzionale che comprende la medicina traduttiva, l'imaging, lo sviluppo clinico, la scienza dei dati e le discipline del biomarcatore — garantire la medicina di precisione è al centro della nostra strategia di oftalmologia.
• La scienza di laboratorio di bridge e la pratica clinica guidando la generazione di robuste strategie di biomarcatore fluido- e imaging che consentono decisioni di area di progetto e malattia.
• Avanzare l'innovazione nella scienza dell'imaging dirigendo approcci di imaging oftalmico all'avanguardia tra cui OCT, OCT-A e FA per informare la pratica clinica futura e lo sviluppo terapeutico.
• Abilitare le intuizioni traduttive attraverso l'intelligenza artificiale e i dati integrando set di dati preclinici e clinici utilizzando approcci analitici classici e di nuova generazione.
• La strategia del portafoglio di influenza su più malattie renali, tra cui AMD neovascolare, edema maculare diabetico, atrofia geografica e AMD intermedio, guida la direzione e il futuro dello sviluppo clinico e della ricerca.
• Rappresentare Roche esternamente attraverso forti partnership con esperti scientifici, ricercatori e la più ampia comunità oftalmologica — rimanendo all'avanguardia dell'innovazione. Chi sei
• Sei un oftalmologo certificato dal consiglio di amministrazione (MD o MD/PhD) con profonda esperienza in oftalmologia, medicina traduttiva, o scienze biomediche.
• Sei un esperto riconosciuto nello spazio retina, con un forte record di pubblicazione scientifica e in piedi come leader di opinione chiave nel tuo campo.
• Hai una profonda conoscenza delle tecnologie dell'imaging oftalmico (OCT, OCT-A, FA) e dell'esperienza con l'analisi delle immagini o gli ambienti del Centro di lettura.
• Siete esperti nell'integrazione di dati preclinici e clinici per sostenere la prova di biologia, efficacia e strategie di sicurezza, con qualche esposizione a studi clinici.
• Sei un leader scientifico collaborativo che prospera in ambienti matrici, stimolato dall'innovazione e dall'opportunità di costruire qualcosa di nuovo. Preferito
• Esperienza nell'applicazione dell'intelligenza artificiale o dell'apprendimento automatico all'analisi oculistica o all'interpretazione dei dati clinici.
• Esperienza prioritaria nei programmi di sviluppo di farmaci farmaceutici per le malattie retiniche.
• Le modalità di lavoro flessibili possono essere disponibili per i candidati eccezionali che desiderano mantenere una certa attività clinica a fianco di questo ruolo. Se costruire una funzione di medicina di precisione di livello mondiale e modellare il futuro dello sviluppo di terapia oftalmica è il tipo di sfida che ti eccita — applicare ora e aiutarci a portare i farmaci trasformativi ai pazienti più velocemente. jobs.title: IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The IT Business Analyst works at the intersection of business analysis and product management to lead the technical roadmap for a portfolio of digital products and components that enable the re-use of clinical trial data and the use of Real-World Data (RWD) by data scientists across Roche. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of interconnected data products and platforms, owning the roadmap with full autonomy and driving delivery across highly ambiguous, cross-functional spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership and a bridge between business needs and technical teams, you will shape long-term product direction, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal solutions that turn clinical and real-world data into compliant, reusable, and high-value capabilities.

Description of the area
The area is responsible for the data products, services, and platforms that make clinical trial data and Real-World Data reusable for secondary use — from data acquisition and governance through to evidence generation and publishing. The portfolio spans GenAI-enabled solutions that streamline data preparation and compliance, services that enable safe sharing of clinical trial data, and platforms that support the end-to-end RWD evidence-generation workflow. The Digital Solution Lead owns the technical roadmap across these products and partners closely with data scientists, clinical and business stakeholders, and engineering teams.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership) : Owns the technical roadmap across multiple products and components for clinical-trial-data re-use and RWD enablement.

The Position
IT Business Analyst

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The IT Business Analyst works at the intersection of business analysis and product management to lead the technical roadmap for a portfolio of digital products and components that enable the re-use of clinical trial data and the use of Real-World Data (RWD) by data scientists across Roche. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of interconnected data products and platforms, owning the roadmap with full autonomy and driving delivery across highly ambiguous, cross-functional spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership and a bridge between business needs and technical teams, you will shape long-term product direction, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal solutions that turn clinical and real-world data into compliant, reusable, and high-value capabilities.

The area is responsible for the data products, services, and platforms that make clinical trial data and Real-World Data reusable for secondary use — from data acquisition and governance through to evidence generation and publishing. The portfolio spans GenAI-enabled solutions that streamline data preparation and compliance, services that enable safe sharing of clinical trial data, and platforms that support the end-to-end RWD evidence-generation workflow. The Digital Solution Lead owns the technical roadmap across these products and partners closely with data scientists, clinical and business stakeholders, and engineering teams.

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Associate - Bioanalytical LC-MS Assay Developer within our Bioanalytics and Biomarkers (BioAM) department, you will play a central role in shaping the non-regulated preclinical and exploratory clinical pipeline. You will be responsible for developing, qualifying, and validating advanced bioanalytical methods to quantify drug candidates and biomarkers across diverse chemical classes—ranging from small molecules and oligonucleotides to complex proteins. In this role, you combine hands-on laboratory expertise with modern digital tools to transform biological samples into high-quality data that directly impacts project decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop, qualify, and validate analytical methods for the accurate quantification of drug candidates, metabolites, and biomarkers in various biological matrices.

• Apply bioanalytical and biomarker assays to support non-clinical pharmacokinetic (PK) and toxicokinetic (TK) studies, as well as exploratory clinical studies following Good Clinical Practice (GCP) principles where required.

• Ensure accurate documentation of all experimental data and contribute to comprehensive technical reporting, including Bioanalytical Reports and Analytical Method Descriptions.

• Take ownership of laboratory equipment care, maintenance, and the management of consumable stocks within your assigned workspace to guarantee operational excellence.

• Maintain, refine, and proactively advance your technical expertise in Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) and automated sample preparation.

• Leverage IT and digital tools for efficient experimental design, data analysis, and documentation, presenting scientific results confidently to cross-functional project teams.
