Cela inclut l’enrichissement des métadonnées et la création d’ensembles de données prêts pour l’IA pour permettre des systèmes d’IA autonomes, agents et humains dans la boucle, qui transforment le processus de développement de médicaments. L'opportunité :
• Leadership et réalisation de l'analyse commerciale : diriger l'analyse commerciale d'initiatives ou de flux de travail avec autonomie, en coordonnant la complexité et l'échelle. Définit et dirige les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus, traduisant les exigences de données complexes en cartes de processus, épopées, fonctionnalités et témoignages d'utilisateurs.
• Résolution de problèmes : dirige l'analyse des problèmes commerciaux, en définissant l'espace du problème et en conduisant une analyse complète des causes profondes pouvant dépasser les limites de l'organisation. Empêche de manière proactive la dérive de la portée, gère la complexité des différentes portées de changement et est, en fin de compte, responsable des livrables de l'analyse commerciale, garantissant l'alignement entre les fonctions et les systèmes dépendants.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : identifie et implique les principales parties prenantes, y compris la direction, au-delà des frontières organisationnelles informatiques et commerciales. Élabore la stratégie en tant que conseiller de confiance du leadership, gère activement les conflits pour parvenir à l'alignement et responsabilise les équipes dans la gestion des parties prenantes.
• Impact et stratégie : génère un impact significatif sur les projets et les programmes en assurant la fourniture de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée qui s'alignent sur la stratégie commerciale. Dirige l’évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques, y compris l’analyse avancée de la valeur et l’évaluation des risques, et façonne activement les feuilles de route à long terme.
• Complexité : fonctionne généralement sur plusieurs systèmes dans la sous-fonction, gérant efficacement les exigences très ambiguës et évolutives. Démontre un point de vue de bout en bout pour analyser les problèmes, en tenant compte de la façon dont les données circulent

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

• Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

• Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

• Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, and manage technical deb

In questo ruolo, si progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti dei prodotti, priorità aziendali e standard aziendali, mentre la gestione di requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Si svilupperà e mantenere la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica ai team di prodotti, e valutare le nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

Opportunità - Scope / (Content Leadership): Progetta soluzioni che soddisfino i requisiti dei prodotti, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico contesto di soluzione. Gestisce requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Documenti e evolve l'architettura durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance. - Responsabilità / soluzione dei problemi: risolve i problemi complessi prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti e esercitando giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione.

Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il panorama attuale della soluzione. Valuta e consulta gli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, il rischio e il paesaggio applicativo. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, Taxenomics e Ontologies per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli e garantisce che siano registrati adeguatamente Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). - Gestione delle parti interessate: illustra informazioni difficili o sensibili chiaramente e attivamente lavora per costruire il consenso tra le parti interessate.

Guida la condivisione delle informazioni e lo scambio sulla soluzione. - Impact/Strategy: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce supervisione tecnica, orientamento e consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico e ricerca, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica le opportunità di migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali. - Complessità / (Dimensioni del prodotto): funziona principalmente all'interno di un contesto definito di soluzione.

- Business / Technical abilità: Applica conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due settori tecnologici. Contribuisce in modo minimale ma efficace allo sviluppo delle pratiche di architettura e di mentoring. Chi sei Istruzione / esperienza - esperienza dimostrativa che progetta soluzioni basate su business, basate su standard, future-ready in un contesto specifico di soluzione. - esperienza mantenendo la visione, roadmap, e paesaggio attuale per soluzioni tecniche, e valutando l'impatto delle iniziative sui paesaggi di rischio e di applicazione.

Capacità tecniche - Conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due settori tecnologici. - Professionalità nella creazione di modelli di dati concettuali e logici, di Taxonomie e di Ontologies per soluzioni e interfacce. - Capacità di definire e guidare architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness. - Capacità di guidare tendenze tecnologiche esterne e valutare la fattibilità della soluzione, comprese valutazioni dei fornitori.

Qualificazioni aggiuntive - Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di spiegare informazioni difficili o sensibili e costruire con successo il consenso. - Mindset proattivo per individuare opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Der Positionslösungsarchitekt - DIA R&D Der Solution Architect konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von geschäftsorientierten, standardbasierten und zukunftsfähigen Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. In dieser Funktion entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards entsprechen, während Sie nicht-funktionale Anforderungen (NFRs) und Fitnessfunktionen verwalten. Sie entwickeln und pflegen die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts, stellen Produktteams technische Aufsicht bereit und bewerten neue Technologien, um bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten.

The Opportunity - Scope / (Content Leadership): Lösungen für die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. Verwalten von nicht-funktionalen Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen. Dokumente und entwickeln die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und stimmen mit der Architektur-Community für Governance überein. - Accountability/Problemlösung: Lösen komplexe Probleme, indem Sie eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen nehmen und Urteile auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen ausüben.

Bewahrt die Vision, die Roadmap und die aktuelle Landschaft für die Lösung. Assesses und berät über die Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erstellt Konzept- & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies und Ontologies für die Lösung und ihre Schnittstellen. Definiert und treibt Referenzarchitekturen, Muster und sorgt dafür, dass Architekturentscheidungs-Datensätze (ADRs) angemessen aufgezeichnet werden. - Archivverwaltung: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar und aktiv, um Konsens zwischen den Stakeholdern zu schaffen.

Fördert den Informationsaustausch und den Austausch über die Lösung. - Impact/Strategy: Entwickelt und pflegt die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Beratung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden, erforscht, bewertet, Piloten und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert und Geschäftsprozessen. - Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Operiert in erster Linie innerhalb eines definierten Lösungskontexts.

- Business / Technical ability: Applys allgemeines und vertieftes Wissen in einem oder zwei Technologiebereichen. Trägt minimal, aber effektiv zur Entwicklung und Mentoring von Architekturpraktiken bei. Wer Sie sind Bildung / Erfahrung - Demonstrierte Erfahrung, die Business-getriebene, standardbasierte, zukunftsfähige Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext entwirft. - Erfahrung mit der Aufrechterhaltung der Vision, Roadmap und der aktuellen Landschaft für technische Lösungen und die Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Initiativen auf Risiko- und Anwendungslandschaften.

Technische Fähigkeiten - Allgemeines und fundiertes Wissen in einem oder zwei Technologiebereichen. - Kompetenz bei der Erstellung von Konzept- und Logikdatenmodellen, Taxonomien und Ontologien für Lösungen und Schnittstellen. - Fähigkeit, Referenzarchitekturen, Muster, NFRs und Fitnessfunktionen zu definieren und zu steuern. - Starke Fähigkeit, externe Technologietrends zu steuern und die Machbarkeit der Lösung zu bewerten, einschließlich der Durchführung von Lieferantenbewertungen.

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen - Starke Kommunikation und Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, schwierige oder sensible Informationen zu erklären und erfolgreich Konsens zu schaffen. - Proaktive Denkweise, um Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, Wert und Geschäftsprozesse zu verbessern, bestehende Lösungen zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten.

L'architecte de la solution de poste - R-D DIA L'architecte de la solution se concentre sur la conception de solutions axées sur l'entreprise, fondées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités de l'entreprise et aux normes d'entreprise tout en gérant les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique.

La possibilité - Portée / (Chancement de contenu) : Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique. Documenter et développer l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'aligner sur la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance. - Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Se pose une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes et exerce un jugement sur la base de l'analyse de multiples sources d'information.

Conserve la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution. Évaluer et consulter les impacts et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le paysage d'application.Créer des modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, des taxonomies et des nontologies pour la solution et ses interfaces. Définir et piloter les architectures de référence, les modèles et s'assurer que les dossiers décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) sont bien enregistrés. - Gestion des intervenants : Explique clairement et activement l'information difficile ou sensible afin de créer un consensus entre les intervenants.

- Impact/Stratégie : Concevoir et maintenir la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques pour les équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies.

- Capacités d'affaires / techniques : Applique des connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques. Contribue de façon minimale mais efficace au développement et au mentorat des pratiques d'architecture. Qui vous êtes Éducation / expérience - Expérience démontrée de conception de solutions axées sur les affaires, fondées sur des normes, prêtes à l'avenir dans un contexte de solution spécifique. - Expérience de maintien de la vision, de la feuille de route et du paysage actuel pour des solutions techniques, et d'évaluation des impacts des initiatives sur les paysages à risque et d'application.

Compétences techniques - Connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques. - Compétences en création de modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, de taxonomies et d'études d'interfaces et de solutions. - Capacité de définir et de piloter des architectures de référence, des modèles, des RNF et des fonctions de conditionnement physique. - Capacité solide de stimuler les tendances technologiques externes et d'évaluer la faisabilité de la solution, y compris la réalisation d'évaluations des fournisseurs.

Qualifications supplémentaires - Compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants solides, avec la capacité d'expliquer des renseignements difficiles ou sensibles et de parvenir à un consensus. - L'état d'esprit proactif pour cerner les occasions d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels, d'améliorer les solutions existantes et de gérer la dette technique.

The Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert will provide technical guidance on complex system integrations, drive architectural efficiency, influence technical stakeholder decisions, and mentor cross-functional teams to achieve strategic ecosystem alignment. In this role, you will navigate both organizational and technical complexity to drive the alignment of related roadmaps for large-scale, strategically critical initiatives. Oversees the management of scope changes related to technical endpoints, ensuring strategic alignment across related roadmaps while proactively driving improvements to integration processes.

Accountable for overall system readiness on significant initiatives, defining data and transaction synchronization solutions, and driving consensus through persuasive technical communication. In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esperto di fornitura di sistemi per partner senior - EPIE L'esperto di fornitura di sistemi per partner senior fornirà assistenza tecnica su integrazioni di sistemi complessi, guiderà l'efficienza dell'architettura, influenzerà le decisioni tecniche delle parti interessate e guiderà i team interfunzionali per raggiungere l'allineamento strategico dell'ecosistema. In questo ruolo, ti occuperai sia della complessità organizzativa che tecnica per guidare l'allineamento delle relative roadmap per iniziative su larga scala e strategicamente critiche. Avrai un ruolo fondamentale nella convalida dei test dell'interfaccia, garantendo una perfetta sincronizzazione dei dati e delle transazioni nel panorama più ampio dell'ecosistema. Approfondendo i dettagli tecnici con le parti interessate interne ed esterne, definirai e comunicherai visioni complete di soluzioni di integrazione. A seconda delle esigenze dell'organizzazione, puoi operare all'interno di archetipi di ruolo come Technical Program Manager, Integration Lead, Systems Readiness SME o Technical Delivery Manager. L'opportunità:
• Leadership nell'ambito/contenuto: fornisce una guida tecnica esperta e una direzione strategica sulla definizione e la gestione dell'ambito di integrazioni di sistemi complessi e iniziative di onboarding dei partner. Sviluppa, implementa e sostiene framework di test dell'interfaccia, criteri di preparazione e migliori pratiche di integrazione. Supervisiona la gestione delle modifiche all'ambito relative agli endpoint tecnici, garantendo l'allineamento strategico tra le relative roadmap e promuovendo in modo proattivo miglioramenti ai processi di integrazione.
• Responsabilità/Risoluzione dei problemi: guida l'analisi di complesse questioni di integrazione tecnica oltre i confini dell'ecosistema, individuando requisiti di sistema dettagliati e influenzando le decisioni sull'architettura. Responsabile della disponibilità complessiva del sistema su iniziative significative, della definizione di soluzioni di sincronizzazione di dati e transazioni e della promozione del consenso attraverso una comunicazione tecnica persuasiva. Identifica in modo proattivo i rischi di integrazione, come le discrepanze nella mappatura dei dati, e guida i colleghi nella risoluzione dei problemi tecnici.
• Gestione delle parti interessate: identifica le principali parti interessate interne ed esterne, inclusi responsabili tecnici, architetti aziendali e dirigenti senior delle organizzazioni partner. Sviluppa ed esegue piani di coinvolgimento completi che colmano il divario tra le esigenze aziendali e le realtà tecniche. Approfondisce i dettagli tecnici con le parti interessate, affronta i conflitti relativi alle specifiche dell'interfaccia e costruisce forti relazioni di collaborazione in tutto l'ecosistema.
• Impatto/Strategia: fornisce una leadership tecnica coerente e un impatto significativo sulle principali piattaforme dell'ecosistema. Who you are:

• Maintain proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-driven architecture, or similar technologies.

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including performance tuning and scalability.

• Leverage excellent knowledge of market-available software development tooling to suggest adoption into the current Roche toolset, continuously improving developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

This Programs and Solutions Lead - Supply Chain and Engineering (Procurement) role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation.
As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Supply Chain and Engineering . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:

• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.

• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ).

These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients.
Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow.
You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality.

The Opportunity:

• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Lead your team in a fast-paced global environment to manage a diverse portfolio of solutions and programs (including cost transformations and critical negotiations) that deliver massive value for Supply Chain and Engineering stakeholders.

Como Estagiário de Engenharia - Customer Experience, você integrará a equipe de atendimento ao cliente, oferecendo suporte vital às operações diárias. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar seus conhecimentos técnicos e causar um impacto positivo na experiência dos nossos clientes.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Partner and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments , focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience , ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation , helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• 2-3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset , thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills , with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently , effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are

• Strong client-facing skills including communication, negotiation, and influencing.

• Highly efficient and results-driven, demonstrating strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

• Commercial awareness and product knowledge, plus the ability to be a team player who thrives and collaborates in a cross-functional, fast-changing environment.

• Required education is a Bachelor or Master Degree in Health/Science/Medical disciplines (Tertiary qualification in Science and Business focus is desired), preferably with at least one year of related industry experience.

• High technical ability and computer literacy are required, along with a valid Malaysian driver’s license and the ability to travel interstate; IT, people management, marketing, and business development experience are beneficial.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Product Manager, you will lead the strategic development and implementation guidance of AI & Digital empowered solutions, ensuring strict alignment with business objectives. You will drive the delivery of key initiatives including DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation, and Research Solutions. Success in this position requires partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Customer Engagement (CE), and Access teams to foster strategic synergy and ensure the seamless execution of these digital innovations.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Develop and execute a long-term strategic plan for the assigned AI & Digital empowered solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, or Research Solutions) that aligns with the organization’s overall business goals.
a) Market Intelligence: Conduct regular analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats within the data-driven product management and marketing landscape.
b) Roadmap & Implementation: Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on the deployment of digital solutions; develop and maintain a phased roadmap to ensure structured execution and scalability.
c) Partnership Management: Establish and nurture relationships with external partners—including data providers, technology vendors, and industry experts—to leverage external capabilities and accelerate innovation.
d) Continuous Improvement: Create a systematic mechanism for the ongoing review and optimization of strategies, processes, and product performance across the solution lifecycle.

2. Scientific Leadership & Ecosystem Engagement Reinforce Roche’s position as a scientific leader in the increasingly competitive and evolving Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape.
a) Ecosystem Collaboration: Leverage internal expertise while fostering collaborations with key players in the external AI & Digital Innovation ecosystem to demonstrate scientific value and address stakeholder needs.
b) Value Communication: Ensure the medical and scientific value of the digital solutions is effectively communicated and recognized by the healthcare system, leveraging existing medical team expertise and stakeholder networks.

3. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Ensure strict adherence to corporate policies, SOPs, and local regulations across all initiatives.
a) Medical Governance: Uphold high standards of scientific and medical compliance, ensuring a balanced framework for risk/benefit management specifically tailored to digital health innovations.
b) Regulatory Adherence: Guarantee that all initiatives strictly comply with Roche’s SOPs, codes of conduct, and local regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in life sciences, medicine, or data science, i.e. an MBA, or equivalent combination of scientific and business education/experience is helpful, such as strategy consulting experience
2. >2 years’ experience in medical affairs, marketing, business development, digital innovation in multinational company
Leadership Competencies
1. Strategic agility
2. Technical and business expertise
3. Inspiring and influencing
4. Teamwork and collaboration
5. Experienced strategic thinking and planning skills.
6. Demonstrated ability in cross-functional leadership, cross-industry and ecosystem leadership

Job Req

Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Sviluppare ed eseguire un piano strategico a lungo termine per le soluzioni abilitate AI & Digital (ad esempio, DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, o Research Solutions) che si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali globali dell'organizzazione. a) Market Intelligence: condurre analisi regolari per identificare tendenze, opportunità e minacce all'interno della gestione dei prodotti e del paesaggio di marketing. b) Roadmap & Implementation: Fornire indicazioni strategiche per i team interfunzionali sull'implementazione di soluzioni digitali; sviluppare e mantenere una roadmap graduale per garantire l'esecuzione strutturata e la scalabilità. c) Partnership Management: Stabilire e nutrire relazioni con partner esterni, inclusi fornitori di dati, fornitori di tecnologia e esperti del settore, per sfruttare le capacità esterne e accelerare l'innovazione. d) Miglioramento continuo: creare un meccanismo sistematico per la revisione e l'ottimizzazione in corso di strategie, processi e prestazioni del prodotto attraverso il ciclo di vita della soluzione. 2. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Assicurare una stretta adesione alle politiche aziendali, alle SOP e alle normative locali in tutte le iniziative. a) Governance medica: Mantenere elevati standard di conformità scientifica e medica, assicurando un quadro equilibrato per la gestione dei rischi/benefici specificamente adattato alle innovazioni sanitarie digitali. b) Aderenza normativa: garantire che tutte le iniziative rispettino rigorosamente le SOP di Roche, i codici di condotta e i requisiti normativi locali durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Corso di laurea o superiore in scienze della vita, medicina, o scienza dei dati, cioè un MBA, o combinazione equivalente di formazione scientifica e aziendale / esperienza è utile, come l'esperienza di consulenza strategica 2. > 2 anni di esperienza in affari medici, marketing, sviluppo aziendale, innovazione digitale in multinazionale Competenze di leadership 1. Agilità strategica 2. Competenze tecniche e aziendali 3. Ispirare e influenzare 4. Lavoro di squadra e collaborazione 5. Esperienza di pensiero strategico e capacità di pianificazione. 6. Capacità dimostrata nella leadership interfunzionale, cross-industry e nella leadership dell'ecosistema Lavoro richiesto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Hauptzweck des Jobs (Job Summary) Als KI-Produktmanager leiten Sie die strategische Entwicklungs- und Implementierungsberatung für KI & Digital-fähige Lösungen und gewährleisten eine strikte Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele. Sie werden die Umsetzung wichtiger Initiativen wie DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation und Research Solutions vorantreiben. Erfolg in dieser Position erfordert eine enge Partnerschaft mit Medical Affairs, Customer Engagement (CE) und Access-Teams, um strategische Synergien zu fördern und die nahtlose Umsetzung dieser digitalen Innovationen sicherzustellen. Grundlegende Rollen &
• Verantwortlichkeiten / Verantwortlichkeiten 1. Strategisches Planungs- und Lebenszyklusmanagement Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines langfristigen Strategieplans für die zugewiesenen KI- und Digitallösungen (z. B. DPMM, PLM, Content Generation oder Research Solutions), der sich an den allgemeinen Geschäftszielen des Unternehmens orientiert. a Market Intelligence: Führen Sie regelmäßige Analysen durch, um Trends, Chancen und Bedrohungen innerhalb der datengesteuerten Produktmanagement- und Marketinglandschaft zu identifizieren. b Roadmap & Implementierung: Strategische Anleitung für funktionsübergreifende Teams bei der Bereitstellung digitaler Lösungen; Entwicklung und Pflege einer schrittweisen Roadmap zur Gewährleistung einer strukturierten Ausführung und Skalierbarkeit. c Partnerschaftsmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu externen Partnern - einschließlich Datenanbietern, Technologieanbietern und Branchenexperten -, um externe Fähigkeiten zu nutzen und Innovationen zu beschleunigen. d Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Schaffung eines systematischen Mechanismus für die laufende Überprüfung und Optimierung von Strategien, Prozessen und Produktleistung während des gesamten Lösungslebenszyklus. 2. Wissenschaftliche Führung und Ökosystem-Engagement stärken Roches Position als wissenschaftlicher Marktführer in der zunehmend wettbewerbsorientierten und sich entwickelnden Landschaft für innovative Gesundheitslösungen. a Ecosystem Collaboration: Nutzen Sie internes Know-how und fördern Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Akteuren im externen Ökosystem für KI und digitale Innovation, um den wissenschaftlichen Wert zu demonstrieren und die Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder zu erfüllen. b Wertkommunikation: Sicherstellen, dass der medizinische und wissenschaftliche Wert der digitalen Lösungen vom Gesundheitssystem effektiv kommuniziert und anerkannt wird, indem das vorhandene Fachwissen des medizinischen Teams und die Stakeholder-Netzwerke genutzt werden. 3. Governance, Compliance & Risikomanagement Gewährleistung der strikten Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, SOPs und lokalen Vorschriften in allen Initiativen. a) Medizinische Governance: Hohe Standards der wissenschaftlichen und medizinischen Compliance einhalten und einen ausgewogenen Rahmen für das Risiko-Nutzen-Management sicherstellen, der speziell auf digitale Gesundheitsinnovationen zugeschnitten ist. b Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften: Garantieren Sie, dass alle Initiativen die SOPs, Verhaltenskodizes und lokalen regulatorischen Anforderungen von Roche während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus strikt einhalten. Qualifikation und Erfahrung Bildung/
• Qualifikationen 1. Bachelor-Abschluss oder höher in Life Sciences, Medizin oder Data Science, dh ein MBA oder eine gleichwertige Kombination aus wissenschaftlicher und kaufmännischer Ausbildung / Erfahrung ist hilfreich, wie Strategieberatung Erfahrung 2. >2 Jahre Erfahrung in Medizin, Marketing, Business Development, Digital Innovation in multinationalen Unternehmen Führungskompetenzen 1. Strategische Agilität 2. Technische und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise 3. Inspirieren und beeinflussen 4. Teamwork und Zusammenarbeit 5. Erfahrene strategische Denk- und Planungsfähigkeiten. 6. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeiten in funktionsübergreifender Führung, branchenübergreifender und Ökosystemführerschaft Erforderlicher Arbeitsplatz

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position But principal de l'emploi (résumé de l'emploi) En tant que gestionnaire de produits d'IA, vous dirigerez le développement stratégique et l'orientation de la mise en œuvre des solutions d'IA & Digital, assurant un alignement strict avec les objectifs opérationnels. Vous dirigerez la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives clés telles que DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation et Research Solutions. Pour réussir, il faut s'associer étroitement aux équipes des Affaires médicales, de l'engagement client (EC) et de l'accès pour favoriser la synergie stratégique et assurer l'exécution transparente de ces innovations numériques. Rôles principaux &
• Responsabilités 1. Planification stratégique et gestion du cycle de vie Élaborer et exécuter un plan stratégique à long terme pour les solutions de l'IA et du numérique (p. ex. DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, ou Research Solutions) qui s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de l'organisation. a) Renseignements sur les marchés : Effectuer des analyses régulières pour déterminer les tendances, les possibilités et les menaces dans le contexte de la gestion et de la commercialisation des produits axée sur les données. b) Feuille de route et mise en oeuvre: Fournir des orientations stratégiques aux équipes interfonctionnelles sur le déploiement de solutions numériques; élaborer et maintenir une feuille de route échelonnée pour assurer une exécution structurée et une évolutivité. c) Gestion des partenariats : Établir et entretenir des relations avec des partenaires externes, y compris les fournisseurs de données, les fournisseurs de technologie et les experts de l'industrie, afin de tirer parti des capacités externes et d'accélérer l'innovation. d) Amélioration continue : Créer un mécanisme systématique pour l'examen et l'optimisation continus des stratégies, des processus et des performances du produit tout au long du cycle de vie de la solution. 2. Leadership scientifique et engagement écosystémique Renforcer Roches en tant que leader scientifique dans le paysage de plus en plus concurrentiel et en évolution des solutions de santé innovatrices. a) Collaboration entre les écosystèmes : Tirer parti de l'expertise interne tout en favorisant la collaboration avec les principaux intervenants de l'écosystème externe de l'IA et de l'innovation numérique pour démontrer la valeur scientifique et répondre aux besoins des intervenants. b) Communication de la valeur : S'assurer que la valeur médicale et scientifique des solutions numériques est efficacement communiquée et reconnue par le système de santé, en tirant parti de l'expertise de l'équipe médicale existante et des réseaux d'intervenants. 3. Gouvernance, conformité et gestion des risques Assurer le strict respect des politiques ministérielles, des PON et des règlements locaux dans toutes les initiatives. a) Gouvernance médicale: maintenir des normes élevées de conformité scientifique et médicale, en assurant un cadre équilibré de gestion des risques et des avantages spécialement adapté aux innovations en matière de santé numériques. b) Respect de la réglementation : Garantir que toutes les initiatives respectent strictement les SOP de Roche, les codes de conduite et les exigences réglementaires locales tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Qualification et expérience Éducation/
• Compétences 1. Baccalauréat ou plus en sciences de la vie, médecine ou sciences des données, c'est-à-dire un MBA, ou une combinaison équivalente d'éducation et d'expérience en sciences et en affaires est utile, comme l'expérience de consultation stratégique 2. >2 ans d'expérience en affaires médicales, marketing, développement des entreprises, innovation numérique dans l'entreprise multinationale Compétences en leadership 1. Agilité stratégique 2. Expertise technique et commerciale 3. Inspiration et influence 4. Travail d'équipe et collaboration 5. Expérience de la pensée stratégique et des compétences de planification. 6. Capacité démontrée en leadership interfonctionnel, en leadership interindustriel et en leadership écosystémique Emploi requis

jobs.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, translating complex technical concepts into successful solutions addressing problems across R&D laboratories. Your responsibilities will span the entire solution lifecycle, from design to implementation, ensuring solutions meet high-performance standards and security requirements. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of enterprise IT landscapes, driving digital transformation and operational efficiency for organizations across various industries.

The Opportunity

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Solution Design: Architect scalable, secure and cost-effective solutions tailored to business needs.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Understand technical opportunities to improve business value. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value.

Who you are
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

• Hands on experience in creating PoCs

• Previous experience collaborating with R&D users preferred

Technical Skills

• Modern architecture practices, including effective use of non functional requirements

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

La Solution Architect si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready all'interno di uno specifico contesto di soluzione. In questo ruolo, collaborerai con team interfunzionali, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in soluzioni di successo che affrontano problemi nei laboratori R&D. Le tue responsabilità si estenderanno all'intero ciclo di vita della soluzione, dalla progettazione all'implementazione, garantendo soluzioni conformi agli standard e ai requisiti di sicurezza ad alte prestazioni. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per modellare il futuro dei paesaggi IT aziendali, guidare la trasformazione digitale e l'efficienza operativa per le organizzazioni di vari settori.

L'opportunità

• Scope / (Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico Context Solution. Gestisce i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance.

• Solution Design: soluzioni scalabili, sicure e convenienti su misura per le esigenze aziendali.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Sostegni problemi complessi prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti ed esercitando un giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Der Lösungsarchitekt konzentriert sich auf die Gestaltung unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter und zukunftsfähiger Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen und übersetzen komplexe technische Konzepte in erfolgreiche Lösungen, die Probleme in allen F & E-Labors lösen. Ihre Aufgaben erstrecken sich über den gesamten Lösungslebenszyklus, vom Design bis zur Implementierung, und stellen sicher, dass die Lösungen die hohen Leistungsstandards und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen. Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft von Unternehmens-IT-Landschaften zu gestalten und die digitale Transformation und betriebliche Effizienz für Unternehmen in verschiedenen Branchen voranzutreiben.

Die Chance

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Entwirft Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext erfüllen. Verwaltet nichtfunktionale Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen. Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an der Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance aus.

• Solution Design: Architekten skalierbare, sichere und kostengünstige Lösungen, die auf die Geschäftsanforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

• Rechenschaftspflicht / Problemlösung: Löst komplexe Probleme, indem Sie eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen einnehmen und ein Urteil auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen fällen. Behält die Vision, Roadmap und aktuelle Landschaft für die Lösung bei. Beurteilt und berät über die Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erstellt konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für die Lösung und ihre Schnittstellen. Definiert und steuert Referenzarchitekturen, Muster und stellt sicher, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) angemessen aufgezeichnet werden.

• Stakeholder Management: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar und arbeitet aktiv daran, einen Konsens zwischen den Stakeholdern zu schaffen. Fördert den Informationsaustausch und den Austausch über die Lösung.

• Impact/Strategie: Verstehen Sie technische Möglichkeiten, um den Geschäftswert zu verbessern. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Anleitung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und erforscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Wertsteigerung.

Wer du bist
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung bei der Gestaltung unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter, zukunftsfähiger Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext.

• Erfahren Sie, wie Sie die Vision, den Fahrplan und die aktuelle Landschaft für technische Lösungen beibehalten und die Auswirkungen von Initiativen auf Risiko- und Anwendungslandschaften bewerten.

• Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von PoCs

• Frühere Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit R&D-Anwendern bevorzugt

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Moderne Architekturpraktiken, einschließlich der effektiven Nutzung nicht funktionaler Anforderungen

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

L'architecte Solution se concentre sur la conception de solutions axées sur l'entreprise, basées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, transformant des concepts techniques complexes en solutions efficaces pour résoudre les problèmes dans les laboratoires de R-D. Vos responsabilités s'étendront sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la solution, de la conception à la mise en œuvre, en veillant à ce que les solutions répondent aux normes de performance et aux exigences de sécurité. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique de façonner l'avenir des paysages informatiques d'entreprise, de stimuler la transformation numérique et l'efficacité opérationnelle pour les organisations de diverses industries.

L'opportunité

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance.

• Conception de la solution : Solutions d'architecte évolutives, sécurisées et rentables adaptées aux besoins des entreprises.

• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Se pose des problèmes complexes en adoptant une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes et en exerçant un jugement fondé sur l'analyse de multiples sources d'information. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le contexte d'application. Définit et anime les architectures de référence, les modèles et veille à ce que les documents décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) soient dûment enregistrés.

• Impact/Stratégie : Comprendre les possibilités techniques d'améliorer la valeur commerciale. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques aux équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies. Indique les possibilités d'accroître la valeur.

Qui vous êtes
Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée en matière de conception de solutions axées sur l'entreprise, fondées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans un contexte de solution spécifique.

• Expérience du maintien de la vision, de la feuille de route et du paysage actuel pour des solutions techniques, et évaluation de l'impact des initiatives sur les paysages à risques et à applications.

• Mains sur l'expérience dans la création de PoCs

• Expérience antérieure de collaboration avec les utilisateurs de R-D

Compétences techniques

• Pratiques d'architecture moderne, y compris l'utilisation efficace des exigences non fonctionnelles

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:

• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).

• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. Berufserfahrung in der Parenteralia-Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.

• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. Bei der Schichtplanung ist uns Deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

• Effettuare controlli ambientali microbiologici e sono responsabili per la risoluzione dei problemi anche malfunzionamenti difficili presso l'impianto di riempimento e di asciugatura

• Inoltre, si impegna a lavorare come parte del nostro processo CIP per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro

• Si tratta di routine nel trattare i lavori di documentazione e le applicazioni IT comuni (soprattutto MS Office, MES, Unilab).
• Avete una forte comprensione tecnica del funzionamento e della conoscenza degli impianti e delle macchine di produzione.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a pharmaceutical specialist approach / bottling (m/f/d), you are responsible for the preparation, monitoring, cleaning and disinfection of the bottling machine, the freeze drying system and the optical control machines. Responsibility In this role, you are responsible for the safe execution of standard tasks and complex processes in drug processing:
• Ensure the smooth filling of sterile solutions in vials, taking into account the aseptic procedure according to the manufacturing instructions and compliance with GMP and hygiene regulations
• You carry out microbiological environmental controls and are responsible for troubleshooting even difficult malfunctions at the filling and freeze-drying plant
• An important part of your task is also the GMP-compliant documentation and control of the work carried out in production protocols (in the future electronic), electronic logbooks and document books, etc.
• As part of work preparation, you clean, disinfect and sterilize equipment and small parts
• You are responsible for the continuous maintenance and updating of SOPs in the workspace and support the creation of GMP documents (SOPs, forms)
• In addition, engage You are working as part of our CIP process to improve our workflows
• You speak negotiable German and generally have excellent communication skills. As a team player, you are able to work effectively with different stakeholders and communicate complex relationships in an understandable way. You bring that with you
• Ideally, you have completed three years of training as a chemical, pharmaceutical or pharmaceutical-technical assistant (PTA) (m/f/d).
• Your several years of relevant professional experience in pharmaceutical production and, if applicable, professional experience in parenteralia production distinguishes you.
• Well-founded knowledge in the hygiene sector and in compliance with the GMP guidelines are a matter of course for you.
• You are routine in dealing with documentation work and common IT applications (especially MS Office, MES, Unilab).
• You have a strong technical understanding of the operation and knowledge of production plants and machines.
• You like to work in a team and convince through your reliable way of working.
• You openly meet all employees with respect and appreciation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department

Your internship will take place in the "Antibody Development" subchapter, which is part of our organization "Reagent Research and Design”. This subchapter focuses on the development of antibodies for various Roche Diagnostics platforms. During your internship, you will work in the "Recombinant Antibody Formats" group, responsible for cloning and expressing antibodies.
From the very beginning, you will be warmly welcomed into the team and gain exciting insights into various areas. The focus is to ensure a constant learning effect, to support and challenge you, and to offer you the opportunity to contribute your own ideas.

Your Tasks

• You will work on cloning and expressing antibodies in different cells

• You will support our team in optimizing transient transfection protocols through cell line engineering

• You will be responsible for sequencing of hybridoma cell lines.

• You will be involved in expression analyses of cells using various methods

• You will independently perform quality controls of expressed antibodies

• You will have the opportunity to plan and present your experiments independently

Your Profile

• You are enrolled in a master's degree program in biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a comparable field

• You have knowledge of fundamental immunological and molecular biological techniques (cloning, cell culture)

• You enjoy working in a team

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Your Benefits

• Flexible working hours

• €2268 gross monthly compensation for a full-time internship > 3 months

• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our employee cafeteria

• Fitness center on campus

• Networking with other students

• Possibility of accommodation in the Roche Boarding House or convenient transport links to Munich with the Roche Shuttle

Your Application

Please upload only your resume.

Please remember that this internship is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled for the entire period of the internship or, alternatively, at people in a gap year of a maximum of one year (between Bachelor's and Master's studies), where it can be proven in writing at which university/college and exactly when (month/year) within a year the studies will be continued.

Duration : Starting October 1st, 2026 for 6 months.

We do not offer the opportunity to write a Master's Thesis.

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

• Ore lavorative flessibili
• Compensazione mensile lorda per uno stage a tempo pieno > 3 mesi
• Prezzi dei pasti scontati (-50%) nella nostra caffetteria dei dipendenti

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department

Your internship will take place in the "Antibody Development" subchapter, which is part of our organization "Reagent Research and Design”. This subchapter focuses on the development of antibodies for various Roche Diagnostics platforms. During your internship, you will work in the "Recombinant Antibody Formats" group, responsible for cloning and expressing antibodies.
From the very beginning, you will be warmly welcomed into the team and gain exciting insights into various areas. The focus is to ensure a constant learning effect, to support and challenge you, and to offer you the opportunity to contribute your own ideas.

Your Tasks

• You will work on cloning and expressing antibodies in different cells

• You will support our team in optimizing transient transfection protocols through cell line engineering

• You will be responsible for sequencing of hybridoma cell lines.

• You will be involved in expression analyses of cells using various methods

• You will independently perform quality controls of expressed antibodies

• You will have the opportunity to plan and present your experiments independently

Your Profile

• You are enrolled in a master's degree program in biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a comparable field

• You have knowledge of fundamental immunological and molecular biological techniques (cloning, cell culture)

• You enjoy working in a team

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Your Benefits

• Flexible working hours

• €2268 gross monthly compensation for a full-time internship > 3 months

• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our employee cafeteria

• Fitness center on campus

• Networking with other students

• Possibility of accommodation in the Roche Boarding House or convenient transport links to Munich with the Roche Shuttle

Your Application

Please upload only your resume.

Please remember that this internship is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled for the entire period of the internship or, alternatively, at people in a gap year of a maximum of one year (between Bachelor's and Master's studies), where it can be proven in writing at which university/college and exactly when (month/year) within a year the studies will be continued.

Duration : Starting October 1st, 2026 for 6 months.

We do not offer the opportunity to write a Master's Thesis.

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

We look forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Ermäßigte Mahlzeitenpreise (-50%) in unserer Mitarbeitercafeteria

• Networking mit anderen Studierenden

Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.
