jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Senior Buyer Specialist , serás responsable de liderar y estructurar la nueva área de compras directas dentro de la afiliada de Chile Diagnóstica, sirviendo como una pieza fundamental del plan de acción estratégico GARA. Tu objetivo central será desarrollar e implementar buenas prácticas de abastecimiento estratégico, optimizando el gasto con proveedores, liderando licitaciones complejas bajo entornos de alta presión y mitigando los riesgos del proceso para alcanzar las metas de ahorros, flujo de caja, cumplimiento y rentabilidad del negocio.

The Opportunity

• Desarrollar y ejecutar el plan anual de abastecimiento estratégico y licitaciones para las principales categorías de compras directas en alineación con los objetivos de la afiliada.

• Liderar de punta a punta los procesos de licitación, negociación y análisis comparativo de propuestas comerciales con proveedores locales y regionales.

• Actuar como un socio estratégico del negocio ( Business Partner ), involucrándote tempranamente con las diversas áreas internas para atender y planificar de forma óptima sus requerimientos en proyectos críticos y soluciones digitales tipo LIS.

• Garantizar el estricto cumplimiento de los requerimientos de Compliance , debida diligencia ( Due Diligence ) y códigos de conducta en todo el ciclo de requisición a pago (RSS).

• Identificar, evaluar y mitigar los riesgos de suministro mediante análisis integrales de SRM ( Supplier Relationship Management ) para diseñar planes de contingencia que aseguren la continuidad del negocio.

• Liderar la clasificación, evaluación y gestión del desempeño de proveedores bajo Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) e indicadores clave (KPIs) bien definidos.

• Configurar, administrar y brindar entrenamiento al equipo y usuarios internos en el uso de plataformas y herramientas de compras corporativas (como SAP, Monday, etc.).

• Velar por el desarrollo de capacidades técnicas y la correcta asignación de códigos de categorías de compra (JCCs) desde que nace la necesidad del negocio hasta la emisión de órdenes de compra.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado con título universitario en Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines al área de Abastecimiento y Operaciones.

• Experiencia sólida y demostrable de entre 5 y 10 años en áreas de compras, Procurement o abastecimiento estratégico, con una destacada trayectoria liderando licitaciones complejas en la industria o sectores corporativos.

• Alta resiliencia y capacidad comprobada para gestionar la presión del entorno y alinear con éxito las expectativas de múltiples stakeholders y directivos internos.

• Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de gasto, principios de Category Management y aplicativos de gestión de compras (SAP avanzado, Monday o similares).

• Enfoque analítico y ágil con orientación a resultados (ahorros, capital de trabajo, eficiencia operativa) y excelente capacidad de negociación persuasiva.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

The Position
Business Analyst - Dia Comm Ops Agiloft

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As part of our visionary team, you will step into a high-impact environment where complex challenges inspire sustainable business transformations. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, applying advanced systems thinking to shape long-term strategic roadmaps across interconnected enterprise networks. Joining us means driving innovation at scale, mentoring the next generation of analysts, and directly influencing the digital future of global healthcare.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist as part of the Demand to Pay department maintains and supports the daily activities of the Travel and Expense and Company Card expenses associated with the Roche Global Credit card programs. This role is expected to offer a high level of customer service as this is the first point of contact for our internal customers.

• Customer Support: Act as the primary point of contact for internal customers, providing high-quality support and guidance for corporate credit cards and Concur expense management via calls and tickets.

• Ticket & Case Management: Own, track, and resolve Help Desk tickets efficiently—aiming for same-day resolution—while making decisions on first-level issues and further actions.

• System Administration: Handle day-to-day administrative duties within the Concur system to keep the platform running smoothly.

• SLA & KPI Compliance: Ensure all services are delivered with high quality and accuracy, strictly adhering to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), KPIs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Documentation & Training: Build and maintain up-to-date documentation for business systems and processes, and deliver process training to end-users as requested.

• Reporting & Monitoring: Manage scheduled and ad-hoc reporting and monitoring activities, proactively applying system fixes and communicating resolutions clearly.

• Team Collaboration & Growth: Participate in team availability planning (holidays/training) and contribute to the onboarding and implementation of new tasks arriving at the Roche-Budapest site.

Who you are

• Self-motivated and passionate about the job, understanding the importance of providing high-quality service.

• Open-minded, dedicated to making a difference, and open to constant development.

• Experience in a shared service environment, preferably in the customer service area.

• Experience with corporate credit card programs is an advantage.

• Fluency in English and Turkish Speaking .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - ERP Data Platform
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Platform Engineer - ERP Data Platform

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architect, you will lead the technical strategy and operational framework for our B DC ecosystem, driving the modernization of legacy SAP BW/4HANA environments to SAP Datasphere . In this role, you will act as a vital bridge between foundational platform engineering, regulatory compliance, and business domain-driven data productization. You will join a forward-thinking team dedicated to building scalable, inclusive, and cutting-edge data solutions that empower global healthcare discovery.

The Opportunity

• Lead and define the Business Data Cloud (BDC) Solution Architecture, ensuring seamless technical alignment with global "Cloud First" and data mesh strategies.

• Design and implement critical "Architectural Guardrails" alongside deep-dive assessments of S/4HANA backend readiness—focusing on Core Data Services (CDS) view compatibility—to maintain a highly compliant, scalable, and audit-ready environment.

• Oversee the technical lifecycle of Datasphere Spaces, governing everything from automated provisioning and resource allocation to decommissioning standards.

• Maintain the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) blueprint for the Data Model Lifecycle, facilitating automated promotion across our 4-tier landscape (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) while optimizing the Flexible Capacity Unit (CU) model.

• Architect complex, bi-directional data sharing (Zero-Copy) between SAP Datasphere and external ecosystems like Snowflake, ensuring high-performance integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and existing DataOne architecture.

• Embed essential compliance and governance directly into the platform setup, integrating Good Practice (GxP) and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) qualification evidence while managing automated platform vulnerability patching.

• Collaborate closely with Data Teams to enforce metadata management and tagging strategies required for marketplace publication and seamless Collibra synchronization.

• Architect robust security access designs , including Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies, data privacy/masking layers (ensuring GDPR/CCPA compliance), and global data modeling design standards.

Who you are

• Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Years of Experience: You bring 5+ years of

Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architetto, guiderai la strategia tecnica e il quadro operativo per il nostro ecosistema B DC, guidando l'ammodernamento degli ambienti SAP BW/4HANA legacy a SAP Datasphere . In questo ruolo, si agirà come un ponte vitale tra l'ingegneria della piattaforma di base, la conformità normativa e la produzione di dati a dominio aziendale. Ti unirai a un team avanzato dedicato alla costruzione di soluzioni dati scalabili, inclusive e all'avanguardia che consentano la scoperta globale della salute. L'opportunità
• Guida e definisce l'Architettura della Soluzione Business Data Cloud (BDC) garantendo un allineamento tecnico senza interruzioni con le strategie globali di "Cloud First" e di data mesh.
• Progettare e implementare critici "Architetture Guardrails" insieme a valutazioni approfondite della prontezza di backend S/4HANA, focalizzandosi sulla compatibilità di vista Core Data Services (CDS), per mantenere un ambiente altamente conforme, scalabile e pronto all'audit.
• Superare il ciclo di vita tecnico di Datasphere Spaces, governando tutto dal provisioning automatizzato e allocazione delle risorse agli standard di decommissione.
• Mantenere la continua integrazione e la continua distribuzione (CI/CD) del ciclo di vita del modello di dati, facilitando la promozione automatizzata attraverso il nostro paesaggio a 4 livelli (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) ottimizzando al contempo il modello di unità di capacità flessibile (CU).
• La condivisione di dati bidirezionali (Zero-Copy) tra SAP Datasphere e ecosistemi esterni come Snowflake, assicura un'integrazione ad alte prestazioni con SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) e l'architettura DataOne esistente.
• Integrare la conformità essenziale e la governance direttamente nella configurazione della piattaforma, integrando Good Practice (GxP) e il controllo interno sulle prove di qualificazione del reporting finanziario (ICFR), gestendo la patch di vulnerabilità della piattaforma automatizzata.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di dati per far rispettare la gestione dei metadati e le strategie di tagging necessarie per la pubblicazione sul mercato e la sincronizzazione senza soluzione di continuità Collibra.
• Architetto robusti progetti di accesso alla sicurezza, comprese le strategie Identity and Access Management (IAM), i livelli di privacy/mascheramento dei dati (conformità GDPR/CCPA) e gli standard globali di progettazione della modellazione dei dati. Chi sei
• Istruzione: Lei ha una laurea o Master in Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, Ingegneria dei dati, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Anni di Esperienza: porti 5+ anni di

En tant qu'ingénieur/architecte de plate-forme de données SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), vous dirigerez la stratégie technique et le cadre opérationnel de notre écosystème B DC, menant à la modernisation des anciens environnements SAP BW/4HANA vers SAP Datasphère . Dans ce rôle, vous agirez comme un pont vital entre l'ingénierie de plate-forme fondamentale, la conformité réglementaire, et la production de données axée sur le domaine des affaires. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'avant-garde dédiée à la construction de solutions de données évolutives, inclusives et de pointe qui permettent la découverte de soins de santé mondiaux. L'opportunité
• Dirigez et définissez l'architecture de solution Business Data Cloud (BDC), assurant un alignement technique sans faille avec les stratégies globales de «Cloud First» et de maillage de données.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des « garde-corps architecturaux » critiques en plus d'évaluer en profondeur l'état de préparation du moteur S/4HANA – mettant l'accent sur la compatibilité des services de données de base (CDS) – afin de maintenir un environnement hautement conforme, évolutif et prêt à l'audit.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie technique des espaces de données, qui régit tout, depuis la fourniture automatisée et l'allocation des ressources jusqu'aux normes de déclassement.
• Maintenir le plan d'intégration et de déploiement continu (IC/CD) pour le cycle de vie du modèle de données, en facilitant la promotion automatisée dans notre paysage à quatre niveaux (boîte à sable, développement, test/qualité, production) tout en optimisant le modèle d'unité de capacité flexible (UC).
• Architecte un partage de données bidirectionnel complexe (Zero-Copy) entre SAP Datasphere et des écosystèmes externes comme Snowflake, assurant une intégration à haute performance avec SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) et l'architecture DataOne existante.
• Intégrer directement la conformité et la gouvernance essentielles à la configuration de la plateforme, en intégrant les preuves de qualification de Bonnes Pratiques (GxP) et de Contrôle Interne sur les Rapports Financiers (ICFR) tout en gérant le patchage automatisé de vulnérabilité de la plateforme.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de données afin d'appliquer les stratégies de gestion des métadonnées et d'étiquetage requises pour la publication sur le marché et la synchronisation transparente de Collibra.
• Architecter des conceptions robustes d'accès à la sécurité, y compris des stratégies de gestion de l'identité et de l'accès (IAM), des couches de confidentialité et de masquage des données (assurer la conformité au RGPD/CCPA) et des normes mondiales de modélisation des données. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, technologie de l'information, génie des données ou un domaine technique connexe.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Diagnostics Operations by maintaining the best performance of our electro-mechanical equipment used in the Facilities/Utilities organization.

The Opportunity:

• You're performing electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electromechanical equipment, HVAC, electrical, refrigeration, and chilled water systems used in Facilities/Utilities. Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• You're using test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild facilities/utilities equipment as required and perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by manufacturing engineers

• You're using maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies and apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

• You're responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• You're completing preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules. You will provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off- hours and weekends. Maintains accurate records of all activities

Who you are:

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years related operations or manufacturing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates Degree or equivalent military training or documented 3 years’ experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: HVAC, Ammonia refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic in an operations or manufacturing setting

• Proficient in Google Office Suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, Email, Calendar

• Knowledge of screw and reciprocal compressors, electrical and controls troubleshooting

• Experience with Precision Maintenance practices; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices)

• Experience with HVAC systems (rooftop units, air handling units, VAVs, fan coil units, electric and gas heaters); chilled water systems (ammonia screw chillers, ammonia and pumps); boilers and hot water systems (gas and electric boilers); refrigeration (stand-alone refrigerator/freezers, walk in coolers and freezers, CO2 refrigeration, and ammonia refrigeration)

• Experience with Building Automation systems

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency

The Position
Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics - Boston

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.
Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.
As an Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics, you will:

• be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role covering the Boston area. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory.

Travel: 50%

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting and problem solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Account Executive - Molekulare Diagnostik - Boston Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function at Roche . We focus on community engagement, modern ways of working, and capability enablement . As Roche Digital Technology (RDT) shifts to a "Federated by Design" model, our success relies entirely on transitioning from static architecture documents to dynamic, data-driven insights .
We connect and empower architects across our global, federated organization to design sustainable technology solutions using shared principles and active communities . To achieve our 2026 strategic goals, we need a visionary architect to build a resilient, fully integrated toolchain ecosystem that drives data-driven portfolio management and landscape consolidation .
The Role: What You Will Do
As the Solution Architect for the Integrated Toolchain , you will serve as the principal technical mind behind our core corporate platforms: ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) , ArchiSense (our custom AI Co-Pilot) , and ITONICS (Innovation Management) . You will bridge the gap between architectural data and strategic execution .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Drive EAM Tooling Excellence: Serve as the technical owner for ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) . You will configure core data models and drive advanced automated integrations with ServiceNow and cloud discovery tools to deliver a real-time, comprehensive view of our IT landscape .

• Advance AI-Driven Architecture: Lead the technical scaling of ArchiSense, maturing it from a proof-of-concept into a production-grade AI Co-Pilot . You will build custom AI agents to automate queries, execute tasks, and streamline technology standard navigation .

• Champion Data Democratization: Design, extract, and publish source-system-oriented data products directly into the Roche DataOne (Snowflake) environment and Data Marketplace (Collibra) to enable intuitive, self-service data consumption for downstream analytics .

• Lead Technology Foresight Integration: Maintain technical ownership and oversee the integration of the ITONICS platform to effectively map external market trends and emerging technology phases .

• Enable Data-Driven Portfolio Management: Architect a seamless toolchain that bridges corporate strategy and engineering execution, providing clear, transparent insights into dependencies, technical debt, and redundancies for senior leadership .

• Embed "Decisions Over Documents" Practices: Partner with Architecture Practice Leads to embed practical governance guardrails directly into the tooling ecosystem, reducing administrative friction for engineering teams .

Who You Are
Education & Experience

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or IT .

• You bring 5-7+ years of applied experience in solution architecture, integration engineering, or platform development within complex, matrixed global organizations .

Technical Skills & Expertise

• Python for Data & AI: Proficient in Python for developing data extraction pipelines and orchestrating custom AI workflows (equivalent open-source or advanced project experience is highly valued) .

• Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM): Hands-on experience configuring and adapting core data models within EAM platforms, specifically SAP LeanIX .

• Modern AI & Emerging Tech: Practical familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures . Experience with Model Co

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo Il team Enterprise Architecture Foundations funge da spina dorsale della funzione di architettura a Roche . Ci concentriamo sull'impegno della comunità, sui modi moderni di lavorare e sulla capacità di abilitazione. Mentre Roche Digital Technology (RDT) si sposta verso un modello "Federated by Design", il nostro successo si basa interamente sul passaggio da documenti di architettura statica a intuizioni dinamiche e basate sui dati. Connettiamo e diamo forza agli architetti nella nostra organizzazione globale e federata per progettare soluzioni tecnologiche sostenibili utilizzando principi condivisi e comunità attive . Per raggiungere i nostri 2026 obiettivi strategici, abbiamo bisogno di un architetto visionario per costruire un ecosistema di toolchain resiliente e completamente integrato che guida la gestione del portafoglio e il consolidamento del paesaggio. Il ruolo: cosa farai Come Solution Architect for Integrated Toolchain , servirai come principale mente tecnica dietro le nostre principali piattaforme aziendali: ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) , ArchiSense (nostro AI Co-Pilot) , e ITONICS (Innovation Management) . Verrà colmato il divario tra i dati architettonici e l'esecuzione strategica. Le tue responsabilità principali includono:
• Drive EAM Tooling Excellence: Servire come proprietario tecnico per ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) . Configurate i modelli di dati fondamentali e le integrazioni automatizzate avanzate con gli strumenti di ServiceNow e cloud Discover per offrire una visione in tempo reale e completa del nostro paesaggio IT .
• Architettura avanzata AI-Driven: Guidare la scalatura tecnica di ArchiSense, maturandolo da un proof-of-concept in un AI Co-Pilot di livello di produzione. Costruirete agenti AI personalizzati per automatizzare le query, eseguire le attività e semplificare la tecnologia di navigazione standard.
• Democratizzazione dei dati campione: progettazione, estrazione e pubblicazione di prodotti di dati orientati al sistema sorgente direttamente nell'ambiente Roche DataOne (Snowflake) e Data Marketplace (Collibra) per consentire il consumo di dati intuitivo e self-service per l'analisi a valle.
• Lead Technology Foresight Integration: Mantenere la proprietà tecnica e supervisionare l'integrazione della piattaforma ITONICS per mappare efficacemente le tendenze del mercato esterno e le fasi tecnologiche emergenti.
• Abilitare Data-Driven Portfolio Management: Architetto una toolchain senza soluzione di continuità che collega la strategia aziendale e l'esecuzione di ingegneria, fornendo chiare e trasparenti intuizioni sulle dipendenze, il debito tecnico e le ridondanze per la leadership senior .
• Embed "Decisioni su documenti" Pratiche: Partner con l'Architettura Pratica porta a incorporare i guardrails di governance pratica direttamente nell'ecosistema di utensili, riducendo l'attrito amministrativo per i team di ingegneria. Chi sei Istruzione e esperienza
• Hai una laurea o un master in Informatica, ingegneria del software, o IT .
• Porti 5-7 anni di esperienza applicata in architettura delle soluzioni, ingegneria dell'integrazione o sviluppo della piattaforma all'interno di organizzazioni globali complesse e matrici. Competenze e competenze tecniche
• Python for Data & AI: Proficiente in Python per lo sviluppo di pipeline di estrazione dati e l'orchestrazione di flussi di lavoro AI personalizzati (l'esperienza di progetto open-source o avanzata equivalente è altamente apprezzata) .
• Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM): Hands-on esperienza di configurazione e adattamento dei modelli di dati core all'interno delle piattaforme EAM, in particolare SAP LeanIX .
• Moderno AI & Emerging Tech: familiarità pratica con i modelli di lingua di grandi dimensioni (LLM), ingegneria rapida, e Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architetture . Esperienza con Model Co

Principle Roles &

向经销商商议制定负责区域内经销商年度/季度/月度商业目标，监督经销商建立关键绩效指标跟踪体系，监控业务数据，定期汇报目标达成情况、策略执行效果及市场动态。 针对目标达成偏差，敦促经销商快速制定优化策略与资源配置，确保产品医院端业务稳健发展。

严格遵守中国法律法规及罗氏内部的合规政策，确保所有市场活动合法合规。监控业务流程中的潜在风险及时处理以保障业务健康运行。完成上级主管指派的其他临时性项目工作。

Education/
• Qualifications 教育程度/所获资格证书
医学/药学/本科及以上；
有销售、项目管理或市场营销经验；
5年及以上医药行业经验，其中至少3年销售管理或项目管理经验；
有医院/成熟产品渠道策略制定或运营经验者优先；
具备深度业务洞察能力，具有预见风险能力，并能提供长远发展建议和创新方案 ；
具备客户管理能力，能够分析区域信息，制定区域业务目标和工作计划能力，并能带领团队推动计划执行；
具备项目管理能力，具有多项目和复杂项目的管理知识，能够资源优化配置，有序推动项目计划 具备系统思考能力和区域管理能力；
能进行区域策略制定，流程优化和团队管理能力；
良好的跨部门合作、沟通能力 成长型思维

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader for the Master Data Data Product, you will be a vital member of the MRHub Team within the Data Management & Data Quality Platforms department. Your primary mission is to deliver high-quality IT operation services that empower our business partners to reliably provide life-saving products to patients.
In this role, you will lead the setup and lifecycle management of Master Data Data Products, ensuring they deliver consistent value regardless of the source system (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub).

Job Responsibilities

• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, independent of specific source systems

• Manages and directs a small external team (4 people) delivering the Master Data Data Products and Snowflake capabilities.

• Manages the end‑to‑end request process for new/changed Master Data Data Products: intake, governance board engagement, approvals, coordinating with source system owners.

• Designs and implements the Data Product technically in Snowflake (pipelines, datasets, exposure for consumption).

• Coordinates closely with the Data Quality team and Ataccama so data quality rules run on Snowflake datasets from the Master Data Data Products.

• Serves as the main operational contact for ongoing demand, changes, and incident/support needs around the Master Data Data Products

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data and analytics needs and develop a product roadmap that aligns with business goals.

• Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data and analytics products and ensure what was agreed gets delivered.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure Teams and software developers to ensure that data and analytics products are integrated into existing systems and platforms in a sustainable way that still meets the needs of business to generate the insights necessary to drive their decisions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.

• Extensive experience leading complex data science projects from end-to-end and driving significant business impact.

• Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions.

• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks and best practices.

Technical Skills

• Deep understanding of Master Data, Data Quality and

La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati e innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutto Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader per il Master Data Data Product, sarai un membro vitale del team MRHub all'interno del reparto Gestione dei dati e piattaforme di qualità dei dati. La vostra missione primaria è quella di fornire servizi operativi IT di alta qualità che consentono ai nostri partner commerciali di fornire in modo affidabile prodotti salvavita ai pazienti. In questo ruolo, si porterà la configurazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti Master Data, assicurando che essi forniscono un valore coerente indipendentemente dal sistema sorgente (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub). Responsabilità del lavoro
• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, indipendente da specifici sistemi di sorgente
• Gestisce e dirige un piccolo team esterno (4 persone) che fornisce le funzionalità Master Data Products e Snowflake.
• Gestisce il processo di richiesta end-to-end per i nuovi/cambiati Master Data Data Products: assunzione, governance board engagement, approvazioni, coordinamento con i proprietari di sistemi sorgente.
• Progetta e implementa tecnicamente il Data Product in Snowflake (pipeline, dataset, esposizione al consumo).
• Coordina a stretto contatto con il team di Data Quality e Ataccama così le regole di qualità dei dati vengono eseguite sui dataset di Snowflake dai prodotti Master Data.
• Serve come principale contatto operativo per la domanda, le modifiche e le esigenze di incidente/supporto in tutto il Master Data Products
• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per comprendere le loro esigenze di dati e analisi e sviluppare una roadmap del prodotto che si allinea agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Definire e dare priorità ai requisiti del prodotto, alle storie degli utenti e ai criteri di accettazione dei dati e dei prodotti di analisi e garantire che ciò che è stato concordato venga consegnato.
• Collaborare con i team di infrastruttura e gli sviluppatori di software per garantire che i prodotti di dati e analytics siano integrati in sistemi e piattaforme esistenti in modo sostenibile che soddisfi ancora le esigenze del business per generare le informazioni necessarie per guidare le loro decisioni. • Bachelor o Master in informatica, sistemi informativi, o un campo correlato.
• Esperienza estesa che conduce complessi progetti di scienza dei dati da end-to-end e la guida di impatto commerciale significativo.
• Provato record di lavoro a stretto contatto con la leadership senior per informare e influenzare le decisioni strategiche di business di alto livello.
• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione e nell'attuazione dei quadri di scienza dei dati a livello aziendale e delle migliori pratiche. Competenze tecniche
• Profonda comprensione dei dati master, qualità dei dati e

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position

Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader for the Master Data Data Product, you will be a vital member of the MRHub Team within the Data Management & Data Quality Platforms department. Your primary mission is to deliver high-quality IT operation services that empower our business partners to reliably provide life-saving products to patients.
In this role, you will lead the setup and lifecycle management of Master Data Data Products, ensuring they deliver consistent value regardless of the source system (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub).

Job Responsibilities

• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, independent of specific source systems

• Manages and directs a small external team (4 people) delivering the Master Data Data Products and Snowflake capabilities.

• Manages the end‑to‑end request process for new/changed Master Data Data Products: intake, governance board engagement, approvals, coordinating with source system owners.

• Designs and implements the Data Product technically in Snowflake (pipelines, datasets, exposure for consumption).

• Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data and analytics products and ensure what was agreed gets delivered.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

• ﻿﻿Build and retain an inclusive workforce and foster an environment where diversity of thought and perspective are valued.

• Maintain an inclusive team that values diversity of thought.

• Maintain strong partnerships with leaders to ensure alignment on strategic projects and daily operations.

• ﻿﻿Take the responsibility for department daily SHE management, implement site SHE procedure and program, and achieve site corporate /site SHE KPI. Promote SHE culture and improve employee safety behavior.

• ﻿﻿Manage performance and development team members to achieve organizational goals and employee personal and professional growth.

• Support manager to build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and model lean leadership principles.

• Maintain a culture of transparent, high performance, empowerment and innovation culture.

Technical

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, equipment selection, URS review, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• As a key role, support to establish an effective operation system in alignment with the Roche’s standards, including manufacturing system, CCS strategy, people training and qualification system.

• Lead to establish the procedures related to aseptic techniques, good aseptic practices on the shop floor, and other relevant processes for aseptic production execution.

• Participate in CCS strategy implementation in operation to ensure a sustaining sterility assurance program setting up.

• Support the filling manager to establish the site aseptic training program and implement it, ensure only qualified people perform GMP lots’ manufacturing.

• Ensure team's competencies in performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, depyrogenating, filling and stoppering, crimping.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation compliance with regulations, maintain sterile conditions, and achieve high-quality production standards .

• Ensure total readiness of manufacturing suites, including housekeeping, machine, materials, documents and other resources to ensure product delivery in time and within budget.

• Arrange the filling shifts in routine production, participate in operation as an aseptic SME and perform daily review of production batch record, deviation according to schedule.

• Lead annual aseptic operators’ qualification, provide on-the-job training to support formalized technical and GMP training.

• Oversee the daily operation, monitoring, and maintenance of filling equipment to ensure compliance with aseptic requirements .

• Supervise aseptic operations during production and intervene promptly in case of abnormalities .

• Participate in the response of regulator audit and global quality audit as SME during regulatory inspections and audits.

• Raise deviation and involve the root cause investigation, including appropriate escalation where needed to ensure closure of deviation within the set timeline.

• Raise change control and provide assessment.

• Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.

•

The Position Principle Roles & Responsibilities Leadership & People Management
• Build and retain an inclusive workforce and foster an environment where diversity of thought and perspective are valued.
• Maintain an inclusive team that values diversity of thought.
• Maintain strong partnerships with leaders to ensure alignment on strategic projects and daily operations.
• Take the responsibility for department daily SHE management, implement site SHE procedure and program, and achieve site corporate /site SHE KPI. Promote SHE culture and improve employee safety behavior.
• Manage performance and development team members to achieve organizational goals and employee personal and professional growth.
• Support manager to build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.
• Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and model lean leadership principles.
• Maintain a culture of transparent, high performance, empowerment and innovation culture. Technical Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, equipment selection, URS review, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
• As a key role, support to establish an effective operation system in alignment with the Roche’s standards, including manufacturing system, CCS strategy, people training and qualification system.
• Lead to establish the procedures related to aseptic techniques, good aseptic practices on the shop floor, and other relevant processes for aseptic production execution.
• Participate in CCS strategy implementation in operation to ensure a sustaining sterility assurance program setting up.
• Support the filling manager to establish the site aseptic training program and implement it, ensure only qualified people perform GMP lots’ manufacturing.
• Ensure team's competencies in performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, depyrogenating, filling and stoppering, crimping.
• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.
• Perform other duties as assigned. Routine Operation:
• Ensure routine operation compliance with regulations, maintain sterile conditions, and achieve high-quality production standards .
• Ensure total readiness of manufacturing suites, including housekeeping, machine, materials, documents and other resources to ensure product delivery in time and within budget.
• Arrange the filling shifts in routine production, participate in operation as an aseptic SME and perform daily review of production batch record, deviation according to schedule.
• Lead annual aseptic operators’ qualification, provide on-the-job training to support formalized technical and GMP training.
• Oversee the daily operation, monitoring, and maintenance of filling equipment to ensure compliance with aseptic requirements .
• Supervise aseptic operations during production and intervene promptly in case of abnormalities .
• Participate in the response of regulator audit and global quality audit as SME during regulatory inspections and audits.
• Raise deviation and involve the root cause investigation, including appropriate escalation where needed to ensure closure of deviation within the set timeline.
• Raise change control and provide assessment.
• Execute regular validation activities, such as APS. •

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant qu' Ingénieur Réseau Terrain (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à collaborer avec les équipes supports et IT sur des missions liées à l'installation et à la maintenance des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d'analyses médicales (privés et hospitaliers).

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités :

• Concevoir les schémas réseau, les matrices de flux et assurer leur déploiement. Gestion de son parc informatique et mise à jour des documents clients (Document d’Architecture Technique, Document d’Exploitation)

• Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Spécialiste IT et Workflow.

• Garantir les plans d'actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. Agir rapidement lors d’élaboration de PRI (Plan de Réponse aux Incidents)

• Effectuer les rétrofits hardware / software IT réseau Roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions chez nos clients.

• Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche.

• Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting précis de vos interventions et des mises à niveau .

Votre profil :

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou Master spécialisé en informatique et réseaux.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (réseaux, pare-feu, accès) des infrastructures informatiques clients.

• Aisance à l’oral, levée d’objection étant identifié comme Interlocuteur privilégié des Directions des Services Informatiques (DSI) pour expliquer les pré requis d’installation des solutions digitales Roche et échanger sur les besoins clients.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'ingénieur principal dirigera le cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'algorithme, depuis le développement jusqu'à la validation jusqu'au déploiement réglementaire, pour assurer l'alignement avec les cadres de gouvernance GxP, SaMD et Imaging. Agissant en tant que point unique de responsabilisation pour gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS, le rôle fournira des capacités de plate-forme analytique évolutives, favorisera l'automatisation et assurera l'application uniforme des normes de qualité, de documentation et de conformité. Cette position stimule la vision, la stratégie et l'exécution de l'écosystème de l'algorithme d'imagerie, permettant un développement et un déploiement plus rapides, reproductibles et conformes dans les domaines de la recherche et de la clinique. Vous serez responsable de la définition des tâches pour les autres et de la conduite d'initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle à travers un produit. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous entraînerez et dirigerez d'autres ingénieurs, excellerez dans les négociations avec les intervenants et fournirez une orientation pour les objectifs à moyen et à long terme. Vous contribuerez activement aux connaissances techniques, inspirerez l'innovation et dirigerez la conception de solutions multiservices et multimodales complexes. Avec une expertise en architecture et en interopérabilité des modèles AI/ML, des cadres d'applications d'analyse avancés et des fonctionnalités cloud, vous favoriserez la cohérence architecturale, piloterez la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants, et mentorez les ingénieurs seniors pour assurer les plus hautes normes de qualité d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle d'ingénieur principal exige un engagement quotidien avec les partenaires scientifiques, réglementaires, cliniques et informatiques afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie, l'établissement des priorités et l'exécution afin de renforcer la collaboration et la visibilité entre les équipes mondiales, fournissant un pont direct entre la gouvernance de l'imagerie, le développement de l'algorithme et les opérations de la plateforme. La possibilité :
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route des produits multimodaux (y compris la radiologie et la pathologie numérique) Imager des données et des informations au sein de la plateforme mondiale d'imagerie (GIP).
• Privilégier et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives qui améliorent la qualité des données, leur accessibilité et leur réutilisabilité pour la R-D, la recherche translationnelle et le développement clinique.
• Agir en tant que principal propriétaire du produit pour les applications d'analyse des modalités d'imagerie, en coordonnant les applications gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS.
• Partenaire avec des pistes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques pour traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques évolutives et conformes.
• Gérer les relations avec les intervenants et les collaborations externes pour assurer l'interopérabilité, la conformité et l'alignement stratégique.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie de bout en bout des applications d'analyse de données d'imagerie multimodale, de visualisation et d'analyse.
• Assurer la prestation en temps opportun des améliorations apportées aux produits, des flux de travail normalisés et l'intégration d'outils compatibles avec l'IA/ML.
• Collaborer avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de qualité et de réglementation pour assurer le respect des normes GxP, FAIR et de gouvernance des données.
• Conduire l'alignement entre les fonctions R-D, Diagnostics et Data Science pour permettre le partage des données et des pipelines d'analyse et des processus unifiés.
• Gérer les dépendances, les risques et les jalons pour tous les produits de pathologie numérique et communiquer les progrès au moyen des ICR et des rapports de rendement.
• Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des occasions d'accroître l'évolutivité, l'automatisation et l'efficacité des processus d'analyse.
• Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et de la technologie en matière de pathologie numérique, d'IA/ML et de santé numérique pour guider l'innovation continue des produits.
• Identifier et introduire le format commun pour le déploiement, réduire les coûts de conversion et améliorer la vitesse d'inférence dans tous les secteurs

• Cultivate Trusted Partnerships: Proactively engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), external scientific experts, and healthcare stakeholders to foster meaningful, science-driven collaborations.

• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: Systematically gather external clinical insights, utilizing emerging digital tools and AI insights responsibly to anticipate and optimize local medical practice adoption.

• Ensure Absolute Excellence & Compliance: Oversee medical information requests and collaborate with Regulatory and Clinical Operations teams, maintaining strict adherence to industry regulations, ethical standards, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).

Who You Are
You are an entrepreneurial, solution-oriented professional who thrives in cross-functional team environments. You balance deep scientific expertise with the strategic acumen required to navigate ambiguity and communicate complex insights with clarity and impact.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Excellence: You hold an advanced degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

• Professional Experience: You bring proven experience in Medical Affairs or equivalent clinical/scientific expertise within relevant therapeutic areas preferably in Retinal Diseases & Ophthalmology

• Strategic Communication: You possess exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead peer-to-peer scientific dialogue at an executive level in English.

• Digital Literacy: You maintain a growth mindset toward digital tools, demonstrating basic AI literacy and the ability to ensure robust human-in-the-loop oversight of digital content.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Product Development Regulatory Affairs (PDR), a flexible, bold, and distinctive regulatory organization where we make strategic decisions quickly, innovate boldly, and deliver insights that shape our portfolio development. We are seeking a talented professional to help build, mature, and sustain our regulatory business capabilities while fostering a culture of continuous learning and meaningful impact for patients.

The Opportunity:

• Support complex and higher exposure quality and compliance activities , providing guidance and risk assessment to PDR staff on GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR compliance issues, and serving as advisor and subject matter expert for Quality and Compliance-related processes

• Lead deviation management and process management activities, updating and maintaining regulatory documents while sustaining Quality and Compliance operational activities required for maintaining Roche's license to operate and Quality Management System (QMS)

• Oversee training management , scheduling training sessions and ensuring completion across PDR to support our commitment to regulatory compliance and continuous learning

• Prepare and manage compliance reports , monitoring trends in the external compliance environment

• Partner across the enterprise with stakeholders within and beyond PDR (including affiliates, PD quality organizations, and the broader Roche group) to unlock company-wide benefits and ensure regulatory compliance

• Lead increasingly complex deliverables while collaborating cross-functionally with key stakeholders, generating insights, and mentoring peers to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

• Monitor and respond to trends in innovation and the external compliance environment, anticipating changes in the regulatory landscape and assessing future business needs

• Contribute to initiatives that shape our technical, business, and healthcare environments , bringing new ideas into the business and leading them with entrepreneurial mindset

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of relevant regulatory affairs, quality, or compliance experience in the Pharma or Medical Device space, with a proven ability to independently deliver and lead increasingly complex projects and initiatives

• Experience working with health authorities , understanding the global regulatory environment

• Strategic and systems thinker with strong data management, content management, and knowledge management capabilities; experienced in change leadership and operating effectively in matrix environments

• Cross-functional collaboration expert with demonstrated experience in building trusted partnerships across internal and external stakeholders, including health authorities

• Compliance-focused professional with a deep understanding of the global regulatory environment, GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR requirements, and a commitment to maintaining license to operate and integrity

• Continuous learner with a growth mindset, strong communication skills, and ability to seek and act on feedback

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring

jobs.title: Clinical Selling Specialist - Toledo
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Clinician Selling Specialist , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en impulsar la adopción de nuestros biomarcadores y soluciones innovadoras dentro de las comunidades clínicas. Construirás relaciones sólidas con líderes de opinión clave (KOLs), investigadores y proveedores de atención médica para avanzar en nuestra misión de mejorar los resultados de los pacientes a través de la medicina personalizada y una mejor gestión de enfermedades crónicas.

En este rol, serás la persona de referencia para aspectos clínicos y técnicos en el área de Castilla-La Mancha . Serás responsable de promover nuestras soluciones con un enfoque técnico-científico, adaptando las estrategias globales a la realidad local de la Atención Primaria y los centros especializados, asegurando que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a los pacientes adecuados en el momento adecuado.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada (Castilla-La Mancha) 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres
Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: D

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Does a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech business, excite you?

Roche Diagnostics has a superb opportunity for you to grow your skills whilst directly supporting our customers in the Omagh, Enniskillen and border regions , surrounding areas and being part of the field based Engineering team in Ireland.

The successful candidate will provide frontline support covering electro-mechanical hardware routine proactive/reactive work, technical training, upskilling of customers and ensuring all administration and regulatory documentation is maintained. As the first responder for technical, Applications and IT related issues, you will be expected to build your system understanding around the entire customer solution to include information solutions and applications of the Roche diagnostic products.

Key activities will include troubleshooting and ownership of faults, preventative maintenance, fault related data analysis and generation of reports to improve efficiency across Roche’s product portfolio.

You will be accountable for the successful delivery/uptime and overall customer experience of their relevant service offering and you will be accountable for the core service activities efficiently and productively, supporting your customer base.

You will work with peers and key stakeholders to ensure a seamless “sales-service” alignment approach and a differentiated customer offering/solution. You will be a key member of the Technical Services Team in Ireland ensuring the right people are in the right place, with the right skills, capabilities and competencies at the right time.

You should be resilient, and tenacious. You thrive under pressure, working effectively as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines. With strong analytical skills, you are at ease working with technical, scientific and numeric information.

For this position, it is essential that you are already based in the Omagh, Enniskillen or border regions . With this intent in mind, applicants will only be considered if they are currently residing within this geographical area.

You will be expected to work closely with the wider team and all other areas of Roche to provide best-in-class service for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

• Technical success in the delivery of our service offering for our customers, putting the customers at the centre of what we do and working with other technical managers.

• Technical effectiveness by championing and upholding technical excellence in the execution of technical activities across systems, processes, data, capability and competence.

• Technical Customer Centricity by ensuring that we support our customers, react to customer and market demands and continuously strive to achieve technical excellence, inc. continuous improvement and change as necessary.

• Employee Impact by role modelling flexibility, creativity and teamwork behaviours and building effective cross-functional/cross-regional collaboration to multiply your impact.

Who you are

• Ideally Degree-educated, or Diploma level in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent demonstrable experience, you will possess a thorough and up-to-date understanding of the IVD industry and have solid experience in implementing best-in-class support.

• With the ability to provide effective support for pathology laboratory solutions, you will be motivated by exceeding customer expectations and instilling knowledge.

• Self-m

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part of achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspir ation to digitally transform and become a lean organization.

PTE catalyzes the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further de velop Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

As we establish a PT-wide Data Governance framework to orchestrate sustainable solutions, we are looking for a Data Security & Privacy Lead . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the security, privacy, and compliance of PT data. You will collaborate widely with PT regulatory functions, IT, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and monitor policies in line with industry standards. This role is critical in our ongoing dedication to ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance, requiring a strong understanding of data privacy and security needs in a life sciences organization.

The Opportunity
As our Data Security & Privacy Lead, your main responsibilities will be divided into four core pillars:
1. Security & Privacy Policy Definition and Implementation

• Work closely with relevant Roche IT, legal, and regulatory functions to define policies for data acquisition, storage, usage, and deletion to ensure security and privacy across the data lifecycle.

• Partner with System Owners, Data Owners, and IT to ensure security and privacy policies are relevant and applied adequately to existing systems across PT.

• Conduct impact assessments and define implementation strategies for new and updated policies, working closely with business partners to effectively and consistently implement policy.

2. Security & Privacy Compliance

• Collaborate with business domains to effectively monitor privacy and security compliance across multiple systems and platforms.

• Support business domains to appropriately respond to data subject requests and regulatory requirements in a compliant and timely manner.

• Ensure PT data adheres to regulatory requirements and global data protection laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPA).

• Coordinate architectural design decisions affecting security and privacy by design principles throughout the solution development lifecycle.

3. Advisory & Advocacy

• Act as the primary point of contact and provide expertise for staff regarding data privacy and protection obligations, including information governance activities and information security.

• Continuously train, upskill, and raise awareness for privacy and security maturity in PT. Lead policy-specific awareness activities, working with the Data Culture Lead where relevant to ensure PT-wide understanding and effective adoption.

4. Risk Monitoring & Escalation

• Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits, scoping and suggesting mitigations to ensure data security and privacy practices are adhered to, and the risk of future incidents is reduced.

• Leverage comprehensive knowledge of Roche escalation pathways and risk mit

Questa posizione richiede una forte e agile miscela di conoscenze di produzione, consapevolezza della sicurezza informatica e gestione eccezionale degli stakeholder a livello del sito. • Consapevolezza di sicurezza OT: Promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza in loco, elevando la consapevolezza intorno ai rischi e alle best practice di Operational Technology (OT).
• Integrazione strategica: colmare il divario tra le iniziative globali di sicurezza delle imprese e le realtà operative locali, garantendo un'implementazione regolare senza interrompere i flussi di produzione.
