jobs.title: Supply Chain Excellence Chapter Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose

To lead end-to-end supply chain operations for the affiliate, ensuring patients and healthcare providers have timely access to Roche’s diagnostic solutions. Guided by Roche’s purpose of "doing now what patients need next," this role also needs to focus on managing 4PL partnerships, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving operational excellence in alignment with global and regional strategies. Furthermore, this role dedicates 20% of its capacity to act as the "FSCP Business Partner," shifting from managing functional silos to orchestrating holistic value, aiming to empower the Commercial teams to achieve aggressive sales growth. Additionally, this position serves as the Transport Safety Advisor, coordinating compliance for dangerous goods, and the Export Control Officer, ensuring adherence to corporate export guidelines.
Job scope:
## Key Responsibilities – Supply Chain Excellence Chapter Lead
1. FSCP Business Partnering (20% Time Allocation) – Focused on Accelerating Sales Growth
• Act as the SPOC to Accelerate Deal Closures (擔任單一窗口，加速案件成交): Act as the dedicated Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Commercial teams. Proactively resolve cross-functional bottlenecks (e.g., integrating supply availability, logistics planning, and financial terms) to accelerate sales velocity and improve customer responsiveness.
• Internal Orchestration via T-shaped Skills (運用T型能力進行內部整合): Cultivate and utilize T-shaped interdisciplinary capabilities to independently coordinate within Finance, Supply Chain, and Procurement silos. Deliver holistic, "ready-to-execute" solutions to the Commercial team, minimizing their communication efforts.
2. Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence
• Strategy Execution: Design and execute supply chain strategies that reflect Roche’s mission of improving lives through diagnostics.
• S&OP Ownership: Lead the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process to ensure high demand forecast accuracy and alignment with commercial objectives.
• End-to-End Oversight: Oversee all supply chain facets, including demand planning, inventory management, procurement, distribution, and customer order management.
• Continuous Improvement: Utilize data-driven insights and Lean principles to identify cost-saving opportunities and enhance speed to market.
• Process Standardization & SOP Management: Lead the creation, regular update, and effective implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance or improve supply chain processes in accordance with Roche Supply Chain Standards.
3. 4PL & Logistics Provider Management
• Primary Interface: Act as the lead contact for the external 4PL partner and other logistics providers to coordinate transportation, distribution, and warehousing.
• Performance Monitoring: Evaluate 4PL performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs, including delivery accuracy, lead times, and cost efficiency.
• Optimization & Risk Mitigation: Partner with providers to optimize logistics models and resolve operational issues promptly to maintain business continuity.
4. Stakeholder Collaboration & Compliance
• Cross-functional Partnership: Collaborate with Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Regulatory, and Quality teams to create a cohesive supply chain aligned with business needs.
• Quality & Regulatory Standards: Ensure all warehouse and transportation practices conform to Roche’s Quality Standards, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), and local/international regulations.
• Risk Management: Proactively ide

• Strategy Execution: Progettare ed eseguire strategie di supply chain che riflettono la missione di Roche di migliorare le vite attraverso la diagnostica.
• S&OP ProprietÃ: Guidare il processo di pianificazione delle vendite e delle operazioni (S&OP) per garantire alta precisione e allineamento delle previsioni di domanda con obiettivi commerciali.
• Supervisione end-to-end: supervisionare tutte le sfaccettature della supply chain, compresa la pianificazione della domanda, la gestione dell'inventario, l'approvvigionamento, la distribuzione e la gestione dell'ordine del cliente.

• Partenariato interfunzionale: collaborare con i team Marketing, Commerciale, Finanza, Regolazione e Qualità per creare una catena di fornitura coerente con le esigenze aziendali.
• Standard di qualità e regolamentazione: assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche di magazzino e di trasporto siano conformi agli standard di qualità di Roche, alla buona prassi di distribuzione (PIL) e alle normative locali/internazionali.

• Primäre Schnittstelle: Handeln Sie als Hauptansprechpartner für den externen 4PL-Partner und andere Logistikanbieter, um Transport, Verteilung und Lagerhaltung zu koordinieren.
• Performance Monitoring: Bewerten Sie die 4PL-Leistung anhand vereinbarter SLAs und KPIs, einschließlich Liefergenauigkeit, Durchlaufzeiten und Kosteneffizienz.
• Optimierung & Risikominderung: Partnerschaft mit Anbietern, um Logistikmodelle zu optimieren und operative Probleme umgehend zu lösen, um die Geschäftskontinuität aufrechtzuerhalten. 4. Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit & Compliance
• Funktionale Partnerschaft: Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-, Handels-, Finanz-, Regulierungs- und Qualitätsteams, um eine zusammenhängende Lieferkette zu schaffen, die auf die Geschäftsanforderungen ausgerichtet ist.
• Qualitäts- und Regulierungsstandards: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Lager- und Transportpraktiken den Qualitätsnormen, der Good Distribution Practice (GDP) und den lokalen / internationalen Vorschriften von Roche entsprechen.
• Risikomanagement: Proaktiv ide

De plus, ce rôle consacre 20% de sa capacité à agir en tant que « partenaire d'affaires FSP », passant de la gestion de silos fonctionnels à l'orchestration de valeur holistique, visant à autonomiser les équipes commerciales pour atteindre une croissance agressive des ventes. • Surveillance de bout en bout : Surveiller toutes les facettes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, y compris la planification de la demande, la gestion des stocks, les achats, la distribution et la gestion des commandes.

• Partenariat interfonctionnel : Collaborer avec des équipes de marketing, commercial, financier, réglementaire et de qualité pour créer une chaîne d'approvisionnement cohérente et adaptée aux besoins des entreprises.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, CHT, SHT etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• Support the initial development and optimization of logistic processes.

• Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, e.g. draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.

• Trained and qualified on equipment operation and procedure.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.

• Performing the following tasks: e.g. facility cleaning, cleanroom garments preparation, cleaning and sterilization of components.

• Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.

• Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.

• Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.

• Support regular validation activities, such as autoclave requalification.

• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.

• Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications

• College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.

• Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.

• Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The ERP Business Operations team runs the operational engine behind this massive unit . We turn complex workforce, financial, and delivery data into the high-impact insights and strategic decisions that keep our global ecosystem moving forward .

We are looking for an independent, tech-savvy, and genuinely curious Business Analyst to own key operational domains end-to-end . You won't just compile spreadsheets; you will instinctively leverage data tooling, automation, and AI to make operations faster, cleaner, and more reliable .
Your core responsibilities will include:

• Workforce & Resource Analytics: Own and maintain the unit's comprehensive global workforce data baseline (internal FTEs, external partners, location strategies, and capacity scaling models) while ensuring absolute data consistency .

• Financial Planning & Budget Tracking: Support budget planning, forecasting, and planned-vs-actual cost tracking . You will reconcile data across sustainment and program lines, investigate variances, and prepare reports that withstand executive scrutiny .

• Leadership Reporting: Prepare and quality-assure recurring status reports, KPI dashboards, and critical decision-support materials for the ERP Leadership Team and governance bodies .

• Process Optimization & AI Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and pragmatically redesign them using advanced spreadsheets, BI dashboards, and emerging AI productivity tools .

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as a dependable contact point across Value Streams (Digital Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing), chasing inputs, managing deadlines, and navigating stakeholder pushback constructively .

• Initiative & Content Leadership: Independently structure and drive complex analysis topics sponsored by the Head of ERP, defining problem spaces, performing root-cause analyses, and bringing clear recommendations to a decision .

Who You Are
Experience & Background

• 5+ years of experience in business analysis, business operations, PMO, or financial analysis within a digital technology or large-scale transformation environment .

• A proven track record of independently owning ambiguous analysis topics from a vague question down to a structured, leadership-ready presentation .

• Experience working within global matrix organizations, massive ERP/SAP environments, or regulated fields (Pharma/Biotech) is a major plus .

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
The ERP team at Roche manages the enterprise’s unified digital backbone, supporting over 100,000 users across more than 100 countries . Our mission is to operate, protect, scale, and innovate the ERP/SAP systems that ensure the reliable delivery of medicines and diagnostics globally . This includes driving the ASPIRE program—one of the healthcare industry’s largest digital transformations, migrating our global footprint to SAP S/4HANA .
The ERP Business Operations team runs the operational engine behind this massive unit . We turn complex workforce, financial, and delivery data into the high-impact insights and strategic decisions that keep our global ecosystem moving forward .

The Role: What You Will Do
We are looking for an independent, tech-savvy, and genuinely curious Business Analyst to own key operational domains end-to-end . You won't just compile spreadsheets; you will instinctively leverage data tooling, automation, and AI to make operations faster, cleaner, and more reliable .
Your core responsibilities will include:

• Workforce & Resource Analytics: Own and maintain the unit's comprehensive global workforce data baseline (internal FTEs, external partners, location strategies, and capacity scaling models) while ensuring absolute data consistency .

• Financial Planning & Budget Tracking: Support budget planning, forecasting, and planned-vs-actual cost tracking . You will reconcile data across sustainment and program lines, investigate variances, and prepare reports that withstand executive scrutiny .

• Leadership Reporting: Prepare and quality-assure recurring status reports, KPI dashboards, and critical decision-support materials for the ERP Leadership Team and governance bodies .

• Process Optimization & AI Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and pragmatically redesign them using advanced spreadsheets, BI dashboards, and emerging AI productivity tools .

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as a dependable contact point across Value Streams (Digital Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing), chasing inputs, managing deadlines, and navigating stakeholder pushback constructively .

• Initiative & Content Leadership: Independently structure and drive complex analysis topics sponsored by the Head of ERP, defining problem spaces, performing root-cause analyses, and bringing clear recommendations to a decision .

Who You Are
Experience & Background

• 5+ years of experience in business analysis, business operations, PMO, or financial analysis within a digital technology or large-scale transformation environment .

• A proven track record of independently owning ambiguous analysis topics from a vague question down to a structured, leadership-ready presentation .

• Experience working within global matrix organizations, massive ERP/SAP environments, or regulated fields (Pharma/Biotech) is a major plus .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Data Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel (complex modeling, large datasets, data hygiene) and hands-on experience with BI tools like Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau .

• Tech-Savvy & AI-Curious: A distinct passion for experimenting with and adopting new technologies, automation, or scripting (SQL, Python, Apps Script) to optimize workflows .

• Financial Acumen: Comfort working with complex cost structures, resource models, and forecasts, with a sharp eye for tracing financial inconsistencies to their root cause .

• Structured Problem Solving: Ability to apply sys

jobs.title: AI Solution Catalyst (Science)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Solution Catalyst, you act as the vital bridge between the AI Innovation Teams (Product & BP) and the wider ecosystem. Your mission is to amplify the value of developed AI solutions by driving their adoption, commercialization, and integration across internal business units and external markets.
You will "catalyze" success by translating complex technical innovations into compelling value propositions, ensuring that the solutions built by the Innovation Leads (Science or Healthcare) achieve maximum impact and visibility.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Value Amplification & Adoption
a) Go-to-Market Strategy: Partner with AI Innovation Leads and Product Managers to design and execute deployment strategies, key objectives for key solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, or Research Tools).
b) Adoption Drive: Act as the primary champion for assigned digital solutions, overcoming barriers to entry and driving usage rates among internal users (e.g., Medical teams) or external customers (e.g., Patients, HCPs).
c) Success Storytelling: Identify and package "wins" and case studies. Transform data and usage metrics into compelling narratives that demonstrate ROI and scientific/business value to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
2. Stakeholder Connection & Synergy
a) Bridge Building: Serve as the connector between the AI Innovation Lab/Teams and the broader commercial/medical organization.
b) Feedback Loop: Gather real-world feedback from the field and market, channeling insights back to the Product Managers to inform future iterations and feature enhancements.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree in Medical, Business, Administration, or related fields
2. 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, administrative support, or general marketing.
3. Experience working in a cross-functional environment, supporting technical or product teams.
Job Required Competencies
1. Exceptional ability to translate technical features (AI/Tech) into business benefits and human-centric value propositions. You are a "translator" between tech and business.
2. Strong interpersonal skills to build networks across a matrix organization. Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
3. Ability to pivot quickly between strategic planning (how to position a product) and tactical execution (organizing a launch event or creating sales aids).
4. Passionate about finding new ways to apply and scale existing innovations.
5. Focused on tangible outcomes (e.g., adoption rates, customer satisfaction, brand equity lift) rather than just process.
Travel Frequency
<25%

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Qualificazione ed esperienza Formazione
• Qualifiche 1. Laurea in Medicina, Business, Amministrazione o settori correlati 2. 3-5 anni di esperienza nel coordinamento del progetto, supporto amministrativo, o marketing generale. 3. Prova a lavorare in un ambiente interfunzionale, supportando team tecnici o di prodotto. Competenze richieste 1. Eccezionale capacità di tradurre caratteristiche tecniche (AI/Tech) in vantaggi aziendali e proposte di valore umano-centrico. Sei un "traduttore" tra tecnologia e business. 2. Forte capacità interpersonali per costruire reti attraverso un'organizzazione di matrice. Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senza autorità diretta. 3. Capacità di ruotare rapidamente tra pianificazione strategica (come posizionare un prodotto) e esecuzione tattica (organizzazione di un evento di lancio o la creazione di aiuti di vendita). 4. Appassionato a trovare nuovi modi per applicare e scalare le innovazioni esistenti. 5. Concentrati su risultati tangibili (ad esempio, tassi di adozione, soddisfazione del cliente, brand equity lift) piuttosto che solo processo. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

The Medical Director participates in development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and helps ensure effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

jobs.title: Praktikum Protein Technology (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Im R&D-Team "Functional Assays" suchen wir für den Zeitraum Mitte August 2026 bis Ende Januar 2027 eine/einen Praktikantin/Praktikanten zur Mitarbeit im Tätigkeitsfeld Protein-Analytik.

Praktikums-Inhalte

• Mitarbeit bei Standard-Protein-Analytik der protein-basierten, diagnostischen Reagentien.

• Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung neuer Methoden zur Reagentien-Charakterisierung

• Mitarbeit bei DSP-Prozessen

Qualifikationen

Für eine Beschäftigung als Praktikant (m/w/d) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Master-Studiengang der Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie o.ä ,
Bachelor-Abschluss wird vorausgesetzt!

• Immunologische Vorkenntnisse über Antikörper, Antigene, Proteinbiochemie

• Interesse an verschiedensten Methoden zur Charakterisierung protein-basierter Reagentien

• Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Eigenständigkeit, Engagement und Teamfähigkeit

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade dein Lebenslauf online hoch.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagement of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality vailable information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

The Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care.

Major Accountabilities

• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping.

Details:

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Farmacie Roche La missione
• L'assistenza sanitaria sta cambiando: innovazione radicale, maggiore apertura al cambiamento, crescente empowerment dei pazienti, molteplici fonti di informazioni mediche e pressione sulla spesa pubblica. Come risultato di tutto questo, i bisogni dei nostri stakeholder continuano ad evolversi.
• Il Partner del Viaggio Paziente (PJP) è al centro dell'organizzazione Roche, ponendo in risalto il ruolo che giochiamo nella società - dall'offrire per lo più medicinali di livello mondiale verso una maggiore collaborazione, innovazione e interruzione generativa. In questo modo il PJP sarà direttamente responsabile per fornire risultati migliori per i pazienti, la loro comunità, l'ecosistema e l'organizzazione, più velocemente.
• Il PJP è un leader potenziato e il volto locale di Roche Hong Kong e Macau. Collabora a stretto contatto con tutte le parti interessate, toccando direttamente il percorso del paziente (in una data area terapeutica o malattia), acquisendo una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze per collegare le capacità di Roche per creare soluzioni significative.
• Il PJP fornirà risultati migliori per i pazienti, migliore valore comunitario e migliori risultati commerciali, quest'ultimo è la conseguenza dei primi due. Commettere a migliorare i risultati di cura migliori per i pazienti è un buon affare.
• Questo ruolo è localmente incorporato nell'ecosistema di Hong Kong, è un ruolo integrato, punto di contatto primario, funzionalemente agnostico, (cioè non si inserisce nei concetti tradizionali di Affari Commerciali/Sales o Medico)
• Non ha redditivitÃ, obiettivi di vendita o incentivi
• Tutti i dipendenti di Roche Hong Kong & Macau devono guidare per esempio, nel modo di lavorare in rete. Questo è dove le soluzioni sono fonte dalla rete interna ed esterna prima, per evitare duplicazioni, e per ottenere risultati migliori paziente più velocemente.
• Tutti i dipendenti di Roche Hong Kong & Macau devono guidare per esempio nell'accelerare la maturità digitale di Roche internamente e nell'ambiente sanitario esterno, allineati con la visione Roche a lungo termine di Personalized Health Care. Principali passività
• Tutti i dipendenti di Roche dovrebbero contribuire efficacemente alla collaborazione e al coordinamento interfunzionali e rispettare tutte le leggi, regolamenti, politiche e procedure che governano il nostro business.
• Questo profilo di posizione serve solo a dare un ampio profilo dei doveri richiesti e sarà rinnovato e modificato a intervalli periodici nella consultazione con l'ente.
• Il PJP è un ruolo di alto livello all'interno dell'affiliato, che ha l'autorità decisionale di richiedere risorse di Roche (sia all'interno della rete affiliata e più ampia) al fine di avere migliorato l'impatto sul viaggio del paziente
• Per quanto riguarda gli ecosistemi di Hong Kong e Macao, il PJP continuerà ad evolvere la collaborazione all'interno dell'ecosistema dei cluster HA, dei partenariati pubblici e privati e dei cambiamenti del sistema sanitario in cui gli HSP saranno modellati. Dettagli:
• Il PJP si concentra sull'importanza di portare l'esterno dentro, lavorando con i partner di Hong Kong e Macau per scoprire tutte le potenziali opportunità di trasformare i risultati per i pazienti, più velocemente. Portano anche l'interno fuori, per portare Roche competenze, scienza e conoscenza all'ecosistema.
• Agisce come partner affidabile ed è il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra gli stakeholder e Roche; il PJP condivide il paziente e la comunità degli stakeholder ha bisogno internamente, prioritizza e protegge le risorse, e guida soluzioni che forniscono risultati più velocemente.
• Partner con paziente

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Pharmaceuticals Die Mission
• Die Gesundheitsfürsorge verändert sich: Radikale Innovation, erhöhte Offenheit für Veränderungen, zunehmende Stärkung der Patientenkompetenz, vielfältige medizinische Informationsquellen und Druck auf die öffentlichen Ausgaben. Als Ergebnis all dessen entwickeln sich die Bedürfnisse unserer Stakeholder weiter.
• Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) steht im Zentrum der Roche-Organisation und stellt die Rolle, die wir in der Gesellschaft spielen, auf den Kopf - von der Bereitstellung von Weltklasse-Medikamenten hin zu viel mehr Partnerschaften, Innovationen und führenden generativen Störungen. Auf diese Weise wird die PJP direkt rechenschaftspflichtig sein, um Patienten, ihrer Gemeinschaft, dem Ökosystem und der Organisation schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern.
• Die PJP ist ein mächtiger Führer und das lokale Gesicht von Roche Hong Kong und Macau. Sie arbeitet eng mit allen Interessengruppen zusammen, die die Patientenreise (in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich) direkt berühren, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer Bedürfnisse zu erlangen, um die Fähigkeiten von Roche zu verbinden und sinnvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln.
• Die PJP wird bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten, einen besseren Gemeinschaftswert und bessere kommerzielle Ergebnisse liefern, wobei letzteres die Folge der ersten beiden ist. Die Verpflichtung zur Verbesserung besserer Pflegeergebnisse für Patienten ist ein gutes Geschäft.
• Diese Rolle ist lokal in das Ökosystem von Hongkong eingebettet, es ist eine integrierte Rolle, primärer Ansprechpartner, funktional agnostisch, (d. H. Es passt nicht in die traditionellen Konzepte von Commercial / Sales oder Medical Affairs)
• Es hat keine Rentabilität, Verkaufsziele oder Anreize
• Alle Roche Hong Kong & Macau Mitarbeiter sollen mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen, in der Netzwerk-Arbeitsweise. Hier werden zuerst Lösungen aus dem internen und externen Netzwerk bezogen, um Doppelungen zu vermeiden und schneller bessere Patientenergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Alle Mitarbeiter von Roche Hong Kong & Macau werden mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen, um die digitale Reife von Roche intern und im externen Gesundheitsumfeld zu beschleunigen, im Einklang mit der langfristigen Roche-Vision von Personalized Health Care. Hauptbuchhaltung
• Von allen Roche-Mitarbeitern wird erwartet, dass sie effektiv zur funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und Koordination beitragen und alle Gesetze, Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Verfahren einhalten, die unser Geschäft regeln.
• Dieses Positionsprofil dient nur dazu, einen groben Überblick über die erforderlichen Aufgaben zu geben und wird in regelmäßigen Abständen in der Konsultation des etablierten Unternehmens erneuert und geändert.
• Der PJP ist eine Führungsposition innerhalb des Affiliates, der die Entscheidungsbefugnis hat, Ressourcen von Roche (sowohl innerhalb des Affiliates als auch im weiteren Netzwerk) anzufordern, um die Patientenreise zu verbessern.
• In Bezug auf die Ökosysteme von Hongkong und Macau wird die PJP die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Ökosystems von HA-Clustern, öffentlichen und privaten Partnerschaften und die reibungslose Einführung von Veränderungen des Gesundheitssystems, in denen die HSPs gestaltet werden, weiter ausbauen. Einzelheiten:
• Die pjp konzentriert sich auf die wichtigkeit, die außenseite nach innen zu bringen, indem sie sowohl mit hongkong als auch mit macau-partnern zusammenarbeitet, um alle möglichen möglichkeiten aufzudecken, die ergebnisse für patienten schneller zu verändern. Sie bringen auch das Innere nach außen, um Roche Know-how, Wissenschaft und Wissen in das Ökosystem zu bringen.
• Tritt als vertrauenswürdiger Partner auf und ist der primäre (aber nicht exklusive) Ansprechpartner zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche; die PJP teilt die Bedürfnisse der Patienten- und Stakeholder-Community intern, priorisiert und sichert Ressourcen und treibt Lösungen voran, die schneller Ergebnisse liefern.
• Partner mit dem Patienten

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutiques La Mission
• Les soins de santé changent : innovation radicale, ouverture accrue au changement, renforcement de l'autonomisation des patients, sources multiples d'information médicale et pression sur les dépenses publiques. Par conséquent, les besoins de nos intervenants continuent d'évoluer.
• Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) est au centre de l'organisation Roche, renversant le rôle que nous jouons dans la société - de l'offre principalement de médicaments de classe mondiale à beaucoup plus de partenariat, d'innovation et de rupture de génération. Ce faisant, le PJP sera directement responsable d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, leur communauté, l'écosystème et l'organisation, plus rapidement.
• Le PJP est un leader habilité et le visage local de Roche Hong Kong et Macao. Elle s'associe étroitement avec toutes les parties prenantes touchant directement le parcours du patient (dans un domaine thérapeutique ou de maladie donné), en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins afin de relier les capacités de Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives.
• Le PJP produira de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, une meilleure valeur communautaire et de meilleurs résultats commerciaux, ce dernier étant la conséquence des deux premiers. S'engager à améliorer les résultats des soins pour les patients est une bonne affaire.
• Ce rôle est intégré localement dans l'écosystème de Hong Kong, c'est un rôle intégré, principal point de contact, fonctionnellement agnostique, (c'est-à-dire qu'il ne s'inscrit pas dans les concepts traditionnels de commerce/ventes ou affaires médicales)
• Elle n'a ni objectifs de rentabilité, ni incitations en matière de ventes.
• Tous les employés de Roche Hong Kong & Macao doivent montrer l'exemple, dans la manière de travailler en réseau. C'est là que les solutions proviennent d'abord du réseau interne et externe, afin d'éviter les doubles emplois et d'obtenir plus rapidement de meilleurs résultats pour les patients.
• Tous les employés de Roche Hong Kong & Macao doivent montrer l'exemple en accélérant la maturité numérique de Roche en interne et dans l'environnement de santé externe, aligné sur la vision à long terme de Roche des soins de santé personnalisés. Principales responsabilités
• Tous les employés de Roche doivent contribuer efficacement à la collaboration et à la coordination interfonctionnelles et se conformer à toutes les lois, règlements, politiques et procédures qui régissent notre entreprise.
• Ce profil de poste sert seulement à donner un aperçu général des fonctions requises et sera renouvelé et modifié à intervalles réguliers en consultation avec le titulaire.
• Le PJP est un rôle de niveau supérieur au sein de l'affilié, qui a le pouvoir décisionnel de demander des ressources de Roche (à la fois au sein de l'affilié et de l'ensemble du réseau) afin d'avoir une incidence améliorée sur le cheminement du patient
• En ce qui concerne les écosystèmes de Hong Kong et de Macao, le PJP continuera à développer la collaboration au sein de l'écosystème des grappes d'HA, des partenariats publics et privés et le bon déroulement des changements du système de santé dans lesquels les PSH seront façonnés. Détails:
• Le PJP met l'accent sur l'importance d'amener l'extérieur, en collaboration avec les partenaires de Hong Kong et de Macao, à découvrir toutes les possibilités potentielles de transformer les résultats pour les patients, plus rapidement. Ils apportent aussi l'intérieur, pour apporter l'expertise, la science et le savoir Roche à l'écosystème.
• Agit en tant que partenaire de confiance et est le principal point de contact (mais non exclusif) entre les intervenants et Roche; le PJP partage les besoins des patients et des intervenants à l'interne, priorise et sécurise les ressources et stimule les solutions qui produisent les résultats plus rapidement.
• Partenaires avec le patient

In this role, you will act as a principal orchestrator across the broader global architecture community. Rather than focusing on a single sub-function, you will guide cross-domain alignment to balance enterprise coherence with functional autonomy. By architecting scalable Data & AI ecosystems and defining the "digital laws" that govern them, you will safely accelerate the adoption of high-value AI capabilities while actively preventing technological fragmentation and agentic chaos.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Enterprise Architect Il Principal Enterprise Architect fornisce una supervisione architettonica essenziale, una leadership visionaria e una guida strategica in un ampio contesto Cross-Domain. In questo ruolo altamente impattante, si prenderanno i temi più complessi e interfunzionali che abbracciano più aree di business e tecnologia. Un focus significativo del vostro mandato sarà l'architettura "RDT as a Business" (Informatics Domain), il trattamento della nostra organizzazione interna Roche Digital Technology come linea di business critica. Il vostro scopo comprenderà anche altre iniziative di impresa che vanno oltre RDT. Potrai guidare gli altri nella risoluzione di problemi e problemi altamente complessi che hanno implicazioni diffuse sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi interfunzionali. Descrizione della zona La funzione Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture forma, allinea ed esegue la strategia tecnologica collegando l'ambizione aziendale agli investimenti, all'architettura e alla consegna. Per questo ruolo specifico, un dominio primario è Informatics (soggetto RDT), insieme ad altri complessi domini cross-enterprise. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i leader operativi, l'Ufficio Trasformazione, l'Eccellenza RDT e la Gestione Portfolio per stabilire un modello operativo moderno e integrato. Questo settore assicura che le operazioni siano costruite sulla generazione delle informazioni e aderiscano agli standard del settore (ad esempio IT4IT, ITIL), stabilendo un robusto supporto architettonico per iniziative strategiche interne e interfunzionali. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Architettare la North Star per "RDT as a Business": Definire architetture e modelli di funzionalità target-state per le operazioni interne di RDT. Prendere la proprietà di definire ed evolvere l'applicazione RDT e il paesaggio tecnologico e il modello di dati, garantendo un solido supporto di architettura per iniziative interne strategiche.
• Ottimizzazione del Modello Operativo: supporta attivamente l'evoluzione del Modello Operativo e integra i suoi elementi (ad esempio Strategia, Portfolio, Consegna, Operazioni). Spostare l'organizzazione verso Data-Driven Portfolio Management e Agile, AI abilitato Consegna e Operazioni, garantendo il collegamento ai nostri asset di paesaggio IT esistenti e fornendo tracciabilità.
• Architettura Governance & Standards ("Enable & Govern"): Guidare la governance dell'architettura per il dominio Informatics e guidare l'allineamento cross-domain attraverso Information, Technology, Business e Application Architecture. Fornire chiarezza, "strada asfaltata", e guardrails che consentono velocità ed efficacia nella consegna piuttosto che creare attrito burocratico.
• Tackling Complex Cross-Functional Topics: Guide squadra a matrice nel risolvere i problemi interfunzionali più complessi con ampie implicazioni sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi. Agire come il piombo architettonico per le principali iniziative cross-domain che vanno oltre una singola funzione, garantendo architetture coessive target in tutta l'impresa.
• Cross-Domain Coherence & Technical Debt Management: condurre rigorose valutazioni di impatto architettonico per iniziative cross-domain. Gestione attiva del debito tecnico e supporto Future State Architecture semplificando sistematicamente il paesaggio delle applicazioni, disattivando i sistemi ridondanti e stabilendo la governance per prevenire la complessità futura.
• Trasparenza Data-Driven: Promuovere la filosofia che il valore dell'architettura è misurato da decisioni migliori e risultati di consegna. Sfrutta la nostra catena di strumenti di architettura integrata (ArchiMEDES) per fornire i critici architettonici

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are a high-performing cybersecurity team tasked with protecting the organization’s computing environments. While our historical stronghold has been managing enterprise Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure, we are now expanding our focus to secure our dynamic, cloud-native environments.
We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer specializing in Cloud Workload Protection. You will be responsible for securing IaaS, PaaS, containers, and serverless architectures. Working alongside your senior endpoint security colleagues, you will bridge the gap between traditional endpoint defense and modern cloud infrastructure, ensuring our threat detection and application governance standards are seamlessly extended to the cloud.

Job Responsibilities

• Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP): Architect, deploy, and manage Cloud Workload Protection Platforms ( e.g., Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Wiz, or Aqua) across our multi-cloud environment ( AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).

• Container & Kubernetes Security: Implement runtime defense, vulnerability scanning, and configuration hardening for containerized applications and orchestration platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE).

• Extending Core Services to the Cloud: Adapt our existing strategies for EDR and Application Control to function effectively in ephemeral, cloud-native workloads without degrading performance.

• DevSecOps Integration: Embed security controls directly into CI/CD pipelines (Shift-Left), ensuring images, registries, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates are scanned and secured before deployment.

• Automated Remediation: Develop automated response playbooks for cloud misconfigurations and workload alerts using serverless functions and native cloud APIs.

Qualifications
Education / Experience / Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of dedicated experience securing public cloud workloads, with a strong understanding of the shared responsibility model.

• Deep technical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration. You should know how to secure a pod, restrict container privileges, and manage network policies.

• Proven, hands-on experience deploying and tuning commercial or open-source cloud security platforms (CWPP / CNAPP).

• Strong grasp of cloud-native networking (VPCs, Security Groups) and Identity and Access Management (least-privilege roles, service accounts).

• Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1 or above level).

Additional Qualifications

• Bridge Builder: Ability to collaborate closely with DevOps and Cloud Engineering teams, acting as an enabler rather than a roadblock.

• Strategic Thinker: Capacity to look at our existing on-premise security policies and intelligently adapt them for ephemeral cloud environments.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a highly dynamic cybersecurity environment where priorities can shift based on emerging needs.

• Team Player: Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external team mates and stakeholders.

• Mentorship: Willingness to cross-train our existing senior endpoint engineers on cloud-native security concepts, while learning from their deep endpoint telemetry expertise.

Who we are

jobs.title: Principal Device Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:
This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.
In this role, you will engage in cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance, Device MSAT, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmaceutical Development, Clinical, and Commercial teams.

• Serve as the Technical Project Lead or Subject Matter Expert to drive the robust development of combination products and medical devices, ensuring a seamless advancement into clinical phases and commercial market applications.

• Apply deep engineering expertise and strategic insights, establish robust technical product requirements and develop drug-device combination product design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products while ensuring high performance, design robustness and fostering innovation.

• Lead internal and external technical investigations to swiftly resolve complex, design-related issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.

• Author and manage comprehensive design control documentation - including Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications (URS), Design Inputs/Outputs, Verification/Validation Plans, conformity assessments, and risk management files.

• Navigate the global regulatory landscape to ensure all product designs and processes comply with industry standards, specifically ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR Part 820 (with an emphasis on 820.30 Design Controls).

Who you are:

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• 10+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development within pharma or highly regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:
This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.

• Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products while ensuring high performance, design robustness and fostering innovation.

• Lead internal and external technical investigations to swiftly resolve complex, design-related issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.

• Author and manage comprehensive design control documentation - including Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications (URS), Design Inputs/Outputs, Verification/Validation Plans, conformity assessments, and risk management files.

• Navigate the global regulatory landscape to ensure all product designs and processes comply with industry standards, specifically ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR Part 820 (with an emphasis on 820.30 Design Controls).

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• Strong background in container closure systems, specifically prefilled syringes and cartridges for parenteral drug delivery.

• Solid understanding of materials science applied to drug delivery systems, with expertise in damage mechanisms, defect identification, and performance testing.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Global Technical Development (PTD) est une organisation de plus de deux mille personnes dans le monde qui font partie intégrante de la mission de Roche de développer des médicaments significatifs pour les patients. Par conséquent, nous collaborons activement et développons des solutions techniques créatives pour combler les besoins en produits en début de phase, en fin de phase et en commercial. Le mandat consiste à livrer le pipeline et à fournir des produits de qualité aux patients. Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. L'ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sûrs qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Ce rôle pratique stimule l'excellence en ingénierie en appliquant des contrôles de conception, en résolvant les défis complexes d'ingénierie des appareils et en fournissant des conseils techniques stratégiques pour assurer le développement et la conformité robustes des produits. Dans ce rôle, vous vous engagerez dans une collaboration interfonctionnelle, particulièrement avec des équipes d'assurance de la qualité, de MSAT d'appareils, d'affaires réglementaires, de développement pharmaceutique, clinique et commerciale.
• Servir de chef de projet technique ou d'expert en matière de projet pour stimuler le développement robuste de produits combinés et d'instruments médicaux, en assurant une progression transparente dans les phases cliniques et les applications commerciales.
• Appliquer une expertise en ingénierie profonde et des idées stratégiques, établir des exigences techniques robustes pour les produits et développer des solutions de conception de produits combinés médicament-dispositifs pour assurer que les appareils maintiennent le niveau de performance requis tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires externes pour assurer la supervision technique des conceptions mécaniques pour les produits combinés tout en assurant des performances élevées, la robustesse de conception et en favorisant l'innovation.
• Diriger les enquêtes techniques internes et externes pour résoudre rapidement les problèmes complexes liés à la conception au moyen de méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes.
• Auteur et gestion d'une documentation complète sur le contrôle de la conception - y compris les plans d'élaboration de la conception, les spécifications relatives aux exigences de l'utilisateur, les intrants/extrants de conception, les plans de vérification/validation, les évaluations de la conformité et les dossiers de gestion des risques.
• Naviguez dans le paysage réglementaire mondial pour s'assurer que toutes les conceptions et tous les procédés de produits sont conformes aux normes de l'industrie, notamment ISO 13485, ISO 14971 et 21 CFR Part 820 (en mettant l'accent sur les contrôles de conception 820.30). Qui vous êtes :
• Diplôme universitaire (BSc ou MSc) en génie ou dans une discipline technique connexe d'un établissement accrédité.
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en génie mécanique et en mise au point d'appareils de distribution de médicaments dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou hautement réglementés (cGxP, QSR).
• Expertise pratique dans le développement du stylo injecteur et de l'autoinjecteur tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Solide fond dans les systèmes de fermeture des contenants, en particulier les seringues préremplies et les cartouches pour l'administration de médicaments parentéraux.
• Un leadership technique éprouvé et des capacités avancées de résolution de problèmes dans des environnements d'équipe interfonctionnels.
• Compréhension solide de la science des matériaux appliquée aux systèmes de livraison de médicaments, avec une expertise dans les mécanismes de dommages, l'identification des défauts et les tests de performance.
• Connaissance approfondie de la réglementation, de l'industrie

• Hands-on-Know-how in der Entwicklung von Pen-Injektoren und Autoinjektoren während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
• Starker Hintergrund in Behälterverschlusssystemen, insbesondere vorgefüllten Spritzen und Kartuschen für die parenterale Arzneimittelabgabe.
• Bewährte technische Führung und fortschrittliche Problemlösungsfähigkeiten in funktionsübergreifenden Teamumgebungen.
• Ein solides Verständnis der Materialwissenschaft, das auf Arzneimittelverabreichungssysteme angewendet wird, mit Expertise in Schadensmechanismen, Fehlererkennung und Leistungstests.

jobs.title: Medical Director/Clinical Scientist (CVM), Early Development
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At CICoR, we aspire to help patients by leveraging China’s life science ecosystem to accelerate scientific innovation and develop breakthrough medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The vision of CICoR ED is to lead the formulation and execution of China strategy for global early clinical development, fostering collaboration with internal and external partners. We also bring critical clinical insights to CICoR discovery projects. Our goal is to prioritize the most promising scientific discoveries and accelerate their translation from the lab to the clinic - quickly, effectively, and safely.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Represents as the China Clinical Lead in the global clinical project team, driving China strategy for global early clinical development through collaborative partnership with global and local organizations

• Ensures the clinical study design, execution, and scientific and medical data interpretation in line with GCP and highest medical and scientific standards, the most recent international and local treatment and health authority guidelines and cutting-edge disease endpoints, including novel and surrogate endpoints.

• Creates and fosters local cross-functional collaboration to steer the molecule integrated end-to-end China development plan, to lead the feasibility assessment, and to ensure timely regulatory, clinical, preclinical, late stage, commercial and external expert input into the China clinical development strategy

• Is the Key interface between the global Asset Team and the local Clinical Operations, Clinical Sites and investigators, and CROs, for study-related activities

• Serves as the DA Strategy Lead for CICoR discovery projects, providing critical clinical insights on indication prioritization, patient population selection, and competitive landscaping.

Additionally:

• Is a Key translational representative on discovery projects; shapes the hypotheses to be tested in clinical experiments.

• Works closely with the Biomarker Experimental Medicine Leader to develop biomarker strategies on discovery projects.

• Represents Roche at congresses and to local authorities.

• Maintains and expands a network of external principal investigators, clinical collaborators, and advisors in China.

• Acts as key local clinical scientific contact/medical monitor, answers selected medical queries when needed.

• Contributes to the review and interpretation of clinical data and the development of content needed for governance committee interactions seeking Go/No Go decisions.

• Participates in Due Diligences and non-project related work streams representing the function whenever applicable.

Qualification
Thrive in a dynamic, inclusive environment, which gives you full accountability for your contributions and own development. Resourceful and flexible in problem solving, and in working in a collaborative and inclusive manner. Transparent and have a sense for ensuring that everyone has the required information at all times.

• Hold an MD (MD preferred, PharmD or PhD if approved qualified) and minimum of 5 years of experience in clinical research (industry/hospital), including experience in diverse working environments; physician scientist desirable.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non meritevoli del mondo. A CICoR, aspiriamo ad aiutare i pazienti sfruttando l’ecosistema della scienza della vita della Cina per accelerare l’innovazione scientifica e sviluppare medicine innovative. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. La visione di CICoR ED è di guidare la formulazione e l'esecuzione della strategia cinese per lo sviluppo clinico precoce globale, favorendo la collaborazione con partner interni ed esterni. Portiamo anche informazioni cliniche critiche ai progetti di scoperta CICoR. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di dare priorità alle scoperte scientifiche più promettenti e accelerare la loro traduzione dal laboratorio alla clinica - in modo rapido, efficace e sicuro. Ruoli e responsabilità
• Rappresenta come leader clinico cinese nel team di progetto clinico globale, guida la strategia cinese per lo sviluppo clinico precoce globale attraverso la collaborazione con organizzazioni globali e locali
• Garantisce la progettazione clinica, l'esecuzione e l'interpretazione dei dati scientifici e medici in linea con il GCP e i più alti standard medici e scientifici, le più recenti linee guida internazionali e locali di trattamento e autorità sanitaria e endpoint di malattie all'avanguardia, tra cui i punti di vista nuovi e surrogate.
• Crea e promuove la collaborazione interfunzionale locale per guidare il piano di sviluppo integrato di molecola end-to-end Cina, per condurre la valutazione di fattibilità, e per garantire la tempestiva regolazione, clinica, preclinica, fase tardiva, ingresso di esperti commerciali ed esterni nella strategia di sviluppo clinico della Cina
• È l'interfaccia chiave tra il Global Asset Team e le Operazioni Cliniche locali, Siti Clinici e Ricercatori, e CRO, per attività correlate allo studio
• Serve come il DA Strategy Lead per i progetti di scoperta CICoR, fornendo informazioni cliniche critiche sulla priorità di indicazione, la selezione della popolazione del paziente, e il paesaggio competitivo. Inoltre:
• È un rappresentante traduttivo chiave sui progetti di scoperta; modella le ipotesi da testare in esperimenti clinici.
• Lavora a stretto contatto con il Biomarker Experimental Medicine Leader per sviluppare strategie di biomarcatore sui progetti di scoperta.
• Rappresenta Roche ai congressi e alle autorità locali.
• Mantiene e amplia una rete di principali investigatori esterni, collaboratori clinici e consulenti in Cina.
• Agisce come contatto clinico locale chiave / monitor medico, risponde a domande mediche selezionate quando necessario.
• Contribuisce alla revisione e all'interpretazione dei dati clinici e allo sviluppo dei contenuti necessari per le interazioni dei comitati di governance che cercano decisioni Go/No Go.
• Partecipa a due diligence e a flussi di lavoro correlati non progetto che rappresentano la funzione quando applicabile. Qualificazione Thrive in un ambiente dinamico e inclusivo, che ti dà piena responsabilità per i tuoi contributi e il tuo sviluppo. Risorse e flessibilità nella risoluzione dei problemi, e nel lavoro in modo collaborativo e inclusivo. Trasparente e ha il senso di garantire che tutti abbiano le informazioni richieste in ogni momento.
• Tenere un MD (MD preferito, PharmD o PhD se approvato qualificato) e minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella ricerca clinica (industria / ospedale), tra cui l'esperienza in diversi ambienti di lavoro; scienziato medico desiderabile.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Business Developer , serás responsable de diseñar, comunicar, desarrollar e implementar la estrategia de negocio y marketing para el portafolio de Banco de Sangre y Serología dentro de la subregión de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia (SAN). En este rol, actuarás como un nexo estratégico clave con el mercado , capturando oportunidades con agilidad e incorporando la inteligencia de mercado y tendencias emergentes. Trabajarás de manera colaborativa y estrecha con el Infectious Diseases Disease Management Squad y equipos multidisciplinarios para expandir la participación de mercado, asegurar la ejecución comercial de punta a punta, aportar valor a los clientes y elevar el estándar de cuidado de los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Planificación Estratégica: Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con el Disease Management Squad . Contribuir a la definición de la estrategia y priorizar las tácticas para el portafolio asignado, adaptando los lineamientos globales/regionales al contexto de la red SAN y definiendo el posicionamiento de precios.

• Gestión Comercial y Licitaciones: Gestionar y validar propuestas comerciales (GDC), adecuar las listas de precios y apoyar activamente en la preparación y defensa de licitaciones públicas y privadas.

• Ejecución y Soporte Técnico: Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios , brindando soporte científico y técnico integral tanto a los clientes como entrenamiento técnico a los roles comerciales internos de Roche y a la red de canales distribuidores. Actuarás como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto dentro de tu área de especialidad.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno e integrando la perspectiva del cliente en los squads y redes regionales (EMEA-LATAM).

• Relaciones Estratégicas y Co-creación: Identificar nuevas oportunidades junto a los equipos de campo y co-crear los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración con los Key Account Managers (KAMs). Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas, efectivas y de confianza con clientes, partners y stakeholders clave del sector científico e institucional (sociedades científicas, planes nacionales y provinciales) para influir en la estrategia.

• Sinergia Interna: Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de Ventas, Finanzas, Supply Chain, Healthcare Manager y Experiencia del Cliente para optimizar los indicadores clave de negocio, alocación de recursos y planes financieros (BP & IP).

Who you are

• Formación Académica: Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica, Biotecnología o carreras afines. Es muy valorable contar con estudios de posgrado o MBA.

• Experiencia Laboral: Experiencia previa comprobable en roles de desarrollo de negocios, marketing de productos, especialista de aplicaciones o ventas dentro de la industria del diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) o farmacéutica.

• Conocimientos Técnicos Críticos: Trayectoria demostrable y conocimientos técnicos profundos y actualizados tanto en serología como en biología molecular . Es indispensable contar con un entendimiento sólido en técnicas de diagnóstico y, específicamente, en pruebas de tamizaje NAT (Nucleic Acid Testing) para bancos de sangre.

• Idiomas: Dominio avanzado del idioma inglés (nivel B2, C1 o C2) para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global, corpora

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als F acharbeiter Pharma für Abfüllung & optische Kontrolle (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Du steuerst und überwachst die maschinelle Abfüllung sowie die optische Kontrolle von sterilen Lösungen in Spritzen unter strikter Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften.

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen eigenständig durch und behebst auftretende, auch komplexe Systemstörungen an den Produktionsanlagen.

• Du übernehmst die lückenlose, GMP-gerechte Dokumentation aller Arbeitsschritte in elektronischen Logbüchern, Herstellprotokollen und Systemen wie SAP und MES.

• Du bereitest Arbeitsgeräte vor, reinigst sowie desinfizierst Anlagenkomponenten und unterstützt aktiv bei Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs- und Wartungsarbeiten.

• Du aktualisierst Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs), erstellst GMP-Dokumente und bringst Deine Ideen im kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) ein.

Das bringst Du mit

• Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Pharmakant, Chemikant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA).

• Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige einschlägige Praxiserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, idealerweise im Bereich der aseptischen Sterilfertigung.

• Fachkompetenz: Fundierte Kenntnisse der GMP-Richtlinien, sicheres Arbeiten im Hygienebereich sowie ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis zur Bedienung komplexer Anlagen.

• IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen DV-Anwendungen und Produktionssystemen (z. B. MS Office, MES, SAP, SingleLims).

• Team & Flexibilität: Eine zuverlässige, wertschätzende Arbeitsweise im Team sowie die uneingeschränkte Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Vollkonti-Schichtbetrieb (Früh/Spät/Nacht) inklusive regelmäßiger Samstagsarbeit.

Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest.
