jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For nearly 25 years, Roche has been at the forefront of innovating companion diagnostics (CDx) that hold the power to transform patients’ lives by providing essential information that informs clinical decision-making and guides personalized treatment strategies.

With a steady pipeline of high medical value predictive tests fueled by collaborations with over 85 pharmaceutical partners, we deliver diagnostic certainty through the broadest menu of immunohistochemistry/in situ hybridization (IHC/ISH) companion diagnostics available today.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHC senior scientist with a strong histology/pathology background to join our innovative research and development team. This is a technical position within our antibody development group, focused on developing high quality rabbit monoclonal antibodies against novel biomarkers for tissue applications.

The Opportunity:

Antibody Discovery & Development:

• Lead the IHC functional screening for novel rabbit monoclonal antibodies against emerging and clinically relevant biomarkers.

• Apply deep knowledge of biomarker biology and histology/pathology to guide antibody selections.

• Analyze biomarker expression patterns across tissues, cell types, and tumor models to ensure appropriate targeting and clinical relevance.

• Interpret complex staining patterns and correlate with biological and pathological context.

IHC Assay Development & Optimization:

• Develop, optimize, and standardize IHC assays using FFPE samples.

• Evaluate antibody performance across normal and diseased tissues, including diverse tumor types and cell lines.

• Improve assay sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility for diagnostic applications.

Research Sample Testing & Performance Improvement:

• Conduct IHC testing on research and preclinical samples to assess antibody performance.

• Identify opportunities to enhance antibody productivity, stability, and sensitivity through iterative testing and optimization.

• Troubleshoot technical challenges and implement solutions to improve assay robustness.

Validation & Documentation:

• Perform analytical validation including specificity, sensitivity, reproducibility, and robustness studies.

• Utilize orthogonal methods (e.g., Western blot, ELISA, RNA ISH, IF) to confirm antibody performance.

Leadership & Collaboration:

• Provide scientific leadership and mentorship to junior scientists and research staff.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, pathology, operation, and regulatory teams.

• Contribute to scientific strategy, publications, patents, and external collaborations.

This is an onsite position based in Pleasanton, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Bachelor of Science in Biology (or related field) plus 10 years relevant experience; or a master’s degree in Biology (or related field) plus 6 years; or a PhD in Biology (or related field) and 4 years relevant experience.

• You have 3+ years of experience with immunohistochemistry (IHC) based methods.

• You have 3+ years of experience in a solid background in Pathology, Histology or Oncology

• You have the ability to translate biological insights into practical assay development strategies.

• You have strong analytical and critical thinking skills with attention to detail; you have the ability to manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast-paced environment; you have a collaborative mindset with demonstrated leadership capabilit

Con una pipeline costante di test predittivi ad alto valore medico alimentati da collaborazioni con oltre 85 partner farmaceutici, forniamo certezza diagnostica attraverso il menu più ampio di immunohistochemistry/in situ ibridazione (IHC/ISH) compagno di diagnostica disponibile oggi. Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato senior IHC altamente motivato ed esperto con un forte background istologico/patologia per unire il nostro team di ricerca e sviluppo innovativo. Si tratta di una posizione tecnica all'interno del nostro gruppo di sviluppo anticorpo, incentrata sullo sviluppo di anticorpi monoclonali di coniglio di alta qualità contro nuovi biomarcatori per applicazioni di tessuto. L'opportunità: Antibody Discovery & Development:
• Condurre lo screening funzionale IHC per nuovi anticorpi monoclonali di coniglio contro i biomarcatori emergenti e clinicamente rilevanti.
• Applicare la conoscenza profonda della biologia del biomarcatore e istologia/patologia per guidare le selezioni anticorpo.
• Analizzare i modelli di espressione del biomarcatore attraverso i tessuti, i tipi di cellule e i modelli tumorali per garantire un targeting appropriato e la rilevanza clinica.
• Interpreti modelli di colorazione complessi e correlati con contesto biologico e patologico. IHC Assay Development & Optimization:
• Sviluppare, ottimizzare e standardizzare i test IHC utilizzando campioni FFPE.
• Valutare le prestazioni anticorpo attraverso tessuti normali e malati, compresi diversi tipi di tumore e linee cellulari.
• Migliorare la sensibilità del saggio, la specificità e la riproducibilità per le applicazioni diagnostiche. Test e miglioramento delle prestazioni del campione di ricerca:
• Condurre test IHC sulla ricerca e campioni preclinici per valutare le prestazioni anticorpo.
• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare la produttività, la stabilità e la sensibilità dell'anticorpo attraverso test e ottimizzazione iterativi.
• Risoluzione dei problemi tecnici e implementare soluzioni per migliorare la robustezza del saggio. Validazione e documentazione:
• Eseguire la validazione analitica tra cui specificità, sensibilità, riproducibilità e studi di robustezza.
• Utilizzare metodi ortogonali (ad esempio, Western blot, ELISA, RNA ISH, IF) per confermare le prestazioni anticorpo. Leadership & collaborazione:
• Fornire leadership scientifica e mentorship ai giovani scienziati e personale di ricerca.
• Collaborare trasversalmente con R&D, patologia, operazione e team di regolazione.
• Contribuire alla strategia scientifica, pubblicazioni, brevetti e collaborazioni esterne. Questa è una posizione in loco con base a Pleasanton, CA. I benefici di trasferimento non sono offerti. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai un Bachelor of Science in Biologia (o campo relativo) più 10 anni di esperienza rilevante; o un master in Biologia (o campo relativo) più 6 anni; o un dottorato in Biologia (o campo relativo) e 4 anni di esperienza rilevante.
• Hai 3 anni di esperienza con metodi basati su immunohistochemistry (IHC).
• Hai 3+ anni di esperienza in un solido background in Patologia, Histologia o Oncologia
• Hai la capacità di tradurre intuizioni biologiche in pratiche strategie di sviluppo del saggio.
• Hai forti capacità di pensiero analitico e critico con attenzione ai dettagli; hai la capacità di gestire più progetti e di guidare risultati in un ambiente frenetico; hai una mentalità collaborativa con una leadership dimostrata

• Entwickeln, optimieren und standardisieren Sie IHC-Assays mit FFPE-Proben.
• Bewerten Sie die Antikörperleistung in normalen und kranken Geweben, einschließlich verschiedener Tumortypen und Zelllinien.
• Verbesserung der Sensitivität, Spezifität und Reproduzierbarkeit von Assays für diagnostische Anwendungen. Research Sample Testing & Performance Improvement:
• Durchführung von IHC-Tests an Forschungs- und präklinischen Proben zur Beurteilung der Antikörperleistung.
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, um die Produktivität, Stabilität und Empfindlichkeit von Antikörpern durch iterative Tests und Optimierungen zu verbessern.
• Beheben Sie technische Herausforderungen und implementieren Sie Lösungen, um die Robustheit des Assays zu verbessern. Validierung und Dokumentation:
• Durchführung einer analytischen Validierung, einschließlich Spezifitäts-, Sensitivitäts-, Reproduzierbarkeits- und Robustheitsstudien.
• Verwenden Sie orthogonale Methoden (z. B. Western Blot, ELISA, RNA ISH, IF), um die Antikörperleistung zu bestätigen. Führung & Zusammenarbeit:
• Bieten Sie wissenschaftliche Führung und Mentoring für Nachwuchswissenschaftler und Forschungspersonal.
• Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit F & E, Pathologie, Betrieb und Regulierungsteams zusammen.
• Beitrag zu wissenschaftlicher Strategie, Publikationen, Patenten und externen Kooperationen. Dies ist eine Position vor Ort mit Sitz in Pleasanton, CA. Relocation-Vorteile werden nicht angeboten. Wer Du bist: (erforderlich)
• Sie haben einen Bachelor of Science in Biologie (oder verwandtem Bereich) plus 10 Jahre relevante Erfahrung; oder einen Master-Abschluss in Biologie (oder verwandtem Bereich) plus 6 Jahre; oder einen PhD in Biologie (oder verwandtem Bereich) und 4 Jahre relevante Erfahrung.
• Sie haben mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Immunhistochemie (IHC) basierte Methoden.
• Sie haben 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem soliden Hintergrund in Pathologie, Histologie oder Onkologie
• Sie haben die Fähigkeit, biologische Erkenntnisse in praktische Assay-Entwicklungsstrategien zu übersetzen.
• Sie haben starke analytische und kritische Denkfähigkeiten mit Liebe zum Detail; Sie haben die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte zu verwalten und Ergebnisse in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu erzielen; Sie haben eine kollaborative Denkweise mit nachgewiesener Führungsfähigkeit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Depuis près de 25 ans, Roche est à l'avant-garde de l'innovation dans le diagnostic des compagnons (CDx) qui détient le pouvoir de transformer la vie des patients en fournissant des informations essentielles qui éclairent la prise de décision clinique et guide des stratégies de traitement personnalisées. Avec un pipeline constant de tests prédictifs de haute valeur médicale alimentés par des collaborations avec plus de 85 partenaires pharmaceutiques, nous fournissons la certitude diagnostique à travers le menu le plus large de diagnostics de compagnon immunohistochimique/hybridation in situ (IHC/ISH) disponible aujourd'hui. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique senior hautement motivé et expérimenté de l'IHC avec une solide expérience en histologie/pathologie pour rejoindre notre équipe de recherche et développement innovante. Il s'agit d'une position technique au sein de notre groupe de développement d'anticorps, axée sur le développement d'anticorps monoclonaux de lapin de haute qualité contre de nouveaux biomarqueurs pour les applications tissulaires. La possibilité : Découverte et développement d'anticorps :
• Diriger le dépistage fonctionnel des nouveaux anticorps monoclonaux chez le lapin contre les biomarqueurs émergents et cliniquement pertinents.
• Appliquer une connaissance approfondie de la biologie des biomarqueurs et de l'histologie/pathologie pour guider la sélection des anticorps.
• Analyser les patrons d'expression des biomarqueurs entre les tissus, les types de cellules et les modèles de tumeurs afin d'assurer un ciblage approprié et une pertinence clinique.
• Interpréter des patrons de coloration complexes et corréler avec le contexte biologique et pathologique. IHC Assay Développement et optimisation :
• Élaborer, optimiser et normaliser les tests IHC à l'aide d'échantillons FFPE.
• Évaluer la performance en anticorps dans les tissus normaux et malades, y compris divers types de tumeurs et lignées cellulaires.
• Améliorer la sensibilité, la spécificité et la reproductibilité pour les applications diagnostiques. Recherche Essais d'échantillons et amélioration du rendement :
• Effectuer des tests IHC sur des échantillons de recherche et précliniques pour évaluer le rendement en anticorps.
• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer la productivité, la stabilité et la sensibilité des anticorps grâce à des tests itératifs et à l'optimisation.
• Dépanner les défis techniques et mettre en œuvre des solutions pour améliorer la robustesse des essais. Validation et documentation :
• Effectuer une validation analytique comprenant des études de spécificité, de sensibilité, de reproductibilité et de robustesse.
• Utiliser des méthodes orthogonales (p. ex. Western blot, ELISA, RNA ISH, FI) pour confirmer la performance des anticorps. Leadership et collaboration :
• Fournir un leadership scientifique et un mentorat aux scientifiques subalternes et au personnel de recherche.
• Collaborer avec des équipes de R-D, de pathologie, d'exploitation et de réglementation.
• Contribuer à la stratégie scientifique, aux publications, aux brevets et aux collaborations externes. Il s'agit d'une position sur place basée à Pleasanton, CA. Les prestations de réinstallation ne sont pas offertes. Qui vous êtes : (Requis)
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en biologie (ou domaine connexe) plus 10 ans d'expérience pertinente; ou une maîtrise en biologie (ou domaine connexe) plus 6 ans; ou un doctorat en biologie (ou domaine connexe) et 4 ans d'expérience pertinente.
• Vous avez plus de 3 ans d'expérience en immunohistochimie (IHC).
• Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience dans une solide expérience en pathologie, histologie ou oncologie
• Vous avez la capacité de traduire les connaissances biologiques en stratégies pratiques de développement de tests.
• Vous avez de solides capacités d'analyse et de pensée critique avec attention aux détails; vous avez la capacité de gérer plusieurs projets et de produire des résultats dans un environnement rapide; vous avez un esprit de collaboration avec une capacité de leadership démontrée

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:

• En tant que Directeur / Directrice Régional des Ventes pour la Gamme Core Lab, vous êtes responsable de la qualité du service produit par l’équipe et de l’amélioration continue des processus que vous supervisez.

• Leader VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coach), vous savez engager autour d’une vision stratégique, et structurer les activités de manière efficace et collaborative.

• En tant que coach, vous accompagnez le développement de votre équipe, savez repérer et faire grandir les talents.

• Multiplicateur de la culture agile, vous mettez en place au sein de votre équipe un cadre d’autonomie croissante et créez les conditions d’une décision déléguée efficace; vous recrutez les talents dont l’organisation a besoin, anticipez les nouvelles compétences grâce à la veille des évolutions du marché et à vos connexions au sein du groupe,

• Enfin, vous incarnez les Leadership commitments.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous participez à des projets/squads au sein de votre Chapter/de la FIiliale/ de la Région

• Vous pilotez l’activité commerciale des comptes locaux et mettez en œuvre l’évolution des pratiques et compétences des CSM (Customer Success Managers) au regard des objectifs stratégiques de la filiale et du groupe (notamment en lien avec les Key Account Managers).

• Vous êtes également garant(e) du strict respect de la compliance pour votre équipe et du respect des politiques et processus de pricing pour les gammes, par segment.

• Vous coopérez avec les Network Leads et le Resource Manager de manière à garantir le bon niveau de compétence et de ressources pour les SPS dans le respect des objectifs financiers .

• Agent du changement, vous êtes responsable de la bonne adoption des nouveaux processus vente dans la filiale et de la coopération inter Chapters

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous bénéficiez d'une solide culture de l'industrie du diagnostic et, plus largement, de l'écosystème de la santé

• Expérimenté en management d’équipe, vous maîtrisez les postures de leader et de coach pour inspirer, engager et faire grandir vos équipes

• Doté d'une forte pensée systémique, vous excellez dans la gestion d'environnements complexes et pilotez vos projets avec agilité

• Vos compétences en négociation de haut niveau et votre sens des affaires (business acumen) sont reconnus

• Vous possédez une excellente communication (écrite et orale), un esprit de synthèse affûté

• Votre anglais est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Project Leader , serás responsable de generar una experiencia de cliente superior desde tu experiencia en gestión de proyectos, logrando implementar soluciones integrales que garanticen la máxima satisfacción, fidelización del cliente y la rentabilidad de nuestro negocio. En este rol dentro de la división de Diagnóstica (DIA), actuarás como el orquestador técnico y operativo que planifica, ejecuta y asegura la puesta en marcha de proyectos de mayor envergadura y complejidad.

The Opportunity

• Orquestar la implementación: Planificar, coordinar y ejecutar la instalación de sistemas de diagnóstico de mediana y gran envergadura.

• Co-diseñar la estrategia: Validar las propuestas técnicas y económicas junto a los equipos de Comercial, Estrategia y Servicio Técnico.

• Optimizar recursos: Gestionar tiempos, costos y presupuestos en conjunto con los KAMs de Servicio y Líderes de línea.

• Asegurar la cadena de suministro: Monitorear el abastecimiento de instrumentos, reactivos y repuestos junto al área de Importaciones.

• Mitigar riesgos: Diseñar y ejecutar planes de contingencia eficaces ante desvíos en el cronograma.

• Comunicación y Control: Controlar el avance del proyecto, reportar los estados a los clientes (internos/externos) y mantener los KPIs actualizados.

Who you are

• Formación: Profesional titulado en áreas de la Salud (Tecnología Médica, Bioquímica, Biomédica o carreras afines) o Ingeniería (Civil, Electrónica, Industrial o carreras afines).

• Experiencia (Excluyente): Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en laboratorios clínicos, gestión de clientes e implementación de proyectos en el sector salud.

• Project Management: Experiencia demostrable en gestión de proyectos complejos, idealmente bajo metodología del PMI o metodologías ágiles.

• Herramientas: Dominio de Microsoft Project, Microsoft Excel, Monday.com o plataformas afines de análisis de datos y gestión de proyectos.

• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (lectura técnica y comunicación operativa).

• Habilidades blandas: Orientación al cliente, autonomía, negociación y adaptabilidad al modelo de liderazgo VACC (Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach y Catalizador).

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients' lives and are bold in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. This is why we come to work each day, committed to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and ensuring access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

We are seeking a Principal Scientist I to join our Molecular Lab, Research and Early Development Team, Oncology and Genetics. Within the Roche Diagnostics organization, our Research and Early Development teams are committed to making a tangible impact on the future of healthcare. The Principal Scientist I brings technical depth and breadth, curiosity, and the creativity to be an important contributor in developing novel molecular diagnostic assays. The goal will be to build sequencing assays on our revolutionary Axelios Sequencing platform and translating the immense potential of our Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) technology into real-world assays that can benefit patients. This is a hands-on, lab-based role where scientific excellence and a proactive, results-oriented mindset are paramount. You will spearhead innovative projects and key collaborations, driving the science from the initial idea to a fully realized solution.

This is an opportunity for a visionary scientist to not only pioneer new workflows but to help shape the next generation of medical innovation.

The Opportunity

• You will join a diverse local team of dedicated and curious scientists where you will role-model leadership qualities, mentor junior scientists, and champion a culture of scientific rigor and innovation.

• You will prototype and optimize different sequencing assay workflows by aligning pharma project needs, designing and implementing rigorous experiments, and applying established and innovative procedures to enable end-to-end solutions; You will proactively highlight issues, troubleshoot assays, and resolve technical challenges by applying broad knowledge of molecular biology techniques and accumulated experience

• You will work closely with the commercial team, external pharma partners, and internal bioinformatics colleagues to implement and analyze novel workflows to further pharma collaborations. You'll translate complex data into meaningful interpretations for internal and external stakeholders.

• You will support the adoption of Axelios sequencing technology and the growth of the pharma service business by executing pilot collaboration projects, creating technical documentations including standard operating protocols, and supporting assay transfer to the CLIA laboratory.

• You will identify and champion new technological opportunities, contributing to the strategic direction of the R&D organization.

This position is based on-site (4+ days) in Pleasanton, CA.
There is no relocation support.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a PhD in Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, (or a related field) with 5+ years of relevant industry experience

• You have a deep understanding of molecular biology in NGS workflows beyond routine preparation of sequencing libraries.

• You have demonstrated experience designing and optimizing novel NGS workflows.

• You have demonstrated the ability to critically examine assay workflows and troubleshoot unknown and unfamiliar issues.

• You have experience with diagnostic assay development, including a high level understanding of the regulatory framework for RUO, LDT, or IVD ass

La posizione A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell'azione. Crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Questo è il motivo per cui andiamo a lavorare ogni giorno, impegnati a rigore scientifico, etica insopportabile, e garantire l'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Stiamo cercando un principale scienziato I per unire il nostro laboratorio molecolare, la ricerca e il team di sviluppo precoce, oncologia e genetica. All'interno dell'organizzazione Roche Diagnostics, i nostri team di ricerca e sviluppo precoce sono impegnati a fare un impatto tangibile sul futuro della salute. Il principale scienziato che porto profondità tecnica e larghezza, curiosità, e la creatività per essere un contributo importante nello sviluppo di nuovi saggi diagnostici molecolari. L'obiettivo sarà quello di costruire saggi di sequenziamento sulla nostra piattaforma rivoluzionaria Axelios Sequencing e tradurre l'immenso potenziale della nostra tecnologia Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) in saggi reali che possono beneficiare i pazienti. Questo è un ruolo pratico e basato sul laboratorio in cui l'eccellenza scientifica e una mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati sono fondamentali. Proverai progetti innovativi e collaborazioni chiave, guidando la scienza dall'idea iniziale a una soluzione completamente realizzata. Questa è un'opportunità per uno scienziato visionario di non solo pioniere nuovi flussi di lavoro, ma di contribuire a plasmare la prossima generazione di innovazione medica. L'opportunità
• Ti unirai a un team locale diversificato di scienziati dedicati e curiosi dove potrai modellare qualità di leadership, mentore junior scienziati, e sostenere una cultura del rigore scientifico e dell'innovazione.
• Prototipi e ottimizza diversi flussi di lavoro di analisi di sequenziamento allineando le esigenze del progetto farmaceutico, progettando e implementando rigorosi esperimenti, e applicando procedure consolidate e innovative per consentire soluzioni end-to-end; Potrai evidenziare proattivamente i problemi, risolvere i saggi e risolvere le sfide tecniche applicando una vasta conoscenza delle tecniche di biologia molecolare e l'esperienza accumulata
• Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team commerciale, i partner esterni di farmaci e i colleghi di bioinformatica interni per implementare e analizzare nuovi flussi di lavoro per ulteriori collaborazioni farmacologiche. Tradurrete dati complessi in interpretazioni significative per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Sosterrai l'adozione della tecnologia di sequenziamento di Axelios e la crescita del business dei servizi farmaceutici eseguendo progetti di collaborazione pilota, creando documenti tecnici tra cui protocolli operativi standard, e sostenendo il trasferimento di saggi al laboratorio CLIA.
• Identificherai e campionerai nuove opportunità tecnologiche, contribuendo alla direzione strategica dell'organizzazione R&D. Questa posizione si basa sul sito (4+ giorni) in Pleasanton, CA. Non c'è supporto di trasferimento. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai un dottorato in Bioingegneria, Biologia Molecolare, Genetica, Biochimica, (o un campo correlato) con 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore
• Avete una profonda comprensione della biologia molecolare nei flussi di lavoro NGS oltre la preparazione di routine di sequenziamento delle biblioteche.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella progettazione e nell'ottimizzazione dei nuovi flussi di lavoro NGS.
• Hai dimostrato la capacità di esaminare criticamente i flussi di lavoro di saggi e risolvere problemi sconosciuti e non familiari.
• Hai esperienza con lo sviluppo del test diagnostico, tra cui una comprensione di alto livello del quadro normativo per RUO, LDT, o il culo IVD

• Sie prototypisieren und optimieren verschiedene Sequenzierungs-Assay-Workflows, indem Sie die Anforderungen des Pharma-Projekts abstimmen, strenge Experimente entwerfen und implementieren und etablierte und innovative Verfahren anwenden, um End-to-End-Lösungen zu ermöglichen; Sie werden proaktiv Probleme hervorheben, Tests zur Fehlerbehebung und technische Herausforderungen lösen, indem Sie ein breites Wissen über molekularbiologische Techniken und gesammelte Erfahrung anwenden
• Sie arbeiten eng mit dem kaufmännischen Team, externen Pharma-Partnern und internen Bioinformatik-Kollegen zusammen, um neue Workflows für weitere Pharma-Kooperationen zu implementieren und zu analysieren. Sie übersetzen komplexe Daten in sinnvolle Interpretationen für interne und externe Stakeholder.
• Sie unterstützen die Einführung der Axelios-Sequenzierungstechnologie und das Wachstum des Pharma-Service-Geschäfts durch die Durchführung von Pilotprojekten, die Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen einschließlich Standardbetriebsprotokollen und die Unterstützung des Assaytransfers in das CLIA-Labor.

• Sie haben ein tiefes Verständnis der Molekularbiologie in NGS-Workflows jenseits der routinemäßigen Vorbereitung von Sequenzierungsbibliotheken.
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Optimierung neuartiger NGS-Workflows gezeigt.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are in the midst of the ASPIRE program—one of our most significant enterprise-wide digital transformations, simplifying global processes and transitioning our global footprint to a modern ERP environment . A transformation of this scale succeeds only when built on a foundation of high-fidelity, trusted data .
The ASPIRE Data Migration team orchestrates the journey of our global data footprint . We are looking for a highly skilled Data Management & Governance Specialist to execute our end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring a seamless, accurate, and secure transition from complex legacy systems to our future-state digital backbone .

The Role: What You Will Do
In this enterprise-level position, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business goals . You will navigate complex legacy data structures, manage large-scale data governance platforms, and ensure migrated data perfectly supports global operations .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Migration Strategy Execution: Lead the design and execution of comprehensive data migration frameworks, policies, and processes to smoothly transition legacy data into the new ERP environment .

• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain advanced enterprise-level data governance frameworks that scale across the organization, ensuring robust data compliance practices .

• Complex Problem Solving: Tackle highly complex data migration anomalies and discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis to protect the integrity of corporate data .

• Data Profiling & Quality: Establish rigorous data quality metrics, validation standards, cleansing routines, and profiling methodologies to ensure a high-fidelity migration .

• Target Data Mapping: Analyze convoluted, highly fragmented legacy data architectures and map them cleanly to future-state target ERP data models .

• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a key strategic advisor, liaising directly with senior leadership, functional business owners, and external vendors to align on migration strategy and translate technical data risks into clear business impacts .

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, direct, and mentor junior specialists and cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment .

​ What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Background

• Extensive Experience: A proven track record of leading full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms and continuously improving complex migration frameworks .

• Governance Impact: Demonstrated success spearheading high-impact data governance projects that successfully shape overarching organizational data policies and long-term business strategies .

• Matrix Collaboration: Experience working alongside technical teams, business leaders, and external consultants within a global, fast-moving organization .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Tooling Expertise: Recognized technical mastery in industry-standard data migration and ETL tools .

• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Advanced capabilities in data profiling, structural validation, and complex data cleansing to achieve absolute data hygiene .

• Data Modeling: Exceptional ability to deconstruct legacy systems and translate them into clean, structured target configurations .

Leadership & Communication

• Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable guiding senior executives through governance strategy decis

La posizione Chi siamo A Roche, siamo nel mezzo del programma ASPIRE, una delle nostre più significative trasformazioni digitali a livello aziendale, semplificando i processi globali e trasformando la nostra impronta globale in un ambiente ERP moderno . Una trasformazione di questa scala riesce solo quando costruito su una fondazione di alta fedeltà, dati di fiducia. Il team ASPIRE Data Migration organizza il viaggio della nostra impronta globale dei dati . Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Data Management & Governance Specialist per eseguire la nostra strategia di migrazione dei dati end-to-end, garantendo una transizione senza soluzione di continuità, accurata e sicura da sistemi legacy complessi alla nostra backbone digitale di stato futuro. Il ruolo: cosa farai In questa posizione a livello aziendale, colmare il divario tra ingegneria dei dati tecnici e obiettivi strategici di business . Potrai navigare in strutture dati legacy complesse, gestire piattaforme di governance dati su larga scala, e garantire i dati migrati perfettamente supporta le operazioni globali. Le tue responsabilità principali includono:
• Esecuzione di strategia di migrazione: portare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di quadri di migrazione dati completi, politiche e processi per transizione senza intoppi dati legacy nel nuovo ambiente ERP .
• Governance & Compliance Avanzata: Progettazione, implementare e mantenere avanzati framework di governance dei dati a livello aziendale che si ridimensionano in tutta l'organizzazione, garantendo pratiche di conformità dei dati robuste .
• Risolvere i problemi complessi: alterare le anomalie e le discrepanze della migrazione dei dati altamente complesse, eseguendo l'analisi root-cause per proteggere l'integrità dei dati aziendali.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are in the midst of the ASPIRE program—one of our most significant enterprise-wide digital transformations, simplifying global processes and transitioning our global footprint to a modern ERP environment . A transformation of this scale succeeds only when built on a foundation of high-fidelity, trusted data .
The ASPIRE Data Migration team orchestrates the journey of our global data footprint . We are looking for a highly skilled Data Management & Governance Specialist to execute our end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring a seamless, accurate, and secure transition from complex legacy systems to our future-state digital backbone .

The Role: What You Will Do
In this enterprise-level position, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business goals . You will navigate complex legacy data structures, manage large-scale data governance platforms, and ensure migrated data perfectly supports global operations .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Migration Strategy Execution: Lead the design and execution of comprehensive data migration frameworks, policies, and processes to smoothly transition legacy data into the new ERP environment .

• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain advanced enterprise-level data governance frameworks that scale across the organization, ensuring robust data compliance practices .

• Complex Problem Solving: Tackle highly complex data migration anomalies and discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis to protect the integrity of corporate data .

• Data Profiling & Quality: Establish rigorous data quality metrics, validation standards, cleansing routines, and profiling methodologies to ensure a high-fidelity migration .

• Target Data Mapping: Analyze convoluted, highly fragmented legacy data architectures and map them cleanly to future-state target ERP data models .

• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a key strategic advisor, liaising directly with senior leadership, functional business owners, and external vendors to align on migration strategy and translate technical data risks into clear business impacts .

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, direct, and mentor junior specialists and cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment .

​ What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Background

• Extensive Experience: A proven track record of leading full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms and continuously improving complex migration frameworks .

• Governance Impact: Demonstrated success spearheading high-impact data governance projects that successfully shape overarching organizational data policies and long-term business strategies .

• Matrix Collaboration: Experience working alongside technical teams, business leaders, and external consultants within a global, fast-moving organization .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Tooling Expertise: Recognized technical mastery in industry-standard data migration and ETL tools .

• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Advanced capabilities in data profiling, structural validation, and complex data cleansing to achieve absolute data hygiene .

• Data Modeling: Exceptional ability to deconstruct legacy systems and translate them into clean, structured target configurations .

Leadership & Communication

• Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable guiding senior executives through governance strategy decis

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche, nous sommes au cœur du programme ASPIRE, l'une de nos transformations numériques les plus importantes à l'échelle de l'entreprise, simplifiant les processus mondiaux et transformant notre empreinte mondiale en un environnement ERP moderne. Une transformation de cette échelle ne réussit que lorsqu'elle est construite sur une base de haute fidélité, de données de confiance. L'équipe ASPIRE Data Migration orchestre le parcours de notre empreinte de données globale. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste hautement qualifié en gestion de données et gouvernance pour exécuter notre stratégie de migration de données de bout en bout, en assurant une transition transparente, précise et sécurisée de systèmes existants complexes à notre colonne vertébrale numérique future. Le rôle : ce que vous ferez Dans cette position au niveau de l'entreprise, vous comblerez l'écart entre l'ingénierie des données techniques et les objectifs commerciaux stratégiques. Vous naviguerez dans des structures complexes de données existantes, gérerez des plates-formes de gouvernance de données à grande échelle et vous assurerez que les données migrées prennent parfaitement en charge les opérations mondiales. Vos responsabilités principales comprendront :
• Exécution de la stratégie de migration : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de cadres, de politiques et de processus complets de migration des données pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des données héritées dans le nouvel environnement ERP.
• Gouvernance et conformité avancées : Concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des cadres avancés de gouvernance des données au niveau de l'entreprise qui s'étendent à l'ensemble de l'organisation, assurant des pratiques de conformité des données solides.
• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Tâcher des anomalies et des anomalies de migration des données très complexes, effectuer une analyse racine-cause pour protéger l'intégrité des données de l'entreprise.
• Profil et qualité des données: Établir des mesures rigoureuses de qualité des données, des normes de validation, des routines de nettoyage et des méthodologies de profilage pour assurer une migration à haute fidélité.
• Cible de cartographie des données : Analyser les architectures de données existantes, très fragmentées, et les cartographier proprement aux modèles de données ERP cibles futurs.
• Alignement des intervenants principaux : Agir en tant que conseiller stratégique clé, assurer la liaison directe avec les cadres supérieurs, les propriétaires d'entreprises fonctionnels et les fournisseurs externes afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie de migration et de traduire les risques liés aux données techniques en impacts opérationnels clairs.
• Leadership d'équipe et mentorat : Guider, diriger et mentorer les jeunes spécialistes et les équipes interfonctionnelles, favoriser un environnement collaboratif et performant. Ce que vous apporterez à l'équipe Expérience et contexte
• Expérience approfondie: Une expérience éprouvée de projets de migration de données à cycle complet pour les grandes plates-formes ERP et l'amélioration continue des cadres de migration complexes.
• Impact de la gouvernance : Succès démontré à l'origine de projets de gouvernance des données à impact élevé qui façonnent avec succès les politiques globales en matière de données organisationnelles et les stratégies opérationnelles à long terme .
• Collaboration Matrix : Expérience en collaboration avec des équipes techniques, des chefs d'entreprise et des consultants externes au sein d'une organisation mondiale en évolution rapide. Compétences techniques et artisanat
• Expertise en matière d'outillage : Maîtrise technique reconnue dans les outils de migration de données standard et ETL.
• Nettoyage et profilage des données: Capacités avancées en profilage des données, validation structurelle et nettoyage des données complexes pour atteindre l'hygiène absolue des données.
• Modélisation des données: Capacité exceptionnelle de déconstruire les systèmes existants et de les traduire en configurations cibles propres et structurées. Leadership et communication
• Présence de la haute direction : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des intervenants et en conseil, orientation confortable des cadres supérieurs à travers la stratégie de gouvernance décis

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Q

jobs.title: Data Scientist Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data Scientist Intern Position Overview
Location: Shanghai/Beijing, China (Onsite)
Duration: 6 months (Minimum 3 days per week)
Team: CET-China AI platform & adoption

We are looking for a passionate, innovative Data Scientist Intern to join our team. In this role, you will be working alongside senior AI scientists and engineers to research AI products, explore data-driven AI use cases, and develop advanced algorithms and models to solve real-world healthcare challenges.

Key Responsibilities

• Algorithm & Model Research: Assist in researching, designing, and evaluating machine learning, deep learning, or Generative AI models tailored to specific product use cases.

• Data Exploration & Analysis: Dive into large-scale datasets to uncover patterns, extract meaningful features, and identify opportunities for AI-driven products.

• Prototyping & PoC (Proof of Concept): Build and test prototypes to validate new AI algorithms and evaluate the feasibility of cutting-edge algorithms within China AI platform & adoption ecosystem.

• Model Optimization: Support the evaluation, fine-tuning, and optimization of existing AI models to improve their accuracy, performance, and robustness.

What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)

• Education: Currently pursuing a Master’s (exceptional Bachelor’s candidates will also be considered) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related highly quantitative field.

• Programming Skills: Solid coding skills in Python, with a strong command of standard AI/ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas).

• AI Knowledge: A strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning architectures, statistical modeling, and data evaluation metrics.

• Research Capability: Demonstrated ability to conduct independent literature reviews, read and synthesize cutting-edge AI research papers, and extract actionable insights for practical use cases.

• Theoretical Foundations: A deep mathematical understanding of machine learning and deep learning principles, including optimization algorithms, loss functions, linear algebra, and probability theory. You should know how models work under the hood, not just how to call their APIs.

• Prototyping & Frameworks: Hands-on experience with research-centric AI frameworks etc. Ability to rapidly translate academic algorithms into working prototypes or Proof of Concepts (PoCs).

• Experimental Design: Strong skills in designing rigorous AI experiments, selecting appropriate baseline models, establishing robust evaluation metrics, and performing comprehensive benchmark analysis.

• GenAI / LLM Research Experience: Deep interest or hands-on research experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), including Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT like LoRA), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) evaluation, or Agentic workflows.

• Paper Replication: A strong GitHub portfolio showcasing your ability to replicate algorithms from recent research papers from scratch.

• Languages: Full professional proficiency in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken). Reading and comprehending complex English technical papers is a daily requirement.

• Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, data scientists and necessary stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into actionable AI research topics and technical solutions.

• Capacità di ricerca: capacità dimostrata di condurre recensioni di letteratura indipendente, leggere e sintetizzare documenti di ricerca AI all'avanguardia e di estrarre intuizioni attuabili per casi di uso pratico.
• Fondazioni teoriche: una profonda comprensione matematica dei principi di machine learning e deep learning, inclusi algoritmi di ottimizzazione, funzioni di perdita, algebra lineare e teoria delle probabilità. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Global Procurement function, which supports Roche’s goal of bringing innovative solutions to patients through business and supplier partnerships. We act as the bridge between Roche business functions and our suppliers, delivering value through productivity, speed, risk management, sustainability, innovative solutions, and streamlined buying experiences.

As the Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will be part of Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Our purpose is to advance value delivery through digital solutions & excellence, with Digital & AI augmenting and amplifying our capacity and capability to magnify outcomes, eventually delivering greater impact per person and a better procurement experience.
Reporting to the Procurement AI Solutions Lead, your primary responsibility is to design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows that transform procurement processes. Leveraging your specialized knowledge and expertise, you will work hands-on with Generative AI, workflow orchestration platforms, MCPs, enterprise systems, and internal data sources to deliver production-ready AI solutions. You will proactively help Global Procurement improve productivity, speed, user experience, quality, and decision-making across the procurement ecosystem.
You will work closely with Procurement SMEs, internal AI solution engineers, Digital peers, IT, Analytics & Insights, and external partners to move high-value ideas from opportunity framing into robust solution concepts, pilots, and scalable implementations. You will bridge strategic AI priorities and the practical realities of building reliable, enterprise-ready solutions in a complex global procurement environment.

Your Key Responsabilities:

As a Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will play a pivotal role according to your experience, knowledge, and strategic business/team requirements, including but not limited to:

• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner with procurement teams to identify, structure, and validate high-impact automation and AI use cases. Translate business needs, process complexity, policy requirements, data realities, and user experience considerations into clear solution designs.

• Workflow & Agent Design: Design and build intelligent workflow logic for procurement use cases, combining AI capabilities, business rules, MCP and API integrations, data checks, human-in-the-loop steps, and measurable quality controls. Independently build, configure and embed AI agents into existing procurement systems and processes to automate end-to-end tasks.

• Rapid Prototyping: Build and test initial proofs-of-concept (PoCs) using workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier) and internal data sources to validate value quickly before full-scale engineering. Translate learnings into actionable specifications for internal teams, external partners, and solution engineers.

• Solution Evaluation & Observability: Utilize enterprise LLM observability and evaluation tools to monitor agent behavior, track accuracy, analyze failure modes, and systematically iterate on prompts and workflow logic to ensure production-grade reliability.

• Build & Delivery Orchestration: Act as product/solution owner from discovery to scalable rollout. Manage scope, timelines, dependencies, value hypotheses, success metrics, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex matrix environment.

• Enterprise-Ready Solution Thinking: Collaborate with Digital Governance & Management, IT, Compl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sulla funzione Global Procurement, che supporta l’obiettivo di Roche di portare soluzioni innovative ai pazienti attraverso partnership di business e fornitori. Agiamo come ponte tra le funzioni aziendali Roche e i nostri fornitori, offrendo valore attraverso produttività, velocità, gestione dei rischi, sostenibilità, soluzioni innovative e esperienze di acquisto semplificate. In qualità di Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), farai parte di Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Il nostro scopo è quello di promuovere la consegna del valore attraverso soluzioni digitali e eccellenza, con Digital & AI che aumenta e amplifica la nostra capacità e capacità di magnificare i risultati, alla fine di fornire un maggiore impatto per persona e una migliore esperienza di approvvigionamento. Segnalandosi al Leader delle soluzioni AI di appalti, la vostra responsabilità primaria è quella di progettare, costruire, testare e distribuire agenti AI e flussi di lavoro agentici che trasformano i processi di approvvigionamento. Sfruttando le tue conoscenze e competenze specialistiche, lavorerai a stretto contatto con l'IA Generativa, piattaforme di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro, MCP, sistemi aziendali e fonti di dati interne per fornire soluzioni AI pronte alla produzione. Aiuterai proattivamente il Global Procurement a migliorare la produttività, la velocità, l'esperienza utente, la qualità e il processo decisionale in tutto l'ecosistema di approvvigionamento. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le PMI di approvvigionamento, gli ingegneri della soluzione AI interna, i coetanei digitali, l'IT, l'analisi e le insights e i partner esterni per spostare idee ad alto valore dall'opportunità di inquadrare in concetti di soluzione robusta, piloti e implementazioni scalabili. Avrete a ponte le priorità strategiche dell'IA e le realtà pratiche di costruire soluzioni affidabili e pronte all'impresa in un complesso ambiente di approvvigionamento globale. Le tue responsabilità chiave: In qualità di Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale in base alle tue esigenze di esperienza, conoscenza e business/team strategici, inclusi ma non limitati a:
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner con i team di approvvigionamento per identificare, strutturare e convalidare i casi di automazione ad alto impatto e utilizzo di AI. Traduci le esigenze aziendali, la complessità del processo, i requisiti politici, le realtà dei dati e le considerazioni sull'esperienza degli utenti in progetti di soluzione chiari.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Progettare e costruire logica di flusso di lavoro intelligente per l'approvvigionamento di casi di utilizzo, combinando capacità di AI, regole aziendali, integrazioni MCP e API, controlli di dati, passi umani-in-the-loop e controlli di qualità misurabili. Creare, configurare e incorporare agenti AI in sistemi e processi di approvvigionamento esistenti per automatizzare le attività end-to-end.
• Prototipazione rapida: costruire e testare le prove iniziali-di-concetto (PoCs) utilizzando strumenti di automazione del flusso di lavoro (ad esempio, n8n, Zapier) e fonti di dati interne per convalidare il valore rapidamente prima dell'ingegneria su larga scala. Traduci gli insegnamenti in specifiche attuabili per team interni, partner esterni e ingegneri di soluzioni.
• Valutazione & Osservabilità della soluzione: Utilizzare strumenti di osservazione e valutazione LLM aziendali per monitorare il comportamento dell'agente, tracciare la precisione, analizzare i modi di guasto, e iterare sistematicamente su richieste e logica del flusso di lavoro per garantire l'affidabilità di livello di produzione.
• Build & Delivery Orchestration: Agite come proprietario del prodotto/soluzione dalla scoperta al rollout scalabile. Gestisci portata, tempestività, dipendenze, ipotesi di valore, metriche di successo, rischi e aspettative degli stakeholder in un ambiente di matrice complesso.
• Soluzione Enterprise-Ready Pensare: Collaborare con Digital Governance & Management, IT, Compl

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Job description
The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation.
Description of the area

Key Responsibilities:

• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.

• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.

• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.

• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.

• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.

• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery.

Technical Requirements & Expertise:

• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.

• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.

• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.

• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.

• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.

• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 10

• Profondità del servizio di sicurezza: profonda comprensione concettuale del ciclo di vita SIEM/Log Management (Collezione, Indicizzazione, Storage, Retention and Searching) e Vulnerability Management.
• Fondamenti di rete: comprensione esperto della rete (TCP/IP, Bilanciamento del carico, Firewalls) come si riferisce al trasporto di dati di sicurezza ad alto volume.
• Coding & API Mastery: Forte esperienza con Python e interagire con le complesse API REST. Prove capacità di interconnettere tecnologie disparate tramite API e integrazioni personalizzate.
• DevOps moderno: forte esperienza con Ansible e GitHub per la gestione delle infrastrutture.
• AI/Automazione avanzata: Esperienza comprovata o profonda costruzione del lavoro di progetto Flussi di lavoro di AI Agentic. Competenze pratiche in MCP (Model Context Protocol) o la costruzione di strumenti basati su LLM personalizzati per automatizzare i compiti tecnici.

Organization: China Enterprise Technology (CET)
Location: Shanghai, China

Position Summary
Roche is seeking a versatile and highly motivated Enterprise Technology Intern to join our China Enterprise Technology (CET) team. In this hybrid role, you will bridge the gap between technical project management, DevOps engineering, and operations research.
You will be instrumental in driving our infrastructure modernization by coordinating the large-scale migration of over 100 GitLab projects. Simultaneously, you will dive deep into scientific computing by designing a Linear Programming model to optimize GPU resource allocation for our complex, data-heavy scientific workloads (such as bioinformatics and computational chemistry).

Key Responsibilities
1. Project Coordination & Governance

• Act as the project coordinator for cross-functional IT, DevOps, and scientific computing teams within CET.

• Facilitate project meetings, track milestones, and manage timelines using Agile methodologies.

• Maintain clear documentation, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and present progress reports to technical leads and stakeholders.

• Identify project bottlenecks and collaborate with team members to resolve blockers efficiently.
2. Large-Scale GitLab Projects Migration

• Plan and execute the seamless migration of 100+ GitLab projects into a unified, secure enterprise environment.

• Ensure the integrity of source code, commit histories, access controls, and environment variables during the transition.

• Update and validate CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous integration remains uninterrupted post-migration.

• Create automated scripts and clear user guides to assist development teams in adapting to the new repository structures.
3. Computing Resource Optimization for Scientific Workloads

• Formulate a Linear Programming (LP) model to optimize the scheduling and allocation of Computing resources for intensive scientific workloads (e.g., genomics, drug discovery simulations, and AI/ML modeling).

• Analyze compute constraints, job priorities, memory requirements, and runtime patterns to maximize cluster throughput and minimize idle time.

• Implement optimization solutions using Python libraries

• Deliver data-driven insights and a proof-of-concept scheduling algorithm to improve the cost-efficiency of Roche’s scientific computing infrastructure.
Key Qualifications

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Bioinformatics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• DevOps & IT Skills: Experience with version control systems (Git) and an understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

• Programming & Math: Strong proficiency in Python and a solid foundational knowledge of mathematical optimization and Linear Programming.

• Project Management: Familiarity with Agile frameworks and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, or Monday.

• Domain Interest: A strong interest in scientific computing, healthcare technology, or bioinformatics infrastructure.

• Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and the capacity to work independently in a dynamic environment.

• Languages: Fluent in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken).
What We Offer

• Meaningful, hands-on experience at the intersection of enterprise IT, DevOps, and life sciences.

• Direct mentorship from experienced architects, DevOps engineers,

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
JD - China Enterprise Technology Intern
Company: Roche
Organization: China Enterprise Technology (CET)
Location: Shanghai, China
Duration: 3–6 months

Position Summary
Roche is seeking a versatile and highly motivated Enterprise Technology Intern to join our China Enterprise Technology (CET) team. In this hybrid role, you will bridge the gap between technical project management, DevOps engineering, and operations research.
You will be instrumental in driving our infrastructure modernization by coordinating the large-scale migration of over 100 GitLab projects. Simultaneously, you will dive deep into scientific computing by designing a Linear Programming model to optimize GPU resource allocation for our complex, data-heavy scientific workloads (such as bioinformatics and computational chemistry).

Key Responsibilities
1. Project Coordination & Governance

• Act as the project coordinator for cross-functional IT, DevOps, and scientific computing teams within CET.

• Facilitate project meetings, track milestones, and manage timelines using Agile methodologies.

• Maintain clear documentation, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and present progress reports to technical leads and stakeholders.

• Identify project bottlenecks and collaborate with team members to resolve blockers efficiently.
2. Large-Scale GitLab Projects Migration

• Plan and execute the seamless migration of 100+ GitLab projects into a unified, secure enterprise environment.

• Ensure the integrity of source code, commit histories, access controls, and environment variables during the transition.

• Update and validate CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous integration remains uninterrupted post-migration.

• Create automated scripts and clear user guides to assist development teams in adapting to the new repository structures.
3. Computing Resource Optimization for Scientific Workloads

• Formulate a Linear Programming (LP) model to optimize the scheduling and allocation of Computing resources for intensive scientific workloads (e.g., genomics, drug discovery simulations, and AI/ML modeling).

• Analyze compute constraints, job priorities, memory requirements, and runtime patterns to maximize cluster throughput and minimize idle time.

• Implement optimization solutions using Python libraries

• Deliver data-driven insights and a proof-of-concept scheduling algorithm to improve the cost-efficiency of Roche’s scientific computing infrastructure.
Key Qualifications

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Bioinformatics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• DevOps & IT Skills: Experience with version control systems (Git) and an understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

• Programming & Math: Strong proficiency in Python and a solid foundational knowledge of mathematical optimization and Linear Programming.

• Project Management: Familiarity with Agile frameworks and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, or Monday.

• Domain Interest: A strong interest in scientific computing, healthcare technology, or bioinformatics infrastructure.

• Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and the capacity to work independently in a dynamic environment.

• Languages: Fluent in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken).
What We Offer

• Meaningful, hands-on experience at the intersection of enterprise IT, DevOps, and life sciences.

• Direct mentorship from experienced architects, DevOps engineers,

The Position
Technisches Praktikum im Sustainability Bereich bei RDA Ludwigsburg

Wir sind das Sustainability Netzwerk am Roche Standort Ludwigsburg und treiben mit viel Engagement und Leidenschaft die Themen rund um Nachhaltigkeit voran. Bestehend aus den Bereichen SHE (Safety, Health, Environment), Mobility und Energiemanagement unterstützen und beraten wir bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und regulatorischen Anforderungen.
Bei uns erhältst du Einblicke in das tägliche Geschäft des Sustainability Teams eines dynamischen Entwicklungs- und Produktionsstandortes. Während dem Praktikum kannst du eigene Ideen einbringen und operative Aufgaben und Projekte im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit mitgestalten. Dabei kannst du deine im Studium erlernten Fähigkeiten in der Praxis anwenden und wertvolle Berufserfahrung sammeln.

Nutze deine Chance und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Während deines Praktikums wirst du die Möglichkeiten haben mit deinen Beiträgen an folgenden Aufgaben mitzuwirken:

• Implementierung technischer Lösungen & KI: Eigenständige Identifikation, Evaluierung und Einführung von neuen Software- oder KI-Lösungen zur Optimierung und Automatisierung von Nachhaltigkeitsprozessen (z. B. KI-gestützte Datenanalysen, automatisierte Workflows oder digitale Tools zur Verbrauchsüberwachung).

• Operative Unterstützung: Mithilfe bei Risk Assessments und Durchführung von Unfallanalysen sowie Unterstützung bei Compliance- und Governance-Themen.

• Kennzahlen & Analytics: Unterstützung bei der Erfassung, Berechnung und modernen, ggf. automatisierten Darstellung von Kennzahlen und KPIs.

• Schulungen & Training: Mithilfe bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen und Unterweisungen.

• Kommunikation & Awareness: Mitgestaltung und Optimierung des Intranet-Auftritts und der standortweiten Kommunikation von Nachhaltigkeitsthemen zur Erhöhung des Bewusstseins der Mitarbeitenden.

Schwerpunkttätigkeiten des Praktikums werden im Zusammenhang mit Projektaufkommen und Interessen des/der Kandidaten/in festgelegt.

Dein Profil
