descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
RIS delivers digital healthcare solutions to drive lab efficiency and improve patient care. The role of Digital Solution Selling leads two critical mandates in order to drive global, commercial adoption:

• Enterprise Transformation: evolving Roche’s offer from individual products to an integrated, enterprise-wide solution-selling approach

• Affiliate Integration: ensuring affiliates systematically embed digital products into their commercial frameworks and buying cycles

The Opportunity
As the Digital Solution Selling Leader, you will drive global commercial adoption and shape the future of enterprise digital health sales. In this role, you will:

• Lead Digital Solution-Selling Strategy: Drive the commercial shift from product-centric marketing to highly integrated, differentiating enterprise solution-selling frameworks.

• Design Buying-Cycle Frameworks: Architect total commercial solutions that firmly embed digital value at the core of our global commercial strategy.

• Develop Scalable Approaches: Leverage and scale existing enterprise tools and global frameworks (including Global Marketing, Rexis, CSM, and consulting) to maximize commercial differentiation.

• Coach Affiliate Leadership: Partner with and coach affiliate leadership teams to shift mindsets and transition from product-focused to solution-selling commercial engines.

• Orchestrate Cross-Functional Integration: Partner deeply with Go-To-Market (GTM), Global Marketing, Consulting, and Lifecycles to seamlessly embed digital solutions into affiliate frameworks.

• Scale Global Success: Identify adoption barriers across regions and deploy strategic playbooks, value narratives, and best practices to drive measurable commercial impact.

• Lead and Develop Key Capabilities: Coach and foster a high-performing team characterized by strong ownership, clear accountability, and a continuous growth mindset.

• Influence the Product Lifecycle: Provide early commercial insights into the product lifecycle to design digital health solutions for optimal commercial adoption right from the beginning.

Who you are
You are a strategic commercial leader who thrives in complex, matrixed environments, translates customer insights into impactful strategies, and is passionate about driving transformational organizational change.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Diagnostics, Digital Health, Data Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field is required (Advanced degree preferred).

• Commercial Strategy Experience: 8+ years of experience in commercial strategy, solution selling, digital health, diagnostics, healthcare technology, product commercialization, go-to-market, or affiliate/regional commercial roles.

• Leadership Excellence: Proven track record of leading, coaching, and developing teams, either through direct management or in a strong matrix leadership capacity.

• Global & Regional Collaboration: Extensive experience successfully working with global, regional, and affiliate commercial teams within healthcare or diagnostics.

• Framework Architecture: Demonstrated experience building scalable commercial frameworks, global playbooks, enablement approaches, or enterprise solution-selling capabilities.

• Strategic Value Translation: Strong communicator who excels at simplifying complex digital topics, translating customer needs into commercial value, and influencing senior stakeholders.

• Agile & Impact Mindset: Comfort operating in ambiguity, a strong ownership mindset

jobs.title: Head of Engineering DIA R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Engineering DIA R&D

As a Head of Engineering in Diagnostics (DIA) R&D, you’ll lead the teams that build the engineering foundation beneath our science, and the development of your people will be your first responsibility. You’ll help them shape their own career paths and open the opportunities that let them grow, remove the roadblocks in their way, and set the clear goals that good performance management depends on. You’ll lead software and service delivery with focus, clearing impediments, managing stakeholders well and building efficiencies into the way teams collaborate.

Description of the Area:

You’ll architect and deliver the next generation of DIA R&D engineering capabilities, leading teams that bring together advanced AI and ML, laboratory informatics infrastructure and computational science. You’ll develop engineers who can work through the unusual complexity that comes when biology, chemistry and technology meet, from LIMS and ELN systems to agentic AI and cloud-scale data platforms. And you’ll drive technical excellence and pace while holding the rigour and compliance standards that Diagnostics R&D depends on.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you’ll have the room to drive technical excellence and shape platforms built for what comes next. You’ll:

• Develop future capabilities: Build the engineering strengths the function will need next, and coach your people through the long arc of their careers, including the systemic roadblocks that hold whole teams back.

• Shape strategy and vision: Co-create the long-term technical direction and strategy for the computational science and AI/ML platform portfolio.

• Set the technical standard: Define the platform architecture for AI/ML infrastructure (model deployment, MLOps, vector databases), scientific computing (HPC and cloud compute), laboratory informatics (LIMS and ELN integration) and the data platforms beneath them.

• Own delivery: Take accountability for how the portfolio performs in production, holding the line on quality, reliability and the performance SLAs people depend on.

• Manage complex dependencies: Direct technical priorities across a portfolio that spans AI solutions, bioinformatics pipelines, laboratory systems and data infrastructure, keeping the architecture coherent and free of duplication.

• Engage senior stakeholders: Build the relationships that make engineering possible here, with research leadership, IT infrastructure, Quality and Compliance, enterprise architecture and cloud platform teams, and align priorities and resources across them.

• Sharpen engineering practice: Improve how the teams build, from CI/CD pipelines for validated systems to infrastructure-as-code, automated testing and model deployment.

• Steward budget and resources: Manage the team’s budget, including headcount, operating costs and vendor contracts, and make the trade-offs that put resources where they matter most.

Who you are:

We’re looking for a leader who pairs technical depth with regulatory discipline, and who has already built and run engineering organisations rather than stepping up to lead one for the first time. You’ll bring:

• Education: A bachelor’s or advanced degree, typically in an engineering, IT or business discipline.

• Engineering leadership: 10+ years in software and platform engineering, including 5+ years leading cross-functional technical teams, with managers as well as engineers reporting to you.

• Regulated life sciences: 5+ years in pharmaceutical R&D,

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Responsabile Ingegneria DIA R&D Come Capo di Ingegneria in Diagnostics (DIA) R&D, guiderai le squadre che costruiranno la fondazione ingegneristica sotto la nostra scienza, e lo sviluppo della tua gente sarà la tua prima responsabilità. Li aiuterà a modellare i propri percorsi di carriera e aprire le opportunità che li lasciano crescere, rimuovere i blocchi stradali nel loro modo, e impostare gli obiettivi chiari che buona gestione delle prestazioni dipende. Potrai guidare il software e la consegna dei servizi con attenzione, sgomberare gli impedimenti, gestire bene gli stakeholder e costruire le efficienze nel modo in cui i team collaborano. Descrizione dell'Area: Potrai progettare e fornire la prossima generazione di capacità di ingegneria DIA R&D, team leader che riuniscono AI avanzato e ML, infrastruttura informatica di laboratorio e scienza computazionale. Potrai sviluppare ingegneri che possono lavorare attraverso la complessità insolita che viene quando la biologia, la chimica e la tecnologia si incontrano, dai sistemi LIMS e ELN alle piattaforme di dati agentic AI e cloud-scale. E guiderai l'eccellenza tecnica e il ritmo, mantenendo gli standard di rigore e conformità che Diagnostics R&D dipende. L'opportunità: In questo ruolo, avrete la stanza per guidare l'eccellenza tecnica e piattaforme di forma costruite per quello che viene dopo. Lo farai:
• Sviluppare le capacità future: Costruisci i punti di forza ingegneristici che la funzione avrà bisogno dopo, e allenare la tua gente attraverso il lungo arco della loro carriera, tra cui i blocchi stradali sistemici che tengono interi team indietro.
• Strategia e visione della forma: Co-creare la direzione tecnica a lungo termine e la strategia per la scienza computazionale e il portafoglio di piattaforme AI/ML.
• Impostare lo standard tecnico: Definire l'architettura della piattaforma per l'infrastruttura AI/ML (implementazione dei modelli, MLOps, database vettoriali), l'informatica scientifica (HPC e cloud compute), l'informatica di laboratorio (integrazione LIMS e ELN) e le piattaforme di dati sotto di esse.
• Consegna propria: Tenere conto di come il portafoglio esegue in produzione, tenendo la linea sulla qualità, l'affidabilità e le prestazioni SLA persone dipendono.
• Gestire dipendenze complesse: priorità tecniche dirette in un portafoglio che abbraccia soluzioni AI, condotte di bioinformatica, sistemi di laboratorio e infrastrutture dati, mantenendo l'architettura coerente e libera di duplicazione.
• Engage senior stakeholders: Costruire le relazioni che rendono possibile l'ingegneria qui, con la leadership di ricerca, infrastruttura IT, qualità e conformità, team di architettura aziendale e piattaforma cloud, e allineare le priorità e le risorse attraverso di loro.
• Affilare la pratica dell'ingegneria: Migliorare il modo in cui i team costruiscono, dalle tubazioni CI/CD per sistemi convalidati ai codici infrastrutturali, ai test automatizzati e alla distribuzione dei modelli.
• Stimo budget e risorse: Gestisci il budget del team, incluso il conto capo, i costi operativi e i contratti di vendita, e fai i trade-off che mettono le risorse dove più conta. Chi sei: Siamo alla ricerca di un leader che accoppia la profondità tecnica con la disciplina di regolamentazione, e che ha già costruito e gestito organizzazioni di ingegneria piuttosto che salire a guidare uno per la prima volta. Porterai:
• Istruzione: Un diploma di laurea o avanzato, in genere in una disciplina di ingegneria, IT o business.
• leadership di ingegneria: 10+ anni di ingegneria del software e della piattaforma, tra cui 5+ anni leader team tecnici cross-funzionali, con manager e ingegneri che segnalano a voi.
• Scienze della vita regolamentate: 5+ anni in R&D farmaceutico,

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - NMR Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

NMR Expert in pRED-pCMC Analytical Chemistry

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This role is situated within the preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC) department, part of the Small Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). We pave the path for drug candidates from early research to development in a diverse, ambitious, and innovative environment. Collaborating actively with our discovery and development partners, we leverage cutting-edge technologies and scientific excellence to transform molecules into future medicines. As CMC experts, we bring a rich diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, pioneering advancements in small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid-based medicines.

The Opportunity

We are offering a unique opportunity for a hands-on NMR Expert in our Analytical Molecular Characterization group. As a Centre of Excellence for Analytics, we provide state-of-the-art methods and services for determining chemical structures, purities, and impurities, supporting portfolio projects throughout the entire value chain. In this role you plan, run and report NMR experiments for structure elucidation and inter- and intra-molecular interaction studies.

• Innovative Analytics: By applying cutting-edge analytics you support synthesis and formulation development enabling fast progress for projects, and identification of possible challenges.

• Method Development: You develop and implement new NMR experiments and give input for future developments of our NMR group.

• Scientific Excellence: You enhance scientific excellence by identifying relevant industry trends, and building and maintaining academic partnerships.

• Strategic Vision: You contribute deep scientific insights to shape the mid- and long-term strategy for NMR within the Roche portfolio. Working alongside the NMR group and the Leadership Team, you guide the translation of your strategic input into actionable team strategies.

• Collaboration and Relationship Building: You foster trustful relationships and effective collaboration with internal discovery and technical development teams as well as with external partners.

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Masters with a minimum of 5 years or PhD in analytical chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the industry.

• Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of NMR analytics and its applications paired with a deep understanding of the technical and theoretical basis beyond the standard experiments for liquid and solid state NMR. Experience with other methods for biophysical characterization is a plus.

• Proven Experience: Hands on expertise in structure elucidation and interaction studies by NMR for synthetic oligonucleotides and/or peptides. Demonstrated expertise on higher order structure studies and aggregation studies.

• Mindset: You possess an open-minded and highly proactive, "just-do-it" approach. You enjoy problem-solving and developing new ways

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione NMR esperto in chimica analitica pRED-pCMC In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questo ruolo è situato all'interno del dipartimento di Chimica preclinica, Produzione e Controllo (pCMC), parte dell'organizzazione di Small Molecule Research in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). Si apre la strada per i candidati alla droga dalla ricerca precoce allo sviluppo in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo. Collaborando attivamente con i nostri partner di scoperta e sviluppo, leviamo tecnologie all'avanguardia e l'eccellenza scientifica per trasformare le molecole in future medicine. Come esperti CMC, portiamo una ricca varietà di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione formulazione, scienza materiale e chimica analitica, progressi pionieristici in piccole molecole, peptidi e medicine a base di acido nucleico. L'opportunità Stiamo offrendo un'opportunità unica per un esperto NMR pratico nel nostro gruppo di caratterizzazione molecolare analitica. Come Centro di Eccellenza per l'Analitica, forniamo metodi e servizi all'avanguardia per la determinazione delle strutture chimiche, delle purezza e delle impurità, supportando progetti di portafoglio in tutta la catena del valore. In questo ruolo si pianifica, eseguire e segnalare esperimenti NMR per l'elucidazione della struttura e studi di interazione inter- e intra-molecolare.
• Analisi innovativa: Applicando analisi all'avanguardia supporti lo sviluppo di sintesi e formulazione consentendo rapidi progressi per i progetti e l'identificazione di possibili sfide.
• Sviluppo del metodo: sviluppate e implementate nuovi esperimenti NMR e date input per gli sviluppi futuri del nostro gruppo NMR.
• Eccellenza scientifica: Migliora l'eccellenza scientifica identificando le tendenze del settore, e costruendo e mantenendo partnership accademiche.
• Visione strategica: Contribuisci approfondimenti scientifici per modellare la strategia a medio e lungo termine per NMR all'interno del portafoglio Roche. Lavorando a fianco del gruppo NMR e del Team Leadership, guidate la traduzione del vostro contributo strategico nelle strategie di squadra attuabili.
• Collaborazione e Relationship Building: Lei promuove relazioni fiduciose e una collaborazione efficace con i team di scoperta e sviluppo tecnico interni e con i partner esterni. Chi sei
• Sfondo educativo: Master con un minimo di 5 anni o PhD in chimica analitica o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore.
• Comprehensive Knowledge of NMR analytics e le sue applicazioni abbinate a una profonda comprensione della base tecnica e teorica oltre gli esperimenti standard per NMR liquido e solido. L'esperienza con altri metodi per la caratterizzazione biofisica è un plus.
• Esperienza comprovata: Le mani sulle competenze negli studi di elucidazione e interazione di NMR per oligonucleotidi sintetici e/o peptidi. Competenza dimostrata sugli studi di struttura di ordine superiore e sugli studi di aggregazione.
• Mindset: Possiedi un approccio di mentalità aperta e altamente proattivo, "just-do-it". Ti piace risolvere i problemi e sviluppare nuovi modi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

jobs.title: Head of RIS Market Adoption
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Position Summary
As the Head of RIS Market Adoption, you play a senior and critical role responsible for driving the uptake of Roche Information Solutions (RIS) from 'Nail-it' to 'Scale-it' across markets and Roche affiliates. You address two key aspects of adoption: overcoming market barriers for broad adoption within and across markets, and leveraging and activating the commercial framework within our affiliates.
Working closely with the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy team and other partners across the Roche organization, you shape the GTM blueprint and identify opportunities to address barriers for broad adoption. While the GTM Strategy function is responsible for a highly commercial-ready product, your focus is ensuring broad adoption into commercial frameworks and markets around the globe.
Your key deliverables include developing strategies to comply with local data residency policies, unlocking revenue pathways for different customer and market archetypes, and demonstrating the value and return on investment (ROI) through commercial evidence generation. You also create and deliver scalable models and frameworks for clinician engagement and customer success.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Team Leadership and Development: Coach, develop, and manage the Market Adoption team, fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning to ensure consistent application of capabilities across all projects and use cases. You will create a high-performing team, empower people to contribute to their full potential, actively coach, and manage succession planning.

• Revenue Strategy and Financial Modeling: Proactively analyze and connect financial flows, value pools, and emerging market dynamics to develop commercial insights and accelerate market success across all regions.

• Payer and Reimbursement Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive revenue and payer strategies at the portfolio level in collaboration with GTM Strategy teams and Lifecycles. Establish innovative payer models to ensure optimal reimbursement and maximum value capture.

• Evidence Generation and Alignment: Drive the strategic alignment and prioritization of Commercial Evidence (e.g., Health Economics and Outcomes Research/HECONs) in close collaboration with the Clinical Evidence team and relevant Lifecycles.

• Clinical Digital Transformation Leadership: Lead the team of clinical digital transformation specialists, providing strategic clinical guidance to specific projects and inspiring affiliates to successfully commercialize and scale digital solutions.

• Market Shaping and Opportunity Identification: Collaborate with regional teams to identify and actively pursue market shaping opportunities with a mid-to-long term view, utilizing an open and experimental approach to ensure the best market fit.

• Operational Readiness and Compliance: Own the assurance of IT readiness and maintain

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti, e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Roche è fortemente impegnata in un luogo di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo. Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti. Posizione Sommario In qualità di responsabile dell'adozione del mercato RIS, si gioca un ruolo senior e critico responsabile per l'assunzione di Roche Information Solutions (RIS) da 'Nail-it' a 'Scale-it' su mercati e affiliati Roche. Rivolgersi a due aspetti chiave dell'adozione: superare le barriere di mercato per un'ampia adozione all'interno e all'interno dei mercati e sfruttare e attivare il quadro commerciale all'interno delle nostre affiliate. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team di strategia Go-to-Market (GTM) e con altri partner dell'organizzazione Roche, modellate il modello GTM e identificate le opportunità per affrontare le barriere per un'ampia adozione. Mentre la funzione GTM Strategy è responsabile di un prodotto altamente commerciale-ready, il vostro obiettivo è garantire un'ampia adozione in quadri commerciali e mercati in tutto il mondo. I vostri principali responsabili includono lo sviluppo di strategie per rispettare le politiche locali di residenza dei dati, sbloccare percorsi di reddito per diversi archetipi di cliente e di mercato, e dimostrare il valore e il ritorno sull'investimento (ROI) attraverso la generazione di prove commerciali. È inoltre possibile creare e fornire modelli e framework scalabili per il coinvolgimento clinico e il successo del cliente. Le tue responsabilità principali
• Team Leadership and Development: Coach, sviluppare e gestire il team Market Adoption, promuovere una cultura di alte prestazioni e apprendimento continuo per garantire un'applicazione coerente delle capacità in tutti i progetti e casi di utilizzo. Si creerà un team altamente performante, che consente alle persone di contribuire al loro pieno potenziale, attivamente coach e gestire la pianificazione di successione.
• Strategia delle entrate e modellazione finanziaria: analizzare e collegare attivamente flussi finanziari, pool di valori e dinamiche di mercato emergenti per sviluppare insight commerciali e accelerare il successo del mercato in tutte le regioni.
• Payer e Reimbursement Strategy: Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie complete di ricavi e payer a livello di portafoglio in collaborazione con i team di GTM Strategy e Lifecycles. Stabilire modelli di payer innovativi per garantire il rimborso ottimale e la cattura del valore massimo.
• Generazione e allineamento delle prove: Guidare l'allineamento strategico e la priorità delle prove commerciali (ad esempio, economia sanitaria e risultati di ricerca/HECON) in stretta collaborazione con il team di Evidenze Cliniche e i relativi cicli di vita.
• Leadership clinica della trasformazione digitale: guidare il team di specialisti della trasformazione digitale clinica, fornendo una guida clinica strategica a progetti specifici e ispirando affiliati per commercializzare e scalare con successo le soluzioni digitali.
• Identificazione di Market Shaping e Opportunity: collaborare con i team regionali per identificare e perseguire attivamente opportunità di modellazione del mercato con una visione a medio-lungo termine, utilizzando un approccio aperto e sperimentale per garantire la migliore vestibilità del mercato.
• Prontezza operativa e conformità: Possa l'assicurazione della disponibilità IT e mantenere

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Profile:
Role Summary:
The Finance & Operations Coordinator will play a central role in ensuring the financial and operational efficiency of Roche Kazakhstan. This role acts as a bridge between local operations and the Roche Shared Services Centre in Budapest, ensuring accurate financial posting, compliance with tax regulations, and procurement coordination. The position also supports local product teams by providing financial insights and modeling to drive data-based decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

•

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Profile:
Role Summary:
The Finance & Operations Coordinator will play a central role in ensuring the financial and operational efficiency of Roche Kazakhstan. This role acts as a bridge between local operations and the Roche Shared Services Centre in Budapest, ensuring accurate financial posting, compliance with tax regulations, and procurement coordination. The position also supports local product teams by providing financial insights and modeling to drive data-based decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

titleByLocale.en: (资深)包装操作工 - 无菌制剂（正式工）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
罗氏正在上海建设全新的大分子工厂。我们开放了包装操作工的岗位，该职位要求具备出色的执行能力和丰富的包装操作经验，精通核心包装流程，并能够操作和日常维护包装设备，以确保生产的连续性和可靠性。此外，该职位还需与项目团队紧密合作，共同执行这项战略计划，包括工厂设计、验证、生产准备和启动等工作。
包装操作工负责在工艺步骤（例如针头切割、贴标和包装）中达成生产目标，确保产品安全、及时地生产，并完全符合GMP/SHE要求以及罗氏的企业原则、质量政策和标准。

• 负责包装线上相关工艺设备的操作和清洁，包括针头切割机、贴标机、装盒机、药监码系统、装箱机和码垛机。

• 负责包装物料的转运和管理，包括包装线上的针头检查。

• 协助进行包装线的设备验证和工艺验证。

•
负责高质量、高效率地执行资质认证和生产活动。

工程项目支持和运行准备阶段:

• 参与新厂房的设计和建设，包括但不限于工厂验收测试 (FAT)、现场验收测试 (SAT)、安装运行性能确认 (IOPQ) 等，为项目交付做出贡献。

• 支持包装工艺的初步开发和优化。

• 参与运行准备工作的实施，例如：起草设备操作规程和日志、现场5S 管理、根据准备计划进行现场机器清洁等。

• 接受包装设备操作和 CCS 实施方面的培训并获得相关资质。

• 完成其他分配的任务。

日常运营阶段:

• 确保日常操作符合罗氏的GMP/SHE及相关法规要求。

• 执行以下生产操作：例如，针头切割和目视检查、贴标和包装。

• 执行常规包装生产操作并填写GMP记录。

• 确保所有包装活动的数据准确性、完整性和可追溯性。

• 在包装过程中实施冷链管理。

• 在维护工程师的支持下，及时诊断并解决设备故障，以最大限度地减少停机时间。

• 相关IT系统操作，例如SAP、MES。

• 执行其他分配的任务。
岗位要求：

教育背景/资质

• 大专及以上学历（药学/生物学专业优先）。

岗位所需胜任力

• 拥有3年及以上注射剂制药行业运营经验，有跨国生物制药公司经验者优先。

• 具备包装设施战略项目经验者优先，包括设计、调试和验证。

• 熟悉cGMP及制药行业相关法规，尤其是生物制药行业相关法规。

• 能够与团队成员和干系人有效沟通、协作并建立积极的互动关系。具备基本的英语沟通能力优先。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

罗氏正在上海建设全新的大分子工厂。我们开放了包装操作工的岗位，该职位要求具备出色的执行能力和丰富的包装操作经验，精通核心包装流程，并能够操作和日常维护包装设备，以确保生产的连续性和可靠性。此外，该职位还需与项目团队紧密合作，共同执行这项战略计划，包括工厂设计、验证、生产准备和启动等工作。
包装操作工负责在工艺步骤（例如针头切割、贴标和包装）中达成生产目标，确保产品安全、及时地生产，并完全符合GMP/SHE要求以及罗氏的企业原则、质量政策和标准。

• 负责包装线上相关工艺设备的操作和清洁，包括针头切割机、贴标机、装盒机、药监码系统、装箱机和码垛机。

• 负责包装物料的转运和管理，包括包装线上的针头检查。

• 协助进行包装线的设备验证和工艺验证。

•
负责高质量、高效率地执行资质认证和生产活动。

工程项目支持和运行准备阶段:

• 参与新厂房的设计和建设，包括但不限于工厂验收测试 (FAT)、现场验收测试 (SAT)、安装运行性能确认 (IOPQ) 等，为项目交付做出贡献。

• 支持包装工艺的初步开发和优化。

• 参与运行准备工作的实施，例如：起草设备操作规程和日志、现场5S 管理、根据准备计划进行现场机器清洁等。

• 接受包装设备操作和 CCS 实施方面的培训并获得相关资质。

• 完成其他分配的任务。

日常运营阶段:

• 确保日常操作符合罗氏的GMP/SHE及相关法规要求。

• 执行以下生产操作：例如，针头切割和目视检查、贴标和包装。

• 执行常规包装生产操作并填写GMP记录。

• 确保所有包装活动的数据准确性、完整性和可追溯性。

• 在包装过程中实施冷链管理。

• 在维护工程师的支持下，及时诊断并解决设备故障，以最大限度地减少停机时间。

• 相关IT系统操作，例如SAP、MES。

• 执行其他分配的任务。
岗位要求：

教育背景/资质

• 大专及以上学历（药学/生物学专业优先）。

岗位所需胜任力

• 拥有3年及以上注射剂制药行业运营经验，有跨国生物制药公司经验者优先。

• 具备包装设施战略项目经验者优先，包括设计、调试和验证。

• 熟悉cGMP及制药行业相关法规，尤其是生物制药行业相关法规。

• 能够与团队成员和干系人有效沟通、协作并建立积极的互动关系。具备基本的英语沟通能力优先。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Organisation “Standort Basel / Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort Basel & Kaiseraugst bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation.

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Unser Fokus liegt auf langfristigen Investitionen im Bereich Forschung und Entwicklung, um das Leben von Menschen zu verbessern - heute und für künftige Generationen.
Der Bereich Site Assets Project Delivery ist an den Standorten Basel & Kaiseraugst verantwortlich für die kosten-, termin- und qualitätsgerechte Durchführung von Investitionsprojekten.

Wir arbeiten in einem rollenbasierten Modell, das Tätigkeiten in unterschiedlichen Verantwortungsbereichen ermöglicht .

Deine Möglichkeit

Als erfahrener Projektleiter auf Bauherrenseite übernehme ich die professionelle Bauherrenvertretung für Roche. In dieser Rolle verantworte ich die ganzheitliche Leitung und Steuerung von anspruchsvollen Bau-, Labor-, Infrastruktur- und Engineering-Projekten im regulierten Pharma-Umfeld.

• Projektsteuerung & -initiierung: Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien (Feasibility Studies) sowie die strategische Projektinitiierung und -organisation gemäß den Anforderungen von Auftraggebern, Nutzern und Betreibern.

• Beschaffung & Vertragsmanagement: Professionelle Erstellung und Prüfung von Konzepten, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeunterlagen sowie die anschließende Beauftragung und Überwachung der Dienstleistungen.

• Projektcontrolling: Umfassendes Kosten-, Termin-, Änderungs- und Risikomanagement zur Sicherung des Projekterfolgs.

• Ressourcen- & Stakeholdermanagement: Effiziente Koordination von Architekten, Fachplanern, Ingenieuren und ausführenden Unternehmen sowie enge Abstimmung mit internen, teils globalen Teams.

• Compliance & Qualität: Konsequente Sicherstellung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben, Qualitätsrichtlinien und Standards zur Arbeitssicherheit.

• Design & Corporate Identity: Verbindliche Einhaltung und Umsetzung der spezifischen Vorgaben der Roche Corporate Architecture .

• Engineering-Expertise: Fachliche Führung von komplexen Projekten an der Schnittstelle von Bau, Labor und kritischer Infrastruktur.

Wer bist du

Du denkst positiv, handelst integer und reflektierst dich und deine Arbeit mit einem klaren Blick. Kommunikation liegt dir und du willst etwas bewegen – im Team und im Projekt als Challenger, Motivator und Macher.

Um deine Rolle als erfolgreiche/r Projektleiter:in (w/m/d) bestmöglich wahrnehmen zu können, bringst du folgende Fähigkeiten mit:

• Ausbildung & Architekturfokus: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Städtebau, Architektur und Innenarchitektur.

• Berufserfahrung im Pharma-Umfeld: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung von Bauprojekten, idealerweise im regulierten Umfeld wie Pharma, Life Sciences, Chemie oder Industrie.

• Projekt- & Kostencontrolling: Fundierte Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement, im Kosten- und Terminc

La divisione Site Assets Project Delivery è responsabile dell'implementazione di progetti di investimento relativi a costi, tempi e qualità nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst. Lavoriamo in un modello basato sul ruolo che consente attività in diversi settori di responsabilità. La tua opportunità Come direttore di progetto esperto da parte del cliente, prendo il controllo del rappresentante cliente professionale per Roche. In questo ruolo, sono responsabile della gestione olistica e del controllo di progetti di costruzione, laboratorio, infrastruttura e ingegneria impegnativi nell'ambiente farmaceutico regolamentato.
• Project Management & Initiation: condurre studi di fattibilità, nonché l'avvio e l'organizzazione di progetti strategici secondo i requisiti dei clienti, degli utenti e degli operatori.
• Procurement & Contract Management: Preparazione professionale e esame dei concetti, delle offerte e dei documenti di approvvigionamento, nonché la successiva messa in servizio e monitoraggio dei servizi.
• Controllo del progetto: Costo globale, scadenza, cambiamento e gestione del rischio per garantire il successo del progetto.
• Resource & Stakeholder Management: Efficiente coordinamento di architetti, progettisti specializzati, ingegneri e aziende che eseguono, oltre a stretto coordinamento con team interni, in parte globali.
• Compliance & Quality: Garanzia costante di tutti i requisiti normativi, linee guida e standard di qualità per la sicurezza sul lavoro.
• Design & Corporate Identity: adempimento e implementazione dei requisiti specifici di Roche Corporate Architecture.
• Competenze ingegneristiche: Gestione professionale di progetti complessi nell'interfaccia di costruzione, laboratorio e infrastrutture critiche. Chi sei Pensi positivamente, agire con integrità e riflettere te stesso e il tuo lavoro con una visione chiara. La comunicazione è tua e vuoi fare la differenza – nel team e nel progetto come sfidante, motivatore e creatore. Al fine di essere in grado di svolgere al meglio il vostro ruolo di project manager di successo:in (f/m/d), si portano le seguenti competenze:
• Formazione e attenzione all'architettura: studi completi in architettura, ingegneria civile o una disciplina comparabile, nonché una forte comprensione del design urbano, architettura e interior design.
• Esperienza professionale nell'ambiente farmaceutico: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti di costruzione, idealmente in un ambiente regolamentato come farmacia, scienze della vita, chimica o industria.
• Project & Cost Controlling: conoscenza approfondita della gestione del progetto, dei costi e della terminologia

jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data

At Roche, we believe every individual can make a difference. We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data to join our team in a role that sits at the intersection of engineering excellence and business impact. In this position, you will lead and grow high-performing data and analytics engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and business-critical solutions that support commercial decision-making across sales, marketing, pricing, and customer engagement .

The Commercial Data, Analytics and AI area supports Service, Marketing, Sales, and Commercial Operations across Roche Diagnostics’ global organization, enabling data-driven decision-making and operational excellence at scale. The area spans global, regional, and country-level teams and covers a wide range of commercial activities, including customer engagement, sales effectiveness, service performance, pricing, installed base management, and operational optimization.

Operating in a highly regulated, global environment, the Commercial Data & Analytics function partners closely with business, IT, Digital, and central Data & AI platform teams to deliver trusted data foundations, analytics, and AI-enabled insights. Solutions are designed to be scalable, compliant, and reusable across markets, while remaining flexible enough to address local needs.

By providing reliable data products, analytics capabilities, and advanced insights, the area plays a critical role in improving commercial effectiveness, service quality, and customer experience, ultimately supporting Roche Diagnostics’ mission to deliver innovative diagnostics solutions to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and develop high-performing data and analytics engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous professional growth .

• Scale engineering capabilities to support diverse Commercial use cases across Service, Marketing, Sales, and Operations through modern data modeling and transformation .

• Drive technical standards by establishing and enforcing best practices for dbt-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, and comprehensive documentation .

• Evolve data onboarding as a service to enable efficient, standardized, and scalable ingestion of new data sources while maintaining strict security and governance .

• Design robust pipelines that power advanced analytics and AI/ML solutions, ensuring all datasets are production-grade and "AI-ready" for downstream science teams .

• Collaborate with platform teams to align commercial data solutions with enterprise architecture, ensuring the reuse of platform capabilities and avoiding tool duplication .

• Manage team delivery on a day-to-day basis, translating complex commercial requirements into reliable analytics layers and high-impact insight products .

• Champion engineering craftsmanship by reviewing technical designs and guiding your team toward maintainable, cost-efficient, and scalable architectural decisions .

Who you are:

• Experienced Leader: You possess 5+ years of experience in data engineering leadership or architecture, with a proven track record of building high-performing teams .

• Industry Expert: You bring 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry to navigate complex compliance needs .

• Formally Educated: You hold a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science or a similar f

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Team Lead Engineering Dati commerciali A Roche, crediamo che ogni individuo possa fare la differenza. Stiamo cercando un Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data per unire il nostro team in un ruolo che siede all'incrocio di eccellenza ingegneristica e impatto aziendale. In questa posizione, guiderai e cresci team di ingegneria dati e analisi altamente performanti per fornire soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e business-critical che supportano il processo decisionale commerciale attraverso vendite, marketing, prezzi e coinvolgimento dei clienti. L’area Commercial Data, Analytics e AI supporta il Servizio, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni Commerciali attraverso l’organizzazione globale di Roche Diagnostics, consentendo il processo decisionale e l’eccellenza operativa in scala. L'area abbraccia team globali, regionali e di livello nazionale e copre una vasta gamma di attività commerciali, tra cui l'impegno del cliente, l'efficacia delle vendite, le prestazioni del servizio, i prezzi, la gestione delle basi installate e l'ottimizzazione operativa. Operando in un ambiente globale altamente regolamentato, la funzione Commercial Data & Analytics collabora a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforme aziendali, IT, Digital e Central Data & AI per fornire fondazioni di dati affidabili, analisi e informazioni AI-enabled. Le soluzioni sono progettate per essere scalabili, conformi e riutilizzabili in tutti i mercati, pur rimanendo abbastanza flessibili per soddisfare le esigenze locali. Fornendo prodotti di dati affidabili, funzionalità di analisi e approfondimenti avanzati, l'area svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare l'efficacia commerciale, la qualità del servizio e l'esperienza del cliente, supportando infine la missione di Roche Diagnostics di fornire soluzioni diagnostiche innovative ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. L'opportunità:
• Guidare e sviluppare team di ingegneria di dati e analisi altamente performanti, favorendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, responsabilità e crescita professionale continua.
• Capacità di ingegneria scala per supportare diversi casi di uso commerciale in Servizi, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni attraverso la modellazione e la trasformazione dei dati moderni.
• Guidare gli standard tecnici, stabilendo e rafforzando le migliori pratiche per lo sviluppo basato su dbt, CI/CD, test automatizzati e documentazione completa.
• Coinvolgere i dati a bordo come servizio per consentire un'ingestione efficiente, standardizzata e scalabile di nuove fonti di dati, mantenendo al contempo una stretta sicurezza e governance.
• Progettazione di robuste condotte che alimentano soluzioni di analisi avanzate e AI/ML, assicurando che tutti i dataset siano di qualità produttiva e "AI-ready" per i team di scienza a valle.
• Collaborare con i team di piattaforma per allineare le soluzioni di dati commerciali con l'architettura aziendale, garantendo il riutilizzo delle funzionalità della piattaforma e evitando duplicazioni degli strumenti .
• Gestire la consegna del team su base giornaliera, traducendo complessi requisiti commerciali in livelli di analisi affidabili e prodotti di analisi ad alto impatto.
• Artigianato di ingegneria campione esaminando i progetti tecnici e guidando il vostro team verso decisioni architettoniche mantenuti, convenienti e scalabili. Chi sei:
• Leader esperto: Possiedi 5+ anni di esperienza nella leadership dell'ingegneria dei dati o nell'architettura, con una comprovata traccia di costruzione di team di alto livello.
• Esperto del settore: Portate 2+ anni di esperienza all'interno del settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata per navigare complesse esigenze di conformità.
• Formally Educated: Hai una laurea o una laurea avanzata in Informatica o un f simile

• Concevoir des pipelines robustes qui alimentent l'analyse avancée et les solutions AI/ML, en veillant à ce que tous les ensembles de données soient de qualité de production et « prêts à l'AI » pour les équipes scientifiques en aval.

• Expert de l'industrie: Vous apportez 2+ ans d'expérience au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie, ou de la technologie de santé réglementée pour naviguer les besoins de conformité complexes.

The Position
Die Abteilung Solids DP (Solida Produktion) ist Teil der Manufacturing Unit Solids am Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst. In der Solida Produktion werden verschiedene feste Arzneiformen (Filmtabletten, Kapseln, Granulat in Glasflaschen) sowie kommerzielle als auch Entwicklungsprodukte hergestellt. Hierbei handelt es sich ausschließlich um High-Potent-Produkte mit einer Batch-Size zwischen 15 KG bis 100 KG. Das Produktionsteam besteht aus ca. 45 Mitarbeitern.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Produktionsexpert:in übernimmst du im Produktionsbereich die folgenden Aufgaben:

• Herstellung von Filmtabletten, Kapsel und deren Zwischenstufen

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Leader - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Roche’s expanding digital product portfolio demonstrates its commitment to provide healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients with digital and digitally-enabled solutions that transform patient care. The existing product portfolio includes decision support systems, data management solutions, and workflow solutions. At the center of these diverse types of solutions is always patient data security and privacy as the highest priority for Roche.

In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

The opportunity:

The Technical Leader will join the Secure Account Management (SAM) team — responsible for cloud infrastructure, account provisioning, security, and governance across Roche's digital product portfolio. The team manages 650+ AWS accounts and enables application teams to build and operate healthcare solutions by providing secure, standardised infrastructure while maintaining development and deployment autonomy.

You will own the technical direction and architecture decisions for SAM's cloud platform. This means designing the systems that provision, secures, and governs hundreds of AWS accounts globally — and ensuring the engineering team builds them to a high standard. Your domain is the *how*: architecture, implementation quality, technical standards, and engineering growth.

What you will do:

• Own technical architecture and design decisions for SAM — landing zone design, account vending, IAM governance, and identity management (AWS Identity Center).

• Translate the Security Architect's guardrail requirements and security standards into implementable engineering work — Terraform modules, automation pipelines, and detection/remediation patterns.

• Design for platform consumers, not just infrastructure: build reusable, self-service modules and APIs that over 200+ product teams can adopt without needing to contact SAM for every change.

• Drive automation-first engineering: replace manual, ticket-driven workflows with programmatic access, IaC-managed configuration, and self-service tooling.

• Set and enforce technical standards: code review expectations, Terraform module stru

Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il portafoglio di prodotti digitali in espansione di Roche dimostra il suo impegno a fornire professionisti sanitari, laboratori e pazienti con soluzioni digitali e digitalmente abilitate che trasformano la cura del paziente. Il portafoglio di prodotti esistente comprende sistemi di supporto decisionale, soluzioni di gestione dei dati e soluzioni di flusso di lavoro. Al centro di questi diversi tipi di soluzioni è sempre paziente sicurezza dei dati e la privacy come la massima priorità per Roche. In questo contesto, Roche ha costruito un team globale che costruisce, protegge e gestisce piattaforme infrastrutturali (cloud e on-prem) per i suoi prodotti digitali. Questo team sta lavorando con una grande libertà di operare in una configurazione auto-organizzata ed è responsabile per affrontare le sfide della sicurezza informatica, della conformità e delle infrastrutture del settore sanitario, consentendo allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta velocità. L'opportunità: Il Leader Tecnico si unirà al team Secure Account Management (SAM), responsabile dell'infrastruttura cloud, dell'erogazione di account, della sicurezza e della governance nel portafoglio prodotti digitali di Roche. Il team gestisce 650+ account AWS e consente ai team applicativi di costruire e gestire soluzioni sanitarie fornendo infrastrutture sicure e standardizzate, mantenendo allo stesso tempo l'autonomia di sviluppo e distribuzione. Possiederai le decisioni tecniche di direzione e architettura per la piattaforma cloud di SAM. Ciò significa progettare i sistemi che forniscono, assicura e governa centinaia di conti AWS a livello globale - e garantire che il team di ingegneria li costruisce ad un alto livello. Il tuo dominio è il *how*: architettura, qualità di implementazione, standard tecnici e crescita ingegneristica. Cosa farai:
• Proprio architettura tecnica e decisioni di progettazione per SAM — progettazione zona di atterraggio, vending conto, governance IAM e gestione dell'identità (AWS Identity Center).
• Traduci i requisiti di protezione dell'architetto di sicurezza e gli standard di sicurezza in un lavoro di ingegneria attuabile — moduli Terraform, condotte di automazione e modelli di rilevamento/rimediazione.
• Progettazione per i consumatori di piattaforme, non solo infrastruttura: costruire moduli e API riutilizzabili, self-service che oltre 200 team di prodotti possono adottare senza dover contattare SAM per ogni cambiamento.
• Automazione dell'azionamento-prima ingegneria: sostituire i flussi di lavoro manuali, con accesso programmatico, configurazione gestita da IaC e tooling self-service.
• Impostare e rispettare gli standard tecnici: le aspettative di revisione del codice, Terraform modulo stru

Die Position Technical Leader - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Roches wachsendes digitales Produktportfolio zeigt sein Engagement, Gesundheitsexperten, Labors und Patienten digitale und digital nutzbare Lösungen zur Verfügung zu stellen, die die Patientenversorgung verändern. Das bestehende Produktportfolio umfasst Entscheidungshilfesysteme, Datenmanagementlösungen und Workflow-Lösungen. Im Mittelpunkt dieser vielfältigen Lösungen steht immer die Sicherheit und Privatsphäre der Patientendaten als oberste Priorität für Roche. In diesem Zusammenhang hat Roche ein globales Team aufgebaut, das Infrastrukturplattformen (Cloud und On-Prem) für seine digitalen Produkte baut, sichert und betreibt. Dieses Team arbeitet mit hoher Freiheit in einem selbstorganisierten Setup und ist verantwortlich für die Bewältigung der Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Cybersicherheit, Compliance und Infrastruktur im Gesundheitswesen und ermöglicht gleichzeitig die Entwicklung von Hochgeschwindigkeitsprodukten. Die Gelegenheit: Der Technical Leader wird Teil des Teams Secure Account Management (SAM) sein, das für Cloud-Infrastruktur, Kontobereitstellung, Sicherheit und Governance im gesamten digitalen Produktportfolio von Roche verantwortlich ist. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly skilled Cybersecurity Engineer responsible for protecting our digital footprint at the endpoint level. Our team manages critical security products across the enterprise, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure.
Our team consists of deep subject matter experts in cybersecurity and we are looking for a driven, technically rigorous Security Engineer to join us. Your primary mission will be to maintain and evolve our security tools, bringing a modern, automation-first development mindset to our operational security practices to ensure optimal performance.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintenance at scale: Configure, deploy, and maintain our global Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solution across thousands of endpoints (Windows, macOS, and Linux) to ensure peak performance.

• Application Control Governance: Design, implement, and fine-tune Application Control policies (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC, or third-party equivalents) to ensure only trusted executables, scripts, and libraries run within our environment, balancing security with user productivity.

• Optimization: Continuous evaluation to minimize false positives, optimize system performance, and improve the overall signal-to-noise ratio.

• Secure Data Erasure Lifecycle: Support the maintenance and auditing of our enterprise-grade secure data wiping services.

• Automation: Leverage a development mindset to build scripts, tools, and API integrations that automate repetitive engineering tasks and deployment processes.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other senior cybersecurity experts, translating their deep security requirements into scalable, automated technical solutions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing EDR solutions (e.g., Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) in a large-scale enterprise environment.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1 or above level).

Technical Skills

• Security Foundations: Good fundamental understanding of enterprise cybersecurity, specifically around endpoint security (EDR/XDR platforms like Cortex XDR), application whitelisting, and secure data handling.

• Application Control Expertise: Strong practical experience designing, rolling out, and maintaining Application Control/Whitelisting strategies across complex organizational structures.

• OS Internals: Strong understanding of operating system architectures, processes, memory management and filesystems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to dive into complex system logs to trace issues back to their root cause.

• Automation & Deployment: Hands-on experience with configuration management and deployment tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).

• Development Best Practices: Solid understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Additional Qualifications

• The "Builder" Mentality: You look at a manual, repetitive IT task and immediately think about how to write a script to do it better and faster.

• Problem Solver: Capable of troubleshooting complex deployment failures across varied endpoint environments.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a high

Il nostro team gestisce prodotti di sicurezza critici in tutta l'azienda, tra cui Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control e Secure Data Erasure. Il nostro team è composto da esperti di materia profonda in sicurezza informatica e stiamo cercando un guidato, tecnicamente rigoroso Security Engineer per unirsi a noi. La vostra missione primaria sarà quella di mantenere ed evolvere i nostri strumenti di sicurezza, portando una mentalità di sviluppo moderna e automazione-prima alle nostre pratiche di sicurezza operativa per garantire prestazioni ottimali. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Manutenzione in scala: Configurare, distribuire e mantenere la nostra soluzione globale Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) su migliaia di endpoint (Windows, macOS e Linux) per garantire prestazioni di punta.
• Governance di controllo delle applicazioni: Progettazione, implementare e perfezionare le politiche di controllo delle applicazioni (ad esempio, AppLocker, WDAC, o equivalenti di terze parti) per garantire solo eseguibili, script e librerie affidabili eseguiti all'interno del nostro ambiente, bilanciando la sicurezza con la produttività degli utenti.
• Ottimizzazione: Valutazione continua per minimizzare i falsi positivi, ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e migliorare il rapporto segnale-rumore generale.
• Il ciclo di vita sicuro per la cancellazione dei dati: Supporta la manutenzione e la verifica dei nostri servizi di pulizia sicura dei dati aziendali.
• Automazione: Leva una mentalità di sviluppo per costruire script, strumenti e integrazioni API che automatizzano i compiti di ingegneria ripetitiva e i processi di distribuzione.
• Collaborazione interattiva: Partner con altri esperti di sicurezza informatica senior, traducendo i loro requisiti di sicurezza profondi in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e automatizzate. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, sicurezza informatica, o esperienza pratica equivalente.
• 3+ anni di comprovata esperienza di gestione delle soluzioni EDR (ad esempio, Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) in un ambiente aziendale su larga scala.
• Competenza in inglese scritto e parlato (C1 o sopra il livello). Competenze tecniche
• Security Foundations: Buona comprensione fondamentale della sicurezza informatica aziendale, in particolare intorno alla sicurezza endpoint (piattaforme EDR/XDR come Cortex XDR), whitelisting delle applicazioni e gestione sicura dei dati.
• Competenza di controllo delle applicazioni: Forte esperienza pratica progettazione, roll out e mantenimento delle strategie di controllo delle applicazioni / whitelisting attraverso strutture organizzative complesse.
• OS Interni: Forte comprensione delle architetture del sistema operativo, processi, gestione della memoria e filesystem (Windows, Linux, macOS).
• Mindset analitico: eccellenti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi con la capacità di immergersi in registri di sistema complessi per tracciare i problemi alla loro causa principale.
• Automation & Deployment: Hands-on esperienza con la gestione della configurazione e strumenti di distribuzione (ad esempio, Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).
• Migliori pratiche di sviluppo: comprensione solida dei cicli di vita di sviluppo del software (SDLC), controllo della versione (Git), e pipeline CI/CD (ad esempio, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions). Ulteriori qualifiche
• La Mentalità "Builder": si guarda a un compito IT manuale e ripetitivo e pensare immediatamente a come scrivere uno script per farlo meglio e più velocemente.
• Problem Solver: Capable of troubleshooting complessi guasti di distribuzione in diversi ambienti endpoint.
• Adattabile: Comodo lavoro in alto
