This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Roche’s expanding digital product portfolio demonstrates its commitment to provide healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients with digital and digitally-enabled solutions that transform patient care. The existing product portfolio includes decision support systems, data management solutions, and workflow solutions. At the center of these diverse types of solutions is always patient data security and privacy as the highest priority for Roche.

In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

The opportunity:
The Technical Product Owner will join the Secure Account Management (SAM) team - responsible for cloud infrastructure, account provisioning, security, and governance across Roche's digital product portfolio. In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

• Propre, prioriser et communiquer la feuille de route du produit pour la zone d'atterrissage en nuage de SAM et les services associés - équilibrer la sécurité, la conformité, l'expérience du développeur et le libre-service.
• Agir en tant que voix des clients de la plateforme (équipes de produits internes et, de plus en plus, partenaires externes) : recueillir des commentaires, représenter la plateforme dans les sessions de planification de l'IP, et maintenir la transparence sur les décisions relatives au cycle de vie des demandes et aux priorités.
• Conduire l'évolution de la plate-forme vers le libre-service et l'automatisation - réduire les workflows manuels basés sur les tickets en faveur de l'accès programmatique, Infrastructure-as-Code, et API-first interfaces.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Partner (18 months contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Supply Chain Partner at Roche Diagnostics, you will join our dynamic Supply Chain team, a key pillar within the Finance and Operations Chapter . In this role, you will report directly to the Supply Chain Team Lead.

You will be part of a high-performing, collaborative team of five dedicated colleagues who take immense pride in delivering world-class customer care. We operate in a modern, agile environment, leveraging cutting-edge digital solutions and a steadfast commitment to sustainability to support our internal and external partners. Our team moves seamlessly between local execution and global collaboration, maintaining a particularly close and strategic partnership with our Nordic counterparts.

The Opportunity

• Master order-to-cash execution within a complex SAP landscape, maximizing the adoption and quality of our digital ordering portfolio (Webshop, eOrder, and Inventory Ordering).

• Drive improvement initiatives and foster cross-functional collaboration , taking full accountability for end-to-end delivery.

• Deliver exceptional supply chain support by swiftly fulfilling customer needs.

• Optimize inventory management by rigorously applying FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principles to minimize waste and ensure reliable product supply.

• Maintain and govern critical customer and material master data to ensure system accuracy.

• Synthesize data to prepare high-impact reports and actionable insights for both internal and external stakeholders.

• Proactively monitor system dataflows incl. IDOC handling , troubleshooting anomalies to maintain operational continuity.

• Orchestrate logistics and transportation frameworks.

Who You Are

• SAP Specialist : You bring solid experience with SAP—ideally SAP S/4HANA —coupled with a deep, functional understanding of its ecosystem.

• Industry Insider : You possess a proven track record in supply chain or logistics, preferably within the highly regulated pharmaceutical or diagnostics sectors.

• Tech-Savvy Analyst : You back up your logistics expertise with robust IT literacy, combining advanced Excel proficiency with a natural talent for data-driven, analytical thinking.

• Bilingual Communicator : You possess exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English , allowing you to collaborate seamlessly with diverse stakeholders.

• Proactive Driver : You are a self-starter by nature—characterized by a resilient, goal-oriented mindset and a passion for moving projects forward.

Your application

We make your life easier: Please upload only your current compelling CV in English.
For questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Simone Däubler-Jensen, Supply Chain Team Lead, at +45 27375452 .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Test Manager is the strategic architect and operational guardian of the ASPIRE Test Methodology. You are tasked with identifying operational "white space" and engineering new processes to fill those gaps. You will ensure the testing organization is compliant with Computer System Validation (CSV) and Quality standards while driving continuous evolution. As the primary defender of processes during audits and the lead architect for system upgrades, you balance regulatory rigor with operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Provides expert-level leadership and strategic guidance for high-impact and/or complex quality assurance projects. Develops and implements Quality Engineering best practices across multiple initiatives, ensuring consistency, test traceability, and alignment with enterprise standards. Leads quality analysis efforts on significant projects, provides guidance to less experienced Quality Engineers, and contributes to strategic initiatives. Provides oversight, advisory, and quality assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring testing purpose and scope alignment, test cohesion, traceability, and ultimate product value.

• Custodianship: Own the master version of the ASPIRE Test Methodology.

• Regulatory Alignment: Ensure every process update is "pre-validated" by aligning with CSV and Quality teams before rollout.

• Content Creation: Author high-quality technical documentation, including SOPs, Work Instructions, and User Guides.

Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of complex and strategic software quality problems, defining the quality assurance scope and driving comprehensive root cause analysis for critical defects that may span organizational boundaries. Elicits and analyzes complex stakeholder quality needs with expertise, influencing business stakeholders to inform and make the right decisions regarding product quality and release readiness. Defines strategic testing solution scope, manages complexity, and drives consensus on quality standards and release criteria through persuasive communication. Recommends optimal quality assurance technologies and tools for business transformation, providing highly innovative solutions to unusually complex quality challenges.

• Milestone Management: Take full accountability for ensuring all test phases (e.g., SAT, UAT, RT) start on time according to the global release calendar.

• Progress Monitoring: Track real-time testing metrics, defect burn-

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. L'ERP Test Manager è l'architetto strategico e il custode operativo della metodologia di test ASPIRE. Hai il compito di identificare gli "spazi bianchi" operativi e progettare nuovi processi per colmare tali lacune. Ti assicurerai che l'organizzazione di test sia conforme agli standard di convalida del sistema informatico (CSV) e di qualità, guidando al tempo stesso l'evoluzione continua. In qualità di difensore principale dei processi durante gli audit e di architetto principale per gli aggiornamenti di sistema, riesci a bilanciare il rigore normativo con l'efficienza operativa. Ambito delle responsabilità / (Leadership dei contenuti): fornisce leadership di livello esperto e guida strategica per progetti di garanzia della qualità ad alto impatto e/o complessi. Sviluppa e implementa le migliori pratiche di ingegneria della qualità in molteplici iniziative, garantendo coerenza, tracciabilità dei test e allineamento con gli standard aziendali. Dirige le attività di analisi della qualità su progetti significativi, fornisce indicazioni agli ingegneri della qualità meno esperti e contribuisce a iniziative strategiche. Fornisce supervisione, consulenza e garanzia della qualità in tutte le iniziative strategiche, garantendo l'allineamento dello scopo e dell'ambito dei test, la coesione dei test, la tracciabilità e il valore finale del prodotto.
• Custodianship: possedere la versione master della metodologia di test ASPIRE.
• Allineamento normativo: garantire che ogni aggiornamento del processo sia "pre-convalidato" allineandosi con i team CSV e Qualità prima dell'implementazione.
• Creazione di contenuti: creazione di documentazione tecnica di alta qualità, comprese SOP, istruzioni di lavoro e guide per l'utente. Responsabilità/Risoluzione dei problemi: guida l'analisi di problemi complessi e strategici di qualità del software, definendo l'ambito di garanzia della qualità e conducendo un'analisi completa delle cause alla radice dei difetti critici che possono oltrepassare i confini dell'organizzazione. Sollecita e analizza le complesse esigenze di qualità delle parti interessate con competenza, influenzando le parti interessate aziendali a informare e prendere le giuste decisioni in merito alla qualità del prodotto e alla disponibilità del rilascio. Definisce l'ambito della soluzione di test strategico, gestisce la complessità e guida il consenso sugli standard di qualità e sui criteri di rilascio attraverso una comunicazione persuasiva. Raccomanda tecnologie e strumenti ottimali di garanzia della qualità per la trasformazione aziendale, fornendo soluzioni altamente innovative a sfide di qualità insolitamente complesse.
• Gestione delle tappe fondamentali: assumersi la piena responsabilità di garantire che tutte le fasi di test (ad esempio SAT, UAT, RT) inizino in tempo secondo il calendario di rilascio globale.
• Monitoraggio dei progressi: traccia in tempo reale i parametri di test e l'eliminazione dei difetti

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Senior DevOps Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Our Certman team issues and manages the digital certificates that secure Roche's internal systems and services worldwide. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help us automate, scale, and secure that trust infrastructure end-to-end.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

What You'll Do

You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our PKI running . That means designing and maintaining Terraform modules across multi-cloud environments, operating Kubernetes in a genuinely hybrid setup, and running the secrets and PKI plumbing that everything else depends on.

Day-to-day, you'll shape how we ship and observe things : improving CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maturing our ArgoCD-based GitOps, managing self-hosted runners, and building observability with Grafana Cloud. When on-prem workloads need it, you'll build VM images.

Beyond the tools, you'll support three product teams in the Certificates organization, balancing their operational needs with the longer-term infrastructure work — and you'll have the autonomy to propose better ways of doing things rather than just executing tickets.

What You Bring

We are looking for thinkers that implement solutions to technical problems (optimisation, reliability). Someone with production Kubernetes experience who's comfortable owning clusters end-to-end, and who has solid hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Scripting in Python or Bash should feel natural, and your English — written and spoken — needs to be excellent. Your communication skills must be so good that we can see you leading technical conversations at all levels from day one.

But honestly, the mindset matters more than the checklist . In a cohesive DevOps and delivery team, we need someone who takes ownership without being asked, communicates openly when things are unclear, asks for help before getting stuck, and treats teammates and stakeholders with patience and respect. We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

Your Opportunity to Shine:

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Why Choose This Role?

At Roche, y

Questo ruolo è quello di prendere la proprietà e guidare l'onere verso le migliori pratiche di DevOps trasformazionale, ingegneria di precisione, e l'integrazione cloud all'avanguardia. Mostra le tue competenze, crescere la tua carriera, e fare un impatto misurabile sulla sicurezza aziendale. tutti insieme a un team che ha le spalle.

Perché scegliere questo ruolo?

A Roche, puoi:

- Vivere come voi stessi e farsi abbracciare per le vostre qualità uniche - Lavorare su tecnologie all'avanguardia che proteggono e potenziano i sistemi sanitari digitali - Unisciti a un team che valorizza la diversità e l'inclusione - Prendere la proprietà e guidare la carica verso le migliori pratiche di DevOps trasformale - Fare un impatto misurabile sulla sicurezza aziendale

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position

Mit Roche die Zukunft der Secure Engineering gestalten

Sind Sie bereit, mutige Herausforderungen zu meistern und wirkliche Wirkung zu erzielen? Bei Roche bauen wir nicht nur IT-Infrastrukturen – wir entwickeln sichere, skalierbare und hoch innovative Softwarelösungen, die digitale Gesundheitssysteme weltweit schützen und stärken. Wir suchen leidenschaftliche und motivierte Personen, die als Senior DevOps Engineer in unser Team von Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) eingreifen und uns dabei helfen, die Spitzenposition in der innovativen, vertrauensbasierten Technologie zu übernehmen.

Unser Certman-Team stellt und verwaltet die digitalen Zertifikate, die die internen Systeme und Dienstleistungen von Roche weltweit sichern. Wir suchen einen Senior DevOps Engineer, der uns dabei hilft, die Infrastruktur Ende zu Ende zu automatisieren, zu skalieren und zu sichern.

Wer wir sind: Ein besseres Morgen beginnt heute

Bei Roche ist alles, was wir tun, von unserer Leidenschaft angetrieben, Patienten, Leben zu verwandeln. Wir setzen uns für Wissenschaft, Ethik und Innovation ein. Wir sind mutig in unseren Entscheidungen und Handlungen, weil wir wissen, dass eine bessere Zukunft davon abhängt. Jeden Tag zeigen wir uns, um diese Zukunft aufzubauen – für eine bessere Welt, für die Menschheit.

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind hier nicht nur ein Schlagwort, sie sind für uns unverzichtbar. Wir glauben, dass einzigartige Perspektiven Innovation und Kreativität hervorbringen, weshalb wir uns für den Aufbau von Teams einsetzen, die das außergewöhnliche Spektrum des menschlichen Potenzials widerspiegeln.

Was du tun wirst

Sie besitzen die Infrastruktur, die unser PKI am Laufen hält. Das bedeutet, Terraform-Module in Multi-Cloud-Umgebungen zu entwerfen und zu warten, Kubernetes in einem wirklich hybriden Setup zu betreiben und die Geheimnisse und PKI-Kernleitungen zu betreiben, von denen alles andere abhängt.

Sie gestalten Tag für Tag, wie wir die Dinge versenden und beobachten: Verbesserung der CI/CD-Pipelines in GitLab CI und GitHub Actions, Reifung unserer ArgoCD-basierten GitOps, Verwaltung von selbstgehosteten Läufern und Aufbau von Beobachtbarkeit mit Grafana Cloud. Wenn Workloads auf der Basis von On-Prem es brauchen, werden Sie VM-Bilder erstellen.

Neben den Tools unterstützen Sie drei Produktteams in der Organisation der Zertifikate, die ihre betrieblichen Bedürfnisse mit der längerfristigen Infrastrukturarbeit abgleichen – und Sie haben die Autonomie, bessere Möglichkeiten zu bieten, um Dinge zu tun, anstatt nur Tickets auszuführen.

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen Denker, die Lösungen für technische Probleme implementieren (Optimierung, Zuverlässigkeit). Jemand mit Produktions-Kubernetes Erfahrung, der komfortable Cluster besitzt Ende-zu-Ende, und der solide praktische Erfahrungen mit Terraform, AWS, Secrets Management, CI/CD Pipelines und Beobachtbarkeit Werkzeug hat. Scripting in Python oder Bash sollte natürlich sein, und Ihr Englisch - geschrieben und gesprochen - muss ausgezeichnet sein. Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten müssen so gut sein, dass wir Sie führende technische Gespräche auf allen Ebenen von Tag eins sehen können.

Aber ehrlich gesagt, die Denkweise zählt mehr als die Checkliste. In einem zusammenhängenden DevOps und Delivery Team brauchen wir jemanden, der Eigentümer ist, ohne gefragt zu werden, offen kommuniziert, wenn es nicht klar ist, um Hilfe bittet, bevor er festhält, und Teamkollegen und Stakeholder mit Geduld und Respekt behandelt. Wir schätzen Menschen, die neugierig, pragmatisch sind und die Dinge um sie herum wirklich genießen.

Ihre Chance zum Leuchten

Diese Rolle besteht darin, Eigentümer zu werden und die Verantwortung für die Transformation von DevOps Best Practices, Precision Engineering und modernste Cloud-Integration zu übernehmen. Zeigen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten, wachsen Sie Ihre Karriere und machen Sie messbare Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmenssicherheit – alles zusammen mit einem Team, das Ihren Rücken hat.

Warum diese Rolle wählen?

Bei Roche können Sie:

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Software Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

Your Role: Redefine Excellence in Secure Software Engineering

As a Software Engineer within Roche's Certman PKI team, you will become a driving force behind the design, development, and evolution of our mission-critical enterprise trust and identity software. Working closely with latest technology trends, you will build the software layer that manages digital certificate lifecycles, cryptographic keys, and secure authentication. Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

A Key Element of Your Contribution: As an experience C# engineer, you will design and deliver high-performance, resilient software services that power Roche's global operations. This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

This role involves writing clean, testa

The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The opportunity:
As a German-speaking Template Manager (P&C Document Management Solution),​ you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful organization and you are responsible for supporting the document generation process within Global P&C Document Management Solution, especially for creating document templates in Workday using Kainos Extend.

Your main tasks will include (but not limited to):

• Creating and maintaining document templates in Global P&C Document Management Solution according to guidelines and guidance from Template Requesters

• Supporting the implementation of template automations in other P&C systems (e. g. ServiceNow, Workday)

• Consulting with Template Requesters regarding possible options for template creation

• Supporting the testing activities for document generation.

• Ensuring document delivery from the personal files upon request

• Providing professional customer service, developing key stakeholder relationships and advising partners on the adoption of new ways of working.

• Demonstrating process knowledge to ensure compliance by updating documentation (SWIs, SOPs, GWIs) and strictly adhering to legal and data protection regulations.

• Esperienza con Java o Visual Basic, conoscenza di base di HTML (sarebbe un plus)
• Esperienza nella fornitura di servizi o nell'ambiente di assistenza clienti
• Fluente in inglese scritto e parlato e tedesco. In cambio vi forniamo:

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position
We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti. Entra nel futuro dell'IT con Roche! Questo non è solo un ruolo: è un invito a modellare la spina dorsale delle innovazioni tecnologiche in avanti. La tua missione Progettare e mantenere strumenti all'avanguardia, script e framework che automatizzano le attività ripetitive, semplificano l'implementazione del software e gestiscono sistemi espansivi con efficienza senza pari. Affidatevi a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo avanzati per l'architettura e l'implementazione di soluzioni ad alte prestazioni che elevano l'efficienza del sistema, ottimizzano l'utilizzo delle risorse e migliorano i processi di implementazione per una migliore soddisfazione degli utenti. Il tuo impatto Guidare l'accusa nella gestione e risposta degli incidenti. Rileva le anomalie del sistema, risolvere rapidamente i problemi e condurre analisi approfondite causa radice per evitare problemi ricorrenti. Campione continuo miglioramento raffinando i meccanismi di monitoraggio e di avviso, conducendo approfondite recensioni post-incidenti e incorporando le migliori pratiche nella gestione del ciclo di vita del software. La vostra visione strategica e la pianificazione meticolosa garantiranno che i nostri sistemi non siano solo affidabili ma anche superlativamente performanti. Unendo il nostro team di élite, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel fornire esperienze senza soluzione di continuità ai nostri utenti finali, superando le richieste di business e clienti, e consolidando la reputazione di Roche come leader nell'innovazione IT. Le tue responsabilità fondamentali Affidabilità Ingegneria e architettura
• Definire e implementare SLIs, SLOs e budget di errore con team di prodotto e ingegneria
• Condurre recensioni di affidabilità per i servizi nuovi e esistenti
• Design architetture scalabili e tolleranti ai guasti in ambienti AWS e Azure
• Iniziative di pianificazione, performance e ottimizzazione dei costi
• Migliorare la resilienza del sistema attraverso l'automazione e i modelli di autoguarigione
• Maturazione dell'osservanza organizzativa dell'azionamento (metri, registri, tracce, qualità dell'avviso) Gestione degli incidenti e miglioramento continuo
• Eseguire analisi complesse cause radice e guidare la mitigazione rapida
• Partecipare a postmortems e follow-through senza colpa
• Migliorare il MTTR, ridurre la frequenza degli incidenti e elevati standard di produzione
• Collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con i team di ingegneria per consentire tempestive ed efficaci

Nous nous efforçons de créer des équipes qui représentent un éventail de milieux, de perspectives et de compétences. Faire place à la diversité nous permet de créer un endroit idéal pour travailler et innover pour les patients. Entrez dans l'avenir de l'informatique avec Roche! En tant qu'ingénieur chevronné de fiabilité du site (SRE) chez Roche, vous tirerez parti de votre expertise en ingénierie logicielle profonde pour propulser nos produits vers de nouvelles hauteurs de robustesse, d'évolutivité et de fiabilité. Ce n'est pas seulement un rôle, c'est une invitation à façonner l'épine dorsale des innovations technologiques. Votre mission Concevoir et entretenir des outils, des scripts et des cadres de pointe qui automatisent les tâches répétitives, rationalisent le déploiement des logiciels et gèrent des systèmes étendus avec une efficacité inégalée. Collaborez étroitement avec des équipes de développement avant-gardistes pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de haute performance qui améliorent l'efficacité du système, optimisent l'utilisation des ressources et améliorent les processus de déploiement pour un temps de pointe supérieur et la satisfaction des utilisateurs. Votre impact Diriger l'accusation dans la gestion des incidents et l'intervention. Détecter les anomalies du système, dépanner rapidement et effectuer des analyses profondes des causes profondes afin de prévenir les problèmes récurrents. Promouvoir l'amélioration continue en perfectionnant les mécanismes de surveillance et d'alerte, en effectuant des examens approfondis après les incidents et en intégrant les meilleures pratiques dans la gestion du cycle de vie des logiciels. Votre prospective stratégique et votre planification méticuleuse garantiront que nos systèmes sont non seulement fiables, mais également superlativement performants. En vous joignant à notre équipe d'élite, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prestation d'expériences sans faille à nos utilisateurs finaux, en dépassant les exigences des entreprises et des clients, et en solidifiant la réputation de Roche en tant que leader de l'innovation informatique. Vos responsabilités fondamentales Ingénierie et architecture de fiabilité
• Définir et mettre en œuvre des budgets d'erreurs, d'IDS et d'OLS avec des équipes de produits et d'ingénierie
• Effectuer des examens de fiabilité pour les services nouveaux et existants
• Concevoir des architectures évolutives et tolérantes aux défauts dans les environnements AWS et Azure
• Initiatives de planification des capacités, de performance et d'optimisation des coûts
• Améliorer la résilience du système par l'automatisation et l'auto-guérison
• Conduire la maturité de l'observation organisationnelle (métrique, logs, traces, qualité d'alerte) Gestion des incidents et amélioration continue
• Effectuer une analyse complexe des causes profondes et provoquer une atténuation rapide
• Participer aux postmortems irréprochables et suivre
• Améliorer le MTTR, réduire la fréquence des incidents et élever les normes de production

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization : Act as the primary project point of contact to capture, structure, and funnel heavy volumes of cross-program requests, ensuring the product teams maintain adequate focus on prioritized objectives.

• Cross-Program Coordination : Coordinate with other programs and incoming functional demands. Actively plan, track, and facilitate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with overarching strategic timelines.

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.

• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency : Provide structural project management to maintain project standards, ensuring clear, transparent, and connected tracking of the product's initiative portfolio for leadership visibility.

• Performance Reporting : Establish and drive consistent project KPI tracking and status reporting across the specific product area to ensure schedule and budget adherence across all parallel initiatives.

• Project Management capability development : Serve as a subject matter expert, providing project management delivery coaching to the product teams to embed "one way of project delivery" across the organization.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by

• Continuously improve the project management capabilities , service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of project management experience; a background in bu

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) intende "trasformare il modo in cui opera Roche". Come organizzazione globale di oltre 3.500 colleghi, possiamo consentire a Roche di operare in un ambiente di business competitivo e in continua evoluzione. Forniamo ai nostri partner servizi e soluzioni aziendali end-to-end, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sulle attività incentrate sui pazienti. Abbracciando una mentalità OneRoche, facciamo leva sulla nostra rete globale situata a Budapest (Ungheria), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), e i nostri altri siti per rimanere clienti-centric 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 e co-creare soluzioni insieme. L'opportunità Come Project Manager sarete parte dell'organizzazione di gestione del progetto RSS e riferire al capo Piombo per la gestione dei progetti. Sei un appassionato di project management e vuoi fornire i migliori servizi di gestione dei progetti di classe ai partner di Roche? Allora tu sei il candidato che stiamo cercando. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per la consegna del progetto di successo utilizzando una metodologia di gestione agile o tradizionale del progetto. Potrai lavorare con i team di soluzioni per Marketing Technologies che sono incaricati di fornire una trasformazione strategica, supportando e evolvendo le operazioni di soluzione in corso. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà, ma non sarà limitato a: Engagement Delivery
• Project Management & Coordination: Coordinare l'esecuzione giornaliera del progetto in tutta l'area della soluzione facilitando cerimonie (scrums, pianificazione sprint), mantenendo i backlog del prodotto e gestendo attivamente i registri delle azioni e delle decisioni.
• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization: Atto come punto di contatto principale del progetto per catturare, strutturare e imbuto volumi pesanti di richieste cross-program, assicurando che i team di prodotto mantengano sufficiente attenzione sugli obiettivi prioritari.
• Coordinamento cross-Program: Coordinamento con altri programmi e richieste funzionali in arrivo. Pianificare, tracciare e facilitare iniziative complesse e multi-stakeholder, garantendo un'integrazione e un allineamento senza soluzione di continuità con tempi strategici overarching.
• Gestione delle dipendenze e delle interfacce: gestione attiva e monitoraggio delle dipendenze end-to-end - sia interne che esterne - mentre raffinazione delle interfacce di handover tra i proprietari dei prodotti e altre funzioni.
• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency: Fornire la gestione dei progetti strutturali per mantenere gli standard di progetto, assicurando un monitoraggio chiaro, trasparente e connesso del portafoglio di iniziative del prodotto per la visibilità della leadership.
• Performance Reporting: Stabilire e guidare il monitoraggio costante del progetto KPI e la segnalazione dello stato attraverso l'area specifica del prodotto per garantire la pianificazione e l'aderenza del budget in tutte le iniziative parallele.
• Sviluppo delle capacità di gestione del progetto: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, fornire la consegna di project management ai team di prodotti per incorporare "un modo di consegna del progetto" in tutta l'organizzazione. Capability Building Essere un membro attivo del Capitolo Project Management
• Migliorare costantemente le capacità di gestione del progetto, le offerte di servizio e il coinvolgimento della comunità sfruttando gli ultimi sviluppi e le dinamiche di mercato
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di contenuti e toolkit upskilling per il nostro team
• Gestione attiva del proprio sviluppo
• Applicare i tuoi insegnamenti durante gli impegni e condividerli con i tuoi colleghi del capitolo Chi sei Possiedi le seguenti qualifiche, esperienza e attributi personali
• Laurea universitaria con 5+ anni di esperienza di gestione del progetto; uno sfondo in bu

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) zielt darauf ab, "die Art und Weise, wie Roche arbeitet, zu verändern". Als globales Unternehmen mit über 3.500 Mitarbeitern ermöglichen wir Roche, in einem wettbewerbsintensiven und sich ständig verändernden Geschäftsumfeld zu agieren. Wir bieten unseren Partnern End-to-End-Services und -Lösungen, damit sie sich auf patientenzentrierte Aktivitäten konzentrieren können. Mit unserer OneRoche-Mentalität nutzen wir unser globales Netzwerk in Budapest (Ungarn), Riga (Lettland), Chennai & Hyderabad (Indien), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) und unseren anderen Standorten, um kundenorientiert zu bleiben und gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln. Die Chance Als Projektmanager sind Sie Teil der RSS Project Management Organisation und berichten an den Chapter Lead für Projektmanagement. Sind Sie ein Projektmanagement-Enthusiast und möchten Ihren Partnern in ganz Roche einen erstklassigen Projektmanagement-Service anbieten? Dann sind Sie der Kandidat, den wir suchen. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für eine erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung mit agiler oder traditioneller Projektmanagement-Methodik verantwortlich. Sie arbeiten mit Lösungsteams für Marketing-Technologien zusammen, die die Aufgabe haben, eine strategische Transformation durchzuführen und gleichzeitig die laufenden Lösungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Arbeit umfasst, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Verpflichtungserklärung
• Projektmanagement & Koordination: Koordinieren Sie die tägliche Projektausführung im gesamten Lösungsbereich, indem Sie Zeremonien (Scrums, Sprintplanung), Produktrückstände und aktives Management von Aktions- und Entscheidungsprotokollen erleichtern.
• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization: Handeln Sie als primärer Projektkontaktpunkt, um große Mengen an programmübergreifenden Anfragen zu erfassen, zu strukturieren und zu leiten, um sicherzustellen, dass sich die Produktteams angemessen auf priorisierte Ziele konzentrieren.
• Programmübergreifende Koordination: Koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen Programmen und eingehenden funktionalen Anforderungen. Planen, verfolgen und erleichtern Sie aktiv komplexe Multi-Stakeholder-Initiativen, um eine nahtlose Integration und Ausrichtung auf die übergreifenden strategischen Zeitpläne zu gewährleisten.
• Dependency & Interface Management: Aktives Verwalten und Verfolgen von End-to-End-Abhängigkeiten - sowohl intern als auch extern - und Verfeinern von Übergabeschnittstellen zwischen Produktbesitzern und anderen Funktionen.
• Portfoliotransparenz und -konsistenz: Bieten Sie strukturelles Projektmanagement, um die Projektstandards einzuhalten und eine klare, transparente und vernetzte Verfolgung des Initiativportfolios des Produkts für die Sichtbarkeit von Führungskräften zu gewährleisten.
• Performance Reporting: Etablierung und Förderung einer konsistenten Projekt-KPI-Tracking- und Statusberichterstattung über den spezifischen Produktbereich, um die Einhaltung des Zeitplans und des Budgets in allen parallelen Initiativen sicherzustellen.
• Entwicklung von Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten: Dienen Sie als Fachexperte und bieten Sie Projektmanagement-Delivery-Coaching für die Produktteams, um "One Way of Project Delivery" in der gesamten Organisation einzubetten. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) vise à « transformer le fonctionnement de Roche ». En tant qu'organisation mondiale de plus de 3 500 collègues, nous permettons à Roche de fonctionner dans un environnement commercial concurrentiel et en constante évolution. Nous fournissons à nos partenaires des services et des solutions d'affaires de bout en bout, leur permettant de se concentrer sur les activités centrées sur le patient. En prenant en compte un état d'esprit OneRoche, nous mettons à profit notre réseau mondial situé à Budapest (Hongrie), Riga (Lettonie), Chennai & Hyderabad (Inde), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaisie) et nos autres sites pour rester axés sur le client 24/7 et co-créer des solutions ensemble. Êtes-vous un passionné de gestion de projet et souhaitez fournir les meilleurs services de gestion de projet de classe aux partenaires de Roche? Alors vous êtes le candidat que nous recherchons. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la réussite de l'exécution de projet en utilisant une méthodologie de gestion de projet agile ou traditionnelle. Vous travaillerez avec des équipes de solutions pour les technologies marketing qui sont chargées de réaliser la transformation stratégique tout en maintenant et en évoluant les opérations de solutions continues. • Gestion et coordination des projets : Coordonner l'exécution quotidienne des projets dans l'ensemble de la zone de solution en facilitant les cérémonies (scrums, planification du sprint), en maintenant les arriérés de produits et en gérant activement les registres d'action et de décision.
• Contrôle et hiérarchisation des entonnoirs entrants : Agir comme principal point de contact pour saisir, structurer et entonner de lourds volumes de demandes interprogrammes, en veillant à ce que les équipes de produits continuent de se concentrer sur les objectifs prioritaires.
• Coordination entre les programmes : Coordonner avec d'autres programmes et les demandes fonctionnelles entrantes. Planifier, suivre et faciliter activement les initiatives complexes et multipartites, en assurant une intégration et une harmonisation harmonieuses avec les échéanciers stratégiques globaux.
• Gestion de la dépendance et de l'interface : Gérer et suivre activement les dépendances de bout en bout - internes et externes - tout en améliorant les interfaces de transfert entre les propriétaires de produits et d'autres fonctions.
• Transparence et cohérence du portefeuille : Fournir une gestion structurelle de projet pour maintenir les normes du projet, assurer un suivi clair, transparent et connecté du portefeuille d'initiative du produit pour la visibilité du leadership.
• Rapports sur le rendement : Établir et diriger des rapports cohérents sur le suivi et l'état des projets dans l'ensemble du secteur de produits afin d'assurer le respect du calendrier et du budget pour toutes les initiatives parallèles.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled and influential Principal Data Engineer to join and provide technical leadership for the digital solution navify Cervical Screening. You will be a top-tier expert, driving architectural decisions, overseeing data integration and ensuring delivery of features and improvements. This is a critical leadership role for someone who is passionate about data, delivery and technical excellence.

As Data Lead, you will provide orchestration within cross-functional agile product teams, influencing the strategic direction and delivery of data-driven features. While hands-on contributions are expected, your primary focus as a Data Lead will be on ensuring the strategic differentiation of products through data and innovation, orchestrating DA&R capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive data integration and data fabric adoption across the domains, bringing together data, business and development domains.

• Ensure best practices and support organization-wide standards for data quality, governance, security, and observability.

• Act as a technical subject matter expert, mentoring Senior and Staff Engineers and collaborating closely with engineering leadership, data scientists, and business stakeholders.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to shape data strategy, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, and influence decision-making at both domain and enterprise levels.

• Spearhead the evaluation and integration of new technologies to continuously improve the performance and reliability of the data ecosystem.

• Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex performance and architectural challenges across the data ecosystem.

• You will be accountable for defining and ensuring timely delivery of all data-related requirements, including data integration, migration, storage, structure, legal compliance, privacy, quality, and insights generation.

• You will orchestrate DA&R engagement and delivery for digital products, activating the right DA&R capabilities. You will act as a key liaison, building and maintaining strong working relationships with cross-functional experts (other data experts, product owners, software engineers, clinicians) to jointly explore business opportunities and data assets.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional experience in a Data Engineering role, with significant experience operating at a Principal or Staff-level capacity .

• Expert proficiency in SQL and Python.

• Extensive experience architecting and managing large-scale cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS Glue, Google Dataflow, Azure Data Factory) and deep expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Deep, hands-on expertise in data warehousing concepts, advanced modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, data vault), and establishing data governance frameworks.

• Proven track record of building, optimizing, and leading the deployment of massive-scale, highly concurrent data pipelines using distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Flink).

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Good command of Spanish.

• Deep experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Dagster) and managing them at scale.

• Experience with NoSQL and graph databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j).

• Expertise in

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo Stiamo cercando un Principal Data Engineer eccezionalmente qualificato e influente per unirsi e fornire la leadership tecnica per la soluzione digitale navify Cervical Screening. Sarete un esperto di alto livello, guidando decisioni architettoniche, supervisionando l'integrazione dei dati e garantendo la consegna di caratteristiche e miglioramenti. Questo è un ruolo di leadership fondamentale per qualcuno che è appassionato di dati, consegna e eccellenza tecnica. In qualità di Data Lead, fornirete l'orchestrazione all'interno di team di prodotti agili cross-funzionali, influenzando la direzione strategica e la consegna di funzionalità data-driven. Mentre i contributi pratici sono attesi, il vostro obiettivo primario come Data Lead sarà quello di garantire la differenziazione strategica dei prodotti attraverso i dati e l'innovazione, orchestrando le capacità DA&R. Principali responsabilità
• Guida l'integrazione dei dati e l'adozione del tessuto dei dati attraverso i domini, unendo i domini di dati, di business e di sviluppo.
• Assicurare le migliori pratiche e sostenere gli standard organizzativi per la qualità dei dati, la governance, la sicurezza e l'osservanza.
• Agire come esperto di materia tecnica, mentoring Senior e Staff Engineers e collaborare strettamente con la leadership di ingegneria, scienziati di dati e stakeholder aziendali.
• Partner con stakeholder interfunzionali per modellare la strategia dei dati, tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e influenzare il processo decisionale sia a livello di dominio che di impresa.
• Guida la valutazione e l'integrazione di nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le prestazioni e l'affidabilità dell'ecosistema dei dati.
• Risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione delle più complesse sfide di performance e architettura in tutto l'ecosistema dei dati.
• Sarete responsabili per la definizione e la fornitura tempestiva di tutti i requisiti relativi ai dati, tra cui l'integrazione dei dati, la migrazione, lo storage, la struttura, la conformità legale, la privacy, la qualità e la generazione di insight.
• Potrai orchestrare l'impegno e la consegna DA&R per i prodotti digitali, attivando le giuste capacità DA&R. Potrai agire come un collegamento chiave, costruire e mantenere forti rapporti di lavoro con esperti cross-funzionali (altri esperti di dati, proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri software, medici) per esplorare congiuntamente opportunità di business e beni di dati. Qualificazioni richieste
• 8+ anni di esperienza professionale in un ruolo di Data Engineering, con esperienza significativa che opera in una capacità di livello Principale o Staff .
• Competenza di esperti in SQL e Python.
• Ampia esperienza di progettazione e gestione di piattaforme di dati cloud su larga scala (ad esempio, AWS Glue, Google Dataflow, Azure Data Factory) e profonda esperienza nella containerizzazione e orchestrazione (Docker/Kubernetes).
• Profondo esperienza pratica nei concetti di data warehousing, tecniche di modellazione avanzate (ad esempio, modellazione dimensionale, data vault), e la creazione di quadri di governance dei dati.
• Provato record di costruzione, ottimizzazione, e leader la distribuzione di datadotti su larga scala, altamente concurrent utilizzando framework di elaborazione distribuiti (ad esempio, Apache Spark, Flink).
• Comunicazione eccezionale, negoziazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di presentare concetti tecnici complessi sia al pubblico tecnico che esecutivo. Qualificazioni predestinate
• Buon comando dello spagnolo.
• Esperienza profonda con strumenti di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro (ad esempio, Apache Airflow, Dagster) e la gestione in scala.
• Esperienza con database NoSQL e grafici (ad esempio MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j).

La position Qui nous sommes Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal de données exceptionnellement compétent et influent pour rejoindre et fournir un leadership technique pour la solution numérique navify Cervical Screening. Vous serez un expert de haut niveau, conduisant les décisions architecturales, surveillant l'intégration des données et assurant la prestation des fonctionnalités et des améliorations. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership essentiel pour quelqu'un qui est passionné par les données, la prestation et l'excellence technique. En tant que responsable de données, vous fournirez l'orchestration au sein d'équipes de produits agiles interfonctionnelles, influençant l'orientation stratégique et la livraison de fonctionnalités axées sur les données. • Conduire l'intégration des données et l'adoption de tissu de données dans tous les domaines, en rassemblant les données, les affaires et les domaines de développement.

• Agissez en tant qu'expert technique, mentorez les ingénieurs cadres et le personnel et collaborez étroitement avec le leadership en génie, les spécialistes des données et les intervenants commerciaux.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם המחויבת לקידום רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה, נוירולוגיה ועוד. בישראל, הפעילות של רוש ממוקדת בשיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. רוש, כחברה פורצת דרך בתחומי רפואה רבים, מובילה פריצת דרך נוספת במודל עבודה חדשני, הטומן בחובו הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה והתפתחות. אנחנו ברוש מאמינים שעל מנת להגשים את כוכב הצפון שלנו, יש לפעול בראיה רחבה יותר מול כלל הגורמים בשוק המהווים את האקוסיסטם שלנו. מתוך כך נולד תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner , שהוא תפקיד מפתח, רחב וחדשני הממוקד בצרכי המטופלים והלקוחות. בתפקיד זה, נדרשת יכולת לבניית קשרים חזקים וליצירת שותפות אמיתית עם לקוחות לאורך הדרך.

תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner משלב בתוכו תחומי אחריות ממספר תפקידים המוכרים היום בתעשיית הפארמה, החל מעבודה אסטרטגית, מדעית, שיווקית ועבודת שטח ממוקדת לקוח. ה- Patient Journey Partner מהווה את הפנים של רוש בכלל האינטראקציות מול הלקוחות שלנו ואחראי על יצירת שיתופי פעולה והובלת תהליכים משמעותיים וחדשניים באקוסיסטם הישראלי.

תחומי האחריות המרכזיים:

• ניהול יומיומי של כלל האינטראקציות בשטח עם בעלי עניין במסע המטופל בתוך האקו-סיסטם

• זיהוי צרכים, אתגרים והזדמנויות תוך כדי עבודה צמודה עם הלקוחות בשטח ומתן מענה ופתרונות מותאמים בתחומים עדכניים כגון רפואה מותאמת אישית ובריאות דיגיטלית.

• הובלת חדשנות ותהליכים משמעותיים ויצירת קשרים חזקים מול הלקוחות, שיאפשרו תוצאות טובות יותר עבור המטופלים.

• עבודה בקבוצות חוצות ארגון, מקומיות וגלובליות

מי את/ה:

התפקיד מתאים לאנשים בעלי רצון להתנסות במודל עבודה אחר - מודל מולטידיסיפלינרי, המאפשר מרחב פעולה רחב, אחריות גדולה ומנדט להוביל מהלכים משמעותיים בארגון ומחוצה לו.
אנשים בעלי תשוקה לעבודה עם צוותים רפואיים, המביאים איתם רקע מגוון לתפקיד שהוא "גם וגם" ומשלב בתוכו מגוון יכולות שיאפשרו לדיאלוג עם הרופאים לעשות הבדל בחיי המטופלים.

• ניסיון מוכח בניהול קשרי לקוחות מורכבים וביצירת שותפויות משמעותיות עם מובילי דעה באקוסיסטם הרפואי

• ניסיון קודם בתפקיד PS/נציג/ה רפואי בפארמה (מינימום 3 שנות ניסיון) – עדיפות לניסיון בתחום הנוירולוגיה, בדגש על טרשת נפוצה

• ניסיון בעבודה שיווקית מדעית מול צוותים רפואיים

• נכונות לעבודת שטח אינטנסיבית (אזור מרכז-ירושלים-דרום), מתוך הבנה ששם נמצאים הפתרונות האמיתיים עבור המטופלים

• תואר אקדמי במדעי החיים

• ניסיון בפיתוח והובלת פרויקטים בשיתוף עם הלקוחות

אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה שליחות ומשמעות נפגשים.
הצטרפו אלינו למסע חדשני שבו כוכב הצפון הוא טובת המטופל.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
