jobs.title: Design Project Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.

This is a maternity cover opportunity.

The Opportunity:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• You have 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• You possess exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• You are able to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• You are skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your pe

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno di Roche Services & Solutions Center. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di coordinatore del progetto di design (DPC), sei il proprietario finale dei biglietti di design. L'utente agisce come punto centrale di contatto dall'assunzione dei biglietti alla consegna, gestione di tutta la gestione del progetto, amministrazione di Workfront, allocazione dei progetti, comunicazione degli stakeholder. La vostra missione è quella di proteggere il tempo creativo per i progettisti e garantire l'esecuzione liscia e tempestiva in tutti i tipi di progetto. Questo ruolo richiede un approccio proattivo alla gestione del progetto, tra cui la proiezione e la delegazione di compiti in arrivo, la comunicazione costante per ottimizzare la consegna del progetto e la manutenzione di un ambiente di team equilibrato e produttivo. Questa e' un'opportunita' di copertura di maternità. L'opportunità:
• Superare il ciclo di vita completo dei biglietti Workfront assegnati, dall'assunzione alla chiusura.
• Verificare i biglietti, chiarire le informazioni mancanti o non chiare con gli stakeholder.
• Assegna progettisti basati su disponibilità e competenza.
• Gestisci l'amministrazione di Workfront, inclusi metadati, timeline, passaggi di attività e documentazione.
• Agire come unico punto di contatto tra stakeholder e designer.
• Coordinate kick-off richiede progetti complessi o ad alta priorità, e route feedback ai progettisti.
• Assicurare consegne tempestive, aggiornare le parti interessate, chiudere i biglietti, bloccanti escalate e monitorare i progressi del team. Chi sei:
• Hai 2+ anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del progetto o nella gestione del flusso di lavoro, preferibilmente in un'area di progettazione o in un'attività simile.
• Possiedi eccezionali capacità di gestione del tempo, con la capacità di priorità compiti in un ambiente frenetico.
• Siete in grado di organizzare e gestire il tempo in modo efficiente, priorità compiti per gestire più progetti contemporaneamente.
• Sei abile nella promozione delle relazioni con i clienti attraverso le discussioni iniziali del progetto, gli aggiornamenti in corso e l'impostazione di aspettative realistiche, assicurando una corretta esecuzione del progetto. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Scopri di cosa si tratta il Global Digital Hub. Scopri il Roche Services & Solutions Center e come lavoriamo insieme come team veramente globale! Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per ulteriori informazioni su come gestiamo la tua pipì

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
The Delivery capability covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.
This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP).

As the Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement, you will work in a dynamic global environment where you will meet the challenge to bring vision, guidance, prioritization, and focus to the Procurement Delivery capability area such as team vision, capability development, performance and strategic category management (in line with functional objectives and business needs).
You will lead and guide a team of Procurement Category Experts and Procurement Category Specialists, working closely with them to develop the team vision, prioritize and focus efforts, and provide coaching and guidance to support your team’s development and growth both as individuals and as a team.

You are accountable for the best allocation of your people to ensure flexibility, excellence in execution, delivery and performance, and talent development. Your scope includes

• Portfolio Leadership: Strategic management of a diverse portfolio of Drug Substance and New Modalities manufacturing partnerships, encompassing a significant commercial and development footprint

• Global Reach: Driving procurement strategy across an international landscape, working with cross-functional teams and external partners spanning Europe, North America, and Asia.

• Strategic Complexity: Balancing the management of established commercial partnerships with the unique requirements of high-growth technology platforms and new pipeline assets.

• Value Creation: Leading the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for this critical network, from strategic outsourcing and site selection to long-term supplier relationship management

The Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, including, but not limited to, these core responsibilities:

• You utilise your in depth knowledge and expertise in External Manufacturing to act as a Delivery domain lead providing thought leadership, advice, and know-how on delivery capability topics, strategies, and best practices, and shaping and defining the Category area vision and priorities.

• You driver performance and category strategies for the Roche Pharma global spend within your category areas. You are accountable for achieving the GP Balanced Score Card targets, translating the GP strategy (including ongoing effectiveness, automation and AI utilisation) and delivering the business specific needs and targets.

• You work within the capability teams, networks, and squads/project teams to ensure prioritization and focus on delivering or supporting both project and foundational work.

• Yo

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità La capacità di consegna copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contrazione, definizione di strategia di contenuto ed esecuzione. Questa posizione fa parte del team di leadership di Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement che segnala nel Capitolo Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP). In qualità di Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement, lavorerai in un ambiente globale dinamico in cui incontrerai la sfida di portare visione, orientamento, priorità e attenzione all'area Procurement Delivery, come la visione del team, lo sviluppo delle capacità, le prestazioni e la gestione strategica delle categorie (in linea con gli obiettivi funzionali e le esigenze aziendali). Potrai guidare e guidare un team di esperti di categoria di appalti e specialisti della categoria di appalti, lavorando a stretto contatto con loro per sviluppare la visione del team, priorità e gli sforzi di messa a fuoco, e fornire coaching e guida per sostenere lo sviluppo e la crescita del tuo team sia come individui e come team. Sei responsabile della migliore allocazione della tua gente per garantire flessibilità, eccellenza nell'esecuzione, consegna e performance e sviluppo del talento. Il tuo scopo include
• Portfolio Leadership: Gestione strategica di un portafoglio diversificato di partnership per la produzione di sostanze stupefacenti e nuove modalità, che comprende una significativa impronta commerciale e di sviluppo
• Global Reach: Guidare la strategia di approvvigionamento attraverso un panorama internazionale, lavorando con team interfunzionali e partner esterni che spaziano dall'Europa, dal Nord America e dall'Asia.
• Complessità Strategica: Bilanciare la gestione di partnership commerciali consolidate con i requisiti unici delle piattaforme tecnologiche ad alta crescita e dei nuovi asset pipeline.
• Creazione del valore: Condurre il ciclo di vita di approvvigionamento end-to-end per questa rete critica, dall'outsourcing strategico e la selezione del sito alla gestione del rapporto dei fornitori a lungo termine Il Capo della Sostanza della Droga & Nuovi Modalities Procurement giocherà una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, la conoscenza e i requisiti generali di business / team, tra cui, ma non solo, queste responsabilità fondamentali:
• Utilizzi la tua profonda conoscenza e competenza nel settore manifatturiero esterno per agire come un lead di dominio di consegna fornendo leadership, consigli e know-how sui temi delle capacità di consegna, strategie e best practice, e modellando e definendo la visione e le priorità dell'area Categoria.
• Le prestazioni del conducente e le strategie di categoria per la spesa globale di Roche Pharma all'interno delle aree di categoria. Sei responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi della GP Balanced Score Card, traducendo la strategia GP (compresa l'efficacia in corso, l'automazione e l'utilizzo AI) e fornendo le esigenze e gli obiettivi specifici del business.
• Lavorate all'interno dei team di capacità, reti e team di squadra/progetto per garantire la priorità e la messa a fuoco sul fornire o sostenere sia il lavoro di progetto che quello di base.
• Ehi.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Das Gesundheitswesen entwickelt sich weiter, und Global Procurement reagiert darauf, indem es kontinuierlich nach höchstmöglicher Leistung strebt und innovative und strategische Ansätze für Geschäfts- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften verfolgt. Global Procurement verwaltet proaktiv das gesamte Lieferanten-Ökosystem und leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Gesundheitsergebnisse, zur Senkung der Kosten für Patienten und globale Gesundheitssysteme und stellt sicher, dass Roche weiterhin das tut, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Die Lieferfähigkeit umfasst die Hauptbeschaffungsaktivitäten von Category Management, strategischer und operativer Beschaffung, Lieferantenmanagement, Auftragsvergabe, Inhaltsstrategiedefinition und -ausführung. Diese Position ist Teil des Führungsteams Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement und berichtet im Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP). Als Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement arbeiten Sie in einem dynamischen globalen Umfeld, in dem Sie sich der Herausforderung stellen, Vision, Anleitung, Priorisierung und Konzentration auf den Bereich der Beschaffungsbereitstellung wie Teamvision, Fähigkeitsentwicklung, Leistung und strategisches Kategorienmanagement (im Einklang mit funktionalen Zielen und Geschäftsanforderungen) zu bringen. Sie führen und führen ein Team von Experten für Beschaffungskategorien und Spezialisten für Beschaffungskategorien, arbeiten eng mit ihnen zusammen, um die Teamvision zu entwickeln, Prioritäten zu setzen und die Bemühungen zu konzentrieren und Coaching und Anleitung zur Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des Wachstums Ihres Teams sowohl als Einzelpersonen als auch als Team bereitzustellen. Sie sind für die beste Zuweisung Ihrer Mitarbeiter verantwortlich, um Flexibilität, Exzellenz in Ausführung, Lieferung und Leistung sowie Talententwicklung zu gewährleisten. Ihr Umfang umfasst
• Portfolio-Führung: Strategisches Management eines vielfältigen Portfolios von Drug Substance und New Modalities Fertigungspartnerschaften, die einen bedeutenden kommerziellen und Entwicklungsfußabdruck umfassen
• Global Reach: Förderung der Beschaffungsstrategie in einer internationalen Landschaft und Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und externen Partnern in Europa, Nordamerika und Asien.
• Strategische Komplexität: Balancierung des Managements etablierter kommerzieller Partnerschaften mit den einzigartigen Anforderungen wachstumsstarker Technologieplattformen und neuer Pipeline-Assets.
• Wertschöpfung: Führung des End-to-End-Beschaffungslebenszyklus für dieses kritische Netzwerk, von strategischem Outsourcing und Standortauswahl bis hin zu langfristigem Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement Der Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement wird eine Vielzahl von Rollen entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrem Wissen und den allgemeinen Geschäfts- / Teamanforderungen spielen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf, diese Kernaufgaben:
• Sie nutzen Ihr fundiertes Wissen und Know-how in der externen Fertigung, um als Delivery-Domain-Lead zu fungieren und Thought Leadership, Beratung und Know-how zu Themen der Lieferfähigkeit, Strategien und Best Practices bereitzustellen sowie die Vision und Prioritäten der Kategoriebereiche zu gestalten und zu definieren.
• Sie treiben Leistung und Kategoriestrategien für die globalen Ausgaben von Roche Pharma in Ihren Kategoriebereichen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die GP Balanced Score Card-Ziele zu erreichen, die GP-Strategie (einschließlich fortlaufender Effektivität, Automatisierung und KI-Nutzung) zu übersetzen und die geschäftsspezifischen Bedürfnisse und Ziele zu erfüllen.
• Sie arbeiten in den Kompetenzteams, Netzwerken und Squads / Projektteams, um die Priorisierung sicherzustellen und sich auf die Bereitstellung oder Unterstützung von Projekt- und Grundlagenarbeit zu konzentrieren.

En tant que chef de l'approvisionnement en substances médicamenteuses et nouvelles modalités, vous travaillerez dans un environnement mondial dynamique où vous releverez le défi d'apporter la vision, l'orientation, l'établissement des priorités et la concentration sur le domaine de la capacité de prestation des approvisionnements, comme la vision de l'équipe, le développement des capacités, le rendement et la gestion de la catégorie stratégique (conformément aux objectifs fonctionnels et aux besoins opérationnels). This is 1-year fixed-term contract.

Who are we

Doing now what patients need next.

Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) :

We aspire to be a leading edge Clinical Operations organisation that drives innovative patient-inclusive approaches in study design and execution, utilises advanced analytics to drive data-driven decisions, and embeds innovative technologies into our ways of working to improve productivity delivery of programs and studies. We strive to create a workplace where team members own their own development and learning and are empowered to create and innovate.

Contract Purpose:

As a contract Study Manager you will be assigned to pRED early phase clinical studies, and as part of a cross-functional study team, you will be responsible for delivering study management and clinical operations activities under the direction and leadership of a Study Management Team Leader.

Through your direct study responsibilities you will also contribute to the management of external stakeholder relationships by helping Roche to be the preferred sponsor for sites, patients and other important healthcare providers.

What you will do / Expectations during your assignment:

During your assignment you will participate as a member of the Study Management Team contributing to the delivery and execution of early phase study protocols. You will:

• DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION by providing operational expertise into protocol design and feasibility, country selection, patient centricity and data delivery plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Ensure study quality and integrity by developing and maintaining study systems and documentation (including informed consent forms, communication plan, Trial Monitoring Plan, Trial Master File etc).

• PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT, for insourced studies, by supporting or managing feasibility assessments to ensure countries and sites are selected for participation in studies. Provide guidance to country operational representatives during studies to ensure countries start-up on time and deliver on their recruitment commitments.

• MANAGE VENDOR PERFORMANCE by providing direction and actively managing relationships. Ensure vendors and third-party suppliers deliver against contracted scope of work and performance expectations and adhere to all appropriate standards (including ICH/GCP, SOPs and other regulations).

• PLAN DEMAND AND SUPPLY by overseeing the forecasting and maintenance of supplies (including IMP) needed to ensure sites have the necessary resources to run clinical studies.

• MANAGE RISK AND COMPLIANCE by assisting the study team in the identification, management and mitigation of study-related risks and issues in your areas of responsi

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer sind wir Jetzt tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Pharmaforschung und frühe Entwicklung (pRED) : Wir glauben, dass es dringend notwendig ist, medizinische Lösungen jetzt zu liefern – auch wenn wir Innovationen für die Zukunft entwickeln. Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern. Wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Handeln. Und wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unangreifbarer Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um ein besseres Morgen zu schaffen. Wir sind stolz darauf, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun. Wir sind viele, arbeiten als eins über Funktionen hinweg, über Unternehmen hinweg und auf der ganzen Welt. pRED Klinische Operationen: Unser North Star soll die R&D-Produktivität und Patienteninklusivität steigern. Dies wird durch unsere CO-Strategie unterstützt, um einen Mehrwert für pRED CO und unser Portfolio zu liefern. Wir streben danach, eine führende Organisation für klinische Operationen zu sein, die innovative patienteninklusive Ansätze in der Studiengestaltung und -durchführung vorantreibt, fortschrittliche Analysen einsetzt, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungen zu treffen, und innovative Technologien in unsere Arbeitsweise einbettet, um die Produktivität von Programmen und Studien zu verbessern. Wir bemühen uns, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem Teammitglieder ihre eigene Entwicklung und ihr eigenes Lernen besitzen und in der Lage sind, zu schaffen und zu innovieren. Vertragszweck: Als Vertragsstudienleiter werden Sie klinischen Studien in der Frühphase von pRED zugewiesen, und als Teil eines funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams sind Sie für die Durchführung von Studienmanagement- und klinischen Betriebsaktivitäten unter der Leitung und Leitung eines Studienmanagementteamleiters verantwortlich. Durch Ihre direkten Studienverantwortlichkeiten tragen Sie auch zum Management externer Stakeholder-Beziehungen bei, indem Sie Roche dabei unterstützen, der bevorzugte Sponsor für Standorte, Patienten und andere wichtige Gesundheitsdienstleister zu sein. Was Sie tun / Erwartungen während Ihres Einsatzes: Während Ihres Einsatzes nehmen Sie als Mitglied des Studienmanagementteams teil und tragen zur Bereitstellung und Durchführung von Studienprotokollen für die Frühphase bei. Sie werden
• DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION durch Bereitstellung von operativem Know-how in den Bereichen Protokolldesign und Machbarkeit, Länderauswahl, Patientenorientierung und Datenbereitstellungspläne in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern. Gewährleistung der Studienqualität und -integrität durch Entwicklung und Pflege von Studiensystemen und -dokumentation (einschließlich Einwilligungsformularen, Kommunikationsplan, Testüberwachungsplan, Trial Master File usw.).
• PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT für Insourcing-Studien durch Unterstützung oder Verwaltung von Machbarkeitsbewertungen, um sicherzustellen, dass Länder und Standorte für die Teilnahme an Studien ausgewählt werden. Bereitstellung von Leitlinien für die operativen Vertreter der Länder während der Studien, um sicherzustellen, dass die Länder rechtzeitig anlaufen und ihre Einstellungsverpflichtungen erfüllen.
• VERWANDELN VENDOR PERFORMANCE durch Direktion und aktives Management von Beziehungen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Anbieter und Drittanbieter nach vertraglich vereinbarten Arbeits- und Leistungserwartungen liefern und alle geeigneten Standards (einschließlich ICH / GCP, SOPs und anderen Vorschriften) einhalten.
• PLANEN ENTWICKLUNG UND VERSORGUNG durch Überwachung der Prognose und Wartung der Lieferungen (einschließlich IMP), die erforderlich sind, um sicherzustellen, dass die Standorte über die notwendigen Ressourcen für die Durchführung klinischer Studien verfügen.
• MANAGE RISIKO UND KOMPLIANZ durch Unterstützung des Studienteams bei der Identifizierung, dem Management und der Minderung von studienbezogenen Risiken und Problemen in Ihren Verantwortungsbereichen (einschließlich der Aufsicht über die Ris)
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui sommes-nous Faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. Recherche pharmaceutique et développement précoce (PRED) : Nous pensons qu'il est urgent de fournir des solutions médicales dès maintenant – même lorsque nous développons des innovations pour l'avenir. Nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients. Nous sommes courageux dans la décision et dans l'action. Et nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler chaque jour. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Nous sommes fiers de qui nous sommes, de ce que nous faisons et de la façon dont nous le faisons. Nous sommes nombreux, travaillant comme un à travers les fonctions, à travers les entreprises, et à travers le monde. Opérations cliniques pRED : Notre North Star vise à accroître la productivité de la R-D et l'inclusion des patients. Ceci est soutenu par notre stratégie CO pour offrir de la valeur pour le CO pRED et notre portefeuille. Nous aspirons à être une organisation d'opérations cliniques de pointe qui stimule des approches innovantes incluant le patient dans la conception et l'exécution des études, utilise des analyses avancées pour conduire des décisions fondées sur les données, et intègre des technologies innovantes dans nos façons de travailler pour améliorer la productivité des programmes et des études. Nous nous efforçons de créer un milieu de travail où les membres de l'équipe possèdent leur propre perfectionnement et apprentissage et sont habilités à créer et à innover. Objet du contrat: En tant que gestionnaire d'étude contractuel, vous serez affecté à des études cliniques de phase initiale du programme et, dans le cadre d'une équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, vous serez responsable de la gestion des études et des activités cliniques sous la direction et la direction d'un chef d'équipe de gestion des études. Grâce à vos responsabilités d'étude directes, vous contribuerez également à la gestion des relations avec les intervenants externes en aidant Roche à être le commanditaire privilégié des sites, des patients et d'autres fournisseurs de soins de santé importants. Ce que vous ferez / Attentes pendant votre mission : Pendant votre affectation, vous participerez à titre de membre de l'équipe de gestion de l'étude qui contribue à la prestation et à l'exécution des protocoles d'étude en phase initiale. Vous:
• EXÉCUTION DE L'ÉTUDE DE LIVRAISON en fournissant une expertise opérationnelle dans la conception et la faisabilité des protocoles, la sélection des pays, la centricité des patients et les plans de livraison des données en partenariat avec les intervenants interfonctionnels. Assurer la qualité et l'intégrité des études en élaborant et en tenant à jour des systèmes et des documents d'étude (y compris les formulaires de consentement éclairé, le plan de communication, le plan de surveillance des essais, le dossier principal des essais, etc.).
• PROVIDE PAYS SURVEILLANCE, pour les études sous-traitées, en appuyant ou en gérant les évaluations de faisabilité pour s'assurer que les pays et les sites sont sélectionnés pour participer aux études. Fournir des conseils aux représentants opérationnels des pays au cours des études afin de veiller à ce que les pays démarrent à temps et respectent leurs engagements en matière de recrutement.
• GESTIONNAIRE PERFORMANCE en fournissant une orientation et une gestion active des relations. Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs et les fournisseurs tiers respectent la portée contractuelle du travail et les attentes en matière de rendement et respectent toutes les normes appropriées (notamment l'ICH/GCP, les SOP et d'autres règlements).
• PLAN DE DEMANDE ET DE POUVOIR en surveillant la prévision et l'entretien des approvisionnements (y compris les PIM) nécessaires pour s'assurer que les sites disposent des ressources nécessaires pour mener des études cliniques.
• RISQUE DE GESTION ET CONFORMITÉ en aidant l'équipe d'étude à identifier, gérer et atténuer les risques et les problèmes liés à l'étude dans vos domaines de responsabilité (y compris la surveillance du ris)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Patient Journey Partner Lead based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for driving the strategic deployment of the PJP network, ensuring activities generate high-impact value within the Disease Areas aligned with the affiliate's goals and ecosystem priorities. In this role, your absolute priority will be leadership and people empowerment ; you will coach, mentor, and guide a highly diverse and multidisciplinary team, managing a mixed structure spanning both specific geographic territories and key therapeutic areas.

The Opportunity

• Take direct accountability for the deployment of PJPs, ensuring their activities generate high-impact value aligned with strategic goals and ecosystem priorities.

• Diagnose individual capability needs, provide tailored field coaching, and empower PJPs to experiment boldly, remove operational roadblocks, and become self-reliant.

• Architect up-to-date competency models, design comprehensive onboarding and learning roadmaps, and foster a continuous learning culture across the network.

• Catalyze cross-functional ecosystems to form self-sufficient "pods" that share business ideas, assess impacts, and prioritize initiatives based on deep patient journey insights.

• Help teams clearly define their purpose, develop effective operational rituals (such as impact retrospectives), and leverage agile methodologies to drive organizational growth.

• Foster a culture of trust and psychological safety, supporting an environment where teams can give and receive continuous feedback to scale value across the enterprise.

Who you are

• University degree in Science, Economics, Business, or related disciplines; an advanced life science degree or an MBA is considered a strong plus.

• Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex stakeholder engagement, with a strong priority on exceptional people leadership skills.

• Demonstrated ability and resilience to lead, inspire, and manage highly diverse professional teams (including physicians, biologists, accountants, and lawyers across various ages and seniorities).

• Strong command of agile ways of working, system thinking, data-driven mindset, and a proactive approach to experimenting and learning from failures.

• Fluent in Spanish with a high proficiency in English, enabling effective collaboration and knowledge-sharing across the broader Roche global enterprise.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Diagnose individual capability needs, provide tailored field coaching, and empower PJPs to experiment boldly, remove operational roadblocks, and become self-reliant.

• Architect up-to-date competency models, design comprehensive onboarding and learning roadmaps, and foster a continuous learning culture across the network.

• Catalyze cross-functional ecosystems to form self-sufficient "pods" that share business ideas, assess impacts, and prioritize initiatives based on deep patient journey insights.

• Help teams clearly define their purpose, develop effective operational rituals (such as impact retrospectives), and leverage agile methodologies to drive organizational growth.

• Foster a culture of trust and psychological safety, supporting an environment where teams can give and receive continuous feedback to scale value across the enterprise.

Who you are

• University degree in Science, Economics, Business, or related disciplines; an advanced life science degree or an MBA is considered a strong plus.

• Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex stakeholder engagement, with a strong priority on exceptional people leadership skills.

• Demonstrated ability and resilience to lead, inspire, and manage highly diverse professional teams (including physicians, biologists, accountants, and lawyers across various ages and seniorities).

• Strong command of agile ways of working, system thinking, data-driven mindset, and a proactive approach to experimenting and learning from failures.

• Fluent in Spanish with a high proficiency in English, enabling effective collaboration and knowledge-sharing across the broader Roche global enterprise.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Oncología & Oncohematología (Neuquén)

titleByLocale.it: Partner del Viaggio Paziente - Oncología & Oncohematología (Neuquén)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner basado en Neuquén y con cobertura en la zona Sur del país, serás responsable de generar valor a lo largo de todo el recorrido del paciente en las áreas de Oncología y Oncohematología. En este rol híbrido, navegarás de manera transversal entre las funciones Médica, de Acceso y Comercial, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con el Healthcare System Partner (HSP) de la zona para co-crear soluciones integrales, acelerar el acceso a la innovación en productos de alto costo y asegurar mejores resultados de salud para la comunidad local.

The Opportunity

• Actuar como el socio de confianza y punto primario de contacto entre los actores clave del ecosistema de salud del Sur del país y Roche para mejorar de manera integral la experiencia del paciente.

• Trabajar de forma proactiva y en sinergia con el HSP (Healthcare System Partner) local y los equipos multifuncionales de la zona para alinear estrategias en común y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos propuestos.

• Identificar barreras críticas en el diagnóstico y tratamiento de patologías oncológicas y oncohematológicas, implementando iniciativas que optimicen el viaje del paciente.

• Incorporar la perspectiva y tendencias del mercado externo del Sur para enriquecer las estrategias de acceso y comercialización de soluciones y productos de alto costo de la compañía.

• Fomentar un modelo de relacionamiento basado en la confianza mutua y la transparencia con instituciones, profesionales de la salud y tomadores de decisión del ecosistema regional.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Ciencias Económicas, Empresariales o afines; contar con un posgrado en salud o MBA será especialmente valorado.

• Experiencia previa comprobable en roles científicos, comerciales, de acceso o de cara al cliente dentro de la industria farmacéutica o biotecnológica.

• Conocimiento sólido y experiencia en las áreas terapéuticas de Oncología y/o Oncohematología, demostrando afinidad y manejo previo en carteras de productos de alto costo.

• Alta adaptabilidad para integrarse rápidamente a dinámicas de trabajo colaborativas en terreno, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia en redes.

• Manejo de metodologías de trabajo ágiles, mentalidad de crecimiento, proactividad y dominio intermedio/avanzado del idioma inglés.

• Radicación en la ciudad de Neuquén y disponibilidad para viajar frecuentemente dentro de la zona Sur asignada.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner basado en Neuquén , serás responsable de gestionar de manera integral el recorrido de los pacientes para un portafolio diversificado que abarca Atrofia Muscular Espinal (AME), Neurología, Oftalmología y Hemofilia. Actuando de forma transversal entre las funciones Médica, de Acceso y Comercial, tu misión será adaptarte ágilmente a los equipos de terreno, identificar oportunidades críticas en el ecosistema regional y asegurar el acceso ágil a tratamientos de alto costo y alta complejidad.

The Opportunity

• Liderar de punta a punta las iniciativas orientadas al paciente para un portafolio multiobjetivo de alta especialidad (AME, Neurología, Oftalmología y Hemofilia) en el Sur argentino.

• Integrarse de manera fluida y veloz a los equipos de soporte y colaboradores de terreno de la zona para potenciar el alcance de los objetivos estratégicos propuestos.

• Construir relaciones de largo plazo y valor agregado con especialistas médicos, sociedades científicas regionales y financiadores clave de la salud en la zona Sur.

• Diseñar e implementar soluciones innovadoras que superen las barreras geográficas y de infraestructura locales para agilizar el diagnóstico y la entrega de productos de alto costo.

• Capturar insights valiosos del mercado y tendencias emergentes para alimentar la planificación y asignación estratégica de recursos en la subregión.

Who you are

• Profesional universitario graduado en carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Administración de Empresas, Economía o afines.

• Experiencia sólida y comprobable gestionando carteras de medicamentos o soluciones de alta complejidad y productos de alto costo.

• Conocimiento técnico o experiencia previa en algunas de las especialidades del puesto (AME/Enfermedades Poco Frecuentes, Neurología, Oftalmología o Hemofilia).

• Excelente capacidad para adaptarse ágilmente al trabajo en equipo, autogestión y resiliencia para manejarse en entornos geográficamente dispersos.

• Pensamiento estratégico, habilidades digitales orientadas a la omnicanalidad y dominio del idioma inglés.

• Radicación efectiva en la ciudad de Neuquén y disponibilidad para viajar en la región Sur según las necesidades de la posición.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Como Patient Journey Partner para la Provincia de Buenos Aires, asumirás un rol estratégico de alto impacto destinado a reforzar el ecosistema de Nefritis Lúpica. Tu propósito principal será actuar como un catalizador en el terreno bonaerense, fusionando las perspectivas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para preparar el mercado, acelerar la adopción de nuestra innovación diagnóstica/terapéutica y asegurar que los pacientes accedan a soluciones críticas en el menor tiempo posible.

The Opportunity

• Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de campo para el recorrido del paciente en el marco del próximo lanzamiento y la fase de expansión de Nefritis Lúpica en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Identificar, mapear y priorizar de manera temprana los centros de referencia, redes de derivación y stakeholders clave (nefrólogos, reumatólogos y comités de auditoría) en PBA.

• Desarrollar e implementar planes de valor que faciliten el diagnóstico temprano de la patología y agilicen los procesos de cobertura y acceso al tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos internos de Marketing, Asuntos Médicos y Acceso para asegurar la consistencia del posicionamiento de la marca durante el lanzamiento.

• Monitorear y evaluar el impacto de las iniciativas desplegadas en el terreno, pivotando ágilmente las tácticas comerciales y médicas para maximizar el éxito en la expansión del portafolio.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras como Bioquímica, Medicina, Farmacia, Comercialización, Administración de Empresas o disciplinas afines al negocio de la salud.

• Experiencia sólida previa en la gestión de lanzamientos de productos biológicos, terapias especiales o soluciones de alta complejidad en la industria de la salud.

• Conocimiento del mercado e instituciones de salud públicas y privadas presentes en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Mentalidad fuertemente emprendedora ( Growth Mindset ), orientación a resultados de negocio y pasión por la innovación disruptiva enfocada en el paciente.

• Excelentes capacidades de comunicación persuasiva, habilidades de negociación estratégica y fluidez intermedia/avanzada en inglés.

Tu propósito principal será actuar como un catalizador en el terreno bonaerense, fusionando las perspectivas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para preparar el mercado, acelerar la adopción de nuestra innovación diagnóstica/terapéutica y asegurar que los pacientes accedan a soluciones críticas en el menor tiempo posible.

The Opportunity

• Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de campo para el recorrido del paciente en el marco del próximo lanzamiento y la fase de expansión de Nefritis Lúpica en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Identificar, mapear y priorizar de manera temprana los centros de referencia, redes de derivación y stakeholders clave (nefrólogos, reumatólogos y comités de auditoría) en PBA.

• Desarrollar e implementar planes de valor que faciliten el diagnóstico temprano de la patología y agilicen los procesos de cobertura y acceso al tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos internos de Marketing, Asuntos Médicos y Acceso para asegurar la consistencia del posicionamiento de la marca durante el lanzamiento.

• Monitorear y evaluar el impacto de las iniciativas desplegadas en el terreno, pivotando ágilmente las tácticas comerciales y médicas para maximizar el éxito en la expansión del portafolio.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras como Bioquímica, Medicina, Farmacia, Comercialización, Administración de Empresas o disciplinas afines al negocio de la salud.

• Experiencia sólida previa en la gestión de lanzamientos de productos biológicos, terapias especiales o soluciones de alta complejidad en la industria de la salud.

• Conocimiento del mercado e instituciones de salud públicas y privadas presentes en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Mentalidad fuertemente emprendedora ( Growth Mindset ), orientación a resultados de negocio y pasión por la innovación disruptiva enfocada en el paciente.

• Excelentes capacidades de comunicación persuasiva, habilidades de negociación estratégica y fluidez intermedia/avanzada en inglés.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner con cobertura en la región del Litoral, serás responsable de liderar y desplegar la estrategia enfocada en el recorrido del paciente para el área terapéutica de Nefritis Lúpica. Tu propósito será navegar de forma transversal entre las áreas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para derribar las barreras del sistema de salud regional, co-diseñando soluciones innovadoras con los actores clave del ecosistema litoraleño que aceleren el acceso oportuno al tratamiento y mejoren la calidad de vida de los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Establecer un canal de comunicación directo y de confianza con nefrólogos, reumatólogos, instituciones de salud y tomadores de decisión en la región del Litoral para optimizar el recorrido del paciente con Nefritis Lúpica.

• Mapear y diagnosticar las brechas críticas del sistema de salud local en el abordaje de la patología, promoviendo el valor médico y científico del portafolio de Roche.

• Co-crear e implementar iniciativas y soluciones de acceso y comerciales que simplifiquen los procesos de derivación, diagnóstico temprano y continuidad del tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con redes transversales internas y squads regionales para integrar las perspectivas específicas del Litoral dentro de las tácticas nacionales de la filial.

• Identificar y priorizar aquellas oportunidades y ecosistemas locales que generen un impacto médico y social sostenible en el tiempo.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Ciencias Económicas, Empresariales o disciplinas afines.

• Trayectoria demostrable en posiciones de cara al cliente dentro del mercado de la salud (especialista de producto, acceso, relaciones institucionales o áreas médicas).

• Conocimiento o experiencia previa en el manejo de enfermedades autoinmunes, nefrología o reumatología será altamente considerado para este desafío.

• Sólida visión de negocios combinada con un genuino interés por la experiencia del cliente y la excelencia médica.

• Habilidades avanzadas de comunicación, pensamiento sistémico y familiaridad con metodologías ágiles de trabajo.

• Residencia en una ciudad principal de la zona del Litoral y plena disponibilidad para viajar por la región.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management Engineer to join our growing IAM team. This role offers a unique opportunity for a Java Developer to expand their expertise into the Identity and Access Management space, with a focus on SailPoint technologies and application integration. You will work on solving complex business problems through practical application of your development skills, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise-scale identity solutions. In this position, you will take on meaningful responsibility for technical design decisions, build resilient IAM infrastructure, and play an active role in shaping how our organization manages identity and access across the enterprise.

The Opportunity
This role positions you at the intersection of software development and information security, where you'll apply your Java expertise to solve complex identity and access management challenges within a large global enterprise.

Your Responsibilities

• Contribute to the end-to-end design of IAM infrastructure solutions and create and maintain related component standards

• Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation for designs, design patterns, and component standards

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters related to organizational priorities

• Strengthen the Information Security community by building bridges and collaborating with peers and stakeholders

• Contribute to determining success criteria and evaluating promising solutions and technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies

• Design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable IAM solutions

• Advise, influence, and collaborate with various IT partners and line-of-business stakeholders, integrating their feedback

• Ensure designs and solutions align with organizational policies, standards, and strategic directions

• Contribute to estimating engineering resources and timelines for successful project delivery

• Write and contribute to position papers, white papers, technical recommendations, and best practices documentation for the IAM solution space

• Remain proactive in identifying operational challenges and opportunities, working with support teams to ensure solutions meet quality and regulatory standards

• Collaborate closely with Identity Management Support and Operations teams on incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement

• Embrace our Infrastructure as Code tool chain and adhere to coding best practices

Who You Are

Technology Skills & Experience

• Deep expertise in Java development with proven ability to apply it within enterprise security contexts

• Hands-on experience with Identity Management technologies; SailPoint experience is highly desired

• Demonstrated experience following CI/CD and DevOps practices

• Knowledge of microservices architectures, API design, and REST APIs

• Understanding of distributed architectures and the challenges they present

• Experience working in an Agile environment

• Proficiency in Python and scripting languages (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) is desired

• Background in Identity and Access Management, Directory Services, or Cyber Security is a plus

Core Competencies & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

• 5+ years of overall experience in relevant technology areas

• 2+ years working in a multinational environment as an Engineer or Te

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di Supporto e Operazioni di gestione degli incidenti, gestione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo dei servizi
• Abbracciare la nostra infrastruttura come catena di strumenti di codice e aderire alla codifica delle migliori pratiche Chi sei Tecnologia competenze e esperienza

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente Agile

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique à un développeur Java d'étendre son expertise dans l'espace Identity and Access Management, en mettant l'accent sur les technologies SailPoint et l'intégration d'applications. Vous travaillerez à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes par l'application pratique de vos compétences de développement, contribuant à la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'évolution de solutions d'identité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Dans cette position, vous assumerez une responsabilité significative pour les décisions de conception technique, bâtirez une infrastructure IAM résiliente et jouerez un rôle actif dans la façon dont notre organisation gère l'identité et l'accès à l'ensemble de l'entreprise. L'opportunité Ce rôle vous place à l'intersection du développement logiciel et de la sécurité de l'information, où vous appliquerez votre expertise Java pour résoudre des défis complexes de gestion d'identité et d'accès au sein d'une grande entreprise mondiale. Vos responsabilités
• Contribuer à la conception de bout en bout des solutions d'infrastructure de l'IAM et créer et maintenir des normes connexes
• Produire et tenir à jour une documentation complète pour les conceptions, les modèles et les normes de composants
• Interagir avec les principaux partenaires internes et externes sur des questions techniques importantes liées aux priorités organisationnelles
• Renforcer la communauté de la sécurité de l'information en établissant des ponts et en collaborant avec les pairs et les intervenants
• Contribuer à la détermination des critères de succès et à l'évaluation des solutions et des technologies prometteuses par le biais de preuves de concept (PdC) et d'études de faisabilité
• Concevoir, construire, tester et mettre en œuvre des solutions IAM intégrées, résistantes et fiables
• Conseiller, influencer et collaborer avec divers partenaires informatiques et intervenants du secteur d'activité, en intégrant leurs commentaires
• Veiller à ce que les conceptions et les solutions soient conformes aux politiques, aux normes et aux orientations stratégiques de l'organisation
• Contribuer à l'estimation des ressources et des délais d'exécution des projets
• Écrire et contribuer aux documents de position, aux livres blancs, aux recommandations techniques et à la documentation sur les meilleures pratiques pour l'espace de solution IAM
• Rester proactif pour identifier les défis opérationnels et les possibilités, en travaillant avec les équipes de soutien pour s'assurer que les solutions répondent aux normes de qualité et de réglementation
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de soutien à la gestion de l'identité et des opérations pour la gestion des incidents, la gestion des problèmes et l'amélioration continue des services
• Embrassez notre infrastructure comme chaîne d'outils Code et respectez les meilleures pratiques de codage Qui vous êtes Compétences et expérience technologiques
• Une expertise approfondie en développement Java avec une capacité prouvée de l'appliquer dans des contextes de sécurité d'entreprise
• Expérience pratique avec les technologies de gestion d'identité; l'expérience SailPoint est très souhaitée
• Expérience démontrée suivant les pratiques de CI/CD et DevOps
• Connaissance des architectures des microservices, de la conception des API et des API REST
• Compréhension des architectures distribuées et des défis qu'elles présentent
• Expérience de travail dans un environnement agile
• La compétence en Python et en langages de script (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) est souhaitée
• Contexte dans la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, les services d'annuaire ou la cybersécurité est un plus Compétences de base et qualifications
• Licence ou expérience professionnelle équivalente
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience générale dans les domaines technologiques pertinents
• 2+ ans de travail dans un environnement multinational comme ingénieur ou Te

jobs.title: APAC RCSC Service Specialist /Application Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Customer Support Specialist within our APAC Hub, you are the first point of professional contact for our customers. You play a vital role in ensuring that healthcare providers can continue their essential work without interruption. In this role, you will:

• Resolve critical challenges: Handle customer inquiries via phone and digital channels, providing foundational troubleshooting and technical problem-solving to ensure patient testing remains on track.

• Champion digital transformation: Actively promote and guide customers in adopting digital support tools and remote assistance technologies to improve laboratory efficiency.

• Drive quality and safety: Act as a local case handler, identifying product quality issues and escalating them to ensure the highest standards of patient safety.

• Foster continuous improvement: Contribute to the creation of new troubleshooting materials and "self-fix" content, empowering both colleagues and customers.

• Collaborate across borders: Work within an agile, intercultural team, participating in local and global projects that shape the future of service excellence in the region.

• Simulate real-world solutions: Utilize our onsite laboratory to recreate customer scenarios, ensuring our solution approaches are accurate and effective.

Who You Are
We are looking for a curious, customer-centric individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about healthcare technology.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or Information Technology.

• Professional Experience: You bring at least 1-2 years of experience in medical technology, laboratory environments, or healthcare IT support.

• Language Excellence: You are fluent in English and possess professional-level proficiency in one or more of the following: Chinese dialects, Thai, or Korean, to support our diverse APAC customer clusters.

• Technical Aptitude: You have a solid understanding of medical analysis systems, connectivity, or IT network technologies, with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Customer-First Mindset: You possess excellent communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical information clearly and concisely.

• Flexibility: You are comfortable working within a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, including public holidays, to support the critical needs of the healthcare systems we serve. Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Come specialista del supporto clienti all'interno del nostro hub APAC, sei il primo punto di contatto professionale per i nostri clienti. Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che i fornitori di assistenza sanitaria possano continuare il loro lavoro essenziale senza interruzioni. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Risolvere le sfide critiche: gestire le richieste dei clienti attraverso i canali telefonici e digitali, fornendo la risoluzione dei problemi fondamentali e la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici per garantire che i test dei pazienti rimangano in pista.
• Trasformazione digitale campione: promuove e guida attivamente i clienti nell'adottare strumenti di supporto digitale e tecnologie di assistenza remota per migliorare l'efficienza del laboratorio.
• Qualità e sicurezza dell'azionamento: Agite come case handler locale, identificando i problemi di qualità del prodotto e aumentandoli per garantire i più elevati standard di sicurezza del paziente.
• Promuovere il miglioramento continuo: contribuire alla creazione di nuovi materiali di risoluzione dei problemi e contenuti "self-fix", abilitando sia colleghi che clienti.
• Collaborare attraverso i confini: lavorare all'interno di un team agile e interculturale, partecipando a progetti locali e globali che plasmano il futuro dell'eccellenza dei servizi nella regione.
• Simula le soluzioni del mondo reale: utilizza il nostro laboratorio in loco per ricreare gli scenari dei clienti, assicurando che i nostri approcci di soluzione siano precisi ed efficaci. Chi sei Siamo alla ricerca di un individuo curioso e orientato al cliente che prospera in un ambiente dinamico ed è appassionato di tecnologia sanitaria. Le tue qualifiche:
• Sfondo educativo: hai una laurea o un master in un campo rilevante come Biochimica, Biologia Molecolare, Scienze della Vita, Ingegneria Biomedica, o Tecnologia dell'informazione.
• Esperienza professionale: porti almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza nella tecnologia medica, negli ambienti di laboratorio o nel supporto IT sanitario.
• Eccellenza linguistica: Lei è fluente in inglese e possiede una competenza professionale in uno o più dei seguenti: dialetti cinesi, tailandese o coreano, per sostenere i nostri diversi cluster di clienti APAC.
• Aptitude tecnica: Hai una solida comprensione dei sistemi di analisi medica, della connettività o delle tecnologie di rete IT, con un approccio metodico alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Customer-First Mindset: Possiedi eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di trasmettere informazioni tecniche complesse in modo chiaro e conciso.
• Flessibilità: Lei è comodo lavorare all'interno di un modello di turni rotanti 24/7, compresi i giorni festivi, per sostenere le esigenze critiche dei sistemi sanitari che serviamo. Facciamo prosperare insieme in una cultura costruita sulla fiducia, la collaborazione, il rispetto e le alte prestazioni. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

• 業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサービスエンジニア
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
　　　　　　　　• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、大宮オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　
• 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　
• 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　
• 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

• 福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing/Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a digital marketing intern, you will support the brand in planning, implementing, monitoring campaigns and creating a social media presence. You will be required to work closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive the adoption of Roche’s Health Digital Solutions (HDS) & Glucose Monitoring (GM) solutions to enable the implementation of Roche’s integrated Personalized Diabetes Management (iPDM) strategy.

The Opportunity:

• Exposure to the E-commerce (Shopee & Lazada) and digital space

• Generating content for Roche’s digital platforms

• Designing digital materials for Shopee, Lazada, social media sites I.e. Telegram

• Identifying and monitoring digital market trends (i.e. reading data to track performance of digital campaigns campaigns)

• Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders - you will be able to hone your relationship management skills

• Access to our diverse Roche Network

Who you are:

• You are currently studying for your Bachelor’s degree in Digital Marketing

• Familiar with E-commerce such as Shopee & Lazada as well as the digital space

• Up to date with trends on social channels (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook etc)

• Excellent digital communication skills

• Able to commit for 6 months internshi p

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position Summary
As the Chief of Staff for the Roche Diagnostics Japan Enabling Team, you will play a key role in the effective functioning and strategic success of the Japan Dia organization. Reporting to the Chapter Lead, ET Office (Dottedly to GM Japan), you will work side by side with the Dia Japan GM and Dia Japan Enabling Team as the “Chief of Staff”.
In this role, you will be involved in the strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders and network teams. In addition, you will work with the ET to translate vision/ strategy to actionable deliverables and assist them in facilitating effective decision-making. You will follow through and update the ET on progress of these deliverables as well as communication to employees through dashboard or other avenues. You will work with ET to prioritize on agenda and work through the backlog. And you will plan, convene and facilitate ET meetings to ensure objectives are achieved.

You will be responsible to:
● Support Japan Dia GM to develop short- and long-term priorities (business, financial and people) aligned to Roche Dia business objectives, by engaging in strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders
and network teams.
● As Chief of Staff, support the ET to ensure they are setting and achieving outcomes, while building and maintaining an environment that keeps the team focused on top priorities.
● Convene and facilitate the ET meetings, plan the agenda and support the team in timely, well-informed decision making.
● Design and facilitate effective meetings by prioritizing key objectives, balancing content review with discussion, and moderating dialogue.
● Strengthen ET cohesiveness by working with the P&C and regular exchanges with individual ET members.
● Increase ET effectiveness; Facilitate the formation of ET squads, make accountability clear, track and monitor ET decisions and backlog; hold ET members accountable to decisions and backlog.
● Lead, supported by administrative staff, on all aspects of logistics and planning of ET meetings.
● Collaborate with the GM and subject matter experts to develop communications and presentation materials for various speaking engagements.

Who you are
Professional and Technical Requirements:
- Degree / Masters in life sciences with typically with 3-5+ years of relevant experience in the life science sector in a similar capacity that may be directly comparable to Diagnostics and/or Pharmaceuticals is an advantage.
- Strategy consulting background and skill set would be desirable.
- Strong leadership experience, preferably with experience leading diverse teams and/or highly complex matrix leadership of enterprise-level projects.
- Strong business sense with a solid understanding of the healthcare industry and experience operating in a regulated environment.

Experience, Skills, Knowledge:

- Fully bilingual in Japanese and English in verbal, writing, and reading
- A systems thinker who can connect the dots between functions and processes in terms of broader business implications, including tactical, strategic, and enterprise dependencies.
- A strong collaborator, able to cultivate a strong and trusting relationship with executive leaders, proven experience in stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage through change, able to work effectively across cultures and highly matrix organization
- Be detail-oriented with exce
