The Position
The Position Summary
As the Chief of Staff for the Roche Diagnostics Japan Enabling Team, you will play a key role in the effective functioning and strategic success of the Japan Dia organization. Reporting to the Chapter Lead, ET Office (Dottedly to GM Japan), you will work side by side with the Dia Japan GM and Dia Japan Enabling Team as the “Chief of Staff”.
In this role, you will be involved in the strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders and network teams. In addition, you will work with the ET to translate vision/ strategy to actionable deliverables and assist them in facilitating effective decision-making. You will follow through and update the ET on progress of these deliverables as well as communication to employees through dashboard or other avenues. You will work with ET to prioritize on agenda and work through the backlog. And you will plan, convene and facilitate ET meetings to ensure objectives are achieved.

You will be responsible to:
● Support Japan Dia GM to develop short- and long-term priorities (business, financial and people) aligned to Roche Dia business objectives, by engaging in strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders
and network teams.
● As Chief of Staff, support the ET to ensure they are setting and achieving outcomes, while building and maintaining an environment that keeps the team focused on top priorities.
● Convene and facilitate the ET meetings, plan the agenda and support the team in timely, well-informed decision making.
● Design and facilitate effective meetings by prioritizing key objectives, balancing content review with discussion, and moderating dialogue.
● Strengthen ET cohesiveness by working with the P&C and regular exchanges with individual ET members.
● Increase ET effectiveness; Facilitate the formation of ET squads, make accountability clear, track and monitor ET decisions and backlog; hold ET members accountable to decisions and backlog.
● Lead, supported by administrative staff, on all aspects of logistics and planning of ET meetings.
● Collaborate with the GM and subject matter experts to develop communications and presentation materials for various speaking engagements.

Who you are
Professional and Technical Requirements:
- Degree / Masters in life sciences with typically with 3-5+ years of relevant experience in the life science sector in a similar capacity that may be directly comparable to Diagnostics and/or Pharmaceuticals is an advantage.
- Strategy consulting background and skill set would be desirable.
- Strong leadership experience, preferably with experience leading diverse teams and/or highly complex matrix leadership of enterprise-level projects.
- Strong business sense with a solid understanding of the healthcare industry and experience operating in a regulated environment.

Experience, Skills, Knowledge:

- Fully bilingual in Japanese and English in verbal, writing, and reading
- A systems thinker who can connect the dots between functions and processes in terms of broader business implications, including tactical, strategic, and enterprise dependencies.
- A strong collaborator, able to cultivate a strong and trusting relationship with executive leaders, proven experience in stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage through change, able to work effectively across cultures and highly matrix organization
- Be detail-oriented with exce

titleByLocale.en: Medical Network Expert/医学网络专家

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary 职位概述:
The Medical Network Expert is a key role that brings the Medical Scientific Affairs (MSA) strategy to life for a given disease area by serving as the interface between China Medical Affairs teams, China cross-functional strategy teams, Regional, and Global teams to deliver an integrated medical strategy plan that incorporates short-, mid- and long-term perspectives. The Medical Network Expert works hand in hand with the Medical Affairs team members to understand and address customer needs, leverages external stakeholder generated insights, and collaborate with the Global teams to provide China-specific insights into products in development.
医疗网络专家是一个关键角色，通过作为中国医疗事务团队、中国跨职能战略团队、区域和全球团队之间的桥梁，为特定疾病领域带来医学科学事务（MSA）战略，以提供包含短期、中期和长期视角的综合医学战略计划。医疗网络专家与医学事务团队成员携手合作，了解并满足客户需求，利用外部利益相关者提出的见解，并与全球团队合作，为正在开发的产品提供中国市场特有的洞见

Main Tasks & Responsibilities 主要工作职责 :
1. Bring clinical insights to all disease area medical squad conversations
在所有疾病领域医学相关讨论中提供临床见解
2. Works within the cross functional core team, in close collaboration with the MSA stakeholders to develop the medical components of the overall China integrated strategy for a given disease area (and related assets/services) leveraging external stakeholder generated insights/needs
在跨职能核心团队中工作，与MSA团队伙伴密切合作利用外部利益相关者提出的见解/需求，针对特定疾病领域制定中国整体综合战略
3. Coordinate medical strategy plan development for a particular disease area to include: INSIGHTS, INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE, GUIDELINES and EDUCATION & SCIENTIFIC EXCHANGES
协调特定疾病领域的医学战略计划制定，包括：见解、创新、证据、指南以及教育和科学交流
4. Develop a robust KOL network outside of the company that can be strategically tapped for medical insights and advocacy work
在公司外部建立强大的 KOL 网络并战略性地利用该网络进行医学见解宣传
5. Review outputs of internal partners for medical accuracy and patient centricity
审查内部合作伙伴的交付成果以确保医学准确性以及以患者为中心的宗旨被充分贯彻
6. Supports the creation of an inspiring team environment with agile, open, and inclusive culture
支持创建具有敏捷、开放和包容文化的鼓舞人心的团队环境
7. May support Medical Affairs work in the specific disease area as needed and respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, or off-label information.
按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。
8. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional cooperation to maximize utilization of resources
识别跨职能合作的机会以最大限度地利用资源

Education & Qualifications 教育背景与专业资格:
Master’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Laboratory Medicine, Pharmacy, or equivalent work experience in the In vitro diagnostics industry
医学临床、医学检验或药学硕士及以上，或有相关体外诊断领域的工作经验
Experience工作经验:
1. 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing medical strategies for various diseases in the medical or pharmaceutical industry
4年以上在医药或诊断行业，具备针对各种疾病制定和实施医疗策略的经验
2. Clinical research and trial management experience, and the ability to interact with KOLs with sufficient knowledge, expertise and confidence.
临床研究试验管理经验，及拥有丰富的知识，专长及自信与KOL 进行互动的能力
3. Must maintain knowledge of applicable research and literature
对适用的研究文献有知识储备
4. Fluent English skills and excellent presentation and teaching skills and the ability to represent the company in a professional manner at medical, scientific and public events.
流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力

Values & Core Competencies 价值观与核心能力：
• Demonstrate Roche values of Integrity, Courage, Passion
体现罗氏的价值观：真诚,勇气,激情
• Follow Roche Operating Principles
遵循罗氏运营准则
• Equip wit

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary 职位概述:
The Medical Network Expert is a key role that brings the Medical Scientific Affairs (MSA) strategy to life for a given disease area by serving as the interface between China Medical Affairs teams, China cross-functional strategy teams, Regional, and Global teams to deliver an integrated medical strategy plan that incorporates short-, mid- and long-term perspectives. The Medical Network Expert works hand in hand with the Medical Affairs team members to understand and address customer needs, leverages external stakeholder generated insights, and collaborate with the Global teams to provide China-specific insights into products in development.
医疗网络专家是一个关键角色，通过作为中国医疗事务团队、中国跨职能战略团队、区域和全球团队之间的桥梁，为特定疾病领域带来医学科学事务（MSA）战略，以提供包含短期、中期和长期视角的综合医学战略计划。医疗网络专家与医学事务团队成员携手合作，了解并满足客户需求，利用外部利益相关者提出的见解，并与全球团队合作，为正在开发的产品提供中国市场特有的洞见

Main Tasks & Responsibilities 主要工作职责 :
1. Bring clinical insights to all disease area medical squad conversations
在所有疾病领域医学相关讨论中提供临床见解
2. Works within the cross functional core team, in close collaboration with the MSA stakeholders to develop the medical components of the overall China integrated strategy for a given disease area (and related assets/services) leveraging external stakeholder generated insights/needs
在跨职能核心团队中工作，与MSA团队伙伴密切合作利用外部利益相关者提出的见解/需求，针对特定疾病领域制定中国整体综合战略
3. Coordinate medical strategy plan development for a particular disease area to include: INSIGHTS, INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE, GUIDELINES and EDUCATION & SCIENTIFIC EXCHANGES
协调特定疾病领域的医学战略计划制定，包括：见解、创新、证据、指南以及教育和科学交流
4. Develop a robust KOL network outside of the company that can be strategically tapped for medical insights and advocacy work
在公司外部建立强大的 KOL 网络并战略性地利用该网络进行医学见解宣传
5. Review outputs of internal partners for medical accuracy and patient centricity
审查内部合作伙伴的交付成果以确保医学准确性以及以患者为中心的宗旨被充分贯彻
6. Supports the creation of an inspiring team environment with agile, open, and inclusive culture
支持创建具有敏捷、开放和包容文化的鼓舞人心的团队环境
7. May support Medical Affairs work in the specific disease area as needed and respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, or off-label information.
按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。
8. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional cooperation to maximize utilization of resources
识别跨职能合作的机会以最大限度地利用资源

Education & Qualifications 教育背景与专业资格:
Master’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Laboratory Medicine, Pharmacy, or equivalent work experience in the In vitro diagnostics industry
医学临床、医学检验或药学硕士及以上，或有相关体外诊断领域的工作经验
Experience工作经验:
1. 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing medical strategies for various diseases in the medical or pharmaceutical industry
4年以上在医药或诊断行业，具备针对各种疾病制定和实施医疗策略的经验
2. Clinical research and trial management experience, and the ability to interact with KOLs with sufficient knowledge, expertise and confidence.
临床研究试验管理经验，及拥有丰富的知识，专长及自信与KOL 进行互动的能力
3. Must maintain knowledge of applicable research and literature
对适用的研究文献有知识储备
4. Fluent English skills and excellent presentation and teaching skills and the ability to represent the company in a professional manner at medical, scientific and public events.
流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力

Values & Core Competencies 价值观与核心能力：
• Demonstrate Roche values of Integrity, Courage, Passion
体现罗氏的价值观：真诚,勇气,激情
• Follow Roche Operating Principles
遵循罗氏运营准则

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior IT Service Delivery Manager

The Opportunity
As a Senior IT Service Delivery Manager within the Diagnostics R&D Portfolio & Project Management (PPM) organization, you will champion the management, governance, and optimization of IT Services across the entire Diagnostics R&D department.

You will put the needs of our scientific teams at the center of everything you do—ensuring the right processes, resources, and KPIs are in place to meet service commitments. Success in this role requires skillfully navigating a highly complex, matrixed organization to execute comprehensive solution visions and drive strategic vendor partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
Stakeholder & Demand Management

• Strategic Partnership: Identify, engage, and collaborate deeply with all R&D functional heads (including Labs, Computational Science & Engineering, Instrumentation, Engineering, Business Partnering, CDMA, and PPM). Understand their unique technical requirements and propose strategic solutions.

• Demand Forecasting: Maintain a forward-looking perspective of the R&D ecosystem to proactively forecast future infrastructure, platform, and service demands.

• Service Lifecycle Management: Drive the service lifecycle strategy in alignment with broader product roadmaps. Ensure services are clearly cataloged, easily discoverable, and highly consumable for R&D teams, continuously measuring success through User Experience (UX) metrics.

Operations, Governance & Process Optimization

• Metrics & Performance: Define service runs against metrics that matter to R&D teams. Establish new Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), design measurement methods, and hold accountability for delivery against targets, deadlines, and quality standards.

• Process Improvement: Spot operational insights and performance trends to continually drive process efficiencies and quality enhancements. Initiate changes to service specifications based on real-world data.

• Incident & Escalation Management: Swiftly resolve operational incidents to minimize downtime, protecting scientific velocity and business goals. Manage high-profile escalations and implement root-cause improvements to reduce recurring issues.

• Backlog Negotiation: Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and technical debt across R&D pillars. Advocate for the prioritization of operational needs directly within product team backlogs.

• Service Continuity: Develop, evaluate, and continually refine business continuity and disaster recovery plans to safeguard critical R&D operations and datasets.

Financial, Sourcing & Vendor Management

• Fiscal Accountability: Manage the team budget with full accountability for invoicing, billing controls, and compliance with local procurement, VMO, security, and legal processes.

• Vendor Performance: Monitor vendor relationships to ensure external operations meet agreed-upon SLA metrics, constantly identifying opportunities to enhance external service delivery.

• Sourcing Innovation: Lead Request for Proposal (RfP) processes, service benchmarking, and the onboarding or transition of services to new suppliers.

• Strategic Sourcing: Partner with sourcing managers to align with global sourcing strategies, exploring modern delivery models (such as co-sourcing or end-to-end sourcing) that fit the R&D landscape.

Methodology & Leadership Innovation

• Agile & DevOps Champion: Drive the implementation of Agile frameworks, DevOps maturity assessments, and automation initiatives to boost operational efficiency across int

jobs.title: Global SHE Compliance Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global SHE Compliance Expert

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe that operational excellence and sustainable action go hand in hand. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical requirements and organizational objectives, ensuring that our compliance systems effectively support our global license to operate. You will join a forward-thinking global team dedicated to maintaining the highest safety, health, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead System Ownership: Act as the Global Product Owner for safety, health, and environmental (SHE) compliance systems, monitoring corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and driving consistent application across global sites.

• Define Strategic Requirements: Document process features, user stories, and requirements in technical platforms to guide digital development teams effectively.

• Develop Compliance Standards: Create, revise, and update global internal compliance standards and process documents to reflect evolving regulatory landscapes.

• Drive Risk Insights: Monitor global compliance updates, identify potential gaps, and partner with regional experts to proactively mitigate operational risks.

• Optimize Data Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to transform SHE compliance data into actionable trend reports and insights for leadership reviews.

• Foster Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact across corporate governance lines, advising site-level SHE officers and compliance managers to support system adoption.

Who You Are

You bring a unique blend of technical curiosity, analytical precision, and collaborative spirit. You are passionate about translating complex regulatory requirements into structured digital processes and thriving in an environment built on ethics and transparency.
Qualifications:

• University degree in Engineering, Legal, Data/Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.

• Proven experience in a similar role (such as technical compliance, IT/digital data consultancy, or operational risk management) within a multinational matrix environment.

• Demonstrated track record in data architecture, compliance analytics, or digital system infrastructure.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in fluent English.

• Familiarity with global compliance standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001) or specific focus areas like occupational health and environmental protection is a distinct advantage.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. That’s what makes us Roche.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esperto globale di conformità SHE L'opportunità A Roche, crediamo che l'eccellenza operativa e l'azione sostenibile vadano di pari passo. In questo ruolo, colmare il divario tra requisiti tecnici e obiettivi organizzativi, assicurando che i nostri sistemi di compliance supportano efficacemente la nostra licenza globale per operare. Ti unirai a un team globale avanzato dedicato a mantenere i più elevati standard di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Responsabilità chiave:
• Lead System Ownership: Act as the Global Product Owner for safety, health and Environmental (SHE) compliance systems, monitoraggio delle azioni correttive e preventive (CAPAs) e la guida di un'applicazione coerente nei siti globali.
• Definire Requisiti Strategici: Caratteristiche del processo di documenti, storie degli utenti e requisiti nelle piattaforme tecniche per guidare efficacemente i team di sviluppo digitale.
• Sviluppare standard di conformità: creare, rivedere e aggiornare gli standard globali di conformità interna e documenti di processo per riflettere i paesaggi normativi in evoluzione.
• Drive Risk Insights: Monitorare gli aggiornamenti di conformità globali, identificare potenziali lacune e collaborare con gli esperti regionali per mitigare proattivamente i rischi operativi.
• Ottimizzare Data Analytics: Utilizzare strumenti di analisi dei dati per trasformare i dati di conformità SHE in report di tendenza attuabili e approfondimenti per le recensioni di leadership.
• Foster Collaboration: Agire come punto centrale di contatto attraverso le linee di corporate governance, consigliando ufficiali SHE di livello del sito e manager di conformità per sostenere l'adozione del sistema. Chi sei Porti un mix unico di curiosità tecnica, precisione analitica e spirito collaborativo. Sei appassionato di tradurre requisiti normativi complessi in processi digitali strutturati e prosperare in un ambiente costruito su etica e trasparenza. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in Ingegneria, Legale, Data/Computer Science, IT o una disciplina tecnica correlata.
• Esperienza dimostrata in un ruolo simile (come la conformità tecnica, la consulenza dati IT/digital o la gestione dei rischi operativi) all'interno di un ambiente multinazionale di matrice.
• Record di traccia dimostrata nell'architettura dei dati, nell'analisi della conformità o nell'infrastruttura del sistema digitale.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di influenzare i team interfunzionali in inglese fluente.
• La familiarità con gli standard di conformità globali (ad esempio, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) o specifiche aree di messa a fuoco come la salute e la protezione ambientale del lavoro è un vantaggio distinto. In cambio vi forniamo
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti e flessibilità: pacchetto stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarvi a trovare il vostro equilibrio: l'ufficio di casa è una pratica comune (2 giorni di ufficio / settimana). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche. Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per furthe

• Lead System Ownership: Agir en tant que propriétaire mondial de produits pour les systèmes de conformité en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement (SHE), surveiller les mesures correctives et préventives (CAPA) et conduire une application cohérente dans tous les sites mondiaux.
• Définir les exigences stratégiques : Documenter les caractéristiques du processus, les histoires d'utilisateurs et les exigences des plateformes techniques pour guider efficacement les équipes de développement numérique.
• Élaborer des normes de conformité : Créer, réviser et mettre à jour des normes de conformité internes mondiales et des documents de processus pour refléter l'évolution des paysages réglementaires.
• Diriger les connaissances sur les risques : Surveiller les mises à jour de la conformité mondiale, cerner les lacunes potentielles et établir des partenariats avec des experts régionaux pour atténuer les risques opérationnels de façon proactive.
• Optimiser l'analyse des données : Utilisez des outils d'analyse des données pour transformer les données de conformité de la SHE en rapports de tendance et en idées pratiques pour les examens de leadership.
• Favoriser la collaboration : Agir en tant que point de contact central entre les secteurs de gouvernance d'entreprise, conseiller les agents de la SHE et les gestionnaires de la conformité au niveau du site pour appuyer l'adoption du système. Qui vous êtes Vous apportez un mélange unique de curiosité technique, de précision analytique et d'esprit de collaboration. Vous êtes passionné par la traduction d'exigences réglementaires complexes en processus numériques structurés et prospère dans un environnement fondé sur l'éthique et la transparence. Qualifications
• Diplôme universitaire en génie, juridique, informatique, informatique ou une discipline technique connexe.
• Expérience éprouvée dans un rôle similaire (comme la conformité technique, le conseil en informatique/données numériques ou la gestion des risques opérationnels) dans un environnement matriciel multinational.
• Expérience démontrée en architecture de données, en analyse de conformité ou en infrastructure de système numérique.
• Forte capacité de communication et de gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité d'influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles en anglais couramment.
• La connaissance des normes mondiales de conformité (par exemple ISO 14001, ISO 45001) ou des domaines d'intérêt spécifiques comme la santé au travail et la protection de l'environnement constitue un avantage distinct. En échange, nous vous fournissons
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) guiderà le nuove attività di sviluppo commerciale del PHCS per Path Labs ed è responsabile per le soluzioni sanitarie personalizzate globali di Roche nuove entrate incrementali relative al portafoglio Path Lab. Il candidato di successo in questo ruolo sarà responsabile per l'identificazione, la guida e la creazione di relazioni con nuovi e esistenti partner biofarmaci emergenti. Questo ruolo è in primo luogo responsabile dell'approvvigionamento e dell'imbarco di nuovi partner biofarmaci e dello sviluppo di piani strategici per creare una pipeline di opportunità per guidare ricavi e crescita sostenibili. Questo ruolo si riferirà al responsabile del team PHCS Pharma Partnering di Roche Diagnostics Solutions e sarà previsto di lavorare in collaborazione attraverso l'organizzazione per raggiungere i risultati. I clienti sono aziende di dispositivi farmaceutici e/o terapeutici che collaborano con Roche Diagnostics per i loro servizi farmaceutici e i progetti diagnostici dei compagni. Cerchiamo un individuo altamente motivato e collaborativo con un forte sforzo per avere successo che gode di costruzione, infl uencing, e lavorare con un team diverso. L'opportunità:
• Conduce un nuovo sviluppo aziendale per lo sforzo di Emerging Biopharma Partnering, attività di gestione dei contratti per il portafoglio Path Lab Customer Area che serve clienti globali.
• Stabilisce obiettivi e sviluppa strategie di business necessarie per aumentare la penetrazione di conti biofarmaci emergenti esterni (cioè non-Roche Group).
• Sviluppa, mantiene ed esegue una forte conduttura di nuovi business e qualifi ed conduce attraverso tutte le diverse modalità di test diagnostici.
• Mantiene una buona comprensione delle tendenze nell'industria farmaceutica e come influiscono sul business diagnostico del compagno. Leva queste informazioni per sostenere il piano strategico dell'organizzazione.
• Conduce la ricerca sulle tendenze di business emergenti e i requisiti economici dell'industria farmaceutica e delle ricerche, schermi e raccomanda le aziende di punta chiave per l'alleanza aziendale.
• Funziona con la leadership di Project e CAP/CLIA Lab per garantire che i progetti possano essere pienamente supportati e consegnati in qualità e tempo.
• Collabora strettamente con tutte le funzioni (ad esempio legali, regolamentari, di sviluppo) per allineare le nostre attività di partnership con le capacità dell'organizzazione.
• Viaggi: stimato 25% Chi sei?
• Hai una laurea in Scienze della Vita
• Hai un minimo di 6-8 anni di esperienza in vendite, partner, o nuove attività di sviluppo aziendale.
• Hai una comprovata esperienza nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali attraverso la creazione di partenariati strategici, tra cui i negoziati precontrattuali e la gestione delle alleanze post-contrattuali.
• Possiedi esperienza con la creazione di contratti, lo sviluppo di strategie di prezzi e il controllo del contratto fulfi llment
• Conoscenze di lavoro dei mercati farmaceutici e diagnostici in vitro in tutto il mondo, comprese le strategie di sviluppo del prodotto, l'ambiente normativo, le tecnologie rilevanti e la commercializzazione globale.
• Hai una comprensione di alto livello delle diverse modalità di test diagnostici e la capacità di consigliare i partner sulle migliori opzioni tecnologiche.
• Porti uno sfondo forte e una conoscenza
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) will lead the PHCS's new business development activities for Path Labs and is accountable for Roche's Global Personalized Healthcare Solutions new incremental revenue related to the Path Lab portfolio. The successful candidate in this role will be responsible for identifying, driving and creating relationships with new and existing emerging biopharma partners. This role is primarily responsible for sourcing and onboarding new biopharma partners and developing strategic plans to create a qualifi ed pipeline of opportunities to drive sustainable revenue and growth. This role will report to the Head of the PHCS Pharma Partnering team at Roche Diagnostics Solutions and will be expected to work collaboratively across the organization to achieve results. Customers are pharmaceutical and/or therapeutic device companies that partner with Roche Diagnostics for their pharma services and companion diagnostic projects. We seek a highly motivated, collaborative individual with a strong drive to succeed who enjoys building, infl uencing, and working with a diverse team.

The Opportunity:

• Leads new business development for the Emerging Biopharma Partnering effort, contracts management activities for the Path Lab Customer Area portfolio serving global customers.

• Establishes objectives and develops business strategies needed to increase the penetration of external (i.e. non-Roche Group) emerging biopharma accounts.

• Develops, maintains and executes a strong pipeline of new business and qualifi ed leads across all different diagnostic testing modalities.

• Maintains a good understanding of the trends in the pharmaceutical industry and how they impact the companion diagnostic business. Leverages these insights to support the strategic plan of the organization.

• Conducts research on emerging business trends and economic requirements of the pharmaceutical industry and researches, screens and recommends key target companies for business alliance.

• Works with Project and CAP/CLIA Lab leadership to ensure projects can be fully supported and delivered on quality and time.

• Closely collaborates with all functions (e.g. legal, regulatory, development) to align our partnership activities with the capabilities of the organization.

• Travel: Estimated 25%

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Life Science

• You hold a minimum of 6-8 years of experience in sales, partnering, or new business development activities.

• You have a proven track record in achieving company goals through the creation of strategic partnerships, including pre-contract negotiations and post-contract alliance management.

• You possess experience with the establishment of contracts, development of pricing strategies and monitoring contract fulfi llment

• Working knowledge of worldwide pharmaceutical and in vitro diagnostic markets, including product development strategies, regulatory environment, relevant technologies and global commercialization.

• You have a high-level understanding of the different diagnostic testing modalities and ability to advise partners on the best technological options.

• You bring a strong background and knowledge

PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) dirigera les nouvelles activités de développement commercial du PHCS pour Path Labs et sera responsable des nouvelles recettes supplémentaires liées au portefeuille Path Lab de Roche. Le candidat retenu dans ce rôle sera chargé d'identifier, de diriger et d'établir des relations avec les nouveaux partenaires biopharmaceutiques et les nouveaux partenaires existants. Ce rôle est principalement responsable de l'approvisionnement et de l'intégration de nouveaux partenaires biopharmaceutiques et de l'élaboration de plans stratégiques visant à créer une réserve d'opportunités pour stimuler des revenus et une croissance durables. Ce rôle relèvera du chef de l'équipe de partenariat PHCS Pharma chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions et devrait travailler en collaboration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation pour obtenir des résultats. Les clients sont des entreprises pharmaceutiques et/ou thérapeutiques qui collaborent avec Roche Diagnostics pour leurs services pharmaceutiques et leurs projets de diagnostic. Nous recherchons une personne hautement motivée et collaborative, avec une forte volonté de réussir qui aime construire, influer et travailler avec une équipe diversifiée. La possibilité :

• Établir des objectifs et élaborer des stratégies d'affaires nécessaires pour accroître la pénétration des comptes biopharmaceutiques émergents externes (c.-à-d. non-Groupe Roche).
• Développer, entretenir et exécuter un important portefeuille de nouvelles activités et des pistes qualifiées pour toutes les différentes modalités de tests diagnostiques.
• Maintient une bonne compréhension des tendances dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et de l'impact qu'elles ont sur les activités diagnostiques des partenaires. Tire parti de ces idées pour appuyer le plan stratégique de l'organisation.
• Mener des recherches sur les nouvelles tendances commerciales et les besoins économiques de l'industrie pharmaceutique et des recherches, filtrer et recommander des entreprises cibles clés pour les alliances commerciales.
• Travaille avec la direction du projet et du laboratoire CAP/CLIA pour s'assurer que les projets peuvent être entièrement soutenus et livrés en temps et en qualité.
• Collabore étroitement avec toutes les fonctions (p. ex., juridiques, réglementaires, de développement) afin d'harmoniser nos activités de partenariat avec les capacités de l'organisation.
• Voyages : estimation de 25 % Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie
• Vous possédez un minimum de 6-8 ans d'expérience dans les activités de vente, de partenariat ou de développement d'entreprise.
• Vous avez fait preuve d'une expérience dans la réalisation des objectifs de l'entreprise grâce à la création de partenariats stratégiques, y compris les négociations précontractuelles et la gestion des alliances postcontractuelles.
• Vous possédez de l'expérience dans l'établissement de contrats, l'élaboration de stratégies de tarification et le suivi de l'exécution des contrats
• Connaissance pratique des marchés mondiaux des produits pharmaceutiques et des diagnostics in vitro, y compris les stratégies de développement des produits, l'environnement réglementaire, les technologies pertinentes et la commercialisation mondiale.
• Vous avez une compréhension de haut niveau des différentes modalités de tests diagnostiques et la capacité de conseiller les partenaires sur les meilleures options technologiques.
• Vous apportez une solide expérience et connaissance

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea (한국로슈진단)
Division: Core Lab & POC (진단검사 사업부)
Location: 서울
Position: Sales Representative (영업)

Your key responsibilities
Job Summary
한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

Who you are

• 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 학력 (신입 ~ 경력 7년 이하 선호)

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호

• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Data Innovation Specialist (RWD)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development (PD). We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

The Principal Data Innovation Specialist helps identify, prototype, and scale novel methods and technologies that transform how data is used across product development. Reporting to the Data Innovation Lead, you will explore emerging capabilities such as AI, semantic integration, and knowledge graphs to unlock new use cases for clinical, real-world, and operational data. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, product teams, and external partners to design proof-of-concepts, validate innovative solutions, and assess long-term feasibility. This role requires curiosity, strong technical grounding, and a mindset oriented toward experimentation and continuous learning.

The Opportunity

• Multi-Agent & AI Development: Prototype, validate, and scale advanced AI capabilities, focusing heavily on multi-agent development and orchestration architectures to unlock complex use cases across product development.

• Core Data Engineering: Lead robust data engineering activities to design, optimize, and streamline data workflows, building scalable data pipelines that integrate unstructured, multi-modal, and unconventional data sources.

• Analytical Project Leadership: Drive innovation activities and lead complex analytical projects focused on exploring novel data types , automated agent-driven workflows, and knowledge graph integrations in a multi-modal environment.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with scientists, engineers, and product teams to pilot data innovations , integrating advanced engineering pipelines and multi-agent frameworks into broader clinical development and data science workflows.

• Platform & Tool Creation: Drive the development of low-/no-code analytics platforms to democratize multi-modal data access and establish frameworks for the scalable evaluation, productization, and reuse of experimental data approaches.

• Subject Matter Expertise & Mentorship: Serve as an innovation methodology expert , guiding peers through new data modalities while mentoring junior team members on cutting-edge techniques, data tools, and agent architectures.

• Compliance & Data Governance: Proactively identify innovation areas via research while ensuring all engineering and AI frameworks maintain absolute compliance with data privacy and security regulations like HIPAA and GDPR.

Who You Are

• Educational & Professional Foundation: You hold a Master’s or Ph

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo si basa sul team Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) che guida l'eccellenza dei dati e l'analisi per potenziare il processo decisionale e la generazione delle prove all'interno di Roche Product Development (PD). Sviluppiamo e implementiamo strategie di dati che sbloccano il valore dei dati clinici, operativi e reali per accelerare la generazione delle prove, il processo decisionale e l'innovazione in PD e oltre. Integrando i principi FAIR, promuovendo la governance dei dati e consentendo la produzione dei dati, RWCDS assicura che i dati non siano solo reperibili e utilizzabili, ma anche un driver di rigore scientifico, di prontezza regolamentare e di trasformazione AI-powered. Attraverso partnership profonde con funzioni interne e collaboratori esterni, forniamo un ecosistema di dati pronto per il futuro che supporta la salute personalizzata e lo sviluppo efficiente della droga. Il Principal Data Innovation Specialist aiuta a identificare, prototipo e scalare nuovi metodi e tecnologie che trasformano il modo in cui i dati vengono utilizzati attraverso lo sviluppo del prodotto. Segnalando al Data Innovation Lead, esplorerai funzionalità emergenti come AI, integrazione semantica e grafici di conoscenza per sbloccare nuovi casi di utilizzo per dati clinici, reali e operativi. Collaborerai con scienziati, ingegneri, team di prodotti e partner esterni per progettare soluzioni innovative e valutare la fattibilità a lungo termine. Questo ruolo richiede curiosità, solide basi tecniche e una mentalità orientata alla sperimentazione e all'apprendimento continuo. L'opportunità
• Multi-Agent & AI Development: Prototipo, convalida e scala capacità AI avanzate, concentrandosi pesantemente su architetture di sviluppo e orchestrazione multi-agenti per sbloccare casi di uso complessi attraverso lo sviluppo del prodotto.
• Core Data Engineering: Leader robuste attività di ingegneria dei dati per progettare, ottimizzare e ottimizzare i flussi di dati, costruzione di datadotti scalabili che integrano fonti di dati non strutturate, multi-modali e non convenzionali.
• Leadership del progetto analitico: guidare attività di innovazione e condurre complessi progetti analitici focalizzati sull'esplorazione di nuovi tipi di dati, flussi di lavoro automatizzati di agenti e integrazioni dei grafici di conoscenza in un ambiente multi-modale.
• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: Partner con scienziati, ingegneri e team di prodotti per pilotare le innovazioni dei dati, integrando pipeline di ingegneria avanzate e quadri multi-agenti in flussi di lavoro più ampi di sviluppo clinico e di scienza dei dati.
• Platform & Tool Creation: Guidare lo sviluppo di piattaforme di analisi a basso/no-code per democratizzare l'accesso multi-modale dei dati e stabilire dei framework per la valutazione scalabile, la produzione e il riutilizzo degli approcci di dati sperimentali.
• Oggetto Matter Expertise & Mentorship: Servire come esperto di metodologia dell'innovazione, guidare i coetanei attraverso nuove modalità di dati mentre mentoring i membri del team junior su tecniche all'avanguardia, strumenti di dati e architetture di agente.
• Compliance & Data Governance: Identificare attivamente le aree di innovazione attraverso la ricerca, assicurando che tutti i framework di ingegneria e AI mantengano il rispetto assoluto della privacy dei dati e delle normative di sicurezza come HIPAA e GDPR. Chi sei

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ou rselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorr ow.

The Position
As a Safety and Reporting Senior Specialist of Post Market Quality , you will be a key player within our Quality and Regulatory organization. Working with a high degree of autonomy and minimal supervision, you will ensure our products maintain the highest standards of safety and compliance after they reach the market. You will dive into complex cases, collaborate globally, and contribute to continuous improvement in a dynamic, patient-centric environment.
Your Main Responsibilities:

• Case & Report Management: Take accountability for the timely and compliant handling of safety, vigilance, and Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) cases/reports, strictly adhering to ISO Quality System requirements and country-specific regulations.

• Regulatory & Affiliate Collaboration: Interface directly with Regulatory Authorities (e.g., FDA, Notified Bodies) and Affiliate Organizations. Coordinate, prepare, and deliver precise responses by collaborating with global subject matter experts.

• Post-Market Surveillance (PMS): Maintain and facilitate the schedule of PMS reports, drive data generation, and lead the planning, completion, and evaluation of PMS activities for various product families.

• Quality System & Process Improvement: Develop advanced monitoring systems for data and PMS reports to boost efficiency. Review case quality and customer feedback to optimize our internal processes.

• Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all records meet established quality processes, and take ownership of completing thorough risk assessments for product quality issues.

• Training, Mentoring & Squad Support: Participate in developing and delivering training on vigilance/safety/PMS topics. Onboard and coach less experienced colleagues, lead or contribute to agile projects (e.g., SQUADs), and act as a proxy for the Principal Specialist when needed.

What’s in your toolbox? (Qualifications & Experience):

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Sciences and/or vocational training with equivalent related experience.

• Experience: 3+ years of experience working in a regulated environment (preferred experience in Quality Systems, Vigilance, and/or Safety).

• Languages: Fluent professional knowledge of English is required. Knowledge of German is a strong asset.

• Technical Savvy: Laboratory experience and/or strong IT skills are highly preferred.

• Global Mindset: Proven experience working successfully in virtual, cross-functional, and intercultural teams.

Leadership & Soft Skills that will make you thrive:

• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to make sound decisions even when dealing with limited or ambiguous information.

• Resilience & Confident Manner: A strong sense of quality, a solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to changing environments.

• Communication & Technical Writing: Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to author technical documentation tailored for regulatory authorities.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generation

• Case & Report Management: Tenere conto della tempestiva e conforme gestione della sicurezza, della vigilanza e dei casi/reporti di sorveglianza post-market (PMS), rispettando rigorosamente i requisiti ISO Quality System e le normative specifiche per il paese.
• Collaborazione di regolamentazione e affiliazione: interfaccia direttamente con le autorità di regolamentazione (ad esempio, FDA, Organismi notificati) e le organizzazioni di affiliazione. Coordinare, preparare e fornire risposte precise collaborando con esperti di materie globali.

• Quality System & Process Improvement: Sviluppare sistemi di monitoraggio avanzati per i report di dati e PMS per aumentare l'efficienza. Verifica la qualità dei casi e il feedback dei clienti per ottimizzare i nostri processi interni.
• Compliance & Risk Management: Assicurarsi che tutti i record soddisfino i processi di qualità stabiliti, e prendere la proprietà di completare valutazioni di rischio complete per i problemi di qualità del prodotto.
• Formazione, Mentoring & Squad Support: Partecipa allo sviluppo e alla formazione su temi di vigilanza/sicurezza/PMS. A bordo e coach colleghi meno esperti, portare o contribuire a progetti agili (ad esempio, SQUADs), e agire come proxy per il Principal Specialist quando necessario. Cosa c'è nella tua cassetta degli attrezzi? (Qualifiche & Esperienza):
• Istruzione: laurea in Scienze e/o formazione professionale con esperienza relativa equivalente.
• Esperienza: 3+ anni di esperienza che lavorano in un ambiente regolamentato (esperienza preferita in Sistemi di Qualità, vigilanza e/o sicurezza).
• Lingue: È richiesta una conoscenza professionale fluida dell'inglese. La conoscenza del tedesco è un bene forte.
• Tecnica Savvy: Esperienza di laboratorio e/o forti competenze informatiche sono altamente preferiti.
• Global Mindset: Provata esperienza di lavoro con successo in team virtuali, cross-funzionali e interculturali. Leadership & Soft Skills che vi farà prosperare:
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Capacità di prendere decisioni sonore anche quando si tratta di informazioni limitate o ambigue.
• Resilience & Confident Manner: Un forte senso di qualità, una mentalità orientata alla soluzione, e la capacità di adattarsi agli ambienti mutevoli.
• Comunicazione e scrittura tecnica: eccellenti competenze di negoziazione e la capacità di autore di documentazione tecnica su misura per le autorità di regolamentazione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla sanità oggi e per la generazione

La position Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients et nous sommes intrépides tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler chaque jour. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inattaquable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour construire une meilleure hib. La position En tant que spécialiste principal de la sécurité et des rapports de la qualité après-vente, vous serez un acteur clé au sein de notre organisme de qualité et de réglementation. Travaillant avec un degré élevé d'autonomie et une supervision minimale, vous assurerez que nos produits maintiennent les normes les plus élevées de sécurité et de conformité après qu'ils atteignent le marché. Vous plongerez dans des cas complexes, collaborerez à l'échelle mondiale et contribuerez à une amélioration continue dans un environnement dynamique et axé sur le patient. Vos principales responsabilités :
• Gestion des cas et des rapports : Rendre compte de la gestion en temps opportun et conforme des cas/rapports de sécurité, de vigilance et de surveillance après la mise en marché, en respectant strictement les exigences du système qualité ISO et les règlements nationaux.
• Collaboration en matière de réglementation et d'affiliation : interface directe avec les autorités réglementaires (p. ex. la FDA, les organismes notifiés) et les organisations affiliées. Coordonner, préparer et fournir des réponses précises en collaborant avec des experts mondiaux.
• Surveillance après la mise en marché (SGP) : Maintenir et faciliter le calendrier des rapports sur les SGP, diriger la production de données et diriger la planification, l'achèvement et l'évaluation des activités des SGP pour diverses familles de produits.
• Système qualité et amélioration des processus : Élaborer des systèmes de surveillance avancés pour les rapports sur les données et les SPM afin d'accroître l'efficacité. Examiner la qualité des cas et les commentaires des clients pour optimiser nos processus internes.
• Conformité et gestion des risques : Veiller à ce que tous les dossiers respectent les processus de qualité établis et s'approprier la réalisation d'évaluations approfondies des risques liés à la qualité des produits.
• Formation, mentorat et soutien de l'équipe : Participer à l'élaboration et à la prestation d'une formation sur les sujets de vigilance, de sécurité et de SPM. À bord et encadrer des collègues moins expérimentés, diriger ou contribuer à des projets agiles (p. ex. SQUAD) et agir comme mandataire du spécialiste principal au besoin. Qu'y a-t-il dans votre boîte à outils ? (Qualifications et expérience):
• Éducation: Baccalauréat en sciences et/ou formation professionnelle avec une expérience équivalente.
• Expérience : plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans un environnement réglementé (expérience privilégiée en systèmes de qualité, vigilance et/ou sécurité).
• Langues: Une connaissance professionnelle de l'anglais est requise. La connaissance de l'allemand est un atout important.
• Savvy technique: l'expérience de laboratoire et/ou les compétences en TI sont hautement préférées.
• Global Mindset: Expérience éprouvée en travaillant avec succès dans des équipes virtuelles, interfonctionnelles et interculturelles. Leadership et compétences souples qui vous feront prospérer :
• Pensée critique et résolution de problèmes : Capacité de prendre des décisions judicieuses même lorsqu'il s'agit d'informations limitées ou ambiguës.
• Résilience & Confiance Manner: Un sens fort de la qualité, un état d'esprit orienté vers la solution et la capacité à s'adapter aux environnements changeants.
• Communication & rédaction technique: Excellentes compétences en négociation et capacité d'écrire une documentation technique adaptée aux autorités réglementaires. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. The Position
A Roche Field Services Engineer provides vital field service activities for Core Lab Instruments, Molecular Diagnostics, Tissue Diagnostics and Sequencing by provision and coordination of all activities relating to instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, software and hardware modifications, relating to both pre and post sales requirements.

What you will work on:
As a Field Service Engineer, you are required to:

• Actively involve with the Senior Account Management Teams and participate in regular team meetings to capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system

• Ensure the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working hand in hand with Regional Service Manager, Application Specialist and Senior Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.

• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer’s guidelines and notify Regional Service Manager for any overdue Preventative maintenance, and ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to all concerned.

• Ensure Spare Part Management and Boot Stock Accuracy, and identify any training deficiencies and inform the Regional Manager.

• Promote of all safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety, health and wellbeing of all employees and visitors.

• Ensure compliance with all Roche Processes as documented in policies and procedures, Roche Code of Conduct and Industry Code/s of Practice

The Brisbane-based Service support is primarily provided for instruments located within QLD, however, on occasion there will be travel regionally and interstate as required.

This service is provided based on hours of employment being typically 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday to Friday, and with a requirement to participate in a rotating On-Call Roster to cover the out of hours’ service requirements from 5 p.m. to 9 a.m. Monday to Friday and 24 hours Saturday and Sunday.

Who you are:
You have:

• A degree/diploma in Electrical/Electronics or equivalent qualification

• Experience working in field engineering / customer services related fields within the Medical Devices industry, having Diagnostic Industry background a plus

• Experience or expertise in the Hematology or diagnostic chemistry field is a plus.

• Experience with IT and Middleware systems, automation with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• A valid driver’s license

Your strong customer empathy and interaction skills and proven record of accomplishment in data connectivity, troubleshooting and resolution will be an advantage. You are someone who wants to influence your own development and working in a multicultural environment motivates you.

Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is preferred for this field based role.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitment agencies. Roche has a dedicated in-house Talent Acquisition team.

Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. A Roche Field Services Engineer provides vital field service activities for Core Lab Instruments, Molecular Diagnostics, Tissue Diagnostics and Sequencing by provision and coordination of all activities relating to instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, software and hardware modifications, relating to both pre and post sales requirements.

What you will work on:
As a Field Service Engineer, you are required to:

• Actively involve with the Senior Account Management Teams and participate in regular team meetings to capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system

• Ensure the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working hand in hand with Regional Service Manager, Application Specialist and Senior Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.

• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer’s guidelines and notify Regional Service Manager for any overdue Preventative maintenance, and ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to all concerned.

• Ensure Spare Part Management and Boot Stock Accuracy, and identify any training deficiencies and inform the Regional Manager.

• Promote of all safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety, health and wellbeing of all employees and visitors.

• Ensure compliance with all Roche Processes as documented in policies and procedures, Roche Code of Conduct and Industry Code/s of Practice

The Brisbane-based Service support is primarily provided for instruments located within QLD, however, on occasion there will be travel regionally and interstate as required.

This service is provided based on hours of employment being typically 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday to Friday, and with a requirement to participate in a rotating On-Call Roster to cover the out of hours’ service requirements from 5 p.m. to 9 a.m. Monday to Friday and 24 hours Saturday and Sunday.

Who you are:
You have:

• A degree/diploma in Electrical/Electronics or equivalent qualification

• Experience working in field engineering / customer services related fields within the Medical Devices industry, having Diagnostic Industry background a plus

• Experience or expertise in the Hematology or diagnostic chemistry field is a plus.

• Experience with IT and Middleware systems, automation with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• A valid driver’s license

Your strong customer empathy and interaction skills and proven record of accomplishment in data connectivity, troubleshooting and resolution will be an advantage. You are someone who wants to influence your own development and working in a multicultural environment motivates you.

Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is preferred for this field based role.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitment agencies. Roche has a dedicated in-house Talent Acquisition team.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders.

Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. We strive for

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In People & Culture our vision is to bring our Roche purpose to life by unlocking the greatness in all our people and organisation. We build trust by protecting and creating value through our partnership with customers to deliver not just services, but impactful experiences. We are a catalyst for enabling high performance while nurturing a sense of belonging and an inclusive culture where we can all thrive as we discover the best ideas and develop truly innovative solutions for patients and Roche’s future success.

The P&OG Consulting Lead for Diagnostics is an important role, accountable for designing and accelerating large-scale organizational effectiveness and transformation initiatives across the Pharma division. This role acts as a key system-wide link, ensuring the Consulting area of practice delivers high-impact, consistent outcomes aligned with Roche’s long-term ambitions.

Your opportunity

• Co-leading the Consulting AoP with the Practice Lead and other Consulting Leads

• Building the brand and advocating for the Consulting practice

• Providing leadership for and developing strategies to achieve short- and long-term outcomes toward the Roche 2030 Ambitions; in particular designing, leading, and executing interventions, large-scale and complex change and transformation initiatives by leading the Consulting Points of Contact for Diagnostics and partnering with:

• the BP Chapter Lead and BPEs for Diagnostics

• the Divisional Strategy and Strategy Implementation team

• key business leaders

• Developing collaborative partnerships with transformation offices and other teams working on transformation and organizational effectiveness across Roche and with that act as a system-wide link across

• The candidate will also have a seat at the DPCET (Dia People & Culture Enabling Team)

Who you are

You have a minimum of 10 years relevant consulting experience in a global organization of similar size and complexity. Ideally, you have worked either in an internal consulting practice or in one of the large external consultancies in the areas of OD, management, and/or leadership.

Your further qualifications are:

• Proven senior stakeholder management skills in a highly complex and matrix environment

• Outstanding networking and interpersonal skills

• Excellent track record of partnering and collaboration within P&C and with other parts of the organization

• Exceptional system-thinking and enterprise mindset

• Formal (or informal) leadership experience

• Demonstrated courage and ability to face into ambiguous situations, pushing back and challenging the status quo

• Knowledge of agile principles and methodologies applied in an enterprise-wide context

• Fluent English language skills are a must, other languages a plus

The preferred location for this position would be Basel or Rotkreuz, however, other locations in Europe can be considered based on the hiring manager’s discretion.

Are you interested, apply now!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

In People & Culture la nostra visione è quella di portare a vita il nostro scopo Roche sbloccando la grandezza in tutta la nostra gente e organizzazione. Costruiamo la fiducia proteggendo e creando valore attraverso la nostra partnership con i clienti per fornire non solo servizi, ma esperienze di impatto. Siamo un catalizzatore per consentire prestazioni elevate, alimentando un senso di appartenenza e una cultura inclusiva dove possiamo prosperare quando scopriamo le migliori idee e sviluppiamo soluzioni veramente innovative per i pazienti e il futuro successo di Roche.

Il P&OG Consulting Lead for Diagnostics è un ruolo importante, responsabile per la progettazione e l'accelerazione di iniziative di grande efficacia organizzativa e di trasformazione in tutta la divisione Pharma. Questo ruolo agisce come un collegamento chiave a livello di sistema, assicurando che l'area di consulenza pratica offre risultati ad alto impatto, coerenti allineati con le ambizioni a lungo termine di Roche.

La tua opportunità

• Co-leading the Consulting AoP with the Practice Lead and other Consulting Leads

• Costruire il marchio e promuovere la pratica Consulting

• Fornire leadership e sviluppare strategie per raggiungere risultati a breve e a lungo termine verso le Ambizioni Roche 2030; in particolare progettando, conducendo ed eseguendo interventi, iniziative di cambiamento e trasformazione su larga scala e complesse, guidando i Punti di Contatto per la Diagnostica e collaborando con:

• BP Capitolo Piombo e BPE per diagnostica

• il team Divisional Strategy and Strategy Implementation

• leader aziendali chiave

• Sviluppare partnership collaborative con uffici di trasformazione e altri team che lavorano alla trasformazione e all'efficacia organizzativa in Roche e che agiscono come un collegamento a livello di sistema

• Il candidato avrà anche un posto al DPCET (Dia People & Culture Eallow Team)

Chi sei

Hai un minimo di 10 anni di esperienza di consulenza rilevante in un'organizzazione globale di dimensioni e complessità simili. Idealmente, avete lavorato sia in una pratica di consulenza interna o in una delle grandi consulenze esterne nei settori dell'OD, della gestione e/o della leadership.

Le tue ulteriori qualifiche sono:

• Prove competenze di gestione degli stakeholder senior in un ambiente altamente complesso e matrice

• Rete eccezionale e competenze interpersonali

• Eccellente track record di collaborazione e collaborazione all'interno di P&C e con altre parti dell'organizzazione

• Eccezionale sistema di pensiero e mentalità aziendale

• Esperienza di leadership formale (o informale)

• Dimostrato coraggio e capacità di affrontare situazioni ambigue, spingendo indietro e sfidando lo status quo

• Conoscenza dei principi agili e delle metodologie applicate in un contesto aziendale

• Le competenze linguistiche fluenti sono un must, altre lingue un plus

La posizione preferita per questa posizione sarebbe Basilea o Rotkreuz, tuttavia, altri luoghi in Europa possono essere considerati in base alla discrezione del gestore di assunzione.

Sei interessato, applica ora!

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.
Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 m

• Ausgezeichnete Erfolgsbilanz der Partnerschaft und Zusammenarbeit innerhalb von P & C und mit anderen Teilen der Organisation

• Außergewöhnliches Systemdenken und Enterprise Mindset

• Formale (oder informelle) Führungserfahrung

• Demonstrierter Mut und Fähigkeit, sich mehrdeutigen Situationen zu stellen, den Status quo zurückzudrängen und herauszufordern

• Kenntnisse über agile Prinzipien und Methoden, die im unternehmensweiten Kontext angewendet werden

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse sind ein Muss, andere Sprachen ein Plus

Der bevorzugte Standort für diese Position wäre Basel oder Rotkreuz, andere Standorte in Europa können jedoch nach Ermessen des Einstellungsmanagers in Betracht gezogen werden.

Sind Sie interessiert, bewerben Sie sich jetzt!

Wenn Lohntransparenz gilt, werden die Angaben auf der Grundlage des primären Entsendeortes angegeben. Für diese Rolle ist der Hauptstandort Basel. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle möglicherweise verfügbar ist, werden wir die relevanten Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess angeben.
Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 m

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Dans People & Culture, notre vision est de donner vie à notre but Roche en débloquant la grandeur de notre peuple et de notre organisation. Nous renforçons la confiance en protégeant et en créant de la valeur grâce à notre partenariat avec nos clients pour offrir non seulement des services, mais aussi des expériences pertinentes. Nous sommes un catalyseur pour permettre des performances élevées tout en nourrissant un sentiment d'appartenance et une culture inclusive où nous pouvons tous prospérer alors que nous découvrons les meilleures idées et développons des solutions vraiment innovantes pour les patients et le succès futur de Roche.

Le chef de file de la consultation P&OG pour le diagnostic est un rôle important, responsable de la conception et de l'accélération des initiatives d'efficacité et de transformation organisationnelles à grande échelle dans la division Pharma. Ce rôle joue un rôle clé à l'échelle du système, assurant que le domaine de pratique de Conseils produit des résultats cohérents et à impact élevé qui correspondent aux ambitions à long terme de Roche.

Votre opportunité

• Codiriger l'AoP-conseil avec le chef de cabinet et d'autres chefs de cabinet

• Bâtir la marque et défendre la pratique du Conseil

• Assurer le leadership et l'élaboration de stratégies visant à obtenir des résultats à court et à long terme pour les Ambitions de Roche 2030; en particulier concevoir, diriger et exécuter des interventions, des initiatives de changement et de transformation à grande échelle et complexes en dirigeant les Points de contact pour le diagnostic et en partenariat avec :

• le plomb du chapitre BP et les BPE pour les diagnostics

• l ' équipe chargée de la stratégie et de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie

• principaux chefs d'entreprise

• Établir des partenariats avec les bureaux de transformation et d'autres équipes qui travaillent à la transformation et à l'efficacité organisationnelle dans l'ensemble de Roche et qui servent de lien à l'échelle du système

• Le candidat aura également un siège au DPCET (Dia People & Culture Enableing Team)

Qui vous êtes

Vous disposez d'un minimum de 10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans une organisation mondiale de taille et de complexité similaires. Idéalement, vous avez travaillé dans une pratique de consultation interne ou dans l'un des grands cabinets de consultants externes dans les domaines de la DPO, de la gestion et/ou du leadership.

• Compétences éprouvées de la haute direction dans un environnement matriciel très complexe

• Compétences en réseau et interpersonnelles exceptionnelles

• Excellente expérience de partenariat et de collaboration au sein de P&C et avec d'autres parties de l'organisation

• Conception exceptionnelle du système et esprit d'entreprise

• Expérience formelle (ou informelle) en matière de leadership

• Le courage et la capacité manifestes de faire face à des situations ambiguës, de repousser et de remettre en question le statu quo

• Connaissance des principes et méthodologies agiles appliqués dans un contexte global

• Les compétences linguistiques en anglais sont un must, d'autres langues un plus

L'emplacement privilégié pour ce poste serait Bâle ou Rotkreuz, mais d'autres endroits en Europe peuvent être considérés en fonction de la discrétion du gestionnaire d'embauche.

Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche.
