• Global Alignement & Network: Vous encouragez une coopération étroite et productive avec des domaines spécialisés internes (tels que les finances, les personnes et la culture) et la Roche mondiale fonctionne et développez nos modèles de gouvernance de manière agile.

Compétences en leadership :

• Leadership et développement de l'équipe : Vous dirigez, coachez et développez une équipe spécialisée de 5 experts au sein du BPM et définissez des priorités claires et motivantes pour le succès conjoint.

• Naviguer dans les structures matricielles : Vous avez une expérience éprouvée dans la gestion par les intervenants de projets matriciaux complexes et interdivisionnels et dirigez les équipes vers l'objectif, même sans ligne de rapport directe.

• Culture axée sur le rendement : Grâce à une communication transparente, à l'intégrité et à un haut degré de discrétion, vous créez la confiance et établissez une culture de leadership ouverte et axée sur le rendement.

Qui vous êtes :
Pour cette position de confiance exigeante, nous recherchons une personnalité de réflexion stratégique avec une forte compétence de mise en œuvre:

• Vous avez réussi vos études (bachelor ou maîtrise) en administration des affaires, en génie ou en sciences naturelles; Un MBA est idéal.

• Vous apporterez une expérience professionnelle approfondie (7-10 ans avec Master ou 8-10 ans avec Bachelor), dont au moins 5 ans d'expertise approfondie en multi-projets et gestion des risques.

• Vous avez prouvé votre succès dans le contrôle stratégique des paysages de projets complexes – idéalement dans un environnement hautement réglementé (IVDR / MedTech / Pharma).

• Vous êtes distingué par une méthode de travail indépendante, une expérience profonde avec des méthodes agiles et une connaissance profonde dans les outils d'analyse modernes. Vous avez la capacité de simplifier des approches complexes et de trouver des solutions pragmatiques et basées sur le risque.

• Vous êtes fidèle, fiable et discret. Vos compétences en communication en allemand et en anglais sont excellentes (écrites et orales).

On va faire le truc pour toi.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst (RDT Data & AI)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Operations Analyst - RDT Data & AI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As a Business Operations Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business operations workstreams, tackling complex problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of RDT DATA and AI functions’ vision and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams analysing, planning and executing the implementation of business operations processes within the function, such as compliance and quality adherence, performance dashboards, vendor management processes, organizational effectiveness related implementations etc. You will also be shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective business operations.

About RDT Data & AI Business Operations

As the strategic engine for RDT Data & AI Functions, our team bridges high-level vision with world-class execution. We are a high-performing collective of experts—from technical leaders to business analysts and human centered design experts—dedicated to elevating operational excellence and driving long-term strategy. By harnessing data-driven insights and managing critical shared capabilities, we ensure our division meets its global commitments with precision. Joining us means operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational effectiveness, with the autonomy to streamline complex processes, and the influence to shape the digital future of healthcare at Roche.

Our Core Focus Areas:

• Strategy & Execution: Co-developing functional strategy and managing global budgets to turn vision into reality.

• Operational Intelligence: Delivering sophisticated, evidence-based insights to guide senior leadership decision-making.

• Shared Capabilities: Orchestrating a diverse portfolio of expertise to support and empower RDT sub-functions.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Partnering across RDT functions as well as business partners in Finance, P&C and Procurement to drive seamless, end-to-end delivery.

The Opportunity:

• Drive End-to-End Workstreams: Independently lead complex business operations workstreams from concept through execution, navigating ambiguity with confidence.

• Deliver Strategic Value: Translate business requirements into actionable implementation plans and long-term solution roadmaps that align with overarching business goals.

La posizione

Analisi delle operazioni aziendali - Dati RDT e AI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Come Business Operations Analyst, gestirete in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro delle operazioni aziendali end-to-end, affrontando problemi complessi con l'ambiguità emergente. Dimostrerai una forte comprensione della visione delle funzioni RDT DATA e AI e delle loro interdipendenze, applicando strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente di fiducia per i team interfunzionali che analizzano, progettano ed eseguono l'implementazione dei processi operativi aziendali all'interno della funzione, come la conformità e l'aderenza di qualità, dashboard di performance, processi di gestione dei fornitori, implementazioni relative all'efficacia organizzativa, ecc. Potrai anche modellare le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire le interdipendenze e contribuire in modo significativo alla progettazione e alla convalida di operazioni aziendali efficaci.

Informazioni su RDT Data & AI Business Operations

Come motore strategico per RDT Data & AI Functions, il nostro team collega una visione di alto livello con l'esecuzione di livello mondiale. Siamo un collettivo di esperti altamente performanti, dai leader tecnici agli analisti di business e agli esperti di design centrati sull'uomo, che si è dedicato ad elevare l'eccellenza operativa e a guidare la strategia a lungo termine. sfruttando le informazioni e gestendo le capacità condivise critiche, garantiamo che la nostra divisione soddisfi i suoi impegni globali con precisione. Unirsi a noi significa operare all'incrocio tra strategia, tecnologia e efficacia operativa, con l'autonomia di semplificare i processi complessi, e l'influenza di modellare il futuro digitale della salute a Roche.

Le nostre aree focali:

• Strategia & Esecuzione: Co-sviluppare la strategia funzionale e gestire i bilanci globali per trasformare la visione in realtà.

• Intelligenza Operativa: fornire approfondimenti sofisticati e basati su prove per guidare il processo decisionale di leadership senior.

• Capacità condivise: orchestrare un portafoglio di competenze diversificato per supportare e potenziare le sotto-funzioni RDT.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner attraverso funzioni RDT e partner commerciali in Finance, P&C e Procurement per guidare la consegna senza soluzione di continuità, end-to-end.

L'opportunità:

• Drive End-to-End Workstreams: Indipendentemente condurre complesse operazioni aziendali flussi di lavoro dal concetto attraverso l'esecuzione, navigando ambiguità con fiducia.

• Fornire Valore Strategico: Traduci i requisiti aziendali in piani di implementazione attuabili e roadmap di soluzione a lungo termine che si allineano con obiettivi aziendali overarching.

About RDT Data & AI Business Operations

As the strategic engine for RDT Data & AI Functions, our team bridges high-level vision with world-class execution. We are a high-performing collective of experts—from technical leaders to business analysts and human centered design experts—dedicated to elevating operational excellence and driving long-term strategy. By harnessing data-driven insights and managing critical shared capabilities, we ensure our division meets its global commitments with precision. Joining us means operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational effectiveness, with the autonomy to streamline complex processes, and the influence to shape the digital future of healthcare at Roche.

Our Core Focus Areas:

• Strategy & Execution: Co-developing functional strategy and managing global budgets to turn vision into reality.

• Operational Intelligence: Delivering sophisticated, evidence-based insights to guide senior leadership decision-making.

• Shared Capabilities: Orchestrating a diverse portfolio of expertise to support and empower RDT sub-functions.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Partnering across RDT functions as well as business partners in Finance, P&C and Procurement to drive seamless, end-to-end delivery.

The Opportunity:

• Drive End-to-End Workstreams: Independently lead complex business operations workstreams from concept through execution, navigating ambiguity with confidence.

• Deliver Strategic Value: Translate business requirements into actionable implementation plans and long-term solution roadmaps that align with overarching business goals.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution Architect - Dia Commercial Operations

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

This role is based in the Commercial Operations division, which is dedicated to evolving digital technology solutions that enhance healthcare experiences worldwide. We operate within a mature environment built on deep business partnership and trust, which means that you will collaborate directly with cross-functional stakeholders to understand complex needs and propose optimal integration pathways. The critical importance of managing a highly interconnected system combined with the unique opportunity to drive future-ready architecture using MuleSoft offers you an exceptionally engaging space to influence strategic digital transformation.

The opportunity:

• Your main focus will be designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions that handle complex interdependencies and seamlessly connect a wide variety of global commercial systems.

• You are defining and driving integration pathways, reference architectures, and patterns, with a primary emphasis on maximizing the capabilities of MuleSoft as our core integration platform.

• You are establishing and maintaining the long-term technology roadmap and architecture vision, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards while actively managing technical debt and non-functional requirements.

• You are partnering directly with business teams and stakeholders to translate their operational needs into optimal technical concepts, acting as a trusted advisor who can clearly explain complex architectures.

• You are leading and mentoring product teams, providing technical oversight, evaluating external technology trends, and conducting vendor feasibility assessments to continuously enhance business value.

Who you are:

To ensure a seamless fit for this highly interconnected environment, candidates will be evaluated against the following criteria:

• Required Experience: Demonstrated track record designing complex, multi-solution architectures, managing long-term technical roadmaps, and creating logical data models.

• Required Technical Mastery: Advanced, expert-level proficiency in integration frameworks, with a strict requirement for hands-on mastery of MuleSoft across highly interdependent landscapes.

• Required Communication: Exceptional negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to challenge assumptions, influence perspectives, and clearly articulate difficult technical concepts to non-technical business partners.

• Preferred: Prior experience proactively cont

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Soluzione Architetto - Dia Commercial Operations Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Questo ruolo è basato nella divisione Operazioni Commerciali, che è dedicata a soluzioni tecnologiche digitali in evoluzione che migliorano le esperienze sanitarie in tutto il mondo. Operiamo all'interno di un ambiente maturo costruito sulla profonda partnership aziendale e la fiducia, il che significa che collaborerete direttamente con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per comprendere le esigenze complesse e proporre percorsi di integrazione ottimali. L'importanza critica della gestione di un sistema altamente interconnesso combinato con l'opportunità unica di guidare l'architettura pronta per il futuro utilizzando MuleSoft vi offre uno spazio estremamente coinvolgente per influenzare la trasformazione digitale strategica. L'opportunità:
• Il vostro focus principale sarà la progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready che gestiscono interdipendenze complesse e collegare senza soluzione di continuità una vasta gamma di sistemi commerciali globali.
• Stai definendo e guidando percorsi di integrazione, architetture di riferimento e modelli, con un'enfasi primaria sulla massimizzazione delle capacità di MuleSoft come la nostra piattaforma di integrazione di base.
• Stai stabilendo e mantenendo la roadmap tecnologica a lungo termine e la visione dell'architettura, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard aziendali, mentre gestisci attivamente il debito tecnico e i requisiti non funzionali.
• Stai collaborando direttamente con i team aziendali e gli stakeholder per tradurre le loro esigenze operative in concetti tecnici ottimali, agendo come consulente di fiducia che può chiaramente spiegare architetture complesse.
• Siete leader e team di prodotti di mentoring, fornendo la supervisione tecnica, valutando le tendenze della tecnologia esterna, e conducendo le valutazioni di fattibilità del fornitore per migliorare continuamente il valore aziendale. Chi sei: Per garantire una soluzione perfetta per questo ambiente altamente interconnesso, i candidati saranno valutati rispetto ai seguenti criteri:
• Esperienza richiesta: Dimostrato track record di progettazione di architetture complesse e multi-soluzione, gestione di roadmap tecniche a lungo termine, e la creazione di modelli di dati logici.
• Mastery Tecnico richiesto: Avanzata, competenza a livello di esperti nei quadri di integrazione, con un requisito rigoroso per la padronanza pratica di MuleSoft attraverso paesaggi altamente interdipendenti.
• Comunicazione richiesta: Eccezionale negoziazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con una comprovata capacità di sfidare i presupposti, influenzare le prospettive e chiaramente articolare concetti tecnici difficili ai partner commerciali non tecnici.
• Preferito: Esperienza precedente proattivamente

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Solution Architecte - Dia Opérations commerciales Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. • Vous établissez et maintenez la feuille de route technologique à long terme et la vision de l'architecture, assurant l'alignement avec les normes d'entreprise tout en gérant activement la dette technique et les exigences non fonctionnelles.

• Expérience requise : Expérience démontrée en matière de conception d'architectures complexes et multisolutions, de gestion de feuilles de route techniques à long terme et de création de modèles de données logiques.
• Maîtrise technique requise : Compétence avancée et experte en cadres d'intégration, avec une exigence stricte de maîtrise pratique de MuleSoft sur des paysages fortement interdépendants.
• Communication requise : Compétences exceptionnelles en matière de négociation et de gestion des intervenants, avec une capacité éprouvée de contester les hypothèses, d'influencer les perspectives et d'expliquer clairement les concepts techniques difficiles aux partenaires commerciaux non techniques.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. The Opportunity:

As a Sales Order Processing Analyst you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process, propose process and system improvements and contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of SSC. • Participating in stakeholder calls, team meetings, and workshops to maintain effective communication.

• Proactively fostering team cooperation, assisting colleagues, and handling various cross-functional or cross-geographic tasks as business needs evolve.

• 1-2 years of related experience desirably in an SSC environment or experience in data entry

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Experience with SAP is an advantage

• Proficiency in English and French

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Il Dipartimento Record to Report (R2R) è un'organizzazione globale di oltre 650 professionisti esperti di finanza che lavorano insieme per fornire servizi finanziari e soluzioni per Roche in tutta la regione EMEA. I nostri servizi riguardano la gestione finanziaria, la chiusura di fine periodo, la contabilità di capitale e di locazione, il credito e i crediti, la finanza di produzione e la rendicontazione divisionale, garantendo la conformità di 263 entità di report in 96 paesi con gli standard contabili (IFRS, GAAP) e garantendo l'integrità finanziaria.

L'opportunità:

In qualità di analista del trattamento degli ordini di vendita eseguirai le attività quotidiane secondo il livello di servizio concordato e nel rispetto delle SOP del rispettivo sottoprocesso aziendale, proporrai miglioramenti di processo e sistema e contribuirai continuamente al miglioramento delle prestazioni di SSC. Il vostro lavoro quotidiano principale sarà quello di elaborare gli ordini di farmaci provenienti da farmacie, ospedali e grossisti situati in Belgio.

• Eseguire attività complete, rigorose e tempestive durante il supporto di operazioni di affiliazione quotidiane.

• Controllo, convalida e modifica degli ordini dei clienti in SAP e blocco degli ordini come richiesto dai processi regionali.

• Identificare e risolvere i problemi, analizzando le cause della radice per prevenire il ripetersi, e prendere decisioni entro criteri definiti.

• Collaborare con il team di assistenza clienti della filiale locale e garantire una gestione precisa.

• Partecipare a chiamate di stakeholder, riunioni di team e workshop per mantenere una comunicazione efficace.

• Proattivamente promuovere la cooperazione di squadra, aiutare i colleghi, e la gestione di vari compiti interfunzionali o cross-geografici come le esigenze aziendali si evolvono.

Chi sei:

• Laurea universitaria o universitaria, o studi in corso che consentono un lavoro a tempo pieno

• 1-2 anni di esperienza correlati in un ambiente SSC o esperienza nell'inserimento dei dati

• centricità del cliente attraverso le interazioni quotidiane

• Responsabilità end-to-end, capacità di problem solving, mentalità di crescita in situazioni ambigue

• accettazione multiculturale, capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce e mutevole

• Esperienza con SAP è un vantaggio

• Proficienza in inglese e francese

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.

• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità inclusiva globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione.

Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per ulteriori informazioni su come gestiamo i vostri dati personali relativi al processo di reclutamento: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Die Abteilung Record to Report (R2R) ist eine globale Organisation von über 650 erfahrenen Finanzexperten, die zusammenarbeiten, um Finanzdienstleistungen und -lösungen für Roche in der gesamten EMEA-Region bereitzustellen. Unsere Dienstleistungen umfassen Finanzmanagement, Periodenabschluss, Kapital- und Leasingbuchhaltung, Kredite und Forderungen, Fertigungsfinanzierung und Teilberichterstattung, um die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards (IFRS, GAAP) für 263 berichtende Unternehmen in 96 Ländern sicherzustellen und die finanzielle Integrität zu gewährleisten.

Die Gelegenheit:

Als Sales Order Processing Analyst führen Sie die täglichen Aktivitäten nach dem vereinbarten Service Level und in Übereinstimmung mit den SOPs des jeweiligen Geschäftsteilprozesses durch, schlagen Prozess- und Systemverbesserungen vor und tragen kontinuierlich zur Verbesserung der Performance von SSC bei. Ihre tägliche Hauptaufgabe wird es sein, Medikamentenbestellungen von Apotheken, Krankenhäusern und Großhändlern in Belgien zu bearbeiten.

• Durchführung vollständiger, strenger und zeitnaher Aufgaben bei gleichzeitiger Unterstützung des täglichen Affiliate-Betriebs.

• Steuerung, Validierung und Änderung von Kundenaufträgen in SAP und Blockierung von Aufträgen nach Bedarf durch regionale Prozesse.

• Identifizieren und Lösen von Problemen, Analysieren von Ursachen, um ein Wiederauftreten zu verhindern, und Treffen von Entscheidungen innerhalb definierter Kriterien.

• 1-2 Jahre verwandte Erfahrung wünschenswert in einer SSC-Umgebung oder Erfahrung in der Dateneingabe

• Customer Centricity durch Ihre täglichen Interaktionen

• End-to-End-Rechenschaftspflicht, Problemlösungskompetenzen, Wachstumsdenken in mehrdeutigen Situationen

• Multikulturelle Akzeptanz, Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen und sich verändernden Umgebung zu arbeiten

• Erfahrung mit SAP ist von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch

Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen:

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.

Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Chance haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This field-based role spans Spain, serving as the primary point of contact for technical information regarding the Portable Delivery System (PDS) in ophthalmic surgery. This includes operating rooms and ophthalmology clinics. As a crucial member of a high-performing technical team, the SDP is responsible for comprehensive training, certification, and technical product support for investigators and clinical staff. The aim is to ensure optimal patient outcomes. By collaborating with study sites and the global cross-functional team, the SDP contributes valuable technical insights to ophthalmic surgery device development programs.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Act as the main channel for ophthalmic surgical technical information to and from the clinical environment (operating room, ophthalmology clinic), both within and outside clinical trials.

• Independently manage the preparation and execution of necessary training for all surgical procedures involving ophthalmic medical devices/the Port Delivery Platform for surgeons, ophthalmologists, and other ophthalmic HCPs.

• Provide ongoing remote and on-site support and training to surgical staff to ensure the proper use of the platform.

• Attend ophthalmic medical product/PD-P surgical procedures (implantation, revision, explantation, refilling-exchange) in the operating room (as per local regulations and strategy) and in the clinic to instruct and support surgeons and clinical staff during live cases.

• Deliver regulatory, safety, and risk minimization activities at the affiliate level, if required.

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with surgeons, therapeutic area experts, and other key healthcare professionals.

• Collaborate with the Medical team to provide strategic scientific review of surgical materials and communications.

• Collect and share insights from the field.

• Collaborate within a cross-functional team, including other SDPs and iSquad members, both locally and globally.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's Degree in Scientific areas, such as Pharmacy, Biology, etc., or having another Bachelor's Degree and demonstrated Medical Education.

• Surgical and operating room experience.

• Strongly preferred and recommended: Ophthalmic operating room experience.

• Strongly preferred: Experience with Class III Medical Devices.

• Both in English and Spanish fluent level.

• Preferible to be located in Barcelona.

• Demonstrated excellent training and teaching abilities, characterized by strong self-confidence, efficiency, and clarity when interacting with diverse trainee audiences.

• Willingness to travel nationally approximately 70% of the time (around 3-4 days per week) and internationally (Europe) 1-3 times per year.

• Proficiency in GCP, Adverse Event Reporting, and ICH guidelines.

• Excellent communication, interviewing, presentation, and moderation skills, including clear and precise written and oral communication and a high level of professionalism in dealing with customers, doctors, nurses, and other medical staff.

• Ability to build strong and trusting relationships with health care providers

• Resilience, self-organization, independence, and a sense of responsibility for patient well-being.

• Attention to detail, strong organizational and time management skills.

• Highly motivated and flexible team player with a focus on the success of colleagues.

• Ability to adapt positively to change and demonstrate entrepreneurial and solution-oriented thinking.

La posizione
Questo ruolo basato sul campo abbraccia la Spagna, servendo come punto primario di contatto per informazioni tecniche riguardanti il sistema di consegna portatile (PDS) in chirurgia oftalmica. Questo include sale operatorie e cliniche di oftalmologia. In qualità di membro cruciale di un team tecnico altamente performante, la SDP è responsabile della formazione completa, della certificazione e del supporto tecnico dei prodotti per gli investigatori e il personale clinico. L'obiettivo è quello di garantire risultati ottimali del paziente. Collaborando con i siti di studio e il team interfunzionale globale, il SDP contribuisce a preziose informazioni tecniche ai programmi di sviluppo di dispositivi di chirurgia oftalmica.

Le tue responsabilità chiave

• Agire come il canale principale per le informazioni tecniche chirurgiche oftalmiche a e dall'ambiente clinico (sala operatoria, clinica oftalmologica), sia all'interno che all'esterno degli studi clinici.

• Indipendentemente gestire la preparazione e l'esecuzione della formazione necessaria per tutte le procedure chirurgiche che coinvolgono dispositivi medici oftalmici/la Piattaforma Port Delivery per chirurghi, oftalmologi e altri HCP oftalmici.

• Fornire supporto e formazione in loco e in remoto per il personale chirurgico per garantire il corretto utilizzo della piattaforma.

• Partecipare a procedure chirurgiche di prodotto medico oftalmico/PD-P (impianto, revisione, espianto, ripieno-scambio) nella sala operatoria (come per regolamenti locali e strategia) e nella clinica per istruire e sostenere chirurghi e personale clinico durante i casi di vita.

• Collabora con il team medico per fornire una revisione scientifica strategica dei materiali chirurgici e delle comunicazioni.

• Raccogliere e condividere informazioni dal campo.

• Collaborare all'interno di un team interfunzionale, tra cui altri membri SDP e iSquad, sia a livello locale che globale.

• Esperienza chirurgica e sala operatoria.

• Fortemente preferito: Esperienza con dispositivi medici di classe III.

• Sia in inglese che in spagnolo livello fluente.

• Dimostrati eccellenti capacità di formazione e di insegnamento, caratterizzati da una forte fiducia in se stessi, efficienza e chiarezza quando interagisce con il pubblico tirocinante.

• Proficienza in GCP, Adverse Event Reporting e linee guida ICH.

• Ottima comunicazione, intervista, presentazione e capacità di moderazione, tra cui comunicazione scritta e orale chiara e precisa e un alto livello di professionalità nel trattare con clienti, medici, infermieri e altri personale medico.

• Resilienza, auto-organizzazione, indipendenza e un senso di responsabilità per il benessere dei pazienti.

• Attenzione ai dettagli, forti capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo.

• Giocatore di squadra altamente motivato e flessibile con un focus sul successo dei colleghi.

• Capacità di adattarsi positivamente al cambiamento e dimostrare il pensiero imprenditoriale e orientato alla soluzione.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This field-based role spans Spain, serving as the primary point of contact for technical information regarding the Portable Delivery System (PDS) in ophthalmic surgery. This includes operating rooms and ophthalmology clinics. As a crucial member of a high-performing technical team, the SDP is responsible for comprehensive training, certification, and technical product support for investigators and clinical staff. The aim is to ensure optimal patient outcomes. By collaborating with study sites and the global cross-functional team, the SDP contributes valuable technical insights to ophthalmic surgery device development programs.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Act as the main channel for ophthalmic surgical technical information to and from the clinical environment (operating room, ophthalmology clinic), both within and outside clinical trials.

• Independently manage the preparation and execution of necessary training for all surgical procedures involving ophthalmic medical devices/the Port Delivery Platform for surgeons, ophthalmologists, and other ophthalmic HCPs.

• Provide ongoing remote and on-site support and training to surgical staff to ensure the proper use of the platform.

• Attend ophthalmic medical product/PD-P surgical procedures (implantation, revision, explantation, refilling-exchange) in the operating room (as per local regulations and strategy) and in the clinic to instruct and support surgeons and clinical staff during live cases.

• Deliver regulatory, safety, and risk minimization activities at the affiliate level, if required.

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with surgeons, therapeutic area experts, and other key healthcare professionals.

• Collaborate with the Medical team to provide strategic scientific review of surgical materials and communications.

• Collect and share insights from the field.

• Collaborate within a cross-functional team, including other SDPs and iSquad members, both locally and globally.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's Degree in Scientific areas, such as Pharmacy, Biology, etc., or having another Bachelor's Degree and demonstrated Medical Education.

• Surgical and operating room experience.

• Strongly preferred and recommended: Ophthalmic operating room experience.

• Strongly preferred: Experience with Class III Medical Devices.

• Both in English and Spanish fluent level.

• Preferible to be located in Barcelona.

• Demonstrated excellent training and teaching abilities, characterized by strong self-confidence, efficiency, and clarity when interacting with diverse trainee audiences.

• Willingness to travel nationally approximately 70% of the time (around 3-4 days per week) and internationally (Europe) 1-3 times per year.

• Proficiency in GCP, Adverse Event Reporting, and ICH guidelines.

• Excellent communication, interviewing, presentation, and moderation skills, including clear and precise written and oral communication and a high level of professionalism in dealing with customers, doctors, nurses, and other medical staff.

• Ability to build strong and trusting relationships with health care providers

• Resilience, self-organization, independence, and a sense of responsibility for patient well-being.

• Attention to detail, strong organizational and time management skills.

• Highly motivated and flexible team player with a focus on the success of colleagues.

• Ability to adapt positively to change and demonstrate entrepreneurial and solution-oriented thinking.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Diese feldbasierte Rolle erstreckt sich über Spanien und dient als primäre Anlaufstelle für technische Informationen zum Portable Delivery System (PDS) in der Augenchirurgie. Dazu gehören Operationssäle und Augenkliniken. Als wichtiges Mitglied eines leistungsstarken technischen Teams ist die SDP für die umfassende Schulung, Zertifizierung und technische Produktunterstützung für Prüfer und klinisches Personal verantwortlich. Ziel ist es, optimale Patientenergebnisse zu gewährleisten. Durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Studienstandorten und dem globalen funktionsübergreifenden Team trägt das SDP wertvolle technische Erkenntnisse zu Entwicklungsprogrammen für Geräte für die Augenchirurgie bei.

Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Als Hauptkanal für ophthalmochirurgische technische Informationen zur und aus der klinischen Umgebung (Operationsraum, Augenklinik) sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb klinischer Studien fungieren.

• Verwalten Sie unabhängig die Vorbereitung und Durchführung der erforderlichen Schulungen für alle chirurgischen Verfahren mit ophthalmologischen Medizinprodukten / der Port Delivery Platform für Chirurgen, Augenärzte und andere ophthalmologische HCPs.

• Bereitstellung von laufender Fern- und Vor-Ort-Unterstützung und Schulung des chirurgischen Personals, um die ordnungsgemäße Nutzung der Plattform sicherzustellen.

• Nehmen Sie an ophthalmologischen Medizinprodukten / PD-P-Chirurgieverfahren (Implantation, Revision, Explantation, Nachfüllungsaustausch) im Operationssaal (gemäß lokaler Vorschriften und Strategie) und in der Klinik teil, um Chirurgen und klinisches Personal bei Live-Fällen zu unterweisen und zu unterstützen.

• Liefern Sie bei Bedarf regulatorische, Sicherheits- und Risikominimierungsaktivitäten auf Affiliate-Ebene.

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie strategische Beziehungen zu Chirurgen, Therapeuten und anderen wichtigen Gesundheitsexperten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Medical-Team zusammen, um eine strategische wissenschaftliche Überprüfung der chirurgischen Materialien und der Kommunikation bereitzustellen.

• Sammeln und teilen Sie Erkenntnisse aus dem Bereich.

• Arbeiten Sie in einem funktionsübergreifenden Team zusammen, einschließlich anderer SDPs und iSquad-Mitglieder, sowohl lokal als auch global.

• Bachelor-Abschluss in wissenschaftlichen Bereichen, wie Pharmazie, Biologie, etc., oder mit einem anderen Bachelor-Abschluss und demonstrierte medizinische Ausbildung.

• Chirurgische und Operationssaal Erfahrung.

• Stark bevorzugt und empfohlen: Ophthalmische Operationssaal Erfahrung.

• Stark bevorzugt: Erfahrung mit Klasse III Medizinprodukte.

• Sowohl in Englisch als auch in Spanisch fließend.

• Am liebsten in Barcelona.

• Demonstrierte hervorragende Trainings- und Lehrfähigkeiten, die sich durch starkes Selbstvertrauen, Effizienz und Klarheit bei der Interaktion mit verschiedenen Trainee-Publikum auszeichnen.

• Bereitschaft, ungefähr 70% der Zeit (ca. 3-4 Tage pro Woche) und international (Europa) 1-3 Mal pro Jahr zu reisen.

• Kenntnisse in GCP, Adverse Event Reporting und ICH-Richtlinien.

• Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Interview-, Präsentations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich einer klaren und präzisen schriftlichen und mündlichen Kommunikation und einem hohen Maß an Professionalität im Umgang mit Kunden, Ärzten, Krankenschwestern und anderem medizinischem Personal.

• Fähigkeit, starke und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Gesundheitsdienstleistern aufzubauen

• Resilienz, Selbstorganisation, Unabhängigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein für das Wohlbefinden der Patienten.

• Aufmerksamkeit für Details, starke Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten.

• Hoch motivierter und flexibler Teamplayer mit Fokus auf den Erfolg von Kollegen.

• Fähigkeit, sich positiv an Veränderungen anzupassen und unternehmerisches und lösungsorientiertes Denken zu demonstrieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Ce rôle sur le terrain s'étend à l'Espagne, qui est le principal point de contact pour les informations techniques concernant le système de livraison portable (SDP) en chirurgie ophtalmique. Cela comprend les salles d'opération et les cliniques d'ophtalmologie. En tant que membre crucial d'une équipe technique performante, le SDP est responsable de la formation complète, de la certification et du soutien technique aux chercheurs et au personnel clinique. L'objectif est d'assurer des résultats optimaux pour les patients. En collaborant avec les sites d'étude et l'équipe interfonctionnelle mondiale, le SDP fournit des renseignements techniques précieux aux programmes de développement d'appareils de chirurgie ophtalmique.

Vos principales responsabilités

• Agir comme principal canal d'information technique sur la chirurgie ophtalmique à destination et en provenance de l'environnement clinique (salle d'opération, clinique d'ophtalmologie), tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des essais cliniques.

• Gérer indépendamment la préparation et l'exécution de la formation nécessaire pour toutes les interventions chirurgicales impliquant des dispositifs médicaux ophtalmiques/la plate-forme de livraison portuaire pour chirurgiens, ophtalmologistes et autres HCP ophtalmiques.

• Fournir un soutien et une formation continus à distance et sur place au personnel chirurgical pour assurer la bonne utilisation de la plateforme.

• Assister à des interventions chirurgicales ophtalmiques/PD-P (implantation, révision, explantation, remplacement-échange) dans la salle d'opération (conformément à la réglementation et à la stratégie locales) et dans la clinique afin d'instruire et de soutenir les chirurgiens et le personnel clinique pendant les cas vivants.

• Mener des activités de réglementation, de sécurité et de réduction des risques au niveau des filiales, au besoin.

• Développer et maintenir des relations stratégiques avec les chirurgiens, les spécialistes du domaine thérapeutique et d'autres professionnels de la santé clés.

• Collaborer avec l'équipe médicale pour fournir un examen scientifique stratégique du matériel chirurgical et des communications.

• Recueillir et partager des idées sur le terrain.

• Collaborer au sein d'une équipe interfonctionnelle, y compris d'autres SDP et membres de l'équipe iSquad, à la fois localement et à l'échelle mondiale.

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat en sciences, comme la pharmacie, la biologie, etc., ou ayant un autre baccalauréat et une formation médicale démontrée.

• Expérience en salle d'opération et de chirurgie.

• Fortement préféré et recommandé : Expérience en salle d'opération ophtalmique.

• Fortement préféré : Expérience avec les instruments médicaux de classe III.

• En anglais et en espagnol.

• De préférence à Barcelone.

• Excellente capacité de formation et d'enseignement démontrée, caractérisée par une confiance en soi forte, l'efficacité et la clarté dans l'interaction avec divers publics de stagiaires.

• Volonté de voyager à l'échelle nationale environ 70 % du temps (environ 3-4 jours par semaine) et à l'échelle internationale (Europe) 1-3 fois par an.

• Compétence en PCG, déclaration des événements indésirables et lignes directrices de l'ICH.

• Excellente capacité de communication, d'entrevue, de présentation et de modération, y compris une communication écrite et orale claire et précise et un haut niveau de professionnalisme dans les relations avec les clients, les médecins, les infirmières et autres personnels médicaux.

• Capacité d'établir des relations solides et confiantes avec les fournisseurs de soins de santé

• La résilience, l'auto-organisation, l'indépendance et un sentiment de responsabilité pour le bien-être des patients.

• Attention aux détails, aux solides compétences organisationnelles et en gestion du temps.

• Joueur d'équipe très motivé et flexible avec un accent sur le succès de collègues.

• Capacité de s'adapter positivement au changement et de faire preuve d'esprit d'entreprise et de pensée axée sur la solution.

• Maintenir tous les certificats requis

jobs.title: Medical Device Technical Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready for an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the Industrialization and Sustaining Engineering of Medical Devices and Drug-Device Combination Products at Roche? As the Medical Device Technical Lead, you will be at the forefront of our future product portfolio, which will feature Device presentations in 60% of our offerings. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable production and supply chain readiness, from early development stages to execution at Sites, Suppliers, and CMOs. This is a unique chance to make a significant impact on the quality, cost-efficiency, and time to market of our products.

The Opportunity

• Develop and manage technical Industrialization and Sustaining Engineering activities from innovation to commercialization, ensuring budget and staffing requirements are met.

• Create and execute a multi-year roadmap for Industrialization and Sustaining Engineering based on product and business needs.

• Lead a global technical matrix team, driving end-to-end technical activities across the development and commercialization process.

• Foster alignment between innovation teams, product teams, life cycle teams, and technical development teams.

• Apply design principles for manufacturing, assembly, industrialization, and life cycle management during product development.

• Share knowledge and exchange best practices with other Development, Industrialization, and Sustaining Engineering teams.

• Drive supplier selection and ensure alignment with market needs and industrialization requirements

Who You Are

• We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced individual to join our team as the Medical Device Technical Lead.

• B.S./M.S/Ph.D. degree in science, engineering, or a related field with extensive work experience and technical capabilities in medical device or combination product development, industrialization, sustaining engineering, and manufacturing.

• Ability to collaborate with internal and external senior-level clinical, commercial, and technical stakeholders.

• Advanced level of innovation skills, including influencing external partners and championing continuous improvement efforts.

• Advanced expertise and in-depth knowledge in industrialization and product sustaining management for complex systems, as well as quality, manufacturing equipment design and qualification, and process performance qualification.

• Experience in external contract negotiation and partnership.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Sei pronto per un'emozionante opportunità di svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nell'industrializzazione e nella gestione di ingegneria di dispositivi medici e prodotti di combinazione di farmaci a Roche? Come il dispositivo medico piombo tecnico, sarete in prima linea del nostro futuro portafoglio di prodotti, che sarà caratterizzato da presentazioni del dispositivo nel 60% delle nostre offerte. Sarete responsabili di garantire la prontezza affidabile della produzione e della supply chain, dalle fasi iniziali di sviluppo all'esecuzione a Siti, Fornitori e CMO. Questa è un'occasione unica per fare un impatto significativo sulla qualità, l'efficienza dei costi e il tempo per il mercato dei nostri prodotti.

L'opportunità

• Sviluppare e gestire le attività tecniche di industrializzazione e di gestione dell'ingegneria dall'innovazione alla commercializzazione, assicurando che siano soddisfatte le esigenze di bilancio e di personale.

• Creare ed eseguire una roadmap pluriennale per l'industrializzazione e la gestione di ingegneria in base alle esigenze di prodotto e business.

• Guida un team di matrice tecnica globale, guidando attività tecniche end-to-end nel processo di sviluppo e commercializzazione.

• Promuovere l'allineamento tra team di innovazione, team di prodotti, team di ciclo di vita e team di sviluppo tecnico.

• Applicare i principi di progettazione per la produzione, l'assemblaggio, l'industrializzazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita durante lo sviluppo del prodotto.

• Condividere conoscenze e scambiare le migliori pratiche con altri team di sviluppo, industrializzazione e ingegneria.

• Selezione del fornitore di unità e garantire l'allineamento con le esigenze di mercato e requisiti di industrializzazione

Chi sei

• Siamo alla ricerca di un individuo altamente qualificato e esperto per unirsi al nostro team come il dispositivo medico piombo tecnico.

• B.S./M.S/Ph.D. laurea in scienze, ingegneria, o un campo correlato con una vasta esperienza di lavoro e capacità tecniche in dispositivi medici o sviluppo di prodotti combinati, industrializzazione, ingegneria di supporto e produzione.

• Capacità di collaborare con gli stakeholder clinici, commerciali e tecnici interni ed esterni.

• Livello avanzato di capacità di innovazione, tra cui l'influenza di partner esterni e la promozione di sforzi di miglioramento continuo.

• Competenze avanzate e conoscenze approfondite nell'industrializzazione e nella gestione del prodotto per sistemi complessi, nonché nella qualità, nella progettazione e nella qualificazione delle attrezzature di produzione e nella qualificazione delle prestazioni di processo.

• Esperienza nella negoziazione e nel partenariato dei contratti esterni.

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'équipe de la paie, du temps et des avantages sociaux met l'accent sur la paye, les avantages sociaux, la gestion des absences, le service à la clientèle et le soutien consultatif aux employés, aux gestionnaires et aux partenaires d'affaires afin d'assurer l'achèvement du processus de bout en bout conformément aux principes axés sur les clients afin de s'assurer que les pratiques humaines de Roche fonctionnent pour l'entreprise. En tant que spécialiste de la paie, du temps et des avantages sociaux, vous êtes responsable de la maintenance des données et des activités administratives du système des RH en temps opportun et avec exactitude, à l'appui des processus opérationnels de P&C dans le domaine de la paie, de l'impôt, de l'assurance sociale, du temps et de plusieurs avantages locaux et mondiaux. etc. Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue de la prestation des solutions de soutien aux personnes de P&C par l'analyse des interactions et de la collaboration avec d'autres fonctions de soutien aux personnes de P&C et à l'extérieur. Vous avez besoin d'une vaste compréhension des processus et des outils des RH locaux, ainsi que des impacts locaux et mondiaux en aval sur la gestion du cycle de vie des employés, les finances, les achats, les TI, etc. Cela s'accompagne d'une forte concentration client, de compétences en communication et d'une orientation vers la solution.

Collaborer avec les pairs de la région et du monde entier pour s'assurer que le réseau People Support Solutions offre des services cohérents et efficaces à nos clients. jobs.title: Post Doctoral Scientist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral scientist with pharmaceutical sciences, peptide chemistry or related background to undertake an exciting, industry research project.

The opportunity

Peptide based therapeutics is a rapidly evolving field, but the physicochemical challenges associated with these molecules, coupled with increasing complexity demands, require a deeper understanding of the factors that impact their stability. This Postdoctoral project will focus on understanding and optimizing lead formulations for peptide candidates and fixed-dose co-formulations. The candidate should be able to work effectively with an interdisciplinary team from academia and industry to implement innovative solutions.

• Develop a study plan and design adequate experiments for pharmaceutical development of peptide and co-formulations

• Execute in vitro stability studies

• Be a catalyst in creating an environment of innovation, learning and growth in the field of pharmaceutical development for peptide therapeutics

• Present research findings through internal reports, scientific contributions, supervision of research projects and initiation of new research activities.

Who are you

• Ph.D. in pharmaceutical sciences, peptide chemistry, or a related field

• Strong hands-on experience in testing peptide delivery systems and relevant analytical methods and desire to learn/develop new methods

• Highly motivated with a passion for applied scientific research and technical innovation

• Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills are required. Must be able to participate and collaborate in highly effective, international and cross-functional teams, organizing and implementing complex research plans

• Demonstrates technical proficiency, scientific creativity, collaboration with others and independent thought in suggesting experimental design

• Experience with data analysis or programming tools (e.g. MatLab, R) is a plus

We are looking forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

L'opportunità

I terapeutici a base di peptide sono un campo in rapida evoluzione, ma le sfide fisicochimiche associate a queste molecole, accoppiate con crescenti esigenze di complessità, richiedono una comprensione più approfondita dei fattori che influiscono sulla loro stabilità. Questo progetto postdoctoral si concentrerà sulla comprensione e l'ottimizzazione delle formulazioni di piombo per i candidati peptide e le co-formulazioni di dosaggio fisso. Il candidato dovrebbe essere in grado di lavorare efficacemente con un team interdisciplinare dall'accademia e dall'industria per implementare soluzioni innovative.

• I risultati attuali della ricerca attraverso relazioni interne, contributi scientifici, supervisione dei progetti di ricerca e avvio di nuove attività di ricerca.

Chi sei

• Ph.D. in scienze farmaceutiche, chimica peptide, o un campo correlato

• Forte esperienza pratica nella sperimentazione di sistemi di consegna peptide e metodi analitici pertinenti e il desiderio di imparare / sviluppare nuovi metodi

• L'esperienza con l'analisi dei dati o gli strumenti di programmazione (ad esempio MatLab, R) è un plus

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral scientist with pharmaceutical sciences, peptide chemistry or related background to undertake an exciting, industry research project.

The opportunity

Peptide based therapeutics is a rapidly evolving field, but the physicochemical challenges associated with these molecules, coupled with increasing complexity demands, require a deeper understanding of the factors that impact their stability. This Postdoctoral project will focus on understanding and optimizing lead formulations for peptide candidates and fixed-dose co-formulations. The candidate should be able to work effectively with an interdisciplinary team from academia and industry to implement innovative solutions.

• Develop a study plan and design adequate experiments for pharmaceutical development of peptide and co-formulations

• Execute in vitro stability studies

• Be a catalyst in creating an environment of innovation, learning and growth in the field of pharmaceutical development for peptide therapeutics

• Present research findings through internal reports, scientific contributions, supervision of research projects and initiation of new research activities.

Who are you

• Ph.D. in pharmaceutical sciences, peptide chemistry, or a related field

• Strong hands-on experience in testing peptide delivery systems and relevant analytical methods and desire to learn/develop new methods

• Highly motivated with a passion for applied scientific research and technical innovation

• Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills are required. Must be able to participate and collaborate in highly effective, international and cross-functional teams, organizing and implementing complex research plans

• Demonstrates technical proficiency, scientific creativity, collaboration with others and independent thought in suggesting experimental design

• Experience with data analysis or programming tools (e.g. MatLab, R) is a plus

We are looking forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

• Präsentation von Forschungsergebnissen durch interne Berichte, wissenschaftliche Beiträge, Betreuung von Forschungsprojekten und Initiierung neuer Forschungsaktivitäten.

Wer bist du

• Demonstriert technische Fähigkeiten, wissenschaftliche Kreativität, Zusammenarbeit mit anderen und unabhängiges Denken, indem es experimentelles Design vorschlägt

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Nous recherchons un chercheur postdoctoral hautement motivé en sciences pharmaceutiques, en chimie des peptides ou dans un contexte connexe pour entreprendre un projet de recherche intéressant dans l'industrie.

L'opportunité

Les traitements à base de peptide sont un champ en évolution rapide, mais les défis physicochimiques associés à ces molécules, associés à des exigences de complexité croissante, nécessitent une compréhension plus approfondie des facteurs qui influent sur leur stabilité. Ce projet postdoctoral sera axé sur la compréhension et l'optimisation des formulations de plomb pour les candidats aux peptides et les coformulations à dose fixe. Le candidat devrait pouvoir travailler efficacement avec une équipe interdisciplinaire du milieu universitaire et de l'industrie pour mettre en oeuvre des solutions novatrices.

• Élaborer un plan d'étude et concevoir des expériences adéquates pour le développement pharmaceutique de peptides et de coformulations

• Exécuter des études de stabilité in vitro

• Être un catalyseur dans la création d'un environnement d'innovation, d'apprentissage et de croissance dans le domaine du développement pharmaceutique pour les peptides thérapeutiques

• Présenter les résultats de la recherche au moyen de rapports internes, de contributions scientifiques, de la supervision des projets de recherche et du lancement de nouvelles activités de recherche.

Qui êtes-vous ?

• Doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, chimie des peptides ou dans un domaine connexe

• Forte expérience pratique dans la mise à l'essai des systèmes de livraison de peptides et des méthodes analytiques pertinentes et désir d'apprendre/de développer de nouvelles méthodes

• Très motivé avec une passion pour la recherche scientifique appliquée et l'innovation technique

• D'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles sont nécessaires. Doit être en mesure de participer et de collaborer à des équipes hautement efficaces, internationales et interfonctionnelles, en organisant et en mettant en oeuvre des plans de recherche complexes

• Démontre la compétence technique, la créativité scientifique, la collaboration avec d'autres et la pensée indépendante en suggérant la conception expérimentale

• L'expérience avec les outils d'analyse de données ou de programmation (p. ex. MatLab, R) est un plus

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature!

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.title: Technical Lead for Archiving
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Lead for Archiving

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to helping shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’ re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential , and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meeting s, and other collaborative even ts.

This role is based in our global data lifecycle ecosystem, which is dedicated to securing, optimizing, and future-proofing Roche's massive healthcare data landscape. We operate with a forward-thinking approach, ensuring complex data archiving strategies directly power process efficiencies and technological innovation. The massive scale and global impact of our initiatives offer you an unparalleled space to drive modern engineering practices and grow as a strategic tech leader.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Lead for Archiving, your main focus will be navigating organizational complexity to define and communicate comprehensive solution visions and roadmaps for large-scale, strategically critical initiatives:

• Define and Drive Solution Roadmaps: Spearhead the strategic vision and roadmap for complex, high-impact data archiving initiatives, ensuring alignment with global business objectives.

• Lead Content and Scope Management: Develop and champion robust scope management strategies, overseeing significant architectural and data-related changes while driving process efficiency.

• Solve Complex Delivery Challenges: Proactively identify strategic opportunities and risks, lead cross-boundary troubleshooting, and drive consensus on critical engineering and delivery decisions.

• Manage High-Impact Stakeholders: Build strong, collaborative relationships with senior management across global sites, effectively navigating conflicts to achieve strategic alignment.

• Embed Agile & Best Practices: Lead organizational change initiatives by fostering innovation, embedding Agile frameworks, and refining delivery methodologies across the product domain.

• Navigate Complex Dependencies: Manage highly intricate project deliveries with multiple interconnected dependencies, transforming ambiguous requirements into execution-ready plans.

Who You Are

We are looking for a visionary, agile-minded technical leader who thrives on solving complex data landscape challenges and collaborating with diverse global teams:

• Extensive Leadership Experience: Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Technical Product Owner, Program Manager, RTE/STE, or Agile Coach) with extensive experience leading large-scale, complex software or data delivery programs (Required).

• Agile Expertise: Mastery of Agile frameworks, delivery methodologies, and leading cross-functional organizational change initiatives (Required).

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communicati
