descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

La funzione Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse si concentra sulla modernizzazione della creazione e della gestione dei dati clinici e delle attività di presentazione delle normative (dati e contenuti). Sviluppa e implementa piattaforme per la gestione dei contenuti strutturata, consentendo il riutilizzo dei componenti approvati attraverso i documenti. Questo gruppo pionieristico anche l'uso di agentic AI per assistere a generare, rivedere e assemblare beni complessi di sottomissione (dati e contenuti), mirando a migliorare la qualità e ridurre i tempi di autore.

L'opportunità:

Il Senior IT Data Scientist è responsabile di soluzioni leader, sviluppo e attuazione basate sui dati per problemi aziendali complessi. Questo ruolo comporta l'individuazione indipendente di opportunità analitiche, la realizzazione di approfondimenti di esplorazione e analisi dei dati, la costruzione, il test e la distribuzione di modelli predittivi utilizzando varie tecniche di machine learning. Possiederai progetti dall'inizio all'implementazione, sfruttando una forte programmazione, modellazione statistica e capacità di visualizzazione dei dati, mentre comunicherai chiaramente i risultati a stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.

Operando in un ambiente GxP altamente regolamentato, si costruirà agenti AI specializzati che aiutano gli scienziati di dati analitici attraverso il ciclo di vita dei dati clinici. Ciò richiede una profonda comprensione di AI generativo avanzato, Generazione Aumentata di Graph (GraphRAG). Potrai bilanciare il lavoro tecnico pratico con responsabilità di leadership, contribuendo frequentemente alla roadmap tecnica del team. Sarete responsabili dell'individuazione delle opportunità di analisi e automazione, proprietaria di progetti dall'inizio al completamento. Inoltre, le tue responsabilità includono:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): porta lo sviluppo e la distribuzione dei modelli. Funziona indipendentemente su specifici progetti di data science dall'inizio alla fine.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi di complessi problemi di business e dati, esegue un'accurata ricerca di dominio e guida l'analisi della causa principale. Identificare e risolvere sfide di dati intermedie e complesse collaborando sulla validità dei dati per garantire l'accuratezza con una supervisione minima. Contabile per fornire requisiti completi di cui il business bridge ha bisogno con capacità tecniche di dati.

• Stakeholder Management: Engages con unità aziendali più ampie per comprendere e soddisfare le loro esigenze di dati. Presenta risultati analitici e approfondimenti a vari stakeholder, tra cui il pubblico non tecnico.

• Impact/Strategy: promuove progetti di medie dimensioni che influenzano direttamente le decisioni aziendali. Assicura che i progetti siano strettamente allineati con obiettivi e strategie aziendali più ampi.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Maniglie più grandi, set di dati più complessi. Sviluppa nuovi modelli predittivi da zero e ottimizza quelli esistenti per migliorare le prestazioni.

• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: dimostra una comprensione concettuale dei domini aziendali e tecnici, delle tecnologie e delle loro interdipendenze. Si basa sulla competenza nella raccolta dei requisiti, strutture di dati, usabilità e analisi dei processi per gestire le interconnessioni e migliorare l'efficienza complessiva. Leva una forte conoscenza funzionale di metodi statistici avanzati, algori di apprendimento automatico

• Optical control of the manufactured products

jobs.title: Data Steward Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) department is establishing the One PT Data Office to serve as the strategic center for data governance, strategy, and enablement across the entire global PT network. This team is at the heart of our digital transformation, responsible for architecting and leading a central data office to unlock the full potential of PT’s data assets.

We are recruiting Data Steward Leads who will have the opportunity to establish PT’s data stewardship framework and approach to delivering and embedding effective data governance within PT domains. You will serve as the leader for Business Data Stewards for data specifications and quality, ensuring that global data standards are adopted and data owners are established. Your role involves identifying and resolving data constraints and issues, acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Business Data Stewards.

The Opportunity

• Own, build, manage, and mobilize a network of domain Data Stewards and Data Owners, working closely to implement global data governance policies, standards, and processes as centrally defined.

• Act as a single point of contact for a specific PT domain (Supply Chain & Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO) for data governance challenges and needs.

• Ensure robust roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities for data stewardship and ownership within the domain and in alignment with broader data domains.

• Enable the data domain to understand and translate global standards, policies, and frameworks and ensure compliance across the domain.

• Identify data constraints and issues, such as data integrity problems, and develop strategies for addressing these challenges on applicable source systems.

• Act as the business process owner within or across the domain, overseeing data governance and ensuring that data practices align with business objectives.

• Work with Data Stewards to implement metadata management processes and establish data dictionaries, glossaries, and cataloguing tools to facilitate documentation.

Who You Are

• Experience: 7 - 10+ years of relevant data stewardship experience or similar, with experience in a leadership capacity and working in a complex organization.

• Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge of data management practices and principles, particularly within the context of Pharma Tech Ops or similar industries, with expertise in Supply Chain & Finance, Quality & Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO.

• Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

• Technical Skills: Strong expertise in data governance standards, policy, flow, and quality; data driven, with the ability to analyse and interrogate data.

• General Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with stakeholders at all levels, and demonstrated leadership and problem-solving abilities to drive data initiatives.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il dipartimento Pharma Technical Operations (PT) sta stabilendo l'One PT Data Office per servire come centro strategico per la governance dei dati, la strategia e l'attivazione in tutta la rete PT globale. Questo team è al centro della nostra trasformazione digitale, responsabile dell’archiviazione e della guida di un data office centrale per sbloccare il pieno potenziale dei dati di PT.

Stiamo reclutando Data Steward Leads che avranno l'opportunità di stabilire il framework di gestione dei dati di PT e l'approccio a fornire e integrare una governance efficace dei dati all'interno dei domini di PT. Potrai servire come leader per Business Data Stewards per le specifiche e la qualità dei dati, assicurando che gli standard di dati globali sono adottati e i proprietari di dati sono stabiliti. Il tuo ruolo consiste nell'identificazione e nella risoluzione di vincoli e problemi di dati, agendo come singolo punto di contatto (SPOC) per gli amministratori di dati aziendali.

L'opportunità

• Possedere, costruire, gestire e mobilitare una rete di amministratori di dati di dominio e proprietari di dati, lavorando a stretto contatto per implementare politiche, standard e processi di governance dei dati globali come definiti centralmente.

• Agire come un unico punto di contatto per uno specifico dominio PT (Supply Chain & Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO) per le sfide e le esigenze di governance dei dati.

• Assicurare ruoli, responsabilità e responsabilità robuste per la gestione e la proprietà dei dati all'interno del dominio e in allineamento con domini di dati più ampi.

• Abilitare il dominio dei dati per comprendere e tradurre standard, politiche e framework globali e garantire la conformità in tutto il dominio.

• Identificare vincoli di dati e problemi, come problemi di integrità dei dati e sviluppare strategie per affrontare queste sfide sui sistemi sorgente applicabili.

• Agire come proprietario del processo di business all'interno o all'interno del dominio, supervisionare la governance dei dati e garantire che le pratiche dei dati si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Lavorare con Data Stewards per implementare i processi di gestione dei metadati e stabilire dizionari di dati, glossari e strumenti di catalogazione per facilitare la documentazione.

Chi sei

• Esperienza: 7 - 10+ anni di esperienza di gestione dei dati rilevanti o simili, con esperienza in una capacità di leadership e lavoro in un'organizzazione complessa.

• Esperienza di dominio: Forte conoscenza delle pratiche e dei principi di gestione dei dati, in particolare nel contesto di Pharma Tech Ops o industrie simili, con competenze in Supply Chain & Finance, Quality & Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO.

• Istruzione: Una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato è richiesto. È preferito un master o un'esperienza equivalente.

• Competenze tecniche: Forte competenza negli standard di governance dei dati, politica, flusso e qualità; dati guidati, con la capacità di analizzare e interrogare i dati.

• Competenze generali: Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, in grado di impegnarsi con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli, e dimostrato leadership e capacità di problem solving per guidare le iniziative di dati.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità!

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Madrid. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.
Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 empl
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) department is establishing the One PT Data Office to serve as the strategic center for data governance, strategy, and enablement across the entire global PT network. This team is at the heart of our digital transformation, responsible for architecting and leading a central data office to unlock the full potential of PT’s data assets.

We are recruiting Data Steward Leads who will have the opportunity to establish PT’s data stewardship framework and approach to delivering and embedding effective data governance within PT domains. You will serve as the leader for Business Data Stewards for data specifications and quality, ensuring that global data standards are adopted and data owners are established. Your role involves identifying and resolving data constraints and issues, acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Business Data Stewards.

The Opportunity

• Own, build, manage, and mobilize a network of domain Data Stewards and Data Owners, working closely to implement global data governance policies, standards, and processes as centrally defined.

• Act as a single point of contact for a specific PT domain (Supply Chain & Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO) for data governance challenges and needs.

• Ensure robust roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities for data stewardship and ownership within the domain and in alignment with broader data domains.

• Enable the data domain to understand and translate global standards, policies, and frameworks and ensure compliance across the domain.

• Identify data constraints and issues, such as data integrity problems, and develop strategies for addressing these challenges on applicable source systems.

• Act as the business process owner within or across the domain, overseeing data governance and ensuring that data practices align with business objectives.

• Work with Data Stewards to implement metadata management processes and establish data dictionaries, glossaries, and cataloguing tools to facilitate documentation.

Who You Are

• Experience: 7 - 10+ years of relevant data stewardship experience or similar, with experience in a leadership capacity and working in a complex organization.

• Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge of data management practices and principles, particularly within the context of Pharma Tech Ops or similar industries, with expertise in Supply Chain & Finance, Quality & Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO.

• Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

• Technical Skills: Strong expertise in data governance standards, policy, flow, and quality; data driven, with the ability to analyse and interrogate data.

• General Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with stakeholders at all levels, and demonstrated leadership and problem-solving abilities to drive data initiatives.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 empl
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Abteilung für Pharma Technical Operations (PT) richtet das One PT Data Office ein, um als strategisches Zentrum für Data Governance, Strategie und Enablement im gesamten globalen PT-Netzwerk zu dienen. Dieses Team steht im Mittelpunkt unserer digitalen Transformation und ist verantwortlich für die Architektur und Leitung eines zentralen Datenbüros, um das volle Potenzial der Datenressourcen von PT zu erschließen.

Wir rekrutieren Data Steward Leads, die die Möglichkeit haben, das Data Stewardship-Framework und den Ansatz von PT zur Bereitstellung und Einbettung einer effektiven Data Governance in PT-Domänen zu etablieren. Sie sind führend bei Business Data Stewards für Datenspezifikationen und -qualität und stellen sicher, dass globale Datenstandards übernommen und Dateneigentümer etabliert werden. Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, Datenbeschränkungen und -probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen und als Single Point of Contact (SPOC) für Business Data Stewards zu fungieren.

Die Chance

• Besitzen, bauen, verwalten und mobilisieren Sie ein Netzwerk von Domänen-Data Stewards und Data Ownern und arbeiten Sie eng zusammen, um globale Data-Governance-Richtlinien, -Standards und -Prozesse zentral definiert zu implementieren.

• Handeln Sie als Ansprechpartner für eine bestimmte PT-Domäne (Supply Chain & Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Development oder Manufacturing & CDMO) für Herausforderungen und Anforderungen der Data Governance.

• Gewährleistung robuster Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten für die Datenverwaltung und -verantwortung innerhalb der Domäne und in Abstimmung mit breiteren Datendomänen.

• Ermöglichen Sie der Datendomäne, globale Standards, Richtlinien und Frameworks zu verstehen und zu übersetzen und die Einhaltung der Domäne sicherzustellen.

• Identifizieren Sie Datenbeschränkungen und Probleme, wie z. B. Datenintegritätsprobleme, und entwickeln Sie Strategien, um diese Herausforderungen auf anwendbaren Quellsystemen zu bewältigen.

• Handeln Sie als Eigentümer von Geschäftsprozessen innerhalb oder innerhalb der Domäne, überwachen Sie die Datenverwaltung und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Datenpraktiken mit den Geschäftszielen übereinstimmen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Data Stewards, um Metadatenverwaltungsprozesse zu implementieren und Datenwörterbücher, Glossare und Katalogisierungstools zu erstellen, um die Dokumentation zu erleichtern.

Wer du bist

• Erfahrung: 7 - 10+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Data Stewardship oder ähnliches, mit Erfahrung in Führungspositionen und in einer komplexen Organisation.

• Domain Expertise: Starke Kenntnisse der Datenmanagementpraktiken und -prinzipien, insbesondere im Kontext von Pharma Tech Ops oder ähnlichen Branchen, mit Expertise in Supply Chain & Finance, Quality & Regulatory, Development oder Manufacturing & CDMO.

• Ausbildung: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich ist erforderlich. Ein Master-Abschluss oder eine gleichwertige Erfahrung wird bevorzugt.

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Starke Expertise in Data Governance Standards, Policy, Flow und Qualität; datengesteuert, mit der Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren und abzufragen.

• Allgemeine Fähigkeiten: Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, sich mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zu beschäftigen, und Führungsqualitäten und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten demonstriert haben, um Dateninitiativen voranzutreiben.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese aufregende Gelegenheit zu entdecken!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le département des Opérations Techniques Pharmaes (PT) est en train de créer le One PT Data Office pour servir de centre stratégique de gouvernance des données, de stratégie et d'habilitation sur l'ensemble du réseau mondial de PT. Cette équipe est au cœur de notre transformation numérique, responsable de l'architecture et de la direction d'un bureau central de données pour libérer tout le potentiel des actifs de données PT.

Nous recrutons des responsables de la gestion des données qui auront l'occasion d'établir un cadre et une approche de gestion des données de PT pour assurer et intégrer une gouvernance efficace des données dans les domaines de PT. Vous serez le chef de file pour les Business Data Stewards pour les spécifications et la qualité des données, en veillant à ce que les normes mondiales de données soient adoptées et que les propriétaires de données soient établis. Votre rôle consiste à identifier et à résoudre les contraintes et les problèmes liés aux données, en agissant comme point de contact unique (SPOC) pour les délégués aux données d'affaires.

L'opportunité

• Propre, construire, gérer et mobiliser un réseau de Data Stewards et de Data Owners, travaillant en étroite collaboration pour mettre en œuvre les politiques, normes et processus de gouvernance mondiale des données tels que définis au niveau central.

• Agir comme un point de contact unique pour un domaine particulier de PT (chaîne d'approvisionnement et finances, qualité, réglementation, développement ou fabrication et CDMO) pour les défis et les besoins en matière de gouvernance des données.

• Assurer des rôles, des responsabilités et des responsabilités solides en matière de gestion et de propriété des données dans le domaine et conformément à des domaines de données plus vastes.

• Permettre au domaine des données de comprendre et de traduire les normes, politiques et cadres mondiaux et d'assurer la conformité dans l'ensemble du domaine.

• Recenser les contraintes et les problèmes de données, comme les problèmes d'intégrité des données, et élaborer des stratégies pour relever ces défis sur les systèmes source applicables.

• Agir en tant que propriétaire de processus opérationnels à l'intérieur ou à travers le domaine, surveiller la gouvernance des données et s'assurer que les pratiques en matière de données cadrent avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Travailler avec Data Stewards pour mettre en oeuvre des processus de gestion des métadonnées et établir des dictionnaires de données, des glossaires et des outils de catalogage pour faciliter la documentation.

Qui vous êtes

• Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience pertinente en gestion des données ou d'une expérience semblable, avec une expérience en leadership et travaillant dans une organisation complexe.

• Domaine d'expertise : Bonne connaissance des pratiques et principes de gestion des données, en particulier dans le contexte des opérations Pharma Tech ou d'industries similaires, avec une expertise en chaîne d'approvisionnement et finances, qualité et réglementation, développement ou fabrication et CDMO.

• Études : Un baccalauréat en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe est requis. Une maîtrise ou une expérience équivalente est préférée.

• Compétences techniques : Forte expertise en matière de normes de gouvernance des données, de politiques, de flux et de qualité; conduite des données, avec la capacité d'analyser et d'interroger les données.

• Compétences générales : Fortes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, capables de s'engager auprès des intervenants à tous les niveaux et ayant démontré leur leadership et leurs capacités de résolution de problèmes pour mener des initiatives en matière de données.

Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante!

Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Madrid. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche.
Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 emplois

jobs.title: Contracts & Legal Analyst - Product Development
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Contracts & Legal Analyst - Product Development

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Legal and Compliance Department ensures that Roche operates within the boundaries of laws, regulations, and ethical standards. We protect Roche's interests and reputation by providing creative and business-focused legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, managing litigation, and addressing compliance issues.

We also collaborate with other departments to develop and implement policies and procedures that promote ethical business behavior, patient safety, data privacy, and transparency, while maximizing the value of our intellectual property. We play a vital role in maintaining the company's integrity and freedom to operate.

The Opportunity:

As a Contract Analyst reporting into the Legal function, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating Roche's clinical research and product development pipeline across Canada.

Your core responsibilities will include:

• Drafting and negotiating clinical trial agreements (CTAs), confidentiality agreements, and related product development contracts.

• Partnering and collaborating with external stakeholders, including major academic hospitals, clinical research sites, and prominent research universities across Canada.

• Ensuring risk mitigation and compliance by aligning agreement terms with Roche’s internal policies, Canadian healthcare regulations, data privacy laws, and ethical standards.

• Managing the contract lifecycle from initial intake and drafting through redlines, negotiation, approval, and final execution.

• Providing legal support to internal clinical operations and study management teams to resolve contract-related bottlenecks efficiently.

• Assisting the Legal department with ad-hoc projects, including the maintenance and optimization of contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance documents.

Who You Are:

• You hold a formal Law Clerk training (e.g., Law Clerk/ diploma or equivalent legal education/certification).

• You posses 3+ years of experience and demontrate a strong foundational interest in drafting and negotiating contracts within the Canadian legal landscape.

• You are self-motivated and capable of working independently, managing multiple contract files simultaneously with strict attention to detail.

• You possess excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between legal requirements and clinical research goals.

• You have a collaborative mindset capable of building strong relationships with both internal business partners and external institutional representatives.

• You complement our culture and the core values that guide our daily behavior and decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

Preferred:

• You have prior experience negotiating clinical trial agreements or working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or broader healthcare/research sector.

• You demonstrate familiarity with intellectual property provisions, liability/indemnification clauses, and Canadian health data privacy considerations.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 89,256.00 and 117,148.50 of hiring ra

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Contratti & Legal Analyst - Sviluppo Prodotto

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Il Dipartimento Legale e Compliance garantisce che Roche opera entro i confini delle leggi, dei regolamenti e degli standard etici. Noi proteggiamo gli interessi e la reputazione di Roche fornendo consulenza legale creativa e focalizzata sul business, redazione e revisione dei contratti, gestione del contenzioso e affrontare i problemi di conformità.

Collaboriamo anche con altri dipartimenti per sviluppare e implementare politiche e procedure che promuovano comportamenti etici, sicurezza dei pazienti, privacy dei dati e trasparenza, massimizzando al contempo il valore della nostra proprietà intellettuale. Si gioca un ruolo vitale nel mantenere l'integrità e la libertà dell'azienda di operare.

L'opportunità:

In quanto analista del contratto nella funzione legale, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'accelerazione della ricerca clinica di Roche e del processo di sviluppo dei prodotti in tutto il Canada.

Le tue responsabilità principali includono:

• Redazione e negoziazione di accordi di sperimentazione clinica (CTA), accordi di riservatezza e relativi contratti di sviluppo dei prodotti.

• Collaborare e collaborare con gli stakeholder esterni, tra cui importanti ospedali accademici, siti di ricerca clinica e importanti università di ricerca in Canada.

• Garantire la mitigazione del rischio e la conformità allineando i termini di accordo con le politiche interne di Roche, le normative sanitarie canadesi, le leggi sulla privacy dei dati e gli standard etici.

• Gestire il ciclo di vita del contratto dall'assunzione iniziale e dalla redazione attraverso redlines, negoziazione, approvazione e esecuzione finale.

• Fornire supporto legale alle operazioni cliniche interne e ai team di gestione degli studi per risolvere efficacemente i colli di bottiglia legati al contratto.

• Assistere il dipartimento legale con progetti ad-hoc, tra cui la manutenzione e l'ottimizzazione di modelli di contratto, playbook e documenti di guida interni.

Chi sei?

• Lei ha una formazione formale di Law Clerk (ad esempio, Law Clerk/ diploma o istruzione legale equivalente/certificazione).

• Possede 3+ anni di esperienza e demontare un forte interesse fondamentale per la redazione e la negoziazione di contratti all'interno del paesaggio legale canadese.

• Sei auto-motivato e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestire più file contract contemporaneamente con rigorosa attenzione ai dettagli.

• Possiedi eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e interpersonali, con la capacità di colmare le lacune tra requisiti legali e obiettivi di ricerca clinica.

• Hai una mentalità collaborativa in grado di costruire relazioni forti con partner aziendali interni e rappresentanti istituzionali esterni.

• Completate la nostra cultura e i valori fondamentali che guidano il nostro comportamento quotidiano e le nostre decisioni: Integrità, Coraggio e Passione.

Preferito:

• Avete una prima esperienza nella negoziazione di accordi clinici di prova o di lavoro all'interno del settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico, o più ampio settore sanitario/ricerca.

• Lei dimostra familiarità con le disposizioni di proprietà intellettuale, le clausole di responsabilità / indennizzo, e le considerazioni sulla privacy dei dati sanitari canadesi.

Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria di Mississauga è 89,256.00 e 117,148,50 del ra di assunzione

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Die Gelegenheit:

Als Vertragsanalyst, der über die Legal-Funktion berichtet, werden Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschungs- und Produktentwicklungspipeline von Roche in ganz Kanada spielen.

• Ausarbeitung und Verhandlung von Vereinbarungen über klinische Studien (CTAs), Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarungen und damit zusammenhängende Produktentwicklungsverträge.

• Partnerschaft und Zusammenarbeit mit externen Interessengruppen, darunter große akademische Krankenhäuser, klinische Forschungsstandorte und prominente Forschungsuniversitäten in ganz Kanada.

• Gewährleistung von Risikominderung und Compliance durch Angleichung der Vertragsbedingungen an die internen Richtlinien von Roche, die kanadischen Gesundheitsvorschriften, Datenschutzgesetze und ethische Standards.

• Verwaltung des Vertragslebenszyklus von der anfänglichen Aufnahme und Ausarbeitung durch Redlines, Verhandlungen, Genehmigung und endgültige Ausführung.

• Bereitstellung rechtlicher Unterstützung für interne klinische Operationen und Studienmanagementteams, um vertragsbedingte Engpässe effizient zu lösen.

• Unterstützung der Rechtsabteilung bei Ad-hoc-Projekten, einschließlich der Pflege und Optimierung von Vertragsvorlagen, Playbooks und internen Leitlinien.

Wer Du bist:

• Sie verfügen über mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung und demontieren ein starkes grundlegendes Interesse an der Ausarbeitung und Verhandlung von Verträgen innerhalb der kanadischen Rechtslandschaft.

• Sie sind selbstmotiviert und in der Lage, unabhängig zu arbeiten und mehrere Vertragsdateien gleichzeitig mit strikter Liebe zum Detail zu verwalten.

• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Lücken zwischen gesetzlichen Anforderungen und klinischen Forschungszielen zu schließen.

• Sie haben eine kollaborative Denkweise, die in der Lage ist, starke Beziehungen zu internen Geschäftspartnern und externen institutionellen Vertretern aufzubauen.

• Sie ergänzen unsere Kultur und die Grundwerte, die unser tägliches Verhalten und unsere Entscheidungen leiten: Integrität, Mut und Leidenschaft.

Bevorzugt:

• Sie haben bereits Erfahrung in der Verhandlung von Vereinbarungen für klinische Studien oder in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder breiteren Gesundheits- / Forschungsbranche.

• Sie zeigen Vertrautheit mit Bestimmungen über geistiges Eigentum, Haftungs-/Entschädigungsklauseln und kanadischen Datenschutzbedenken.

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Le service juridique et de conformité veille à ce que Roche fonctionne dans les limites des lois, des règlements et des normes éthiques. Nous protégeons les intérêts et la réputation de Roche en fournissant des conseils juridiques créatifs et axés sur l'entreprise, en rédigeant et en examinant les contrats, en gérant les litiges et en abordant les questions de conformité.

Nous collaborons également avec d'autres ministères pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des politiques et des procédures qui favorisent le comportement éthique des entreprises, la sécurité des patients, la confidentialité des données et la transparence, tout en maximisant la valeur de notre propriété intellectuelle. Nous jouons un rôle vital dans le maintien de l'intégrité et de la liberté de l'entreprise.

La possibilité :

En tant qu'analyste de contrats faisant rapport sur la fonction juridique, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'accélération du pipeline de recherche clinique et de développement de produits de Roche partout au Canada.

Vos principales responsabilités comprendront :

• La rédaction et la négociation d'accords d'essais cliniques, d'accords de confidentialité et de contrats de développement de produits connexes.

• Partenariat et collaboration avec des intervenants de l'extérieur, y compris les grands hôpitaux universitaires, les sites de recherche clinique et les grandes universités de recherche du Canada.

• Assurer l'atténuation des risques et la conformité en harmonisant les modalités de l'entente avec les politiques internes de Roches, les règlements canadiens sur les soins de santé, les lois sur la protection des données et les normes éthiques.

• Gérer le cycle de vie du contrat à partir de l'admission initiale et de la rédaction jusqu'aux lignes directrices, à la négociation, à l'approbation et à l'exécution finale.

• Fournir un soutien juridique aux opérations cliniques internes et aux équipes de gestion des études pour résoudre efficacement les goulets d'étranglement liés aux contrats.

• Aider le service juridique à réaliser des projets ponctuels, y compris la maintenance et l'optimisation des modèles de contrats, des livres de lecture et des documents d'orientation internes.

Qui vous êtes :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation officielle en droit (p. ex., clerc/diplôme ou formation/certification juridique équivalente).

• Vous possédez plus de 3 ans d'expérience et démontrez un fort intérêt fondamental pour la rédaction et la négociation de contrats dans le contexte juridique canadien.

• Vous êtes automotivé et capable de travailler de façon indépendante, gérant plusieurs dossiers contractuels simultanément avec une attention stricte aux détails.

• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication, en négociation et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de combler les écarts entre les exigences légales et les objectifs de recherche clinique.

• Vous avez un esprit de collaboration capable d'établir de solides relations avec des partenaires commerciaux internes et des représentants institutionnels externes.

• Vous complètez notre culture et les valeurs fondamentales qui guident notre comportement quotidien et nos décisions : intégrité, courage et passion.

Préféré:

• Vous avez une expérience antérieure dans la négociation d'accords d'essais cliniques ou dans le secteur pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou de la recherche.

• Vous démontrez que vous connaissez bien les dispositions relatives à la propriété intellectuelle, les clauses de responsabilité/indemnisation et les considérations relatives à la protection des données sur la santé au Canada.

Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste.

L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste en fonction de l'emplacement principal de Mississauga est de 89 256,00 et 117 148,50

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Impact

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment.
Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently.

Purpose
The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context.

Key Activities and Deliverables

• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.

• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.

• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.

• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.

• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.

• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

Job Skills Required

• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.

• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Qualifications and Experience Required

• 3-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.

• Demonstrated hands-on experie

• Assicurarsi che le soluzioni di sicurezza soddisfino i requisiti normativi e supportano le attività di audit e compliance.
• Identificare attivamente le lacune nei controlli di accesso e proporre miglioramenti con un self-driven, soluzione-oriented mindset.
• Collabora con partner interfunzionali tra cui team di rete, identità e cloud per offrire funzionalità di accesso sicure integrate.
• Mentori più membri del team junior e contribuisce allo sviluppo delle best practice di sicurezza Competenze di lavoro richieste
• Alta energia, auto-motivata, e capace di possedere lavoro end-to-end con direzione minima.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Indipendentemente conduce l'analisi di incidenti di sicurezza cibernetica moderatamente complessi e problemi tecnici, definendo chiaramente la portata del problema di sicurezza e l'analisi della causa principale di guida per violazioni di sicurezza o vulnerabilità
• Identificare una vasta gamma di stakeholder di sicurezza in tutte le aree funzionali e gestire efficacemente le relazioni per costruire affidamento attraverso una profonda comprensione aziendale e tecnica, agendo come consulente affidabile
• Forte attenzione al cliente con un servizio altamente reattivo consegna e supporto etico.
• Collaborativo e comunicativo — comodo lavoro in team distribuiti e interfunzionali.
• Dettaglio orientato con un impegno a qualità, documentazione e eccellenza operativa.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale inglese. Qualifiche e esperienza richiesti
• 3-7 anni di esperienza tecnica pratica in ingegneria della sicurezza, con un focus sulla sicurezza della rete e tecnologie di accesso sicuro.
• Mani-su esperie dimostrate

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Senior Security Engineer Auswirkungen Unser Secure Access-Team schützt die globale Belegschaft des Unternehmens durch die Bereitstellung und den Betrieb der Technologien, die einen sicheren, zuverlässigen und konformen Zugriff auf Unternehmensressourcen ermöglichen. Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Netzwerksicherheit, Identität und Cloud und unterstützen Benutzer und geschäftskritische Systeme in einem regulierten Industrieumfeld. Möchten Sie als Security Engineer, der sich auf sicheren Zugang und Netzwerksicherheit konzentriert, einen sinnvollen Einfluss haben? Gedeihen Sie in einer schnelllebigen, selbstgesteuerten Umgebung? Wenn ja, würden wir gerne von Ihnen hören! Was Sie tun werden Als Security Engineer im Secure Access-Team entwerfen, implementieren und betreiben Sie die Technologien, die den Fernzugriff, die Websicherheit und den Netzwerkschutz in unserem Unternehmen unterstützen. Sie werden ein praktischer Mitwirkender sein, der sowohl fundiertes technisches Fachwissen als auch die Energie mitbringt, um Verbesserungen unabhängig voneinander voranzutreiben. Zweck Das Secure Access-Team entwickelt, liefert und unterstützt die Lösungen, die verwendet werden, um einen sicheren Netzwerkzugang in der gesamten Unternehmensumgebung zu gewährleisten - On-Premises-, Cloud- und Hybrid-Infrastruktur. Das Team bietet praktische Engineering-, Konfigurationsmanagement- und Automatisierungsunterstützung, um die Zugriffskontrollen in einem regulierten Industriekontext robust, überprüfbar und skalierbar zu halten. • Erstellen und pflegen Sie Automatisierungspipelines, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und die Konsistenz in allen Sicherheitskonfigurationen zu verbessern.

• Sicherstellen, dass Sicherheitslösungen die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen und Audit- und Compliance-Aktivitäten unterstützen.
• Erkennen Sie proaktiv Lücken in den Zugangskontrollen und schlagen Sie Verbesserungen mit einer selbstgesteuerten, lösungsorientierten Denkweise vor.
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zusammen, einschließlich Netzwerk-, Identitäts- und Cloud-Teams, um integrierte sichere Zugriffsmöglichkeiten bereitzustellen.
• Mentoren mehr Junior-Teammitglieder und trägt zur Entwicklung von Best Practices für Sicherheit bei Erforderliche berufliche Fähigkeiten

• Starke Kundenorientierung mit einer sehr reaktionsschnellen Servicebereitstellung und Support-Ethik.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data Scientist Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse (AIDCG) - Pharma R&D

Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge artificial intelligence and data science to transform patient care? As a Data Scientist , you will play a pivotal role in leading, developing, and deploying innovative, data-driven solutions to solve complex business problems. You will balance hands-on technical execution with strategic content leadership, building state-of-the-art AI capabilities that directly accelerate healthcare innovation.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Description of the Area

The Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse function focuses on modernizing the creation and management of clinical data and regulatory submission assets (data and content). It develops and deploys platforms for structured content management, enabling the reuse of approved components across documents. This group also pioneers the use of agentic AI to assist in generating, reviewing, and assembling complex submission assets (data and content), aiming to improve quality and reduce authoring timelines.

The Opportunity

• End-to-End Solution Ownership: Lead, develop, and deploy data-driven solutions and predictive models from inception to deployment to tackle complex business challenges.

• Agentic AI Development: Build specialized AI agents and bespoke multi-agent workflows in a highly regulated GxP environment to support Analytical Data Scientists across the clinical data lifecycle.

• Independent Problem Solving: Identify analytical opportunities independently and solve complex data problems, ensuring model accuracy and validation with minimal supervision.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage directly with business units to understand their data requirements and translate analytical findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strategic Project Leadership: Drive medium-sized data science projects that directly influence key business decisions and align with broader organizational strategies.

• Data Modeling & Optimization: Work with large, complex datasets to build new predictive models from scratch and optimize existing algorithms for maximum performance.

• Technical Roadmap Guidance: Frequently contribute to the team’s technical roadmap, balancing hands-on AI/ML development with strategic technical leadership.

• Process Automation: Develop innovative tools, such as proactive coding debuggers that parse verbose logs and automatically propose code/configuration fixes for complex clinical programming.

Who you are

Sie werden die praktische technische Ausführung mit strategischer Content-Führung in Einklang bringen und modernste KI-Fähigkeiten aufbauen, die die Innovation im Gesundheitswesen direkt beschleunigen.

Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Beschreibung des Gebiets

• Solution de problèmes indépendante : Identifier les possibilités d'analyse indépendamment et résoudre les problèmes de données complexes, en assurant l'exactitude et la validation du modèle avec une supervision minimale.

• Orientation technique de la feuille de route : contribuer fréquemment à la feuille de route technique de l'équipe, en conciliant le développement pratique de l'IA/ML et le leadership technique stratégique.

• Automatisation des processus : Développez des outils novateurs, comme des débogueurs de codage proactifs qui analysent les journaux de verbes et proposent automatiquement des corrections de code/configuration pour une programmation clinique complexe.

Qui vous êtes

• Études et expérience : Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en sciences des données, informatique, statistique ou domaine quantitatif connexe, jumelé à un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en sciences des données, modélisation prédictive et déploiement de bout en bout.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Product Manager Manager, qPCR systems & Reagents

The Opportunity:

Drives the U.S. commercial growth, market adoption, and day-to-day product management of our core molecular portfolio—including the MagnaPure System, LightCycler Pro System, LightCycler 480 System, cobas z480 Analyzer , and TIB Molbiol LightMix Modular Assay Kits . This role serves as a key technical and strategic bridge between front-line field teams, clinical laboratory customers, and Global product roadmaps to advance our footprint in the Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) and RUO spaces.

Key Responsibilities:

6-Month Deliverables

• Portfolio SME Mastery: Develop deep technical and clinical fluency to become the internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the assigned instrumentation and assay portfolios.

• Installed Base & Market Audit: Map out the current U.S. installed base to evaluate system utilization trends and identify immediate conversion opportunities for LightMix assay menus.

• Field Stakeholder Discovery: Complete a listening tour with sales, technical support, and applications teams to document active customer pain points and system validation hurdles.

• Immediate Sales Enablement: Target immediate gaps in current marketing collateral and training tools, delivering quick-turn resources to help the sales team progress active pipeline opportunities.

12-Month Deliverables

• Field Technical Consultation : Travel into the field to engage directly with Lab Directors, PhDs, and laboratory scientists, leading peer-level technical discussions around assay development techniques and validation protocols.

• Technical Storytelling: Deliver high-impact technical presentations to prospective customers, translating complex molecular data and instrument specifications into value-driven stories that resonate with clinical decision-makers.

• Peer Network Building: Connect existing power users with prospective accounts to build an informal "knowledge-exchange" network where labs can share workflow optimization and LDT validation experiences.

• Competitive Workflow Analysis: Evaluate competitive open-channel extraction and PCR platforms to map out our portfolio's technical and operational advantages. Maintain or develop strong familiarity with key industry benchmark systems, including extraction platforms ( Thermo Fisher KingFisher, QIAGEN QIAsymphony ) and qPCR instruments ( Applied Biosystems 7500 / QuantStudio, Bio-Rad CFX Opus, and QIAGEN Rotor-Gene ).

• Scientific Asset Mapping: Partner with Medical Science Affairs (MSA) to organize customer validation protocols and peer-reviewed data into a practical reference library for the sales force

24-Month Deliverables

• Establish Diagnostic Center of Excellence (DCOE) Sites: Partner with high-volume accounts to establish reference laboratory models running standardized sample-to-answer workflows (MagnaPure extraction to LightCycler Pro/z480).

• Assay Menu Scalability: Standardize the validation pathways for TIB Molbiol LightMix® assays across major accounts, turning assay validation into a predictable, repeatable process.

• Sales/Field Support: Travel up to 25% of time in the field supporting the field teams and developing relationships with KOLs.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Product Manager, sistemi qPCR & Reagents

L'opportunità:

Guida la crescita commerciale degli Stati Uniti, l'adozione del mercato e la gestione quotidiana dei prodotti del nostro portafoglio molecolare centrale - tra cui il sistema MagnaPure, LightCycler Pro System, LightCycler 480 System, cobas z480 Analyzer , e TIB Molbiol LightMix Modular Assay Kits . Questo ruolo funge da ponte tecnico e strategico chiave tra team di campo di prima linea, clienti di laboratorio clinici e roadmap di prodotto globali per far avanzare la nostra impronta negli spazi del Laboratorio di Test sviluppato (LDT) e RUO.

Responsabilità chiave:

Consegnabili a 6 mesi

• Portfolio PMI Mastery: Sviluppare una profonda fluidità tecnica e clinica per diventare il Soggetto interno Matter Expert (SME) sui portafogli di strumentazione e di analisi assegnati.

• Installato Base & Market Audit: mappa la base installata negli Stati Uniti per valutare le tendenze di utilizzo del sistema e identificare le opportunità di conversione immediate per i menu di analisi LightMix.

• Field Stakeholder Discovery: Completa un tour di ascolto con le vendite, il supporto tecnico e i team di applicazioni per documentare i punti di dolore dei clienti attivi e gli ostacoli di validazione del sistema.

• Abilitazione immediata delle vendite: individuare le lacune immediate negli attuali strumenti di marketing collaterale e formazione, fornendo risorse rapide per aiutare il team di vendita a progredire opportunità di pipeline attive.

Consegnabili a 12 mesi

• Consultazione tecnica sul campo: viaggiare nel campo per interagire direttamente con i direttori di laboratorio, i dottori e gli scienziati di laboratorio, le principali discussioni tecniche di peer-level intorno a tecniche di sviluppo di saggi e protocolli di validazione.

• Storytelling tecnico: fornire presentazioni tecniche ad alto impatto ai potenziali clienti, tradurre dati molecolari complessi e specifiche degli strumenti in storie orientate al valore che risuonano con i decisori clinici.

• Peer Network Building: Collega gli utenti di potenza esistenti con i potenziali account per costruire una rete informale "knowledge-exchange" in cui i laboratori possono condividere esperienze di ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e di validazione LDT.

• Analisi dei flussi di lavoro competitivi: Valutare le piattaforme di estrazione open-channel e PCR competitive per mappare i vantaggi tecnici e operativi del nostro portafoglio. Mantenere o sviluppare una forte familiarità con i principali sistemi di riferimento del settore, tra cui piattaforme di estrazione ( Thermo Fisher KingFisher, QIAGEN QIAsymphony ) e strumenti qPCR ( Applied Biosystems 7500 / QuantStudio, Bio-Rad CFX Opus, e QIAGEN Rotor-Gene ).

• Mappatura del patrimonio scientifico: Partner con Medical Science Affairs (MSA) per organizzare i protocolli di convalida del cliente e i dati peer-reviewed in una pratica libreria di riferimento per la forza di vendita

Consegnabili 24 mesi

• Istituisci il Centro Diagnostico di Eccellenza (DCOE) Siti: Partner con account ad alto volume per stabilire modelli di laboratorio di riferimento che eseguono flussi di lavoro standardizzati campione-risposta (estrazione di MagnaPure a LightCycler Pro/z480).

• Global Pipeline Advocacy: Agite come principale sostenitore tecnico per i requisiti di laboratorio degli Stati Uniti all'interno del Global Life Cycle pipeline, influenzando direttamente le capacità future di software, hardware e open-channel.

• Scalabilità del menu di analisi: standardizzare i percorsi di validazione per test TIB Molbiol LightMix® attraverso i principali account, trasformando la validazione del test in un processo prevedibile e ripetibile.

• Supporto Vendite/Field: Viaggia fino al 25% di tempo nel campo supportando le squadre di campo e sviluppando relazioni con KOL.

• Posizione competitiva: Mantenere un mercato profondo

• Activement immédiat des ventes : Cibler les lacunes immédiates dans les garanties de marketing et les outils de formation actuels, en fournissant des ressources rapides pour aider l'équipe de vente à faire progresser les possibilités de pipeline actif.

Produits livrables 12 mois

• Consultation technique sur le terrain : Voyagez sur le terrain pour collaborer directement avec les directeurs de laboratoire, les docteurs et les scientifiques de laboratoire, menant des discussions techniques au niveau des pairs sur les techniques de développement des essais et les protocoles de validation.

• Témoignage technique : Présentez des présentations techniques à fort impact aux clients potentiels, traduisant des données moléculaires complexes et des spécifications d'instruments en histoires axées sur la valeur qui résonnent avec les décideurs cliniques.

• Création d'un réseau de pairs : Connectez les utilisateurs d'énergie existants à des comptes potentiels pour créer un réseau informel d'échange de connaissances où les laboratoires peuvent partager l'optimisation des flux de travail et les expériences de validation de LDT.

• Analyse compétitive des flux de travail : évaluer les plateformes compétitives d'extraction à canaux ouverts et de PCR pour définir les avantages techniques et opérationnels de notre portefeuille. Maintenir ou développer une bonne connaissance des principaux systèmes de référence de l'industrie, y compris les plates-formes d'extraction ( Thermo Fisher KingFisher, QIAGEN QIAsymphony ) et les instruments qPCR ( Applied Biosystems 7500 / QuantStudio, Bio-Rad CFX Opus et QIAGEN Rotor-Gene ).

• Scientific Asset Mapping: Partner with Medical Science Affairs (MSA) pour organiser les protocoles de validation des clients et les données évaluées par les pairs dans une bibliothèque de référence pratique pour la force commerciale

Produits livrables 24 mois

• Global Pipeline Advocacy: Act en tant que principal défenseur technique des exigences des laboratoires américains dans le pipeline du cycle de vie mondial, influe directement sur les capacités futures des logiciels, du matériel et des canaux ouverts.

• Assay Menu Scalability: Normaliser les voies de validation des tests TIB Molbiol LightMix® sur les comptes principaux, transformer la validation des tests en un processus prévisible et répétable.

• Ventes/appui sur le terrain : Voyages jusqu'à 25 % du temps sur le terrain pour appuyer les équipes sur le terrain et développer des relations avec les KOL.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
The Head of Site Operations, Hospitality & Real Estate is responsible for the strategic management of the site's non-technical infrastructure and "Soft Services." This role oversees Real Estate management, GMP Cleaning Services, Canteen/Catering, Waste Management, and general site services. The position ensures a high-quality, compliant, and sustainable working environment for all employees while managing a significant number of outsourced service partners (100+ external staff). This role is critical in maintaining the site's hygiene standards (GMP requirement) and driving sustainability goals through effective waste management.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:

• Real Estate & Space Management: Manage site layout and space utilization; plan and execute office renovation or reorganization projects. Maintain lease agreements and ensure compliance with real estate regulations.

• GMP Service & Hygiene Management: Oversee Plant Service Cleaning to ensure production and lab areas meet strict cleanliness classifications (ISO/GMP standards). Manage GMP garment services and Pest Control programs.

• Employee Services (Hospitality): Manage the Canteen and Catering services, ensuring food safety, quality, and variety for employees. Oversee other site amenities such as shuttle buses, green maintenance, and reception services.

• Waste Management & Environmental Strategy: Manage the collection, storage, and disposal of all site waste in compliance with local laws. Lead initiatives such as zero-waste-to-landfill to reduce the site's environmental footprint.

• Vendor Partnership & Contract Management: Act as the primary contract owner for large Integrated Facility Management (IFM) providers. Foster a "One Team" culture aligned with Roche values and safety standards.

• Financial Scope & Budgeting: Manage a significant OPEX budget for outsourced services and utilities. Continuously optimize service contracts to ensure value for money without compromising quality.

• EHS Support: Collaborate with the SHE team to ensure all service providers adhere to safety protocols and site-specific safety regulations.

• Digitalization & Innovation: Implement digital tools for facility booking, service requests, and visitor management to drive operational efficiency.

Qualification & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Facility Management, or related field.

• Requirements of China Medical Device GMP article 8 and IVD section 2.1.1.

• 8+ years of experience in Facility Management or Site Operations, preferably in a manufacturing (GMP) environment. Proven experience in managing large integrated facility management (IFM) contracts.

• Specialist knowledge of GMP cleaning requirements and environmental waste regulations. Strong negotiation and SLA definition skills. Fluency in English and Mandarin (written and spoken).

Leadership Competencies:
"Leadership competencies at proficient level, in line with corporate framework."

Remarks:

• SHE Responsibility please refer to RDSZ SHE handbook

A healthier future drives us to innovate. • Partenariato e gestione dei contratti: agire come titolare del contratto primario per i grandi fornitori di gestione integrata delle strutture (IFM). Promuovere una cultura "One Team" allineata ai valori Roche e agli standard di sicurezza.

• Financial Scope & Budgeting: Gestisci un bilancio OPEX significativo per i servizi e le utenze outsourced. Ottimizzare costantemente i contratti di servizio per garantire il valore del denaro senza compromettere la qualità.

• Supporto EHS: Collabora con il team SHE per garantire che tutti i fornitori di servizi aderiscano ai protocolli di sicurezza e alle normative di sicurezza specifiche sul sito.

• Digitalizzazione e innovazione: implementare strumenti digitali per la prenotazione di strutture, richieste di servizi e gestione dei visitatori per guidare l'efficienza operativa.

Qualificazione e esperienza:

• Corso di laurea in Business Administration, gestione dell'ospitalità, gestione della struttura, o relativo campo.

• Requisiti di China Medical Device GMP articolo 8 e IVD sezione 2.1.1.

• 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione delle strutture o nelle operazioni del sito, preferibilmente in un ambiente di produzione (GMP). Esperienza comprovata nella gestione di grandi contratti integrati di gestione delle strutture (IFM).

• Conoscenza specialistica dei requisiti di pulizia GMP e delle normative sui rifiuti ambientali. Forte capacità di negoziazione e definizione SLA. Fluenza in inglese e mandarino (scritta e parlata).

Competenze di leadership:
"Leadership competenze a livello competente, in linea con il quadro aziendale."

Osservazioni:

• SHE Responsabilità si prega di fare riferimento al manuale RDSZ SHE

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Arbeitsübersicht:
Der Head of Site Operations, Hospitality & Real Estate ist verantwortlich für das strategische Management der nichttechnischen Infrastruktur und "Soft Services". Diese Rolle beaufsichtigt Real Estate Management, GMP Cleaning Services, Canteen / Catering, Waste Management und allgemeine Site Services. Die Position gewährleistet ein qualitativ hochwertiges, konformes und nachhaltiges Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter und verwaltet gleichzeitig eine erhebliche Anzahl von ausgelagerten Servicepartnern (100 externe Mitarbeiter). Diese Rolle ist entscheidend für die Aufrechterhaltung der Hygienestandards (GMP-Anforderungen) des Standorts und die Erreichung der Nachhaltigkeitsziele durch eine effektive Abfallwirtschaft.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• GMP Service & Hygiene Management: Beaufsichtigen Sie die Werksreinigung, um sicherzustellen, dass Produktions- und Laborbereiche strenge Reinheitsklassen erfüllen (ISO / GMP-Standards). Verwalten Sie GMP-Bekleidungsdienste und Schädlingsbekämpfungsprogramme.

• Vendor Partnership & Contract Management: Handeln Sie als Hauptauftragsinhaber für große Integrated Facility Management (IFM) -Anbieter. Pflegen Sie eine "One Team" -Kultur, die auf Roche-Werte und Sicherheitsstandards ausgerichtet ist.

• EHS-Support: Arbeiten Sie mit dem SHE-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Dienstleister die Sicherheitsprotokolle und standortspezifischen Sicherheitsvorschriften einhalten.

• Digitalisierung & Innovation: Implementieren Sie digitale Tools für die Buchung von Einrichtungen, Serviceanfragen und das Besuchermanagement, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu steigern.

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Facility Management oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Anforderungen von China Medical Device GMP Artikel 8 und IVD Abschnitt 2.1.1.

• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung im Facility Management oder Site Operations, vorzugsweise in einer Fertigungsumgebung (GMP). Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von großen integrierten Facility Management (IFM) Verträgen.

• Spezialisiertes Wissen über GMP-Reinigungsanforderungen und Umweltabfallvorschriften. Starke Verhandlungs- und SLA-Definitionsfähigkeiten. fließend in Englisch und Mandarin (geschrieben und gesprochen).

La position
Résumé de l'emploi :
Le responsable des opérations, de l'accueil et de l'immobilier est responsable de la gestion stratégique de l'infrastructure non technique du site et des « Services logiciels ». Ce rôle supervise la gestion de l'immobilier, les services de nettoyage des BPF, la cantine et le classement, la gestion des déchets et les services généraux du site. Le poste assure un environnement de travail de haute qualité, conforme et durable pour tous les employés tout en gérant un nombre important de partenaires de services externalisés (100 employés externes). Ce rôle est essentiel pour maintenir les normes d'hygiène du site (exigence des BPF) et pour atteindre les objectifs de durabilité grâce à une gestion efficace des déchets.

• Partenariat avec les fournisseurs et gestion des contrats : agir en tant que principal propriétaire du contrat pour les grands fournisseurs de gestion intégrée des installations (GIF). Favoriser une culture « Une équipe » alignée sur les valeurs et les normes de sécurité de Roche.

• Portée financière et budgétisation : gérer un budget important de l'OPEX pour les services et les services publics externalisés. Optimiser continuellement les contrats de service pour garantir un bon rapport qualité-prix sans compromettre la qualité.

• Soutien EHS : Collaborer avec l'équipe de la SHE pour s'assurer que tous les fournisseurs de services respectent les protocoles de sécurité et les règlements de sécurité propres au site.

• Digitalisation et innovation : Mettre en place des outils numériques pour la réservation d'installations, les demandes de services et la gestion des visiteurs afin de stimuler l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Qualification et expérience :

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion de l'accueil, gestion des installations ou domaine connexe.

• Exigences de l'article 8 et de la section 2.1.1 des BPF des matériels médicaux chinois.

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion d'installations ou en exploitation de sites, de préférence dans un environnement manufacturier (BPF). Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des grands contrats de gestion intégrée des installations.

• Connaissance spécialisée des exigences de nettoyage des BPF et des règlements sur les déchets environnementaux. Forte capacité de négociation et de définition de l'ALS. Connaissance de l'anglais et du mandarin (écrit et parlé).

Compiti e responsabilità principali

• Funzionamento & Manutenzione Utilità: Gestire il ciclo di vita E2E delle utilità del sito (Acqua Verificata, WFI, HVAC, aria compressa, energia elettrica) assicurando >99% uptime per i sistemi critici.

• Facility Management & Infrastructure: supervisionare la manutenzione di tutti gli edifici degli impianti e delle infrastrutture tecniche per garantire la sicurezza a lungo termine, la conformità e la longevità degli asset.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
The Head of Site Engineering & Technical Support is responsible for the strategic planning, operation, and maintenance of the site's "Hard Services" and technical infrastructure. This includes Plant Engineering (Utilities: HVAC, Water, Gas, Electricity), Facility Maintenance, and Technical Support. The role ensures the continuous, safe, and reliable supply of critical utilities to manufacturing operations, strictly adhering to GMP and SHE standards, acting as the technical authority for the site's physical assets and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities

• Utility Operation & Maintenance: Manage the E2E lifecycle of site utilities (Purified Water, WFI, HVAC, Compressed Air, Electrical Power) ensuring >99% uptime for critical systems.

• Facility Management & Infrastructure: Oversee the maintenance of all plant buildings and technical infrastructure to ensure long-term safety, compliance, and asset longevity.

• Technical Authority & Lifecycle Management: Act as the final technical sign-off for engineering changes and asset lifecycle plans; lead the long-term CAPEX roadmap for infrastructure upgrades.

• Financial Accountability: Manage the annual operating budget (OPEX) for Utilities and Maintenance and oversee significant CAPEX budgets for site infrastructure.

• SHE & Compliance: Ensure all technical services comply with Global GMP, local legal regulations (Pressure Vessels, High Voltage etc.), and Roche SHE standards.

• Leadership & People Management: Foster a culture of Safety and Reliability; lead the technical response team during site emergencies and ensure technical competency training for the team.

• Innovation & Sustainability: Lead the digitalization of maintenance (e-Maintenance, IoT monitoring) and champion sustainable energy projects to reduce the site's carbon footprint.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal Manufacturing, QA, and SHE heads while managing relationships with external utility authorities, OEM suppliers, and contractors.

Education
Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or HVAC Engineering
Bachelor’s Degree
