jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche / GenMark Diagnostics’ mission is to revolutionize patient care by providing high-value, simple-to-perform, and clinically relevant multiplex molecular diagnostics, specifically targeting infectious disease testing. We aim to improve patient outcomes, enhance laboratory efficiency, and reduce total cost-of-care through rapid, sample-to-answer solutions.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics is seeking a Lead Software Development in Test (SDET) to join our team. In this role, the Lead SDET will architect the next generation of our automated verification strategy. This is a high-impact "Player-Coach" role where you will balance hands-on framework development with the leadership of a dedicated team of Software Quality Engineers.

You will lead the technical evolution of our testing capabilities for FDA-regulated diagnostic instruments. Your mandate is to champion a culture of automation—architecting robust C#/.NET test harnesses, integrating them into modern CI/CD pipelines, and mentoring the team to ensure high-velocity, high-quality releases.

The Opportunity

Automation Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Technical Debt Remediation: Act as the specialist in reducing our manual testing burden. Identify and automate "High-Value/Low-Effort" manual tests first to rapidly buy the team breathing room and accelerate feedback cycles.

• Framework Design: Architect and build scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks (using C#, Playwright, Appium, or similar) to support both UI and backend logic, utilizing advanced object-oriented programming.

• Hardware & Integration Testing: Design test strategies that account for hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) testing and software interactions with physical diagnostic instruments and sensors.

• Continuous Integration & Security: Partner with the DevOps/Architecture team to integrate automated suites into Azure DevOps pipelines. Lead the automation of vulnerability scanning and static/dynamic analysis (SAST/DAST) to align with modern FDA cybersecurity guidelines.

• Tooling Selection & Modernization: Evaluate, select, and continuously modernize the right tools for performance profiling, load testing, and security scanning to ensure comprehensive coverage while proactively deprecating legacy testing dependencies.

Team Management & Mentorship

• Technical Mentorship: Act as the technical anchor for the SW Quality team, lead and mentor Quality Engineers on coding best practices, automation scripting, and source control management.

• Team Growth: Foster a collaborative environment where manual testing expertise is complemented by growing technical skills. Lead code reviews for test scripts to ensure they meet production-quality standards.

• Resource Management: Balance hands-on coding (the "Player") with team leadership (the "Coach"). Align team activities with the software roadmap, ensuring that verification activities happen in parallel with development rather than lagging behind.

Regulatory & Process Compliance

• Tool Validation: Collaborate closely with Regulatory Affairs (RA) to formally validate automated testing tools, ensuring they meet strict regulatory compliance standards.

• V&V Modernization: Enhance Master V&V Plans to support automated evidence generation, ensuring strict compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485 standards.

• Metrics Driven: Define and track key quality metrics (e.g., Defect Density, Automation Coverage) to drive continuous improvement and transparency.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
La missione di Roche / GenMark Diagnostics è quella di rivoluzionare la cura del paziente fornendo diagnosi molecolari multiplex ad alto valore, semplice-performale e clinicamente rilevanti, specificamente mirando a test di malattia infettiva. Il nostro obiettivo è migliorare i risultati dei pazienti, migliorare l'efficienza del laboratorio e ridurre il costo totale della cura attraverso soluzioni rapide, campione a risposta.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics sta cercando un Lead Software Development in Test (SDET) per unirsi al nostro team. In questo ruolo, il Lead SDET svilupperà la prossima generazione della nostra strategia di verifica automatizzata. Questo è un ruolo "Player-Coach" ad alto impatto in cui si bilancia lo sviluppo del framework hands-on con la leadership di un team dedicato di ingegneri di qualità del software.

Potrai condurre l'evoluzione tecnica delle nostre capacità di test per gli strumenti diagnostici regolamentati dalla FDA. Il vostro mandato è quello di sostenere una cultura dell'automazione: l'archiviazione di robuste cinture di test C#/.NET, l'integrazione in moderne tubazioni CI/CD, e la mentoring del team per garantire release ad alta velocità e di alta qualità.

L'opportunità

Automation Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Remediazione del debito tecnico: agire come specialista nella riduzione del nostro peso di prova manuale. Identificare e automatizzare "High-Value/Low-Effort" test manuali prima di acquistare rapidamente la sala respirazione del team e accelerare i cicli di feedback.

• Framework Design: Architetto e costruisci framework di automazione di test scalabili e manutenbili (utilizzando C#, Playwright, Appium, o simili) per supportare sia la logica UI che il backend, utilizzando la programmazione avanzata orientata agli oggetti.

• Hardware & Integration Testing: Strategie di test di progettazione che rappresentano i test hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) e le interazioni software con strumenti e sensori diagnostici fisici.

• Integrazione continua e sicurezza: Partner con il team DevOps/Architecture per integrare suite automatizzate nelle pipeline Azure DevOps. Condurre l'automazione della scansione delle vulnerabilità e l'analisi statica/dinamica (SAST/DAST) per allineare con le moderne linee guida per la sicurezza informatica della FDA.

• Selezione e modernizzazione degli strumenti: Valutare, selezionare e modernizzare continuamente gli strumenti giusti per la profilazione delle prestazioni, il test di carico e la scansione della sicurezza per garantire una copertura completa mentre depreca le dipendenze di test legacy proattivamente.

Team Management & Mentorship

• Mentorship Tecnica: Agite come ancora tecnica per il team di SW Quality, lead and mentor Quality Engineers sulla codifica delle migliori pratiche, scrittura di automazione e gestione del controllo delle sorgenti.

• Crescita del team: Promuovere un ambiente collaborativo in cui le competenze di collaudo manuale sono integrate da crescenti competenze tecniche. Riviste di codice di piombo per gli script di prova per garantire che soddisfino gli standard di qualità della produzione.

• Gestione delle risorse: Codifica delle mani bilanciate (il "Player") con la leadership del team (il "Coach"). Allineare le attività del team con la roadmap del software, assicurando che le attività di verifica avvengano in parallelo con lo sviluppo piuttosto che in ritardo.

Regolazione e conformità di processo

• Validazione degli strumenti: Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli Affari Regolatori (RA) per convalidare formalmente gli strumenti di test automatizzati, assicurando che soddisfino rigidi gli standard di conformità normativi.

• V&V Modernizzazione: Enhance Master V&V Piani per supportare la generazione di prove automatizzate, garantendo una stretta conformità con gli standard FDA 21 CFR Part 820 e ISO 13485.

• Metrics Driven: Definire e tracciare metriche di qualità chiave (ad esempio, Densità difetti, Copertura di automazione) per guidare il miglioramento continuo e la trasparenza.

Die Position
Die Mission von Roche / GenMark Diagnostics ist es, die Patientenversorgung durch die Bereitstellung hochwertiger, einfach durchzuführender und klinisch relevanter Multiplex-Molekulardiagnostik zu revolutionieren, die speziell auf Infektionskrankheiten ausgerichtet ist. Unser Ziel ist es, die Patientenergebnisse zu verbessern, die Laboreffizienz zu verbessern und die Gesamtkosten der Versorgung durch schnelle Lösungen von Proben zu Antworten zu senken.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics sucht eine Lead Software Development in Test (SDET) für unser Team. In dieser Rolle wird das Lead SDET die nächste Generation unserer automatisierten Verifikationsstrategie gestalten. Dies ist eine einflussreiche "Player-Coach" -Rolle, bei der Sie die praktische Framework-Entwicklung mit der Führung eines engagierten Teams von Software Quality Engineers in Einklang bringen.

Sie werden die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer Testfähigkeiten für FDA-regulierte Diagnoseinstrumente leiten. Ihr Auftrag ist es, sich für eine Kultur der Automatisierung einzusetzen – robuste C#/.NET-Testsysteme zu architekturieren, sie in moderne CI/CD-Pipelines zu integrieren und das Team zu betreuen, um hochgeschwindigkeitsfähige und qualitativ hochwertige Releases zu gewährleisten.

Die Chance

Automatisierungsarchitektur und technische Führung

• Technische Schuldensanierung: Handeln Sie als Spezialist bei der Verringerung unserer manuellen Testlast. Identifizieren und automatisieren Sie manuelle Tests mit "High-Value / Low-Effort", um dem Team schnell Raum zum Atmen zu geben und Feedback-Zyklen zu beschleunigen.

• Framework-Design: Erstellen und erstellen Sie skalierbare, wartbare Test-Automatisierungs-Frameworks (unter Verwendung von C#, Playwright, Appium oder ähnlichem), um sowohl die Benutzeroberfläche als auch die Backend-Logik unter Verwendung fortschrittlicher objektorientierter Programmierung zu unterstützen.

• Hardware & Integration Testing: Entwerfen Sie Teststrategien, die Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL)-Tests und Software-Interaktionen mit physikalischen Diagnoseinstrumenten und Sensoren berücksichtigen.

• Continuous Integration & Security: Partnerschaft mit dem DevOps/Architecture-Team zur Integration automatisierter Suiten in Azure DevOps-Pipelines. Führen Sie die Automatisierung von Schwachstellenscanning und statischer / dynamischer Analyse (SAST / DAST) an, um sich an die modernen Cybersicherheitsrichtlinien der FDA anzupassen.

• Ressourcenmanagement: Balance-Hands-on-Codierung (der "Spieler") mit der Teamführung (der "Coach"). Richten Sie die Teamaktivitäten an der Software-Roadmap aus und stellen Sie sicher, dass Verifizierungsaktivitäten parallel zur Entwicklung stattfinden und nicht hinterherhinken.

Regulatory & Process Compliance

• Tool-Validierung: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Regulatory Affairs (RA) zusammen, um automatisierte Test-Tools formell zu validieren und sicherzustellen, dass sie strenge regulatorische Compliance-Standards erfüllen.

La position
La mission de Roche / GenMark Diagnostics est de révolutionner les soins aux patients en fournissant des diagnostics moléculaires multiplex de grande valeur, simples à réaliser et cliniquement pertinents, ciblant spécifiquement les tests de maladies infectieuses. L'opportunité

Architecture d'automatisation et leadership technique

jobs.title: DSX eSub/COE Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity

The DSX eSub/COE Specialist is a key individual contributor within the Statistical Programming Enablement team, responsible for developing strategy and delivering global electronic regulatory submissions across multiple studies or programs within the Analytical Data Science function. As the primary owner of electronic submission programming workflows and tools, this role ensures compliance with evolving regulatory requirements while driving consistency, efficiency, and inspection readiness.
This role is expected to remain up-to-date on new Health Authority requirements that impact data submission expectations and / or advance future submissions process. This role will serve as a subject matter expert within the Submission, Fillings and FAIR Center of Excellence, who partners cross-functionally with Regulatory, Biostatistics, and Clinical teams to align submission strategies, mentor supporting programmers, and advance scalable, high-quality programming solutions that enable successful global submissions.

• You support the development of tools and processes for electronic regulatory submission programming, including the development, validation, and delivery of SDTM and ADaM datasets, as well as submission-ready outputs (define.xml, annotated CRFs, reviewer’s guides, and other deliverables) to meet global regulatory requirements

• You assist programming efforts for studies or programs, ensuring completeness, consistency, and traceability of submission packages across multiple molecules or indications

• You interpret and implement evolving regulatory guidelines (e.g., FDA, PMDA, EMA) to ensure electronic submission packages are compliant, scientifically sound, and inspection-ready

• You optimize submission programming workflows, including automation, reuse of components, and quality control approaches, to drive operational efficiency and inspection readiness

• You collaborate cross-functionally with regulatory, clinical, biostatistics, data management, and data standards teams to align timelines, standards, and submission strategy across functions

• You contribute to innovation and capability building in submission programming, including development of tools, templates, and training to enhance scalability and robustness of eSubmission processes

• You proactively identify risks and escalate challenges, contributing to resolution strategies and ensuring timely submission deliverables

Who you are:

• Yo

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Questo ruolo è in Analytical Data Science, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. I team di PDD Analytical Data Science sono mobilitati in tutto il portafoglio per generare informazioni basate sui dati, identificare le opportunità di scala e implementare soluzioni efficaci.

PDD Analytical Data Science è riconosciuto come un hub leader per i migliori talenti del settore, operante come una forza lavoro agile per fornire impegni normativi in tutto il portafoglio. Identifichiamo, influenziamo e adottiamo soluzioni digitali e di automazione leader del settore, sviluppiamo approcci analitici per sostenere le analisi esplorative e allineiamo le pratiche di programmazione statistica sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio dello sviluppo clinico.

L'opportunità

DSX eSub/COE Specialist è un contributore individuale chiave all'interno del team di Statistica Programming Enablement, responsabile dello sviluppo della strategia e della fornitura di sottomissioni normative elettroniche globali in più studi o programmi all'interno della funzione Analytical Data Science. Come principale proprietario dei flussi di lavoro e degli strumenti di programmazione di presentazione elettronica, questo ruolo garantisce il rispetto dei requisiti normativi in evoluzione mentre guida la coerenza, l'efficienza e la disponibilità di ispezione.
Questo ruolo dovrebbe rimanere aggiornato sui nuovi requisiti dell'Autorità per la Salute che influenzano le aspettative di presentazione dei dati e / o anticipano il processo di presentazione futura. Questo ruolo servirà da esperto di materia nell'ambito della Sottomissione, Fillings e FAIR Center of Excellence, che collabora trasversalmente con i team normativi, biostatistici e clinici per allineare le strategie di presentazione, i programmatori di supporto del mentore, e le soluzioni di programmazione scalabili e di alta qualità che consentono le presentazioni globali di successo.

• Supporti lo sviluppo di strumenti e processi per la programmazione elettronica di presentazione delle normative, tra cui lo sviluppo, la validazione e la consegna di dataset SDTM e ADaM, così come le uscite di presentazione-ready (define.xml, CRFs annotati, guide del recensore e altri deliverables) per soddisfare i requisiti normativi globali

• Assisti gli sforzi di programmazione per studi o programmi, garantendo completezza, coerenza e tracciabilità dei pacchetti di presentazione attraverso molecole o indicazioni multiple

• Lei interpreta e implementa le linee guida normative in evoluzione (ad esempio, FDA, PMDA, EMA) per garantire che i pacchetti di presentazione elettronica siano conformi, scientificamente sani e pronti all'ispezione

• Ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di programmazione di presentazione, tra cui l'automazione, il riutilizzo dei componenti e gli approcci di controllo della qualità, per guidare l'efficienza operativa e la disponibilità di ispezione

• Collabori trasversalmente con i team normativi, clinici, biostatistici, gestione dei dati e standard di dati per allineare le linee temporali, gli standard e la strategia di presentazione attraverso le funzioni

• Contribuisci all'innovazione e alla creazione di capacità nella programmazione di presentazione, incluso lo sviluppo di strumenti, modelli e formazione per migliorare la scalabilità e la robustezza dei processi di eSubmission

• Identificare proattivamente i rischi e intensificare le sfide, contribuendo alle strategie di risoluzione e assicurando tempestiva presentazione dei risultati

Chi sei:

• Ehi.

En tant que principal propriétaire des flux de travail et des outils de programmation des présentations électroniques, ce rôle assure la conformité aux exigences réglementaires en évolution tout en favorisant l'uniformité, l'efficacité et la préparation aux inspections.
On s'attend à ce que ce rôle demeure à jour sur les nouvelles exigences des autorités sanitaires qui influent sur les attentes en matière de présentation de données et/ou sur le processus de présentation future. Ce rôle servira d'expert en la matière au sein du Centre d'excellence de la présentation, du remplissage et de la FAIR, qui s'associera fonctionnellement aux équipes de réglementation, de biostatistique et de clinique pour harmoniser les stratégies de présentation, encadrer les programmeurs et faire progresser les solutions de programmation évolutives et de haute qualité qui permettent de réussir les présentations mondiales.

• Vous soutenez le développement d'outils et de processus pour la programmation de présentations réglementaires électroniques, y compris l'élaboration, la validation et la livraison des ensembles de données SDTM et ADaM, ainsi que des extrants prêts à soumettre (define.xml, CRF annotés, guides d'examinateurs et autres produits livrables) pour répondre aux exigences réglementaires mondiales

• Vous aidez les efforts de programmation pour les études ou les programmes, en assurant l'exhaustivité, l'uniformité et la traçabilité des paquets de soumission à travers plusieurs molécules ou indications

• Vous interprètez et appliquez des lignes directrices réglementaires en évolution (p. ex., FDA, PMDA, EMA) pour s'assurer que les dossiers de présentations électroniques sont conformes, scientifiquement valables et prêts à être inspectés.

• Vous optimisez les workflows de programmation de soumission, y compris l'automatisation, la réutilisation des composants et les approches de contrôle de la qualité, pour stimuler l'efficacité opérationnelle et la préparation à l'inspection

• Vous collaborez de façon interfonctionnelle avec des équipes de réglementation, clinique, biostatistique, de gestion des données et de normalisation des données afin d'harmoniser les délais, les normes et la stratégie de soumission entre les fonctions

• Vous contribuez à l'innovation et au renforcement des capacités dans la programmation des présentations, y compris l'élaboration d'outils, de modèles et de formation pour améliorer l'évolutivité et la robustesse des processus de soumission électronique

• Vous identifiez les risques de façon proactive et augmentez les défis, contribuant ainsi aux stratégies de résolution et assurant la soumission en temps opportun des produits livrables.

Qui vous êtes :

• Oui.

Un futuro più sano - è ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.

• Lo stipendio base (NZD 100.000–110.000 all'anno) e il pacchetto di benefici interessanti offerto

Stiamo cercando uno specialista del prodotto dedicato per unirsi al nostro team, supportando le funzioni pre- e post-vendita per offrire un'esperienza di servizio clienti premium. Le tue responsabilità principali includono formazione e formazione continua sul nostro portafoglio prodotti, strumenti di risoluzione dei problemi e prodotti, supervisionando l'installazione e la messa in servizio degli strumenti e fornendo la formazione del cliente sulle procedure dell'utente. Potrai anche gestire modifiche del produttore e problemi di servizio post-vendita, assicurando la soddisfazione del cliente in allineamento con le SOP e le politiche della nostra organizzazione.

Su cosa lavorerai:
In questo ruolo dinamico, fornirete un supporto tecnico eccezionale sia ai clienti interni che esterni, aggiungendo valore alle squadre assegnate da Roche Diagnostics. Questa posizione offre flessibilità attraverso Core Lab, Molecular e Export Markets, adattandosi alle esigenze aziendali e alla vostra area di competenza. Unisciti a noi per avere un impatto significativo offrendo una guida tecnica esperta e esperienze di cliente eccezionali.

Le responsabilità chiave includono ma non sono limitate a:

• Mantenere la competenza nel portafoglio Sistemi Analitici RD e garantire la formazione continua con gli aggiornamenti.

• Condurre cross-training per colleghi e completare la formazione obbligatoria in modo tempestivo.

• Controllare l'installazione tempestiva e la messa in servizio di sistemi analitici seguendo i protocolli stabiliti.

• Condurre una formazione completa dei clienti per migliorare le competenze e ridurre le future esigenze di supporto.

• Fornire assistenza post-vendita efficiente, risoluzione dei problemi, e l'adesione a SLA per i tempi di risposta.

• Mantenere la documentazione dei reclami per il sistema di qualità di Roche e garantire gli aggiornamenti tecnici / software tempestivi.

• Sviluppare e facilitare il coinvolgimento dei contenuti/eventi del Gruppo Utente per costruire la fiducia dei partecipanti e migliorare le relazioni con i clienti.

• Fornisci un input tecnico esperto durante i processi di vendita e le offerte, monitorando l'intelligenza del mercato e l'attività dei concorrenti.

• Assicurare la documentazione accurata e tempestiva, la gestione delle scorte e i record di clienti CRM aggiornati.

• Identificare le opportunità di business e sostenere le strategie di conto e contratto di servizio.

• Complimenti alle politiche di sicurezza, salute e ambiente di Roche per salvaguardare i dipendenti e i visitatori.

Chi sei:
Hai...

• Laurea magistrale in Biotecnologia o in un campo correlato. L'istruzione superiore nel settore relativo sarà vantaggioso

• 5+ anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante nella diagnostica molecolare (PCR, RT-PCR, NAT) o campo simile

• Un entusiasmo per l'apprendimento, la guida dell'eccellenza e diventare un esperto di materia tematica sui portafogli di prodotti assegnati, sostenuto da un forte background in scienza e business e una comprensione approfondita dei laboratori diagnostici e di ricerca

• Una straordinaria capacità di comunicare e di rete, con comprovate capacità di costruzione delle relazioni che permettono di rappresentare l'azienda esternamente e costruire connessioni significative e a lungo termine con gli stakeholder

• Una mentalità strategica che sviluppa piani efficaci

• Master-Abschluss in Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich. Hochschulbildung im verwandten Bereich wird von Vorteil sein

• 5+ Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Molekulare Diagnostik (PCR, RT-PCR, NAT) oder ähnlichem

• Eine hervorragende Fähigkeit zu kommunizieren und sich zu vernetzen, mit bewährten Fähigkeiten zum Aufbau von Beziehungen, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, das Unternehmen nach außen zu vertreten und sinnvolle, langfristige Verbindungen zu Stakeholdern aufzubauen

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position - National Manager - Technical
Location - Mumbai

Your Opportunity

As a National Manager - Technical you will leads and oversees the Field Support function and team for the assigned affiliate in the assigned division. You will typically oversee and guide technical support for customers through a team of field support management, field service engineers and/or application specialists diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing products and/or related components. You will develops and oversee implementation of the affiliate Field Support vision, strategies, objectives, metrics, policies, procedures, tools and resources to guide field support execution, consistent standards and efficient field operations. May also oversee pre-sale and/or post-sale support activities, including assessment of how company products meet customer needs and the preparation of product specifications for development and installation of customised solutions.
• Responsibilities may also include pre-sale support in sales presentations and product demonstrations. With team, establishes and maintains lines of communication cross-functionally on issues such as product design, reliability, and maintenance issues. May be involved in critical customer issues. You will works with team to define new products and provide insights from the field back to other groups. Selects, develops, and evaluates employees to ensure the efficient operation of the function. Responsible for the divisional cross-portfolio field support strategy within a single entity/location and may be revenue accountable.

Role and
• Responsibilities

1. Development of Team and Effective People Leadership as demonstrated by Leadership Commitments
2. Strategy Planning/ Implementation (Processes)
3. Customer Complaint Management
4. Planning and Management Installations and Commissioning
5. ASC and SIQ Performance Management
6. Internal / External Training
7. Key Account Management - Services
8. Key Account Management and Coordination
9. Coordination Sales/Service/Logistics
10. NM support for TNI, secondary support, customer call Data management
11. Reporting- MIS
13. ISO Compliance/CAPA
14. Service Revenue

Who You Are

In a leadership position for atleast 5 to 7 years.
Have built the robost field service strategy for the affiliate with proven impact
Customer centric approach
Engineer/Science graduate with masters as an added advantage

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
AI & Data Science Intern
We're seeking a motivated AI & Data Science Intern to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, clinical experts, and cross-functional teams, contributing to exciting projects that leverage generative AI and advanced analytics to optimize Roche's digital healthcare solutions. This is an excellent opportunity to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and real-world healthcare innovation.

Key Responsibilities
As an AI & Data Science Intern, your key duties will include:

• GenAI Prototype Development: Support the design and building of Generative AI prototypes, focusing on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Vectorization to enhance data retrieval and response accuracy.

• Prompt & Context Engineering: Experiment with and refine prompt engineering and contextual orchestration techniques to optimize LLM performance for laboratory, clinical and to-Consumer use cases.

• Agentic AI Exploration: Assist in developing and testing Agentic AI frameworks that can autonomously execute workflows and reason through complex healthcare data tasks.

• Data Pipeline Construction: Build and maintain scalable data pipelines to preprocess, clean, and ingest diverse datasets into vector databases and analytical models.

• Visualization & Insights: Transform complex model outputs into actionable insights using data visualization tools, helping stakeholders understand AI-driven trends and performance.

• Operational AI Improvements: Suggest and implement processes to improve the efficiency of the AI lifecycle (MLOps), offering innovative ideas that align with the team's technical objectives.

What We're Looking For

• Education: Currently enrolled in or recently completed a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics , or a related quantitative field.

• Technical Skills: * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain).

• Foundational understanding of Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus) and embedding techniques.

• Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Matplotlib/Seaborn).

• Knowledge of SQL and building basic data integration pipelines.

• Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on how AI can solve specific business and clinical challenges.

• Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical cross-functional teams.

• Growth-Oriented: Enthusiastic about staying at the forefront of the rapidly evolving Generative AI landscape.

Als AI & Data Science Praktikant sind Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

• Wachstumsorientiert: Enthusiastisch, an der Spitze der sich schnell entwickelnden Generative AI-Landschaft zu bleiben.

Was ist für dich drin?

• Hands-on AI Experience: Arbeiten Sie an einflussreichen Projekten im schnell wachsenden Bereich GenAI im Gesundheitswesen.

• Cutting-Edge Tech: Exposition gegenüber den neuesten LLMs, Agentic Frameworks und vektorbasierten Sucharchitekturen.

• Mentoring: Direkte Anleitung von erfahrenen Data Scientists und AI Leads in einem globalen, branchenführenden Unternehmen.

• Innovation at Scale: Sehen Sie, wie Ihre Prototypen zu digitalen Lösungen beitragen, die die Patientenergebnisse weltweit verbessern.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden und Kreativität zu fördern

La position
IA & Data Science stagiaire
Nous recherchons un stagiaire motivé de l'IA & Data Science pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez avec des data savants, des ingénieurs de l'IA, des experts cliniques et des équipes interfonctionnelles, contribuant à des projets passionnants qui tirent parti de l'IA générative et de l'analyse avancée pour optimiser les solutions de soins numériques de Roche. C'est une excellente occasion de combler le fossé entre la recherche de pointe sur l'IA et l'innovation dans le domaine des soins de santé.

Principales responsabilités
En tant que stagiaire en sciences de l'intelligence artificielle et des données, vos fonctions clés comprendront :

• Développement de prototypes GenAI: Soutenir la conception et la construction de prototypes d'IA Generative, en mettant l'accent sur la génération retrieval-augmentée (RAG) et la vectorisation pour améliorer la récupération des données et la précision de réponse.

• Prompt & Context Engineering: Expérimentez et perfectionnez rapidement les techniques d'ingénierie et d'orchestration contextuelles afin d'optimiser les performances de LLM pour les cas d'utilisation en laboratoire, clinique et pour les consommateurs.

• Exploration Agentique de l'IA: Aider à développer et à tester des cadres Agentique de l'IA qui peuvent exécuter de façon autonome des workflows et raisonner par des tâches complexes de données de santé.

• Construction de pipelines de données : Construisez et maintenez des pipelines de données évolutives pour préprocéder, nettoyer et ingérer divers ensembles de données dans des bases de données vectorielles et des modèles analytiques.

• Visualisation & Insights: Transformer les sorties de modèles complexes en informations exploitables à l'aide d'outils de visualisation des données, aidant les intervenants à comprendre les tendances et le rendement liés à l'IA.

• Améliorations opérationnelles de l'IA: Proposer et mettre en œuvre des processus pour améliorer l'efficacité du cycle de vie de l'IA (MLOps), offrant des idées innovantes qui s'harmonisent avec les objectifs techniques de l'équipe.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Éducation: actuellement inscrit ou récemment obtenu un diplôme en Data Science, Informatique, Intelligence artificielle, Statistiques, ou un domaine quantitatif connexe.

• Compétences techniques : * Compétence en python et connaissance des cadres d'IA (p. ex. LangChain).

• Compréhension fondamentale des bases de données vectorielles (p. ex. Pinecone, Milvus) et des techniques d'intégration.

• Expérience des outils de visualisation des données (Tableau, Power BI ou Matplotlib/Seaborn).

• Connaissance de SQL et construction de pipelines d'intégration de données de base.

• Analyst Mindset: Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes en mettant l'accent sur la façon dont l'IA peut résoudre des défis commerciaux et cliniques spécifiques.

• Joueur d'équipe : esprit de collaboration avec la capacité de communiquer des concepts techniques aux équipes interfonctionnelles non techniques.

• Orientation croissance: Enthousiaste de rester à l'avant-garde du paysage d'IA en évolution rapide.

Qu'y a-t-il pour toi ?

• Expérience pratique de l'IA: Travail sur des projets à impact élevé dans le domaine en croissance rapide de GenAI dans les soins de santé.

• Cutting-Edge Tech: Exposition aux dernières architectures LLM, frameworks agentsiques et de recherche vectorielle.

• Mentorship: Conseils directs de data savants expérimentés et d'IA dirige au sein d'une entreprise mondiale, leader de l'industrie.

• Innovation à l'échelle : vos prototypes contribuent à des solutions numériques qui améliorent les résultats des patients dans le monde entier.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativit

jobs.title: Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Writer
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2-office days/week).

The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

Position Summary

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.

In addition, you will work with senior medical writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.

The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Writer, you will contribute to the growing medical writing team within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. You will develop medical writing and digital content solutions across various therapeutic areas and play an integral role in business development and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Create and edit medical content for various digital channels and platforms, including patient information, educational materials for healthcare professionals (slides, posters, speaker briefs, and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports, study summaries, and materials for public relations.

• May research, write, and edit pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from studies.

• Assist in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation, prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts, and posters.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring timely delivery.

• Ensure content complies with regulatory guidelines and Roche best practices.

• Monitor and manage workload, anticipate capacity issues, and provide solutions.

• Ensure projects meet deadlines and maintain scientific accuracy.

• Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM, including referencing.

• Collaborate with the Creative Artworker to develop content.

• Contribute creative ideas and suggestions.

• Liaise professionally with internal teams, clients, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses.

• Understand customer business needs to create relevant content.

• Engage resources, using both formal and informal networks to achieve goals and work closely with Business Partners.

• Suggest improvements to service and responsivenes

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Scrittore medico
Roche India – Servizi e Soluzioni Roche
Hyderabad

Roche è un'azienda biotecnologica stabile e innovativa che offre percorsi di carriera eccezionali e grandi benefici per laureati freschi e professionisti eccezionali. Siamo in continua espansione, alla ricerca di nuovi talenti per unire il nostro Roche Services & Solutions Center trasformante. Offriamo un quadro di lavoro flessibile (2 giorni di ufficio / settimana).

La linea aziendale di crescita Global Digital Hub all'interno di Roche Services & Solutions Center. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation e Creative Design.

Posizione Sommario

In qualità di scrittrice medica, supporterai il crescente team di scrittura medica all'interno di Roche Services & Solution Centre nello sviluppo di soluzioni di scrittura medica e contenuti digitali per i nostri partner commerciali. Sarete parte di formulare e identificare le esigenze attuali e future dei contenuti e sostenere diverse iniziative di creazione di contenuti.

Inoltre, lavorerai con scrittori e stakeholder medici senior per garantire l'efficace distribuzione di risorse e strumenti per supportare e garantire che le attività di scrittura siano condotte in modo efficiente, economico e in conformità alle esigenze aziendali.

Il team di copia e contenuti medici all'interno del Global Digital Hub opera sotto il Content Creation Chapter. Questo team specializzato si concentra sulla generazione di contenuti commerciali destinati a vari formati digitali (email, video, banner, infografica, siti web ecc.). Il loro lavoro svolge un ruolo cruciale nel sostenere le strategie di comunicazione sviluppate dai team aziendali globali e locali di Roche.

L'opportunità

Come Scrittore Medico, contribuirai alla crescente squadra di scrittura medica all'interno del Centro Servizi e Soluzioni Roche. svilupperai soluzioni di scrittura medica e contenuti digitali in varie aree terapeutiche e svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo aziendale e nell'impegno degli stakeholder.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Creare e modificare contenuti medici per vari canali e piattaforme digitali, tra cui informazioni sul paziente, materiali didattici per i professionisti del settore sanitario (slidi, manifesti, brevi altoparlanti e presentazioni per conferenze), newsletter, report medici, sintesi di studi e materiali per le pubbliche relazioni.

• Può ricercare, scrivere e modificare report preclinici e/o clinici, riassumendo i dati dagli studi.

• Assistere nello sviluppo di formati e linee guida per la documentazione clinica, preparare manoscritti scientifici, astratti e poster.

• Gestire più progetti concomitanti in aree terapeutiche, garantendo la consegna tempestiva.

• Assicurarsi che i contenuti siano conformi alle linee guida normative e alle best practice Roche.

• Monitorare e gestire il carico di lavoro, anticipare i problemi di capacità e fornire soluzioni.

• Assicurare che i progetti soddisfino le scadenze e mantengano l'accuratezza scientifica.

• Preparare il contenuto per l'approvazione LMR in VVPM, compreso il rinvio.

• Collabora con l'Artista Creativo per sviluppare contenuti.

• Contribuisci idee creative e suggerimenti.

• Liaise professionalmente con team interni, clienti, professionisti sanitari e altri stakeholder per ottenere brevi e risposte complete.

• Comprendere le esigenze di business del cliente per creare contenuti rilevanti.

• Coinvolgere risorse, utilizzando reti sia formali che informali per raggiungere gli obiettivi e lavorare a stretto contatto con Business Partners.

• Suggerisci miglioramenti al servizio e ai reattivi

Die Position
Medizinischer Schriftsteller
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

Roche ist ein stabiles und innovatives biotechnologisches Unternehmen, das außergewöhnliche Karrierewege und große Vorteile für junge Absolventen und herausragende Fachkräfte bietet. Wir expandieren kontinuierlich und suchen nach neuen Talenten, um unserem transformierenden Roche Services & Solutions Center beizutreten. Wir bieten einen flexiblen Arbeitsrahmen (2 Bürotage/Woche).

Der wachsende Geschäftsbereich Global Digital Hub innerhalb des Roche Services & Solutions Center. Unser Hauptzweck ist es, die digitalen Fähigkeiten von Roche weltweit zu stärken, indem wir zentrale Initiativen wie Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation und Creative Design unterstützen.

Positionsübersicht

Als Medical Writer unterstützen Sie das wachsende Medical Writing Team von Roche Services & Solution Center bei der Entwicklung von Medical Writing & Digital Content Lösungen für unsere Geschäftspartner. Sie sind Teil der Formulierung und Identifizierung aktueller und zukünftiger Content-Anforderungen und unterstützen verschiedene Content-Erstellungsinitiativen.

Darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie mit leitenden medizinischen Autoren und Stakeholdern zusammen, um den effektiven Einsatz von Ressourcen und Tools sicherzustellen, um sicherzustellen, dass Schreibaktivitäten effizient, kostengünstig und in Übereinstimmung mit den Geschäftsanforderungen durchgeführt werden.

Das medizinische Kopier- und Inhaltsteam im Global Digital Hub arbeitet unter dem Content Creation Chapter. Dieses spezialisierte Team konzentriert sich auf die Generierung kommerzieller Inhalte für verschiedene digitale Formate (E-Mails, Videos, Banner, Infografiken, Websites usw.). Ihre Arbeit spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Unterstützung der Kommunikationsstrategien, die von den globalen und lokalen Geschäftsteams von Roche entwickelt wurden.

Die Chance

Als Medical Writer tragen Sie zum wachsenden Medical Writing-Team im Roche Services & Solutions Center bei. Sie entwickeln Lösungen für medizinisches Schreiben und digitale Inhalte in verschiedenen therapeutischen Bereichen und spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Geschäftsentwicklung und dem Engagement von Stakeholdern.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Erstellen und Bearbeiten von medizinischen Inhalten für verschiedene digitale Kanäle und Plattformen, einschließlich Patienteninformationen, Bildungsmaterialien für Angehörige der Gesundheitsberufe (Folien, Poster, Referentenbriefs und Präsentationen für Konferenzen), Newsletter, medizinische Berichte, Studienzusammenfassungen und Materialien für die Öffentlichkeitsarbeit.

• Kann präklinische und / oder klinische Berichte recherchieren, schreiben und bearbeiten und Daten aus Studien zusammenfassen.

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Formaten und Richtlinien für die klinische Dokumentation, Vorbereitung wissenschaftlicher Manuskripte, Abstracts und Poster.

• Verwalten Sie mehrere gleichzeitige Projekte in therapeutischen Bereichen und gewährleisten Sie eine rechtzeitige Lieferung.

• Sicherstellen, dass der Inhalt den regulatorischen Richtlinien und den Best Practices von Roche entspricht.

• Überwachen und verwalten Sie die Arbeitsbelastung, antizipieren Sie Kapazitätsprobleme und bieten Sie Lösungen an.

• Sicherstellen, dass Projekte ihre Termine einhalten und wissenschaftliche Genauigkeit wahren.

• Bereiten Sie Inhalte für die LMR-Zulassung in VVPM vor, einschließlich Referenzierung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Creative Artworker zusammen, um Inhalte zu entwickeln.

• Tragen Sie kreative Ideen und Vorschläge bei.

• Kontaktieren Sie professionell mit internen Teams, Kunden, Gesundheitsexperten und anderen Interessengruppen, um umfassende Briefings und Antworten zu erhalten.

• Verstehen Sie, dass das Kundengeschäft relevante Inhalte erstellen muss.

• Engagieren Sie Ressourcen, indem Sie sowohl formelle als auch informelle Netzwerke nutzen, um Ziele zu erreichen und eng mit Geschäftspartnern zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Vorgeschlagene Verbesserungen für Service und Responsenes

En tant que rédacteur médical, vous accompagnerez l'équipe croissante de rédaction médicale au sein de Roche Services & Solution Centre dans le développement de solutions de rédaction médicale et de contenu numérique pour nos partenaires commerciaux. jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea
Cluster: Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG)
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
We are looking for a Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) who will specialize in IND (Investigational New Drug) applications and overall regulatory strategy to lead our clinical trials into action.

The Role
As an SSUL specializing in IND and Regulatory submission, you will be the architect of our country-level start-up strategy. You won't just follow processes—you will optimize them. Your primary focus will be ensuring the efficient and compliant start up of Roche-sponsored trials by mastering the bridge between global strategy and local regulatory requirements.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the Korean regulatory landscape. You excel in a cross-functional environment and are passionate about driving innovation in clinical trials.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience(0-2 years) in IND/Regulatory submissions within the pharmaceutical industry or a leading CRO.

• In-depth knowledge of local regulatory requirements (MFDS, GCP, etc.) and experience interacting with HA or Ethics Committees.

• A "Solution-Oriented" mindset: Ability to identify bottlenecks and proactively drive process improvements.

• Strong communication skills in both Korean and English to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders.

Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
We are looking for a Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) who will specialize in IND (Investigational New Drug) applications and overall regulatory strategy to lead our clinical trials into action.

The Role
As an SSUL specializing in IND and Regulatory submission, you will be the architect of our country-level start-up strategy. You won't just follow processes—you will optimize them. Your primary focus will be ensuring the efficient and compliant start up of Roche-sponsored trials by mastering the bridge between global strategy and local regulatory requirements.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the Korean regulatory landscape. You excel in a cross-functional environment and are passionate about driving innovation in clinical trials.

• Experience(0-2 years) in IND/Regulatory submissions within the pharmaceutical industry or a leading CRO.

• In-depth knowledge of local regulatory requirements (MFDS, GCP, etc.) and experience interacting with HA or Ethics Committees.

• A "Solution-Oriented" mindset: Ability to identify bottlenecks and proactively drive process improvements.

• Strong communication skills in both Korean and English to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders.

Title position : Quality & Regulatory Affairs Specialist
Reporting Line : Regulatory and Quality Affairs Leader
Location : Taguig City, Roche Philippines (Diagnostics Division)

The Opportunity:
Accountable for quality and regulatory affairs for Roche Philippines (Dia and NPC), with support from Regulatory and Quality Affairs Leader and senior peers, in which the incumbent has to implement and perform activities necessary to ensure compliance with local regulation requirements and Roche Global Quality principles, policies and standards.

As the Quality & Regulatory Affairs Specialist, you are responsible for:

• Manage product licenses during the product life-cycle and ensure license to operate

• Submit and review promo applications and maintain promo permits to make sure seamless business continuity

• Support regulatory activities to meet product sustainability and compliance with chemical registrations

• Manages Affiliate Notifications; Safety Board Notifications (SBN) and Quality Notifications (QN) in a timely manner

• Approve release incoming RBR(Repackaging Batch Record)

• Assist in creating artwork for labelling and suppliers’ work instruction

• Guide and support internal stakeholders to comply with regulatory and quality requirements

• Perform various regulatory and quality activities required for organizational operations

Who You Are:

• Pharmacy Degree or Bachelor's Degree in relevant field is preferred.

• Ideally minimum of 2 years industry experience in the Medical Devices is preferred.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every person deserves a healthy future — and that starts with ensuring the right medicines reach the right patients. We're looking for a strategic leader to shape how Indonesia's healthcare system values and accesses innovative therapies, working at the intersection of public policy, communications, and patient impact.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences who share our commitment to improving lives through science.

Your Opportunity
As Chapter Lead, you will sit on Indonesia's Leadership Team and play a central role in shaping the country's medicines access strategy — ensuring eligible patients can reach Roche's innovative therapies. You'll build and lead a high-performing team while driving relationships across government, health authorities, and patient organizations.
In this role, you will:

• Build productive relationships with government bodies, the Ministry of Health, and patient groups to strengthen treatment access and delivery nationally

• Lead the development of public policy strategies that create a favorable environment for healthcare investment and innovative treatment access

• Oversee the process for securing formulary listings and drive proposals that expand or extend access to Roche therapies

• Shape communications strategy and campaigns that reflect the business's long-term vision and key brand priorities

• Represent Roche in industry trade groups and collaborate with regional and global teams to share learnings across markets

• Lead early strategic analysis of local market potential for new therapies entering the pipeline

• Coach, mentor, and develop your team, embedding a culture of collaboration, integrity, and continuous growth

Who you are

• You hold a university degree in a relevant field such as life sciences, political science, health economics, public health, or business; an MBA is a plus

• You bring at least 10 years of experience in specialty therapeutic areas, ideally within pharmaceuticals, health economics, or private payer industries

• You have a track record of engaging senior stakeholders across complex, matrixed organizations

• You're a strong communicator with excellent analytical and business presentation skills

• You bring proven people leadership experience, with a genuine passion for developing others

• You act with integrity, courage, and a strategic mindset, and you're energized by driving impact at a national level

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

• Forma strategia di comunicazione e campagne che riflettono la visione a lungo termine del business e le priorità chiave del marchio
• Rappresentare Roche nei gruppi di commercio del settore e collaborare con i team regionali e globali per condividere gli insegnamenti sui mercati
• Analisi strategica precoce del potenziale di mercato locale per nuove terapie che entrano nel gasdotto
• Allenatore, mentore e sviluppare il vostro team, incorporando una cultura di collaborazione, integrità e crescita continua Chi sei
• Lei ha una laurea in un campo rilevante come le scienze della vita, la scienza politica, l'economia della salute, la salute pubblica, o il commercio; un MBA è un plus
• Porti almeno 10 anni di esperienza in aree terapeutiche speciali, idealmente all'interno di farmaceutici, economia sanitaria, o industrie di payer private
• Hai un track record di coinvolgere gli stakeholder senior in organizzazioni complesse e matrici
• Sei un comunicatore forte con eccellenti capacità di presentazione analitica e aziendale
• Porti delle persone provate esperienza di leadership, con una vera passione per lo sviluppo di altri
• Agite con integrità, coraggio e mentalità strategica, e siete eccitati dalla guida di impatto a livello nazionale Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every person deserves a healthy future — and that starts with ensuring the right medicines reach the right patients. We're looking for a strategic leader to shape how Indonesia's healthcare system values and accesses innovative therapies, working at the intersection of public policy, communications, and patient impact.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences who share our commitment to improving lives through science.

Your Opportunity
As Chapter Lead, you will sit on Indonesia's Leadership Team and play a central role in shaping the country's medicines access strategy — ensuring eligible patients can reach Roche's innovative therapies. You'll build and lead a high-performing team while driving relationships across government, health authorities, and patient organizations.
In this role, you will:

• Build productive relationships with government bodies, the Ministry of Health, and patient groups to strengthen treatment access and delivery nationally

• Lead the development of public policy strategies that create a favorable environment for healthcare investment and innovative treatment access

• Oversee the process for securing formulary listings and drive proposals that expand or extend access to Roche therapies

• Shape communications strategy and campaigns that reflect the business's long-term vision and key brand priorities

• Represent Roche in industry trade groups and collaborate with regional and global teams to share learnings across markets

• Lead early strategic analysis of local market potential for new therapies entering the pipeline

• Coach, mentor, and develop your team, embedding a culture of collaboration, integrity, and continuous growth

Who you are

• You hold a university degree in a relevant field such as life sciences, political science, health economics, public health, or business; an MBA is a plus

• You bring at least 10 years of experience in specialty therapeutic areas, ideally within pharmaceuticals, health economics, or private payer industries

• You have a track record of engaging senior stakeholders across complex, matrixed organizations

• You're a strong communicator with excellent analytical and business presentation skills

• You bring proven people leadership experience, with a genuine passion for developing others

• You act with integrity, courage, and a strategic mindset, and you're energized by driving impact at a national level

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Specialist (Events & Congresses) will lead the operational execution of our Global Congresses and Events. You will be responsible for bringing our face-to-face, virtual, and hybrid event experiences to life by executing high-impact digital marketing campaigns. Working closely with the global team, you will drive the creation of digital assets, manage complex project timelines, and analyze campaign performance to shape future digital strategies.

Please note that this is a fixed term position for 2 years.

The Opportunity:

• Execute end-to-end digital marketing campaigns for global events and congresses, ensuring seamless delivery across the entire event lifecycle (pre-event, live, and post-event).

• Create, update, and localize high-quality digital assets including webpages, email campaigns, social media posts, and sales enablement materials across our core platforms.

• Manage multiple concurrent event projects with tight deadlines, bringing structured coordination and precision to high-volume campaign operations.

• Track, analyze, and report on campaign performance , maintaining accurate dashboards and translating marketing metrics into actionable optimization insights.

• Collaborate closely with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams to anticipate project bottlenecks, align timelines, and deliver consistent brand experiences.

• Bring a creative, innovative mindset to our digital marketing processes, proactively identifying opportunities to improve our campaign workflows and technologies.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, alongside 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience executing digital marketing campaigns, email marketing, or content creation (events experience is a plus).

• You are highly proficient in managing digital marketing platforms, including website content management systems, email automation tools, social media channels, and CRM systems.

• You have a proven track record of coordinating multiple complex projects simultaneously under tight deadlines with a strong commitment to zero-error execution.

• You possess strong analytical capabilities, with experience using marketing analytics tools to track performance, build reports, and derive insights.

• You are a natural team player with excellent interpersonal skills and a strong ability to manage stakeholder expectations and solve problems creatively.

• You are an adaptable, detail-oriented digital marketer who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• You bring a structured approach to managing multiple moving parts and are passionate about leveraging digital channels to create meaningful connections.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coa

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design.

Come Digital Campaign Specialist (Eventi & Congressi) guiderà l'esecuzione operativa dei nostri Congressi ed Eventi Globali. Sarete responsabili di portare a vita le nostre esperienze di eventi faccia a faccia, virtuali e ibridi, eseguendo campagne di marketing digitale ad alto impatto. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team globale, guiderai la creazione di asset digitali, gestirai tempi di progetto complessi e analizzerai le prestazioni della campagna per modellare le future strategie digitali.

Si prega di notare che questa è una posizione a termine fissa per 2 anni.

L'opportunità:

• Esegui campagne di marketing digitale end-to-end per eventi e congressi globali, assicurando la consegna senza interruzioni in tutto il ciclo di vita degli eventi (pre-evento, live e post-evento).

• Creare, aggiornare e localizzare beni digitali di alta qualità, tra cui pagine web, campagne e-mail, post dei social media e materiali di attivazione delle vendite attraverso le nostre piattaforme principali.

• Gestire più progetti di eventi contemporaneamente con scadenze strette, portando coordinamento strutturato e precisione alle operazioni di campagna ad alto volume.

• Traccia, analizza e segnala le prestazioni della campagna, mantenendo scrivanie accurate e traducendo metriche di marketing in insight di ottimizzazione attuabili.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate globali e i team interfunzionali per anticipare i colli di bottiglia del progetto, allineare le linee temporali e fornire esperienze di marca coerenti.

• Porta una mentalità creativa e innovativa ai nostri processi di marketing digitale, identificando in modo proattivo le opportunità per migliorare i flussi di lavoro e le tecnologie della nostra campagna.

Chi sei?

• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Business, Comunicazioni o un campo correlato, insieme a 3 a 4 anni di esperienza pratica che eseguono campagne di marketing digitale, email marketing, o creazione di contenuti (l'esperienza di eventi è un plus).

• Sei altamente competente nella gestione di piattaforme di marketing digitale, compresi i sistemi di gestione dei contenuti del sito web, strumenti di automazione e-mail, canali social media e sistemi CRM.

• Hai una comprovata traccia di coordinamento di più progetti complessi simultaneamente sotto scadenze strette con un forte impegno per l'esecuzione zero-error.

• Possiedi forti capacità analitiche, con l'esperienza utilizzando strumenti di analisi di marketing per monitorare le prestazioni, costruire report e trarre insight.

• Sei un giocatore di squadra naturale con eccellenti competenze interpersonali e una forte capacità di gestire le aspettative degli stakeholder e risolvere i problemi in modo creativo.

• Sei un marketer digitale adattabile e dettagliato che prospera in ambienti dinamici e veloci.

• Porti un approccio strutturato per gestire più parti in movimento e sei appassionato di sfruttare i canali digitali per creare connessioni significative.

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coa
