jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst (PTM) die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung mit qualitativ hochwertigen Medikamenten sicher. PTM steht für die höchsten Standards der pharmazeutischen Herstellung, das grösste, innovativste Verpackungszentrum der Roche und die Versorgung von mehr als 120 Ländern.

Im Bereich DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) im Team Business Automation Support wirst du als Business Automation Expert im Daily Business und bei Projekten im Bereich Verpackungstechnologien mit vielfältigen Schnittstellen mitarbeiten. Du unterstützt bei wiederkehrenden Tätigkeiten zur Einhaltung von regulatorischen Anforderungen, bei Störungen auf den Automationssystemen von Verpackungsanlagen und bist Subject Matter Expert bei Deviations, Complaints und Root Cause Analysen.

Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den jeweiligen Bereichen wie den Manufacturing Units, der Qualitätssicherung, dem Pharma Engineering, ITOT, MSAT und E&S zusammen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Durchführung bzw. Unterstützung von Tests / Implementierung von neuen Anlagen oder Systemen im Verantwortungsbereich von Business Automation Support (BAS)

• Unterstützung von Qualifizierung und Validierung von Anlagen und Prozessen im Verpackungsbetrieb, selbstständige Durchführung und Dokumentation von Qualifizierungs Tests

• Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Pflege von GMP-Dokumenten (z.B. SOP’s, Rationalen, Risikoanalysen, Testplänen- und Berichten, etc.)

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der bestehenden Prozesse und zugehörigen Dokumenten

• Sicherstellung des GMP gerechten Lifecycles mittels Change Control- und Abweichungs Prozesses in Veeva

• Einhaltung der Data Integrity und CSV Anforderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Quality, für den Standort Kaiseraugst

• Administrator Tätigkeiten an Anlagen wie System Audit Trail Review

• Unterstützung vom User- und Passwort Management für den Standort Kaiseraugst

• Teilnahme in lokalen und standortübergreifenden Experten-Teams

Wer Du bist

Du besitzt eine Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Automation oder in Pharma-, Biotech-, Lebensmittel-, Elektro- oder Verfahrenstechnik. Du bringst im besten Fall mindestens 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion und deren Technologien (z.B. Abfüllungstechnologien, Verpackungstechnologien etc.) oder einer vergleichbaren Branche mit.
Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise aus und arbeitest gerne vor Ort am Standort Kaiseraugst und bist daran interessiert unsere Produktionsanlagen und Prozesse kennenzulernen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Du bist offen für neue Ideen, eigeninitiativ und hinterfragst konventionelle Denkmuster. Du schätzt es, in einer leistungsorientierten Umgebung zu arbeiten, die von gegenseitigem Respekt, Kommunikation, Diskussion und Zusammenarbeit getragen wird

• Du verstehst es regulatorische Anforderungen in pragmatische Lösungen zu übersetzen und diese Sachverhalte auf allen Ebenen der Organisation strukturiert, präzise und leicht verständlich zu formulieren

• Erfahrungen im Good Manufacturing Process (GMP) Umfeld und Besitz einer Betriebselektrikerbewilligung sind von Vorteil

• Versierter Umgang mit Betriebssystemen (Windows, Linux etc.), MS Office Anwendungen sowie Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil

• Du bist an der Entwicklung von neuen und innovativen Lösungsansätzen interessiert

• Du liebst Herausforderungen und bist bereit dich auch persönlich kontinuierlich weiter zu entwickeln (Polyvalenz)

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Con i suoi 1400 dipendenti, il Kaiseraugst Production Center (PTM) garantisce una cura ininterrotta dei pazienti con farmaci di alta qualità. PTM è sinonimo di elevati standard di produzione farmaceutica, il più grande e innovativo centro di confezionamento di Roche e la fornitura di oltre 120 paesi.

Nell'area di DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) nel team di Business Automation Support, lavorerai come Business Automation Expert nel Daily Business e nei progetti nel campo delle tecnologie di packaging con una vasta gamma di interfacce. Sosteni le attività di conformità regolamentare, i malfunzionamenti sui sistemi di automazione degli impianti di confezionamento e sono un esperto di materia tematica nelle deviazioni, componenti e analisi causa radice.

Si lavora a stretto contatto con le rispettive aree come Manufacturing Units, Quality Assurance, Pharma Engineering, ITOT, MSAT e E&S.

La possibilità

• Attuazione o supporto di test / implementazione di nuovi impianti o sistemi nell'area di responsabilità di Business Automation Support (BAS)

• Supporto per la qualificazione e la validazione di impianti e processi nell'impianto di confezionamento, implementazione indipendente e documentazione delle prove di qualificazione

• Cooperazione nella preparazione e nella manutenzione dei documenti GMP (ad esempio SOP, razionali, analisi dei rischi, piani di prova e relazioni, ecc.)

• Miglioramento continuo dei processi esistenti e dei documenti correlati

• Garantire il ciclo di vita equo GMP attraverso il processo di controllo e deviazione dei cambiamenti a Veeva

• Rispetto dell'integrità dei dati e dei requisiti CSV in stretta collaborazione con la Qualità, per il sito Kaiseraugst

• Attività di amministratore in strutture come System Audit Trail Review

• Supporto dalla gestione utente e password per la posizione Kaiseraugst

• Partecipazione a team di esperti locali e cross-location

Chi sei

Hai un'istruzione con un focus sull'automazione o nell'ingegneria farmaceutica, biotecnica, alimentare, elettrica o di processo. Nel migliore dei casi, hai almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale nella produzione farmaceutica e nelle sue tecnologie (ad esempio tecnologie di imbottigliamento, tecnologie di confezionamento, ecc.) o un settore paragonabile.
Ti distinguono attraverso un metodo di lavoro strutturato e indipendente e ti godi di lavorare in loco presso il sito Kaiseraugst e sei interessato a conoscere i nostri impianti e processi produttivi e a migliorarli continuamente.

• Sei aperto a nuove idee, auto-iniziativa e mettere in discussione modelli di pensiero convenzionali. Valori di lavorare in un ambiente orientato alle prestazioni guidato da rispetto reciproco, comunicazione, discussione e collaborazione

• Capite come tradurre i requisiti normativi in soluzioni pragmatiche e formulare questi problemi in modo strutturato, preciso e facile da comprendere a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione.

• L'esperienza nell'ambiente di Good Manufacturing Process (GMP) e il possesso di un permesso elettrico aziendale sono vantaggiosi

• Utilizzo esperto dei sistemi operativi (Windows, Linux, ecc.), le applicazioni di MS Office e la conoscenza di SAP sono vantaggiose

• Sei interessato a sviluppare soluzioni nuove e innovative

• Amate le sfide e siete pronti a svilupparsi continuamente personalmente (polivalenza)

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
With its 1400 employees, the Kaiseraugst Production Center (PTM) ensures uninterrupted patient care with high-quality medicines. PTM stands for the highest standards of pharmaceutical manufacturing, Roche’s largest, most innovative packaging centre and the supply of more than 120 countries.

In the area of DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) in the Business Automation Support team, you will work as a Business Automation Expert in the Daily Business and in projects in the field of packaging technologies with a wide range of interfaces. You support recurring regulatory compliance activities, malfunctions on the automation systems of packaging plants and are a subject matter expert in deviations, components and root cause analyses.

You work closely with the respective areas such as Manufacturing Units, Quality Assurance, Pharma Engineering, ITOT, MSAT and E&S.

The possibility

• Implementation or support of tests / implementation of new plants or systems in the area of responsibility of Business Automation Support (BAS)

• Support for qualification and validation of plants and processes in the packaging plant, independent implementation and documentation of qualification tests

• Cooperation in the preparation and maintenance of GMP documents (e.g. SOPs, rationales, risk analyses, test plans and reports, etc.)

• Continuous improvement of existing processes and related documents

• Ensuring the GMP fair lifecycle through the change control and deviation process in Veeva

• Compliance with data integrity and CSV requirements in close cooperation with Quality, for the Kaiseraugst site

• Administrator activities at facilities such as System Audit Trail Review

• Support from user and password management for the Kaiseraugst location

• Participation in local and cross-location expert teams

Who you are

You have an education with a focus on automation or in pharmaceutical, biotech, food, electrical or process engineering. In the best case, you have at least 2-3 years of professional experience in pharmaceutical production and its technologies (e.g. bottling technologies, packaging technologies, etc.) or a comparable industry.
You distinguish yourself through a structured and independent working method and enjoy working on site at the Kaiseraugst site and are interested in getting to know our production facilities and processes and continuously improving them.

• You are open to new ideas, self-initiative and question conventional thinking patterns. You value working in a performance-driven environment driven by mutual respect, communication, discussion and collaboration

• You understand how to translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic solutions and formulate these issues in a structured, precise and easy-to-understand way at all levels of the organization.

• Experience in the Good Manufacturing Process (GMP) environment and possession of a company electrician permit are advantageous

• Experienced use of operating systems (Windows, Linux, etc.), MS Office applications and knowledge of SAP are advantageous

• You are interested in developing new and innovative solutions

• You love challenges and are ready to continuously develop yourself personally (polyvalence)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

This Programs and Solutions Lead - Digital and Tech (Procurement) role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation.

As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Digital and Tech . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:

• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.

• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ).

These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients.
Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow.
You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality.

(Please note: This is a IT Category focused Procurement role. This is not an internal procurement operations or Procurement technology implementation role.)

The Opportunity:

• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Lead your team in a fast-paced global environment to manage a diverse portfolio of solutions and programs (including cost transformations and critical negotiations) that deliver massive value for Digital and Tech stakeholders.

• Culture & Community Building: Cultivate a high-trust, inclusive environment. You will be a key driver in building a community where team members feel safe to share failures as learnings, celebrate successes together, and collaborate across boundaries to spark new ideas.

• Resource Orchestration: Dynamically balance resources to maximize impact; you will work across networks and squads to ensure the right talent is in the right place at the right time.

• Strategic Innovation & Problem Solving: Diagnose complex business needs within the Digital and Tech space, selecting the right approach (e.g. Solution versus program) seeking avenu

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

This Programs and Solutions Lead - Digital and Tech (Procurement) role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation.

As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Digital and Tech . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:

• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.

• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ).

These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients.
Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow.
You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality.

(Please note: This is a IT Category focused Procurement role. This is not an internal procurement operations or Procurement technology implementation role.)

The Opportunity:

• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Lead your team in a fast-paced global environment to manage a diverse portfolio of solutions and programs (including cost transformations and critical negotiations) that deliver massive value for Digital and Tech stakeholders.

• Culture & Community Building: Cultivate a high-trust, inclusive environment. You will be a key driver in building a community where team members feel safe to share failures as learnings, celebrate successes together, and collaborate across boundaries to spark new ideas.

• Resource Orchestration: Dynamically balance resources to maximize impact; you will work across networks and squads to ensure the right talent is in the right place at the right time.

• Strategic Innovation & Problem Solving: Diagnose complex business needs within the Digital and Tech space, selecting the right approach (e.g. Solution versus program) seeking avenu

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Domain Architect – Pharma R&D is a senior, pivotal role within the SPG Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This role serves as the critical connector between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the Pharma R&D function. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Global Head of Digital Technology - Pharma R&D, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of the Pharma R&D environment.

Crucially, in our federated RDT model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Pharma R&D architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain architects embedded directly within the Pharma R&D organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready technology roadmaps.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural interface for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Pharma R&D domain, this involves deeply integrating with teams across Clinical Trial Execution, Discovery & Preclinical, Biometrics, and Regulatory Affairs to drive efficiency and innovation with end-to-end accountability. This role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and Pharma R&D’s operational execution is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Business Partnering: Act as the strategic liaison between SPG and Pharma R&D. Partner with the Global Head of Digital Technology - Pharma R&D and the R&D DT Leadership team to align business priorities with multi-year technology roadmaps and target-state architectures.

• Architecture Network Orchestration: Lead the Pharma R&D architecture network by shaping and promoting shared strategic priorities. Enable Domain and Solution Architects to execute efficiently while maintaining alignment and leveraging shared principles and platforms.

• Architecture Governance Leadership: Provide leadership for governance activities across Pharma R&D in collaboration with function embedded domain architects. Oversee architecture deliverables, technology guardrails, and create alignment on non-functional requirements (e.g., security, resilience).

• Critical Program Delivery & Domain Success: Drive the success of large, critical technology programs in Pharma R&D. Translate strategy into action and ensure transformative initiatives deliver intended business value while providing architectural oversight.

• Domain Architecture Deliverables: Lead the development and upkeep of core domain architecture artifacts for Pharma R&D. Ensure data accuracy across the technology and application inventory using the ArchiMEDES toolchain, delivering key outputs such as Capability Maps, Target-State Architectures, and Architecture Standards.

• Portfolio & Investment Alignment: Work with Pharma R&D Portfolio Management to embed architectural insights into investment decisions. Evaluate the impacts of strategies, address architectural gaps, and prevent fragmentation by maximizing platform reuse and minimizing technical debt.

• Technology Innovation & Vendor Evaluation: Monitor emerging technology trends and evaluate vendor

jobs.title: Domain Architect - Dia R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D is a senior-level, key position within the SPG Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This position plays a critical role between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the Diagnostics R&D function. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture - Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Head of Dia RDT for DIA R&D, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of the Diagnostics R&D environment.

Crucially, in our federated RDT model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Diagnostics R&D architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Diagnostics R&D organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready roadmaps.

Description of the Area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural point of contact for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Diagnostics R&D domain, this involves deeply integrating with teams such as DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, and DIA Portfolio & Project Management to drive efficiency and innovation with end-to-end accountability. This role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and Diagnostics R&D’s operational execution is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Business Partnering: Act as the strategic liaison between SPG EA and Diagnostics R&D. Partner with the Head of Dia RDT for DIA R&D and the R&D DT Leadership team to align business priorities with multi-year roadmaps and target-state architectures and ensure domain strategies are coherent with enterprise strategies.

• Architecture Network Orchestration: Lead the Diagnostics R&D architecture network by shaping and promoting shared strategic priorities. Enable Domain and Solution Architects to execute efficiently while maintaining alignment and maximizing the use of shared principles and platforms.

• Architecture Governance Leadership: Provide leadership for governance activities across Diagnostics R&D in collaboration with other embedded domain architects. Oversee architecture deliverables, technology guardrails, and create alignment on non-functional requirements (e.g., security, resilience). Represent architecture within other Governance bodies (e.g. Portfolio).

• Critical Program Delivery: Drive the success of large, critical technology programs in Diagnostics R&D. Translate strategy into action and ensure transformative initiatives deliver intended business value while providing architectural oversight.

• Domain Architecture Deliverables: Lead the development and upkeep of core architecture artifacts for Diagnostics R&D. Ensure data accuracy across the standard architecture and RDT toolchain, delivering key outputs such as Capability Maps, Target-State Architectures, Architecture Standards, and Reference Architectures.

• Portfolio & Investment Alignment: Work with Diagnostics R&D Portfolio Management and Functional Heads to embed architectural insights into investment decision

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D è una posizione chiave nel team di Strategy, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions. Questa posizione svolge un ruolo critico tra l'organizzazione Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) e la funzione Diagnostics R&D. Segnalandosi direttamente al Capo delle Imprese Architettura Business Partnering Functions con una linea tratteggiata al Capo di Dia RDT per DIA R&D, sarete campioni delle nostre pratiche di architettura aziendale, pur comprendendo profondamente le complessità uniche dell'ambiente Diagnostics R&D. Crucialmente, nel nostro modello Roche Digital Technology (RDT) federato, si agirà come il principale orchestratore della rete di architettura Diagnostics R&D. Con la guida di questa rete, che include te stesso insieme a tutti gli architetti di dominio e soluzioni incorporati direttamente all'interno dell'organizzazione Diagnostics R&D, guiderai la governance dell'architettura e la formulazione di strategia, garantirai la coerenza delle imprese e tradurrai gli obiettivi aziendali in roadmap adattabili e future. Descrizione dell'Area L'area Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions funge da punto di contatto architettonico strategico per i leader del dominio aziendale, favorendo la collaborazione per allineare applicazioni, capacità aziendali e asset informativi con soluzioni tecnologiche. Per il dominio Diagnostics R&D, questo implica profondamente l'integrazione con team come DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, e DIA Portfolio & Project Management per guidare l'efficienza e l'innovazione con la responsabilità finale. Questo ruolo assicura che il ponte tra la visione aziendale di SPG e l'esecuzione operativa di Diagnostics R&D sia senza soluzione di continuità, collaborativo e altamente efficace. L'opportunità:
• Agirai come collegamento strategico tra SPG EA e Diagnostics R&D, collaborando con la leadership per allineare le priorità aziendali con roadmap pluriennali.
• Guidate la rete di architettura R&D Diagnostics, modellando le priorità strategiche condivise e consentendo agli architetti di eseguire mantenendo l'allineamento delle imprese.
• Fornire la leadership per le attività di governance dell'architettura, supervisionare i materiali di consegna e le protezioni tecnologiche per garantire la sicurezza e la resilienza.
• Si guida il successo di grandi e critici programmi di tecnologia, traducendo la strategia in iniziative attuabili e trasformative che forniscono valore aziendale.
• Sviluppi e mantieni manufatti di architettura di base, tra cui Capability Maps e Target-State Architectures, utilizzando la toolchain standard RDT.
• Collaborate con Portfolio Management per incorporare intuizioni architettoniche sulle decisioni di investimento, massimizzando il riutilizzo della piattaforma e la gestione del debito tecnico.
• Monitora le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti e valuta i fornitori per garantire che l'architettura R&D di Diagnostics rimanga innovativa e pronta per il futuro.
• Influenzi un modello RDT complesso e federato, bilanciando la coerenza aziendale con l'agilità necessaria per l'esecuzione operativa locale. Chi sei:
• Si possiede un Master e portare 7+ anni di esperienza nell'architettura IT e enterprise, specificamente all'interno di organizzazioni globali complesse, matrici o federazioni.
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza di dominio in Diagnostics R&D, con una comprensione completa dei processi scientifici, clinici e ingegneristici, dalla scienza computazionale e dalla strumentazione all'operazione di laboratorio a secco e umido

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job facts

You will be part of the Antibody Characterization team of the subchapter “Antibody Development” which is part of to the “Antibody and Protein Technologies” unit of the Chapter Area “Reagent Research and Design”. The subchapter has its focus on the discovery, selection, and characterization of protein-based reagents for immunological diagnostic assays.
The goal of the proposed position is to extend and optimize the technical capabilities of the current automation workflows for protein chemistry and immune reagent screening.

Your work will focus on the following aspects:

• You will actively participate in on-going projects to optimize antibody-based reagents development in the context of high-throughput automation technologies.

• You will support the routine processes with lab automation systems to prepare and analyze these reagents.

• You will co-develop, implement, and run an integrated immune reagent screening procedure, which will include liquid handler programming.

• You will review and evaluate scientific literature and present your findings.

• You will work in close cooperation with several teams distributed over different departments (Protein Chemistry, Antibody and Test development as well as Biostatistics).

Who you are
In hiring new employees, we look for people who are also inspired by our mission and who would fit in well with the collaborative spirit of the company culture.

• Basic knowledge in Biochemistry and Immunology.

• Background knowledge about different protein purification strategies. First experience in protein labeling and automated liquid handling is a plus.

• Basic knowledge in bioanalytical techniques. First experience in instrumental analytics is a plus (UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Strong interest in learning and applying new laboratory techniques for immunological reagent development.

• Good proficiency in spoken and written English, working knowledge of German would be beneficial.

La posizione
Fatti di lavoro

Sarete parte del team di caratterizzazione Anticorpo del sottocapitolo “Sviluppo Anticorpo” che fa parte dell’unità “Antibody and Protein Technologies” dell’Area Capitolo “Reagent Research and Design”. Il subchapter si concentra sulla scoperta, la selezione e la caratterizzazione dei reagenti basati sulle proteine per i test diagnostici immunologici.
L'obiettivo della posizione proposta è quello di estendere e ottimizzare le capacità tecniche dei flussi di lavoro di automazione attuali per la chimica delle proteine e lo screening dei reagenti immunitari.

Il vostro lavoro si concentrerà sui seguenti aspetti:

• Parteciperete attivamente a progetti in corso per ottimizzare lo sviluppo di reagenti anticorpo nel contesto delle tecnologie di automazione ad alto rendimento.

• Supporterete i processi di routine con i sistemi di automazione del laboratorio per preparare e analizzare questi reagenti.

• Potrai co-sviluppare, implementare e eseguire una procedura di screening del reagente immunitario integrato, che includerà la programmazione del maniglione liquido.

• Potrai rivedere e valutare la letteratura scientifica e presentare i tuoi risultati.

• Si lavorerà in stretta collaborazione con diverse squadre distribuite su diversi reparti (Protein Chemistry, Antibody and Test development e Biostatistics).

Chi sei
Nell'assunzione di nuovi dipendenti, cerchiamo persone che sono anche ispirate alla nostra missione e che si adattano bene allo spirito collaborativo della cultura aziendale.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, sarete o avrete:

• Conoscenza di base in Biochimica e Immunologia.

• Conoscenza di fondo sulle diverse strategie di purificazione delle proteine. La prima esperienza nell'etichettatura delle proteine e nella gestione automatizzata dei liquidi è un vantaggio.

• Conoscenza di base nelle tecniche bioanalitiche. La prima esperienza nell'analisi strumentale è un plus (UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Forte interesse nell'apprendimento e nell'applicazione di nuove tecniche di laboratorio per lo sviluppo di reagente immunologico.

• Buona competenza in inglese parlato e scritto, la conoscenza di lavoro del tedesco sarebbe utile.

• Buona conoscenza di MS Office. Ulteriori conoscenze IT e di programmazione è un plus.

• In grado di lavorare in un team con flessibilità e impegno.

I vostri vantaggi:

• Gestione del tempo flessibile

• 2.268 € salario al mese per uno stage a tempo pieno > 3 mesi

• Riduzione dei prezzi dei pasti (-50%) nella nostra mensa dei dipendenti

• Centro fitness nel campus Roche

• Rete con altri studenti

• La possibilità di alloggio nella Roche Boarding House o comodi collegamenti di trasporto a Monaco con il Roche Shuttle

Inizia da Jan 2027 per 6 mesi.

Tenete a mente che questo stage è diretto solo agli studenti (m/f/d) che sono attualmente iscritti all'università o sono nel loro anno di Gap (tra gli studi di Bachelor e Master).

Siamo entusiasti di vedere la vostra applicazione!

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenangaben

Sie werden Teil des Antikörper-Charakterisierungsteams des Unterkapitels "Antikörperentwicklung", das Teil der Abteilung "Antikörper- und Proteintechnologien" des Kapitelbereichs "Reagensforschung und -design" ist. Das Unterkapitel konzentriert sich auf die Entdeckung, Auswahl und Charakterisierung von proteinbasierten Reagenzien für immunologische diagnostische Assays.
Ziel der vorgeschlagenen Position ist es, die technischen Möglichkeiten der aktuellen Automatisierungs-Workflows für die Proteinchemie und das Immunreagenz-Screening zu erweitern und zu optimieren.

Ihre Arbeit wird sich auf folgende Aspekte konzentrieren:

• Sie beteiligen sich aktiv an laufenden Projekten zur Optimierung der Entwicklung antikörperbasierter Reagenzien im Rahmen von Hochdurchsatz-Automatisierungstechnologien.

• Sie unterstützen die Routineprozesse mit Laborautomatisierungssystemen zur Vorbereitung und Analyse dieser Reagenzien.

• Sie entwickeln, implementieren und führen ein integriertes Immunreagens-Screening-Verfahren durch, das die Programmierung von Liquid Handlern umfasst.

• Sie werden wissenschaftliche Literatur überprüfen und bewerten und Ihre Ergebnisse präsentieren.

• Sie arbeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Teams, die über verschiedene Abteilungen verteilt sind (Proteinchemie, Antikörper- und Testentwicklung sowie Biostatistik).

Wer du bist
Bei der Einstellung neuer Mitarbeiter suchen wir Menschen, die sich auch von unserer Mission inspirieren lassen und die sich gut in den Kooperationsgeist der Unternehmenskultur einfügen.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, werden Sie sein oder haben:

• Grundkenntnisse in Biochemie und Immunologie.

• Hintergrundwissen über verschiedene Proteinreinigungsstrategien. Erste Erfahrungen in der Proteinkennzeichnung und im automatisierten Liquid Handling sind ein Plus.

• Grundkenntnisse in bioanalytischen Techniken. Erste Erfahrungen in der instrumentellen Analytik sind ein Plus (UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Starkes Interesse am Erlernen und Anwenden neuer Labortechniken zur Entwicklung immunologischer Reagenzien.

• Gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch, Arbeitskenntnisse in Deutsch wären von Vorteil.

• Gute MS Office Kenntnisse. Weiteres IT- und Programmierwissen ist ein Plus.

• Kann in einem Team mit Flexibilität und Engagement arbeiten.

Ihre Vorteile:

• Flexibles Zeitmanagement

• 2.268 € Gehalt pro Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Reduzierte Mahlzeitenpreise (-50%) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesscenter auf dem Roche Campus

• Networking mit anderen Studierenden

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House oder bequeme Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit dem Roche Shuttle

Beachten Sie, dass dieses Praktikum nur an Studierende (m/w/d) gerichtet ist, die derzeit an der Universität eingeschrieben sind oder sich in ihrem Lückenjahr (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium) befinden.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Faits sur le travail

Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de caractérisation d'anticorps du sous-chapitre Développement d'anticorps qui fait partie de l'unité d'anticorps et de protéines de l'aire de chapitre Recherche et conception d'anticorps. Le sous-chapitre met l'accent sur la découverte, la sélection et la caractérisation de réactifs à base de protéines pour les essais diagnostiques immunologiques.
L'objectif de la position proposée est d'étendre et d'optimiser les capacités techniques des flux de travail d'automatisation actuels pour la chimie des protéines et le dépistage du réactif immunitaire.

Votre travail portera sur les aspects suivants :

• Vous participerez activement à des projets en cours visant à optimiser le développement de réactifs à base d'anticorps dans le contexte des technologies d'automatisation à haut débit.

• Vous supporterez les processus de routine avec les systèmes d'automatisation de laboratoire pour préparer et analyser ces réactifs.

• Vous allez co-élaborer, mettre en œuvre et exécuter une procédure intégrée de dépistage du réactif immunitaire, qui comprendra la programmation du gestionnaire de liquide.

• Vous examinerez et évaluerez la littérature scientifique et présenterez vos conclusions.

• Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec plusieurs équipes réparties dans différents départements (Protein Chemistry, Antibody et Test de développement ainsi que Biostatistics).

Qui vous êtes
En embauchant de nouveaux employés, nous recherchons des personnes qui sont également inspirées par notre mission et qui s'intégreraient bien à l'esprit de collaboration de la culture de l'entreprise.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous serez ou aurez :

• Connaissances de base en biochimie et immunologie.

• Connaissances générales sur différentes stratégies de purification des protéines. La première expérience dans l'étiquetage des protéines et la manipulation automatisée des liquides est un plus.

• Connaissances de base en techniques de bioanalyse. La première expérience en analyse instrumentale est un plus (UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Un vif intérêt pour l'apprentissage et l'application de nouvelles techniques de laboratoire pour le développement de réactifs immunologiques.

• Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit, la connaissance pratique de l'allemand serait bénéfique.

• Bonne connaissance de MS Office. D'autres connaissances en TI et en programmation sont un atout.

• Capacité de travailler en équipe avec souplesse et engagement.

Vos avantages :

• Gestion flexible du temps

• 2.268 € salaire par mois pour un stage à temps plein > 3 mois

• Réduction des prix des repas (-50%) dans notre cantine

• Centre de fitness sur le campus de Roche

• Réseautage avec d'autres étudiants

• La possibilité d'un hébergement dans la Maison d'embarquement Roche ou des liaisons de transport pratiques à Munich avec la navette Roche

Départ à partir de janvier 2027 pour 6 mois.

Votre demande :
Avec votre CV/résume, veuillez fournir une lettre d'accompagnement expliquant les raisons pour lesquelles vous aimeriez être stagiaire à Roche Diagnostics. Les candidatures pour ce poste peuvent être envoyées en allemand ou en anglais.

Gardez à l'esprit que ce stage ne s'adresse qu'aux étudiants (m/f/d) qui sont actuellement inscrits à l'université ou qui sont dans leur année d'écart (entre les études de baccalauréat et de maîtrise).

Nous sommes ravis de voir votre candidature!

Veuillez noter que les références pour toutes les activités étudiantes (par exemple les stages, les thèses, etc.) sont exclues.

Votre contact avec nous ! Avec des gens. Pour les gens.
Avez-vous besoin d'un soutien supplémentaire?
Consultez nos FAQ, vous les trouverez via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Methodology Coaching . Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Business Value & Success Factors: Understanding the business goals and value of the project to deliver defined organizational benefits, while ensuring critical success factors (reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time-to-value) are managed throughout the entire lifecycle.

• Methodology & Execution: Using the appropriate methodology (Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) to manage dependencies and set clear priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Global Team Leadership: Leading or participating in global project teams by ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and precise resource assignment to project plan deliverables.

• Stakeholder & Change Management: Effectively managing stakeholders and understanding their organizations to establish key relationships, while applying organizational change management practices and ensuring effective project communication.

• Facilitation & Coaching: Designing and leading workshops, acting as a proactive facilitator, and serving as a comfortable coach for project squads.

• Planning & Risk Management: Generating, maintaining, and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan alongside a project risk and issue log, ensuring the project status remains timely and transparent.

• Governance & Reporting: Preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the chosen project methodology and good project management practice.

• Financial Control: Tracking project financials and seeking governance approvals whenever needed.

• Business Development: Contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

Capability Building
Be an active member of the Methodology Coaching Chapter by

• Continuously improve the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your project management upskilling

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• Appropriate university degree and 5+ years of project management related work experience

• Deep understanding of project management fundamentals (Waterfall) and agile ways of working (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), alon

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) vise à « transformer le fonctionnement de Roche ». En tant qu'organisation mondiale de plus de 3 500 collègues, nous permettons à Roche de fonctionner dans un environnement commercial concurrentiel et en constante évolution. Nous fournissons à nos partenaires des services et des solutions d'affaires de bout en bout, leur permettant de se concentrer sur les activités centrées sur le patient. En prenant en compte un état d'esprit OneRoche, nous mettons à profit notre réseau mondial situé à Budapest (Hongrie), Riga (Lettonie), Chennai & Hyderabad (Inde), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaisie) et nos autres sites pour rester axés sur le client 24/7 et co-créer des solutions ensemble.

L'opportunité
En tant que gestionnaire de projet, vous faites partie de l'organisation de gestion de projet RSS et faites rapport au responsable du chapitre sur la méthodologie. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la réussite de l'exécution de projet en utilisant une méthodologie de gestion de projet agile ou traditionnelle. Votre travail comprendra entre autres :

Engagement

• Facteurs de valeur opérationnelle et de réussite : Comprendre les objectifs opérationnels et la valeur du projet pour obtenir des avantages organisationnels définis, tout en veillant à ce que les facteurs de réussite critiques (fiabilité, conformité, efficience, durabilité, durée de vie) soient gérés tout au long du cycle de vie.

• Méthodologie et exécution : Utiliser la méthodologie appropriée (Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) pour gérer les dépendances et établir des priorités claires dans un environnement à rythme rapide.

• Leadership de l'équipe mondiale : Diriger ou participer à des équipes de projet mondiales en garantissant des rôles, des responsabilités et une affectation précise des ressources aux produits livrables du plan de projet.

• Gestion des intervenants et du changement : Gérer efficacement les intervenants et comprendre leur organisation pour établir des relations clés, tout en appliquant les pratiques de gestion du changement organisationnel et en assurant une communication efficace des projets.

• Facilitation et coaching : Concevoir et diriger des ateliers, agir comme facilitateur proactif, et servir d'entraîneur confortable pour les équipes de projet.

• Planification et gestion des risques : produire, tenir à jour et suivre un plan de projet précis et réaliste en même temps qu'un registre des risques et des enjeux du projet, en veillant à ce que l'état du projet demeure opportun et transparent.

• Gouvernance et rapports : Préparer et présenter aux réunions de gouvernance pertinentes, selon la méthodologie choisie et les bonnes pratiques de gestion de projet.

• Contrôle financier : suivre les finances des projets et obtenir des approbations de gouvernance au besoin.

• Développement des entreprises : contribuer aux possibilités de développement des entreprises, le cas échéant

Renforcement des capacités

• Améliorer continuellement les capacités de gestion de projet, les offres de services et l'engagement communautaire en tirant parti des derniers développements et de la dynamique du marché

• Soutenir le développement de contenus de formation et d'outils pour notre équipe

• Gestion active de votre gestion de projet

• Appliquer vos apprentissages pendant vos engagements et les partager avec vos collègues de chapitre

Qui vous êtes
Vous possédez les qualifications, l'expérience et les attributs personnels suivants

• Diplôme universitaire approprié et 5 ans et plus d'expérience de travail liée à la gestion de projet

• Compréhension approfondie des principes fondamentaux de gestion de projet (Waterfall) et des méthodes de travail agiles (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), alon

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Proprietario del prodotto tecnico Affiliazione Produttività

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

L'opportunità

Questo ruolo si basa nella nostra divisione commerciale RDT Diagnostics all'interno del team di Affiliazione Produttività, che si concentra sulla fornitura di prodotti digitali efficaci e l'ottimizzazione di soluzioni tecnologiche internazionali. Operiamo in un ecosistema altamente collaborativo, garantendo le nostre strategie commerciali globali in grado di rafforzare senza soluzione di continuità le esigenze di affiliazione locale e ottimizzare l'esecuzione della forza di campo commerciale. L'ampia gamma di iniziative e il legame profondo con le operazioni aziendali globali offrono una piattaforma straordinaria per espandere le tue competenze strategiche di consegna. Come parte integrata del team, il vostro focus principale comprenderà:

• Definire e controllare Scopo: Indipendentemente condurre la definizione di portata, il monitoraggio e la mitigazione del rischio per le iniziative medie e grandi, garantendo un allineamento completo con gli obiettivi di dominio commerciale.

• Risolvere problemi di consegna: Guidare l'analisi della causa principale strutturata per i blocchi stradali complessi di consegna, progettare piani di miglioramento completi e guidare pragmaticamente i team attraverso l'ambiguità.

• Gestisci i Paesaggi degli stakeholder: Costruire relazioni di consulenza affidabili in diverse aree funzionali, modellare proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder e navigare con successo i conflitti per mantenere l'allineamento.

• Ottimizzare l'impatto aziendale: Tradurre le esigenze commerciali di business in strategie di consegna altamente efficaci, guidando miglioramenti continui delle prestazioni attraverso le linee di prodotto assegnate.

• Metodologie di consegna adattate: selezionare e personalizzare i quadri di esecuzione (modelli agili, Scrum o ibridi) per gestire complesse versioni di funzionalità, transizioni di servizio o incrementi di rilascio del software.

• Foster Team Spirit & Growth: Campioni una cultura di responsabilità e costruisci lo spirito della comunità guidando i colleghi e collegando strettamente lo sviluppo del team con obiettivi di business di alto livello.

Chi sei?

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto di fornitura analitico e relazionale che possa collegare l'esecuzione tecnica con le realtà commerciali, prosperando in reti di stakeholder complesse.

• Esperienza: Provato record di traccia che opera in un archetipo di Delivery Management (come Project Manager, Service Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, o Agile Coach) che gestisce medie e grandi iniziative, transizioni di servizio, o incrementi di prodotto.

• Attuazione tecnica: Forte sfondo nel tradurre i complessi requisiti aziendali in piani di implementazione strategica, combinati con l'esperienza che contribuisce alla pianificazione aziendale e alla previsione.

• Metodologia & Tooling: Alta competenza nella selezione, annuncio

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Productivité d'affiliation du propriétaire du produit technique

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

L'opportunité

Ce rôle est basé sur notre division RDT Diagnostics Commercial au sein de l'équipe Productivité Affiliée, qui se concentre sur la livraison de produits numériques impactés et l'optimisation des solutions technologiques internationales. Nous opérons dans un écosystème hautement collaboratif, assurant à nos stratégies commerciales mondiales une gestion transparente des besoins des filiales locales et optimisant l'exécution des forces commerciales sur le terrain. La diversité des initiatives et le lien profond avec les opérations commerciales mondiales vous offrent une plateforme formidable pour développer vos compétences stratégiques en matière de prestation de services. En tant que partie intégrante de l'équipe, votre objectif principal sera :

• Définir et contrôler Portée : Diriger de façon indépendante la définition de la portée, le suivi et l'atténuation des risques pour les initiatives de taille moyenne à grande, en assurant l'harmonisation complète avec les objectifs du domaine commercial.

• Résoudre les problèmes liés à la livraison : Diriger l'analyse structurée des causes profondes pour les barrages routiers complexes, concevoir des plans d'amélioration complets et guider les équipes de façon pragmatique par l'ambiguïté.

• Gérer les paysages des intervenants : établir des relations de confiance entre les conseillers dans divers domaines fonctionnels, façonner de façon proactive les perspectives des intervenants et naviguer avec succès les conflits pour maintenir l'alignement.

• Maximiser l'impact des affaires : Traduire les besoins des entreprises commerciales en stratégies de livraison hautement efficaces, conduisant à des améliorations continues de la performance dans vos gammes de produits assignées.

• Adapter les méthodes de livraison : Sélectionner et personnaliser les cadres d'exécution (modèles agiles, Scrum ou hybrides) pour gérer les versions complexes de fonctionnalités, les transitions de service ou les incréments de versions logicielles.

• Favoriser l'esprit d'équipe et la croissance : championne d'une culture de responsabilisation et renforce l'esprit communautaire en tutorant des collègues et en établissant un lien étroit entre le développement d'équipes individuelles et les objectifs opérationnels de haut niveau.

Qui vous êtes :

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un expert analytique, axé sur les relations, capable de relier l'exécution technique aux réalités commerciales tout en florissant dans des réseaux d'intervenants complexes.

• Expérience : Expérience éprouvée dans un archétype de gestion de la livraison (comme le gestionnaire de projet, le gestionnaire de services, Scrum Master, RTE ou Agile Coach) gérant des initiatives moyennes à grandes, des transitions de service ou des incréments de produits.

• Mise en œuvre technique : Forte expérience de la traduction des exigences opérationnelles complexes en plans stratégiques de mise en oeuvre, combinée à l'expérience de la planification et des prévisions opérationnelles.

• Méthodologie & outillage: Haute compétence dans la sélection, publicité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Quality Unit in Kaiseraugst/Basel besteht aus Quality Assurance (QA), Qualitätskontrolle (QC), Quality Systems (QS) sowie Quality Compliance und Issues. Wir garantieren die Qualität und Compliance von über 40 Produktfamilien für mehr als 120 Länder in einem integrierten Drug Product- und Verpackungsstandort. Zudem sind wir für die zentralisierte QC und den hier durchgeführten Freigabe- und Stabilitätsprüfungen von sterilen und nicht- sterilen Produkten sowie Ausgangs- und Packmaterialien verantwortlich.
Unsere Philosophie ist es, dass Qualität das Recht eines jeden Patienten ist, dass wir dafür die Verantwortung übernehmen und unseren Teil dazu beitragen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Du treibst die Harmonisierung von Abläufen und Prozesse durch gezielte Prozessverbesserungen voran – zunächst in der QA für QC und perspektivisch innerhalb der gesamten Quality Unit.

• Du zeigst grosses Interesse daran, vor- und nachgelagerte Schritte zu analysieren und zu optimieren, wobei Du stets eine teamorientierte Denkweise im Sinne der Steigerung von Qualität und Effizienz pflegst.

• Du unterstützt uns bei der Konzeption, Gestaltung und Trainings für SOPs sowie weitere GMP-relevante Dokumentationen und Abläufe.

• Du begleitest die Migration von Google Tools hin zu Microsoft-Anwendungen, übernimmst dabei Projektverantwortung und stehst den Teams beratend zur Seite.

• Die Implementierung sowie das Testing innovativer AI Tools gehören ebenso zu Deinem spannenden Aufgabengebiet.

• Du übernimmst das eigenständige Handling administrativer Abläufe und stimmst Dich dazu vertrauensvoll mit den jeweiligen Teams ab.

Wer du bist
Du bist immatrikuliert an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule im Bereich Pharmazie, Chemie, Biologie, (Wirtschafts-)ingenieurwesen, IT oder verwandten Fachgebieten, oder hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, dass nicht länger als 12 Monate zurückliegt.
Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn du Folgendes mitbringst:

• eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team- Fähigkeiten und bringst eine offene und qualitätsorientierte Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt wird.

• Proaktivität und Hands-on Mentalität. Bereitschaft, mit hohem Mass an Eigenverantwortung in einem offenen, konstruktiven und kollaborativen Umfeld zu arbeiten.

• Eine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und „Can-Do“- Einstellung. Ausserdem vertraust du dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up und Fehlerkultur.

Des Weiteren besitzt du:

• Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie gute Präsentationsskills

• Umfassende Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Google Tools, MS Office Anwendungen (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) und AI Tools

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (fliessend in Wort und Schrift)

• Gewissenhaftigkeit im Umgang mit Geschäftsdokumenten, Kreativität, Ideenreichtum und Innovation

• Kenntnisse und überzeugter Einsatz bezüglich Prozessverbesserungen (z.B. LPS) sowie Agile Management sind von Vorteil.

Bewerbungsprozess

• Für die Bewerbung benötigen wir eine gültige Immatrikulationsbestätigung oder ein Diplom, ein Motivationsschreiben und einen Lebenslauf.

• Nicht-EU / EFTA-Bürger*innen müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist, den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen.

• Diese Praktikumsstelle ist nicht für Bachelor / Master Thesen geeigne

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'unità di qualità in Kaiseraugst/Basel è costituita da Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), Quality Systems (QS) e Quality Compliance and Issues. Garantiamo la qualità e la conformità di oltre 40 famiglie di prodotti per oltre 120 paesi in un unico sito di prodotti e imballaggi integrati. Inoltre, siamo responsabili del QC centralizzato e del test di rilascio e stabilità dei prodotti sterili e non sterili, nonché delle materie prime e dei materiali di imballaggio.
La nostra filosofia è che la qualità è il diritto di ogni paziente, che ci assumiamo la responsabilità e facciamo la nostra parte.

La possibilità

• Si guida l'armonizzazione dei processi e dei processi attraverso miglioramenti mirati di processo – prima in QA per QC e in prospettiva all'interno dell'intera unità di qualità.

• Si mostra grande interesse nell'analisi e nell'ottimizzazione dei passi a monte e a valle, mantenendo sempre una mentalità orientata al team nel senso di aumentare la qualità e l'efficienza.

• Ci supporta nella concezione, nella progettazione e nella formazione per le SOP, nonché in altri documenti e processi GMP rilevanti.

• Potrai accompagnare la migrazione da Google Tools alle applicazioni Microsoft, assumersi la responsabilità del progetto e consigliare i team.

• L'implementazione e il collaudo di strumenti AI innovativi fanno parte anche dell'emozionante area di attività.

• Si occupa della gestione indipendente dei processi amministrativi e si coordina con le rispettive squadre in sicurezza.

Chi sei
Sei iscritto a un'università o università di scienze applicate nei campi di farmacia, chimica, biologia, ingegneria (economica), IT o campi correlati, o hanno un diploma di laurea completa o master che non è stato completato più di 12 mesi fa.
Sei una soluzione perfetta per noi se porti i seguenti:

• una personalità positiva, integrità e autoriflettente con forti capacità di squadra e portare un atteggiamento aperto e orientato alla qualità e mentalità che è necessario per il lavoro di successo nel vostro team e in tutti i reparti.

• Proattività e mentalità hands-on. La volontà di lavorare con un alto grado di responsabilità personale in un ambiente aperto, costruttivo e collaborativo.

• Un atteggiamento di base orientato alla soluzione e un atteggiamento “can-do”. Inoltre, ti fidi di te stesso e degli altri, prenditi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta di conversazione e di errore.

Hai anche:

• Forte capacità analitiche e concettuali

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e buone capacità di presentazione

• Conoscenza completa dell'applicazione di strumenti Google, applicazioni MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) e strumenti AI

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese (fluente nelle parole e nella scrittura)

• Coscienza nel trattare documenti aziendali, creatività, creatività e innovazione

• La conoscenza e l'impegno convinto di elaborare miglioramenti (ad esempio LPS) e Agile Management sono vantaggiosi.

Processo di applicazione

• Per l'applicazione, abbiamo bisogno di una valida conferma di matricolazione o di un diploma, una lettera di motivazione e un CV.

• I cittadini non UE/EFTA devono concludere una conferma dall'università che uno stage obbligatorio fa parte della formazione con i documenti di richiesta.

• Questo stage non è adatto per Bachelor / Master tesi

The possibility

• You drive the harmonization of processes and processes through targeted process improvements – first in QA for QC and perspectively within the entire Quality Unit.

• You show great interest in analysing and optimising upstream and downstream steps, always maintaining a team-oriented mindset in the sense of increasing quality and efficiency.

• You support us in the conception, design and training for SOPs as well as other GMP-relevant documentation and processes.

• You will accompany the migration from Google Tools to Microsoft applications, take on project responsibility and advise the teams.

• The implementation and testing of innovative AI tools are also part of your exciting task area.

• You take over the independent handling of administrative processes and coordinate with the respective teams in confidence.

Who you are
You are enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences in the fields of pharmacy, chemistry, biology, (economic) engineering, IT or related fields, or have a completed bachelor's or master's degree that has not been completed more than 12 months ago.
You are a perfect fit for us if you bring the following:

• a positive, integrity and self-reflective personality with strong team skills and bring an open and quality-oriented attitude and mindset that is needed for successful work in your team and across departments.

• Proactivity and hands-on mentality. Willingness to work with a high degree of personal responsibility in an open, constructive and collaborative environment.

• A solution-oriented basic attitude and “can-do” attitude. In addition, you trust yourself and others, take responsibility and live an open speak-up and error culture.

You also have:

• Strong analytical and conceptual skills

• Good communication skills and good presentation skills

• Comprehensive knowledge of the application of Google Tools, MS Office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and AI tools

• Very good knowledge of German and English (fluent in words and writing)

• Conscientiousness in dealing with business documents, creativity, creativity and innovation

• Knowledge and convinced commitment to process improvements (e.g. LPS) as well as Agile Management are beneficial.

Application process

• For the application, we need a valid matriculation confirmation or a diploma, a letter of motivation and a CV.

• Non-EU/EFTA citizens must enclose a confirmation from the university that a mandatory internship is part of the training with the application documents.

• This internship is not suitable for Bachelor / Master theses

• Customer Satisfaction: assicura che tutti i clienti siano pienamente soddisfatti della loro installazione di prodotti IT.

Sei un professionista di assistenza precoce e media con una vasta esperienza di lavoro su questioni che richiedono la valutazione di molti fattori. Esercitare un giudizio appropriato nella scelta dei metodi di valutazione e determinare le soluzioni è fondamentale. Inoltre, siete comodi a coordinare le attività di altri, in rete con personale senior interno ed esterno nella vostra area di competenza, e in rete con contatti chiave al di fuori della vostra area di competenza

Requisiti minimi:

• Corso di laurea in Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, Tecnologia medica, Scienze della vita E 2 anni di laboratorio IT, IT generale, esperienza della linea di prodotto,

O

• 4 anni di esperienza di laboratorio IT, IT generale o linea di prodotto

Preferiti:

• Il candidato dovrebbe essere in grado di viaggiare 25% o più ai siti dei clienti

• Il candidato dovrebbe risiedere entro 50 miglia di un importante aeroporto metropolitano degli Stati Uniti

• Un anno di esperienza di progettazione o gestione del processo, che dimostra la capacità di multitask e gestire il tempo in modo efficace

• Esperienza di istotecnologo o di patologia

• Fluency with health standards and technologies (HL7, ASTM, HIPAA, Networking, Microsoft Windows, Cache Intersystems, Windows Server, SQL, Digital Pathology)

• Conoscenza approfondita della base clinica dei clienti e dei componenti critici di un LIS e dei processi IT di laboratorio e flussi di lavoro

• Dimostrare una comunicazione efficace e risoluzione dei problemi con i requisiti per i gruppi tecnici e non tecnici

• Capacità di valutare processi complessi e applicare competenze di pensiero critico per completare incarichi che sono complessi in natura

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Gelegenheit:

Der Digital Solutions Engineer bietet technische Beratung zur Unterstützung einer Vielzahl von Post-Sales-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Installation, Test, Integration und Wartung von Roche Diagnostic Commercial (RDC) Produkten. Dies umfasst die Beratung von Vertrieb und Kunden zu RDC-Systemproduktlösungen und die Integration in die medizinischen Systeme der Kunden (LIS, EMR usw.). Während ein Großteil dieser Arbeit aus der Ferne ausgeführt wird, erfordert diese Position eine Reise von 25% oder mehr zu den Kundenstandorten für Beratung und / oder Installation, Problemlösung und Teilnahme an Teambesprechungen nach Bedarf. Dies ist eine entfernte Position.

Standort:

Dies ist eine entfernte, feldbasierte Position

Schlüsselrollen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Installationsmanagement: Verantwortlich für die Verwaltung der Installation von IT-Produktlösungen bei Kunden vor Ort, sowohl aus der Ferne als auch vor Ort.

• Bedarfsbeurteilung und -erwartungen: Bestimmt die Kundenbedürfnisse und setzt angemessene Installationserwartungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ressourcen innerhalb des angegebenen Zeitrahmens ausgerichtet und verfügbar sind.

• Lösungsvalidierung: Führt Validierungsprozesse durch, um die Effektivität von IT-Lösungen zu bewerten.

• Kundenzufriedenheit: Stellt sicher, dass alle Kunden mit ihrer IT-Produktinstallation voll und ganz zufrieden sind.

• Technischer Support und Problemmanagement: Dient als technische Ressource für komplexe Systemprobleme, verwaltet kritische Kundensituationen und behebt Fehler während der Installations- und Nachlaufphasen.

Darüber hinaus koordinieren Sie gerne die Aktivitäten anderer, vernetzen sich mit internen und externen Führungskräften in Ihrem Fachgebiet und vernetzen sich mit wichtigen Kontakten außerhalb Ihres Fachgebiets.

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences UND 2 Jahre Labor IT, allgemeine IT, Produktlinienerfahrung,

ODER

• 4 Jahre Labor IT, allgemeine IT oder Produktlinie Erfahrung

• Austausch von Gesundheitsstandards und -technologien (HL7, ASTM, HIPAA, Networking, Microsoft Windows, Cache Intersystems, Windows Server, SQL, Digital Pathology)

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Prozesse zu bewerten und kritische Denkfähigkeiten anzuwenden, um komplexe Aufgaben zu erfüllen
