Ein Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt darin, strategische Partnerschaften mit Versicherungsunternehmen zu schmieden und Hand in Hand mit ihnen zu arbeiten, um den Erstattungsprozess für unsere innovativen Lösungen zu optimieren und zu optimieren. Der Healthcare System Partner (HSP) ist ein führendes Unternehmen und das lokale Gesicht von Roche und arbeitet eng mit Interessengruppen auf Systemebene wie Anbietern und Kostenträgern zusammen. Die HSP identifiziert gemeinsame Zwecke und Werte, ko-kreiert Lösungen und ko-implementiert sie über Ökosysteme hinweg, was sich indirekt auf die Ergebnisse für Tausende von Patienten auswirkt. Auf diese Weise wird die HSP direkt verantwortlich sein, um das Gesundheitssystem herauszufordern und zu gestalten, um bessere Gesundheitsergebnisse für mehr Patienten schneller und nachhaltiger für die Gesellschaft zu erzielen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten
- Die HSP arbeitet mit Versicherungsunternehmen, RCMs und Kostenträgern zusammen, um die Innovation des Gesundheitssystems voranzutreiben, Erstattungswege zu rationalisieren und Möglichkeiten zu erschließen, Wert für das Ökosystem und die Gesellschaft zu schaffen.
- Die HSP entwickelt, pflegt und verwaltet aktiv langfristige strategische Partnerschaften mit wichtigen Versicherungsanbietern, um einen nahtlosen Marktzugang und effiziente Genehmigungsprozesse zu gewährleisten.
- Als Teil davon trägt das HSP zur Identifizierung, Kartierung, Einbeziehung und Verwaltung von Ökosystem-Stakeholdern bei.
- Die HSP fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und primärer Ansprechpartner zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche. Sie oder er teilt die Vision und den Wert der Stakeholder-Community intern, priorisiert und sichert Ressourcen und treibt Lösungen voran, die schneller Ergebnisse liefern.
- Die HSP lebt das Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) Modell, agiert als Katalysator und Coach extern und intern.
- Die Rolle ist in der Lage, Fachwissen und Ressourcen lokal und nach Bedarf aus dem Netzwerk zu beziehen, auch in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Gesundheitssystempartnern und Patientenreisepartnern.

Wer bist du?
Erforderliche Ausbildung und Erfahrung
- Universitätsabschluss (wissenschaftlicher, wirtschaftlicher oder geschäftlicher Abschluss). Ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss in Life Science und / oder MBA ist ein Plus.
- Praktisches, eingehendes Verständnis des Gesundheitsversicherungssystems und der Erstattungslandschaft in den VAE
- Tiefes Verständnis von Gesundheitssystem, Prozessen und Governance
- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Krankenkassen, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz bei der Navigation und Rationalisierung von Erstattungsprozessen
- fließend in lokaler Sprache. Englischkenntnisse, um intern im größeren Roche-Unternehmen zusammenzuarbeiten, sind sehr wünschenswert.

Erforderliche Kompetenzen und Fähigkeiten
- Ausgezeichnete Kundenbindung und Managementfähigkeiten
- Erfahrung führende funktionsübergreifende Teams sind erforderlich. Cross-Functional-Führungserfahrung in der Formulierung von Cross-Functional-Strategien und in der Orchestrierung von Cross-Functional-Teams ist wünschenswert.
- System Thinker und Deep Listener
- Starker Geschäftssinn mit gewünschter Expertise in Kommerzialisierung und Customer Experience Excellence
- Kann komplexe Projekte verwalten

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. La position
L'opportunité
Les soins de santé changent : innovation radicale, ouverture accrue au changement, renforcement de l'autonomisation des patients, sources multiples d'information médicale et pression sur les dépenses publiques. Par conséquent, les besoins de nos intervenants continuent d'évoluer. Un des principaux objectifs de ce rôle est de forger des partenariats stratégiques avec les compagnies d'assurance, en travaillant main dans la main avec elles pour rationaliser et optimiser le processus de remboursement de nos solutions innovantes. Le Healthcare System Partner (HSP) est un leader habilité et le visage local de Roche travaille en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants du système de santé tels que les fournisseurs et les payeurs. Le PSH identifie l'objectif et la valeur communs, co-crée des solutions et les met en oeuvre conjointement entre les écosystèmes, ce qui a une incidence indirecte sur des milliers de patients. Ce faisant, le PSH sera directement responsable de remettre en question et de façonner le système de soins de santé au service d'une amélioration de la santé pour un plus grand nombre de patients plus rapidement et de manière durable pour la société.

Principales responsabilités
- Le PSH s'associe avec les compagnies d'assurance, les MCR et les payeurs pour stimuler l'innovation dans le système de santé, rationaliser les voies de remboursement et débloquer les possibilités d'offrir de la valeur pour l'écosystème et la société.
- Le PSH développe, nourrit et gère activement des partenariats stratégiques à long terme avec des fournisseurs d'assurance clés afin d'assurer un accès sans faille au marché et des processus d'approbation efficaces.
- Dans ce cadre, le PSH contribue à identifier, cartographier, mobiliser et gérer les intervenants des écosystèmes.
- Le PSH agit en tant que partenaire de confiance et principal point de contact entre les intervenants et Roche. Elle partage la vision et la valeur de la communauté des intervenants à l'interne, priorise et assure la sécurité des ressources et stimule les solutions qui produisent les résultats plus rapidement.
- Le HSP vit le modèle Visionary, Architecte, Coach, Catalyst (VAC), agit comme catalyseur et coach externe et interne.
- Ce rôle est habilité à mobiliser l'expertise et les ressources locales et du réseau au besoin, y compris en collaboration avec d'autres partenaires du système de santé et des partenaires du cheminement des patients.

Qui êtes-vous ?
Éducation et expérience requises
- Diplôme universitaire (scientifiques, économiques ou d'affaires). Un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie et/ou en MBA est un plus.
- Compréhension pratique et approfondie du système d'assurance maladie et du contexte des remboursements aux Émirats arabes unis
- Connaissance approfondie du système de santé, des processus et de la gouvernance
- Expérience éprouvée de travail avec les compagnies d'assurance maladie, avec une solide expérience de navigation et de rationalisation des processus de remboursement
- Fluent dans la langue locale. Il est hautement souhaitable d'avoir une bonne connaissance de l'anglais pour collaborer en interne dans toute l'entreprise Roche.

Compétences et compétences requises
- Excellent engagement client et compétences de gestion
- Il faut de l'expérience pour diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles. Une expérience de leadership transfonctionnel dans la formulation de stratégies interfonctionnelles et l'orchestration d'équipes interfonctionnelles est souhaitable.
- penseur système et auditeur profond
- Forte entreprise avec l'expertise souhaitée dans la commercialisation et l'expérience client excellence
- Capacité à gérer des projets complexes

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Cloud Engineer - Data Platforms , you will play a vital role in architecting, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and deployment pipelines for our search platform on AWS. Your expertise in cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and automation will be instrumental in ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of our enterprise search solution

Job Responsibilities

• Work with the Cloud Devops Enterprise Search team to collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and external teams.

• Focus on priorities, milestones and deliverables as per direction of the product management team.

• Contribute to the Cloud Devops Enterprise Search team on technical implementations and decisions.

• Work to meet SLAs on customer deployments in a global environment.

• Be part of the technical solution team focusing on maintaining service since they are live by measuring and monitoring availability and overall system health and improving the reliability of the IT Infrastructure.

• Collaborate with clients, other IT departments and managed service suppliers in the design and delivery of Cloud IT Solutions.

• Troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

Qualifications

Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent work experience in information technology environment (networking, infrastructure, database).

• You will bring +5 years of relevant work experience in one or more multinational work environments (e.g. healthcare industry experience is a plus)

Technical Skills

• Recent experience/exposure designing, implementing, operating infrastructure or designing hybrid multi cloud solutions in Public Cloud Platforms (AWS and Azure).

• Experience with containers and serverless AWS services: EKS, Lambda, AWS ECR.

• Cloud Networking experience with VPC subnets, Security Groups, Transit Gateway, Network Firewall.

• Application Networking experience with AWS API Gateway, NLB/ALB.

• Experience with Grafana for Cloud observability.

• DevOps Pipeline Automation: Gitlab CI/CD, Ansible.

• Experience with Cloudformation, Terraform, Python.

• Experience with FinOps for cloud cost optimization.

• Experience with development of AI pipelines is preferable.

Additional Qualifications will be a plus

• Preferred to be certified AWS Architect Professional/DevOps, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent working knowledge on AWS and Azure environments.

• Knowledge of data visualization tools ( i.e. Tableau).

• Experience with observability tools (i.e. ElasticSearch,)

• Experience with modern tools in the Agile Software Development Life Cycle.

• Experience with Version Control Systems (GitHub, Git, Stash/Bitbucket)

• Experience with knowledge management systems ( i.e. Confluence, Google Docs).

• Experience on development workflow ( i.e. JIRA)

La vostra esperienza nell'infrastruttura cloud, le pratiche DevOps e l'automazione saranno fondamentali per garantire la scalabilità, l'affidabilità e la sicurezza della nostra soluzione di ricerca aziendale

• Lavora con il team Cloud Devops Enterprise Search per collaborare con stakeholder, clienti e team esterni.

Istruzione / Esperienza

• Corso di laurea in Informatica / Ingegneria o equivalente esperienza di lavoro in ambiente di tecnologia dell'informazione (networking, infrastruttura, database).

Competenze tecniche

• Recenti esperienze/espositivi di progettazione, implementazione, infrastruttura operativa o progettazione di soluzioni ibrido multi cloud in Public Cloud Platforms (AWS e Azure).

• Esperienza con contenitori e servizi AWS senza server: EKS, Lambda, AWS ECR.

• Esperienza di rete cloud con sottorete VPC, Gruppi di sicurezza, Transit Gateway, Network Firewall.

• Applicazione Networking experience con AWS API Gateway, NLB/ALB.

• Esperienza con Grafana per l'osservabilità cloud.

• DevOps Pipeline Automation: Gitlab CI/CD, Ansible.

• Esperienza con Cloudformation, Terraform, Python.

• Esperienza con FinOps per l'ottimizzazione dei costi cloud.

• L'esperienza con lo sviluppo di condotte AI è preferibile.

Ulteriori qualifiche saranno un plus

• Preferito essere certificato AWS Architect Professional/DevOps, Azure Solutions Architect Expert o equivalente conoscenza di lavoro sugli ambienti AWS e Azure.

• Conoscenza degli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati (cioè Tableau).

• Esperienza con strumenti di osservabilità (es. ElasticSearch,)

• Esperienza con strumenti moderni nel ciclo di vita di sviluppo del software Agile.

• Esperienza con i sistemi di controllo della versione (GitHub, Git, Stash/Bitbucket)

• Esperienza con sistemi di gestione della conoscenza (ad esempio Confluence, Google Docs).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Cloud Engineer - Data Platforms , you will play a vital role in architecting, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and deployment pipelines for our search platform on AWS. Your expertise in cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and automation will be instrumental in ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of our enterprise search solution

Job Responsibilities

• Work with the Cloud Devops Enterprise Search team to collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and external teams.

• Focus on priorities, milestones and deliverables as per direction of the product management team.

• Contribute to the Cloud Devops Enterprise Search team on technical implementations and decisions.

• Work to meet SLAs on customer deployments in a global environment.

• Be part of the technical solution team focusing on maintaining service since they are live by measuring and monitoring availability and overall system health and improving the reliability of the IT Infrastructure.

• Collaborate with clients, other IT departments and managed service suppliers in the design and delivery of Cloud IT Solutions.

• Troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

Qualifications

Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent work experience in information technology environment (networking, infrastructure, database).

• You will bring +5 years of relevant work experience in one or more multinational work environments (e.g. healthcare industry experience is a plus)

Technical Skills

• Recent experience/exposure designing, implementing, operating infrastructure or designing hybrid multi cloud solutions in Public Cloud Platforms (AWS and Azure).

• Experience with containers and serverless AWS services: EKS, Lambda, AWS ECR.

• Cloud Networking experience with VPC subnets, Security Groups, Transit Gateway, Network Firewall.

• Application Networking experience with AWS API Gateway, NLB/ALB.

• Experience with Grafana for Cloud observability.

• DevOps Pipeline Automation: Gitlab CI/CD, Ansible.

• Experience with Cloudformation, Terraform, Python.

• Experience with FinOps for cloud cost optimization.

• Experience with development of AI pipelines is preferable.

Additional Qualifications will be a plus

• Preferred to be certified AWS Architect Professional/DevOps, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent working knowledge on AWS and Azure environments.

• Knowledge of data visualization tools ( i.e. Tableau).

• Experience with observability tools (i.e. ElasticSearch,)

• Experience with modern tools in the Agile Software Development Life Cycle.

• Experience with Version Control Systems (GitHub, Git, Stash/Bitbucket)

• Experience with knowledge management systems ( i.e. Confluence, Google Docs).

• Experience on development workflow ( i.e. JIRA)

This vacancy will remain open until August 20.
To ensure a fair selection process, applications will be reviewed and candidates will be shortlisted only after that date

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

Scopo del ruolo

• ● Pianifica l'intero viaggio di vendita e adatta strategie di vendita / tattiche alle fasi e stili di adozione dei clienti

• ● Crea strategie attuabili in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• ● Migliora le relazioni con i portachiavi per identificare le possibilità di crescita per upsell e cross sell.
• ● Positivamente colpisce la conversione e la previsione di opportunità.

• Condurre gli affari in piena conformità al comportamento in affari e comportamento in concorrenza

• ● Esperienza con implementazione strategica e ottimizzazione di processi di vendita complessi, preferibilmente in un ambiente ospedaliero o di laboratorio.

• ● Ampia esperienza nella gestione dei distributori, gestione dei conti chiave e eccellenza commerciale.
• ● Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta tra cui fare presentazioni, fogli di calcolo e proposte di impatto.

jobs.title: Site Services Intern - Hungarian speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly organized and proactive intern to join our Site Services team. This role will support various IT-related tasks (including hardware and software installation, device handovers for newcomers and leavers, handling ordered devices, and administrative tasks), Facility, and SHE tasks. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, great problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage technical responsibilities efficiently.

The Opportunity

IT Support & Coordination:

• Assist in setting up and configuring new workstations and IT equipment.

• Handle corresponding administrative tasks

• Help with smaller IT projects, such as software rollouts or system upgrades.

• Update IT asset inventory and assist with inventory tasks.

• Manage IT equipment handovers and returns for new hires and leavers.

• Assist with physical tasks related to IT equipment deployment and recovery.

• Provide support for new IT service projects and assist in event preparations.

• Supporting AV equipment in meeting rooms

• Supporting workstation equipment (monitor, docking station)

Operational & Facilities Support:.

• Handling the tickets submitted to the SAM ticketing system

• Supporting the annual inventory of Facility team

• Weekly building inspection with Handyman team

• Administration of home office equipment handover and return

Procurement & Administrative Tasks:

• Administrative support related to car fleet management and vendor management

Safety, Health and Environment-related tasks:

• Administrative support related to occupational health examination

• Supporting business continuity documentation update process

• Helping in inventory

Who you are

• Currently enrolled to a Hungarian University in a relevant field
(e.g., Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering etc.).

• Ability to work at least 20-30 hours/week independently and as part of a team.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Proficient in troubleshooting Windows/macOS operating systems and common software applications.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

• Flexibility to take on various tasks and contribute to different teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

• Partnerschaften mit Interessengruppen der Patientenreise, um Hindernisse zu beseitigen und Möglichkeiten zu erschließen, um einen Mehrwert für Patienten und die Gemeinschaft zu schaffen.

• Stewards Roch e Produkte durch ihren Lebenszyklus und unterstützt ihre angemessene Verwendung, die ihre Verdienste mit HCPs in einer wahrheitsgemäßen und balanced Art und Weise zu teilen beinhaltet.

• Durch die Überwachung der Patientenreise in ihrer Gesamtheit agiert die PJP als Systemdenker mit der Fähigkeit, einen gemeinsamen Zweck unter den Interessengruppen zu identifizieren und nutzt dies, um gemeinsam mit Interessengruppen im Ökosystem Lösungen zu entwickeln.

• Die Rolle ist befugt, Fachwissen und Ressourcen lokal und nach Bedarf aus dem Netzwerk zu beziehen, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit anderen PJPs.

• Sicherstellen großartiger Erfahrungen, wenn sich Stakeholder im Ökosystem mit Roche Mitarbeitern, Produkten und Dienstleistungen beschäftigen.

Mindset & Behaviors / VACC
Die PJP zeigt persönliche Ziele bei der Verbesserung der Patientenreise sowie eine starke Leidenschaft für die Schaffung von Wert und Auswirkungen auf das Ökosystem. Sie denken von einer Enterprise-Ebene aus, über Grenzen und Grenzen hinaus, um bestmögliche Ergebnisse sowohl für die Gesundheitsumgebung als auch für Roche weltweit zu erzielen.

• Visionär: Definition und Einbettung der Strategie zur Schaffung verbesserter Patientenreisen

Mi-ndset

• Unternehmerisch: Starke unternehmerische Denkweise mit hervorragenden Partnering-Fähigkeiten (Coaching, Beratung, Fähigkeit, tief zuzuhören, zu hinterfragen und untertrieben)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The T&E Compliance Intern role is responsible for working with Roche employees all over the EMEA region in order to perform the Travel & Expense activities.
Everyday tasks are covering: claim processing, T&E compliance related ticket handling, checking all expense claims to be part of the payment against the local T&E policies and taking care of the financial posting fails.
Working with precision and quality in order to ensure the reliability of financial reports of Roche affiliates.
Follow the instructions of the Regional Lead regarding the daily work coordination.

Responsibilities
Service Delivery

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements

• Verify T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Clearly document all compliance assessment (i.e assessment results) activities in SAP Concur during claim processing

• Escalate issues and recommend resolution plans in a timely manner to the RSS line manager and affiliate (where required)

• Actively and thoroughly work on avoiding potential financial fraud to appear in the company through T&E claims

• Creation and maintenance of internal process documentation to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaboration with other T&E related teams within the RSS to support the End to end processes (Eg.: GCX, Country Chief Accountant, Master Data, Demand to Pay, Record to Report)

• Collaboration with the Roche affiliates in order to maintain an up to date T&E compliance processes in alignment with the local regulations.

• Collaboration with the T&E 2nd level support team in order eliminate appearing technical issues or to implement new solutions in SAP Concur .

Who you are
We are seeking an individual with:

• Ongoing Hungarian university studies

• Good command of English and Arabic

• Outstanding communication skills

• Excellent customer focus

• A reliable attitude

• At least 20-30 hours free to work per week

• Experience in administrative tasks (advantage)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione
Il ruolo di T&E Compliance Intern è responsabile del lavoro con i dipendenti Roche in tutta la regione EMEA per svolgere le attività di Travel & Expense.
I compiti di ogni giorno riguardano: l'elaborazione dei reclami, la gestione dei biglietti relativi alla conformità T&E, il controllo di tutte le richieste di spesa per essere parte del pagamento contro le politiche T&E locali e l'assunzione del fallimento della pubblicazione finanziaria.
Lavorare con precisione e qualità al fine di garantire l'affidabilità dei rapporti finanziari delle affiliate Roche.
Seguire le istruzioni del Lead Regionale per quanto riguarda il coordinamento quotidiano del lavoro.

responsabilità
Consegna del servizio

• Verificare le richieste di spesa T&E dal punto di vista IVA

• Documentare chiaramente tutte le attività di valutazione della conformità (cioè i risultati della valutazione) in SAP Concur durante il trattamento dei reclami

• Escalate i problemi e consigliate i piani di risoluzione in modo tempestivo al gestore della linea RSS e alla filiale (dove richiesto)

• Lavorare in modo attivo e approfondito per evitare potenziali frodi finanziarie da apparire in azienda attraverso reclami T&E

• Creazione e manutenzione della documentazione interna del processo per rispondere agli aggiornamenti del processo di monitoraggio della conformità

Collaborazione trasversale

• Collaborazione con il team di supporto T&E 2nd level per eliminare i problemi tecnici o implementare nuove soluzioni in SAP Concur .

Chi sei
Stiamo cercando un individuo con:

• Studi universitari in Ungheria

• Buon comando di inglese e arabo

• Competenze di comunicazione eccezionali

• Ottima attenzione al cliente

• Un atteggiamento affidabile

• Almeno 20-30 ore gratis per lavorare a settimana

• Esperienza nei compiti amministrativi (vantaggio)

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Dienstleistungen

• Erstellung und Pflege der internen Prozessdokumentation zur Aktualisierung des Compliance-Überwachungsprozesses

• Gute Beherrschung von Englisch und Arabisch

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichneter Kundenfokus

jobs.title: Lead UI/UX Designer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPS drives the business strategy at Roche from research to commercialization. GPS collaborates closely with teams across the organization to bring new therapies to the market and maximize the launched product portfolio. With your ability to work in detail yet see the big picture, you can influence the direction of the company in a disease area. At Roche, we offer you chances to create your career inside or outside of GPS. With offices in 160 countries, we offer a truly international experience depending on where your interests take you.

We are looking for a Lead UI/UX Designer to join our visualization team, part of the Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) Center of Excellence within GPS. The visualization team is responsible for providing the vision, strategy, and hands-on leadership in visual analytics and leveraging them to generate high-impact business insights.

The Lead UI/UX Designer is a visualization expert with an extensive portfolio of projects where their visual analytics were successfully used to generate insights. Your key goal will be to design exceptional, user-centered, and intuitive experiences across digital devices. To succeed, you will need a mix of customer focus, creative talent, data literacy, and a passion for leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate design cycles.

The Opportunity

• Accelerate Design with AI: Leverage cutting-edge, AI-driven UX/UI tools (e.g., AI-assisted wireframing, automated asset generation, predictive user testing) to dramatically shorten turnaround times from ideation to high-fidelity mock-ups.

• Rapid Prototyping & Iteration: Enable ultra-fast prototyping and real-time visual adjustments to keep pace with the rapidly changing pharmaceutical and data environments.

• Influence & Motivate Without Authority: Act as the strategic heart of cross-functional squads to energize, align, and motivate diverse stakeholders (Data Scientists, Product Owners, Business Leaders) toward a unified, user-centric vision without relying on hierarchical power.

• Synthesize Complex Requirements: Translate mixed, highly technical, and potentially conflicting inputs into elegant, accessible, and intuitive visual analytics designs.

• Lead Visual Implementation: Serve as the visual architect in analytical projects, providing proactive guidance and creative solutions to complex user experience challenges while positioning different technologies effectively to create a highly coherent, seamless user experience across Roche’s entire analytical product portfolio.

• Collaborate Dynamically: Work hand-in-hand with Dev Teams, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Scrum Masters, and end-users to translate complex medical and commercial data into highly functional development concepts.

• Drive Business Value: Think beyond individual projects to focus heavily on outcomes that maximize business value, while engaging regularly in peer mentorship, coaching, and advocacy.

Who You Are

• Education & Experience: You hold a Bachelor's degree in Design (e.g., interaction, graphic, visual communications, product), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience, backed by a minimum of 5 years of UX design/visual analytics experience (with at least 3 years deeply embedded within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry).

• Proven Design Portfolio: You possess an online portfolio demonstrating a proven track record of designing high-impact analytical dashboards, complex data visualization

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
GPS guida la strategia aziendale a Roche dalla ricerca alla commercializzazione. GPS collabora a stretto contatto con i team di tutta l'organizzazione per portare nuove terapie al mercato e massimizzare il portafoglio prodotti lanciato. Con la vostra capacità di lavorare in dettaglio ancora vedere il quadro grande, è possibile influenzare la direzione della società in una zona di malattia. A Roche, ti offriamo la possibilità di creare la tua carriera all'interno o all'esterno del GPS. Con uffici in 160 paesi, offriamo un'esperienza davvero internazionale a seconda di dove i vostri interessi vi portano.

Stiamo cercando un User Experience Designer per unire il nostro team di visualizzazione, parte del Centro di eccellenza Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) all'interno del GPS. Il team di visualizzazione è responsabile di fornire la visione, la strategia e la leadership hands-on nell'analisi visiva e di sfruttarli per generare intuizioni aziendali ad alto impatto.

User Experience Designer è un esperto di visualizzazione con un ampio portafoglio di progetti in cui i loro analytics visivi sono stati utilizzati con successo per generare insight. Il vostro obiettivo principale sarà quello di progettare esperienze eccezionali, centrate sull'utente e intuitive su dispositivi digitali. Per avere successo, avrete bisogno di un mix di focus del cliente, talento creativo, l'alfabetizzazione dei dati, e una passione per sfruttare moderni strumenti AI per accelerare i cicli di progettazione.

L'opportunità

• Accelerate Design con AI: Leverage all'avanguardia, AI-driven UX/UI strumenti (ad esempio, AI-assisted wireframing, generazione di asset automatizzata, test utente predittivo) per ridurre drasticamente i tempi di turnaround da ideazione a mock-up ad alta fedeltà.

• Rapid Prototyping & Iteration: Abilitare regolazioni visive ultra-veloci e in tempo reale per tenere il passo con gli ambienti farmaceutici e dati in rapida evoluzione.

• Influenza & Motivate Senza Autorità: Agite come il cuore strategico delle squadre interfunzionali per energizzare, allineare e motivare i diversi stakeholder (Data Scientists, Product Owners, Business Leaders) verso una visione unificata, user-centric senza contare su potere gerarchico.

• Synthesize Complex Requisiti: Tradurre ingressi misti, altamente tecnici e potenzialmente in conflitto in progetti di analisi visiva eleganti, accessibili e intuitivi.

• Attuazione visiva di piombo: Servire come architetto visivo in progetti analitici, fornire una guida proattiva e soluzioni creative a complesse sfide dell'esperienza degli utenti, posizionando in modo efficace diverse tecnologie per creare un'esperienza utente altamente coerente e senza soluzione di continuità nell'intero portafoglio di prodotti analitici di Roche.

• Collaborare dinamicamente: lavorare a mano con Dev Teams, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Scrum Masters e utenti finali per tradurre dati medici e commerciali complessi in concetti di sviluppo altamente funzionali.

• Drive Business Value: Pensa al di là dei progetti individuali per concentrarsi fortemente sui risultati che massimizzano il valore aziendale, mentre si impegna regolarmente in mentore peer, coaching e advocacy.

Chi sei

• Istruzione e esperienza: Lei ha una laurea in Design (ad esempio, interazione, grafica, comunicazione visiva, prodotto), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Informatica, un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente, sostenuta da un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza di progettazione/analisi visiva UX (con almeno 3 anni profondamente incorporati nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico).

• Proven Design Portfolio: Possiedi un portafoglio online che dimostra una comprovata traccia di progettazione di dashboard analitiche ad alto impatto, dati complessi vis
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPS drives the business strategy at Roche from research to commercialization. GPS collaborates closely with teams across the organization to bring new therapies to the market and maximize the launched product portfolio. With your ability to work in detail yet see the big picture, you can influence the direction of the company in a disease area. At Roche, we offer you chances to create your career inside or outside of GPS. With offices in 160 countries, we offer a truly international experience depending on where your interests take you.

We are looking for a Lead UI/UX Designer to join our visualization team, part of the Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) Center of Excellence within GPS. The visualization team is responsible for providing the vision, strategy, and hands-on leadership in visual analytics and leveraging them to generate high-impact business insights.

The Lead UI/UX Designer is a visualization expert with an extensive portfolio of projects where their visual analytics were successfully used to generate insights. Your key goal will be to design exceptional, user-centered, and intuitive experiences across digital devices. To succeed, you will need a mix of customer focus, creative talent, data literacy, and a passion for leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate design cycles.

The Opportunity

• Accelerate Design with AI: Leverage cutting-edge, AI-driven UX/UI tools (e.g., AI-assisted wireframing, automated asset generation, predictive user testing) to dramatically shorten turnaround times from ideation to high-fidelity mock-ups.

• Rapid Prototyping & Iteration: Enable ultra-fast prototyping and real-time visual adjustments to keep pace with the rapidly changing pharmaceutical and data environments.

• Influence & Motivate Without Authority: Act as the strategic heart of cross-functional squads to energize, align, and motivate diverse stakeholders (Data Scientists, Product Owners, Business Leaders) toward a unified, user-centric vision without relying on hierarchical power.

• Synthesize Complex Requirements: Translate mixed, highly technical, and potentially conflicting inputs into elegant, accessible, and intuitive visual analytics designs.

• Lead Visual Implementation: Serve as the visual architect in analytical projects, providing proactive guidance and creative solutions to complex user experience challenges while positioning different technologies effectively to create a highly coherent, seamless user experience across Roche’s entire analytical product portfolio.

• Collaborate Dynamically: Work hand-in-hand with Dev Teams, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Scrum Masters, and end-users to translate complex medical and commercial data into highly functional development concepts.

• Drive Business Value: Think beyond individual projects to focus heavily on outcomes that maximize business value, while engaging regularly in peer mentorship, coaching, and advocacy.

Who You Are

• Education & Experience: You hold a Bachelor's degree in Design (e.g., interaction, graphic, visual communications, product), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience, backed by a minimum of 5 years of UX design/visual analytics experience (with at least 3 years deeply embedded within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry).

• Proven Design Portfolio: You possess an online portfolio demonstrating a proven track record of designing high-impact analytical dashboards, complex data visualization

Wer du bist

Interaktion, Grafik, visuelle Kommunikation, Produkt), Mensch-Computer-Interaktion (HCI), Informatik, ein verwandtes Gebiet oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung, die durch mindestens 5 Jahre UX-Design / Visual Analytics-Erfahrung unterstützt wird (mit mindestens 3 Jahren tief in der Pharma- oder Biotech-Industrie eingebettet).

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le GPS conduit la stratégie commerciale de Roche de la recherche à la commercialisation. Le GPS collabore étroitement avec les équipes de l'organisation pour commercialiser de nouvelles thérapies et maximiser le portefeuille de produits lancés. Grâce à votre capacité de travailler en détail et de voir le tableau, vous pouvez influencer la direction de l'entreprise dans une zone de maladie. Chez Roche, nous vous offrons des chances de créer votre carrière à l'intérieur ou à l'extérieur du GPS. Avec des bureaux dans 160 pays, nous offrons une expérience vraiment internationale selon où vos intérêts vous emmènent.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Utilisateur Experience Designer pour rejoindre notre équipe de visualisation, qui fait partie du Centre d'excellence AABI (Avancé Analytics for Business Insights) au sein du GPS. L'équipe de visualisation est responsable de fournir la vision, la stratégie et le leadership pratique dans l'analyse visuelle et de les exploiter pour générer des perspectives d'affaires à fort impact.

Le Designer d'expérience utilisateur est un expert en visualisation avec un vaste portefeuille de projets où leur analyse visuelle a été utilisée avec succès pour générer des idées. Votre objectif principal sera de concevoir des expériences exceptionnelles, centrées sur l'utilisateur et intuitives sur les appareils numériques. Pour réussir, vous aurez besoin d'un mélange de concentration client, de talents créatifs, de connaissances en données et d'une passion pour tirer parti des outils modernes d'IA pour accélérer les cycles de conception.

L'opportunité

• Accélérer la conception avec l'IA : Tirer parti des outils UX/UI à la fine pointe de l'intelligence artificielle (p. ex., filage assisté par l'IA, génération automatisée d'actifs, essais prédictifs pour les utilisateurs) pour raccourcir considérablement les délais d'exécution de l'idée jusqu'aux maquettes à haute fidélité.

• Prototypage et itération rapides: Permet de prototypage ultra-rapide et des ajustements visuels en temps réel pour suivre le rythme des environnements pharmaceutiques et de données en évolution rapide.

• Influence et motivation sans autorité : agir en tant que cœur stratégique des équipes interfonctionnelles pour stimuler, aligner et motiver divers intervenants (data Scientists, Product Owners, Business Leaders) vers une vision unifiée et centrée sur l'utilisateur sans compter sur le pouvoir hiérarchique.

• Exigences complexes de synthèse : Traduire des entrées mixtes, hautement techniques et potentiellement contradictoires en conceptions analytiques visuelles élégantes, accessibles et intuitives.

• Mise en œuvre visuelle principale: servir d'architecte visuel dans les projets d'analyse, fournir des conseils proactifs et des solutions créatives aux défis complexes de l'expérience utilisateur tout en positionnant efficacement différentes technologies pour créer une expérience utilisateur hautement cohérente et transparente dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits analytiques de Roche.

• Collaborer dynamiquement : travailler main dans la main avec les équipes de Dev, les analystes d'affaires, les gestionnaires de projet, Scrum Masters et les utilisateurs finaux pour traduire des données médicales et commerciales complexes en concepts de développement hautement fonctionnels.

• Conduire la valeur de l'entreprise : Au-delà des projets individuels, pensez à privilégier les résultats qui maximisent la valeur de l'entreprise, tout en participant régulièrement au mentorat par les pairs, au coaching et à la défense des intérêts.

Qui vous êtes

• Éducation et expérience: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en design (p. ex., interaction, graphique, communication visuelle, produit), interaction homme-ordinateur (HCI), informatique, un domaine connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente, soutenu par un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience de conception UX/analyse visuelle (avec au moins 3 ans profondément ancrés dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou de biotechnologie).

• Portfolio de conception éprouvé: Vous possédez un portefeuille en ligne démontrant une expérience éprouvée de la conception de tableaux de bord analytiques à impact élevé, des données complexes

jobs.title: Commercial Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview
As Commercial Enablement Manager for Frontier Markets (Diagnostics) , you will be responsible for leading the teams for Customer Value & Solutions, Distributor Strategy & Management, as well as Commercial Operations Excellence. You will build enabling strategies that drive exceptional sales performance in the commercial teams in the Frontier Markets.
In this role, we are seeking the Head of Commercial Enablement to lead the teams for Customer Value & Solutions, Distributor Strategy & Management, as well as Commercial Operations Excellence.
Key Responsibilities
1. Customer Value & Solutions
You will lead the Customer Value & Solutions team to strategize, develop, and manage marketing activities, including, but not limited to:

• Strategy & Growth: Planning and executing marketing strategy to ensure market penetration and Growth.

• Materials & Assets: Ensuring the availability of relevant marketing materials to support the planned business activities, which are in line with local market conditions and global product priorities.

• Market Engagement: Maintaining close liaison with key opinion leaders and a high level of market intelligence.

2. Distributor Strategy & Management
The Distributor Strategy & Management team under your guidance will be responsible for:

• Network Strategy: Strategize & manage distribution network across the country, to ensure the product portfolio has an appropriate channel to penetrate the key potential market.

• Performance Monitoring: Monitor distributor performance based on the set KPI of each distributor.

• Collaboration & Compliance: Work closely with respective stakeholders and departments in managing distributor performance & compliance.

• Capability Building: Develop a training program for distributors to make sure the alignment works well.

3. Commercial Operations Excellence
You will lead the Commercial Operations Excellence team to be responsible for:

• Forecasting & Inventory: Managing sales forecast related to supply chain and inventory management.

• Logistics Optimization: Working closely with 3PL logistics, do any improvement required to have a better sales & supply process.

• Contract Administration: Contract management with sales/ finance department.

• Process & Tools Management: Driving business processes such as Leads, Opportunities to Quote process using tools such as but not limited to Marketing Automation (i.e. Marketo), CRM (i.e. Salesforce), and commercial insights.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione
Panoramica del ruolo
Come Commercial Enablement Manager per i mercati di frontiera (Diagnostics) , sarete responsabili per guidare i team per il valore e le soluzioni dei clienti, la strategia e la gestione dei distributori, così come l'eccellenza operativa commerciale. Costruirete strategie che permettono di ottenere prestazioni eccezionali di vendita nei team commerciali del mercato IVD in Indonesia.
In questo ruolo, stiamo cercando il responsabile dell'abilitazione commerciale per guidare i team per il valore e le soluzioni dei clienti, la strategia e la gestione dei distributori, così come l'eccellenza delle operazioni commerciali.
Principali responsabilità
1. Valore e Soluzioni dei Clienti
Condurrai il team Customer Value & Solutions a strategizzare, sviluppare e gestire attività di marketing, tra cui, ma non solo:

• Strategia & Crescita: Pianificazione ed esecuzione della strategia di marketing per garantire la penetrazione del mercato e la crescita.

• Materials & Assets: Garantire la disponibilità di materiali di marketing rilevanti per supportare le attività di business pianificate, in linea con le condizioni di mercato locali e le priorità dei prodotti globali.

• Engagement di mercato: Mantenere stretto legame con i leader di opinione chiave e un alto livello di intelligenza di mercato.

2. Strategia e gestione dei distributori
Il team di Distributor Strategy & Management sotto la vostra guida sarà responsabile per:

• Strategia di rete: Strategize & gestire la rete di distribuzione in tutto il paese, per garantire che il portafoglio prodotti ha un canale appropriato per penetrare il mercato potenziale chiave.

• Monitoraggio delle prestazioni: Monitorare le prestazioni del distributore in base al set KPI di ogni distributore.

• Collaborazione e conformità: lavorare a stretto contatto con i rispettivi stakeholder e dipartimenti nella gestione delle prestazioni e della conformità dei distributori.

• Capability Building: Sviluppare un programma di formazione per i distributori per assicurarsi che l'allineamento funziona bene.

3. Eccellenza delle operazioni commerciali
Potrai guidare il team di Operazioni Commerciali Eccellenza per essere responsabile per:

• Forecasting & Inventory: Gestione delle previsioni di vendita relative alla supply chain e alla gestione delle scorte.

• Logistica Ottimizzazione: Lavorare a stretto contatto con la logistica 3PL, fare qualsiasi miglioramento necessario per avere un migliore processo di vendita e fornitura.

• Amministrazione dei contratti: Gestione dei contratti con reparto vendite / finanza.

• Gestione dei processi e degli strumenti: Guidare processi aziendali come Leads, Opportunità al processo di Quote utilizzando strumenti come, ma non limitati a Marketing Automation (cioè Marketo), CRM (cioè Salesforce), e insight commerciali.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Materialien & Vermögenswerte: Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit relevanter Marketingmaterialien zur Unterstützung der geplanten Geschäftsaktivitäten, die den lokalen Marktbedingungen und globalen Produktprioritäten entsprechen.

• Market Engagement: Eine enge Verbindung zu wichtigen Meinungsführern und ein hohes Maß an Marktintelligenz.

2. Vertriebsstrategie und -management
Das Distributor Strategy & Management-Team unter Ihrer Anleitung ist verantwortlich für:

• Netzwerkstrategie: Strategisieren und verwalten Sie das Vertriebsnetz im ganzen Land, um sicherzustellen, dass das Produktportfolio über einen geeigneten Kanal verfügt, um den wichtigsten potenziellen Markt zu durchdringen.

• Leistungsüberwachung: Überwachen Sie die Leistung des Verteilers basierend auf dem festgelegten KPI jedes Verteilers.

• Zusammenarbeit & Compliance: Arbeiten Sie eng mit den jeweiligen Stakeholdern und Abteilungen zusammen, um die Leistung und Compliance von Distributoren zu verwalten.

• Capability Building: Entwickeln Sie ein Schulungsprogramm für Distributoren, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ausrichtung gut funktioniert.

3. Kommerzielle Operations Excellence
Sie werden das Commercial Operations Excellence-Team leiten, um verantwortlich zu sein für:

• Forecasting & Inventory: Verwaltung von Verkaufsprognosen in Bezug auf Supply Chain und Bestandsmanagement.

• Logistikoptimierung: Arbeiten Sie eng mit der 3PL-Logistik zusammen und führen Sie Verbesserungen durch, die für einen besseren Verkaufs- und Lieferprozess erforderlich sind.

• Vertragsverwaltung: Vertragsmanagement mit Vertriebs-/Finanzabteilung.

• Prozess- und Tools-Management: Steuerung von Geschäftsprozessen wie Leads, Opportunitys to Quote-Prozess mit Tools wie, aber nicht beschränkt auf Marketing Automation (d. H. Marketo), CRM (d. H. Salesforce) und kommerzielle Einblicke.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Aperçu du rôle
En tant que Directeur d'Activation Commerciale pour les Marchés Frontiers (Diagnostic), vous serez responsable de la direction des équipes pour la Valeur Client & Solutions, la Stratégie Distributeur & Gestion, ainsi que l'Excellence Opérations Commerciales. Vous allez construire des stratégies habilitantes qui conduisent des performances de vente exceptionnelles dans les équipes commerciales sur le marché indonésien IVD.
Dans ce rôle, nous recherchons le Chef de l'Activation Commerciale pour diriger les équipes pour la Valeur Client & Solutions, la Stratégie Distributeur & Gestion, ainsi que l'Excellence Opérations Commerciales.
Principales responsabilités
1. Valeur client & Solutions
Vous dirigerez l'équipe Client Value & Solutions pour stratégiser, développer et gérer les activités de marketing, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter :

• Stratégie et croissance : Planifier et exécuter une stratégie de marketing pour assurer la pénétration et la croissance du marché.

• Matériaux et biens: garantir la disponibilité de matériaux de marketing pertinents pour soutenir les activités commerciales prévues, qui sont conformes aux conditions du marché local et aux priorités de produits mondiales.

• Engagement du marché : maintenir une liaison étroite avec les principaux leaders d'opinion et un niveau élevé de renseignements sur le marché.

2. Stratégie et gestion des distributeurs
Sous votre direction, l'équipe de la stratégie et de la gestion des distributeurs sera chargée de:

• Stratégie de réseau : Stratégisez et gérez le réseau de distribution partout au pays, afin de s'assurer que le portefeuille de produits dispose d'un canal approprié pour pénétrer le marché potentiel clé.

• Surveillance de la performance : Surveiller la performance du distributeur en fonction de l'ICP de chaque distributeur.

• Collaboration et conformité : Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants et les ministères concernés pour gérer le rendement et la conformité des distributeurs.

• Renforcement des capacités : Élaborer un programme de formation pour les distributeurs afin de s'assurer que l'alignement fonctionne bien.

3. Excellence en opérations commerciales
Vous dirigerez l'équipe d'excellence en opérations commerciales qui sera responsable :

• Prévision et inventaire : Gestion des prévisions de ventes liées à la chaîne d'approvisionnement et à la gestion des stocks.

• Optimisation logistique: Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la logistique 3PL, faire toute amélioration nécessaire pour avoir un meilleur processus de vente et d'approvisionnement.

• Administration des contrats : Gestion des contrats avec le service des ventes/finances.

• Gestion des processus et des outils : diriger des processus d'affaires comme les leads, les possibilités de soumission à l'aide d'outils tels que, sans s'y limiter, l'automatisation du marketing (c.-à-d. Marketo), le CRM (c.-à-d. Salesforce) et les perspectives commerciales.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.title: Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst based in Hyderabad within our Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE), you will build deep expertise in the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will partner with cross-functional teams and U.S. stakeholders to evaluate, acquire, and manage data sources, directly shaping how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.

The Opportunity

• Dataset Management: Support the evaluation, acquisition, and ongoing management of a broad range of U.S. healthcare datasets, including payer, market access, claims, sales, and competitive intelligence.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate closely with U.S. stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify use cases, and translate complex business questions into clear data requirements, evaluation criteria, and actionable next steps.

• Vendor Evaluation: Evaluate new and existing datasets and vendors (such as IQVIA, Komodo Health, MMIT, and DRG Fingertip) based on business relevance, methodology, quality, limitations, and fit-for-purpose application.

• External Partnerships: Partner with external data vendors to understand source methodologies, resolve data-related queries, and ensure timely access to high-quality datasets.

• Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Apply structured thinking to perform data profiling, data comparison, and validation. Assess potential gaps or risks, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives.

• Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including dataset summaries, vendor comparisons, and standard operating procedures, to support decision-making around data investments.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

• Experience: You have 2–4 years of relevant experience in pharma, healthcare analytics, life sciences consulting, market research, or commercial analytics.

• Industry Knowledge: You bring a strong foundation in biology, life sciences, and the pharmaceutical industry, possessing a deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, the drug development process, and the U.S. commercial/market access landscape.

• Analytical & Strategic Thinking: You possess strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail. This enables you to engage stakeholders consultatively, ask strategic questions, and synthesize complex information into clear summaries, actionable recommendations, and “so what?” insights.

• Communication & Organization: You are an effective communicator with strong organizational and documentation skills. You can manage multiple priorities and are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively across time zones with U.S.-based teams and external vendors.

• Data Platforms & Datasets Expertise: You have exposure to external healthcare data platforms and vendors (e.g., MMIT, DRG Fingertip, IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN). You are highly familiar with datasets spanning payer intelligence, sales, clai

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Come analizzatore di strategia e acquisizione dati basato a Hyderabad all'interno del nostro Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE), si costruirà una profonda esperienza nel panorama dei dati sanitari degli Stati Uniti. Potrai collaborare con team interfunzionali e stakeholder statunitensi per valutare, acquisire e gestire le fonti di dati, modellando direttamente come Roche utilizza i dati per supportare le esigenze commerciali e strategiche del mercato statunitense.

L'opportunità

• Dataset Management: Supporta la valutazione, l'acquisizione e la gestione in corso di una vasta gamma di dataset sanitari statunitensi, tra cui payer, accesso al mercato, reclami, vendite e intelligenza competitiva.

• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder degli Stati Uniti per comprendere le esigenze aziendali, chiarire i casi di utilizzo e tradurre questioni aziendali complesse in chiari requisiti di dati, criteri di valutazione e passi successivi attuabili.

• Valutazione del fornitore: Valutare nuovi e esistenti set di dati e fornitori (come IQVIA, Komodo Health, MMIT e DRG Fingertip) sulla base di rilevanza aziendale, metodologia, qualità, limitazioni e applicazione fit-for-purpose.

• Partenariati esterni: Partner con fornitori di dati esterni per comprendere metodologie di origine, risolvere query relative ai dati e garantire l'accesso tempestivo a set di dati di alta qualità.

• Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Applicare il pensiero strutturato per eseguire la profilazione dei dati, il confronto dei dati e la validazione. Valutare potenziali lacune o rischi, sfidare i presupposti e fornire pushback costruttivo per garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Documentazione: Sviluppare e mantenere una documentazione completa, inclusi i riassunti dei dataset, i confronti dei fornitori e le procedure operative standard, per supportare il processo decisionale sugli investimenti dei dati.

Chi sei

• Istruzione: Lei ha una laurea o Master in Scienze della Vita, Farmacia, Assistenza sanitaria, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, o una disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza: Hai 2-4 anni di esperienza rilevante in farmacia, analisi sanitaria, consulenza sulle scienze della vita, ricerca di mercato o analisi commerciali.

• Conoscenza dell'industria: Lei porta una solida base in biologia, scienze della vita e l'industria farmaceutica, in possesso di una profonda comprensione dell'ecosistema sanitario, del processo di sviluppo della droga e del paesaggio di accesso commerciale/mercato degli Stati Uniti.

• Analitico & Strategic Thinking: Possiedi forti ragionamenti analitici e capacità di problem solving con meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli. Questo consente di coinvolgere le parti interessate in modo consultivo, porre domande strategiche, e sintetizzare informazioni complesse in sintesi chiare, raccomandazioni attuabili, e “cosa?” approfondimenti.

• Comunicazione & Organizzazione: Sei un comunicatore efficace con forti capacità organizzative e documentali. È possibile gestire più priorità e sono confortevoli lavorare sia in modo indipendente e collaborativo attraverso fusi orari con team basati sugli Stati Uniti e fornitori esterni.

• Expertise: Hai esposizione a piattaforme e fornitori di dati sanitari esterni (ad esempio, MMIT, DRG Fingertip, IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN). Siete molto familiarità con i dataset che spaziano da payer intelligenza, vendite, clai

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.

C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

En tant que Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyste basé à Hyderabad au sein de notre Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE), vous allez développer une expertise profonde dans le paysage américain des données de santé. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des intervenants américains afin d'évaluer, d'acquérir et de gérer des sources de données, et de façonner directement la façon dont Roche utilise les données pour répondre aux besoins commerciaux et stratégiques du marché américain.

L'opportunité

• Gestion des données : Appuyer l'évaluation, l'acquisition et la gestion continue d'un large éventail de données de santé aux États-Unis, y compris le payeur, l'accès au marché, les réclamations, les ventes et l'intelligence concurrentielle.

• Collaboration avec les intervenants : Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants américains pour comprendre les besoins des entreprises, clarifier les cas d'utilisation et traduire les questions complexes des entreprises en exigences claires en matière de données, en critères d'évaluation et en prochaines étapes réalisables.

• Évaluation des fournisseurs : Évaluer les ensembles de données et les fournisseurs nouveaux et existants (tels que IQVIA, Komodo Health, MMIT et DRG Fingertip) en fonction de la pertinence opérationnelle, de la méthodologie, de la qualité, des limites et de l'application adaptée aux besoins.

• Partenariats externes : S'associer à des fournisseurs de données externes pour comprendre les méthodes de base, résoudre les questions relatives aux données et garantir un accès rapide à des ensembles de données de haute qualité.

• Profil des données et évaluation des risques : Appliquer une réflexion structurée pour effectuer le profil des données, la comparaison des données et la validation. Évaluer les lacunes ou les risques potentiels, remettre en question les hypothèses et fournir un retour en arrière constructif pour assurer l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Documentation: Élaborer et tenir à jour une documentation complète, y compris des résumés des ensembles de données, des comparaisons avec les fournisseurs et des procédures opérationnelles normalisées, pour appuyer la prise de décisions concernant les investissements dans les données.

Qui vous êtes

• Éducation : Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en sciences de la vie, en pharmacie, en santé, en analyse des affaires, en analyse des données ou dans une discipline connexe.

• Expérience : Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience pertinente en pharmacologie, en analyse de santé, en conseil en sciences de la vie, en études de marché ou en analyse commerciale.

• Connaissances de l'industrie : Vous apportez une base solide en biologie, en sciences de la vie et dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, possédant une compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème de la santé, du processus de développement des médicaments et du paysage d'accès commercial et commercial des États-Unis.

• Analyse & réflexion stratégique: Vous possédez de solides capacités de raisonnement analytique et de résolution de problèmes avec une attention méticuleuse au détail. Cela vous permet d'engager les parties prenantes de manière consultative, de poser des questions stratégiques et de synthétiser des informations complexes en résumés clairs, en recommandations réalisables, et donc ?

• Communication et organisation : Vous êtes un communicateur efficace doté de solides compétences organisationnelles et documentaires. Vous pouvez gérer plusieurs priorités et travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration avec des équipes américaines et des fournisseurs externes.
