At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you brag. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to three both personally and professionally. This is how we love to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The post
Are you passionate about law and want to turn your theoretical knowledge into concrete skills? Join our team! We are looking for a Trainee Legal Assistant who is motivated and rigorous.

Your Mission
- Development or updating of contract formats adapted to existing local laws (various routine contracts); commercial contract, partnership, service delivery, donation and grant, etc.);
- Drafting and editing of various contracts;
- Assistance in reviewing contracts with external parties;
- Liaison between the Legal Director and local teams;
- Legal monitoring including legal research on a variety of topics, including medical and biomedical diagnostics; compliance;

Administrative tasks:
- Establishment of a single contract identification system and development of a local register; filing and archiving of legal documents;
- Participation in updating the company's legal documentation.
- Preparation of meetings and presentations;

In general , any activity contributing to the achievement of the objective of the Legal Directorate and the organisation in general .

Who are you?
Required skills
- To hold a master's degree in business law OHADA
- Have completed an internship in company or law firm with experience in contract writing, carrying out administrative diligences ...
- Good knowledge and mastery of OHADA business law
- Mastery of office tools (Google,Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Good editorial qualities and organizational sense
- Interest in science and biomedical
- Good legal drafting capacity
- Good command of French and appreciated knowledge of English

Valued:
- Spirit of synthesis and openness
- Respect for confidentiality
- Being disciplined
- Reactivity and proactivity
- Rigor and discretion
- Opening up to innovation

Who we are
A healthythier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100,000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 trillion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Lets build a future healthier, together.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, mit denen Sie prahlen. Unsere kultur fördert persönlichen ausdruck, offenen dialog und echte verbindungen, in denen sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer sie sind, so dass sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich drei. So lieben wir es, Krankheiten zu verhindern, zu stoppen und zu heilen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Post
Sie interessieren sich für Recht und möchten Ihr theoretisches Wissen in konkrete Fähigkeiten umwandeln? Treten Sie unserem Team bei! Wir suchen einen Trainee Legal Assistant, der motiviert und streng ist.

Deine Mission
- Entwicklung oder Aktualisierung von Vertragsformaten, die an bestehende lokale Gesetze angepasst sind (verschiedene Routineverträge); Handelsverträge, Partnerschaft, Dienstleistungserbringung, Spende und Zuschuss usw.;
- Ausarbeitung und Bearbeitung verschiedener Verträge;
- Unterstützung bei der Überprüfung von Verträgen mit externen Parteien;
- Verbindung zwischen dem Legal Director und lokalen Teams;
- Rechtliche Überwachung einschließlich juristischer Forschung zu einer Vielzahl von Themen, einschließlich medizinischer und biomedizinischer Diagnostik; Compliance;

Verwaltungsaufgaben:
- Einrichtung eines einheitlichen Vertragsidentifikationssystems und Entwicklung eines lokalen Registers; Hinterlegung und Archivierung von Rechtsdokumenten;
- Teilnahme an der Aktualisierung der rechtlichen Dokumentation des Unternehmens.
- Vorbereitung von Sitzungen und Präsentationen;

Im Allgemeinen jede Tätigkeit, die zur Erreichung des Ziels der Rechtsdirektion und der Organisation im Allgemeinen beiträgt.

Wer bist du?
Erforderliche Fähigkeiten
- Um einen Master-Abschluss in Wirtschaftsrecht OHADA zu halten
- Haben Sie ein Praktikum in einer Firma oder Anwaltskanzlei mit Erfahrung im Vertragsschreiben, der Durchführung administrativer Sorgfalt ...
- Gute Kenntnisse und Beherrschung des OHADA Wirtschaftsrechts
- Beherrschung von Office-Tools (Google, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Gute redaktionelle Qualitäten und Organisationssinn
- Interesse an Wissenschaft und Biomedizin
- Gute Rechtsetzungskapazität
- Gute Französischkenntnisse und geschätzte Englischkenntnisse

Wert:
- Geist der Synthese und Offenheit
- Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit
- Diszipliniert sein
- Reaktivität und Proaktivität
- Strenge und Diskretion
- Öffnung für Innovationen

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Billionen Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Equal Opportunity Mitarbeiter.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

En Roche LATAM Training Center , buscamos un/a Becario/a de Entrenamiento altamente motivado/a para apoyar en la gestión operativa y digital de las iniciativas de capacitación para personal interno y clientes. Esta posición ofrece una oportunidad única para desarrollarte en un entorno regional, colaborando en proyectos estratégicos de formación, adopción digital y mejora continua de la experiencia de aprendizaje.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión y Soporte: Actuar como apoyo de contacto para la revisión de incidencias técnicas en el sistema de entrenamiento interno y asegurar el correcto uso de la plataforma estándar para clientes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
El Especialista en Gestión de Pedidos será el nexo estratégico y operativo entre los clientes y la operación interna en Roche. Este rol tiene como objetivo principal manejar de manera efectiva, oportuna y precisa las órdenes de clientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio acordados y contribuyendo a una experiencia superior para el cliente en cada punto de interacción.

Responsabilidades:
Gestión de órdenes

• Supervisar y coordinar el ciclo completo de órdenes de clientes desde la recepción hasta la entrega final, garantizando la trazabilidad junto a los operadores logísticos y la alineación con las políticas internas del país.

Optimización de procesos

• Identificar e investigar oportunidades de mejora continua y mejores prácticas mediante benchmarking para rediseñar procesos, aumentar la eficiencia, reducir costos y elevar la experiencia del cliente.

Colaboración con equipos

• Trabajar con equipos multifuncionales (logística, finanzas, planificación, entre otros) para solucionar problemas operativos y optimizar el flujo de trabajo.

• Liderar la gestión del cambio a nivel interno a través de la influencia y el trabajo colaborativo, asegurando siempre la centralidad en el cliente.

Atención al cliente

• Actuar como el punto de contacto clave para atender y resolver consultas relacionadas con la gestión de órdenes.

• Garantizar una experiencia consistente, fluida y positiva para los clientes a lo largo de todo su customer journey .

Seguimiento y análisis

• Generar y analizar datos métricos de desempeño de procesos para presentar informes relevantes que impulsen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Quién Eres

• Grado universitario en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Comercio Internacional o carreras afines, con manejo avanzado o intermedio del idioma inglés.

• Experiencia o conocimiento comprobado en la gestión de clientes del sector público, con fuerte preferencia en la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica.

• Conocimiento y experiencia en gestión de pedidos y operaciones logísticas.

• Familiaridad en el uso de SAP (módulo SD) y sistemas de gestión de almacenes (WMS), junto con dominio de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Fuerte capacidad de análisis, excelentes habilidades de comunicación, sentido de urgencia y un enfoque orientado al cliente.

• Capacidad demostrada para liderar iniciativas mediante la influencia y el trabajo colaborativo.

• Disponibilidad para viajar y realizar visitas a clientes entre un 25% y 30% del tiempo laboral.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier fut

Questo è il modo in cui amiamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Impatto sostenitore
Nuestradad responsabili va más allá de innovar. Contribui a soluciones que risponde a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud minetras reducimos nuestro Impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas genericiones.

L'Oportunità
El Especialista en Gestión de Pedidos será el nexo estrategico y operativo entre los clientelas y la operaación interna en Roche. Este rol tiene como objetivo principal manejar de manera efectiva, oportuna y precisa las órdenes de clientela, asegurando el cumpliento de los niveles de servicio acordados y contribuyendo a una experiencia superior para el clientela en cada punto de interacción.

Responsabilità:
Gestión de l'órdenes

• Supervisar y coordinater el ciclo compléto de órdenes de clientelas desde la reepción hasta la entrega finale, garantizando la trazabilidad junto a los operadores logísticos y la alineación con las políticas internas del país.

Ottimizzazione dei programmi

• Identificar e investgar oportunidades de mejora continua y mejores prácticas mediante benchmarking para rediseñar procesos, aumentar la eficiencia, riduce i costi y elevar la experiencia del cliente.

Colaboración con equipaggio

• Trabajar con equipos multifuncionales (logística, finanzas, planificación, entre otros) para solucionar problemas operativos y optimizar el flujo de trabajo.

• Liderar la gestión del cambio a livello interno a traves de la influencencia y el trabajo colaborativo, asegurando siempre la centralidad en el clientela.

Atención al cliente

• Actuar como el punto de contacto clave para atender y risolver consults relacionadas con la gestión de órdenes.

• Garantizar una experiencia consisteva, fluida y positiva para los clientelas a lo largo de todo su customer journeye .

Seguimiento y análisis

• Generar y analizar datos metricos de desempeño de procesos para presentar informés rilevanties que impulson la toma de décisiones estrategicas.

Quién Eres

• Grado universitario en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Comercio Internacional o carreras afines, con manejo avanzado o intermedio del idioma inglés.

• Experiencia o conocimiento comprobado en la gestión de clientelas del settore público, con fuerte preferencia en la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica.

• Conocimiento y experimentencia en gestión de pedidos y operaciones logísticas.

• Familiaridad en el uso de SAP (módulo SD) y sistemas de gestión de almacenes (WMS), junto con dominio de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Fuerte capacidad de análisis, excelentes habilidades de comunicación, sentido de urgencia y un enfoque orientaledo al cliente.

• Capacidad demostrada para reader iniciativas mediante la influencencia y el trabajo colaborativo.

• Disponibilidad para viajar y realizar visitas a clientelas entre un 25% y 30% del tiempo laboral.

Beneficios de reubicación no available para este puesto de trabajo.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 trilioni di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Hanno costruito un più sano

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Estamos buscando um(a) Key Account Manager para atuar em nossa estrutura da Roche Diagnóstica, que será responsável por superar os objetivos comerciais por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias comerciais de impacto. É esperado que colabore ativamente para o crescimento do negócio, aplicando metas que visam garantir o sucesso e as boas vendas, a sustentabilidade do negócio, a retenção e conquista de novos clientes, além de assegurar continuamente a melhoria da experiência dos clientes com relação aos produtos e serviços, simplificando as ações e buscando impactar em curto e longo prazo.

Principais responsabilidades:

• Gestão do Relacionamento com o Cliente: Desenvolver e manter relações sólidas com clientes estratégicos, compreendendo suas necessidades e objetivos de longo prazo;

• Planejamento Estratégico: Criar planos de conta detalhados, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e alinhamento estratégico;

• Coordenação Interna: Trabalhar com equipes internas (vendas, marketing, suporte, produto, etc.) para garantir que as demandas do cliente sejam atendidas;

• Negociação e Renegociação de Contratos: Definir termos contratuais que beneficiem ambas as partes e garantir a renovação de contratos importantes;

• Monitoramento de KPIs: Acompanhar métricas de desempenho da conta, como receita, satisfação do cliente (NPS), churn rate e share of wallet;

• Identificação de Oportunidades de Expansão: Explorar possibilidades de up-selling e cross-selling dentro da conta;

• Gestão de Crises e Resolução de Problemas: Atuar proativamente na resolução de conflitos e problemas operacionais que possam impactar o relacionamento;

• NPS – Garantir que a pesquisa seja respondida pelas personas de influência e que os planos de melhoria sejam implementados.

Requisitos:

• Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Comércio ou áreas relacionadas.

• Experiência prévia como Executivo/Gerente de Contas ou posição similar.

• Habilidade comprovada em gerenciar contas estratégicas e alcance de resultados.

• Excelentes capacidades de comunicação e negociação.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes internas.

• Forte habilidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.

• Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As a Record to Report Period End Close Analyst (NAM) , you will execute core general accounting and management accounting operational activities supporting the North America (NAM) region from our Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) center in Costa Rica.
In this role, you will perform advanced accounting functions—utilizing in-depth knowledge of accounting methods, principles, and practices—while conducting complex analysis, reconciliations, and audits of financial transactions and processes across the NAM affiliate landscape.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting & Auditing Excellence: Lead complex accounting analysis and month-end close activities, acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned NAM affiliates and a technical resource for team members.

• Financial Reporting & Statements: Prepare and review a variety of complex financial/cost reports, trial balances, balance sheets, and P&L statements.

• General Ledger & Journal Entries: Execute month-end journal entries, ensuring accurate cost allocations, supporting audit trails, and proper ledger maintenance.

• Financial Commentary & Variance Analysis: Provide meaningful commentary on financial statements, investigate balance discrepancies, and present actionable recommendations to finance leadership.

• Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Ensure all systems and procedures strictly comply with company policies, US GAAP/IFRS, and regulatory standards while supporting internal training and process optimization.

Who You Are:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related business field.

• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of direct experience in General Ledger, Operational Accounting, or Month-End Close functions.

• Technical ERP Knowledge: Hands-on experience with SAP modules (e.g., FI, CO, FA, MM) and financial close management tools (e.g., BlackLine ).

• Core Accounting Skills: Solid understanding of financial principles (US GAAP / IFRS), financial statements, and audit requirements within a Shared Services environment.

• English: Advanced/Fluent English is a MUST (written and spoken) for daily collaboration with US/NAM stakeholders and leadership.

• AI & Data Analytics Skills: Experience or strong interest in leveraging AI tools, advanced analytics, automation (e.g., Power BI, Alteryx, Python, macros), or process digitalization to streamline reporting and workflows..

• Certifications: Professional accounting certifications (e.g., CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) are highly desirable.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche-assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 40% travel. This person will support Memphis, TN (Ideal candidate to live in Memphis, TN or 20 miles away)

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tennessee is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Are you ready to apply?

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Support Network offre un'opportunità emozionante per le persone che sono appassionati di problem solving. In qualità di azienda sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche è dedicata alla scoperta, allo sviluppo e alla fornitura di prodotti diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi. Con un impegno per lo sviluppo dei dipendenti e un ambiente di lavoro che valorizza il rispetto e l'empowerment, Roche offre interessanti prospettive di carriera per coloro che cercano di avere un impatto significativo sulla cura dei pazienti.

L'opportunità:

Roche Support Network è dedicata a fornire un supporto eccezionale ai clienti. Come specialista di ingegneria del campo, Lei sarà:

• Mostra la tua esperienza nella riparazione tecnica per le linee di prodotto assegnate Roche.

• Offri un prezioso servizio ai clienti di laboratorio nel tuo territorio assegnato.

• Fornire supporto tecnico di routine, servizio in loco e riparazione dei prodotti Roche.

• servire come contatto con il cliente per problemi tecnici e legati al servizio e eseguire la manutenzione preventiva.

• diagnosticare e risolvere guasti meccanici, hardware, software e sistema.

• documentare tutte le attività, contribuire al miglioramento della qualità e concentrarsi sulla massimizzazione della soddisfazione del cliente.

Questo ruolo sul campo richiede fino al 40% di viaggio. Questa persona sosterrà Memphis, TN (Ideal candidato a vivere a Memphis, TN o 20 miglia di distanza)

Chi sei?

• Diploma di scuola superiore e 2 anni di scuola tecnica o di formazione militare equivalente o esperienza lavorativa equivalente

• 5 anni di progressiva esperienza di riparazione o manutenzione hardware e software meccanico/sistema, o networking/wireless networking O una laurea in ingegneria biomedica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica, chimica o campo correlato più 1-2 anni di esperienza progressiva riparazione o manutenzione complessa hardware e software meccanico/sistema, o networking/wireless networking

• Formazione o certificazione con successo come definito dalla Leadership e dalla politica dei Servizi RD

• Capacità di viaggiare, tra cui alcuni viaggi notturni, è richiesto

Preferiti:

• 8+ anni di esperienza progressiva o di laurea in un campo rilevante più 4+ anni di esperienza progressiva sono necessari.

• Conoscenza avanzata di elettronica, sistemi elettromeccanici, tecnologia dell'informazione e chimica di base.

• La capacità di servire come risorsa tecnica interna, fornire supporto dopo le ore e nei fine settimana / festivi, e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti è essenziale.

I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione principale del Tennessee è 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annuale. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante.
Vantaggi

Sei pronto a candidarti?

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Support Network bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit für Menschen, die sich für Problemlösungen begeistern. Als forschungsorientiertes Gesundheitsunternehmen widmet sich Roche der Entdeckung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung innovativer Diagnostik- und Therapieprodukte. Mit einem Engagement für die Mitarbeiterentwicklung und einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Respekt und Empowerment wertschätzt, bietet Roche spannende Karriereperspektiven für diejenigen, die einen signifikanten Einfluss auf die Patientenversorgung haben wollen.

Die Gelegenheit:

Roche Support Network widmet sich der außergewöhnlichen Unterstützung der Kunden. Als Field Engineering Specialist werden Sie:

• Präsentieren Sie Ihre Expertise in der technischen Reparatur von Roche-zugeordneten Produktlinien.

• Bieten Sie Laborkunden in Ihrem zugewiesenen Gebiet einen wertvollen Service.

• Routinemäßiger technischer Support, Service vor Ort und Reparatur von Roche Produkten.

• als Kundenkontakt für technische und servicerelevante Fragen dienen und vorbeugende Wartungsarbeiten durchführen.

• Diagnose und Behebung von mechanischen, Hardware-, Software- und Systemfehlern.

• alle Aktivitäten dokumentieren, zur Qualitätsverbesserung beitragen und sich auf die Maximierung der Kundenzufriedenheit konzentrieren.

Diese feldbasierte Rolle erfordert bis zu 40% Reisen. Diese Person wird Memphis, TN (Ideal Kandidat in Memphis, TN oder 20 Meilen entfernt leben) unterstützen

Wer Du bist:

• Abitur und 2 Jahre technische Schule oder gleichwertige militärische Ausbildung oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung

• 5 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Reparatur oder Wartung von mechanischer / System-Hardware und -Software oder Vernetzung / drahtlose Vernetzung ODER ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Biomedizinischer Technik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Chemie oder verwandten Bereichen plus 1-2 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Reparatur oder Wartung komplexer mechanischer / System-Hardware und -Software oder Netzwerk / drahtlose Vernetzung

• Erfolgreiches Training oder Zertifizierung gemäß Definition von RD Services Leadership und Policy

• Reisefähigkeit, einschließlich einiger Übernachtreisen, ist erforderlich

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• 8+ Jahre progressive Erfahrung oder ein Bachelor-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich plus 4+ Jahre progressive Erfahrung sind erforderlich.

• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Elektronik, elektromechanischen Systemen, Informationstechnologie und Grundlagenchemie.

• Die Fähigkeit, als interne technische Ressource zu dienen, Unterstützung nach Stunden und an Wochenenden / Feiertagen zu bieten und starke Kundenbeziehungen zu pflegen, ist unerlässlich.

Umzugsleistungen sind für diese Stellenausschreibung nicht verfügbar.

Die erwartete Gehaltsspanne für diese Position basierend auf dem primären Standort von Tennessee ist 71.100.00 - 132.000,00 USD Jährlich. Die tatsächliche Bezahlung wird auf der Grundlage von Erfahrung, Qualifikationen, geografischer Lage und anderen gesetzlich zulässigen arbeitsbezogenen Faktoren festgelegt. Ein diskretionärer Jahresbonus kann auf der Grundlage der Leistung des Einzelnen und des Unternehmens verfügbar sein. Diese Position qualifiziert sich auch für die unter dem unten angegebenen Link aufgeführten Vorteile.
Vorteile

Sind Sie bereit, sich zu bewerben?

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Roche Support Network offre une opportunité passionnante aux personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes. En tant qu'entreprise de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche se consacre à la découverte, au développement et à la fourniture de diagnostics et de produits thérapeutiques innovants. Avec un engagement envers le perfectionnement des employés et un milieu de travail qui valorise le respect et l'autonomisation, Roche offre des perspectives de carrière stimulantes à ceux qui cherchent à avoir un impact significatif sur les soins aux patients.

La possibilité :

Roche Support Network se consacre à fournir un soutien exceptionnel aux clients. En tant que spécialiste en génie de terrain, vous :

• Montrez votre expertise en réparation technique pour les lignes de produits affectées par Roche.

• Offrez un service précieux aux clients de laboratoire sur votre territoire.

• Fournir un soutien technique de routine, un service sur place et la réparation des produits Roche.

• servir de contact client pour les questions techniques et de service et effectuer l'entretien préventif.

• diagnostiquer et résoudre les défaillances mécaniques, matérielles, logicielles et système.

• documenter toutes les activités, contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité et se concentrer sur la maximisation de la satisfaction des clients.

Ce rôle sur le terrain nécessite jusqu'à 40 % de déplacements. Cette personne soutiendra Memphis, TN (candidat idéal pour vivre à Memphis, TN ou à 20 milles de distance)

Qui vous êtes :

• Diplôme d'études secondaires et 2 années d'études techniques ou d'instruction militaire équivalente ou expérience de travail équivalente

• 5 ans d'expérience progressive de réparation ou d'entretien du matériel et des logiciels mécaniques/systèmes, ou de réseautage/réseau sans fil OU un baccalauréat en génie biomédical, génie mécanique, génie électrique, chimie ou domaine connexe plus 1-2 ans d'expérience progressive de réparation ou d'entretien du matériel et des logiciels mécaniques/systèmes complexes, ou de réseautage/réseau sans fil

• Formation ou certification réussies selon la définition de leadership et de politique des services de RD

• La capacité de voyager, y compris certains voyages de nuit, est requise

Qualifications préférées :

• 8+ années d'expérience progressive ou un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent plus 4+ années d'expérience progressive sont nécessaires.

• Connaissance avancée de l'électronique, des systèmes électromécaniques, des technologies de l'information et de la chimie de base.

• La capacité de servir de ressource technique interne, de fournir un soutien après les heures de travail et les week-ends et les vacances, et de maintenir de solides relations avec la clientèle est essentielle.

Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation.

L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste en fonction de l'emplacement principal du Tennessee est de 71 100,00 - 132 000,00 USD Chaque année. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi permis par la loi. Une prime annuelle discrétionnaire peut être offerte en fonction des performances individuelles et de l'entreprise. Ce poste est également admissible aux avantages décrits au lien ci-dessous.
Avantages

Êtes-vous prêt à postuler?

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

jobs.title: Lead Field Engineering Specialist - California/Nevada
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Are you an expert in technical problem-solving with a passion for mentoring? We're looking for a Lead Field Engineer Specialist to be a critical resource for our team and customers in California/Nevada. This is a self-supervised role where you'll use your expert-level technical skills to resolve complex issues and improve efficiency.

• Act as the go-to subject matter expert for our products, providing high-level support for installation, maintenance, and repair

• Lead the development of training and mentorship plans for new hires and junior engineers

• Use your independent judgment to analyze regional and customer needs , proactively solving complex problems before, during, and after the installation process

• Serve as a leader in managing escalations and guiding the local team through critical technical issues to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction

• Provide strategic leadership and direction to your team, referring only the most complex issues to senior leadership

Who You Are:

• An associate’s degree in Electronics, Information Technology, Medical Technology or related field or equivalent military training is required

• 8+ years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 4+ years/Master’s degree in Management, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 2+ years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Prior experience in coaching/mentoring junior level staff

• Prior leadership or lead worker experience and proven success in overseeing and guiding a work team’s functional activities

Preferred Requirements:

• Excellent analytical, problem analysis, and decision-making skills

• Effective planning, organizational, and time management skills

• Successfully completes training and certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, and information technology, with the ability to communicate knowledge to lower-level staff

• Highly effective written/verbal communication, organization and prioritization skills

• Highly effective customer service skills, including leadership, negotiation, persuasion and conflict resolution skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role that requires up to 60% overnight travel. This includes overnight travel throughout the week; some holidays and weekends may be required. Ideal candidate to reside in California or Nevada

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of California / Nevada is $78,100 - $145,000 USD annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.title: Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
The Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry is specialized in launching, selling and promoting our breakthrough Mass Spectrometry solution to customers in the territory. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Accounts are key, highly strategic, and have complex requirements.

Responsible for significant key partner relationship management and development strategy for strategic accounts and ensures the strategy is executed. Sells the company's products or services to new accounts and/or expands existing accounts. Responsible for the development of new business opportunities or emerging areas. Focuses on critical, large, complex, highly visible, strategic or tactically important accounts. Develops and presents comprehensive financial proposals and contracts which enhance profitability and protect margins. Works in coordination with Account Managers to call on prospective and current customers. Conducts demonstration sessions on product characteristics. Involves technical personnel to resolve customer issues and problems as needed. May participate in the establishment of sales targets and design of the territory's sales plan, manages sales expenses.

Has broad expertise or unique knowledge in the lab testing segment and specific LC/MS experience is preferred. Uses skills to contribute to development of company objectives and principles and to achieve goals in creative and effective ways. Viewed as an expert by the company and in the field. Has complete knowledge of all Mass Spectrometry products and services and may be tasked with sales/development of new or strategic products. Works on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles. Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Creates formal networks involving coordination among groups.

This is a field based role. The territory is South East region. You must live in the territory to be considered for this role.

Job Facts:

• Manages and leads the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives for highly strategic accounts

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Retains, extends, and acquires customers through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and builds strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Overnight travel as needed, including short notice, to most effectively and efficiently cover territory while maximizing customer facing time.

• Navigates the financial landscape of complex health systems, helping them to maximize their capital budget cycles to achieve growth goals

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Specialista del Conto Regionale - Spettrometria di Massa

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

L'opportunità:
Il Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry è specializzato nel lanciare, vendere e promuovere la nostra soluzione Mass Spectrometry innovativa ai clienti del territorio. Attuazione piani di vendita progettati per raggiungere i ricavi consolidati e obiettivi finanziari. I conti sono fondamentali, altamente strategici e hanno requisiti complessi.

Responsabile di una significativa strategia di gestione e sviluppo delle relazioni con i partner chiave per i conti strategici e garantisce l'esecuzione della strategia. Vende i prodotti o servizi dell'azienda a nuovi account e/o amplia i conti esistenti. Responsabile per lo sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business o aree emergenti. Si concentra su conti critici, grandi, complessi, altamente visibili, strategici o tatticamente importanti. Sviluppa e presenta proposte finanziarie e contratti completi che migliorano la redditività e proteggono i margini. Funziona in coordinamento con Account Manager per chiamare i clienti potenziali e attuali. Conduce sessioni dimostrative sulle caratteristiche del prodotto. Invola il personale tecnico per risolvere i problemi e i problemi del cliente come necessario. Può partecipare alla creazione di obiettivi di vendita e progettazione del piano di vendita del territorio, gestisce le spese di vendita.

Ha una vasta esperienza o una conoscenza unica nel segmento di test di laboratorio e l'esperienza specifica LC/MS è preferita. Utilizza le competenze per contribuire allo sviluppo di obiettivi e principi aziendali e per raggiungere gli obiettivi in modi creativi ed efficaci. Visto come esperto della società e del settore. Ha la conoscenza completa di tutti i prodotti e servizi Mass Spectrometry e può essere incaricato di vendite / sviluppo di prodotti nuovi o strategici. Funziona su questioni significative e uniche in cui l'analisi di situazioni o dati richiede una valutazione di immateriali. Esercizi giudizio indipendente in metodi, tecniche e criteri di valutazione per ottenere risultati. Crea reti formali che coinvolgono il coordinamento tra i gruppi.

Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo. Il territorio è la regione sud-orientale. È necessario che nel territorio sia considerato per questo ruolo.

Fatti di lavoro:

• Gestisce e guida lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di vendita di attrezzature di capitale per raggiungere obiettivi di vendita assegnati per conti altamente strategici

• Fornisce leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite equilibrata, nella penetrazione continua del conto e nella soddisfazione del cliente.

• Utilizza la forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e l'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le preoccupazioni del cliente.

• Mantiene, estende e acquisisce i clienti attraverso un'efficace identificazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni.

• Stabilisce e costruisce forti relazioni con i clienti che permettono la crescita, la redditività e la prevedibilità. Comunica con altre funzioni Roche rilevanti per garantire il supporto di vendita necessario e la consegna di programmi / prodotti.

• Pernottamento di viaggio secondo necessità, tra cui breve preavviso, per coprire in modo più efficace ed efficiente il territorio, massimizzando il tempo di affrontare il cliente.

• Naviga il paesaggio finanziario di complessi sistemi sanitari, aiutandoli a massimizzare i loro cicli di budget di capitale per raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita

Die Position
Spezialist für regionale Konten - Massenspektrometrie

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Gelegenheit:
The Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry ist spezialisiert auf die Einführung, den Verkauf und die Förderung unserer bahnbrechenden Mass Spectrometry-Lösung für Kunden in diesem Gebiet. Implementiert Verkaufspläne, die darauf abzielen, festgelegte Umsatz- und Finanzziele zu erreichen. Konten sind wichtig, hochstrategisch und haben komplexe Anforderungen.

Verantwortlich für wichtige wichtige Partnerbeziehungsmanagement- und Entwicklungsstrategie für strategische Konten und stellt sicher, dass die Strategie umgesetzt wird. Verkauft die Produkte oder Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens an neue Konten und / oder erweitert bestehende Konten. Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten oder aufstrebender Bereiche. Konzentriert sich auf kritische, große, komplexe, gut sichtbare, strategische oder taktisch wichtige Konten. Entwickelt und präsentiert umfassende Finanzvorschläge und Verträge, die die Rentabilität verbessern und die Margen schützen. Arbeitet in Abstimmung mit Account Managern, um potenzielle und aktuelle Kunden anzusprechen. Führt Demonstrationssitzungen zu Produkteigenschaften durch. Beauftragt das technische Personal, Kundenprobleme und -probleme nach Bedarf zu lösen. Kann an der Festlegung von Verkaufszielen und der Gestaltung des Verkaufsplans des Territoriums teilnehmen, verwaltet die Verkaufskosten.

Hat breites Fachwissen oder einzigartiges Wissen im Labortestsegment und spezifische LC / MS-Erfahrung wird bevorzugt. Verwendet Fähigkeiten, um zur Entwicklung von Unternehmenszielen und -prinzipien beizutragen und Ziele auf kreative und effektive Weise zu erreichen. Als Experte vom Unternehmen und auf dem Gebiet angesehen. Hat vollständige Kenntnisse aller Massenspektrometrie-Produkte und -Dienstleistungen und kann mit dem Verkauf / der Entwicklung neuer oder strategischer Produkte beauftragt werden. Arbeitet an wichtigen und einzigartigen Themen, bei denen die Analyse von Situationen oder Daten eine Bewertung der immateriellen Werte erfordert. Übt ein unabhängiges Urteil in Methoden, Techniken und Bewertungskriterien, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Schafft formale Netzwerke, die die Koordination zwischen Gruppen beinhalten.

Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle. Das Gebiet ist Region Südosten. Sie müssen auf dem Territorium für diese Rolle in Betracht gezogen werden.

Job Facts:

• Verwaltet und leitet die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsstrategien für Investitionsgüter, um zugewiesene Verkaufsziele für hochstrategische Konten zu erreichen

• Bietet professionelle Führung bei der Planung, Organisation und Steuerung eines ausgewogenen Umsatzwachstums, einer kontinuierlichen Kontodurchdringung und der Kundenzufriedenheit.

• Nutzt starkes Produkt- / Marktwissen und Verkaufserfahrung, um komplexe Verkäufe zu verwalten und Kundenfragen und -anliegen zu lösen.

• Behält, erweitert und akquiriert Kunden durch effektive Identifizierung von Chancen und die Erstellung und Implementierung von Lösungen.

• Etabliert und baut starke Kundenbeziehungen auf, die Wachstum, Rentabilität und Vorhersagbarkeit ermöglichen. Kommuniziert mit anderen relevanten Roche-Funktionen, um die erforderliche Verkaufsunterstützung und Lieferung von Programmen / Produkten sicherzustellen.

• Übernachtungsreisen nach Bedarf, einschließlich kurzfristiger Reisen, um das Territorium effektiv und effizient abzudecken und gleichzeitig die Zeit der Kunden zu maximieren.

• Navigiert durch die Finanzlandschaft komplexer Gesundheitssysteme und hilft ihnen, ihre Kapitalhaushaltszyklen zu maximieren, um Wachstumsziele zu erreichen

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

La possibilité :
Le spécialiste de compte régional - spectrométrie de masse est spécialisé dans le lancement, la vente et la promotion de notre solution de spectrométrie de masse révolutionnaire aux clients du territoire. Mettre en oeuvre des plans de vente conçus pour atteindre les objectifs financiers et financiers établis. Les comptes sont essentiels, hautement stratégiques et comportent des exigences complexes.

Responsable de la gestion des relations avec les partenaires clés et de la stratégie de développement des comptes stratégiques et s'assure que la stratégie est exécutée. Vend les produits ou services de l'entreprise à de nouveaux comptes et/ou élargit les comptes existants. Responsable du développement de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires ou de nouveaux domaines. Se concentre sur des comptes critiques, grands, complexes, très visibles, stratégiques ou d'importance tactique. Élaborer et présenter des propositions et des contrats financiers complets qui améliorent la rentabilité et protègent les marges. Travaille en coordination avec les gestionnaires de comptes pour faire appel aux clients potentiels et actuels. Organisation de séances de démonstration sur les caractéristiques du produit. Implique du personnel technique pour résoudre les problèmes des clients au besoin. Peut participer à l'établissement des objectifs de vente et à la conception du plan de vente du territoire, gère les frais de vente.

A une vaste expertise ou des connaissances uniques dans le segment des essais en laboratoire et l'expérience spécifique de CL/SM est préférée. Considéré comme un expert par l'entreprise et dans le domaine. A une connaissance complète de tous les produits et services de spectrométrie de masse et peut être chargé de la vente ou du développement de produits nouveaux ou stratégiques. C'est un rôle sur le terrain. Le territoire est sud-est. Vous devez aimer sur le territoire être considéré pour ce rôle.

Faits sur l'emploi :

• Gérer et diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de vente d'équipement pour atteindre les objectifs de vente assignés pour des comptes hautement stratégiques

• Fournir un leadership professionnel dans la planification, l'organisation et le contrôle de la croissance équilibrée des ventes, la pénétration continue des comptes et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

• Utilise une solide connaissance des produits/marchés et une expérience de vente pour gérer les ventes complexes et résoudre les questions et les préoccupations des clients.

• Conserve, étend et acquiert des clients en identifiant efficacement les opportunités et en créant et en mettant en œuvre des solutions.

• Établir et établir de solides relations avec les clients qui permettent la croissance, la rentabilité et la prévisibilité. Communique avec d'autres fonctions pertinentes de Roche afin d'assurer le soutien des ventes et l'exécution des programmes et des produits nécessaires.

• Voyages de nuit au besoin, y compris un court préavis, pour couvrir le territoire le plus efficacement et efficacement tout en maximisant le temps face au client.

• Navigue le paysage financier des systèmes de santé complexes, les aidant à maximiser leurs cycles budgétaires d'immobilisations pour atteindre leurs objectifs de croissance

jobs.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D Instrumentation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We have an exciting opportunity for a Solution Architect to join our Diagnostics R&D Instrumentation team. We are looking for a highly motivated individual with strong leadership skills, hands-on experience and a strategic architecture mindset and a proven track record of transforming complex scientific demands into scalable, production-grade software and data ecosystems.

The Opportunity:
In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge science and enterprise engineering - breaking down data silos, optimizing high-throughput AI/ML pipelines, and championing FAIR data principles across our global research environment.

Your responsibilities include:

• Solution Design: architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective hybrid-cloud solutions tailored to complex scientific business needs, that consolidate fragmented R&D silos into machine-ready "Data Product" ecosystems with automated data lineage.

• Technical Leadership : guide development teams in cloud-native application implementation, system migration, and advanced pipeline re-engineering.

• Data Strategy & FAIR Principles: design conceptual/logical data models and FAIR-compliant APIs to ensure experimental and formulation data is Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable.

• Ensure Quality : define non-functional requirements and review implementations to identify gaps between design and code. Establish comprehensive observability standards to maintain the health and performance of distributed systems.

• Technology Evangelism : educate teams on architecture best practices, enterprise frameworks, and emerging technologies

• Stakeholder Management : partner with business stakeholders and scientists to gather and document detailed requirements and manage this input in the product backlog.

• Experimentation : Drive the prototyping phase, connecting all stakeholders and key actors to provide a proof of concept.

• Cross-functional : Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, product management, and development, to ensure alignment and successful integration

Who you are:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, systems analysis, or a related study

• 7+ years of relevant experience (software development, cloud, integration, architecture design), or similar experience.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in the following areas/technologies:

• AI/ML Workflows & Orchestration: high-throughput pipeline development, specifically utilizing Nextflow orchestration and containerization.

• Cloud computing (e.g., AWS)

• High-Throughput Pipelines

• Observability (e.g. Icinga, Grafana, Prometheus)

• Event-Driven Architecture and Data Mesh

• 3+ proven experience with Diagnostics solutions or life sciences research environments, or similar background:

• Digital Pathology architecture, integrations within complex scientific data ecosystems.

• Applying AI/LLMs to improve Diagnostics workflows and business processes.

• Experience working in agile teams and bridging the "requirements gap" between scientific demand and engineering output.

• Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to challenge status-quo data silos and influence cross-functional leadership.

• Strong logical, analytical, and problem-resolution skills tailored to highly complex, GxP-compliant research environments.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Arizona, is $116,900 - $217,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qua
