titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file de l'excellence opérationnelle de la CDD

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
CSD Operational Excellence Lead

Who We Are:
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all.

As part of Roche Information Solution (RIS), Global Customer Support (GCS) is the global organization responsible for technical services in the Roche Diagnostics Division. GCS builds a worldwide network of support and training centers, which educate and provide assistance to local and regional service staff in the Roche Diagnostics affiliates and its external distributors.

The Opportunity:
In this position, you will serve as the Primary Technical Authority and Operational Driver for the NALA CSD Chapter. While the Chapter Lead manages the overarching business strategy and affiliate relationships, you will be the technical expert who "owns the work."
You will be responsible for the technical execution, process automation, and operational delivery of our primary product, navify LabOps (nLO), as well as other digital healthcare products within the Roche portfolio, for upgrades and new implementations across the Americas. By acting as the bridge between complex technical realities and business goals, you will direct our regional delivery teams, ensuring high-quality, standardized, and automated technical delivery.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Own end-to-end technical delivery of CSD projects across NAM and LATAM, serving as the ultimate escalation point for complex technical risks, with accountability for success metrics and timely resolution.

• Define and monitor operational KPIs (system utilization, delivery speed, quality indicators) through structured bi-weekly engagement with delivery teams, translating metrics into continuous improvement actions.

• Drive technical standardization across all CSDs and regions to ensure consistent quality, repeatable processes, and predictable outcomes in project delivery.

• Lead Factory Automation initiatives that radically enhance scalability and efficiency—evaluate, implement, and monitor adoption of tailored tools (iSync, Docufy, performance lab replacements) to measurably increase delivery speed.

• Serve as primary technical interface to cross-functional stakeholders—confidently engage with delivery teams, PMOs, Scrum Masters, and developers to enforce technical standards and accountability.

• Manage technical budget oversight , approving tool, delivery, and PMO expenses to ensure alignment with strategic priorities and financial constraints.

• Act as technical translator bridging product teams, PMOs, the Chapter Lead, and regional IT managers—ensure clarity, alignment, and informed decision-making across organizational silos.

• Mentor and unblock regional delivery teams by removing technical roadblocks, facilitating skill development, and championing modern, agile practices within the hubs.

• Forecast technical capacity and strategically allocate engineers and analysts across regional hubs to optimize resource utilization and project success.

• Promote CSD adoption and global alignment by leveraging technical credibility to build trust with local affiliates, identify cross-regional collaboration opportunities with EMEA, and drive consistent technical strategy globally.

Who You Are:
You are a deeply technical expert who thrives in an operational leadership role. You have the hands-on knowle

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Piombo di eccellenza operativa CSD

Chi siamo:
A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti e siamo senza paura sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti.

Nell'ambito di Roche Information Solution (RIS), Global Customer Support (GCS) è l'organizzazione globale responsabile dei servizi tecnici nella divisione diagnostica Roche. GCS costruisce una rete mondiale di centri di supporto e formazione, che educano e forniscono assistenza al personale di servizio locale e regionale nelle affiliate di Roche Diagnostics e dei suoi distributori esterni.

L'opportunità:
In questa posizione, servirai come Autorità Tecnica Primaria e Driver Operativo per il Capitolo CSD NALA. Mentre il Capitolo Lead gestisce la strategia aziendale e i rapporti di affiliazione, sarai l'esperto tecnico che "ha lasciato il lavoro".
Sarete responsabili per l'esecuzione tecnica, l'automazione dei processi e la consegna operativa del nostro prodotto primario, navify LabOps (nLO), così come altri prodotti sanitari digitali all'interno del portafoglio Roche, per aggiornamenti e nuove implementazioni in tutte le Americhe. Agendo come ponte tra realtà tecniche complesse e obiettivi aziendali, dirigerete i nostri team di consegna regionali, garantendo consegne tecniche di alta qualità, standardizzate e automatizzate.

Ruoli e responsabilità chiave:

• Consegna tecnica end-to-end di progetti CSD in NAM e LATAM, servendo come punto di escalation finale per i rischi tecnici complessi, con responsabilità per metriche di successo e risoluzione tempestiva.

• Definire e monitorare i KPI operativi (utilizzo del sistema, velocità di consegna, indicatori di qualità) attraverso il coinvolgimento bi-settimanale strutturato con i team di consegna, traducendo metriche in azioni di miglioramento continuo.

• Guidare la standardizzazione tecnica in tutte le CSD e regioni per garantire una qualità coerente, processi ripetibili e risultati prevedibili nella consegna del progetto.

• Iniziative di Lead Factory Automation che migliorano radicalmente la scalabilità e l'efficienza—valutare, implementare e monitorare l'adozione di strumenti su misura (iSync, Docufy, sostituzioni di laboratorio di prestazioni) per aumentare notevolmente la velocità di consegna.

• Servire come interfaccia tecnica primaria per gli stakeholder interfunzionali – confidenza con i team di consegna, PMO, Scrum Masters e gli sviluppatori per rispettare gli standard tecnici e la responsabilità.

• Gestisci la supervisione del bilancio tecnico, approvando gli strumenti, la consegna e le spese PMO per garantire l'allineamento con priorità strategiche e vincoli finanziari.

• Agire come traduttori tecnici che corrompono i team di prodotti, i PMO, il Capitolo Lead e i responsabili IT regionali – assicurano chiarezza, allineamento e decision-making informato su silos organizzativi.

• Mentore e sbloccare i team di consegna regionali rimuovendo i blocchi tecnici, facilitando lo sviluppo delle abilità e sostenendo pratiche moderne e agili all'interno dei hub.

• Previsione della capacità tecnica e allocare strategicamente ingegneri e analisti attraverso hub regionali per ottimizzare l'utilizzo delle risorse e il successo del progetto.

• Promuovere l'adozione di CSD e l'allineamento globale sfruttando la credibilità tecnica per costruire la fiducia con le affiliate locali, identificare le opportunità di collaborazione interregionale con EMEA e guidare una strategia tecnica coerente a livello globale.

Chi sei?
Sei un esperto profondamente tecnico che prospera in un ruolo di leadership operativa. Tu hai le mani in mano

• Servir d'interface technique principale pour les intervenants interfonctionnels – s'engager avec des équipes de prestation, des OGP, des Scrum Masters et des développeurs pour faire respecter les normes techniques et la responsabilisation.

• Gérer la supervision du budget technique, approuver l'outil, l'exécution et les dépenses du BGP pour assurer l'alignement sur les priorités stratégiques et les contraintes financières.

• Agir en tant que traducteur technique qui relie les équipes de produits, les OGP, le chef de chapitre et les gestionnaires régionaux de la TI – assurer la clarté, l'alignement et la prise de décisions éclairées dans tous les silos organisationnels.

• Mentor et débloquer les équipes régionales d'exécution en éliminant les obstacles techniques, en facilitant le développement des compétences et en défendant les pratiques modernes et agiles au sein des pôles.

• Prévision de la capacité technique et affectation stratégique des ingénieurs et des analystes dans les centres régionaux pour optimiser l'utilisation des ressources et la réussite des projets.

• Promouvoir l'adoption de la CDD et l'alignement mondial en tirant parti de la crédibilité technique pour renforcer la confiance avec les affiliés locaux, identifier les possibilités de collaboration interrégionale avec l'EMEA et mener une stratégie technique cohérente à l'échelle mondiale.

Qui vous êtes :
Vous êtes un expert profondément technique qui prospère dans un rôle de leadership opérationnel. Vous avez le savoir pratique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Regional Business Manager- South Central - Near Patient Care

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

This is a field based role- The region covers Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi. You must live within the territory to be considered for this role.

Job Facts
The Regional Business Manager manages the sale of the company’s products or services to specific existing named or strategic accounts on a geographic basis. Manages a defined sales territory to achieve sales and financial targets in accordance with the company's strategic goals. Manages a staff of Account Executives and Strategic Account Executive and participates in the establishment of sales and financial goals for a given territory, designing and ensuring implementation of sales plans to achieve these goals. Responsible for hiring, terminating and implementing disciplinary decisions affecting employees. Interacts with sales leadership to communicate sales performance in territory, and cooperates with Marketing to implement promotional strategies and to monitor competitor's activities.

Assist Senior Leadership in overall operations of assigned department(s). Contributes and achieves results through the management of subordinates (professional and support staff). Establishes and manages the department's budget and all assigned resources. Provides leadership to ensure department objectives and goals are achieved. Directs and implements tactical plans. Has full discretion on all employment decisions for department staff including hiring, training, performance management, and progressive disciplinary actions.

Job Facts

• Selects, trains, and provides ongoing feedback to direct reports via direct observation, meetings, and evaluations.

• Assumes a leadership role in establishing and maintaining long-term relationships with key high value customers to continually enhance overall revenues.

• Promotes cross-divisional communication, strategy, and tactical planning to maximize revenue generation.

• Understands market conditions and trends, develops long term strategies, and provides recommendations to high level management which may include the creation and delivery of presentations.

• Provides necessary administrative reports while overseeing budgets and expenses.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s Degree required

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience with demonstrated success

• 1-2 years

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Regional Business Manager- South Central - Vicino alla cura del paziente

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

L'opportunità
In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro dove sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana.

Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo La regione copre Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi. Dovete vivere nel territorio da considerare per questo ruolo.

Fatti di lavoro
Il Regional Business Manager gestisce la vendita dei prodotti o dei servizi della società a specifici account denominati o strategici esistenti su base geografica. Gestisce un territorio di vendita definito per raggiungere obiettivi di vendita e finanziari in conformità con gli obiettivi strategici dell'azienda. Gestisce uno staff di Amministratori di Account e Esecutivo di Account Strategico e partecipa alla creazione di obiettivi di vendita e finanziari per un determinato territorio, progettando e garantendo l'attuazione dei piani di vendita per raggiungere questi obiettivi. Responsabile per l'assunzione, la cessazione e l'attuazione di decisioni disciplinari riguardanti i dipendenti. Interagisce con la leadership di vendita per comunicare le prestazioni di vendita in territorio, e collabora con Marketing per implementare strategie promozionali e per monitorare le attività dei concorrenti.

Assistere la leadership senior nelle operazioni generali del reparto assegnato. Contribuisce e raggiunge i risultati attraverso la gestione dei subordinati (personale professionale e di supporto). Stabilisce e gestisce il bilancio del dipartimento e tutte le risorse assegnate. Fornisce la leadership per garantire obiettivi e obiettivi di reparto sono raggiunti. Dirige e attua piani tattici. Ha piena discrezione su tutte le decisioni di lavoro per il personale del dipartimento, tra cui l'assunzione, la formazione, la gestione delle prestazioni e azioni disciplinari progressive.

Fatti di lavoro

• Selezioni, treni e fornisce un feedback continuo alle relazioni dirette tramite osservazione diretta, riunioni e valutazioni.

• Assume un ruolo di leadership nel stabilire e mantenere relazioni a lungo termine con i clienti di alto valore chiave per migliorare continuamente i ricavi globali.

• Promuove la comunicazione trasversale, la strategia e la pianificazione tattica per massimizzare la generazione dei ricavi.

• Comprende le condizioni di mercato e le tendenze, sviluppa strategie a lungo termine e fornisce raccomandazioni alla gestione di alto livello che possono includere la creazione e la consegna di presentazioni.

• Fornisce relazioni amministrative necessarie durante la supervisione di bilanci e spese.

• Responsabile del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso azioni quotidiane.

Chi sei

• Corso di laurea richiesto

• 3+ anni di vendite rilevanti o esperienza equivalente con successo dimostrato

• 1-2 anni

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Regional Business Manager - South Central - Nahe Patientenversorgung

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Chance
Als forschungsorientiertes Gesundheitsunternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik- und Therapieprodukte und -dienstleistungen an, die Patienten und medizinischem Fachpersonal erhebliche Vorteile bieten - von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zu Diagnose, Behandlung und Behandlungsüberwachung. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe Ihres Karrierewegs vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und schätzen unsere Mitarbeiter. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl, geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt zu werden, eine tägliche Erfahrung ist.

Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle- Die Region umfasst Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana und Mississippi. Sie müssen innerhalb des Territoriums leben, um für diese Rolle in Betracht gezogen zu werden.

Job Fakten
Der Regional Business Manager verwaltet den Verkauf der Produkte oder Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens an bestimmte bestehende benannte oder strategische Konten auf geografischer Basis. Verwaltet ein definiertes Verkaufsgebiet, um Umsatz- und Finanzziele in Übereinstimmung mit den strategischen Zielen des Unternehmens zu erreichen. Verwaltet ein Personal von Account Executives und Strategic Account Executive und beteiligt sich an der Festlegung von Verkaufs- und Finanzzielen für ein bestimmtes Gebiet, die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsplänen, um diese Ziele zu erreichen. Verantwortlich für die Einstellung, Beendigung und Umsetzung von Disziplinarentscheidungen, die Mitarbeiter betreffen. Interagiert mit der Vertriebsleitung, um die Verkaufsleistung im Gebiet zu kommunizieren, und kooperiert mit dem Marketing, um Werbestrategien umzusetzen und die Aktivitäten der Wettbewerber zu überwachen.

Unterstützen Sie Senior Leadership bei den Gesamtoperationen der zugewiesenen Abteilungen. Trägt bei und erzielt Ergebnisse durch das Management von Untergebenen (professionelles und unterstützendes Personal). Erstellt und verwaltet das Budget der Abteilung und alle zugewiesenen Ressourcen. Bietet Führung, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ziele und Ziele der Abteilung erreicht werden. Leitet und implementiert taktische Pläne. Hat volle Diskretion bei allen Beschäftigungsentscheidungen für Abteilungsmitarbeiter, einschließlich Einstellung, Schulung, Leistungsmanagement und progressive Disziplinarmaßnahmen.

Job Fakten

• Auswählt, trainiert und liefert fortlaufendes Feedback zu direkten Berichten über direkte Beobachtung, Besprechungen und Auswertungen.

• Übernahme einer Führungsrolle bei der Etablierung und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden mit hohem Wert, um den Gesamtumsatz kontinuierlich zu steigern.

• Fördert bereichsübergreifende Kommunikation, Strategie und taktische Planung, um die Umsatzgenerierung zu maximieren.

• Versteht Marktbedingungen und Trends, entwickelt langfristige Strategien und gibt Empfehlungen an das Management auf hoher Ebene, die die Erstellung und Bereitstellung von Präsentationen umfassen können.

• Bietet notwendige Verwaltungsberichte, während Budgets und Ausgaben überwacht werden.

• Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des Qualitätssystems und die Erreichung der Qualitätsziele durch tägliches Handeln.

Wer du bist

• Bachelor-Abschluss erforderlich

• 3+ Jahre relevante Verkäufe oder gleichwertige Erfahrung mit nachgewiesenem Erfolg

• 1-2 Jahre
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Gestionnaire d'affaires régional - Centre-Sud - Près des patients

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

L'opportunité
En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui apportent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans des domaines d'intérêt qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre réussite et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne.

Il s'agit d'un rôle sur le terrain. La région couvre le Texas, l'Oklahoma, l'Arkansas, la Louisiane, le Mississippi. Vous devez vivre sur le territoire pour être considéré pour ce rôle.

Faits sur l'emploi
Le directeur d'entreprise régional gère la vente des produits ou services de l'entreprise à des comptes désignés ou stratégiques spécifiques sur une base géographique. Gère un territoire de vente défini pour atteindre les objectifs financiers et commerciaux conformément aux objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise. Gère un personnel de dirigeants de comptes et de dirigeants de comptes stratégiques et participe à l'établissement d'objectifs financiers et de vente pour un territoire donné, en concevant et en assurant la mise en oeuvre de plans de vente pour atteindre ces objectifs. Responsable de l'embauche, du licenciement et de la mise en oeuvre des décisions disciplinaires touchant les employés. Interagit avec le leadership des ventes pour communiquer les performances des ventes sur le territoire, et coopère avec Marketing pour mettre en œuvre des stratégies promotionnelles et surveiller les activités des concurrents.

Aider le leadership supérieur dans l'ensemble des activités des ministères affectés. Contribue et obtient des résultats par la gestion de subordonnés (personnel professionnel et de soutien). Établir et gérer le budget du ministère et toutes les ressources affectées. Assurer le leadership pour s'assurer que les objectifs et les buts du Ministère sont atteints. Dirige et met en œuvre des plans tactiques. Avoir toute latitude sur toutes les décisions d'emploi du personnel du ministère, y compris l'embauche, la formation, la gestion du rendement et les mesures disciplinaires progressives.

Faits sur l'emploi

• Sélectionne, forme et fournit une rétroaction continue pour diriger les rapports par l'observation directe, les réunions et les évaluations.

• Suppose un rôle de leadership dans l'établissement et le maintien de relations à long terme avec des clients clés de haute valeur afin d'accroître continuellement les revenus globaux.

• Promouvoir la communication interdivisions, la stratégie et la planification tactique pour maximiser la production de revenus.

• Comprendre les conditions et les tendances du marché, élaborer des stratégies à long terme et formuler des recommandations à l'intention de la haute direction, y compris la création et la prestation de présentations.

• Fournit les rapports administratifs nécessaires tout en surveillant les budgets et les dépenses.

• Responsable du maintien et de l'amélioration continue du système de qualité et de la réalisation des objectifs de qualité par des actions quotidiennes.

Qui vous êtes

• Diplôme requis

• 3 ans et plus ventes pertinentes ou expérience équivalente avec succès démontré

• 1-2 ans

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Ophthalmology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Title: Patient Journey Partner (PJP) – Ophthalmology
Location: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India

As a Patient Journey Partner ,you will be responsible for creating value across the healthcare ecosystem by partnering with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders to improve patient outcomes. You will work in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment, leveraging customer insights to address unmet needs and enhance the patient journey.
Your Key Responsibilities

• Develop a deep understanding of the local healthcare ecosystem and customer needs.

• Build trusted partnerships with ophthalmologists, retina specialists, hospitals, and other healthcare stakeholders.

• Drive scientific and value-based engagements while ensuring the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Identify opportunities to improve patient access and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement sustainable solutions.

• Execute territory plans using customer insights, data, and agile ways of working.

• Collaborate closely with Medical, Marketing, Market Access, and other internal partners to deliver meaningful customer and patient outcomes.
Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medicine, or a related discipline; MBA is preferred.

• 2–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.

• Experience in Ophthalmology or Specialty Care is preferred.

• Strong customer engagement, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

• Learning agility, digital mindset, and a passion for improving patient outcomes.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Ubicazione: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India

In qualità di Partner del Viaggio Paziente, sarai responsabile per la creazione di valore in tutto l'ecosistema sanitario collaborando con i professionisti sanitari e altri stakeholder per migliorare i risultati dei pazienti. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e interfunzionale, sfruttando le informazioni dei clienti per soddisfare le esigenze non soddisfatte e migliorare il viaggio del paziente.
Le tue responsabilità chiave

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dell'ecosistema sanitario locale e delle esigenze dei clienti.

• Costruire partnership affidabili con oftalmologi, specialisti della retina, ospedali e altri stakeholder sanitari.

• Guidare gli impegni scientifici e basati sul valore, garantendo al contempo i più elevati standard di etica, integrità e conformità.

• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'accesso dei pazienti e collaborare con i team interfunzionali per implementare soluzioni sostenibili.

• Eseguire i piani del territorio utilizzando le intuizioni dei clienti, i dati e i modi agili di lavorare.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con medico, marketing, accesso al mercato e altri partner interni per fornire risultati significativi del cliente e del paziente.
Chi sei

• Laurea in Farmacia, Scienze della vita, Medicina, o una disciplina relativa; MBA è preferito.

• 2-6 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o sanitario.

• L'esperienza in oftalmologia o Specialty Care è preferita.

• Forte impegno del cliente, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di comunicazione.

• Dimostrata capacità di lavorare in collaborazione in team interfunzionali.

• Agilità di apprendimento, mentalità digitale, e una passione per migliorare i risultati dei pazienti.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

You will work in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment, leveraging customer insights to address unmet needs and enhance the patient journey.
Your Key Responsibilities

• Develop a deep understanding of the local healthcare ecosystem and customer needs.

• Build trusted partnerships with ophthalmologists, retina specialists, hospitals, and other healthcare stakeholders.

• Drive scientific and value-based engagements while ensuring the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Identify opportunities to improve patient access and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement sustainable solutions.

• Execute territory plans using customer insights, data, and agile ways of working.

• Collaborate closely with Medical, Marketing, Market Access, and other internal partners to deliver meaningful customer and patient outcomes.
Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medicine, or a related discipline; MBA is preferred.

• 2–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.

• Experience in Ophthalmology or Specialty Care is preferred.

• Strong customer engagement, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

• Learning agility, digital mindset, and a passion for improving patient outcomes.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Job Title: Patient Journey Partner (PJP) – Ophthalmologie
Standort: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, Indien

Als Patient Journey Partner sind Sie für die Wertschöpfung im gesamten Gesundheitsökosystem verantwortlich, indem Sie mit medizinischen Fachkräften und anderen Interessengruppen zusammenarbeiten, um die Patientenergebnisse zu verbessern. Sie arbeiten in einer hochgradig kooperativen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung und nutzen Kundeninformationen, um unerfüllte Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen und die Patientenreise zu verbessern.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis des lokalen Gesundheitsökosystems und der Kundenbedürfnisse.

• Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Partnerschaften mit Augenärzten, Netzhautspezialisten, Krankenhäusern und anderen Interessengruppen im Gesundheitswesen.

• Förderung wissenschaftlicher und wertorientierter Engagements bei gleichzeitiger Gewährleistung höchster Standards in Bezug auf Ethik, Integrität und Compliance.

• Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung des Patientenzugangs und Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Umsetzung nachhaltiger Lösungen.

• Führen Sie Gebietspläne mit Kundeninformationen, Daten und agilen Arbeitsweisen aus.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Medizin, Marketing, Marktzugang und anderen internen Partnern, um sinnvolle Kunden- und Patientenergebnisse zu liefern.
Wer du bist

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Pharmazie, Life Sciences, Medizin oder einer verwandten Disziplin; MBA wird bevorzugt.

• 2-6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- oder Gesundheitsbranche.

• Erfahrung in der Augenheilkunde oder Specialty Care wird bevorzugt.

• Starke Kundenbindung, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Lernen Agilität, digitale Denkweise und eine Leidenschaft für die Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Titre du poste: Partenaire de voyage patient (PJP) – Ophtalmologie
Lieu: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, Inde

En tant que partenaire de voyage pour les patients, vous serez responsable de créer de la valeur dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème de santé en collaborant avec les professionnels de la santé et d'autres intervenants afin d'améliorer les résultats des patients. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et interfonctionnel, en tirant parti des points de vue des clients pour répondre aux besoins non satisfaits et améliorer le cheminement des patients.
Vos principales responsabilités

• Développer une compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème de santé local et des besoins des clients.

• Établir des partenariats de confiance avec les ophtalmologistes, les spécialistes de la rétine, les hôpitaux et d'autres intervenants en santé.

• Encourager les engagements scientifiques et fondés sur la valeur tout en assurant les normes les plus élevées en matière d'éthique, d'intégrité et de conformité.

• Identifier les occasions d'améliorer l'accès des patients et collaborer avec les équipes interfonctionnelles pour mettre en œuvre des solutions durables.

• Exécuter des plans de territoire en utilisant les informations client, les données et les façons agiles de travailler.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires médicaux, marketing, accès au marché et d'autres partenaires internes afin d'obtenir des résultats significatifs pour les clients et les patients.
Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat en pharmacie, sciences de la vie, médecine ou une discipline connexe; MBA est préféré.

• 2 à 6 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou la santé.

• L'expérience en ophtalmologie ou en soins spécialisés est préférée.

• Fort engagement des clients, gestion des intervenants et compétences en communication.

• Capacité démontrée de travailler en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Apprendre l'agilité, l'état d'esprit numérique et une passion pour améliorer les résultats des patients.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
En tant que FMI - Chef de Produit (d/f/m), vous intégrez l’équipe marketing responsable des activités de diagnostic moléculaire au sein de Roche Diagnostic France et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le/la responsable des solutions de séquençage. Vous êtes en charge de la gestion du cycle de vie d’une nouvelle gamme de produits FMI (Fondation médecine) intégrés dans la filiale et des lancements qui complètent cette gamme. Vous êtes le point de contact privilégié pour toutes questions expertes sur les produits de cette gamme. Vous collaborez avec vos homologues au niveau régional/groupe et participez à des projets en lien avec votre expertise.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez un réseau de leaders d’opinion autour de cette gamme

• Vous possédez une connaissance intime des enjeux du marché et des besoins des clients sur cette offre et savez démontrer sa valeur ajoutée

• Vous initiez et gérez des actions de Co marketing en collaboration avec notre partenaire (l'Institut Gustave Roussy) pour donner de la visibilité à ce partenariat et supporter le développement du business

• Vous êtes en charge d’élaborer le plan marketing annuel pour votre gamme et d'en assurez le suivi en lien avec les informations fournies par le groupe

• Vous mettez en place des plans d’actions correctives et tactiques pour garantir une expérience et satisfaction client optimum sur votre gamme

• Vous gérez le cycle de vie des produit/solutions (lancement, prévisions de commandes, plan d’obsolescence ..), en assurez la promotion par des contenus adaptés aux différents supports de communication et mesurez l’impact de ces campagnes.

• Vous suivez l’évolution de la croissance de votre gamme en terme de revenu et proposez des actions correctives si besoin

• Vous produisez des indicateurs clés de performance et les suivez en permanence afin d’ajuster la stratégie marketing et d'accroître la satisfaction client sur le produit

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous avez une formation supérieur scientifique/médicale complétée par une formation management/marketing

• Vous avez une expérience reconnue en marketing produit, techniques marketing et l'établissement de business models

• Vous êtes autonome et possédez des capacités d’innovation, d’anticipation, d’analyse et de synthèse

• Vous démontrez une aisance relationnelle, la capacité de fédérer et d'influencer, vous aimez communiquer à l’écrit et à l’oral

• Une bonne connaissance du marché et des parcours patients en oncologie serait un réel atout

• Enfin, votre niveau d'Anglais est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Service Partner Manager - Indianapolis, IN

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network (RSN) offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:
To accomplish the obligations of this role, the Service Partner Manager will act in line with the Roche core competencies and leadership commitments. This individual brings knowledge of RSN operational and service delivery areas and collaborates with the business to establish partnerships and supplier relationships that enable cost effective, efficient, and high quality service delivery. The Supplier Manager serves as an ambassador for the Roche Support Network's brand and expectations for service excellence by role modeling a growth mindset, creative competencies, and a strong service, customer-focused drive. This position holds a key role for driving and fostering a positive team spirit and an excellent working environment in the Roche Support Network.
As the Service Partner Manager, you will:

• plan, manage and control business processes related to suppliers to ensure a coherent price-performance ratio and fulfillment of their contractual obligations.

• initiate and support a tendering process in coordination with procurement and

• supervise the selection process and subsequent contracting. Development of Strategic Partnering Models—moving from transactional "vending" to "outcome-based" service contracts.

• inform suppliers about the forecasted workload and agree on budgets and service requirements.

• oversee the invoicing process and adherence of the budget.

• provide the supplier with a service requirement catalog which details obligations and expectations regarding business objectives, KPIs and a communication and escalation plan.

• ensure an outstanding customer experience and the reaching of other defined business objectives by monitoring, controlling and facilitating operational processes and adherence to quality standards.

• monitor daily operations and the performance of the supplier based on available data and take action where needed.

• ensure agreed performance targets are achieved by controlling and discussing KPIs while having a deep understanding of the mechanisms behind, to be able to suggest corrective actions in case of deviations.

• ensure a high service quality by applying, supervising and supporting quality management measures in alignment with the Roche quality policy.

• implement and develop an effective supplier quality management system and by controlling strong adherence to processes and compliant documentation. Agree on an action plan with the supplier if issues need to be addressed.

• identify training needs for new services, products and processes as well as in case of quality deviations and organize respective (refresher) training courses.

• build a high performance team culture with suppliers to achiev

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Service Partner Manager - Indianapolis, IN

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Roche Support Network (RSN) offre un'opportunità emozionante per le persone che sono appassionati di problem solving. In qualità di azienda sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche è dedicata alla scoperta, allo sviluppo e alla fornitura di prodotti diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi. Con un impegno per lo sviluppo dei dipendenti e un ambiente di lavoro che valorizza il rispetto e l'empowerment, Roche offre interessanti prospettive di carriera per coloro che cercano di avere un impatto significativo sulla cura dei pazienti.

L'opportunità:
Per adempiere agli obblighi di questo ruolo, il Service Partner Manager agirà in linea con le competenze di base Roche e gli impegni di leadership. Questo individuo porta la conoscenza delle aree operative e di servizio RSN e collabora con l'azienda per stabilire partnership e rapporti di fornitore che consentono la fornitura di servizi efficienti, efficienti e di alta qualità. Il Fornitore Manager funge da ambasciatore per il marchio Roche Support Network e le aspettative per l'eccellenza del servizio modellando una mentalità di crescita, competenze creative e un servizio forte, orientato al cliente. Questa posizione ha un ruolo chiave per guidare e promuovere uno spirito di squadra positivo e un ambiente di lavoro eccellente nella Roche Support Network.
In qualità di Service Partner Manager,:

• pianificare, gestire e controllare i processi aziendali relativi ai fornitori per garantire un rapporto di prezzo-performance coerente e l'adempimento dei loro obblighi contrattuali.

• avviare e sostenere un processo di appalto in coordinamento con gli appalti e

• supervisionare il processo di selezione e il successivo contratto. Sviluppo di Modelli di Partnering Strategici – passando da contratti di servizio "vending" transazionale a "outcome-based".

• informare i fornitori circa il carico di lavoro previsto e concordare su budget e requisiti di servizio.

• supervisionare il processo di fatturazione e l'adesione del bilancio.

• fornire al fornitore un catalogo dei requisiti di servizio che dettaglia gli obblighi e le aspettative per gli obiettivi aziendali, i KPI e un piano di comunicazione e di escalation.

• garantire un'esperienza clienti eccezionale e il raggiungimento di altri obiettivi aziendali definiti monitorando, controllando e facilitando i processi operativi e rispettando gli standard di qualità.

• monitorare le operazioni giornaliere e le prestazioni del fornitore in base ai dati disponibili e agire laddove necessario.

• garantire obiettivi di performance concordati sono raggiunti controllando e discutendo i KPI, pur avendo una profonda comprensione dei meccanismi dietro, per essere in grado di suggerire azioni correttive in caso di deviazioni.

• garantire un'alta qualità del servizio applicando, supervisionando e sostenendo misure di gestione della qualità in linea con la politica di qualità Roche.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Medical Copywriter , you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solutions Centre, developing medical writing and digital content solutions for our business partners. You will play a key role in formulating and identifying current and future content needs while supporting various content creation initiatives.

Working alongside senior medical writers, you will help ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support efficient, cost-effective writing activities aligned with business needs. As part of the medical copy and content team within our Global Digital Hub, you will contribute to generating high-quality commercial content for diverse digital formats—including emails, videos, banners, infographics, and websites—that supports Roche's global communication strategies.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Develop your expertise through continuous learning, mentorship programs, and training to build comprehensive knowledge of Roche's therapeutic areas and enhance your medical writing capabilities

• Create medical content across multiple formats and digital channels, including patient information, HCP educational materials (slides, posters, speaker briefs), conference presentations, newsletters, medical reports, and public relations materials

• Master content briefs by identifying key components, asking probing questions, and proactively flagging potential issues that could affect delivery

• Deliver publication-ready quality through high-level self-editing, accurate referencing, and marked-up packs that maintain source authenticity and authority

• Manage concurrent projects across diverse therapeutic areas, adhering to regulatory frameworks while meeting agreed timelines and deadlines

• Collaborate creatively with internal teams, clients, and stakeholders to develop compelling content and contribute innovative ideas that add measurable value

• Prepare content for approval in VVPM, including comprehensive referencing

• Demonstrate excellence in communication through professional liaison with team members, healthcare professionals, and key stakeholders

Who You Are

Required Experience & Profile:

• Bachelor's degree in medical sciences or a related field

• 0–2 years of experience in medical writing, communications, or a similar role (internships and academic projects are valued)

• Native-level written and spoken English; fluency in Spanish, Italian, German, or French is a significant advantage

• Exceptional attention to detail with a commitment to scientific rigor, consistency, and clarity

• Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proven ability to interpret data and understand complex scientific information

• Proficiency with standard IT applications, including Google Suite

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and business stakeholders

• Natural communicator and relationship builder with strong interpersonal skills

• Customer-service mentality with a can-do attitude

• Growth-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and emerging technologies

• Accountable, focused, and precise in your approach to work

• Quick learner with adaptability to changing priorities and environments

Ready to Join Our Team?

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Come copywriter medico, supporterete il crescente team di scrittura medica all'interno di Roche Services & Solutions Centre, sviluppando soluzioni di scrittura medica e di contenuto digitale per i nostri partner commerciali. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella formulazione e nell'identificazione delle esigenze attuali e future dei contenuti, supportando diverse iniziative di creazione di contenuti.

Lavorando a fianco di scrittori medici senior, vi aiuterà a garantire l'implementazione efficace di risorse e strumenti per supportare attività di scrittura efficienti e convenienti allineate alle esigenze aziendali. Nell'ambito del team di copia e contenuti medicali all'interno del nostro Global Digital Hub, contribuirai a generare contenuti commerciali di alta qualità per diversi formati digitali, tra cui e-mail, video, banner, infografica e siti web, che supportano le strategie di comunicazione globali di Roche.

L'opportunità

In questo ruolo, voi:

• Sviluppa la tua esperienza attraverso l'apprendimento continuo, programmi di mentorship e formazione per costruire una conoscenza completa delle aree terapeutiche di Roche e migliorare le tue capacità di scrittura medica

• Creare contenuti medici in più formati e canali digitali, tra cui informazioni sul paziente, materiali didattici HCP (slidi, manifesti, brevi altoparlanti), presentazioni di conferenze, newsletter, report medici e materiali di pubbliche relazioni

• Brevetti di contenuti master identificando i componenti chiave, ponendo domande probing, e segnalando proattivamente potenziali problemi che potrebbero influenzare la consegna

• Fornire la qualità di pubblicazione pronta attraverso auto-editing di alto livello, arbitraggio accurato e marcati pacchetti che mantengono l'autenticità e l'autorità della fonte

• Gestire i progetti concomitanti in diverse aree terapeutiche, attenendosi ai quadri normativi e rispettando i termini e le scadenze concordate

• Collaborare creativamente con team interni, clienti e stakeholder per sviluppare contenuti convincenti e contribuire idee innovative che aggiungono valore misurabile

• Preparare il contenuto per l'approvazione in VVPM, compreso il rinvio completo

• Dimostrare l'eccellenza nella comunicazione attraverso il collegamento professionale con i membri del team, i professionisti del settore sanitario e i principali stakeholder

Chi sei

Esperienza e profilo richiesti:

• Laurea in scienze mediche o un campo correlato

• 0-2 anni di esperienza nella scrittura medica, nelle comunicazioni o in un ruolo simile (gli stage e i progetti accademici sono valutati)

• Inglese di livello nativo scritto e parlato; la fluenza in spagnolo, italiano, tedesco o francese è un vantaggio significativo

• Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli con impegno a rigore scientifico, consistenza e chiarezza

• Forte gestione del tempo e competenze organizzative, con la capacità di priorizzare i compiti in un ambiente frenetico

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale

• Prova capacità di interpretare i dati e comprendere informazioni scientifiche complesse

• Competenza con applicazioni IT standard, tra cui Google Suite

• Mindset collaborativo con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in diversi team e stakeholder aziendali

• Trasmettitore naturale e costruttore di relazioni con forti abilità interpersonali

• mentalità del servizio clienti con un atteggiamento can-do

• mentalità orientata alla crescita con la passione per il miglioramento continuo e le tecnologie emergenti

• Contabili, focalizzati e precisi nel tuo approccio al lavoro

• Imparante veloce con adattabilità alle mutevoli priorità e ambienti

Pronto ad entrare nel nostro team?

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
En tant que rédacteur médical, vous accompagnerez l'équipe croissante de rédaction médicale au sein du Roche Services & Solutions Centre, développant des solutions de rédaction médicale et de contenu numérique pour nos partenaires commerciaux. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la formulation et l'identification des besoins actuels et futurs en matière de contenu tout en appuyant diverses initiatives de création de contenu.

En travaillant avec des rédacteurs médicaux chevronnés, vous contribuerez à assurer le déploiement efficace des ressources et des outils pour soutenir des activités de rédaction efficaces et rentables qui répondent aux besoins des entreprises. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de copie médicale et de contenu au sein de notre Global Digital Hub, vous contribuerez à la production de contenu commercial de haute qualité pour divers formats numériques, dont les courriels, les vidéos, les bannières, les infographies et les sites Web, qui soutiennent les stratégies de communication mondiale de Roche.

L'opportunité

Dans ce rôle, vous :

• Développez votre expertise grâce à l'apprentissage continu, aux programmes de mentorat et à la formation pour acquérir une connaissance complète des domaines thérapeutiques de Roche et améliorer vos capacités de rédaction médicale

• Créer du contenu médical sur plusieurs formats et canaux numériques, y compris de l'information sur les patients, du matériel éducatif HCP (diapositives, affiches, exposés), des présentations de conférences, des bulletins d'information, des rapports médicaux et du matériel de relations publiques

• Sommaires de contenu principal en identifiant les éléments clés, en posant des questions de sondage et en signalant de façon proactive les problèmes potentiels qui pourraient avoir une incidence sur la prestation

• Fournir une qualité prête à la publication grâce à des trousses d'auto-édition, de référencement précis et de marquage qui maintiennent l'authenticité et l'autorité de la source

• Gérer des projets concomitants dans divers domaines thérapeutiques, en respectant les cadres réglementaires tout en respectant les échéances et les délais convenus

• Collaborer de façon créative avec les équipes internes, les clients et les intervenants pour élaborer un contenu convaincant et apporter des idées novatrices qui ajoutent une valeur mesurable

• Préparer le contenu pour approbation en VVPM, y compris le renvoi complet

• Démontrer l'excellence de la communication par la liaison professionnelle avec les membres de l'équipe, les professionnels de la santé et les principaux intervenants

Qui vous êtes

Expérience et profil requis :

• Licence en sciences médicales ou dans un domaine connexe

• 0–2 ans d'expérience en rédaction médicale, en communication ou dans un rôle semblable (les stages et les projets universitaires sont valorisés)

• Niveau autochtone écrit et parlé anglais; la maîtrise de l'espagnol, de l'italien, de l'allemand ou du français est un avantage important

• Une attention exceptionnelle au détail avec un engagement à la rigueur scientifique, la cohérence et la clarté

• Forte capacité de gestion du temps et d'organisation, avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches dans un environnement rapide

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale

• Capacité éprouvée d'interpréter les données et de comprendre des informations scientifiques complexes

• Compétence avec les applications informatiques standard, y compris Google Suite

• L'esprit de collaboration avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre diverses équipes et intervenants commerciaux

• Communicateur naturel et bâtisseur de relations avec des compétences interpersonnelles fortes

• La mentalité du service à la clientèle avec une attitude de can-do

• Un état d'esprit axé sur la croissance avec une passion pour l'amélioration continue et les technologies émergentes

• Comptable, concentré et précis dans votre approche du travail

• Apprentissage rapide avec adaptabilité à l'évolution des priorités et des environnements

Prêt à rejoindre notre équipe?

Si vous êtes un professionnel motivé désireux de lancer votre carrière dans l'écriture médicale et faire un imp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Te unirás al equipo de Commercial Finance en Roche Diagnostics Chile, trabajando junto a cinco colegas senior y reportando directamente a nuestro Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) Lead. En este rol, colaborarás de cerca con los equipos locales de Ventas y Marketing, así como con nuestro Centro de Servicios Compartidos en Costa Rica y Hungría. Nuestra misión es impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio mediante la entrega de insights financieros y propuestas ejecutables que guíen las decisiones comerciales clave.

La oportuniidad

• Apoyar el análisis financiero de las ofertas a clientes, ayudando a evaluar márgenes de rentabilidad y entregando la información basada en datos necesaria para optimizar las propuestas comerciales.

• Preparar reportes financieros mensuales y analizar datos clave, destacando proactivamente las desviaciones financieras y proponiendo posibles acciones correctivas para ayudar a cumplir los objetivos financieros.

• Contribuir a los proyectos de mejora de procesos de negocio, identificando oportunidades de automatización y potenciando el uso de IA para lograr procesos financieros más rápidos y precisos.

• Gestionar el mantenimiento de los datos maestros de precios y contratos en SAP, asegurando la precisión y consistencia de la información.

Quién eres

• Titulado/a universitario/a en Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería o una carrera afín.

• 1 a 2 años de experiencia laboral en análisis financiero, planificación de negocios (business planning) o contabilidad.

• Inglés nivel avanzado

• Experiencia trabajando con MS Office y, de preferencia, conocimientos de SAP.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, con la capacidad de traducir datos financieros en insights claros y sencillos para los socios comerciales.

• Sólidas habilidades analíticas y cuantitativas, con una gran capacidad para "conectar los puntos" entre los datos financieros y el rendimiento del negocio.

• Actitud proactiva para resolver problemas, con una alta motivación por aprender, adaptarse y crecer dentro de un entorno dinámico.

Nota: Si tu CV es preseleccionado, el siguiente paso en nuestro proceso de selección será una invitación a participar en una evaluación en video (video assessment), la cual se realizará tanto en inglés como en español.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Biospecimen Associate III in Pleasanton, California, you will manage critical biological assets that serve as the foundation for the research, development, and validation of diagnostic products . You will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, ensuring the availability and integrity of these specimens to play a key role in advancing diagnostic innovation . Joining our team means collaborating with diverse stakeholders to maintain the highest standards of quality while navigating technical challenges with minimal supervision .

The Opportunity

• Manage the life cycle of biospecimens by receiving, storing, retrieving, and distributing physical biological samples with minimal supervision .

• Perform essential laboratory tasks, including sample aliquoting and pooling .

• Interface directly with our validated digital tracking systems to create, update, and maintain meticulous sample data records .

• Oversee the physical inventory of biospecimens, conduct routine storage monitoring, and manage laboratory supplies .

• Prepare samples for global shipments and maintain a strict chain of custody to meet complex shipping requirements .

• Collaborate cross-functionally with user groups and stakeholders to hit project timelines, resolve service requests, and meet customer commitments .

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies alongside subject matter experts to maintain total data validity .

• Propose innovative solutions to workflow bottlenecks, support continuous improvement efforts, and actively assist with safety, quality, and regulatory audits .

Who you are

• You hold an Associate degree in a biological discipline (or related field) plus 3 years of relevant work experience, or a Bachelor’s degree in a biological discipline or related field .

• You are a detail-oriented, self-motivated individual who works well with minimal supervision and communicates effectively across diverse, fast-paced teams .

• You are fully willing and able to work with potentially infectious biological material, dry ice, -80 degree freezers, and liquid nitrogen .

• You are proficient with MS Excel, Google Suite, and digital laboratory tracking systems, demonstrating a strong commitment to data validity and good documentation practices .

• You can follow complex instructions, stand for long periods, lift up to 30 lbs, climb ladders, and comfortably work in cold storage environments with limited daylight .

Preferred

• You have experience handling biological specimens and ideally bring prior biobanking or inventory management experience .

• You have practical experience working in a BSL 2 Laboratory .

• You are organized, adaptable, and meticulous, with a results-oriented mindset .

• You are capable of handling multiple projects concurrently and operating efficiently within a fast-paced, dynamic environment .

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Biospecimen Associate III in Pleasanton, California, you will manage critical biological assets that serve as the foundation for the research, development, and validation of diagnostic products . You will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, ensuring the availability and integrity of these specimens to play a key role in advancing diagnostic innovation . Joining our team means collaborating with diverse stakeholders to maintain the highest standards of quality while navigating technical challenges with minimal supervision .

The Opportunity

• Manage the life cycle of biospecimens by receiving, storing, retrieving, and distributing physical biological samples with minimal supervision .

• Perform essential laboratory tasks, including sample aliquoting and pooling .

• Interface directly with our validated digital tracking systems to create, update, and maintain meticulous sample data records .

• Oversee the physical inventory of biospecimens, conduct routine storage monitoring, and manage laboratory supplies .

• Prepare samples for global shipments and maintain a strict chain of custody to meet complex shipping requirements .

• Collaborate cross-functionally with user groups and stakeholders to hit project timelines, resolve service requests, and meet customer commitments .

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies alongside subject matter experts to maintain total data validity .

• Propose innovative solutions to workflow bottlenecks, support continuous improvement efforts, and actively assist with safety, quality, and regulatory audits .

Who you are

• You hold an Associate degree in a biological discipline (or related field) plus 3 years of relevant work experience, or a Bachelor’s degree in a biological discipline or related field .

• You are a detail-oriented, self-motivated individual who works well with minimal supervision and communicates effectively across diverse, fast-paced teams .

• You are fully willing and able to work with potentially infectious biological material, dry ice, -80 degree freezers, and liquid nitrogen .

• You are proficient with MS Excel, Google Suite, and digital laboratory tracking systems, demonstrating a strong commitment to data validity and good documentation practices .

• You can follow complex instructions, stand for long periods, lift up to 30 lbs, climb ladders, and comfortably work in cold storage environments with limited daylight .

Preferred

• You have experience handling biological specimens and ideally bring prior biobanking or inventory management experience .

• You have practical experience working in a BSL 2 Laboratory .

• You are organized, adaptable, and meticulous, with a results-oriented mindset .

• You are capable of handling multiple projects concurrently and operating efficiently within a fast-paced, dynamic environment .

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance
